Benefit: A kindred summon monster spell has a chance of failure equal to 30% + 10% per spell level of the metamagic cost reduction, as summarized in the following table. If the summoning fails, that daily use of the spell-like ability is lost.
Chance of Failure | Chance of Success | Metamagic   Cost
40% | 60% | -1 level
50% | 50% | -2 levels
60% | 40% | -3 levels
70% | 30% | -4 levels
80% | 20% | -5 levels
For example, a summon monster VII spell used as a 4th level spell-like ability has only a 40% chance of succeeding.
Metamagic Cost: By reduced spell level; see above.
Source: Outsiders’ summon demons ability, etc.

sections.heading: Summon Undead                                               [Evil, Metamagic, Necromancy]
sections.text:
Prerequisite: Command Undead feat.
Benefit: This feat is applied to the summon seed. Instead of a specific outsider or other extra-planar being, the spell summons a specific undead creature. (Incorporeal undead seem to come drifting in through the walls or out of the air, corporeal undead come crawling up out of the ground, etc.; regardless of the visual effect, the undead are actually summoned, and the mechanical aspects of those rules apply.)
The school of the spell changes from Conjuration to Necromancy.
Metamagic Cost: +1 level.
Source: This feat, combined with the Variable Spell (select from menu) and Ritual Spell (for full-round casting) feats, allows the simulation of the summon undeadLM spells.

sections.heading: Summoning, ImbuedPHII                                       [Conjuration, Metamagic]
sections.text:
Your summoning spells gain an element of surprise. You can summon creatures that come into existence with the benefit of a spell such as invisibility.
Prerequisite: Conjurer or Spell Focus (conjuration).
Benefit: When you cast a spell from the summoning sub-school, you can choose to grant the summoned creature(s) the benefit of any spell of 3rd level or lower you can cast that has a range of touch. You cast the spell you wish to grant the creature (using a prepared spell or a spell slot as appropriate) at the same time you cast your summoning spell; the casting time is equal to the greater of the two spells’. The creature gains the benefit of the spell when it appears.
Metamagic Cost: +1 level.

sections.heading: Tenacious Spell [Metamagic]
sections.text:
Benefit: Whenever a tenacious spell would otherwise end due to a dispel or remove condition effect, the magic is instead only suppressed for 1 round per caster level of the dispeller. Dispelling or otherwise removing the effect while it is suppressed causes the end of that spell effect.
Suppressed rounds do not count against the spell’s duration, but once it resumes, the magic still ends when its duration expires. You can also dismiss or dispel your own magic normally.
Metamagic Cost: +1 level.
Special: If you apply this feat to a latent spell such as an alarm, symbol, or other magic trap (Cf. Delay Spell), after the latent spell is discharged, you can choose to re-invest the latent spell numen to re-set the effect.

sections.heading: Tenuous Spell [Metamagic]
sections.text:
Benefit: This feat can only be applied to a spell that allows a saving throw to avoid an effect lasting more than 1 round. A tenuous spell allows a new saving throw each round.
If the spell has an ongoing, reduced effect even on a failed save (q.v. Fell Condition), two consecutive successful saves end that secondary effect as well.
Special: In some cases, this feat can also be used in creating spells whose effects end if some other reasonably likely event occurs (Cf. detect evil, mirror image, scrying, et al.). Those types are usages are general reserved for game designers and must be adjudicated very carefully if requested by others.
Metamagic Cost: -1 level.
Thanatopic SpellUM                                      [Metamagic, Necromancy]
Your spells can pierce wards against negative energy or even affect undead targets.
Prerequisite: Knowledge (the planes) 6 ranks.
Benefit: A thanatopic spell pierces defenses that protect against [death] effects (including negative levels and energy drain) and negative energy. For example, you could cast a thanatopic vampiric touch or enervation on a target under the effects of death ward and they would suffer the normal effect of the spell. Saving throws and SR (if any) still apply.
Undead are susceptible to spells augmented by this feat, as it “retunes” the negative energy to be harmful to them. A thanatopic spell that would kill a living creature (such as by giving it negative levels equal to its hit dice) destroys an undead (ghosts, liches, vampires, etc. can reform).
Metamagic Cost: +2 levels.
Normal: Defenses such as death ward negate death effects, negative levels, and energy drain. Undead are immune to these attacks.
Threnodic SpellUM                                     [Metamagic, Necromancy]
Prerequisite: Knowledge (the planes) 6 ranks.
Benefit: This feat works only on [mind-affecting] spells, spells that target attributes (penalty, damage, or drain), or other spells that undead are normally immune to. A threnodic spell affects undead creatures (even mindless undead) as if they weren't immune to these effects, but has no effect on living creatures. Cf. Coaxing Spell (q.v.).
Metamagic Cost: +0 levels. If you increase the cost to +2 levels (essentially removing the implied “Creature-Specific Spell” metamagic of this feat), the spell affects both living and undead targets normally.
Synergy: If you also apply the Irresistible Spell feat (q.v.), you can modify the effect to include constructs rather than undead.
Normal: Undead and constructs are immune to [mind-affecting] spells and effects, and to attribute penalties, damage, and drain.

sections.heading: Transdimensional SpellCA                          [Conjuration, Metamagic]
sections.text:
You can cast spells that affect targets lurking in coexistent planes and extradimensional spaces whose entrances fall within the spell's area.
Prerequisites: Able to cast Conjuration spells; Knowledge (the planes) 1 rank, Planar Sense 1 rank.
Benefit: A transdimensional spell has its full normal effect on incorporeal creatures, creatures on the Ethereal Plane or the Plane of Shadow, and creatures within an extradimensional space in the spell's area. Such creatures include ethereal creatures, creatures that are blinking or shadow walking, manifested ghosts, and creatures within the extradimensional space of a rope trick, portable hole, or familiar pocket. You must be able to perceive a creature to target it with a transdimensional spell, but you do not need to perceive a creature to catch it in the area of a burst, cone, emanation, or spread.
Metamagic Cost: +1 level. If the spell only affects incorporeal creatures and not material ones, the level cost is instead -1, as if the Creature-Specific Spell feat (q.v.) had also been applied.
Normal: Only ghost touch or [force] spells and effects can affect ethereal creatures, and no Material Plane attack affects creatures on the Plane of Shadow or in an enclosed extradimensional space. Spells other than [force] effects deal 50% damage against incorporeal creatures.
Source: This feat subsumes the Ectoplasmic Spell featAPG.

sections.heading: Unskittering Spell [Evocation, Metamagic]
sections.text:
Your knowledge of arcane defenses allows you to cast spells that bypass them.
Benefit: This feat can be applied only to spells that require an attack roll (melee or ranged; normal or touch). An unskittering spell ignores deflection bonuses to AC and CMD, and also ignores any AC bonus granted by mage armor or bracers of armor.
Metamagic Cost: +1 level.
Source: This is the “Piercing Spell” home brew feat from the angelfire Migdalia campaign.

sections.heading: Variable Spell [Metamagic, Transmutation]
sections.text:
Prerequisite: At least two other metamagic feats.
Benefit: For spells with multiple parameters that are selected when the spell is learned or prepared, this feat instead allows the selection of those parameters at the time of casting. Examples are provided below and in Appendix 8A.
For spells prepared with metamagic, or that come pre-modified, a variable spell has a menu of specific metamagic feats (including Cascaded spells, q.v.) or combinations of feats, created when the spell is prepared or created. Each feat or combination of feats in the menu must have the same total metamagic cost. At the time of the casting, one of these options is selected by the caster.
All of the options use the same base spell as the root, and they must all follow a relatively narrow theme or motif (referee and player agreement). It is thus not possible to use this feat to prepare, in essence, large numbers of potential 5th level spells in place of one 6th level spell.
Metamagic Cost: +1 level.
Synergy: For spells extended using the Concentration Spell feat (q.v.), a different menu option can be selected each round.
Special: In a few example spells (notably confusion), the Variable Spell feat has been applied at a -1 spell level cost, because the caster has no control over which menu option that will apply. This use of the feat is generally for Game Designer use only (Cf. Restricted Spell).
Violate SpellBVD                                                              [Evil, Metamagic, Necromancy]
The wounds the spell inflicts are tainted with the foulest evil.
Prerequisite: Corrupt Spell (q.v.); evil alignment.
Benefit: This feat adds the [evil] descriptor to the modified spell. Furthermore, if the spell deals hit damage, half of the damage dealt is Vile damage, which can only be healed by healing or restoration magic that is cast within an area sanctified by the forces of good (such as within a consecrate or a hallow spell). Natural healing, regeneration, fast healing and magical healing are otherwise ineffective in restoring the lost hit points or ability points.
Metamagic Cost: +2 levels.

sections.heading: Volumetric BurstPH1                                 [Evocation, Metamagic]
sections.text:
Prerequisite: Shape Spell.
Benefit: When this feat is applied to a spell with a “burst” or “spread” area of effect, the spell effects always fill the full (normal) volume of space. Each square that an affected spell is prevented from occupying (because of a wall or similar obstruction) is added to the other side of the effect's area. For example, a fireball normally bursts in a 20-ft. radius (1,255 square feet, or 50 squares). When used in a long, 10-ft.-wide hallway, a volumetric fireball would occupy 125 feet of the corridor’s length (the target pair of squares, plus 12 pairs of squares in either direction along the length of the hallway). If cast in a totally confined area less than or equal to half the total volume (for example, a fireball cast within a closed 20-ft. x 20-ft. room), the spell deals double damage/effects to everyone within the area.
Metamagic Cost: +0 levels.

sections.heading: Widen Spell [Metamagic]
sections.text:
“Unlikely. I put a teleport block up.”
“Around three square miles of caves?”
“Yes.”	―Steven Brust, Athyra (1993)
You can cast your spells so that they occupy a larger space.
Benefit: You can alter an area-effect spell to increase its measurements in all three dimensions. For spells that affect a number of cubes, each cube’s dimensions are increased. For line-shaped effects, increase the radius as shown below, but the length (i.e., range) remains constant—i.e., do not recalculate new radii based on a total volume change.
Metamagic Cost: Refer to the table below. For spells that affect a certain weight limit, assume a constant density, so that an increase in volume translates to an equivalent increase in weight (for example, a sphere with increased radius translates to a 4/3πr3 increase in weight).
Meta-magic Cost | Dimension Multiplier | New Radius (Starting 20’r.) | Weight/ Volume Multiplier
-2 | x1/4 | 5 ft. | 0.016
-1 | x½ | 10 ft. | 0.125
0 | x1 | 20 ft. | 1
+1 | x1.5 | 30 ft. | 3
+2 | x2 | 40 ft. | 8
+3 | x3 | 60 ft. | 27
+4 | x6 | 120 ft. | 216
+5 | x18 | 360 ft. | 5,832
+6 | x50 | 1,000 ft. | 16,000
+7 | x200 | 1 mile | 8,000,000
+8 | x1,000 | 5 miles | 40,000,000
+9 | * | 1 mile/level | *
Examples:
Mage hand (0 level) can move an object weighing up to 1 lb./level; if Widened to 5th level, a 10th level caster could move a weight of over 29 tons (Cf. Yoda’s levitation of a spaceship via the Force, in The Empire Strikes Back). A fireball could Widened to a 7th level spell (+5 spell level cost, reduced to +4 levels due to the metamagic synergy rules), resulting in a 360-ft. blast radius that could potentially allow you to envelop a large mansion in its entirety. Loraan’s huge-area dimensional lock (referenced above) can be accomplished as follows: Warding (teleportation; 1st level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to  1 mile; +6 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (within caster’s home territory; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 8th level.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente

sections.heading: Seed Spells
sections.text:
Ideally, almost all spells can be “built” using a low-level basic “seed” spell and metamagic feats. The system outlined herein is designed to that end. As a general rule of thumb, if an existing spell can be built using seed spell(s) and metamagic feats, then do so; if not, it can potentially be used as-is (with referee permission) provided that it does not violate any of the strictures noted in above. A large number of existing spells have been so converted, and are presented in Appendix 8A.
Most seed spells can be Augmented for greater effects. Each augmentation is essentially a metamagic feat (q.v.) that applies to that spell, and follows the general rules for metamagic feats described above. However, rather than learning each Augmentation as a separate feat, a caster who knows the base spell can apply the Augmentation when preparing the spell. Spontaneous casters can apply the Augmentation during casting by succeeding at a Spellcraft check (as if for Heightening the spell; DC 20 + final level of the spell).
Special: In some of the example cases presented here, the metamagic rules have been stretched somewhat so as to allow a given spell to be reproduced without the need for creating an excessive number of new metamagic feats, etc. When the spell creation rules are used within an ongoing game, they should be followed as written unless the participants agree on a specific variation being permissible.
Existing Spells: The following spells can be used “as-is,” without being built from other seeds: contagion (reduce spell level to 2nd), unseen servant. In addition, most cantrips can be used as written, treating them as minor variations of prestidigitation.

sections.heading: Acid Arrow, Melf’s
sections.text: Acid Arrow, Melf’s: Acid splash (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level (damage cap 5d6 plus 2d6/rd. thereafter.

sections.heading: Flame Blade
sections.text: Flame Blade: Jet of flame (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (move action; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 7d6/rd. (arcane 12d6) divided among iterative melee touch attacks (max. 5d6/10d6 for any one attack).

sections.heading: Lightning Bolt
sections.text: Lightning Bolt: Electric arc (0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Magic Missile, Lesser
sections.text: Magic Missile, Lesser: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (evoker or generalist wizard; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 1st level; one missile +1/level (max. 6 total) deal 1d6 force each (no attack roll needed; Reflex half).

sections.heading: Produce Flame
sections.text: Produce Flame: Jet of flame (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Variable Spell (can also deliver as melee touch; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard action; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Fire domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (5d6 to 1d6; -1 level) = 1st level; each round, make a standard action touch or ranged touch attack for 1d6 fire.

sections.heading: Scorching Ray
sections.text: Scorching Ray: Jet of flame (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Overwhelming Evocation (+1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 12d6 (fire resistance does not apply), divided evenly among iterative-attack rays.

sections.heading: Shocking Grasp
sections.text: Shocking Grasp: Electric arc (0 level) + Conductive Evocation (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 1st level (no SR).

sections.heading: Acid Splash
sections.text:
School Evocation [acid]
Level arcane 0, divine 0
Components V, S, M/F
Casting Time standard
Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect ray (ranged touch attack)
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; SR yes
Description deals 1d6 acid damage.
Improvement Heighten Spell (increases damage cap); Versatile Evocation (changes energy/damage type, descriptor, and possibly spell level, per the following table):
Energy/ Damage Type | Seed Spell | Level of Seed Spell
Acid | Acid splash | 0
Bludgeoning | Energy mace | 0
Cold | Ray of frost | 0
Electricity | Electric arc | 0
Fire | Jet of flame | 0
Force | Bolt of force | 2nd (evoker 1st)
Piercing | Invisible needle | 0
Sonic | Sound lance | 1st (bard 0)
Slashing | Invocation of the knife | 0
Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to line; +1 level) = +2 levels; Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteRay Splitting (+1 level) + Shape Spell (rays to lines; +1 level) = +2 levels.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
= 3rd level. You can produce a single line with a damage cap of 10d6 at Medium range, or fork into two Close range lines, for up to 13d6 total damage. Add the Ricochet Spell feat (see Metamagic, above) for a lightning bolt that bounces off walls, etc., as in the 1st edition rules.

sections.heading: Arcane Eye
sections.text: Arcane Eye: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to line of sight; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (magical sensor can be detected/destroyed; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); you can scry visually, moving the sensor up to 30 ft./round with concentration.

sections.heading: Blindness
sections.text: Blindness: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 3rd level; blinds 1 rd./level (or permanently, if invest 3,000 numen: 3rd level spell x CL 5th x 50 x 4).

sections.heading: Clairaudience/Clairvoyance
sections.text: Clairaudience/Clairvoyance: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Variable Spell (choose hearing or vision; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (not blocked by stone; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (area scried must be known or obvious; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Deafness
sections.text: Deafness: Alter senses (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level; deafens 1 rd./level, or permanently if 1,200 numen invested (2nd level x CL 3rd x 50 x 4 for 1 rd./level base duration).

sections.heading: Power Word, Blind
sections.text: Power Word, Blind: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Expedient Spell (individual hp; -1 level) = 7th level; those with 77 hp or less are blinded 1 hr./level; those with 154 hp or less for 1 min./level (no save).

sections.heading: Prying Eyes
sections.text: Prying Eyes: Arcane eye (q.v.; 3rd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 eye/level; +3 levels) + Expedient Spell (max. Perception skill modifier of +1/level; -1 level) + Delay Spell (gain no information until eyes return to you; -1 level) = 6th level.

sections.heading: Scrying
sections.text: Scrying: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Resistible Spell (save permitted; -1 level) + Tenuous Spell (sensor can be dispelled or destroyed; −1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 4th level. You gain the ability to observe one creature (and area around it to Close range) or one specific location (same radius) at any distance. AKA remote viewingSRD.

sections.heading: Scrying, Greater
sections.text: Scrying, Greater: Scrying (4th level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full ritual to 1 round; +1 level) = 7th level.

sections.heading: See Invisibility
sections.text: See Invisibility: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) = 2nd level; you can see invisible and ethereal for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Alter Senses
sections.text:
School Transmutation [sensory]
Level arcane 0, divine 0
Components V, S
Casting Time standard
Range close
Target one living creature
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Intuition negates; SR yes
Description adds sense of hearing or taste to the target creature, effective out to close range.
Improvement Augment Spell (+1 level to affect other senses); Augment Spell (+1 level per additional sense affected); Hex Spell (removes sense), Accursed Spell (prevents dispelling, and allows discounted permanency); Reach Spell (extend sense(s) to distant locations; school changes to Divination); Heighten Spell (final spell level determines sense(s) that can be affected):
Final Spell Level | Options
0-1 | Hearing, taste, vision (dazzled only)
2-3 | Smell (including scent), vision (blinded)
4-5 | Blindsense, touch (including tremorsense)
6+ | Blindsight

sections.heading: Animate Dead
sections.text: Animate Dead: Lesser animate dead (2nd level) + Augment Spell (+2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level; animates up to 2d4+1 human skeletons or other CR 1/3 undead, 1d4+1 human zombies or other CR ½ skeletons or zombies, 1d3 CR 1 skeletons or zombies, or one CR 2 skeleton or zombie.

sections.heading: Create Undead
sections.text: Create Undead: Lesser animate dead (2nd level) + Augment Spell (+5 levels) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 6th level; animates one corporeal undead of up to CR 8. Create greater undead is Augmented 2 more steps (8th level; max. CR 12).

sections.heading: Animate Dead, LesserUM
sections.text:
School Necromancy [evil]
Level divine 2, necromancer 2
Components V, S, M (onyx worth 25 gp/HD of undead to be animated), F
Casting Time standard
Range touch
Target one corpse
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; SR no
Effect animates the corpse as a normal skeleton or zombie (CR up to ½); to place it under your control, use the Command Undead feat (Chapter 5).
Improvement Augment Spell (allows higher-order undead to be created; use guidelines listed for summon monster); Cross-Class Spell (allows use by arcane casters other than Necromancers).

sections.heading: Animate Objects
sections.text: Animate Objects: Animate object (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) = 6th level. You can animate larger objects than small; Medium ones count as 2 Small ones, Large as 4, Huge as 8, etc.

sections.heading: Animate Plants
sections.text: Animate Plants: Animate objects (6th level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (plants only; −2 levels) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Variable Spell (extended entangle instead; +1 level) = 7th level.

sections.heading: Animate Rope
sections.text: Animate Rope: Animate object (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (+1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (rope-like object; -2 levels) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Animate Object
sections.text:
School Transmutation
Level arcane 1, divine 1
Components V, S, M/F
Casting Time standard
Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one unattended object of size Small or smaller
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw none; SR no
Effect temporarily animates one object (as an Animated Object construct).
Improvement Widen Spell (animate larger objects), Mass Effect Spell (animate multiple objects)

sections.heading: Bull’s Strength
sections.text: Bull’s Strength: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+2 to +4; +1 level) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Bull’s Strength, Mass
sections.text: Bull’s Strength, Mass: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2 to +4; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) = 5th level (listed in the CRB as 6th).

sections.heading: Rage
sections.text: Rage: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Con; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Cha; +1 level) + Empathic Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/3 levels; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (willing subjects; -2 levels) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; 1 subject/3 levels gains +2 to Str, Con, and Cha while you concentrate and for 1 rd./level thereafter. Bards can add the Language-Dependent Spell feat, for a final level of 2nd.

sections.heading: Attribute Boost
sections.text:
School Transmutation
Level arcane 0, divine 0
Components V, S, M/F
Casting Time standard
Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Will negates; SR yes
Description provides a +2 enhancement bonus to one attribute score (chosen when spell is learned/prepared: bull’s strength, cat’s grace, bear’s endurance, fox’s cunning, owl’s wisdom, eagle’s splendor)
Improvement Augment Spell (bonus increase, as shown below):
Bonus Increase | Total Bonus | Metamagic Cost
+1 | +3 | +1 level
+2 | +4 | +2 levels
+4 | +6 | +3 levels
+6 | +8 | +4 levels
+8 | +10 | +5 levels
+10 | +12 | +6 levels
+12 | +14 | +7 levels
+14 | +16 | +8 levels
Mass Effect Spell (boost multiple attributes); Variable Spell (choose attribute at time of casting).

sections.heading: Commune
sections.text: Commune: Augury (2nd level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +4 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (your deity or its agents answer the questions according to their aims, not necessarily to your benefit; ad hoc -1 level) = 5th level. You ask your deity up to one question/level (1-word answers).

sections.heading: Contact Other Plane
sections.text: Contact Other Plane: Augury (2nd level) + Cross-Class Spell (arcane; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 question/3 levels; +2 levels) = 5th level. You can ask up to 1 question/3 levels, receiving 1-word answers; roll a separate Knowledge check for each question. On a failed check, the entity contacted either lies or doesn’t know the answer, and you take 5d4 attribute damage (divine as evenly as possible between Int, Wis, and Cha).

sections.heading: Divination
sections.text: Divination: Augury (2nd level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd.; +2 levels) = 4th level; you gain general (and often very cryptic) advice requiring up to 6 seconds to convey.

sections.heading: Legend Lore
sections.text: Legend Lore: Augury (2nd level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) = 6th level. You gain impressions of legends regarding a place, person, creature (CR 11+), object, or whatever; information can take up to 1 min./level to convey. If the Knowledge check fails, you take 3d4 Wis drain.

sections.heading: Vision
sections.text: Vision: Legend lore (6th level) – Ritual Spell (+1 level) = 7th level; as legend lore, but casting is a full-round action rather than a lengthy ritual.

sections.heading: Augury
sections.text:
School Divination
Level bard 2, divine 2, diviner 2, seer 2
Components V, S, M/F
Casting Time full ritual
Range personal
Target you
Duration instantaneous
Description you gain an instantaneous “feeling” (consisting of a 1-word answer) about some action being contemplated for the near future, or about some past event. (Obviously, the onus is on the referee to predict the outcome of future events and answer accordingly, which means that incorrect results may occur.)
In order to augur successfully, a Knowledge (the Planes) check is needed; on an unsuccessful check, the spell fails. The DC is as follows:
Extent of Current Knowledge | Knowledge DC
Immediate (imminent event / happening at current location) | 10 + 2x spell level
Detailed but not immediate | 15 + 2x spell level
Rumors or hints only | 20 + 2x spell level
Improvement Cross-Class Spell (for arcane casters other than Diviners and Seers; failure on the Knowledge check inflicts 1d4 mental attribute damage/level of spell or 1d4 drain/2 levels of spell); Extend Spell (longer answers, rather than instantaneous 1-word replies); Irresistible Spell (allows divination regarding areas past stone walls, etc.), Mass Effect Spell (more questions)

sections.heading: Foresight
sections.text: Foresight: Bestow feat (Alertness; 1st level) + Tenacious Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (Perception 21 ranks; +4 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Canny Defense; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) = 9th level; the subject gains insight bonus to AC and cannot be caught flat-footed, flanked, or surprised except by Stealth check (see Alertness feat in Chapter 5).

sections.heading: Keen Edge
sections.text: Keen Edge: Bestow feat (Improved Critical; 1st level) + Augment Spell (BAB +6 effects; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (edged weapons only; -2 levels) = 3rd level; doubles critical threat range (and +4 to confirm) for edged weapon for 10 min./level. AKA duodimensional clawSRD.

sections.heading: Spectral Hand
sections.text: Spectral Hand: Bestow feat (Reach Spell; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (Sudden Metamagic; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (touch spells only; -2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (“hand” can be destroyed; -1 level) = 2nd level; you can deliver touch spells at range, as per the Sudden Metamagic (Reach Spell) feat, except it applies to twice as many spells starting at CL 6th, 3x as many at CL 9th, etc. (max. 6x as many at CL 18th).

sections.heading: Bestow Feat
sections.text:
School Divination
Level arcane 1, divine 1
Components V, S, M/F
Casting Time standard
Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Intuition negates; SR yes
Description The target gains use of one feat, assuming prerequisites met (the feat is selected at the time this spell is learned/prepared).
Special Because of the rule limiting spell bonuses to skills as enhancement bonuses (q.v. skill enhancement seed), it is generally not possible to use bestow feat in conjunction with the Skill Focus feat, except to provide a skill as a class skill.
Improvement Augment Spell: higher-BAB or skill rank feat effects, if subject of spell does not meet those requirements:
Feat Effect Prerequisite | Metamagic Cost
+1 BAB or 1 rank | +1
+6 BAB or 6 ranks | +2
+11 BAB or 11 ranks | +3
+16 BAB or 16 ranks | +4

sections.heading: Entangle, Lesser
sections.text: Entangle, Lesser: Bind (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (vegetation; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger, or access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 1st level; vegetation in 40’r. area entangles those within, 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Entangle, Greater
sections.text: Entangle, Greater: Bind (0 level) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (vegetation; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (as above; -1 level) = 3rd level; as lesser entangle, but lasts longer, and area is treated as difficult terrain.

sections.heading: Snare
sections.text: Snare: Bind (0 level) + Augment Spell (pinned; +4 levels) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r. -1 level) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (as for entangle; -1 level) = 3rd level; magic trap pins those in 10’r. area. For 10 min./level (check to free self each round).

sections.heading: Web
sections.text: Web: Bind (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (grappled; +1 level) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (try and break free each round; -1 level) + Tenuous Spell (webs can be burned away; -1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (anchors needed; -2 levels) = 2nd level; webs grapple those in 20’r. spread.

sections.heading: Bind
sections.text:
School Evocation
Level arcane 0, divine 0
Components V, S, M/F
Casting Time standard
Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature (or object, for some uses)
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Reflex negates; SR yes
Description one target gains the entangled condition
Improvement Augment Spell:
Condition | Metamagic Cost
Grappled | +2
Pinned | +4

sections.heading: Bane
sections.text: Bane: Blessing (0 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (emanation is centered on you; -1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 min./level; ­1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 1st level; enemies within 40 ft. of you take a -1 penalty to attacks, damage, and saves vs. fear (Will neg.).

sections.heading: Bless
sections.text: Bless: Blessing (0 level) + Communal Spell (+1 level) = 1st level; affects up to 10 allies for 1 min./level each.

sections.heading: Inspire Courage
sections.text: Inspire Courage: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (scaling bonus; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Pattern Spell (auditory; minstrel) or Language-Dependent Spell (skald) (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) = 1st level; provides morale bonus to atks, damage, saves vs. fear equal to bardic college bonus.

sections.heading: Blessing
sections.text:
School Enchantment [compulsion]
Level arcane 0, divine 0
Components V, S, F
Casting Time standard
Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 10 min./level
Saving Throw Will negates; SR yes
Description the subject gains a +1 bonus to attacks, damage, and saving throws vs. [fear] effects. This bonus is an enhancement bonus (as a wizard/sorcerer spell), a morale bonus (as a bard spell), or a sacred/profane bonus (as a divine spell)
Improvement Augment Spell (bonus improves by +1 per +1 spell level).

sections.heading: Expeditious Retreat
sections.text: Expeditious Retreat: Celerity (0 level) + Augment Spell (+10 ft. to +30 ft.; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; your land speed increased by +30 ft. for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Longstrider
sections.text: Longstrider: Celerity (0 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Travel domain; -1 level) = 1st level; +10 ft. to land speed for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Celerity
sections.text:
School Transmutation
Level arcane 0, divine 0
Components V, S, M/F
Casting Time standard
Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Fort negates; SR yes
Description the target gains a +10 ft. enhancement bonus to its base land speed (or one other speed chosen).
Improvement Variable Spell (other movement speeds); Heighten Spell (land speed bonus is +10 ft. x final spell level); Reduce Spell (-1 spell level per -20 ft.).

sections.heading: Command
sections.text: Command: Compel (2nd level) + Variable Spell (select command at time of casting; +1 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoids; -2 levels) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Command, Greater
sections.text: Command, Greater: Compel (2nd level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 round to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 5th level.

sections.heading: Confusion, Lesser Compelling
sections.text: Confusion, Lesser Compelling: Compel (act randomly; 2nd level) + Variable Spell (no control over menu item chosen; -1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Confusion, Compelling
sections.text: Confusion, Compelling: Compel (act randomly; 2nd level) + Variable Spell (no control over effect; -1 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (save each round to act normally; -1 level) = 4th level.

sections.heading: Daze Person
sections.text: Daze Person: Compel (do nothing; 2nd level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoids; -2 levels) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) = 0 level; affects 1 humanoid of 4 HD max.

sections.heading: Daze Monster
sections.text: Daze Monster: Compel (do nothing; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Expedient Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; 6 HD max.

sections.heading: Hypnotism
sections.text: Hypnotism: Compel (watch; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (emanation; +2 levels) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (1 round; -1 level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; 2d4+1/level (max. +5) total HD affected.

sections.heading: Suggestion
sections.text: Suggestion: Compel (2nd level) + Variable Spell (choose compulsion at time of casting; +1 level) + Delay Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; victim compelled to perform some action, chosen at the time of casting, for up to 1 min./level; you can cause a time delay or set an activating condition.

sections.heading: Suggestion, Mass
sections.text: Suggestion, Mass: Compel (2nd level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Delay Spell (up to 1 hr./level; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) = 6th level.

sections.heading: Compel
sections.text:
School Enchantment [compulsion, mind-affecting]
Level arcane 2, divine 2
Components V, S
Casting Time standard
Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw Will negates; SR yes
Description forces target to spend next turn performing a specified action. A compulsion of “do nothing” is, in essence, a dazing effect (q.v., inertia, below); a compulsion to commit suicide only causes the target to attack itself for 1 round; a compulsion of “watch!” is equivalent to a fascinate effect; etc. The specific compulsion must be selected when the spell is learned/ prepared.
Improvement Variable Spell (allows the caster to choose compulsion from a menu at the time of casting)

sections.heading: Create Food and Water
sections.text: Create Food and Water: Creation (food; 1st level) + Variable Spell (also water; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 2 hrs./level; +1 level) = 1st level; 1 cu. ft./level is enough for a full meal for 3 Medium creatures/level. The food goes bad (and the drink evaporates) after 2 hrs./level if not consumed.

sections.heading: Create Water
sections.text: Create Water: Creation (water; 1st level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 1/8 cu. ft./level; -1 level) = 0 level; creates 1 gallon/level. The water is either eliminated or sweat out (if consumed), or evaporates (otherwise) after 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Creation, Major
sections.text: Creation, Major: Creation (1st level) + Variable Spell (multiple materials; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (shaping; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (fine detail; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 4th level.

sections.heading: Wall of Iron
sections.text: Wall of Iron: Creation (iron; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (energy mace; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 8 cu. ft./level; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target or volume to wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 5-ft. squares; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 6th); iron wall (one 5-ft. square/level, 4 in. thick) can be tipped over, potentially dealing up to 10d6 bludgeoning damage (Reflex half).

sections.heading: Wall of Stone
sections.text: Wall of Stone: Creation (stone; 1st level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 8 cu. ft./level; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bind: can capture opponent; +1 level) + Shape Spell (volume to wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 5-ft. squares; ­1 level) = 5th level; wall of stone (one 5-ft. square/level, 4 in. thick) lasts 1 hr./level unless invested with numen (use latent spell effect pricing: spell level x caster level x 50).

sections.heading: Creation
sections.text:
School Conjuration [creation]
Level arcane 1, divine 1
Components V, S, M/F
Casting Time standard
Range 0 ft.
Effect no more than 1 cu. ft./level of a single nonliving, mundane, harmless substance (1 lb./level for rare metals)
Duration 1 hour/level or less (see text)
Saving Throw none; SR no
Description creates lump or pool of a single substance, (chosen when spell learned/prepared). If a mold or template is used, it may be possible to shape the material without adding the shaping spell (q.v.).
Improvement Augment Spell:
Material | Duration | Other Limits | Metamagic Cost
Precious metals/ gems | 10 min./ level | Cannot be used as material components | +1 level
Rare metals | 1 rd./ level | Max. weight 1 lb./level | +2 levels
Cascade Spell (shaping) to shape material; Variable Spell (choose material at time of casting, or create multiple materials), Widen Spell (increase volume/mass of material), other metamagic.

sections.heading: Circle of Death
sections.text: Circle of Death: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+2d4, +2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) = 6th level; 3d4 Con (Fort. half) to creatures with up to 10 HD in 40’r. area.

sections.heading: Destruction
sections.text: Destruction: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Crippling Drain (3d4, +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (jet of flame; +1 level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) = 7th level; damage cap 20d6 (half fire, half unholy) plus 3d4 Con drain.

sections.heading: Dominate Monster
sections.text: Dominate Monster: Damage attribute (Cha; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+5d4; +4 levels) + Cascade Spell (mindlink; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) = 9th level; 6d4 Cha damage and telepathic commands.

sections.heading: Dominate Person
sections.text: Dominate Person: Damage attribute (Cha; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (mindlink; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoids only; -2 levels) = 5th level; 4d4 Cha damage and telepathic commands. For bards, add the Language-Dependent Spell feat (-1 level, for 4th level).

sections.heading: Feeblemind (Variant)
sections.text: Feeblemind (Variant): Damage attribute (Int; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Crippling Drain (+2 levels) = 5th level; 3d4 Int drain (Will half) at Close range.

sections.heading: Finger of Death
sections.text: Finger of Death: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Reach spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+6d4; +5 levels) = 7th level; 7d4 Con damage (Fort half) at Close range.

sections.heading: Hold Monster
sections.text: Hold Monster: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+5d4; +5 levels) + Reach spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (days to rounds; ­3 levels) = 4th level; 6d4 Dex damage (or 5th level for 7d4). An initial save reduces the damage by half; thereafter, an additional point of attribute damage is removed each round (1+ Con bonus if target has the Fast Recovery feat).

sections.heading: Hold Monster, Mass
sections.text: Hold Monster, Mass: Hold monster (4th level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +2 levels) = 9th level; 8d4 Dex damage to 1 creature/level (Will half; damage removed at 1 point/rd. thereafter).

sections.heading: Hold Person
sections.text: Hold Person: Hold monster (4th level) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoids only; -2 levels) = 2nd level; deals 4d6 temporary Dex damage (or 7d4 for a 3rd-level version).

sections.heading: Insanity
sections.text: Insanity: Damage attribute (Wis; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +2 levels) + Crippling Drain (4d4, +3 levels) = 7th level; 4d4 Wis drain at Close range (insane at 0; Intuition neg.).

sections.heading: Slay Living
sections.text: Slay Living: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+4d4; +3 levels) = 5th level; 5d4 Con damage by touch (Fort half).

sections.heading: Wail of the Banshee
sections.text: Wail of the Banshee: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+5d4; +4 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) = 9th level; 6d6 Con damage in 40’r. (Fort neg.).

sections.heading: Damage Attribute
sections.text:
School As appropriate for effect
Level arcane 1, divine 1
Components V, S, M/F
Casting Time standard
Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fort or Intuiton/Will half; SR yes
Description deals 1d4 damage to one attribute (a separate “seed spell” exists for each attribute), with a saving throw applicable for half.
Improvement Augment Spell (+1d4 per +1 spell level); Crippling Drain metamagic feat (for attribute drain); Extend Spell (attribute damage is recovered over minutes or rounds, rather than days; reduces final spell level).
Synergy If an Augmented damage attribute spell is modified using the Empower Spell feat, only the initial 1d4 attribute damage is Empowered; the effect does not extend to the additional dice granted by augmentation.

sections.heading: Shield of Faith
sections.text: Shield of Faith: Deflection (0 level) + Augment Spell (scaling bonus; +1 level) = 1st level; subject gains +2 deflection, +1/6 levels, for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Telekinetic ShieldAUG
sections.text: Telekinetic ShieldAUG: Deflection (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+8 total; +5 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Selective Spell (+2 levels) = 8th level; for 1 rd./level, allies within 10’r. of you gain +8 deflection to AC.

sections.heading: Deflection
sections.text:
School Abjuration
Level arcane 0, divine 0
Components V, S, M/F
Casting Time standard
Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Will negates; SR yes
Description The subject gains a +2 deflection bonus to AC.
Improvement Augment Spell (+1 level/+1 bonus; or +1 level for scaling bonus of +1/6 levels).

sections.heading: Arcane Sight
sections.text: Arcane Sight: Detection (magic; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (concentration to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level (listed in the CRB as 3rd).

sections.heading: Arcane Sight, Greater
sections.text: Arcane Sight, Greater: Arcane sight (q.v.; 4th level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) = 7th level; you gain all information instantaneously, with no need to concentrate.

sections.heading: Commune with Nature
sections.text: Commune with Nature: Detection (natural creatures and features; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to line of sight; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (concentration to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Sudden Spell (gain information instantaneously, but no ongoing effect thereafter; +0 levels) + Restricted Spell (druid or ranger; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level (ranger 4th).

sections.heading: Deathwatch
sections.text: Deathwatch: Detection (life; 2nd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (creatures you see only; -2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard to swift action; +2 levels) = 2nd level; for each creature within close range you see, you can determine if alive/dead/ neither/undead, and if healthy/lightly or heavily wounded/at death’s door.

sections.heading: Detect Animals or Plants
sections.text: Detect Animals or Plants: Detection (animals; 2nd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (specify particular type of animal or plant to be scanned for; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (choose new types during duration; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Animal or Plant domain; −1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Detect Evil (etc.)
sections.text: Detect Evil (etc.): Detection (creatures, effects, and objects with [evil] descriptor or actively evil intents; 2nd level) + Tenuous Spell (ends if encounters overwhelming aura, and you are stunned 1 round if HD = 2x yours; -1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Detect Magic
sections.text: Detect Magic: Detection (magical auras; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (cone to ray; -1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 0 level.

sections.heading: Detect Poison
sections.text: Detect Poison: Detection (poison; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (concentration to instantaneous; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (additional information requires Craft: toxicology check; -1 level) = 0 level.

sections.heading: Detect Secret Doors
sections.text: Detect Secret Doors: Detection (secret doors, compartments, etc.; 2nd level) + Restricted Spell (rogue skill trick; -1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Detect Snares and Pits
sections.text: Detect Snares and Pits: Detection (pits, deadfalls, other simple natural-material traps; 2nd level) + Restricted Spell (druid or ranger; -1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Detect Undead
sections.text: Detect Undead: Detection (undead; 2nd level) + Delay Spell (you can activate the effect immediately or have it “ping” the first time an undead creature is within range; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (ends if encounters overwhelming aura, and you are stunned 1 round if HD = 2x yours; -1 level) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Discern Location
sections.text: Discern Location: Detection (creature or object specified; 2nd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (must have a former possession of the subject’s; for an object, must have previously touched it; -2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+3 levels) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Overwhelming Spell (breaches protections; +1 level) – Concentration Spell (inst.; -1 level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (target’s current location only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 8th level; no save, SR and other magic protections against detection and location do not apply.

sections.heading: Find the Path
sections.text: Find the Path: Detection (route to specified location; 2nd level) + Location-Specific Spell (must have an object from that location in your possession as a focus; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to same plane; +6 levels) + Extend Spell (concentration to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 6th level; indicates shortest and most direct route, but does not reveal traps, etc.

sections.heading: Find the Path, Greater
sections.text: Find the Path, Greater: Find the path (q.v.; 6th level) – Location-Specific Spell (+2 levels) = 8th level; finds the route even if no focus is possessed (the ranger’s 16th level class feature of the same name is similar to this version, except it also indicates traps, etc.).

sections.heading: Know Direction
sections.text: Know Direction: Detection (north; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) – Concentration Spell (-1 level) = 0 level; you get an instantaneous reading of “north” from your current location (only).

sections.heading: Know TimeTM2
sections.text: Know TimeTM2: Detection (time of day; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) – Concentration Spell (-1 level) = 0 level; you instantaneously know what the local time of day is. Note that this can be an invaluable tool to keep track of your other spell durations.

sections.heading: Locate Creature
sections.text: Locate Creature: Detection (specific kind or individual creature; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) = 4th level; additional rounds of concentration reveal direction creature is moving (as will triangulation).

sections.heading: Locate Object
sections.text: Locate Object: Detection (item specified; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (direction of nearest only, not numbers or any other additional information; -2 levels) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Detection
sections.text:
School Divination
Level arcane 2, divine 2
Components V, S
Casting Time standard
Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Targets creatures or objects of specified type within a 90-degree arc, out to the extent of the range
Duration concentration (Standard action)
Saving Throw none (unattended object) or Intuition negates (creature); SR no
Description by concentration, you can detect the presence of one specific thing (creature type, type of material, etc.), chosen when the spell is learned/prepared. The amount of information gained depends on the length of time you spend concentrating:
Concentration Time | Information
1st round | Presence or absence
2nd round | Number, and relative strength (CR for creatures) of strongest (e.g., highest CR) present
3rd round | Location and strength or condition of each
Improvement Irresistible Spell (allows detection through walls, etc.); other metamagic (for purposes of the Shape Spell feat, treat the area as a cone)
Note like other divination spells, detection is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead or gold, or 3 feet of wood or dirt, unless the Irresistible Spell feat is applied..
There was a spell Childermass knew. It was a spell to detect magic. It would not tell you what the magic was or who was performing it; it simply told you whether there was any magic occurring or not.
―Susanna Clarke,
Jonathan Strange & Mr Norrell (2004)
Discern Lies: Detection (lies; 2nd level). Listed as a 4th level spell in the CRB.

sections.heading: Create Lesser DemiplaneUM
sections.text: Create Lesser DemiplaneUM: Dimensional pocket (1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Planar Sense; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Power over Shadow; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 30-ft. cubes; +2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 7th level. Greater demiplanes are larger, gaining additional features by the associated automatic Heightening. To maintain a personal demi-plane, 3,500 x CL personal numen is invested. AKA genesisSRD.

sections.heading: Mordenkainen’s Magnificent Mansion
sections.text: Mordenkainen’s Magnificent Mansion: Dimensional pocket (1st level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (creation: food; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (unseen servant; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 20-ft. cubes; +1 level) = 7th level. Note the feat/skill tax in order to get the full effects.

sections.heading: Rope Trick
sections.text: Rope Trick: Dimensional pocket (1st level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 216 lbs./level; +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 2nd in the core rules).

sections.heading: Dimensional PocketWotC
sections.text:
School Conjuration [extradimensional]
Level arcane 1
Components V, S, M
Casting Time standard
Range touch
Target one unattended object or willing creature weighing up to 1 lb./level
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw none; SR yes
Description Transfers target object to an extradimensional pocket (invisible and weightless from outside, regardless of contents). When the duration ends (or the effect dismissed), the object returns to your hand (or adjacent, if you cannot hold it).
You cannot use this spell as an attack to trap a creature in a pocket universe without using a dimensional skip (q.v.,) effect, although a helpless creature can be carried into a pocket universe by a willing entrant, and the entrance can be made enticing-looking in order to lure creatures in willingly.
Improvement Heighten Spell (if you have the Power over Shadow feat and sufficient ranks in Planar Sense, you can add features to Heightened dimensional pockets, as indicated below):
Spell Level | Min. Ranks | Added Features
7th | 13 | Natural (or artificial) environment (including food, etc.); control over ingress/egress
8th | 15 | Alignment or elemental traits,, thriving ecology, custom seasons, shapeable terrain
9th | 17 | Negative or positive energy traits, alternative magic (dead, enhanced, impeded, wild), morphic terrain, portal, variable time.
Shape Spell, Widen Spell (for larger pocket dimensions)―for larger spaces that can be entered by creatures, creatures re-appear where they entered. Variable Spell (open and close pocket and/or enter and leave more than once).
Note opening or bringing an extradimensional space inside of another such space briefly opens a rift, collapsing the smaller space and expelling the contents of both into the Astral Plane.

sections.heading: Dimension Door
sections.text: Dimension Door: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long range; +1 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/3 levels; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (you must go; -1 level) = 4th level; teleports you and 1 creature/3 levels to location within Long range.

sections.heading: Dismissal
sections.text: Dismissal: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (target: touch to close; +1 level) + Reach Spell (teleport: close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell ([extraplanar] only; -2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (home plane; -2 levels) = 4th level.

sections.heading: Plane Shift
sections.text: Plane Shift: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Teleport
sections.text: Teleport: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to continental; +5 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/3 levels; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Variable Spell (mishap possibility; ad hoc -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full-round; -1 level) = 5th level.

sections.heading: Teleport, Greater
sections.text: Teleport, Greater: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to planar; +6 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/3 levels; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (full-round; -1 level) = 7th level.

sections.heading: Transport via Plants
sections.text: Transport via Plants: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (Plant domain; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to planar; +5 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (to and from plants of like type; -2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/3 levels; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 6th).

sections.heading: Word of Recall
sections.text: Word of Recall: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to planar; +5 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (transports to designated sanctum only; -2 levels) = 6th level.

sections.heading: Dimensional Skip
sections.text:
School Conjuration [teleportation]
Level arcane 1, Travel 1 (also divine 1 if interplanar)
Components V, S
Casting Time standard
Range touch (subject)/close (teleport range)
Target creature touched, or object (up to 10 lbs./level, max. 50) touched
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates; SR yes
Description teleports target to a specified location within close range.
Improvement Heighten Spell (increases weight limit cap), Irresistible Spell (allows transportation through walls, etc.), other metamagic
Jester’s JauntAPG: Dimensional skip (1st level); listed as 3rd.
Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (destination plane & location; -2 levels) = 6th level; send subject to another plane (pre-selected when spell learned/ prepared) by touch.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteReach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/3 levels; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (willing or helpless targets only; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (arrive at random off-target location; ad hoc -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level; transports 1 willing or helpless creature/3 levels to plane specified upon casting, but arrival is 5d% miles off-target. A successful Knowledge (the planes) check can reduce this distance: DC 20 for 5d20 miles, DC 25 for 5d10 miles, DC 30 for 5d6 miles (this supersedes the Planar Wanderer featUI).Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente

sections.heading: Break Enchantment
sections.text: Break Enchantment: Dispel (0 level) + Cascade Spell (remove curse; +4 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/3 levels; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level; paladins and bards add Restricted Spell (-1 level), for 4th level.

sections.heading: Disjunction, Mordenkainen’s
sections.text: Disjunction, Mordenkainen’s: Dispel (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Inexorable Spell (destroys rather than suppressing items; +3 levels) = 9th level.

sections.heading: Dispel Magic
sections.text: Dispel Magic: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Bouncing Spell (if highest-level spell effect on target not dispelled, try next lowest; +1 level) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Dispel Magic, Greater
sections.text: Dispel Magic, Greater: Dispel magic (q.v.; 3rd level) + Variable Spell (+1 level; Mass Effect Spell, 1/3 levels, +2 levels; or Shape Spell: burst, +2 levels) = 6th level; dispels multiple effects (up to 1/3 levels, plus bouncing) or all in a 20’r. burst.

sections.heading: Erase
sections.text: Erase: Dispel (0 level) + Target-Specific Spell (destroys writing only; -2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (also removed non-magical script; +3 levels) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Spell Turning
sections.text: Spell Turning: Dispel (0 level) + Augment Spell (reverse back onto caster instead of dispelling; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to long; +2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (no check needed; +2 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 spell/3 levels; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Expedient Spell (total spell levels; ­1 level) = 7th level; turns up 1d4+7 total levels’ worth of spells (up to 1 spell/3 levels) targeting you.

sections.heading: Dispel
sections.text:
School Abjuration
Level arcane 0, divine 0
Components V, S, M/F
Casting Time standard
Range touch
Target one creature or object
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; SR opposed check
Description Opposed Concentration check to accomplish one of the following: end one spell effect specified; counterspell a spell being cast; remove a spell slot or prepared spell; or suppress a magic item effect for 1 round/level.
Improvement Augment Spell (“steal” active spell effect or reflect back on caster instead of negating; +2 levels), Selective Spell (choose any target within range for redirected effect).

sections.heading: Barkskin
sections.text: Barkskin: Enhancement (2nd level) + Augment Spell (+0 to +1 base; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Item-Specific Spell (natural armor only; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1/4 to +1/3; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; +1 bonus, +1/3 levels (max. +7 at 18th).

sections.heading: Divine Favor
sections.text: Divine Favor: Enhancement (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (weapon attacks and damage; -2 levels) + Lucky Spell (+2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1/4 to +1/3; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (divine; -1 level) = 1st level; you gain a +1/3 levels luck bonus to weapon attacks and damage for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Magic Fang
sections.text: Magic Fang: Enhancement (2nd level) + Item-Specific Spell (natural weapon only; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (penetrates DR; +1 level) = 1st level. AKA metaphysical clawSRD.

sections.heading: Magic Fang, Greater
sections.text: Magic Fang, Greater: Enhancement (2nd level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Magic Vestment
sections.text: Magic Vestment: Enhancement (2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Item-Specific Spell (armor or shield only; -2 levels) = 3rd level; +1 bonus/4 levels.

sections.heading: Magic Weapon
sections.text: Magic Weapon: Enhancement (2nd level) + Item-Specific Spell (manufactured weapon only; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (penetrates DR; +1 level) = 1st level; weapon gains +1 enhancement bonus and penetrates DR/magic. AKA metaphysical weaponSRD.

sections.heading: Magic Weapon, Greater
sections.text: Magic Weapon, Greater: Magic weapon (q.v.; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) = 3rd level; +1 bonus/4 levels.

sections.heading: Enhancement
sections.text:
School Transmutation
Level arcane 2, divine 2
Components V, S, F
Casting Time standard
Range touch
Target creature or object touched
Duration 1 minute/level
Saving Throw Intuition negates; SR yes
Description the item touched gains a +1 enhancement bonus (to armor, if armor; to skill checks, if an item; to natural armor, if a creature’s skin; etc.
Improvement Augment Spell (+1 level per +1 increase in bonus); Augment Spell (allows penetration of DR as if actually possessed permanent enhancement bonus; +1 level per +1); Consecrate/Corrupt Spell (change bonus to sacred/profane); Heighten Spell (the bonus scales as shown below; if increased using Augment Spell, the cost is not reduced by metamagic synergy):
Final Level of Spell | Enhancement Bonus
0 – 1st | +1
2nd – 4th | +1/4 levels
5th – 7th | +1/3 levels
8th – 9th | +1/2 levels
Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (+1/4 to +1; ­1 level)Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
+ Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Item-Specific Spell (natural weapons only; -2 levels) = 3rd level; +1 bonus/4 levels to one natural attack, or +1 each to multiple natural attacks.

sections.heading: Death DevotionCC
sections.text: Death DevotionCC: Enervation (4th level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (necromancer or access to Death domain, etc.; -1 level) = 3rd level; melee [strike] also deals 1d4 temporary negative levels.

sections.heading: Energy Drain
sections.text: Energy Drain: Enervation (4th level) + Crippling Drain (+4 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 9th level; ray permanently drains 1d4 levels per round for 1 rd./level or until save is made.

sections.heading: MindwipeSRD
sections.text: MindwipeSRD: Enervation (4th level) + Cross-Class Spell (telepathy; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 10 min./level; −1 level) = 4th level; target gains 1d4 negative levels (Fort half) that disappear more quickly.

sections.heading: Enervation
sections.text:
School Necromancy [death]
Level arcane 4
Components V, S
Casting Time standard
Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect ray
Duration instantaneous (negative levels last 1 hr./level)
Saving Throw None (Fortitude half if Shaped); SR yes
Description A successful ranged touch attack inflicts 1d4 temporary negative levels on a living target (an undead creature instead gains 1d4x5 temporary hp).
Improvement Crippling Drain (allows 1 temp. negative level to become permanent if Fort save failed)

sections.heading: Enlarge Person
sections.text: Enlarge Person: Enlarge (3rd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoid; -2 levels) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Enlarge Person, Mass
sections.text: Enlarge Person, Mass: Enlarge person (1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (+3 levels) = 4th level.

sections.heading: Enlarge Self
sections.text: Enlarge Self: Enlarge (3rd level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Reduce Person
sections.text: Reduce Person: Reduce (3rd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoid; -2 levels) = 1st level. Reduce animal is similar, but also has the Cross-Class Spell feat (Animal domain; +1 level) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Shrink Item
sections.text: Shrink Item: Reduce (3rd level) + Augment Spell (½ to 1/8; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (object only; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Expedient Spell (maximum initial volume: 1 cu. ft./level; -1 level) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Enlarge/Reduce
sections.text:
School Transmutation
Level arcane 3
Components V, S, M
Casting Time standard
Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target 1 creature or object
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Fortitude negates; SR yes
Description you increase or decrease the size category of the creature or object by 1 step (chosen when the spell is learned)—dimensions by a factor of 2, weight and volume by a factor of eight. For creatures, each size step enlarged provides +2 Str, -2 Dex, +2 natural AC; each size step reduced instead provides -2 Str, +2 Dex, -2 natural armor (size bonus/penalty)
Improvement Augment Spell (+1 level per additional size step)

sections.heading: Arcane Mark
sections.text: Arcane Mark: Figment (0 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. cubes to 1 sq. ft.; -3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 0 level; render mark permanent by investing 100 x CL numen (you can choose to cast at CL 1st if you don’t care about the mark being easier to remove).

sections.heading: Illusory Wall
sections.text: Illusory Wall: Figment (0 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (wall only; -2 levels) = 2nd level; invest 1,000 x CL numen to maintain effect.

sections.heading: Image, Minor
sections.text: Image, Minor: Figment (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (remove olfactory; -1 level) = 2nd level; visual and auditory components, and you can move the image with concentration.

sections.heading: Image, Major
sections.text: Image, Major: Figment (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 3rd level; visual, auditory (including speech), and olfactory components, and you can control what the image is doing with concentration.

sections.heading: Image, Permanent
sections.text: Image, Permanent: Figment (0 level) + Variable Spell (scripted; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 6th level; invest 250 x CL numen (5th level x 50 x 1 for duration) to maintain indefinitely.

sections.heading: Image, Persistent
sections.text: Image, Persistent: Figment (0 level) + Variable Spell (scripted; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Augment Spell (tactile; +1 level) = 4th level; visual, auditory (including speech), olfactory, and tactile/thermal components last 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Image, Programmed
sections.text: Image, Programmed: Figment (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (swift command word trigger; +3 levels) + Variable Spell (scripted; +1 level) = 6th level.

sections.heading: Image, Silent
sections.text: Image, Silent: Figment (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 round; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 levels) + Reduce Spell (visual only; -1 level) = 1st level; visual illusion can be moved with concentration.

sections.heading: Ventriloquism
sections.text: Ventriloquism: Figment (0 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (no visual display; -1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Figment
sections.text:
School Illusion [figment]
Level arcane 0, Trickery 0
Components V, S, M
Casting Time standard
Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Area illusory sounds/images (see below)
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Intuition disbelief; SR no
Description creates illusory sound (no more than 4 humans per level sound, or one 10-ft. cube/level)
Improvement Heighten spell:
Final Spell Level | Sensory Components
0 | Auditory only (no speech)
1st | Auditory (with speech) or visual
2nd | Auditory and visual
3rd | Auditory, visual, and olfactory
4th and above | Auditory, visual, olfactory, and tactile (including thermal)
Ghost Sound: Figment (0 level); audible effect only, not including recognizable speech.

sections.heading: Blur
sections.text: Blur: Glamer (1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Disguise Self
sections.text: Disguise Self: Glamer (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (­1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (your same type only; ­2 levels) = 1st level; visual only.

sections.heading: Displacement
sections.text: Displacement: Glamer (1st level) + Augment Spell (effective invisibility; +2 levels) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Hallucinatory Terrain
sections.text: Hallucinatory Terrain: Glamer (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (emanation to cubes; +0 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. cubes to 30-ft. cubes; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (terrain only; no structures, creatures, etc.; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (40 minutes; -2 levels) = 4th level; long-lasting illusory terrain (affecting all senses) in one 30-ft. cube/level.

sections.heading: Invisibility
sections.text: Invisibility: Glamer (1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Stealth; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +1 level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 2nd level; subject invisible to sight and +1/2 levels to Stealth (+5 max.).

sections.heading: Invisibility, Greater
sections.text: Invisibility, Greater: Glamer (1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Stealth; +1 level) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +1 level) + Heighten Spell (+1 level) = 4th level; subject invisible to sight, sound, and smell, and gains +1/2 levels to Stealth (+10 max.).

sections.heading: Magic Aura, Nystul’s
sections.text: Magic Aura, Nystul’s: Glamer (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (hide or add magic aura only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 1st level; invest numen to maintain (as a latent effect: 25 x 1 x CL), as per mask magicRR2.

sections.heading: Mirage Arcana
sections.text: Mirage Arcana: Glamer (1st level) + Shape Spell (emanation to cubes; +0 levels) + Widen Spell (20-ft. cubes; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 5th level; long-lasting illusory terrain and structures in one 20-ft. cube/level.

sections.heading: Seeming
sections.text: Seeming: Glamer (1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (same type only; -2 levels) = 5th level; as disguise self, but applies to 1 creature/3 levels.

sections.heading: Silence
sections.text: Silence: Glamer (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (inure: sonic; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (auditory w/speech only; -3 levels) = 2nd level; suppresses sound and reduces sonic damage by -5/2 levels (max. -30) in 20’r. emanation.

sections.heading: Veil
sections.text: Veil: Glamer (1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (no olfactory/tactile; -2 levels) = 6th level; 1 subject/level is cloaked by illusion to appear and sound as you choose.

sections.heading: Glamer
sections.text:
School Illusion [glamer]
Level arcane 1, Trickery 1
Components V, S
Casting Time standard
Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature or object, or
Area 20’r. emanation (landscape)
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Intuition negates (for creature or object targeted) and Intuition disbelief (interaction); SR no (yes for target)
Description covers target or area with an illusion so that it seems to be something else of the same size
Improvement Heighten spell (as Figment, above). Augment Spell: replace glamer with outright invisibility (+2 levels, which do not count towards Heightening the glamer effect). Any application of full invisibility that is not broken on an attack (i.e., without the Pacific Spell metamagic feat) must be at least 4th level.
He did not know that these despised rock heaps of the Phanfasms were merely deceptions to his own eyes, nor could he guess that he was standing in the midst of one of the most splendid and luxurious cities ever built by magic power. All he saw was a barren waste of rock heaps, a hairy man with an owl’s head and another with a bear’s head. The sorcery of the Phanfasms permitted him to see no more.
―L. Frank Baum, The Emerald City of Oz (1910)

sections.heading: Darkness
