sections.text: Darkness: Gloom (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 2nd level spell lowering ambient light by 1 step (max. darkness) in 20’r.

sections.heading: Darkness, Deeper
sections.text: Darkness, Deeper: Darkness (q.v.; 2nd level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) = 3rd level; ambient light in 40’r. lowered by 2 steps (max. supernatural darkness) for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Gloom
sections.text:
School Evocation [darkness]
Level arcane 0, divine 0
Components V, S, M/F
Casting Time standard
Range touch
Area 20-ft. radius spread
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw none; SR no
Description lowers ambient light by 1 step (e.g., normal to dim light; Chapter 1), to a minimum intensity of 0 (darkness).
Improvement Shape Spell (emanation; allows Will save and SR to resist becoming the focal point); Heighten spell (increases number of steps decrease in ambient light, and allows supernatural darkness or eldritch darkness conditions as follows):
Final Spell Level | Light Reduced By | Minimum Final Ambient Light
0 | 1 step | Dim
1st – 2nd | 1 step | Darkness
3rd – 4th | 2 steps | Supernatural darkness
5th – 6th | 3 steps | Supernatural darkness
7th – 8th | 4 steps | Supernatural darkness
9th | 5 steps | Eldritch darkness

sections.heading: Choose FutureTM2
sections.text: Choose FutureTM2: Hand of fate (0 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd.; +1 level) = 2nd level; for the next round, the target rolls twice for everything and chooses which roll to use. The bit of luckCRB domain power is the same, but is Restricted (access to Fate domain; -1 level).

sections.heading: Fate of OneCRB
sections.text: Fate of OneCRB: Hand of fate (0 level) + Quicken Spell (+4 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level (listed as 7th); as an immediate action, you can reroll 1 die roll after the results are revealed. You must take the second roll, even if it’s worse than the first.

sections.heading: Hand of Fate
sections.text:
School Divination
Level arcane 0, divine 0
Components V, S, M/DF
Casting Time standard
Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Intuition negates (harmless); SR yes
Description the target can reroll any one die roll that round (target’s choice). The second roll must be used, even if worse than the first.
Improvement Delay Spell (save reroll for when needed); Effect-Specific Spell (only a specific type of roll can be rerolled); Interrupting Spell (reroll after results revealed); Extend Spell (reroll all rolls during duration); Selective Spell (can choose whether to use reroll or original)

sections.heading: Antilife Shell
sections.text: Antilife Shell: Hedge (2nd level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature type/level; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level.

sections.heading: Antiplant Shell
sections.text: Antiplant Shell: Hedge (plants; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Magic Circle Against Evil
sections.text: Magic Circle Against Evil: Protection from evil (1st level; see below) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r; -1 level) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Protection from Evil
sections.text: Protection from Evil: Hedge (evil; 2nd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (summoned only; -2 levels) + Widen Spell (10’r. to 20’r.; +1 level) + Shape Spell (emanation to target; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3 bonus; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (evil attackers only; -2 levels) = 1st level; hedges away evil summoned creatures, subject gains +2 deflection, +3 resistance to saves vs. evil.

sections.heading: Repel Vermin
sections.text: Repel Vermin: Hedge (vermin; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +3 levels) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) = 4th level (ranger 3rd); vermin of 8 HD cannot approach within 10 ft. of you.

sections.heading: Hedge
sections.text:
School Abjuration
Level arcane 2, divine 2
Components V, S, M/F
Casting Time standard
Range personal
Effect 10-ft. radius emanation
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw none; SR yes
Description you bring into being a mobile, hemispherical energy field that prevents the entrance of one specific creature type or descriptor (e.g., animals, or [evil]). The barrier is defensive only; an attempt to force it against affected creatures causes it to collapse. Affected creatures can still use ranged attacks or spells; they simply cannot enter the barrier. You cannot erect a hedge against objects or materials, only creatures.
Improvement Metamagic.

sections.heading: Dazing
sections.text: Dazing: Inertia (0 level) + Augment Spell (dazed; +3 levels) = 3rd level; note that this is similar to a 2nd level compel spell (q.v.) to “do nothing,” except that it lacks the [mind-affecting] descriptor and therefore vermin are not immune, and certain other resistances (e.g., mind blank) do not apply.

sections.heading: Power Word, Stun
sections.text: Power Word, Stun: Inertia (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Expedient Spell (individual hp; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as 8th level compulsion); target with 77 hp or less is stunned 1 rd./level, or 1 rd. if 154 hp or less (no save).

sections.heading: Psionic BlastSRD
sections.text: Psionic BlastSRD: Inertia (0 level) + Cross-Class Spell (telepath; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stunning; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (cone; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoids; -2 levels) = 3rd level; humanoids in Close range cone are stunned 1 rd.

sections.heading: Slow
sections.text: Slow: Bind (q.v.; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (staggered; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) = 3rd level; target staggered and entangled 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Slow, Mass
sections.text: Slow, Mass: Slow (3rd level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) = 6th level.

sections.heading: Inertia
sections.text:
School Transmutation
Level arcane 0, divine 0
Components V, S
Casting Time standard
Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw Fortitude negates; SR yes
Description the target is flat-footed for 1 round (lose Dex bonus to AC and cannot use immediate actions during that time, unless has the Alertness feat and 4+ ranks in Perception).
Improvement Augment Spell:
Condition | Level Cost
Staggered | +2 levels
Dazed | +3 levels
Stunned | +4 levels
Note that the revised action economy (Chapter 7) makes these conditions more dangerous than they are in the core rules. Spells incorporating this seed are often of correspondingly higher level than they are as listed in 3.5e D&D/Pathfinder.

sections.heading: Endure Elements
sections.text: Endure Elements: Inure (fire; 0 level) + Variable Spell (Versatile Evocation: cold; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (30 to 5; -2 levels) = 1st level (ranger 0); grants long-lasting resistance 5 to heat or cold.

sections.heading: Resist Energy
sections.text: Resist Energy: Inure (0 level) + Variable Spell (select energy type at time of casting; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) = 2nd level; subject gains resistance 5/2 levels (max. 30) against the specified energy type for 10 min./level. AKA specified energy adapationSRD.

sections.heading: Stoneskin
sections.text: Stoneskin: Inure (slashing; 0 level) + Energy Admixture: bludgeoning and piercing; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) = 4th level; subject gains DR 10/adamantine for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Inure
sections.text:
School Abjuration
Level arcane 0, divine 0
Components V, S, DF
Casting Time standard
Range touch
Target creature or object touched
Duration 1 minute/level
Saving Throw Fortitude negates; SR yes
Description the creature touched gains resistance 5 against one energy type (acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, negative energy, positive energy, or sonic), or DR 5/adamantine against one damage type (bludgeoning, nonlethal, piercing, slashing), chosen when the spell is learned/prepared.
Improvement Variable Spell (choose type at time of casting), Heighten Spell (at 1st level or above, the resistance increases to 5 per 2 caster levels, with a cap as shown in the table below).
Final Spell Level | Maximum Resistance/DR
0 | 5
1st | 15 at CL 6th
2nd – 4th | 30 at CL 12th
5th – 7th | 40 at CL 16th
8th – 9th | 50 at CL 20th
Irresistible Spell (bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage reduction not overcome by adamantine weapons); Maximize Spell (gain full scaling bonus regardless of caster level); Tenuous Spell (DR overcome by, e.g., evil weapons, magic weapons, silver weapons, etc.).

sections.heading: Dancing Lights
sections.text: Dancing Lights: Light (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd.; -3 levels) + Concentration Spell (move action; +2 levels) = 0 level.

sections.heading: Darkvision
sections.text: Darkvision: Light (0 level) + Widen Spell (20 ft. to 60 ft.; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 hr./level; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (single creature only benefits from “light”; -2 levels) = 2nd level; subject sees for 60 ft. in dim light and darkness as if in normal light.

sections.heading: Daylight
sections.text: Daylight: Light (0 level) + Augment Spell (bright light; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Pyrotechnics
sections.text: Pyrotechnics: Light (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (blinding; +4 levels) + Shape Spell (emanation to burst; +0 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (light: 10 min./level to inst.; -3 levels) + Extend Spell (blindness: 1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Pattern Spell (line of sight; -1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (existing bonfire; -2 levels) = 2nd level. Add the Variable Spell feat to also allow the smoke cloud option (Appendix 8A) and the final spell level is 3rd, as for a 1st edition druidPH1.

sections.heading: Light
sections.text:
School Evocation [light]
Level arcane 0, divine 0
Components V, S, M/F
Casting Time standard
Range touch
Area 20-ft. radius emanation
Duration 10 min./level
Saving Throw Fort negates (see below); SR yes
Description touched object sheds normal light in a 20’r., dim light for another 20 ft.
Improvement Augment Spell (greater light). For dazzling and blinding light, there are two durations to track: the duration of the light itself, and the duration the target(s) are dazzled/blinded (base 1 round). The spell’s saving throw and SR apply vs. being the source of the emanation, but not to the condition unless an immediate action is spent averting one’s gaze from an instantaneous flash (Reflex neg.). If the light is ongoing, to avoid being affected one must keep one’s eyes closed while in the area (effectively blinded).
Metamagic Cost | Light Improved To
+1 level | Bright light
+4 levels | Dazzling light
+5 levels | Blinding light
So the Warlock smiled and began moving his fingers in an intricate pattern. Primary colors streamed up from between the Warlock’s fingers, roiled and expanded beneath the beamed roof. Heads turned at other tables. Then the clattering of table knives stopped. Then came sounds of delight and appreciative finger-snapping, for a spell the Warlock had last used to blind an enemy army.
―Larry Niven, The Magic Goes Away (1978)

sections.heading: Mage Armor, EpicELH
sections.text: Mage Armor, EpicELH: Mage armor (1st level) + Augment Spell (increase bonus by +16; +9 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 9th level; subject gains +20 armor bonus to AC for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Mage Armor, GreaterCA
sections.text: Mage Armor, GreaterCA: Mage armor (1st level) + Augment Spell (+2 levels) = 3rd level; subject gains +6 armor bonus to AC for 1 hr./level..

sections.heading: Shield
sections.text: Shield: Mage armor (1st level) + Variable Spell (shield bonus; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (warding:  bolt of force; +1 level) = 1st level; subject gains +4 shield bonus to AC and is immune to bolt of force and its derivatives. AKA force screenSRD.

sections.heading: Wall of Force
sections.text: Wall of Force: Mage armor (1st level) + Variable Spell (cover rather than armor bonus; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 AC to total cover; +4 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to wall; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 rd./level; -3 levels) = 5th level.

sections.heading: Mage Armor
sections.text:
School Abjuration [force]
Level arcane 1
Components V, S, F
Casting Time standard
Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw Will negates; SR no
Description a field of force provides a +4 armor bonus to AC. Unlike mundane armor, mage armor entails no armor check penalty, arcane spell failure chance, or speed reduction. Since mage armor is made of force, incorporeal creatures can't bypass it the way they do normal armor.
Improvement Augment Spell (+1 level/+1 for first +2; +1 level/+2 thereafter); Variable Spell (converts bonus to shield bonus); other metamagic.

sections.heading: Air Walk
sections.text: Air Walk: Mage hand (0 level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (concentration to 10 min./level; +3 levels) = 4th level; subject creature is buoyed into the air, and can walk on it as if it were solid ground (max. altitude is the extent of Close range).

sections.heading: CatfallSRD
sections.text: CatfallSRD: Mage hand (0 level) + Extend Spell (conc. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (slow fall only; -2 levels) = 0 level (listed as 1st); immediate casting slows fall for 1 rd.

sections.heading: Feather Fall
sections.text: Feather Fall: Mage hand (0 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 target/3 levels; +3 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (slow fall only; -2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 1st); immediate casting slows whole party’s fall.

sections.heading: Floating Disc, Tenser’s
sections.text: Floating Disc, Tenser’s: Mage hand (0 level) + Concentration Spell (standard to swift; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 216 lbs./level; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (carries weight only; -2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (follows you along ground only; -2 levels) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Levitate
sections.text: Levitate: Mage hand (0 level) + Concentration Spell (standard to move action; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 216 lbs./level; +3 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (vertical movement only; -2 levels) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Open/Close
sections.text: Open/Close: Mage hand (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 8 lbs./level; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (open or close door, window, or container only; -2 levels) = 0 level.

sections.heading: PushPH1
sections.text: PushPH1: Mage hand (0 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 3 lbs./level for objects; +1 level) + Extend Spell (concentration to instantaneous; -1 level) = 0 level; bull rushes one creature (CMB = Concentration bonus, rather than saving throw) or knocks back object within weight limit up to 20 ft.

sections.heading: Repulsion
sections.text: Repulsion: Mage hand (0 level) + Shielding Spell (if approached, instead of hit; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (blocks creatures from approaching only; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to up to 120’r.; +3 levels) - Concentration Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 6th level. AKA avoidanceUA1.

sections.heading: Telekinesis
sections.text: Telekinesis: Mage hand (0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Mage Hand
sections.text:
School Transmutation
Level arcane 0
Components V, S
Casting Time standard
Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature, or one object weighing up to 1 lb./level (5 lbs. max.)
Duration concentration (standard)
Saving Throw Will negates; SR yes
Description levitate object horizontally or vertically (up to 20 ft./round) while you concentrate (or for duration of Cascaded spell).
Improvement Heighten Spell (increases weight limit cap: 10 lbs. at 2nd level, 15 at 4th, etc.); Widen Spell (increases weight limit per level)
Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 27 lbs./lvl; +2 levels).Cascade Spell (invisible needle; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level); damage cap 15d6 divided among up to 15 objects.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteCascade Spell (pushPH1; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level); bull rushes and trips.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteCascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level); grapples.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
+ Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) = 4th level. Note that only the damaging function has duration Instantaneous; the other functions use the base spell’s duration of Concentration.

sections.heading: Distance DistortionPH1
sections.text: Distance DistortionPH1: Metaphysical feat (Widen Spell; 1st level) + Variable Spell (increase or decrease size; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) = 5th level; space inside one 10-ft. cube/level is effectively half or twice as large as it is when unaffected.

sections.heading: Tempus FugitUA1

sections.heading: Time Stop

sections.heading: Metaphysical Feat
sections.text:
School Transmutation
Level arcane 1
Components V, S, M
Casting Time standard
Range touch
Target creature or object touched
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Fort negates; SR yes
Description One metamagic feat you know (chosen at the time this spell is learned) can be temporarily applied to a physical object or area of space as if it were a spell, with a +0 or +1 level metamagic cost (for higher costs, the spell must be Augmented; see below). The specific effects depend on the feat; only certain feats can be used in conjunction with this spell (as listed below), and those that affect an Area also require the Shape Spell feat):
A Bane weapon increases its base damage by 1 step when used against the specified type.A Consecrated object or area gains an aura of [good]; a Corrupted area of object, one of [evil].In an area of Crippling Drain, attribute damage becomes attribute drain instead, and temporary negative levels become potentially permanent.A Delayed area might cause a pre-set time delay, or require some precipitating event, before actions begun in it actually take effect.An Empowered weapon can be used to make [strikes] dealing 1.5 times its normal damage.In an Extended area, non-offensive processes (e.g., aging, becoming hungry and thirsty, combustion, elapsing of ongoing spell durations, resting, etc.) occur as if time were passing more quickly or slowly.An area of Energy Admixture might convert half of the damage from certain energy types to other energy types; a weapon or area of Versatile Evocation would convert all the damage.In a Fell Condition area, successful saves against the specified condition type still result in diminished effects.In a Hexed area, numerical bonuses of a specified type become penalties instead.Inexorable traps do not allow normal Reflex saves to reduce damage.Spell Resistance does not function in an Irresistible Spell area.A Lingering Evocation area causes all damage of the appropriate energy type to become Lingering.A Maximized weapon deals maximum base damage, with no need to roll.A Merciful weapon deals nonlethal damage. All damage sustained in a Merciful area is treated as nonlethal damage until the metaphysical feat duration expires, whereupon it becomes lethal damage.In an area of Overwhelming Evocation, normal resistances and immunity to energy of the specified type do not apply.A Quickened weapon can be used to make an additional attack each round as a swift action.A Reach weapon can be used to make attacks at greater range.A Residual area is treated as difficult terrain.In a Ritual Spell area, standard casting times take a full round, and full round spells require full rituals.Figments and glamers of at least 2nd level cast within a Shadow Spell area become 10% real (Augment the metaphysical feat to increase the percentage).Dispelled magic within a Tenacious area is merely suppressed.An area of Tenuous magic allows new saves each round to end ongoing spell effects.Half of all damage sustained in a Violated area is treated as Vile damage until the duration of the metaphysical feat expires.A Widened area is, effectively, either larger or smaller inside than it is outside.
Improvement Augment Spell: Higher metamagic costs (+1 level per +1 level cost, not discounted by metamagic synergy); Shape Spell (affect an area instead of an object).

sections.heading: Demand

sections.heading: Telepathic Bond, LesserSRD

sections.text:
School Transmutation [polymorph]
Level arcane 3, divine 3
Components V, S, M/F
Casting Time standard
Range touch
Effect creature touched
Duration 1 minute/level
Saving Throw Fort negates; SR yes
Description transform subject’s physical form to Small or Medium humanoid, animal (beast shape), plant (plant shape), or elemental (elemental body), etc. Each creature type is a separate seed spell, but the specific form (e.g., a dog, if the type is Animal) can generally be chosen at the time of casting.
The subject gains +2 to Str (if Medium) or Dex (if Small) and +2 to natural armor (treat these as racial bonuses that stack with existing ones), and can trade out one of its existing feats for one of the feats possessed by the creature whose form is assumed.
Improvement Cascade Spell (enlarge/reduce, attribute boost, and/or enhancement (natural armor); in the latter two cases, boosts are also treated as racial bonuses rather than enhancement); Cascade Spell (glamer, to change likeness to that of a specific individual); Heighten Spell (1 feat/final level of the spell, and higher-tier bonuses and abilities, as follows):
Final Spell Level | Other Abilities (If possessed by imitated form)
1st | Low-light vision, one natural attack
2nd | Darkvision 60’, hold breath, scent, swim 30’, up to 3 natural attacks
3rd | Climb 30’, fly 30’, resist energy 5*, water breathing
4th | Climb/fly/swim 60’, resist energy 10*, up to 4 natural attacks
5th | Blindsense 30’, damage reduction 5, disease, burrow 30’, climb/fly/swim 90’, jet, poison, resist energy 15*, tremorsense 30’, web
6th | Blindsense 60’, burrow 60‘, fast healing 5, fly/swim 120’, resist energy 20*, spikes, tremorsense 60’, up to 5 natural attacks
7th | Damage reduction 10, ethereal jaunt (incorporeal forms), regeneration 5, resist energy 30*, spell resistance, up to 6 natural attacks
8th | Blindsight 60’, immunities
9th | (Almost any)
* (Or +1 bonus/5 points resistance to saves vs. assumed form’s normal immunities.)
Use the feats gained from the spell to simulate the feat-driven special abilities of the assumed form (e.g., constrict, favored terrain, frightful presence, grab, pounce, rend, etc.).
Spells or spell-like abilities are not acquired by means of this spell (and you cannot use your own except with the Natural Spell feat, q.v.). For supernatural abilities (and for (Ex) abilities not listed), construct them as spell-like abilities and compare the equivalent spell level against the spell level of the polymorph spell. Abilities that emulate a spell level higher than the polymorph spell’s level are not gained with the new form. Daily usages are limited per the Supernatural Ability feat (Chapter 5).

sections.heading: PossessionOcA
sections.text:
School Necromancy [possession]
Level arcane 3
Components V, S
Casting Time standard
Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw Will negates; SR yes
Description Your life force occupies the host body. The host's soul is imprisoned with you, but can still use its own senses (though it can't assert any influence or use even purely mental abilities unless you allow it). You can communicate telepathically with the host as if you shared a common language, but only with your consent. You keep your mental attributes, class levels and class features, BAB, base save bonuses, and mental abilities. The body retains its physical attributes, hp, natural abilities, and automatic abilities. A body with extra limbs doesn't allow you to make more attacks (or more advantageous two-weapon attacks) than normal.
You can use your own spells and spell-like abilities, but a totally unnatural form for you (e.g., a human caster possessing an aberration, animal, etc.) would require you to apply the Natural Spell feat. You can't activate the body's supernatural abilities, nor can you cast any of its spells or spell-like abilities (although the host can, if you allow it and use the body to perform the needed components).
When you transfer your soul upon casting, your body appears to be dead. Failure to take over a host ends the spell. If the possession succeeds, as a standard action, you can shift freely back to your own body regardless of range, so long as it remains on the same plane. If the host's body is killed, you return to your own body and the life force of the host departs (it is dead). If your body is slain, when the spell expires or the host's body is killed, you are slain. It is possible to cast this spell on a new target from within another creature's body. You still return to your original body (not any intermediate body) when you take a standard action to do so or the spell's duration expires. Returning to your body ends the spell.
Casters whose souls are their bodies, such as incorporeal undead, fey, and non-native outsiders, use the effects of greater possessionOcA instead (see below), and incorporeal undead and evil outsiders can possess dead bodies as if they were still alive.
Improvement Concentration Spell (you control subject and still retain some actions for your body; for this purpose, treat the duration as “Concentration (full round”), and decreasing the Concentration time to a standard action carries a +1 metemagic cost.

sections.text: Remove Paralysis: Remove condition (Dex damage; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) = 3rd level; removes 6d4 Dex damage total (can be spread among multiple affected creatures; max. 3d4 to any one).

sections.heading: Restoration, Lesser
sections.text: Restoration, Lesser: Remove condition (attribute damage; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (remove condition: fatigue; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level; removes fatigue (or reduces exhaustion to fatigue) and up to 2d4 damage to one attribute.

sections.heading: Restoration
sections.text: Restoration: Remove condition (1st level) + Ritual Spell (-1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Restoration, Greater
sections.text: Restoration, Greater: Remove condition (1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (one condition/level; +4 levels) + Crippling Drain (+4 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; ­1 level) = 7th level; removes 1 condition/level of any severity.

sections.heading: Resurrection
sections.text: Resurrection: Raise dead (q.v.; 5th level) + Cascade Spell (remove condition: lost body parts; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) = 7th level; as raise dead, but body need not be intact, and is healed up to 20d6 hp. The ritual requires 10,000 gp of diamond dust, and a resurrection survival check (see above) applies.

sections.heading: Resurrection, True
sections.text: Resurrection, True: Resurrection (7th level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) = 9th level; as resurrection, but no body needed. Ritual requires 25,000 gp of diamond dust, but no resurrection survival check is needed.

sections.heading: Remove Condition
sections.text:
School Abjuration, or Necromancy [healing]
Level divine 1
Components V, S
Casting Time standard
Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates; SR yes
Description removes one Minor condition (Chapter 7) or reduces more serious conditions 1 step along track (if applicable), or removes 1d4 attribute damage and/or one temporary attribute penalty (as from ray of enfeeblement). Each potential application is, in essence, a different spell.
Improvement
Crippling Drain to remove permanent conditions; +1 level per “step” – see examples; Extend Spell to create resistance to condition type, and, in some cases, a “positive condition” (Chapter 7; see also heroism, below).Heighten Spell to remove more attribute damage (1d4/level total);Heighten Spell to ameliorate or remove more severe conditions (if Augmented, cost is not reduced by metamagic synergy):
Final Spell Level | Condition Severity Reduction
0 – 2nd | 1 step (or remove Minor condition)
3rd – 5th | 2 steps (or remove Moderate condition)
6th – 8th | 3 steps (or remove Serious condition)
9th | 4 steps (or remove Critical condition)
Special a proper application of this spell can remove other spell effects that do not otherwise duplicate conditions (e.g., baleful polymorph); use the table above to determine the maximum level of the spell that can be affected.
[Attribute damage] + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 attribute/3 levels; +2 levels) = 4th level; removes up to 4d4 attribute damage or 1d4 drain from 1 attribute/3 levels, or 4d4 drain from 1 attribute.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente[Death] + Crippling Drain (+2 levels) + Augment Spell (moderate to serious; +1 level) = 4th level; removes up to 4d4 Con damage, 3d4 Con drain, all temporary negative levels, or up to 2 permanent negative levels.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente[Fatigue] + Cascade Spell (remove condition: attribute damage; +1 level) + Communal Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) = 4th level; removes fatigue or exhaustion, and also removes up to 6d4 attribute damage, divided among affected attributes.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente

sections.heading: Protection from Spells
sections.text: Protection from Spells: Resistance (0 level) + Augment Spell (+8 to bonus; +5 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/3 levels; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (spells and SLAs only; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as 8th); one ally/3 levels gains +9 resistance bonus to saves against spells and spell-like abilities. AKA Serten’s Spell ImmunityPH1.

sections.heading: Resistance, GreaterSC
sections.text: Resistance, GreaterSC: Resistance (0 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Augment Spell (+2 to save bonus; +1 level) = 4th level; grants long-lasting +3 resistance bonus to saves. Superior resistanceSC is the same, but is Augmented 2 more steps (6th level; +7 total bonus).

sections.heading: Fabricate
sections.text: Fabricate: Shaping (2nd level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 8 cu. ft./level; +1 level) + Augment Spell (fine manipulation; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Craft; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level; creates an item of up to 8 cu. ft./level, and caster gains a bonus to the Craft check equal to +1/2 levels (+10 max.).

sections.heading: Make Whole
sections.text: Make Whole: Shaping (2nd level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 8 cu. ft./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 2nd level; Craft check needed.

sections.heading: Mending
sections.text: Mending: Shaping (2nd level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 0 level; repairs simple breaks/tears.

sections.heading: Passwall
sections.text: Passwall: Shaping (2nd level) + Variable Spell (multiple materials; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 216 cu. ft./level; +3 levels) + Tenuous Spell (lasts 1 hr./level max.; -1 level) + Delay Spell (can dismiss effect early as a move action; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (in wall only; -2 levels) = 5th level; opens passage 5 ft. x 8 ft. x 5 ft./level.

sections.heading: Stone Shape
sections.text: Stone Shape: Shaping (2nd level) + Object-Specific Spell (stone only; -2 levels) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 3 cu. ft./level; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2 levels) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Warp Wood
sections.text: Warp Wood: Shaping (2nd level) + Object-Specific Spell (wood only; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 8 cu. ft./level; +1 level) = 2nd level; warps one wooden object/level (up to 8 cubic feet each).

sections.heading: Wood Shape
sections.text: Wood Shape: Shaping (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Craft; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 8 cu. ft./level; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (wood only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain; −1 level) = 1st level; shapes wooden object(s) with +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Craft check.

sections.heading: Shaping
sections.text:
School Transmutation
Level arcane 2, divine 2
Components V, S, M/F
Casting Time standard
Range touch
Target up to 1 cu. ft./level of material
Duration Instantaneous
Saving Throw none (for unattended material; otherwise Fort neg.); SR yes
Description rearranges a volume of material; the base spell moves mass around in basic shapes, and a successful Craft check appropriate to the material allows more detailed or precise shaping. Shaping mechanical objects or moving parts also requires Augmentation of the spell (see below).
Improvement Augment Spell (allows very fine manipulation of shape including moving parts; +3 spell levels cost); Widen Spell (increases volume).

sections.heading: Ray of SickeningUM
sections.text: Ray of SickeningUM: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); close ranged touch attack sickens for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Touch of NauseaAUG
sections.text: Touch of NauseaAUG: Sickening touch (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 0); touch nauseates 1 rd. (Fort. neg.).

sections.heading: Symbol of Pain
sections.text: Symbol of Pain: Sickening touch (0 level) + Fell Sickening (+1 level) + Augment Spell (ailing; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r; +2 level) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level; those in 60’r. emanation (lasting 1 rd./level) are ailing (Fort sickened). Invest 250 x CL numen to maintain trap.

sections.heading: Feather StepAPG
sections.text: Feather StepAPG: Skill enhancement (Acrobatics; 0 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Use-Specific Spell (move through difficult terrain only; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 level) = 1st level; provides +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Acrobatics checks to move through difficult terrain.

sections.heading: Find Traps
sections.text: Find Traps: Skill enhancement (Disable Device; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Spellcraft; +2 levels) + Use-Specific Spell (finding traps only; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level; +1/2 levels (+10 max.).

sections.heading: Glibness
sections.text: Glibness: Skill enhancement (Bluff; 0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min,/level to 10 min./level) = 3rd level; +1/2 levels (+10 max.) enhancement to Bluff checks.

sections.heading: Pass without Trace
sections.text: Pass without Trace: Skill enhancement (Survival; 0 level) + Augment Spell (+2 levels) + Hex Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (being tracked; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (druid or ranger; -1 level) = 1st level; subject is -1/2 levels (-10 max.) to be tracked (rather than “impossible”).

sections.heading: Channel Positive Energy
sections.text: Channel Positive Energy: Spark of life (1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; −1 level) = 5th level.

sections.heading: Cure Light Wounds
sections.text: Cure Light Wounds: Spark of life (1st level) + Augment Spell (+1 hp/level; +1 level) + Resistible Evocation (-1 level) = 1st level; touch heals 1d6 +1/level (max 1d6+5, Will half if used to damage undead).

sections.heading: Cure Moderate Wounds
sections.text: Cure Moderate Wounds: Spark of life (1st level) + Augment Spell (+1 hp/level; +1 level) = 2nd level; touch bestows (1d6+1)/level (max 5d6+5) positive energy, and undead receive no save for half damage.

sections.heading: Cure Serious Wounds
sections.text: Cure Serious Wounds: Spark of life (1st level) + Augment Spell (+1 hp/level; +1 level) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Resistible Evocation (-1 level) = 3rd level; touch heals 7 hp/level (max 70) or damages undead (Will half).

sections.heading: Cure Critical Wounds
sections.text: Cure Critical Wounds: Spark of life (1st level) + Augment Spell (+1 hp/level; +1 level) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Empower Spell (+1 level) + Resistible Evocation (-1 level) = 4th level; touch heals 0.5d6+7 hp/level (max 5d6+70) or damages undead.

sections.heading: Cure Wounds, Mass
sections.text: Cure Wounds, Mass: Spark of life (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (+3 levels) = 5th level; heals 1d6 hp/level (max. 10d6) in up to 1 creature/level.

sections.heading: Disrupt Undead
sections.text: Disrupt Undead: Spark of life (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead; -2 levels) = 0-level spell dealing 1d6 positive energy damage to undead hit (no effect on others).

sections.heading: False Life
sections.text: False Life: Spark of life (1st level) + Augment Spell (+1 hp/level; +1 level) + Cross-Class Spell (arcane; +1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 hr./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; you gain 1d6+1/level (max. 5d6+5) temporary hp.

sections.heading: Heal
sections.text: Heal: Remove condition (q.v.; 1st level) + Variable Spell (conditions affecting target; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 condition/3 levels; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 15d6; -1 level) = 6th level; heals 6 hp/level (max. 90) and removes one non-permanent condition/3 levels (up to Serious severity).

sections.heading: Heal, Mass
sections.text: Heal, Mass: Heal (6th level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) = 9th level; heals 6 hp/level (max. 120) and removes critical conditions.

sections.heading: Stabilize
sections.text: Stabilize: Spark of life (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (-1 hp or below; -2 levels) = 0 level; heals no hp, but automatically stabilizes dying creature.

sections.heading: Virtue
sections.text: Virtue: Spark of life (1st level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 min.; -1 level) = 0 level; subject gains 1 temp. hp.

sections.heading: Spark of Life
sections.text:
School Necromancy [healing, positive energy]
Level divine 1, necromancer 1
Components V, S, F
Casting Time standard
Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none (Will half if area-effect); SR yes
Description positive energy infuses the subject, healing 1d6 damage or damaging an undead a like amount. (You can alter the spell when learned/prepared to instead provide temporary hp lasting up to 10 min./level)
Improvements
Augment Spell (+1 hp/level, subject to scaling bonuses cap; +1 level cost);Extend Spell (healing over multiple rounds is 1 hp per 1d6 hp worth of instantaneous healing that would normally result);Heighten Spell (increases cap, as damage cap for divine spells; if the spell level is Reduced or otherwise lowered below 1st, the amount of healing is therefore 0 (but can still stabilize a dying creature), or 1 non-stacking temporary hp).
Synergy When you Cascade spark of life with a damaging spell (in order to simultaneously damage an enemy and heal yourself or an ally), the damage and healing scale by 1d6/2 levels rather than 1d6/level (Cf. vampiric touch, below).

sections.heading: Cause Fear
sections.text: Cause Fear: Spook (0 level) + Augment Spell (shaken to frightened; +1 level) + Fell Condition (+1 level) + Expedient Spell (-1 level) = 1st level spell causing the frightened condition (save for shaken), with a 5 HD limit.

sections.heading: Doom
sections.text: Doom: Spook (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (frightened to shaken; -1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Fear
sections.text: Fear: Spook (0 level) + Fell Frightening (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cone; +1 level) + Augment Spell (frightened to panicked; +1 level) = 3rd level spell causing the panicked condition (save for shaken) in a 30-ft. cone.

sections.heading: Phantasmal Killer
sections.text: Phantasmal Killer: Spook (0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (shaken to cardiac arrest; +4 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level spell allowing an Intuition save to avoid all effects; if fail, save vs. Fort or die (3d6 nonlethal if save).

sections.heading: Scare
sections.text: Scare: Spook (0 level) + Fell Condition (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (+2 levels) + Expedient Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level spell causing the frightened condition (save for shaken) in 1 target/3 levels (6 HD max.).

sections.heading: Symbol of Fear
sections.text: Symbol of Fear: Spook (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) = 6th level; panics if save failed. Note the numen investiture cost for latent spells (in this case, 300 x CL).

sections.heading: Weird
sections.text: Weird: Phantasmal killer (q.v.; 4th level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Str; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 target/level; +3 levels) = 8th level.

sections.heading: Creeping Doom
sections.text: Creeping Doom: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 6; +4 levels) + Augment Spell (1d4+1 summoned; +1 level) = 6th level (listed as 7th in the CRB); summons 1d4+1 Advanced, 12 HD centipede swarms.

sections.heading: Giant Vermin
sections.text: Giant Vermin: Summon (1st level) + Variable Spell (select augmentation; +1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 4, or 1d4+1 CR 2, or 2d4+1 CR 1; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; summons one Large giant scorpion, 1d4+1 Medium giant spiders, or 2d4+1 Medium giant centipedes.

sections.heading: Insect Plague
sections.text: Insect Plague: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 2 wasp swarm; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (stationary once summoned; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 5th level; summons 1 wasp swarm/3 levels.

sections.heading: Mount
sections.text: Mount: Summon (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (light horse or pony only; -2 levels) + Pacific Spell (serves as mount only; -2 levels) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Summon Monster I
sections.text: Summon Monster I: Summon (1st level) + Variable Spell (choose from list at time of casting; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Summon Monster II
sections.text: Summon Monster II: Summon (1st level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 1; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Summon Swarm
sections.text: Summon Swarm: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 2 swarm; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level; summons a CR 2 swarm of bats, rats, or spiders that lasts while you concentrate plus 1 rd. thereafter.

sections.heading: Summon
sections.text:
School Conjuration [summoning]
Level arcane 1, divine 1
Components V, S, M/F
Casting Time standard
Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft. per 2 levels)
Target one summoned creature
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw none; SR no
Description summons one pre-determined creature of CR ½ and 1 HD. Clerics and wizards summon extraplanar creatures (or animals with the celestial or fiendish template); druids generally summon animals, elementals, fey, plants, vermin, etc.
Improvement Variable Spell (choose summoned creature at the time of casting from short list); if used in this manner, the +1 spell level cost from Variable Spell does not contribute towards metamagic synergy (see above) for Augmenting the spell.
Augment Spell (greater CR and/or HD, and/or greater numbers):

+1 level | II | 1 | 2-3 | 1d3
+2 levels | III | 2 | 2-4 | 1d4+1
+3 levels | IV | 4 | 4-5 | 2d4+1

sections.heading: Comprehend Languages
sections.text: Comprehend Languages: Tongues (3rd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (read and understand only; cannot speak or write; -2 levels) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Speak with Animals
sections.text: Speak with Animals: Tongues (3rd level) + Augment Spell (basic; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (animals; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 min./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Speak with Plants
sections.text: Speak with Plants: Tongues (3rd level) + Augment Spell (different senses; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 min./level; -1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (plants; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Speak with Vermin
sections.text: Speak with Vermin: Tongues (3rd level) + Augment Spell (different senses; +4 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (animals; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 min./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Pestilence domain; -1 level) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Stone Tell
sections.text: Stone Tell: Tongues (3rd level) + Augment Spell (inanimate; +9 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (stone only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 min./level; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Earth domain; -1 level) = 6th level.

sections.text: Grease: Topple (0 level) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) = 1st level.

sections.heading: StompSRD
sections.text: StompSRD: Topple (0 level) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) + Widen Spell (30 ft. to 15 ft.; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (5d6 to 1d6; -1 level) = 0 level; 1d6 nonlethal and knocked prone (Reflex half/negates) in a 15-ft. cone.

sections.heading: Ray of Exhaustion
sections.text: Ray of Exhaustion: Touch of fatigue (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (exhaustion; +1 level) + Fell Condition (+1 level) = 3rd level; close ranged touch exhausts target (Fort fatigued). AKA dying breathRR2.

sections.heading: Waves of Exhaustion
sections.text: Waves of Exhaustion: Touch of fatigue (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (exhaustion; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) + Widen Spell (30 ft. to 60 ft.; +1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) = 7th level; those in 60-ft. cone become exhausted (no save).

sections.heading: Waves of Fatigue
sections.text: Waves of Fatigue: Touch of fatigue (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) + Augment Spell (exhausted; +1 level) + Fell Condition (+1 level) = 4th level (listed as 5th); those in 30-ft. cone become exhausted (Fort fatigued).

Components V, S
Casting Time standard

Target creature touched

Saving Throw Fortitude negates; SR yes

sections.heading: Warding
sections.text:
School Abjuration
Level arcane 1, divine 1
Components V, S, M/F
Casting Time standard
Range 0 ft.
Target creature or object touched
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw none (unattended object) or Fort neg. (creature); SR yes (object or creature)
Description A warding prevents a specific type of spells and spell-like abilities―and supernatural abilities and magic item effects that emulate them―from functioning on the target. A “type” of spell, loosely-speaking, is the group of spells built from the same spell or seed. For each spell type to be affected, there is a separate warding spell (see below for examples).
Effects with an ongoing duration are suppressed for the duration of the counter (this counts against the durations of the suppressed spells).Instantaneous effects targeting the creature or object fail. Area-effect spells affect others normally, but not the target.
Improvement Irresistible Spell (also protects against non-magical effects that otherwise imitate applicable spell effects); Shape Spell (maintains an emanation free of the warded effects).

Description A misty vapor arises around you. It is stationary. The vapor obscures all sight, including darkvision, beyond 5 feet. A creature 5 feet away has concealment (attacks have a 20% miss chance). Creatures farther away have total concealment (50% miss chance, and the attacker cannot use sight to locate the target).

sections.heading: Appendix 8a: Spells Grimoire
sections.text:
This appendix contains examples of spells from the core rules and other sources, rebuilt using seed spells and metamagic. They include the synergy effects of metamagic stacking, and also the automatic Heighten Spell effects of applied metamagic, as described in Chapter 8.
Generally, the spell effects and calculated spell level are very similar (or identical) to those described in the source material. In the event of a variance, a “listed as” reference may be provided; this indicates the spell level listed in the source, for comparison with the calculated spell level.
In many cases, a number of spells from different sources have different names, but similar or nearly identical effects (e.g., sanctuary alone has at least 13 variants). In order to save space (and to avoid excessive cross-indexing), rather than all of them receiving separate entries, one of the spells is listed alphabetically, and the variations are described as bullet points at the end of that entry. Therefore, a Search function may be needed to find a specific spell, if it does not appear alphabetically in the document.
Spells named after a deity, wizard, etc. (e.g., Mordenkainen’s sword) are alphabetized with the proper name last (e.g., “Sword, Mordenkainen’s”).
Note that a number of feats and class features with spell-like effects have also been converted here as spells. To use them as feats, simply select them in conjunction with the Magical Talent feat (Chapter 5).
