sections.text: Adhesive SpittleACG: Bind (0 level) + Residual Spell (+1 level) = 1st level; target save or entangled 1 round/level; moves as if in difficult terrain even if not entangled.

sections.heading: Adjuring StepUC
sections.text: Adjuring StepUC: Bestow feat (Press the Advantage; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Concentration; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; for next 1 rd./level, after each 5-ft. step, you can take another as a free action, and gain +1/2 levels (+5 msx.) to Concentration checks, enabling you to more easily cast defensively.

sections.heading: AdorationUC
sections.text: AdorationUC: Skill enhancement (Diplomacy; 0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) = 1st level; +1/2 levels (max. +5) to Diplomacy for 1 min./level. Variants:

sections.heading: Adrenaline BoostCPs
sections.text: Adrenaline BoostCPs: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Dex; +1 level) + Insightful Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 1st level; swift casting grants you +1 insight to Str and Dex for 1 rd.

sections.heading: Adrenaline SurgeMW
sections.text: Adrenaline SurgeMW: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Dex; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Con; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 bonus; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (your summoned allies only; -2 levels) = 2nd level; for 1 rd./level, creatures you summoned that are within 40 ft. of you gain +4 enhancement to Str, Dex, and Con.

sections.heading: AdversityRRE
sections.text: AdversityRRE: Skill enhancement (Diplomacy; 0 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) = 3rd level; subject -1/2 levels (-10 max.) to Diplomacy. Invest 225 x CL numen to maintain effect. Variants:

sections.heading: Aeonian LanternAUG2
sections.text: Aeonian LanternAUG2: Light (0 level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +3; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Delay Spell (turn on/off as standard action; +1 level) = 5th level; enemies in 20’r. light take −3 morale penalty to atks, damage, saves vs. fear; invest 375 x CL numen to maintain effect beyond 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Aerial TracksUI
sections.text: Aerial TracksUI: Bestow feat (Skill Focus: Survival; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Survival; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (16 ranks effect; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (aerial tracking only; -2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 4th); you gain Skill Focus (Survival) with an additional +1/2 levels to checks, and 16 ranks equivalent, for purposes of tracking flying creatures.

sections.heading: Affect Normal FiresPH1
sections.text: Affect Normal FiresPH1: Variable Spell (+1 level: gloom or light) + Augment Spell (normal to bright light; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (light from existing fire only; -2 levels) = 1st level; light from existing fire is increased or decreased by 1 step for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Affinity FieldSRD
sections.text: Affinity FieldSRD: Spark of life (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (psionic; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) = 8th level (listed as 9th); those in 20’r. are healed/injured whenever you are (9d6 + 1d6/level per round, max. 28d6/rd. total or 20d6 for a single occurrance). Pain affinity fieldCPs is also Selective (+1 level) = 9th level; cap 34d6/25d6.

sections.heading: AfflictionRR2
sections.text: AfflictionRR2: Ray of enfeeblement (1st level) + Resistible Spell (-1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 attribute/3 levels; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Redcuce Spell (+20 to +10’ -2 levels) = 4th level; target takes 1d6 +1/2 levels penalty to Str and Dex (and Con at CL 9th, Int at 12th, Wis at 15th, and Cha at 18th), Fort and Intuition saves for half.

sections.heading: Age ResistanceUM
sections.text: Age ResistanceUM: Warding (age; 1st level) + Irresistible Spell (suppresses effects of natural aging; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 5th level; you take no aging penalties to attributes. By investing 5,000 x CL numen, you can maintain the effect indefinitely as an active spell effect. Note that this allows you to temporarily ignore penalties and prevents additional penalties from accruing but does not actually eliminate those already gained. AKA ease the ages’ burdenRR2, slow the yearsRR2, stop the yearsRR2. Cf. extend lifeAUG.

sections.heading: Aggressive ThundercloudACG
sections.text: Aggressive ThundercloudACG: Electric arc (0 level) + Cascade Spell (wisp; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level; partial action directs electrically-charged, obscuring mist. Variants:

sections.heading: Agile FeetCRB
sections.text: Agile FeetCRB: Bestow feat (Favored Terrain; 1st level) + Variable Spell (terrain as applicable; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (terrain movement only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 0 level; swift casting allows you to ignore difficult terrain for 1 rd.

sections.heading: Aging TouchDr350
sections.text: Aging TouchDr350: Damage attribute (1st level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 attribute/3 levels; +2 levels) + Resistible Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; touch deals 1d4 attribute damage/3 levels (Str, Dex, Con, Wis, Int, Cha, in that order) due to temporary aging (Fort neg.). Variants:

sections.heading: Agonizing PrayerHA
sections.text: Agonizing PrayerHA: Whelm (0 level) + Energy Admixture (slashing +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Pattern Spell (auditory; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 nonlethal plus 2d6 bleed/rd. and staggered 1 rd. in 60’r. burst around you.

sections.heading: Agonizing RebukeARG
sections.text: Agonizing RebukeARG: Whelm (0 level) + Shielding Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; those attacking from within close range save vs. Intuition on 1st attack against you or take 3d6 nonlethal, and on subsequent attacls save vs. Will or take 1d6 +1/level (+10 max.) nonlethal per attack.

sections.heading: Aid
sections.text: Aid: Spark of life (temp hp; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 min./level; -1 level) + Augment Spell (1d6 to 5d6; +1 level) = 2nd level; creature touched gains 1d6/level (max. 5d6) temp. hp and +1 sacred bonus to atks, damage, and saves vs. fear. Variants:

sections.heading: Air GeyserACG
sections.text: Air GeyserACG: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (mage hand; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 27 lbs./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 (divine 5d6) bludgeoning and thrown upward 50 ft. (Reflex half/neg).

sections.heading: Aid PlantsAUG
sections.text: Aid PlantsAUG: Warding (disease; 1st level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1,000’r.; +5 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (nonintelligent, inanimate plants; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Resticted Spell (access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); plants in large area resist disease: invest 200 x CL numen (as latent spell) to maintain effect.

sections.heading: Alert BebilithBVD
sections.text: Alert BebilithBVD: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 10 bebelith; +6 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (in presence of other demon; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (bebelith is uncontrolled; -1 level) = 6th level; uncontrolled bebilith appears, attacks any demon present (and possibly the caster and allies), pursues if prey flees.

sections.heading: Algid EnhancementFB
sections.text: Algid EnhancementFB: Spark of life (1st level) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (enhancement; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (those with [cold] subtype only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-1 level) = 6th level; one [cold] creature/level gains 1d6 temp. hp/level (max. 15d6), +2 deflection to AC, and +1/3 levels enhancement to one weapon or natural attack.

sections.heading: Align Weapon
sections.text: Align Weapon: Magic weapon (q.v.; 1st level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Variable Spell (choose alignment at time of casting; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (caster must have alignment descriptor chosen; −1 level) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: AllegroCAd
sections.text: AllegroCAd: Celerity (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) + Augment Spell (+20’ to +40’; +1 level) = 3rd level; subjects gain +40 ft. to land speed for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: AllegroUM
sections.text: AllegroUM: Skill enhancement (0 level) + Variable Spell (any Dex-based skill; +1 level) + Personal Spell (­1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (haste; +3 levels) + Tenuous Spell (ends when skill enhancement used; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 2nd level; you are hasted, and as an immediate action, you can gain +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to one Dex-based skill check (you can choose to use this after the die is rolled), ending the spell.

sections.heading: Allied FootstepsCM
sections.text: Allied FootstepsCM: Mindlink (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (detection; +3 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 2nd level; by concentrating, subject can sense your location through passive link. Invest 300 x CL numen to extend effect.

sections.heading: Alluring SporesPC
sections.text: Alluring SporesPC: Bestow feat (Spell Focus: Enchantment; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Resistible Spell (-1 level) = 1st level (listed as 2nd); your enchantment spells gain +1 to the save DC unless the target(s) succeed at Fort saves.

sections.heading: Ally from the GravePC
sections.text: Ally from the GravePC: Summon (1st level) + Summon Undead (+1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 7 bhuta; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (mindlink; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (necromancer or access to Death domain, etc.; -1 level) = 7th level; summons one bhutaPB3, with which you can communicate telepathically.

sections.heading: Alpha InstinctUW
sections.text: Alpha InstinctUW: Speak with animals (1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Handle Animal; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 2nd level; you can communicate with animals, and gain +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Handle Animal checks.

sections.heading: Alter FortunePHII
sections.text: Alter FortunePHII: Hand of fate (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) = 5th level (listed as 3rd); forces immediate reroll of one roll just made. Alternate realityTM2 (4th level) is restricted to those with access to wild magic or the Chaos domain.

sections.heading: Alter Musical InstrumentACG
sections.text: Alter Musical InstrumentACG: Glamer (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (musical instrument sound type only; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (no visual or olfactory; ­2 levels) = 1st level; makes instrument sound like a different instrument.

sections.heading: Alter Shadow RealityADR
sections.text: Alter Shadow RealityADR: Dispel (0 level) + Shape Irresistible Spell (also chemical processes; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Effect-Selective Spell (processes specified during casting; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (Power over Shadow feat; -1 level) = 7th level; magical processes you specify (e.g., schools of magic, etc.) require opposed Concentration checks to function within 20 ft. of you, and/or chemical processes specified (combustion, etc.) fail.

sections.heading: Alter WindsAPG
sections.text: Alter WindsAPG: Zephyr (0 level) + Variable Spell (increase or decrease speed; +1 level) + Shape Spell (line to emanation; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (severe to light; -3 levels) = 1st level; alter wind speed in 10’r. by 1 step.

sections.heading: Amber SarcophagusBED
sections.text: Amber SarcophagusBED: Time skipRR (q.v.; 5th level) + Accrused Spell (+1 level) ­ Ritual Spell (+1 level) + Tenuous Spell (end effect by destroying amber focus; ­1 level) = 6th level (listed as 7th); invest numen to maintain the effect past 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Amplify StenchMC
sections.text: Amplify StenchMC: Metaphysical feat (Augment Spell; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+3 levels total cost; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (stench ability; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (troglodyte or access to Scalykind domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; target’s stench ability causes nausea instead of sickening.

sections.heading: Analyze Dweomer
sections.text: Analyze Dweomer: Detection (magic; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Spellcraft; +1 level) + Extend Spell (concentration to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) = 7th level; you discern magic auras and learn effects, functions, charges, etc. instantaneously with a Spellcraft check at +1/2 levels (+10 max.).

sections.heading: AnamensisDr338
sections.text: AnamensisDr338: Skill enhancement (Knowledge; 0 level) + Variable Spell (all Knowledge skills; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 level) = 3rd level; you gain +1/2 levels (max. +10) to Knowledge checks for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: AnathemaRRO
sections.text: AnathemaRRO: Dispel (0 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (divine spells only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level; opposed Concentration checks needed to cast divine spells within 40’r. of you.

sections.heading: Ancestral AdviceDr311
sections.text: Ancestral AdviceDr311: Skill enhancement (0 level) + Variable Spell (choose skill at time of casting; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+5 to +10; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Ancestors domain; -1 level) = 0  level; you gain +1/2 levels to one skill for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Ancestral CommunionDG
sections.text: Ancestral CommunionDG: Hand of fate (0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (−1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Ancestors domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; you gain +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Knowledge checks, and can reroll them at will (max. once each), for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Ancestral GiftDG
sections.text: Ancestral GiftDG: Magic weapon (1st level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Ancestral RegressionARG
sections.text: Ancestral RegressionARG: Polymorph (humanoid; 3rd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (elf; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (low-light vision only; -2 levels) = 2nd level; target drow temporarily becomes a high elf.

sections.heading: Ancestral VengeanceOA
sections.text: Ancestral VengeanceOA: Energy mace (0 level) + Bane Spell (undead; +0 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) = 1st level; damage cap 5d6 bludgeoning (5d8 vs. undead).

sections.heading: Anchored NavigationSRD
sections.text: Anchored NavigationSRD: Detection (starting point; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (cone to target; -1 level) + Reach Spell (close to planar; +6 levels) + Extend Spell (concentration to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (fixed starting pont; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (seer or access to Travel domain; -1 level) = 8th level (ranger 7th; listed as 4th); know distance and route to starting point.

sections.heading: Ancient KnowledgeME
sections.text: Ancient KnowledgeME: Variable Spell (skill enhancement: any Knowledge; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) = 1st level; you gain +1/2 levels (max. +5) to any one Knowledge check as an immediate action. Cf. lore keeperCRB.

sections.heading: Angry AcheBVD
sections.text: Angry AcheBVD: Blessing (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (-1 to -4; +2 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 min./level; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (rogue or access to Suffering domain; -1 level) = 1st level; victim -4 to attacks, damage, saves vs. fear for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Animal AffinitySRD
sections.text: Animal AffinitySRD: Attribute boost (0 level) + Variable Spell (choose attribute at time of casting; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2 to +4; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; you gain +4 enhancement to attribute chosen for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Animal AmbassadorUI
sections.text: Animal AmbassadorUI: Attribute boost (Int; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Cha; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2 to +8; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (compel: go to particular spot and deliver message; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (animal; -2 levels) + Expedient Spell (HD limit; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard, ranger, or access to Animal domain; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 4th level; animal of up to 8 HD gains +8 to Int and Cha (uses skill point boost from Int on Bluff, Diplomacy, Knowledge (linguistics), and goes to a place you designate and delivers a message from you to a creature you identify.

sections.heading: Animal CamouflageRRO
sections.text: Animal CamouflageRRO: Glamer (1st level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (animals only; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (visual, auditory, olfactory; +1 level) = 2nd level; to animals, you appear, sound, and smell like an animal  of the chosen type.

sections.heading: Animal Camouflage, GreaterRRO
sections.text: Animal Camouflage, GreaterRRO:  Glamer (1st level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 type/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (animals only; -2 levels) = 5th level; to animals, you appear, sound, smell, and feel like an animal of their type (up to 1 type/level).

sections.heading: Animal Growth
sections.text: Animal Growth: Enlarge (3rd level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Str; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Con; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+6 total bonus; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (animal; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Animal domain; -1 level) = 5th level; size increases by 1 step (+8 Str, +6 Con, -2 Dex, +2 natural armor) for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Animal HordeTM2
sections.text: Animal HordeTM2: Summon (1st level) + Variable Spell (animals chosen; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+5 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Animal domain; -1 level) = 9th level; summons up to 4d8 CR ½ animals, or 3d6 CR 1, or 2d4+1 CR 2, etc. that serve for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Animal InfusionRR
sections.text: Animal InfusionRR: Polymorph (animal; 3rd level) + Augment Spell (4th level options; +1 level)  + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Animal domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; you gain abilities and/or skills of chosen animal (up to 4th level spell options, as listed under the polymorph spell seed) for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Animal Messenger
sections.text: Animal Messenger: Compel (go to particular spot and wait; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (mindlink; +1 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (animal only; -2 levels) + Expedient Spell (HD limit; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 1st level. Upon casting the spell, you provide mental directions and invest 1,000 numen for a use-activated spell effect (1st level x CL 1st x 500 x 2); the animal goes to the designated spot and waits until the message is delivered or until you choose to end the effect (the numen is restored to you when the spell ends).

sections.heading: Animal ReductionMW
sections.text: Animal ReductionMW: Reduce (3rd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (animal; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 2nd level; animal is reduced by 1 size category for up to 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Animal Trance
sections.text: Animal Trance: Compel (watch; 2nd level) + Concentration Spell (+2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (animals only; -2 levels) = 2nd level; 2d4 + 1/level (+5 max.) HD worth of animals and/or magical beasts with Int 1 or 2 become facrinated while you concentrate.

sections.heading: Animalistic PowerPHII
sections.text: Animalistic PowerPHII: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Dex; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Con; +1 level) = 2nd level; +2 enhancement to Str, Dex, and Con for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Animate CityRD
sections.text: Animate CityRD: Energy mace (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (urban; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 15d6; -1 level) = 6th level; animated buildings damage enemies in area.

sections.heading: Animate NecrosisAUG2
sections.text: Animate NecrosisAUG2: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (lightly wounded or more; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (necromancer or access to Death domain, etc.; -1 level) = 5th level; wounded creature takes up to 15d6 negative energy (Fort half) plus stunned 1 rd. (Fort neg.) and grappled 1 rd./level (Reflex neg.) for 2d6 lingering damage/rd.

sections.heading: Animate RockPH1
sections.text: Animate RockPH1: Animate object (1st level) + Widen Spell (Small to Medium; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (rock only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Earth domain; -1 level) = 0 level (listed as 7th); animates up to 2 cu. ft./level of rock (as a Medium animated object) for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Animate ShadowRR
sections.text: Animate ShadowRR: Bind (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medim; +1 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 3rd level; shadows entangle 1 rd./level, redirect as a standard action.

sections.heading: Animate SnowFB
sections.text: Animate SnowFB: Animate objects (6th level) – Concentration Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (weapon of energySC; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Blinding Strike, Improved Overrun, Vital Strike; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (snow only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Winter domain; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as 6th); you create animated objects from snow that deal additional cold damage and can blind or trample.

sections.heading: Animate WeaponCM
sections.text: Animate WeaponCM: Animate object (1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Versatile Strike; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) + Item-Specific Spell (weapon; -2 levels) = 2nd level; weapon attacks as a Small animated object but otherwise retains its properties.

sections.heading: Anonymous InteractionACG
sections.text: Anonymous InteractionACG: Glamer (1st level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +4 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (blur memories of last 1 min./level; -2 levels) = 2nd level; up to 1 subject/level remembers only vaguely the last 1 rd./level (“we talked to someone about a job,” but not who or what exactly). Variants:

sections.heading: Ant HaulAPG
sections.text: Ant HaulAPG: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Augment Spell (+8 total bonus; +4 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (carrying capacity only; -2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (armor encumbrance not included; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 1st level; subject’s carrying capacity (except armor) triples. AKA Drawmij’s beast of burdenGA.

sections.heading: Anthropomorphic AnimalUM
sections.text: Anthropomorphic AnimalUM: Polymorph (human-oid; 3rd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (animal; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); animal becomes bipedal version, with arms and opposable thumbs (but no Int gain), for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Anti-Incorporeal ShellACG
sections.text: Anti-Incorporeal ShellACG: Hedge (incorporeal; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min/level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Anticipate TeleportationCA
sections.text: Anticipate TeleportationCA: Detection (incoming teleportation; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (cone to emanation; +1 level) + Extend Spell (concentration to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Delay Spell (incoming teleports, by 1 round; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 7th level; you gain 1-round notice of incoming teleportation within 20 ft.

sections.heading: Anticipate ThoughtsOcA
sections.text: Anticipate ThoughtsOcA: Bestow feat (Canny Defense; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Insightful Strike; +2 levels) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (bonuses apply only against a single creature; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (select creature at time of casting; +1 level) + Personal Spell (−1 level) = 2nd level; you gain Canny Defense and Insightful Strike against one opponent.

sections.heading: Anticipated Attack, Anavar’sAUG2
sections.text: Anticipated Attack, Anavar’sAUG2: Deflection (0 level) + Augment Spell (scaling bonus; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) = 1st level; you gain +2 deflection (+1/6 levels) vs. next attack.

sections.heading: Anticipatory StrikeCPs
sections.text: Anticipatory StrikeCPs: Metaphysical feat (Quicken Spell; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 action/3 levels; +2 levels) = 5th level; immediate casting allows you to instantly take up to 1 partial action/3 levels that you would otherwise take on your next turn.

sections.heading: Anticold SphereFB
sections.text: Anticold SphereFB: Warding (cold; 1st level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (hedge: [cold]; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +2 levels) = 7th level (listed as 5th); mobile 10’r. emanation grants immunity to cold and hedges out [cold] creatures. Antifire sphereSSt is identical, except fire instead of cold.

sections.heading: Antimagic RaySC
sections.text: Antimagic RaySC: Warding (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (all schools of magic; +3 levels) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 7th level; target cannot use spells or (Sp) or (Su) abilities for 1 rd./level (Will neg.).

sections.heading: Antimineral ShellS&M
sections.text: Antimineral ShellS&M: Hedge (2nd level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 type/3 levels; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 6th level (listed as 7th); keeps [earth] creatures, constructs and animated objects, etc. from approaching within 10 ft.

sections.heading: Antipathy
sections.text: Antipathy: Compel (leave area or avoid object; 2nd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (type or alignment specified; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (select type or alignment at time of casting; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of clumsiness; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Persistent Spell (save again 1d6 x 10 min. later even if succeed; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 8th level; specified creature(s) stay out of area, take Dex penalty of 1d6 + 1/level (Fort half) even if resist compulsion. Invest 4,000 x CL numen to maintain effect. Sympathy is the same, except the command is to stay in an area or touch/possess an object.

sections.heading: Antitech FieldTG
sections.text: Antitech FieldTG: Warding (technological effects; 1st level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (hedge: robots, etc.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 6th level; hedges out robots, etc. and suppresses functioning of technology inside field.

sections.heading: Anti-Vermin BarrierTM2
sections.text: Anti-Vermin BarrierTM2: Hedge (vermin; 2nd level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (emanation to cubes; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (9 HD to 1 HD; -4 levels) = 1st level; hedges out vermin of 1 HD or less (incl. individual members of swarms).

sections.heading: Anything to PleaseAPG
sections.text: Anything to PleaseAPG: Compel (please me; 2nd level) + Restricted Spell (access to Charm or Greed domain; -1 level) = 1st level; subject attacks your enemies, gives you its most valuable possession, or grovels at you for 1 rd.

sections.heading: ApparitionCA
sections.text: ApparitionCA: Spook (0 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (emanation; inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (frightened to shaken; -1 level) = 2nd level; those viewing subject from within 20 ft. shaken 1 rd./level. Variants:

sections.heading: Apocalypse from the SkyBVD
sections.text: Apocalypse from the SkyBVD: Acid splash (0 level) + Energy Admixture (fire and sonic; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to zero; -1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1 mi./level; +8 levels) + Empower Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 9th level; 10d6 each acid, sonic, and fire to everything within a 1-mile/level radius, after 8-hour ritual casting completed.

sections.heading: ApopsiSRD
sections.text: ApopsiSRD: Compel (don’t use spell/power; 2nd level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 spell/3 levels; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 8th level (listed as 9th); target loses access to 1 spell or power per 3 levels you possess. Invest 450 x CL numen to maintain effect.

sections.heading: Appearance of LifeHA
sections.text: Appearance of LifeHA: Glamer (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level; up to 2d4 +1/level (+5 max.) HD worth of undead appear as if alive (but no tactile or thermal components).

sections.heading: Apport ObjectOcA
sections.text: Apport ObjectOcA: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Appraising TouchDr325
sections.text: Appraising TouchDr325: Skill enhancement (Knowledge: lore; 0 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (estimate value only; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 to +1/2 levels; +2 levels) = 0 level (listed as 1st); aubject gains +1/2 levels to appraise items.

sections.heading: Aptitude Appropriator, Rary’sGA
sections.text: Aptitude Appropriator, Rary’sGA: Skill enhancement (0 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (skill known to creature touched; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (+0 to +10; +2 levels) = 1st level; you gain +1/2 level (+10 max.) to one skill known to creature touched.

sections.heading: Aquatic CavalryUW
sections.text: Aquatic CavalryUW: Summon (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 2 hippocampus; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (large body of water; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); summons 1 hippocampus/3 levels.

sections.heading: Aquatic EscapeCSc
sections.text: Aquatic EscapeCSc: Polymorph (animal; 3rd level) + Cascade Spell (reduce self; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (Diminutive; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (fish only; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Animal or Water domain; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); swift casting turns you into a Diminutive fish (low-light vision, swim 30 ft., no air breathing) for 1 rd.

sections.heading: Aqueous Column, Laeral’sDr181
sections.text: Aqueous Column, Laeral’sDr181: Creation (water; 1st level) + [Cascade Spell (mage hand; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 8 lbs./level; +1 level)] + Shape Spell (target to cylinder; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (conc. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Pacific Spell (cannot use to drown a creature, etc.; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 4th); creates cylindrical fishtank with no glass.

sections.heading: Aqueous OrbAPG
sections.text: Aqueous OrbAPG: Whelm (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (partial  action; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 3rd level; damage cap 5d6 and carried along.

sections.heading: ArbitramentPnA
sections.text: ArbitramentPnA: Electric arc (0 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (staggered; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Arboreal HammerUM
sections.text: Arboreal HammerUM: Energy mace (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) = 3rd level; partial action ranged touch attacks deal 1d6/level each (10d6 max).

sections.heading: Arboreal TransformationCM
sections.text: Arboreal TransformationCM: Polymorph (plant; 3rd level) + Cascade Spell (enlarge person; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (Huge; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Restructed Spell (access to Plant domain or Wood mystery; -1 level) = 9th level; target becomes Huge tree, takes 3d4 Cha penalty to your commands (you can cause the tree to be inanimate if not able to command it). Invest 900 x CL numen to maintain the effect.

sections.heading: Arcana TheftUM
sections.text: Arcana TheftUM: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (change target to you, instead of dispelling; +2 levels) + Bouncing Spell (+1 level) = 3rd level; you “steal” an ongoing spell effect. Variants:

sections.heading: Arcane ConcordanceAPG
sections.text: Arcane ConcordanceAPG: Bestow Feat (metamagic; 1st level) + Variable Spell (choose metamagic feat at time of casting; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Sudden Metamagic; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 3rd level; spells cast within 10 ft. of you are affected by metamagic (Extend Spell, Reach Spell, Silent Spell, Still Spell, or Widen Spell), as if by the Sudden Metamagic feat (limits to total spell level, etc. apply).

sections.heading: Arcane Lock
sections.text: Arcane Lock: Skill enhancement (Disable Device; 0 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (transmute: steel; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 8 cu. ft./level; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Item-Specific Spell (door, chest, etc. only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level; warded chest or portal is -1/2 levels to unlock (locked at DC 20 even if no lock present), and gains hardness and hp of steel; invest 100 x CL numen to maintain effects past 1 hr./level. Variants:

sections.heading: Arcane ParryRR2
sections.text: Arcane ParryRR2: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Quicken Spell (+4 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (­1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); immediate casting teleports you out of the way of one incoming attack, reappearing in same location. Variants:

sections.heading: Arcane ProhibitionRRO
sections.text: Arcane ProhibitionRRO: Dispel (0 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (arcane spells only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level; opposed Concentration checks needed to cast arcane spells within 120’r. of you.

sections.heading: Arcane Prohibition, GreaterRRO
sections.text: Arcane Prohibition, GreaterRRO: Antimagic field (6th level) + Selective Spell (divine and druidic magic exempt; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10’r. to 20’r.; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 8th level; arcane magic does not function in a 20’r. emanation around you.

sections.heading: Arctic HazeFB
sections.text: Arctic HazeFB: Ray of frost (0 level) + Energy Admixture (slashing; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (wisp; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 1d6; -5 levels) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); 5d6 damage/rd. (half cold, half slashing) and obscures vision in 20’r. Variant:

sections.heading: Ardent GazeRRO
sections.text: Ardent GazeRRO: Warding (illusions; 1st level) + Irresistible Spell (+3 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to long; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (single target only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) = 7th level (listed as 5th); you can see target’s true form clearly at up to Long range despite illusions, fog, darkness, polymorph effects, and possibly other concealment (CL 15th) or across planes (CL 18th).

sections.heading: Armament of the GodsRR
sections.text: Armament of the GodsRR: Enhancement (2nd level) + Item-Specific Spell (armor and weapons; -1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 2 hrs./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 4th); one suit of armor, shield, or weapon per level (not 20 per level as listed) gains long-lasting enhancement bonus of +1/3 levels.

sections.heading: Armor ContingencyAUG2
sections.text: Armor ContingencyAUG2: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (target: touch to line of sight; +5 levels) + Reach Spell (destination: close to touch; -1 level) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (unattended armor designated during casting; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (armor appears on you, not next to you; ad hoc +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 1st level; designated suit of armor appears on you if a specific event occurs.

sections.heading: Armor LockCSc
sections.text: Armor LockCSc: Celerity (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Exend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (armored; -2 levels) = 0 level (listed as 1st); armored creature is flat-footed and slowed by 10 ft. for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Armor of AgathysPH5
sections.text: Armor of AgathysPH5: Spark of life (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (cold; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of frost; +1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Restricted Spell (sorcerer with [cold] bloodline; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 5d6 and +20 to +5; -3 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); you gain 5d6 temp hp and attackers take 1d6+5 cold damage when hitting you.

sections.heading: Armor of BramblesRR2
sections.text: Armor of BramblesRR2: Barkskin (2nd level) + Disadvantages (max. Dex, spell failure, etc.; ad hoc -1 level) + Cascade Spell (invisible needle; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Resistible Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (+15 to +5) = 4th level; melee attackers take 1d6 + 1/level (max. +5) piercing (Reflex half).

sections.heading: Armor of DarknessSRD
sections.text: Armor of DarknessSRD: Deflection (0 level) + Augment Spell (+1/6 levels; +1 level) + Augment Spell (base +3; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (glamer: conceals face; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (no olfactory; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (darkvision; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 10 min./level; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Darkness domain; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 4th); subject gains +3 deflection (+1/6 levels) and darkvision.

sections.heading: Armor of LightRR
sections.text: Armor of LightRR: Attribute boost (0 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (bundled bonuses to +3; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 4th level; you shed light, and gain +3 sacred bonus to AC, saves, and 1 attribute/3 levels.

sections.heading: Armor of UndeathRR
sections.text: Armor of UndeathRR: Spark of life (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 hr./level; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (mage armor; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; you gain +4 armor bonus and 1d6 temp. hp/level (max. 10d6) lasting up to 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Arms of the MotherDD
sections.text: Arms of the MotherDD:  Dimensional skip (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (druid; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (willing subjects; -2 levels) = 6th level (listed as 3rd); you and up to 1 willing ally/3 levels disappear into the earth for 1 hr./level (treat as night’s rest) and emerge healed by an additional 15d6 hp.

sections.heading: Arrow CharmRR
sections.text: Arrow CharmRR: Detection (2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to line of sight; +4 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (bearing your arcane mark; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); with concentration, you can locate a person or object bearing your arcane mark (or brandAPG) up to ¼ mile/level away.

sections.heading: Arrow DeflectionAUG2
sections.text: Arrow DeflectionAUG2: Bestow feat (Exotic Weapon Proficiency: unarmed; 1st level) + Effect-Specific Spell (as prerequisite only; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Deflect Arrows; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); you can use the Deflect Arrows feat if you have at least 1 hand free.

sections.heading: Arrow EruptionAPG
sections.text: Arrow EruptionAPG: Invisible needle (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat; any two you normally have with ranged weapons; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (within 30 ft. of creature you killed; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Versatile Strike; +1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 12d6 (divided among targets within 30’r. of corpse), and properties of a physical weapon (not spell) used to kill the location-focus creature apply.

sections.heading: Arrow MindCAd
sections.text: Arrow MindCAd: Bestow feat (Ranged Threat; 1st level) + Augment Spell (BAB +16 effects; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (bow only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger; -2 levels) = 1st level; your bowshots threaten area around you and do not provoke AoO. For an immediate casting time, apply the Sudden Spell and Interrupting Spell feats as well (2nd level spell lasting 1 round).

sections.heading: Arrow of LawUM
sections.text: Arrow of LawUM: Inertia (0 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (chaotic only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (invisible needle; +1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Positive Spell (modified for law; +0 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6 (half piercing, half axiomatic; 1.5x total and daze 1 rd. vs. chaotic, half and no dazing for others).

sections.heading: Arrow of SlayingSRD
sections.text: Arrow of SlayingSRD: Enhancement (2nd level) + Item-Specific Spell (projectile; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4d4; +3 levels) + Channel Spell (into missile; +1 level) = 5th level; fire one arrow with +1/3 levels enhancement, +5d4 Con (Fort half) on a hit. Variants:

sections.heading: Arrow StormCAd
sections.text: Arrow StormCAd: Bestow feat (Manyshot; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Sleight of Hand; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +16 effects; +3 levels) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Archery domain; -1 level) = 4th level; swift casting allows you to make one ranged attack against all targets within 1st range increment.

sections.heading: ArrowlinkRRO
sections.text: ArrowlinkRRO: Bestow feat (Spellstrike; 1st level) + Quicken Spell (+4 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Archery domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; swift casting allows you to deliver touch spells through arrows as [strikes] for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Arrowlink, GreaterRRO
sections.text: Arrowlink, GreaterRRO: Arrowlink (4th level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Precise Shot; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Fell Shot; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Striking Mastery; +1 level) = 7th level; as arrowlink, but imbued arrows make ranged touch attacks.

sections.heading: ArrowsparkRRO
sections.text: ArrowsparkRRO: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Channel Spell (bow: see below; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (Versatile Strike: feats apply; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Archery domain; -1 level) = 8th level; for 1 hr./level, you can fire “arrows” of force from bow (damage cap 23d6 , divided among arrows, which make ranged touch attacks using the bow’s properties and your archery-related feats).

sections.heading: AshstarSSt
sections.text: AshstarSSt: Whelm (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (damaged that round; -2 levels) = 2nd level; each round, you deal 1d6 nonlethal/level (max. 10d6) to a creature already injured that round.

sections.heading: Aspect of the BearAPG
sections.text: Aspect of the BearAPG: Enhancement (2nd level) + Augment Spell (+1 base; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (natural armor; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 feat/3 levels; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (improved combat maneuvers only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Animal domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; subject +1 enhancement to natural armor (+1/4 levels) and gains one improved combat maneuver feat (Improved Bull Rush, Improved Grapple, etc.) per 3 levels.

sections.heading: Aspect of the DeityBED
sections.text: Aspect of the DeityBED: Polymorph (outsider; 3rd level) + Augment Spell (additional effects; +5 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 6th level; you become celestial or fiendish creature (including resistances, etc.) for 1 rd./level. AKA visage of the deityCD. Variants:

sections.heading: Aspect of the FalconAPG
sections.text: Aspect of the FalconAPG: Skill enhancement (Perception; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Cascade Spell [(bestow feat: Improved Critical; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +16 effects; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Item-Specific Spell (bow or crossbow only; -2 levels)] + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Animal domain; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); you gain +1/2 levels to Perception, +1 to attacks and damage, and expanded crit threat range and multiplier with one bow or crossbow.

sections.heading: Aspect of the Icy HunterCM
sections.text: Aspect of the Icy HunterCM: Polymorph (magical beast; 3rd level) + Cascade Spell (enlarge self; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (winter wolf only; -2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; you become a Large winter wolf as a swift action, +4 Str, -2 Dex, +4 natural armor, darkvision, favored terrain +4, low-light vision, scent, speed 50 ft., resist cold 20, can use breath weapon once during duration.

sections.heading: Aspect of the StagAPG
sections.text: Aspect of the StagAPG: Bestow feat (1st level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (invisible needle; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 feat/3 levels; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Animal domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6 and +60 ft. to +20 ft.; -2 levels) = 4th level; you gain +20 ft. speed, gore attack for 5d6, Favored Terrain (forests) +2, and Combat Reflexes (and Draw Attack at CL 9th, Dodge at 12th, Improved Critical (gore) at 15th, and Mobility at 18th).

sections.heading: Aspect of the WolfAPG
sections.text: Aspect of the WolfAPG: Polymorph (monstrous humanoid; 3rd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (anthropomorphic wolf; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Str; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Dex; +1 levels) + Augment Spell (+4 total bonus; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Animal domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; you become a Medium wolf-man (+6 Str, +4 Dex, +2 natural armor, low-light vision, scent, bite, trip) for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Assassin’s SensesRR
sections.text: Assassin’s SensesRR: Bestow feat (Improved Critical; 1st level) + Variable Spell (different weapons you use; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +16 effects; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (rogue skill trick; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); your attacks have double crit threat range, +1 to crit multiplier, and crits auto-confirmed for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Assume AppearanceHA
sections.text: Assume AppearanceHA: Polymorph (humanoid; 3rd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (dead creature from whom piece of corpse used as material component; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Perform; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (reduce; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); you assume the form of dead person up to 1 size smaller, with +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Perform (acting) to impersonate that individual.

sections.heading: Astral CaravanSRD
sections.text: Astral CaravanSRD: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (destination: close to interplanar; +7 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (Astral plane; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Variable Spell (allows “piggybacking” by astral traveler; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Psychoportation discipline, Void domain, etc.; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level; you project yourself to the Astral Plane, can lead others who join you via astral traveler (q.v.). Ends when enter any other plane from the Astral (including the one you came from). This spell gets you to the Astral Plane; successfully navigating it requires Survival, Knowledge (planes), and/or Planar Sense checks.

sections.heading: Astral CelerityS&M
sections.text: Astral CelerityS&M: Celerity (0 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (­1 level) + Augment Spell (+20 ft. to +40 ft.; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (Astral Plane; -2 levels) = 1st level; your base speed is increased by 40 ft. while on the Astral Plane.

sections.heading: Astral ConstructSRD
sections.text: Astral ConstructSRD: Summon (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (summoning to creation; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 1st level; you create a CR ½ astral construct lasting 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Astral Projection
sections.text: Astral Projection: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (conjuration to necromancy; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/3 levels; +2 levels) + Variable Spell (enter various planes; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 9th level. This works if it is assumed that the silver cord/astral body mechanics are properties of the Astral Plane itself, rather than of the spell (aside from the school change).

sections.heading: Astral Projection, LesserUM
sections.text: Astral Projection, LesserUM: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (conjuration to necromancy; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (Astral Plane; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 5th level; you project yourself to the Astral Plane.

sections.heading: Astral TravelerSRD
sections.text: Astral TravelerSRD: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (destination: close to interplanar; +7 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (Astral plane; -2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (must join material body of creature using astral caravan, q.v.; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 2nd level; you or creature touched joins an existing astral caravan. AKA join with astral travelerTM2.

sections.heading: Astral WindowTM2
sections.text: Astral WindowTM2: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (Astral Plane only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Void domain, etc.; -1 level) = 4th level; the subject can see into the Astral Plane (any location within the plane) for 1 rd./level. Variant:

sections.heading: AtavismUM
sections.text: AtavismUM: Attribute boost (0 level) + Augment Spell (+2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (all attributes; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (barkskin; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (animal; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Animal domain; -1 level) = 4th level; animal gains +4 enhancement to all attributes and +1/4 levels enhancement to natural armor.

sections.heading: Atonement
sections.text: Atonement: Remove condition (misdeed/alignment change; 1st level) + Crippling Drain (+4 levels) + Augment Spell (moderate to critical; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level.

sections.heading: AttractionOA
sections.text: AttractionOA: Blessing (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +5; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd./level; -2 levels) = 1st level; subject saves vs. Will or is +5 to be hit and takes +5 damage for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: AttractionSRD
sections.text: AttractionSRD: Compel (get close to person or object; 2nd level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 1st level; invest 300 x CL numen (1st level x 50 x 6) to maintain effect beyond 1 rd. Variants:

sections.heading: Audible WhisperAUG2
sections.text: Audible WhisperAUG2: Figment (0 level) + Shape Spell (cubes to spread; +0 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (auditory speech only; -3 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 0); your whispers can be heard by all within 60 ft. for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Augment FamiliarCW
sections.text: Augment FamiliarCW: Resistance (0 level) + Cascade Spell (inure: slashing; +1 level) + Energy Admixture (bludgeoning and piercing; +0 levels) + Tenuous Spell (overcome by magic weapons; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 attribute/3 levels; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (+2 to +4; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (your familiar; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (arcane bond: familiar; -1 level) = 2nd level; your familiar gains the following:

sections.heading: AugmentationTM2
sections.text: AugmentationTM2: Bestow feat (Empower Spell; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (Sudden Metamagic; +2 levels) = 3rd level; spells you cast for the next 1 rd./level are Empowered, as if by the Sudden Metamagic feat (limits to total spell level, etc. apply).

sections.heading: Aura of Cold, GreaterFB
sections.text: Aura of Cold, GreaterFB: Ray of frost (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Inexorable Evoction (+3 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 7th); you emanate 5d6 cold/rd. (no save) in a 10’r.

sections.heading: Aura of Cold, LesserFB
sections.text: Aura of Cold, LesserFB: Greater aura of coldFB (4th level) + Widen Spell (10’r. to 5’r.; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (5d6 to 1d6; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); you emanate 1d6 cold/rd. (no save) in a 5’r.

sections.heading: Aura of ComfortTM2
sections.text: Aura of ComfortTM2: Endure elements (1st level) + Cascade Spell (prestidigitation: keep dry; +1 level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Travel domain; -1 level) = 2nd level (ranger 1st); keeps subject cool/warm and dry for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Aura of ConfidencePnH
sections.text: Aura of ConfidencePnH: Blessing (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) = 4th level; you and adjacent allies +1 morale to atks, damage, saves, checks. Use in conjunction with the Permanent Spell feat to emulate the FatemakerPnH prestige class feature of the same name.

sections.heading: Aura of EvasionDN
sections.text: Aura of EvasionDN: Bestow feat (Lighting Reflexes; 1st level) + Augment Spell (Acrobatics 6 ranks effects; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 5th level; +2 to Reflex saves and evasion to those within 10 ft. of you.

sections.heading: Aura of LifePH5
sections.text: Aura of LifePH5: Spark of life (1st level) + Cascade Spell (warding: negative energy; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 1d6; -2 levels) = 4th level; allies in 20’r. emanation from you are immune to negative energy, heal 1 hp/rd. while you concentrate.

sections.heading: Aura of MadnessCRB
sections.text: Aura of MadnessCRB: Lesser compelling confusion (1st level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Madness domain; -1  level) = 4th level; swift casting causes confusion in those you select within 20 ft. of you for 1 rd.

sections.heading: Aura of MenaceRR2
sections.text: Aura of MenaceRR2: Skill enhancement (Bluff; 0 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; you gain +1/2 levels (max. +5) to Bluff for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Aura of ProtectionCRB
sections.text: Aura of ProtectionCRB: Deflection (0 level) + Cascade Spell (inure: sonic; +1 level) + Energy Admixture (acid, cold, electricity, fire; +0 levels) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Protection domain; -1 level) = 4th level; swift casting grants you and allies in 20’r. +2 deflection to AC and resistance 6 each to acid, cold, electricity, fire, and sonic, for 1 rd.

sections.heading: Aura of the SunLEF
sections.text: Aura of the SunLEF: Warding (darkness; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 4th); for 1 rd./level you shed light and suppress [darkness] spells within 10 ft. of you.

sections.heading: Aura of the UnremarkableUI
sections.text: Aura of the UnremarkableUI: Compel (think actions unremarkable; 2nd level) + Selective Spell (yours and your allies’; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; for 1 min./level, those within 20 ft. of you find all your and your allies’ actions unremarkable; effect broken if hostile action taken, and new save each time asked about what happened.

sections.heading: Aura of VitalityMF
sections.text: Aura of VitalityMF: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Dex; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Con; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 total; +1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (druid; -1 level) = 6th level (listed as 7th); 1 creature/3 levels gains +4 sacred bonus to Str, Dex, and Con for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Aura SightACG
sections.text: Aura SightACG: Detection (alignment; 2nd level) + Widen Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (conc. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 3rd); you detect alignment in 120-ft. quarter-circle (number, and location and power of each).

sections.heading: AuroraGA
sections.text: AuroraGA: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (compel: do not leave area; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 5d6; -3 levels) = 6th level; damage cap 5d6 force/rd. and cannot leave area (Will half/neg.).

sections.heading: Aurora BorealisAPG
sections.text: Aurora BorealisAPG: Compel (fascinated; 2nd level) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of frost; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (wisp; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. squares to 20-ft. squares; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (non-consecutive rounds; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Void domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 5d6; -3 levels) = 4th level (divine 5th); damage cap 5d6 cold, obstructs vision, and fascinates those within close range who can see the display.

sections.heading: Authenticating GazePC
sections.text: Authenticating GazePC: Skill enhancement (Knowledge: lore; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Linguistics; +1 level) = 1st level; +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to checks.

sections.heading: AvalancheRR2
sections.text: AvalancheRR2: Energy mace (0 level) + Energy Admixture (cold; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (pin; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (snowy, mountainous area only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level; damage cap 15d6 and pinned; area moves up to 90 ft./rd. with concentration.

sections.heading: Avalanche, CallFB
sections.text: Avalanche, CallFB: Energy mace (0 level) + Energy Admixture (cold; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (pin; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (pinning: 1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (outdoors; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Winter domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 10d6; -2 levels) = 5th level; snow deals 5d6 bludgeoning and 5d6 cold damage in 20’r. and pins those in area for 1 hr./level (Reflex half/neg.).

sections.heading: Avalanche, ObedientCD
sections.text: Avalanche, ObedientCD: Energy mace (0 level) + Energy Admixture (cold; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Avalanche, Zajimarn’sMF
sections.text: Avalanche, Zajimarn’sMF: Ray of frost (0 level) + Cascade Spell (push; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Explosive Spell (+1 level) = 6th level (listed as 9th); damage cap 15d6 and pushed along line of cubes, expelled from area, and knocked prone.

sections.heading: AvasculateLM
sections.text: AvasculateLM: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) + Lingering Evocation (+2 levels) = 7th level; ray deals up to 15d6 negative energy plus 4d6 bleed, plus Fort. or stunned 1 round.

sections.heading: Avatar of ChaosRR
sections.text: Avatar of ChaosRR: Blessing (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement; +1 level) + Lucky Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell [(bestow feat: Magical Talent; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (Magical Array; +1 level) + Augment Spell (11 ranks effects; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = +3 levels] + Cascade Spell [panic infidels = spook (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (lawful; -2 levels) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) = +1 level] + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Chaos domain, etc.; -1 level) = 6th level (listed as 8th); you gain +3 luck bonus to attacks, damage, saves, and checks; panic lawful onlookers within 60 ft.; and gain array of spell-like powers: at will—detect law, 3/day—Enkili’s luckRR, 1/day—magic circle against law, chaos hammer, dispel law.

sections.heading: Avatar of EvilRR
sections.text: Avatar of EvilRR: Resistance (0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (magical array: see avatar of chaosRR; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (panic infidels: see avatar of chaosRR; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Evil domain, etc.; -1 level) = 6th level (listed as 8th); you gain +2 profane bonus to attacks, damage, and saves; panic [good] onlookers within 60 ft.; and gain array of spell-like powers: at will—sanctuary, 3/day—chill touch, 1/day—magic circle against good, confusion, lesser insanity (3d4 Wis).

sections.heading: Avatar of GoodRR
sections.text: Avatar of GoodRR: Compel (don’t attack; 2nd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (self; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Magical Talent; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 use/3 levels; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (panic infidels: see avatar of chaosRR; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 min./level; +2 levels + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Good domain, etc.; -1 level) = 6th level; evil onlookers within 60 ft. are panicked; creatures within 20 ft. must make Will saves to attack you; and you can cast a quickened positive energy burst (see below) as a spell-like ability once per 3 levels.

sections.heading: Magical Talent
sections.text: Magical Talent: Spark of life (1st level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +3 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 5th level; 5d6 positive energy in 20’r. as a swift action.

sections.heading: Avatar of HeavenRR
sections.text: Avatar of HeavenRR: Deflection (0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (magical array: see avatar of chaosRR; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (panic infidels: see avatar of chaosRR; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (servant of lawful good; -1 level) = 6th level; you gain +3 sacred bonus to atks, damage, and AC; 1d6 temp. hp/level (max. 10d6); panic chaotic evil onlookers within 60 ft.; and gain array of spell-like powers: at will—detect chaos/evil, 3/day—aid, 1/day—magic circle against evil, holy smite, dispel evil.

sections.heading: Avatar of LawRR
sections.text: Avatar of LawRR: Deflection (0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (magical array: see avatar of chaosRR; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (panic infidels: see avatar of chaosRR; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min/level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Law domain; -1 level) = 6th level; you gain a +5 axiomatic bonus to AC (+1/6 levels; max. +8 total at CL 18th); panic chaotic onlookers within 60’r.; and gain array of spell-like powers: at will—detect chaos, 3/day—field of lawDLM, 1/day—magic circle against chaos, order’s wrath, dispel evil.

sections.heading: Avatar of NatureRR
sections.text: Avatar of NatureRR: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+4 bonus; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (ranged attacks only; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (panic infidels: see avatar of chaosRR; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (magical array: see avatar of chaosRR; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell [(compel: wander off; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) = +2 levels] + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (servant of CG or nature-oriented deity; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as 8th); you gain +4 sacred bonus to ranged atks, damage; lawful evil onlookers within 60’r. are panicked; creatures attacking you must save or wander off; and you gain an array of spell-like powers: at will—lesser entangle, 3/day—dominate animal, 1/day—magic circle against evil, command plants.

sections.heading: Avatar of SlaughterRR
sections.text: Avatar of SlaughterRR: Blessing (0 level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 total bonus; +2 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 min./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell [(jet of flame; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) = +1 level] + Cascade Spell [(bestow feat: Magical Talent; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 use/3 levels; +2 levels) = +2 levels] + Cascade Spell (panic infidels: see avatar of chaosRR; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (servant of chaotic evil; -1 level) = 6th level (listed as 8th); you gain +4 profane bonus to atks, damage; those hitting you in melee take 1d6+5 fire damage); you can cast a quickened negative energy burst (see below) 1/3 levels; and lawful good creatures within 60’r. are panicked.

sections.heading: Avatar of TyrannyRR
sections.text: Avatar of TyrannyRR: Deflection (0 level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (magic weapon; +1 level) + Cascade Spell [(resistance; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (Will saves; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (LE; -2 levels) = +2 levels] + Cascade Spell (panic infidels: see avatar of chaosRR; +1 level) + Cascade Spell [(haste; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = +2 levels] + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (servant of lawful evil; -1 level) = 6th level (listed as 8th); you gain +1 profane bonus to atks, damage; +2 deflection to AC; weapon wielded gains +1 enhancement/3 levels; lawful evil creatures within 60’r. gain +3 to Will saves; and chaotic good creaturs within 60’r. are panicked.

sections.heading: AversionSRD
sections.text: AversionSRD: Compel (avoid creature, location, object, or topic specified; 2nd level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (telepath; -1 level) = 2nd level; subject attempts to stay at least Close range distance away from specified creature, location, or object (cannot be its bonded item, familiar, etc.), or refrains from speaking about topic or performing action, etc. Invest 600 x CL numen to maintain effect.

sections.heading: Avoidance WardOcA
sections.text: Avoidance WardOcA: Compel (don’t mess with door; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (-2 levels) + Variable Spell (choose creature type upon casting spell; +1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (Spellcraft check needed to cast; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (bolt of force; -2 levels) = 4th level; after ritual, creatures of specified type cannot touch, attack, or otherwise interact with door chosen; you take 1d6 force/level (max. 15d6).

sections.heading: Awaken ConstructOcA

Bands of SirellynS&M lacks the Fell Binding component (-1 level) and lasts 1 min./level (+1 level) = 5th level (listed as 3rd).

sections.heading: Bane BowCD
sections.text: Bane BowCD: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+5 total bonus; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd.; -3 levels) + Cascade Spell (invisible needle; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (-2 levels) + Variable Spell (choose creature type at time of casting; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); damage cap +13d6, divided among iterative attacks, each with +5 to attacks and damage.

sections.heading: Bane of the ForgeRR2
sections.text: Bane of the ForgeRR2: Bestow feat (Unstoppable Strike; 1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (druid; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (also Rapid Strike; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (vs. metal armor only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+5 bonus; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (attack bonus only; -2 levels) + Item-Specific Spell (nonmetallic weapon; -2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 2nd); one non-metallic weapon ignores AC bonuses from metal armor/shields for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Baneful Attractor, Strahd’sDr348
sections.text: Baneful Attractor, Strahd’sDr348: Dispel (0 level) + Selective Spell (redirect effect; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Effect=Specific Spell (ranged attack spells only; -2 levels + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = 5th level (listed as 4th); ranged attack spells or ranged touch spells targeting others within 20’r. of target are redirected to target instead.

sections.heading: Baneful Deflector, Hornung’sTM2
sections.text: Baneful Deflector, Hornung’sTM2: Compel (choose different target; 2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (ranged attacks only; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (wild magic; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 2nd); for 1 rd./level, those within 120 ft. targeting the subject with ranged attacks must save vs. Will or target a different creature.

sections.heading: Banish SeemingAPG
