sections.text: Banish SeemingAPG: Dispel (0 level) + Bouncing Spell (+2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 effect/3 levels; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (illusion or polymorph only; -1 level) = 3rd level; touch dispels up to 1 illusion and/or suppresses 1 polymorph effect per 3 levels (failed dispels also “bounce”).

sections.heading: Banish ShadowRR
sections.text: Banish ShadowRR: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (target: touch to medium; +1 level) + Reach Spell (destination: close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Creature-Secific Spell x2 ([extraplanar] and [shadow]; -4 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (to Plane of Shadow; -2 levels) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Banner, Alustriel’s7S
sections.text: Banner, Alustriel’s7S: Light (0 level) + Shape Spell (emanation to cubes; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (figment; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) = 2nd level; illusory banner and fanfare also fill one 10-ft. cube/level with light.

sections.heading: Banshee BlastACG
sections.text: Banshee BlastACG: Sound lance (1st level) + Energy Admixture (negative energy; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) + Augment Spell (frightened to panicked; +1 level) = 5th level; damage cap 15d6 (half sonic, half negative energy) and panicked in a 30-ft. cone.

sections.heading: Barbed ChainsHA
sections.text: Barbed ChainsHA: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (diabolic bloodline, devil cultist, etc.; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 1st level (divine 2nd); damage cap 7d6 slashing, divided among interative ranged touch attacks, plus knock prone and victim shaken 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Barghest FeastPF117
sections.text: Barghest FeastPF117: Blessing (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+5 bonus; +3 levels) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (goblinoid caster; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level; ritual (involving devouring a corpse) grants subject +5 profane bonus to attacks, damage, saves, and skill checks.

sections.heading: Barghest’s FeastPnH
sections.text: Barghest’s FeastPnH: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (jet of flame; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4d4; +3 levels) + Crippling Drain (+4 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (corpse only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level; deals up to 20d6 fire plus 5d4 Con drain to corpse. If creature, while alive, would have been destroyed (Con drained to 0 or below), the corpse is utterly destroyed, making a true resurrection needed to raise that creature from the dead (and even that requires a resurrection survival check). Charnel fireBVD (5th level) requires a full ritual casting.

sections.heading: Barrier of RetentionTM2
sections.text: Barrier of RetentionTM2: Antilife shell (6th level) + Variable Spell (ingress rather than egress; +1 level) + Spell (emanation to cubes; +0 levels) + Resistible Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (full ritual; -1 level) = 5th level; those entering one 5-ft. cube/level cannot leave unless save vs. Will.

sections.heading: Barrow HazeACG
sections.text: Barrow HazeACG: Wisp (0 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Cascade Spell [(bestow feat: Reach Spell; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Sudden Metamagic; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (­1 level)] + Location-Specific Spell (targets within fog; -2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 3rd). Your touch and close-range spells can reach anyone within a 20’r. fog cloud within medium range (subject to Sudden Metamagic limits, and x1/3 levels as many spells), and you can see through the fog.

sections.heading: BashAUG
sections.text: BashAUG: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+2 total bonus; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 0 level; swift action grants you +2 bonus to attack and damage on next attack (sacred for divine caster, enhancement for arcane).

sections.heading: Battle RageCRB
sections.text: Battle RageCRB: Enhancement (2nd level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (damage; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 to +1/2 levels; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to War domain; -1 level) = 0 level; creature touched gains +1/2 levels sacred bonus to damage for 1 rd.

sections.heading: Battle TranceARG
sections.text: Battle TranceARG: Bestow feat (Diehard; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Endurance; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+5 bonus; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (mind-affecting; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (dispel; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell ([orc] or access to War domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; you gain Diehard feat and +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Endurance, 1d6 temp hp/level (max. 10d6), and +5 profane bonus vs. [mind-affecting], but must concentrate to cast spells.

sections.heading: BattlecryCM
sections.text: BattlecryCM: Dispel (0 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (charm, compulsion, fear; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (energy mace; +1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 4th level; allies gain +1d6/level (max. +10d6) damage to each of their next attacks, and magical charm, compulsion, or fear effects on them are dispelled.

sections.heading: BattlecryRR
sections.text: BattlecryRR: Inertia (0 level) + Still Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to cone; +1 level) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); creatures (max. HD 7 each) in 30-ft. cone are dazed 1 rd.

sections.heading: BattlefateS&M
sections.text: BattlefateS&M: Enhancement (2nd level) + Variable Spell (no control over effect; -1 level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+1/4 to +1/3; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Chaos or Fate domain; -1 level) = 1st level; subject gains +1/3 levels profane bonus to AC, saves, attacks, or damage (roll 1d4 each round for 1 rd./level).

sections.heading: Battlemind LinkUM
sections.text: Battlemind LinkUM: Hand of fate (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (you and 1 ally; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (attack rolls and initiative; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 6th); for the next 1 min./level, you and one ally both make initiative and attack rolls, both use the higher of the two dice (individual modifiers retained), if applicable.

sections.heading: Bead of Frost, Blaise’sRR2
sections.text: Bead of Frost, Blaise’sRR2: Ray of frost (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Augment Spell (5d6 to 10d6; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); damage cap 10d6 cold.

sections.heading: Beast of a Thousand LegsSSt
sections.text: Beast of a Thousand LegsSSt: Zephyr (0 level) + Shape Spell (line to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1 mi.; +6 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 9th level (listed as epic); tornado winds cover 1-mile radius area for 1 hr./level, except for calm spots you designate.

sections.heading: Beastland FerocityPnH
sections.text: Beastland FerocityPnH: Bestow feat (Diehard; 1st level) + Augment Spell (16 ranks effects; +4 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (disabled or dying; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard or access to Animal domain; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); subject can fight without penalty while disabled or dying.

sections.heading: BeastskinAUG
sections.text: BeastskinAUG: Enhancement (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (natural armor; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 to base; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) = 2nd level; subject gains +1 to natural armor, +1/4 levels. Variants:

sections.heading: BeastspeakACG
sections.text: BeastspeakACG: Tongues (3rd level) + Augment Spell (basic; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (witch or access to Animal domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; you can speak normally while in wild shape, etc.

sections.heading: Beckon BreezeRW
sections.text: Beckon BreezeRW: Zephyr (0 level) + Variable Spell (increase or decrease speed; +1 level) + Shape Spell (line to emanation; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to [air] bloodline, domain, etc.; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (severe to light winds; -3 levels) = 1st level; alter winds in 120’r. by 1 step.

sections.heading: Beckoning CallFC1
sections.text: Beckoning CallFC1: Compel (come to me; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard or access to Charm domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; subject comes to you and/or stands at your side while you concentrate (save each round to end effect). Variants:

sections.heading: Bed Bug BitesRR2
sections.text: Bed Bug BitesRR2: Sickening touch (0 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (sleeping target; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 1st level; sleeping target sickened 1 hr./level (Fort neg.).

sections.heading: Beetle SwarmRR2
sections.text: Beetle SwarmRR2: Invisible needle (0 level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Extend Spell (blindness: 1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 5-ft. cubes; -1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 10d6; -2 levels) = 5th level; damage cap 10d6 plus 3d6/rd. and blinded 1 rd. (Fort half/neg.) in one 5-ft. cube/level, redirect each round as a standard action.

sections.heading: Beggar’s CharmBRL
sections.text: Beggar’s CharmBRL: Skill enhancement (Perform: acting; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Stealth; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; you are +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to be noticed by Perception, and on your Profession (acting) checks.

sections.heading: Beguiling DanceCSc
sections.text: Beguiling DanceCSc: Compel (do nothing; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (ray of beguiling; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (attitude towards you only; -1 level) + Disguise Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard, by dancing; +1 level) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (7+ ranks in Perform: dance; -1 level) = 4th level; onlookers within 20 ft. dazed 1 and take 1d6 + ½ levels (+10 max.) penalty to Cha in determining attitude towards you (charmed at 1; Intuition each round to halve penalty and negate dazing).

sections.heading: Beguiling GiftAPG
sections.text: Beguiling GiftAPG: Compel (accept and use/consume proffered item for 1 round; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Beloved of the ForgePC
sections.text: Beloved of the ForgePC: Skill enhancement (Survival; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Craft; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell [(resistance; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Lucky Spell (+1 level) + Item-Specific Spell (items in your possession; ­2 levels)] + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); you gain +1/2 levels to Craft and Survival checks, and items in your possession have a +3 luck bonus to saves.

sections.heading: Bend FatePnH
sections.text: Bend FatePnH: Variable Spell (blessing, resistance, or skill enhancement; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +3; +1 level) = 2nd level; immediate casting grants +3 to one attack (and damage), save, or check.

sections.heading: Bend SoundsRR2
sections.text: Bend SoundsRR2: Warding (sonic and language-dependent; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (glamer; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (auditory only; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); subject surrounded in silence, warded against [sonic] and [language-dependent] magic.

sections.heading: Bend Sounds, GreaterRR2
sections.text: Bend Sounds, GreaterRR2: Bend soundsRR2 (q.v.; 3rd level) + Shape Spell (target to wall; +1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); barrier of silence protects against [sonic] and [language-dependent] magic.

sections.heading: BerserkergangAPG
sections.text: BerserkergangAPG: Warding (1st level) + Cascade Spell (inure: bludgeoning; +1 level) + Energy Admixture (slashing and piercing; +0 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 warding/3 levels; +2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Restricted Spell (skald; -1 level) = 5th level; subject temporarily immune to fear, pain, and [inertia] effects, plus 1 more category per 3 levels above 9th, and also gains DR 13/—.

sections.heading: Bestow Curse, ConditionalUI
sections.text: Bestow Curse, ConditionalUI: Bestow curse (q.v.; 3rd level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Concentration; +1 level) = 4th level; as bestow curse, but your effective caster level for purposes of removing curse is +1/2 levels. Name a realistic condition upon which the curse ends, and the cost to maintain the effect is only 200 x CL numen.

sections.heading: Bestow Curse, MajorUM
sections.text: Bestow Curse, MajorUM: Bestow curse (3rd level) + Tenacious Spell (+1 level) = 5th level (4th for witch or divine caster). Remove curse only suppresses a major curse for 1 rd./level; it must be successfully removed again while suppressed in order to be permanently removed.

sections.heading: Bestow InsightARG
sections.text: Bestow InsightARG: Skill enhancement (0 level) + Variable Spell (choose skill at time of casting; +1 level) = 1st level; subject +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to one skill.

sections.heading: Bestow PowerSRD
sections.text: Bestow PowerSRD:  Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (bestow slot on target; +1 level) = 2nd level; you lose one spontaneous spell slot, transferring it to another spontaneous caster.

sections.heading: Bestow Weapon ProficiencyUC
sections.text: Bestow Weapon ProficiencyUC: Bestow feat (Exotic Weapon Proficiency; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (weapon held; -1 level) = 2nd level; subject gains Exotic proficiency with weapon held for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Bewildering SubstitutionCC
sections.text: Bewildering SubstitutionCC: Glamer (1st level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 2nd); up to 1 creature/3 levels disguised as one another, as if had magically changed places, but only those you specify see the illusion. Cf. confounding battlefieldRR2.

sections.heading: Bewildering VisionsCC
sections.text: Bewildering VisionsCC: Sickening touch (0 level) + Fell Sickening (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nauseated; +2 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; target is nauseated 1 rd./level (Fort sickened). Vision of punishmentCV is Tenuous instead of Phantasmal, and is Restricted (good caster; -1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Big SkyMW
sections.text: Big SkyMW: Variable Spell (spook or blessing; +1 level) + Cross-Class Spell (druid; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Fell Frightening (+1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 5th level; you and allies within 20 ft. gain +3 sacred bonus to attacks, damage, and saves vs. fear, while enemies are panicked 1 rd./level (Will shaken).

sections.heading: Binding
sections.text: Binding: Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (casting requires victim’s HD x 1,000 gp worth of gems; -1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Binding EarthARG
sections.text: Binding EarthARG: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Variable Spell (damage scales with movement rather than caster level; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (earth or stone floor; -1 level) = 2nd level; target entangled, treats earth/stone as difficult terrain and takes 1d6 damage/5 ft. of movement (max. 10d6).

sections.heading: Binding PactAUG2
sections.text: Binding PactAUG2: Damage attribute (1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (all attributes; +3 levels) + Delay Spell (when not fulfilling promise; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (willing recipient; -2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (two people; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; two willing creatures make a bargain, each suffering 1d4 damage/day to all attributes if refuses to fulfil. Invest 200 x CL numen to maintain effect.

sections.heading: Binding TiesAPG
sections.text: Binding TiesAPG: Warding (1st level) + Variable Spell (select warded condition at time of casting; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Community domain; -1 level) = 1st level; creature touched is immune to effects of specified condition for 1 rd./level; you are sickened during that time.

sections.heading: Binding WindsCD
sections.text: Binding WindsCD: Bind (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (silence; +2 levels) + Concent-ration Spell (+1 level) = 5th level.

sections.heading: Bite of the WerebearWotC
sections.text: Bite of the WerebearWotC: Polymorph (monstrous humanoid; 3rd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (hybrid werebear; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+8 total; +3 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (enlarge person; +1 level) + Augment Spell (Huge; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 7th level; you gain +14 Str, +4 Dex, +8 Con and Wis (and Cha at CL 15th, Int at 18th), +6 natural armor, DR 5/silver, blindsense 60 ft., low-light vision, scent, claw attacks (2d6), grab, and rend.

sections.heading: Bite of the WereboarWotC
sections.text: Bite of the WereboarWotC: Polymorph (monstrous humanoid; 3rd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (hybrid wereboar; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+6 total; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (Str and Con; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (non-extended barkskin; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 5th level; you gain +8 Str, +6 Con, +2 natural armor (+1/2 levels, max. +12 total at 20th), low-light vision, scent, blindsense 30 ft., gore attack (1d6), and Spirited Charge.

sections.heading: Bite of the WereratWotC
sections.text: Bite of the WereratWotC: Polymorph (monstrous humanoid; 3rd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (hybrid wererat; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 total; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (Dex and Con; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat; Weapon Finesse; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; you gain +6 Str, +4 Con, +2 natural armor, low-light vision, scent, bite attack (1d6), and Weapon Finesse.

sections.heading: Bite of the WeretigerWotC
sections.text: Bite of the WeretigerWotC: Polymorph (monstrous humanoid; 3rd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (hybrid weretiger; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+6 total; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (enlarge person; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (Huge; +1 level) = 6th level; you gain +10 Str, +4 Dex, +6 Con and Wis (and Cha at CL 15th, Int at 18th), +4 natural armor, DR 5/silver, blindsense 60 ft., low-light vision, scent, claw (1d6) and bite (1d8) attacks, grab, pounce, and rake.

sections.heading: Bite of the WerewolfWotC
sections.text: Bite of the WerewolfWotC: Polymorph (monstrous humanoid; 3rd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (hybrid werewolf; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 total; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (Dex and Con; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (non-extended barkskin; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Blind-Fight; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; you gain +2 Str, +4 Dex, +4 Con, +2 natural armor (+1/3 levels, max. +8 total at 18th), low-light vision, scent, bite attack (1d6), trip, and Blind-Fight.

sections.heading: Bite of the WolfSRD
sections.text: Bite of the WolfSRD: Invisible needle (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; you gain bite attack for 1d6/level (max. 5d6). Variants:

sections.heading: Black BagBVD
sections.text: Black BagBVD: Dimensional pocket (1st level) + Cascade Spell (creation; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (shaping; +2 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (torture implements only; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); small bag of holding also contains torture implements (Craft check needed or they are not usable).

sections.heading: Black HandBRL
sections.text: Black HandBRL: Damage attribute (1st level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 attribute/3 levels; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell [(attribute boost; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level)] = 5th level (listed as 4th); your touch deals 1d4 Str, Dex, and Con drain, and you gain +2 enhancement to Str, Dex, and Con for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Black TalonPGF
sections.text: Black TalonPGF: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Energy Admixture (slashing; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (magic weapon; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level; partial acton ranged touch attacks deal 5d6 (half slashing, half negative energy), with enhancement bonus to attacks and damage of +1/4 levels.

sections.heading: Black Tentacles, Evard’s
sections.text: Black Tentacles, Evard’s: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grappled; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 5d6; -3 levels) = 4th level; 5d6 bludgeoning/rd. and grappled 1 rd./level or until save. Variants:

sections.heading: BlackfireCA
sections.text: BlackfireCA: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (contagious; +2 levels) = 8th level; 1d4 Con drain/rd. and sickened; adjacent creatures must also save or be affected (up to 4 more targets, or 5 more if CL 18+).

sections.heading: BlackflameRR
sections.text: BlackflameRR: Jet of flame (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (frightened to cowering; +2 levels) = 6th level (listed as 8th); damage cap 20d6 fire plus 2d6 burn (Reflex half/neg.) and cowering 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: BlacklightSRD
sections.text: BlacklightSRD: Gloom (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (spread to emanation; +0 levels) + Augment Spell (+2 steps; +1 level) = 3rd level; target object emanates darkness (reduces light by 3 steps total, possibly to supernatural darkness) that you can see through.

sections.heading: Blackmote, Nystul’sGA
sections.text: Blackmote, Nystul’sGA: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Energy Admixture (cold; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Cross-Class Spell (evocation; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 10d6 (half cold, half negative energy).

sections.heading: BlackrotCM
sections.text: BlackrotCM: Variable Spell (+1 level, +1 level worth of options; see below) = 2nd level (listed as 4th).

sections.heading: BlackstaffDr181
sections.text: BlackstaffDr181: Dispel (0 level) + Variable Spell (dispel or lose spell slot; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Vile Strike; +1 level) + Augment Spell (6d6 effects; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (lesser confusion; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (magic weapon; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 5d6 and +1/2 to +1; -4 levels) = 8th level; damage cap +13d6 negative energy, divided among attacks (each +1 Vile damage), plus up to 1 hit/3 levels per round drains 1 spell slot or dispels 1 spell effect and causes confusion 1 rd./level or until save.

sections.heading: Blacksteel7S
sections.text: Blacksteel7S: Glamer (1st level) + Augment Spell (also visual; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (manufactured weapon; -2 levels) = 1st level; weapon touched makes no sound, and effects of use (bloodstains, dulling of edge, etc.) are concealed.

sections.heading: Blackwater MindSW
sections.text: Blackwater MindSW: Spook (0 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (dazed; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (blinded; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (attempting to manifest telepathy power on you; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); the next creature attempting to telepathically contact or influence your mind is dazed 1 round and unnerved and blinded for 1 rd./level or until saves.

sections.heading: Blade Barrier
sections.text: Blade Barrier: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Energy Admixture (force; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to wall; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) = 6th level; damage cap 15d6 (half slashing, half force). Variants:

sections.heading: Blade LashACG
sections.text: Blade LashACG: Topple (0 level) + Cascade Spell (enhancement: trip attempt; +3 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (melee weapon held; -2 levels) = 1st level; you make a Close ranged trip attempt (+1 enhancement bonus), using a held melee weapon as a focus.

sections.heading: Blade of BloodPHII
sections.text: Blade of BloodPHII: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) = 1st level; damage cap +5d6 negative energy, discharged on next hit.

sections.heading: Blade of Pain and FearLM
sections.text: Blade of Pain and FearLM: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 7d6 slashing (divided among iterative melee touch attacks) and those hit are frightened (1 rd./level, divided among those affected).

sections.heading: Blade ThirstSC
sections.text: Blade ThirstSC: Enhancement (2nd level) + Item-Specific Spell (slashing weapon; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Augment Spell (base +1 to +3; +2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Extend  Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (+1/4 to +1; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); swift casting grants slashing weapon +3 enhancement bonus, and it sheds normal light.

sections.heading: BladesongWotC
sections.text: BladesongWotC: Inertia (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to ray; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (making full attack with focus weapon; -2 levels) = 3rd level (bard 2nd), while recipient makes full attacks, gains one swift touch attack/rd. that dazes 1 rd.

sections.heading: BladeweaveCAd
sections.text: BladeweaveCAd: Compel (daze: 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 level) = 2nd level; melee attack also dazes target 1 rd.

sections.heading: Blasphemy
sections.text: Blasphemy: Alter senses (deafness; 0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Blast of ColdAUG2
sections.text: Blast of ColdAUG2: Ray of frost (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) = 1st level; damage cap 5d6 (Reflex half). Variants:

sections.heading: Blast RuneCRB
sections.text: Blast RuneCRB: Acid splash (0 level) + Variable Spell (Versatile Evocation: cold, electricity, or fire; +1 level + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Delay Spell (square entered; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Rune domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 10d6.

sections.heading: Blaze BonesDr347
sections.text: Blaze BonesDr347: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+3 bonus; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (19 min./level to 1 rd./level; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell [(jet of flame (+1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels)] + Creature-Specific Spell (corporeal undead; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 1d6; -2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 2nd); for 1 rd./level, cirporeal undead subject is +3 to attacks and damage and deals +1d6 fire damage with up to 2 melee attacks/rd.

sections.heading: Blazing Beads, Blaise’sRR2
sections.text: Blazing Beads, Blaise’sRR2: Energy mace (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 1st level; damage cap 7d6 bludgeoning, divided among up to 1 ranged touch attack/level.

sections.heading: Blazing Rainbow (Bow)ACG
sections.text: Blazing Rainbow (Bow)ACG: Invisible needle (0 level) + Cascade Spell (flare; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (faerie fire; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (magic weapon; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (true strike; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Delay Spell (release arrows over multiple rounds; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Weather domain; -1 level) = 5th level; makes 5 long ranged attacks +1/level (20 max.) with +1/3 levels enhancement, and ignores concealment. Hits deal 1d6+Str modifier (plus enhancement, and target dazzled and lit by faerie fire).

sections.heading: BleaknessPHII
sections.text: BleaknessPHII: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cascade Spell (gloom; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6 and 3 steps to 1 step; -2 levels) = 4th level; creates 20’r. area of negative energy (5d6/rd.), and reduces ambient light by 1 step (min. darkness). Variants:

sections.heading: Bleed for Your MasterUW
sections.text: Bleed for Your MasterUW: Compel (intercept attack; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Quicken Spell (+4 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (your animal companion, cohort, familiar, etc.; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (spook; ­1 level) = 3rd level; your animal companion, cohort, familiar, etc., if adjacent, intercepts one attack that would otherwise hit you, is shaken 1 rd./level thereafter.

sections.heading: Bleeding TouchCRB
sections.text: Bleeding TouchCRB: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Lingering Evocation (+2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Death domain, etc.; -1 level) = 0 level; touch deals 1d6 slashing plus 1d6 bleed/rd. Variants:

sections.heading: BlendARG
sections.text: BlendARG: Glamer (1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Stealth; +1 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (elf or half-elf; -1 level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 1st level; illusion masks your color (blur effect) and enhances your Stealth (+1/2 level, +5 max.).

sections.heading: Bless Water
sections.text: Bless Water: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead or evil outsider; -1 level) + Splash Evocation (+0 levels) + Delay Spell (throw as standard action; +1 level) + Restricted Spell ([good] caster; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (5d6 to 1d6; -1 level) = 1st level; damage 1d6 vs. undead or [evil] outsider (half force, half holy), plus 1 point splash damage.

sections.heading: Bless Weapon
sections.text: Bless Weapon: Magic weapon (q.v.; 1st level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + [Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Improved Critical; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +11 effects; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (vs. evil only; -2 levels)] + Restricted Spell ([good] caster; -1 level) + Personal Spell (you must wield the weapon; -1 level) = 2nd level (paladin 1st); weapon penetrates DR/evil and auto-confirms crits vs. [evil] creatures. For the 3.5e Blackguard’s corrupt weaponSRD (AKA distort weaponBVD), modify with Corrupt Spell and Bane Spell (vs. good), respectively, instead.

sections.heading: Blessed AimCD
sections.text: Blessed AimCD: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+2 bonus; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (ranged attacks only; −2 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd.; -3 levels) + Concentration Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level; allies in 60’r. gain +2 to ranged attacks and damage while you concentrate. AKA inspired aimBED.

sections.heading: Blessed AimSC
sections.text: Blessed AimSC: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (ranged attacks only; −2 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 min./level.; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); allies within 60 ft. gain +2 to ranged atks and damage.

sections.heading: Blessed FistACG
sections.text: Blessed FistACG: Bestow feat (Exotic Weapon Proficiency: unarmed; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Blessed SightBED
sections.text: Blessed SightBED: Detection (evil; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (concentraton to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell ([good] descriptor; -1 level) = 3rd level; as detect evil, but longer range and constantly active (no need for concentration).

sections.heading: Blessed WarmthTM2
sections.text: Blessed WarmthTM2: Inure (cold; 0 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +4 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Sun domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (30 to 15; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 4th); 1 creature/level gains resistance to cold 5/2 levels (max. 15).

sections.heading: Blessing of ApolloRRO
sections.text: Blessing of ApolloRRO: Skill enhancement (Heal; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Perform; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell [(warding: darkness; +3 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (fixed at focus of initial burst; -2 levels)] + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Music or Sun domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (+10 to +5; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 2nd); allies in 60’r. +5 enhancement to Heal and Perform for 1 min./level, and wards against darkness in area.

sections.heading: Blessing of ArtemisRRO
sections.text: Blessing of ArtemisRRO: Blessing (0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Survival; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (ranged attacks only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger or worshipper of Artemis; -1 level) = 1st level; 1 ally/level gains +1 to ranged atks, damage and +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Survival for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Blessing of AthenaRRO
sections.text: Blessing of AthenaRRO: Blessing (0 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Wis; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 total; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (Wis-based skill checks; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin or access to Valor domain; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); allies in 40’r. of you +1 to atks, damage, saves vs. fear, and +2 to Wis-based skill checks.

sections.heading: Blessing of Courage and LifeAPG
sections.text: Blessing of Courage and LifeAPG: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + [Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Delay Spell (+1 level) + Tenuous Spell (using spark ends blessing; -1 level)] = 2nd level; subject +2 to attacks, damage, saves vs. [death] and [fear]; can end blessing to heal 1d6 hp/level (max. 5d6).

sections.heading: Blessing of FervorAPG
sections.text: Blessing of FervorAPG: Variable Spell (choose each round; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) = 6th level. Options:

sections.heading: Blessing of HephaestusRRO
sections.text: Blessing of HephaestusRRO: Enhancement (2nd level) + Object-Specific Spell (manufactured weapons; -2 levels) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Cascade Spell (inure: slashing; +1 level) + Energy Admixture (bludgeoning and piercing; +0 levels) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (overcome by natural weapons; -1 level) + Augment Spell (30 to 50; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1/3 to +1/2; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Artifice domain; -1 level) = 5th level; manufactured weapons gain −1/2 levels enhancement penalty to attacks and damage against subject, and subject gains DR 15/− against them, for 1 min./level. Variant:

sections.heading: Blessing of LibertyPC
sections.text: Blessing of LibertyPC: Resistance (0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +3; +2 levels) + Lucky Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (impedence of movement; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level (listed as 2nd); for 1 min./level, you gain +10 ft. to speed and +3 luck bonus to saves vs. effects that would impede your movement.

sections.heading: Blessing of Luck and ResolveARG
sections.text: Blessing of Luck and ResolveARG: Warding (fear; 1st level) + Irresistible Spell (+3 levels) + Restricted Spell (halfling caster; -1 level) = 3rd level; subject immune to fear for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Blessing of the MoleUM
sections.text: Blessing of the MoleUM: Darkvision (30 ft. instead of 60 ft.; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Stealth; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/3 levels; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level; subjects gain darkvision 30 ft. and +1/2 levels (+10 max.) enhancement bonus to Stealth checks.

sections.heading: Blessing of the RighteousPHII
sections.text: Blessing of the RighteousPHII: Jet of flame (0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (individual to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell ([good] caster; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 4th level; damage cap +9d6 (half fire, half holy). In a 20’r. emanation of you, melee attacks deal +5d6 (one attack/rd.), +4d6 (2 attacks), +3d6 (3 attacks), +2d6 (4 attacks), or +1d6 (5+ attacks).

sections.heading: Blessing of the SalamanderAPG
sections.text: Blessing of the SalamanderAPG: Spark of life (1st level) + Cascade Spell (inure: fire; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Fire domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; subject gains fire resistance 5/2 levels (max. 30) and fast healing 1/level (max. 10 hp/rd.) for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Blight
sections.text: Blight: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Augment Spell (1d6 to 15d6; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (plants only; -2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 4th/5th); 1d6/level (max. 15d6) necrotic damage to plant touched. Variants:

sections.heading: Blind MarkRR2
sections.text: Blind MarkRR2: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (individual represented by focus doll; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Fell Dazzling (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level; blind target at Long range using voodoo doll (save for dazzled). To maintain the effect, invest 200 x CL numen (2nd level x 50 x 2).

sections.heading: Blinding BeautyBED
sections.text: Blinding BeautyBED: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (blindness; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (onset: inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Pattern Spell (avert gaze to avoid being affected; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard, druid, ranger, or [fey] race, bloodline, etc.; -1 level) = 4th level; you gain a 60’r. aura that blinds onlookers 1 rd./level (Intuition neg.). Invest 200 x CL numen to make blindness permanent until eyes bathed in holy water.

sections.heading: Blinding Beauty, UnearthlyBED
sections.text: Blinding Beauty, UnearthlyBED: Blinding beautyBED (q.v.; 4th level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+4d4; +3 levels) = 8th level; you gain 60’r. aura that deals 5d4 Con damage and blinds onlookers (those not blinded avert gaze or save each round to avoid Con damage).

sections.heading: Blinding Color SurgePHII
sections.text: Blinding Color SurgePHII: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (blindness; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; ­1 level) + Cascade Spell (vanish; +1 level) = 2nd level; target blinded 1 rd.; you are invisible 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Blinding GloryBED
sections.text: Blinding GloryBED: Light (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (blinding; +4 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (only [evil] creatures blinded; -2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1 mile; +6 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 hr./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 9th level; creates large area of bright light (blinding to evil creatures or those with light sensitivity).

sections.heading: Blinding SpittlePGF
sections.text: Blinding SpittlePGF: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Shape Spell (target to ray; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 2nd level; ranged touch attack blinds target hit for 1 min./level (no save, but SR applies).

sections.heading: Blink
sections.text: Blink: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Trans-dimensional Spell (to ethereal plane; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; you randomly “blink” back and forth between planes; 50% miss chance against you (20% for your attacks) and possibly pass through objects. Variants:

sections.heading: Blissful SleepAUG2
sections.text: Blissful SleepAUG2: Bestow feat (Skill Focus: Endurance; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Endurance; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (sleeping only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); gain Endurance check at +1/2 levels to sleep soundly in full armor, amidst distractions, etc.

sections.heading: Blistering InvectiveUC
sections.text: Blistering InvectiveUC: Spook (0 level) + Cascade Spell (jet of flame; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard or access to Inquisition domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; enemies in 20’r. of you take 5d6 fire plus 2d6 burn (Reflex half/neg.) and are unnerved 1 rd./level (Will neg.).

sections.heading: BloatbombACG
sections.text: BloatbombACG: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +2 levels) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (acid splash; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Delay Spell (until corpse disturbed; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 4th level; creature touched (8 HD max.) takes 3d4 Con damage. If dies, corpse explodes for 1d6 acid/level (max. 5d6) in 10’r. if disturbed.

sections.heading: BlockadeCSc
sections.text: BlockadeCSc: Creation (wood; 1st level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 3 cu. ft./level; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 rd./level; -3 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 1st level; you create up to 3 cu. ft./level of wood as a swift action, potentially blocking a corridor, providing a raft, etc.

sections.heading: Blood ArmorACG
sections.text: Blood ArmorACG: Enhancement (2nd level) + Item-Specific Spell (armor only; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+5 total bonus; +4 levels) + Expedient Spell (special; −1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; your armor (or clothing) gains +1 enhancement to AC per 5 hp piercing or slashing damage you take (+5 max.).

sections.heading: Blood CreaturesRRO
sections.text: Blood CreaturesRRO: Summon (1st level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (Advanced template; +1 level) + Augment Spell (base CR 6; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 7th level; you summon one base CR 5-6, 1d3 CR 3-4, 1d4+1 CR 2, 2d4+1 CR 1, or 3d6 CR ½ creatures (with the Advanced simple template then added to them) to fight for you for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Blood CreepersPHII
sections.text: Blood CreepersPHII: Invisible needle (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./lvl; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; target grappled and 10d6 piercing/round until saves.

sections.heading: Blood Crow StrikeUM
sections.text: Blood Crow StrikeUM: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Energy Admixture (fire; +0 levels) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (5d6 to 10d6; +1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 13d6 (half fire, half negative energy), divided among iterative ranged attacks (max. 10d6 for one), and you add your Str modifier to damage.

sections.heading: Blood in the WaterMC
sections.text: Blood in the WaterMC: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Con; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (sahuagin; -1 level) = 2nd level; allies in 20’r. emanation gain +2 to Str and Con.

sections.heading: Blood MistUM
sections.text: Blood MistUM: Damage attribute (Wis; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (wisp; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of obliviousness; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Weather domain; -1 level) = 8th level; 60’r. fog obscures sight, deals 1d4 Wis damage plus 1d6 +1/level penalty to Wis for 1 rd./level (save half, confused at 1); fog lasts while you concentrate.

sections.heading: Blood ProtectorsRRO
sections.text: Blood ProtectorsRRO: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 6; +4 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 8th level (listed as 9th); summons one blood protector (see below) per 3 levels.

sections.heading: Blood SentinelACG
sections.text: Blood SentinelACG: Bestow feat (Arcane Bond: familiar; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +3 levels) = 4th level; you gain a Tiny animal familiar (no improvements other than Arcane Familiar feat; see Wizard).

sections.heading: Blood SnowFB
sections.text: Blood SnowFB: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to horizontal wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 20-ft. squares; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (snow field; -2 levels) = 7th level (listed as 2nd); snow field deals 1d4 Con drain/rd. and nauseates those within.

sections.heading: Blood SpikesAUG2
sections.text: Blood SpikesAUG2: Invisible needle (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (applies only to unarmed/natural attacks; -2 levels) = 1st level; damage cap +6d6 piercing, divided among natural or unarmed attacks.

sections.heading: Blood Tentacles, Stellen’sRR2
sections.text: Blood Tentacles, Stellen’sRR2: Bind (0 level) + Cascade Spell (energy mace; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Throat Punch; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (originating from corpses within close range of you during casting; -2 levels) + Variable Spells (tentacles attack random targets within reach; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 5th level; 5 + 1/level (max. +10) Close ranged touch attacks/rd. against random targets within reach deal 1d6 bludgeoning plus grappled (can’t speak and must hold breath). Once a tentacle hits, it maintains the grapple on that target until the victim escapes or dies, or the duration ends.

sections.heading: Blood TiesHA
sections.text: Blood TiesHA: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (bound or helpless; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to inetrplanar; +6 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (blood relative; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Reduce Spell (+25 to +0; -5 levels) = 5th level; whenever hostage damaged, target (a blood relative of hostage) also takes 1d6 damage (regardless of distance).

sections.heading: Blood WindSC
sections.text: Blood WindSC: Metaphysical feat (Reach Spell; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (natural/unarmed attacks only; -2 levels) = 2nd level; swift casting allows subject to use its natural weapons and unarmed attacks as Close ranged attacks for 1 rd. Variants:

sections.heading: BloodbriarsLEF
sections.text: BloodbriarsLEF: Invisible needle (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Delay Spell (when moves; +1 level) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 4th level; for 1 min./level, target takes 5d6 piercing (Reflex half) each round it attempts to move or make gestures (including somatic spell components), and this damage can disrupt casting.

sections.heading: BloodhoundCAd
sections.text: BloodhoundCAd: Hand of fate (0 level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (Survival checks; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger; ­2 levels) = 1st level; you can choose to reroll Survival checks made during the next 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Bloodied BladeRR2
sections.text: Bloodied BladeRR2: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +5; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd./level; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell [(spook; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (onset: inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (fear: 1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level)] + Delay Spell (after next hit; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (panicked to shaken; -2 levels) = 4th level; after next hit, weapon gains +5 morale bonus to attacks and damage for 1 rd./level, and those hit are shaken for 1 rd.

sections.heading: BloodlettingCM
sections.text: BloodlettingCM: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 1st level; your next melee attack deals +1d6 slashing/level (max. +5d6) plus 2d6 bleed. Variants:

sections.heading: BloodstarLM
sections.text: BloodstarLM: Light (0 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (damaged while in area; -2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 4th level; those in 20’r. light who are damaged that round also take 1d4 Con damage (Fort half).

sections.heading: Blunt EdgeRRE
sections.text: Blunt EdgeRRE: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Energy Admixture (piercing; +0 levels) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 3rd level; edged weapon deals -3d6 damage per attack (4 attacks/rd. max.).

sections.heading: Blurred MovementACG
sections.text: Blurred MovementACG: Blur (2nd level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (retain visual element; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (while moving only; -2 levels) = 0 level.

sections.heading: Bodak’s GlarePnH
sections.text: Bodak’s GlarePnH: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Augment Spell (+5d4; +4 levels) + Cascade Spell [(lesser animate dead; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (CR 5 bodak; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (slain by Con damage; -2 levels)] + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 8th level; 6d4 Con damage (Fort neg.), plus animates corpse as a bodak if kills victim. Variants:

sections.heading: Body AdjustmentSRD
sections.text: Body AdjustmentSRD: Spark of life (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (psionic; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level; you heal self 1d6 hp/level (max. 5d6). Variants:

sections.heading: Body ClockTM2
sections.text: Body ClockTM2: Bestow feat (Skill Focus: Endurance; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Endurance; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (restless slumber function only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (creation: breathable air; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (know time; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (monk or access to Time domain; -1 level) = 4th level; subject always knows time (can set mental alarms), can slow breath to imperceptible, needs 1 less hour of sleep per 4 ranks in Concentration you have (to heal and regain spells).

sections.heading: Body of IceAPG
sections.text: Body of IceAPG: Elemental body I (4th level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Restricted Spell ([cold] bloodline, domain, etc.; -1 level) = 2nd level; you become an ice elemental. Variants:

sections.heading: Body of SandRR2
sections.text: Body of SandRR2: Skill enhancement (Stealth; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (inure: slashing; +1 level) + Energy Admixture (piercing; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; you gain DR 2/bludgeoning or adamantine (5/bludgeoning or adamantine at CL 4th+), and +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Stealth, for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Body of the SunCD
sections.text: Body of the SunCD: Jet of flame (0 level) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Shape Spell (emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; 5’r. aura of fire deals 1d6/level (max. 5d6) and illuminates area as a torch. Variants:

sections.heading: Body PurificationSRD
sections.text: Body PurificationSRD: Remove condition (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (psionic; +1 level) + Personal Spell (­1 level) = 1st level (listed as 3rd); you heal 1d4 points of damage to one attribute score.

sections.heading: Body WardCC
sections.text: Body WardCC: Warding (damage attribute; 1st level) + Variable Spell (choose attribute at time of casting; +1 level) = 2nd level; subject immune to magical damage/drain to 1 attribute for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: BoilAUG
sections.text: BoilAUG: Jet of flame (0 level) + Casacade Spell (wisp; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (in body of water; ­2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; 10’r. area of water boils, up to 5d6 fire/rd. and bubbles obscure vision.

sections.heading: Boiling BloodCM
sections.text: Boiling BloodCM: Jet of flame (0 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6 fire plus 2d6/rd. and sickened 1 rd./level (Fort half/neg.).

sections.heading: Boiling BloodUM
sections.text: Boiling BloodUM: Variable Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/3 levels; +1 level):

sections.heading: Bolt of GlorySC
sections.text: Bolt of GlorySC: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Bane Spell (lower planar; +1 level) + Positive Spell (+0 levels) + Empower Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (10d6 to 20d6; +2 levels) = 6th level; ray deals damage (half force, half holy) as follows:

sections.heading: Bolts of BedevilmentCD
sections.text: Bolts of BedevilmentCD: Inertia (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (dazing; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Madness domain; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 5th); one ray/rd. dazes target for 1 rd./level (save each round to end effect).

sections.heading: Bomb Admixture, TargetedUC
sections.text: Bomb Admixture, TargetedUC: Energy mace (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Channel Spell (delivered by missile; +1 level) + Delay Spell (use missiles over multiple rounds; +1 level) = 3rd level; 3 missiles +1/level (max. 13) deal +1d6 bludgeoning against targets at up to Long range.

sections.heading: Bomb Admixture, ShadowUC
sections.text: Bomb Admixture, ShadowUC: Wisp (0 level) + Channel Spell (through missile; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (use missiles over multiple rounds; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 3rd level; up to 1 missile/3 levels releases 20’r. fog lasting 1 round/level.

sections.heading: Bomb Admixture, ViperUC
sections.text: Bomb Admixture, ViperUC: Summon (viper; 1st level) + Augment Spell (1d3; +1 level) + Channel Spell (delivered by missile; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (use missiles over multiple rounds; +1 level) = 6th level; 1 missile/3 levels summon 1d3 vipers each on impact.

sections.heading: BombardmentPGF
sections.text: BombardmentPGF: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (pin; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Throat Punch; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to [earth] Domain, etc.; -1 level) = 8th level; damage cap 20d6 in 20’r. and buried (pinned, can’t speak or breathe, and immediately begins to suffocate) for 10 min./level or until save. Cf. smotherRR. Variants:

sections.heading: Bone ClubCWH
sections.text: Bone ClubCWH: Energy mace (0 level) + Postive Spell (+0 levels) + Cascade Spell (magic weapon; +2 levels) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 3rd level; damage cap 13d6 bludgeoning (divided among attacks; 1.5x vs. undead, half vs. others), with +1 enhancement/4 levels to attacks and damage.

sections.heading: Bones of AdamantineRR2
sections.text: Bones of AdamantineRR2: Transmute (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (rare metal; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (corporeal undead; -2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 6th); up to 1 corporeal undead/level (2d4 +1 HD/level, +10 max. total) gains DR 20/adamantine.

sections.heading: Bones of the EarthPHII
sections.text: Bones of the EarthPHII: Shaping (2nd level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (energy mace; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 27 cu. ft./level; +2 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (stone only; −2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Earth domain; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 6th); damage cap 10d6. Each round, one stone pillar (5 ft. dia., 1.38 ft./level tall) erupts from the ground, damages those in area, possibly carries upward. Variants:

sections.heading: BoneshakerHA
sections.text: BoneshakerHA: Variable Spell (+1 level) +2 levels worth of options = 3rd level (listed as 2nd).

sections.heading: BoneshatterPC
sections.text: BoneshatterPC: Energy mace (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (touch of fatigue; +1 level) + Augment Spell (exhaust; +1 level) + Fell Fatigue (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 bludgeoning (arcane 15d6) plus exhausted 1 min./level (Fort for half damage and fatigued).

sections.heading: Borrow FortuneAPG
sections.text: Borrow FortuneAPG: Hand of fate (0 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (oracle, seer, etc.; -1 level) = 3rd level; as an immediate action, roll twice for any one roll you make that round and keep the better result. AKA luck of battleCC.

sections.heading: Bottle of SmokeCD
sections.text: Bottle of SmokeCD: Summon (light horse; 1st level) + Augment Spell (add phantom steed template; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (riding only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Delay Spell (pull cork as standard action; +1 level) + Delay Spell (use duration in increments; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Travel domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; phantom steed moves at 80 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels.

sections.heading: Bountiful BanquetUI
sections.text: Bountiful BanquetUI: Create food and water (1st level) Augment Spell (wine, etc.; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (glamer; +1 level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 4th level; as create food and drink, but may include wine, caviar, or other rare foods/drinks, and with fine-tuned taste, visual, olfactory, tactile, thermal adjustments to food, drink, utensils, etc.

sections.heading: Bountiful HarvestRRO
sections.text: Bountiful HarvestRRO: Enlarge (3rd level) + Shape Spell (ray to cubes; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (one 10-ft. cube/level to 432 5-ft. cubes/level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (plants; -2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (crop yield; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); doubles harvest over 1 acre/level area. Variants:

sections.heading: Bounty of StraashaDLM
sections.text: Bounty of StraashaDLM: Creation (water; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 216 cu. ft./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to [water] bloodline, domain, etc.; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); creates enough water to fill, for example, one 10-ft. cube per 5 levels. Gift of GromeDLM is the same, but is an [earth] spell and produces soil/dust/sand instead of water.

sections.heading: Bow SpiritAPG
sections.text: Bow SpiritAPG: Invisible needle (0 level) + Cascade Spell [(bestow feat: Versatile Strike; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level)] + Reach Spell (close to extreme; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Archery domain; ­1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 2nd level (Archery 3rd; listed as 4th); swift ranged attacks deal base 5d6 piercing each, and carry the focus weapon’s properties and any feats you have that apply to it.

sections.heading: BowstaffUC
sections.text: BowstaffUC: Transmute (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 rd./level; -3 levels) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (bow to club or staff only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (paladin, ranger, or access to Archery or Inquisition domain; -1 level) = 1st level; effectively changes short bow to club or longbow to quarterstaff as a swift action.

sections.heading: Brain LockSRD
sections.text: Brain LockSRD: Compel (daze; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoid only; -2 levels) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Bramble ArmorCRB
sections.text: Bramble ArmorCRB: Invisible needle (0 level) + Shielding Spell (+2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; immediate casting deals 1d6 +1/level (+10 max.) piercing to those hitting you for 1 rd.

sections.heading: BrandAPG
sections.text: BrandAPG: Arcane mark (0 level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Inquisition or Rune domain; -1 level) = 0 level.

sections.heading: Brand, GreaterAPG
sections.text: Brand, GreaterAPG: Brand (q.v., 0 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Delay Spell (within range of visible symbol of your faith; +1 level) + Tenacious Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); as brandAPG, but sickens as indicated (1 rd./level, once per day) and cannot be easily removed (only suppressed).

sections.heading: Branding, Chardun’sRR2
sections.text: Branding, Chardun’sRR2: Damage attribute (Cha; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+4d4; +4 levels) + Crippling Drain (+4 levels) + Selective Spell (specify master; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 9th level; subject takes 5d4 Cha drain (Will half, dominated at 0) with respect to master’s commands.

sections.heading: Branding SmitePH5
sections.text: Branding SmitePH5: Jet of flame (0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (targeted faerie fire; +1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap +5d6 (half fire, half holy) plus faerie fire.

sections.heading: Brawl, Tenser’sGA
sections.text: Brawl, Tenser’sGA: Magic fang (unarmed; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Improved Grapple; +1 level) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Breaching the GulfAPG
sections.text: Breaching the GulfAPG: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (target: touch to close; +1 level) + Reach Spell (destination: close to planar; +5 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Void domain, etc.; -1 level) = 5th level; teleports victim into space (6d6 cold/rd. plus suffocation, save each round to return). Variant:

sections.heading: BreakAPG
sections.text: BreakAPG: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Overwhelming Evocation (+2 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (cannot target creatures; -2 levels) = 1st level; damage cap 5d6 entropic to an object (ignores hardness). Variants:

sections.heading: Breath of Bewilderment7S
sections.text: Breath of Bewilderment7S: Wisp (0 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stunning; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (target to cone; +1 level) = 5th level (listed as 2nd); vapor stuns those in 30-ft. cone for 1 rd.

sections.heading: Breath of DeathRR2
sections.text: Breath of DeathRR2: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Attribute Admixture (Str; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (summon; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (CR 2; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (1/rd. to 1/hr.; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Death or Pestilence domain; -1 level) = 5th level; those in 30-ft. cone save or take 1d2 Str and Con/hr. (Fort half) and attacked by 1 CR 2, 1d3 CR 1 or 1d4+1 CR ½ predators/hr.

sections.heading: Breath of FliesBotD
sections.text: Breath of FliesBotD: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (invocation of the knife; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Breath of LifeCRB
sections.text: Breath of LifeCRB: Remove condition (death; 1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (also remove negative level; +2 levels) + Crippling Drain (+3 levels) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (killed in last 1 rd./level; -2 levels) = 5th level; heals up to 15d6 hp. If this would restore person killed (but not destroyed—see Chapter 7) by hp damage within the last 1 rd./level to enough hp to survive, that person is resuscitated with no negative levels. RevivifySRD is the same, except with the Cross-Class Spell feat added (also 5th level, due to metamagic synergy).

sections.heading: Breath of LifeTM2
sections.text: Breath of LifeTM2: Remove condition (affliction; 1st level) + Augment Spell (moderate condition; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to ‘r.; +6 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Healing domain; -1 level) = 7th level; cures all within 1 mile of one disease (chosen at time of casting).

sections.heading: Breath of Life, Drawmij’sGA
sections.text: Breath of Life, Drawmij’sGA: Water breathing (3rd level) + Delay Spell (until caster starts making checks to hold breath; +1 level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 2nd level; lasts 1 creature up to 100 min./level, or 1/level up to 100 min. (reduce accordingly for larger or smaller creatures, strenuous activity, etc.).

sections.heading: Breath of the Black DragonSRD
sections.text: Breath of the Black DragonSRD: Acid splash (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (30 ft. to 60 ft.; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 6th); damage cap 10d6 acid. Variants:

sections.heading: Brilliant AuraCD
sections.text: Brilliant AuraCD: Brilliant blade (see below; 6th level) + Communal Spell (+1 level) = 7th level.

sections.heading: Brilliant BladeCA
sections.text: Brilliant BladeCA: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) = 6th level; damage cap 26d6 force, divided among iterative touch attacks.

sections.heading: Brilliant InspirationAPG
sections.text: Brilliant InspirationAPG: Hand of fate (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (natural 20 ends effect; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard or access to Fate domain; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 6th); for 1 rd./level, subject rolls everything twice, takes the better result; effect ends when a natural 20 is rolled.

sections.heading: BristleAPG
sections.text: BristleAPG: Magic fang (1st level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+1/4 to +1/2 levels; +1 level) + Cascade Spell [(non-extended barkskin; -1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels)] Restricted Spell (access to Animal domain; -1 level) = 1st level; subject gains total enhancement bonus of 1 + ½ levels to attacks and damage, divisible among natural attacks, but takes -1/3 levels penalty to natural armor.

sections.heading: BrittleskinShS
sections.text: BrittleskinShS: Invisible needle (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (+10 to +5; -1 level) = 3rd level; for the next 1 rd./level, subject takes +1d6+5 piercing damage each time it is hit in combat (Fort neg.).

sections.heading: Brother’s RevengeAUG2
sections.text: Brother’s RevengeAUG2: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (harmed your family; -2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 4th); victim (who must have previously harmed an immediate family member of yours) is sickened and takes 1d4 Con/day while spell is maintained (invest 200 x CL numen).

sections.heading: Bubbling MurkRRE
sections.text: Bubbling MurkRRE: Acid splash (0 level) + Cascade Spell (wisp; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 20-ft. cubes; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (within a body of water; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (-1 level) = 6th level; water obscures vision and deals 10d6 acid and 1d4 Con/rd. (Fort half). You can direct as a standard action as long as you concentrate; it lasts 1 rd./level thereafter.

sections.heading: Build TrustUI
sections.text: Build TrustUI: Attribute boost (Cha; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (hand of fate; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+2 to +4; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (when interacting with one designated creature only; -2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (reroll Cha-based checks only; -2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (save again each time reroll; -1 level) = 2nd level; you gain +4 Cha vs. subject, and can reroll failed Cha-based checks made against it as an immediate action.

sections.heading: Bullet ShieldUC
sections.text: Bullet ShieldUC: Deflection (0 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (+4 base; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1/5 levels; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (applies only against projectiles; -2 levels) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Bull’s GraceRR2
sections.text: Bull’s GraceRR2: Ray of clumsiness (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (+10 to +5; -1 level) = 2nd level; penalty to Dex of 1d6 + ½ levels (+5 max., Fort half) for 1 min./level. AKA disrupt reflexesAUG2. Variants:

sections.heading: Bull’s Strength
sections.text: Bull’s Strength: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+2 to +4; +1 level) = 2nd level; subject gains +4 enhancement to Strength for 1 min./level. Variants:

sections.heading: Bully’s CurseAUG2
sections.text: Bully’s CurseAUG2: Compel (make no AoOs; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3 total bonus; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (applies only vs. foes with lower attack bonus; -2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 4th); victim is -3 to attacks and damage, -2 to AC, and cannot make attacks of opportunity when fighting opponents with a lower attack bonus than his own. Invest 500 x CL numen to maintain effect longer than 1 min./level.

sections.heading: BungleUM
sections.text: BungleUM: Enhancement (2nd level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (next effort; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoid; -2 levels) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +1/2; +3 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); one humanoid with 6 HD or less takes a -1/2 levels penalty to attacks, saves, or checks for 1 rd., starting when next attempts one.

sections.heading: Buoyancy NetRR
sections.text: Buoyancy NetRR: Mage hand (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 216 lbs./level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (conc. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (in liquid; -2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (float to surface only; -2 levels) = 1st level; causes up to 216 lbs./level of creatures and/or objects to ascend to the surface. Variants:
