sections.heading: Burden of FaithRR2
sections.text: Burden of FaithRR2: Ray of enfeeblement (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (carrying capacity only; -2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+15 to +20; +1 level) = 5th level; divine casters (clerics, archivists, incarnates, paladins) in area take penalty to Str (for encumbrance purposes only) of 1d6 + 1/level (Fort half).

sections.heading: Burning BloodCA
sections.text: Burning BloodCA: Jet of flame (0 level) + Energy Admixture (acid; +0 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (staggering; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 (half fire, half acid) plus 2d6/round and staggered 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Burning BrandToB
sections.text: Burning BrandToB: Metaphysical feat (Versatile Evocation: fire; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Lunge; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (melee weapon; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 1st level (listed as 2nd); swift casting causes your melee weapon to deal fire damage instead of damage of its normal type for 1 rd., and you can extend its reach by 5 ft.

sections.heading: Burning Hands
sections.text: Burning Hands: Jet of flame (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) + Widen Spell (30 ft. to 15 ft.; -1 level) = 1st level; damage cap 5d6 fire (Reflex half) in a 15-ft. cone. Variants:

sections.heading: Burning HateDr347
sections.text: Burning HateDr347: Jet of flame (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell [(blessing; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd./level; -2 levels)] = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6 fire (arcane 10d6; Reflex half), and you and allies (up to 1 per level) gain +1 to attacks and damage against victim for the next 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Burning SightRR2
sections.text: Burning SightRR2: Darkvision (q.v.; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (touch to planar; +6 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (individual represented by focus doll; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 2nd); grant subject darkvision from anywhere on the same plane.

sections.heading: Burst of AdrenalineOcA
sections.text: Burst of AdrenalineOcA: Attribute boost (0 level) + Variable Spell (Str, Dex, or Con; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+8 total bonus; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (touch of fatigue; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 2nd level; you gain swift +8 enhancement to one physical attribute and are then fatigued 1 round.

sections.heading: Burst of InsightOcA
sections.text: Burst of InsightOcA: Attribute boost (0 level) + Variable Spell (Int, Wis, or Cha; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+8 total bonus; +4 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (attribute or skill check only; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; -1 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; -1 level) = 1st level; you gain immediate +8 enhancement to one mental attribute (for purposes of a skill check or attribute check only) and are then staggered 1 rd.

sections.heading: Buzzing Bee, Mordenkainen’sMH
sections.text: Buzzing Bee, Mordenkainen’sMH: Skill enhancement (Concentration; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Stealth; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); subject is -1/2 levels (-5 max.) to Concentration and Stealth for 1 min./level. Note that in order to force concentration checks simply to cast, and deny a saving throw or SR (as listed), the spell level would be 9th, rather than 1st.

sections.text: Bypass WardAUG: Warding (magical traps; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Rune domain or rogue skill trick; -1 level) = 2nd level; magical traps (latent spells that trigger when area entered or item disturbed) are suppressed in 20’r. for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Call Dretch HordeBVD
sections.text: Call Dretch HordeBVD: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 2 dretch; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (2d4+1 summoned; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level. The numen cost to maintain the effect (5,000 x CL) can be paid by the caster but is more often paid in the form of souls for the dretches to haul back to the Abyss.

sections.heading: Call Forth the BeastHH
sections.text: Call Forth the BeastHH: Compel (kill everyone you meet; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (memory lapseAPG; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Delay Spell (when next fall asleep, and after compulsion ends; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoid; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 5th level; when next falls asleep, target immediately wakes up, goes on a murder spree for 1 hr./level, then forgets what happened. Caster takes 1d4 Con damage.

sections.heading: Call Guardian, LesserAUG
sections.text: Call Guardian, LesserAUG: Summon (1st level) + Variable Spell (choose at time of casting; +1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 4; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 6th level; as summon monster IV (gargoyle, griffon, harpy, minotaur), but ritual casting for much longer service.

sections.heading: Call Guardian, GreaterAUG
sections.text: Call Guardian, GreaterAUG: Call lesser guardian (q.v.; 6th level) + Augment Spell (CR 7; +2 levels) = 8th level (listed as 9th); dire bear, gorgon, medusa, etc.

sections.heading: Call KolyarutPnH
sections.text: Call KolyarutPnH: Summon (1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 8 kolyarut; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Tenacious Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (lawful caster; -1 level) = 7th level; summons one kolyarut inevitable for 1 hr./level. At the end of that time, you can invest 350 x CL numen to keep the kolyarut to complete a specific task taking up to 1 day/level. Call marutPnH is Augmented 2 more steps, for CR 12 (9th level).

sections.heading: Call Lightning
sections.text: Call Lightning: Electric arc (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cylinder; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10’r. to 5’r.; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Delay Spell (standard action to resume concentration; +1 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Weather domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6 (Reflex half) in a 5’r. to a height of 25 ft. You can redirect each round as a standard action. Variants:

sections.heading: Call NightmareBVD
sections.text: Call NightmareBVD: Summon (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 8 nightmare; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 levels) + Ritual Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to the Soulcrafting feat; -1 level) = 5th level; invest 10,000 x CL numen to maintain effect (for obvious reasons, this is often paid for in the form of souls).

sections.heading: Call of the EmeraldAUG2
sections.text: Call of the EmeraldAUG2: Compel (steal onject; 2nd level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to planar; +5 levels) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level; named creature of ≤10 HD must steal the nearest object worth >500 gp it is aware of and doesn’t already own. Invest 1,800 x CL numen to maintain effect past 1 rd.

sections.heading: Call to MindSRD
sections.text: Call to MindSRD: Hand of fate (0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Knowledge; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) = 1st level; re-roll failed knowledge check with +1/2 levels (+5 max.) bonus.

sections.heading: Call MountBED
sections.text: Call MountBED: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to interplanar; +7 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (your bonded mount; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 2nd); calls your mount to you, even from across planes.

sections.heading: Call upon FaithTM2
sections.text: Call upon FaithTM2: Variable Spell (see below; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 1st level; swift action provides one of the following before your next turn:

sections.heading: Call Upon the PowerAU
sections.text: Call Upon the PowerAU: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Con; +1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 1st level; swift casting grants +2 sacred bonus to Str and Con for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Call WeaponrySRD
sections.text: Call WeaponrySRD: Creation (1st level) + Variable Spell (material and weapon; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (shaping; +2 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (mundane weapon only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Craft; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (magic weapon; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 1st level. Conjures a single mundane weapon lasting 1 min./level before disappearing; it gains a +1 enhancement bonus (and overcomes DR/magic). The spell grants you a Craft check of +1/2 levels (max. +5) even if you have no ranks; if this check is failed, the conjured weapon is broken or unusable. Variants:

sections.heading: Call Woodland BeingsPH1
sections.text: Call Woodland BeingsPH1: Summon (1st level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+5 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Resistible Spell (summoned beings can save vs. being called; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (druid; -1 level) = 5th level; summons one treant, 1d3 uncorns or satyrs, 1d4+1 centaurs or dryads, 2d4+1 brownies, or 4d8 sprites.

sections.heading: CallbackUW
sections.text: CallbackUW: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to long; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (your familiar, etc.; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (when has taken amount of damage specified at time of casting; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (arrives in your space; -2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 2nd); your animal companion, familiar, etc., if within Long range, is instantly transported adjacent to you when the amount of damage it has taken reaches the threshold you set.

sections.heading: Callback, GreaterUW
sections.text: Callback, GreaterUW: Callback (q.v.; 1st level) + Reach Spell (long to continental; +3 levels) = 4th level (listed as 5th). Cf. familiar refugeCM.

sections.heading: Calm Animals
sections.text: Calm Animals: Compel (fascinate; 2nd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (animals only; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (affected animals must be of the same type; -2 levels) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Animal domain; ­1 level) + Augment Spell (+0 to +10; +2 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 1st level; up to 2d4 +1/level (+10 max.) HD of animals of the same type are fascinated 1 min./level; effect broken if they are threatened.

sections.heading: Calm ChaosTM2
sections.text: Calm ChaosTM2: Compel (cease violent or emotional actions; 2nd level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Law domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; up to 1 creature/level within Close range who see you refrains from violence, merrymaking, passion, etc. while you concentrate.

sections.heading: Calm Emotions
sections.text: Calm Emotions: Warding (emotion and morale effects; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; −2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (nonmagic emotions also suppressed; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd). Variants:

sections.heading: Calm SpiritsOcA
sections.text: Calm SpiritsOcA: Compel (don’t attack or act destructively; 2nd level) + Threnodic Spell (+0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 2nd).

sections.heading: Calming TouchCRB
sections.text: Calming TouchCRB: Remove condition (fatigued; 1st level) + Variable Spell (sickened, shaken, etc. instead; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Community domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (5d6 to 1d6; -1 level) = 1st level; touch cures 1d6 hp and removes a minor condition.

sections.heading: CaltropsTM2
sections.text: CaltropsTM2: Invisible needle (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to horizontal wall; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to War domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 1d6; -2 levels) = 3rd level; 1d6 piercing/rd. in area plus gain entangled condition for the remaining duration (Reflex half/neg.).

sections.heading: CamouflageCD
sections.text: CamouflageCD: Skill enhancement (Stealth; 0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; you gain +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Stealth. Variants:

sections.heading: Canny EffortAUG
sections.text: Canny EffortAUG: Skill enhancement (0 level) + Variable Spell (next skill used; +1 level) + Delay Spell (until check made; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 0 level; +1 enhancement bonus to next skill you use, for 1 rd./level once activated.

sections.heading: Capable Caravel, Mordenkainen’sSW
sections.text: Capable Caravel, Mordenkainen’sSW: Creation (wood; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Craft; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (shaping; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 216 cu. ft./level; +3 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (ship; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (moving parts; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (dimensional pocket; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (summon; +1 level) + Augment Spell (CR ½ to 1/3; -1 level) + Augment Spell (1d4+1; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranks in Profession (Sailing) equal to max. caster level; -1 level) = 8th level; creates sailing ship with +1/2 levels to Craft check, plus crew (1st level Experts) with 1 rank Profession (sailor) and Skill Focus; ship includes extradimensional hold and staterooms (up to one 10-ft. cube/level = 10 register tons/level). Invest 400 x CL numen to extend past 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Card ControlBRL
sections.text: Card ControlBRL: Glamer (1st level) + Disguise Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (gambling item; -2 levels) = 1st level; disguised casting causes one card draw, coin toss, die roll, tile selection, or result of some other gambling piece to appear to come up as you specify.

sections.heading: Caress, Lastai’sBED
sections.text: Caress, Lastai’sBED: Spook (0 level) + Augment Spell (cowering; +3 levels) + Variable Spell (no control over severity; -1 level) = 2nd level; target is affected by fear according to 1d4 (1 = shaken; 2 = unnerved; 3 = panicked; 4 = cowering) for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Carrion StenchBVD
sections.text: Carrion StenchBVD: Sickening touch (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (onset: inst. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Death domain or cultist of Kabriri, Orcus, or Yeenoghu; -1 level) = 2nd level; swift casting provides 10’r. stench (Fort or sickened 1 rd./level) for 1 rd. AKA gore stenchMM5.

sections.heading: CastigateAPG
sections.text: CastigateAPG: Spook (0 levels) + Fell Frightening (+1 level) + Augment Spell (shaken to cowering; +3 levels) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; target cowering (Will shaken) 1 rd./level or until save.

sections.heading: Castigate, MassAPG
sections.text: Castigate, MassAPG: Spook (0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Fell Frightening (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (+3 levels) + Augment Spell (panicked to cowering; +1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 4th level spell; 1 target/level cowering (Will shaken) 1 rd./level or until saves.

sections.heading: CatapsiSRD
sections.text: CatapsiSRD: Warding (psionics; 1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (all disciplnes; +4 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Resistible Spell (-1 level) = 5th level; those in 20’r. of you cannot manifest psionic powers unless they save vs. Intuition.

sections.heading: CatapultCSc
sections.text: CatapultCSc: Energy mace (0 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) = 1st level (listed as 2nd); thrown weapon flies from your hand at speed, dealing +1d6 bludgeoniong/ level (max. +5d6) on a hit (normal ranged attack).

sections.heading: CaterwaulCM
sections.text: CaterwaulCM: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Fell Sickening (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 3rd level; 30-ft. cone nauseates 1 round (Fort sickened).

sections.heading: CatsfeetCM
sections.text: CatsfeetCM: Skill enhancement (0 level) + Cascade Spell (hand of fate; +1 level) + Variable Spell (choose skill; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 1st level; as a swift action, reroll any one Acrobatics, Athletics, or Stealth check you make with a +1/2 levels (+5 max.) bonus.

sections.heading: Caustic DisdainDr347
sections.text: Caustic DisdainDr347: Acid splash (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell ([dispel; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst, to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Selective Spell (beneficial only; +1 level)] + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 acid (arcane 15d6; Reflex half) and beneficial spells cast on target are pre-emptively dispelled for the next 1 rd./level or until that caster succeeds on a Will save.

sections.heading: Celerity, Mordenkainen’sTM2
sections.text: Celerity, Mordenkainen’sTM2: Bestow feat (Extend Spell; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Sudden Metamagic; +2 levels) + Mass Effect (also Sudden Cascade Spell: celerity; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (movement spells; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; for the next 1 min./level, spells you cast that grant or alter movement also provide celerity (+40 ft.) and/or are Extended 1 step in duration, subject to Sudden Metamagic limits.

sections.heading: Celestial BloodBED
sections.text: Celestial BloodBED: Resistance (0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +5; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (Fort saves only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (inure: slashing; +1 level) + Energy Admixture (bludgeoning and piercing; +0 levels) + Tenuous Spell (overcome by evil; -1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (sonic; +1 level) + Energy Admixure (cold and electricity; +0 levels) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell ([good] descriptor; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 6th); subject gains +5 sacred bonus to Fort saves, DR 10/adamantine, and resistance 10 to acid, cold, and electricity for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Celestial BrillianceBED
sections.text: Celestial BrillianceBED: Light (0 level) + Positive Spell (+0 levels) + Augment Spell (bright light; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 hr./level; +1 level) = 5th level (listed as 4th); large, long-lasting area of bright light affects susceptible undead.

sections.heading: Censure ElementalsME
sections.text: Censure ElementalsME: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (elementals only; -2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 force/rd. in 20’r. against elementals you specifiy while you concentrate.

sections.heading: Censure of MesosRR2
sections.text: Censure of MesosRR2: Antimagic field (q.v.; 6th level) + Shape Spell (10’r. emanation to target; -1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd./level; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = 4th level (listed as 9th); target cannot use magical abilities for 1 rd./level (Fort save neg. and initial SR applies).

sections.heading: Chain Lightning
sections.text: Chain Lightning: Electric arc (0 level) + Conductive Evocation (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 target/level; +3 levels) = 5th level (listed as 6th); damage cap 15d6, save for half (at -4 if metal-armored and/or holding metal weapons).

sections.heading: Chain of PerditionUC
sections.text: Chain of PerditionUC: Bind (0 level) + Variable Spell (Cascade Spell: push or topple; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) = 4th level; chain binds and either jerks away or pulls prone while you concentrate.

sections.heading: Chain of SorrowHH
sections.text: Chain of SorrowHH: Damage attribute (Cha; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Crippling Drain (+2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Delay Spell (when current target touches friend or ally; +1 level) + Cascade Spell [(damage attribute: Cha; -1 level) + Augment Spell (+1d4; -1 level)] = 7th level; target takes 3d4 Cha drain (Will half), as does next friend or ally touched by target, and so on until 1 creature/level affected. Caster takes 2d4 Cha damage.

sections.heading: Chains of BindingRR2
sections.text: Chains of BindingRR2: Invisible needle (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 3rd level; small area deals 5d6 piercing/rd. (divine 1d6/rd.) and grapples 1 rd./level (Reflex half/neg.).

sections.heading: Chains of Null MagicAUG2
sections.text: Chains of Null MagicAUG2: Warding (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (all schools of magic; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) = 8th level; subject is grappled, treated as being in antimagic field (not affecting this spell itself) for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Chains of VengeanceAUG
sections.text: Chains of VengeanceAUG: Bind (0 level) + Cascade Spell (jet of flame; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Augment Spell (pin; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 4th level; target takes 1d6 fire/level (max. 10d6, Reflex half) and is pinned 1 rd./level, taking 2d6/rd. ongoing fire damage.

sections.heading: Challenge EvilAPG
sections.text: Challenge EvilAPG: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (sickened only if doesn’t attack you; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3 bonus; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 1st level; you gain +3 sacred bonus to attacks and damage against target, who is sickened if doesn’t attack you (spell ends if you withdraw).

sections.heading: ChamberMP
sections.text: ChamberMP: Warding (dimensional travel; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (wall of force, q.v.; +5 levels) + Transdimensional Spell (-1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); traps ethereal target in spherical wall of force for 1 rd./level or until saves.

sections.heading: Chameleon StrideAPG
sections.text: Chameleon StrideAPG: Blur (q.v.; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Stealth; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; you gain +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Stealth and 20% miss chance for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Chameleon Stride, GreaterAPG
sections.text: Chameleon Stride, GreaterAPG: Chameleon strideAPG (q.v.; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Skalykid domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; as above, but affects you and allies within 10 ft.

sections.heading: Champion’s StrengthTM2
sections.text: Champion’s StrengthTM2: Blessing (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+8 total bonus; +6 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./leel to 1 rd.; -3 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 5th level; subject gains +8 sacred bonus to attacks, damage, and saves vs. fear while you concentrate.

sections.heading: Change WeaponAUG2
sections.text: Change WeaponAUG2: Shaping (2nd level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (enlarge or reduce object; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (weapon only; -2 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); reshapes weapon into a different weapon with same properties for 1 min./level (Craft check needed).

sections.heading: Changestaff
sections.text: Changestaff: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 8 treant; +5 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./lvl to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 7th level.

sections.heading: Channel Negative Energy
sections.text: Channel Negative Energy: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6. Variants:

sections.heading: Channeled Divine HealthPHII
sections.text: Channeled Divine HealthPHII: Spark of life (1st level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Channeled LifetheftCM
sections.text: Channeled LifetheftCM: Touch of fatigue (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Cross-Class Spell (arcane; +1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Channeled PyroburstPHII
sections.text: Channeled PyroburstPHII: Jet of flame (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Channeled Sound BlastCM
sections.text: Channeled Sound BlastCM: Sound lance (1st level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +2 levels) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Chant of PainSS
sections.text: Chant of PainSS: Whelm (0 level) + Augment Spell (0 to 5d6; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Suffering domain; -1 level) = 0 level; damage cap 5d6 nonlethal (Will half). Chant of agonySS is Augmented one more step (1st level; damage cap 10d6).

sections.heading: ChaosPH1
sections.text: ChaosPH1: Lesser compelling confusion (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + [Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (spells or SLAs; -1 level)] + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) = 7th level; those in area confused 1 rd./level (no save if used vs. creatures possessing spells or spell-like abilities).

sections.heading: Chaos DevotionCC
sections.text: Chaos DevotionCC: Deflection or blessing (0 level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 bonus; +2 levels) + Varible Spell (no control over which effect; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Restricted Spell ([chaotic] bloodline, domain, deity, etc.; -1 level) = 0 level; as a swift action, grant yourself a +4 profane bonus to AC or attacks and damage (determine which randomly) for 1 round.

sections.heading: Chaos FlameRR2
sections.text: Chaos FlameRR2: Jet of flame (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Variable Spell (attacks random targets 50%; −1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6 fire. Each round, the fire has a 50% of affecting either the target you initially selected, or some other creature within range (determine randomly).

sections.heading: Chaos Hammer
sections.text: Chaos Hammer: Acid splash (0 level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Bane Spell (lawful; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (staggering; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenous Spell (-1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) + Restricted Spell ([chaotic] caster; -1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 (10d8 vs. lawful; half acid, half entropic) plus staggered 1 rd./level (save each round to end effect).

sections.heading: Chaos WardS&M
sections.text: Chaos WardS&M: Glamer (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Chaos domain; -1 level) = 1st level (listed as 2nd); subject gains +2 deflection to AC and 20% miss chance for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Chaotic CombatTM2
sections.text: Chaotic CombatTM2: Deflection (1st level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +3; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Chaos domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; grants +3 profane bonus to attacks and damage and +2 profane bonus to AC for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Chaotic CommandsTM2
sections.text: Chaotic CommandsTM2: Warding (compulsions; 1st level) + Variable Spell (active effects turned on caster instead of negated; ad hoc +2 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Chaos domain; -1 level) = 4th level; enchantment [compusion] effects targeting subject rebound on caster.

sections.heading: Charge ObjectOcA
sections.text: Charge ObjectOcA: Nystul’s magic aura (1st level) + Variable Spell (choose which aura information to impart; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full riutual; -1 level) = 1st level; you psychically “charge” item so that it detects as psychic, and object reading, etc. reveal information you impart (cannot impart false auras). Invest 25 x CL numen to maintain indefinitely.

sections.heading: Charm Animal
sections.text: Charm Animal: Ray of beguiling (1st level) + Crfoss-Class Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (animal; -2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (attitude towards caster only; -2 levels) = 1st level; target’s Cha is treated as 1d6 +1/2 levels (+5 max.) lower than actual when determining its attitude towards you (Intuition half, automatically Helpful if reduced to 1).

sections.heading: Charm ItemAUG
sections.text: Charm ItemAUG: Ray of beguiling (1st level) + Threnodic Spell (modified; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Item-Specific Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); intelligent item takes penalty to Cha of 1d6 + ½ levels vs. you.

sections.heading: Charm Person, MassRD
sections.text: Charm Person, MassRD: Charm person (1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) = 4th level; Cha penalty is 1d6 +1/level (+15 max.).

sections.heading: Charm Person, MassUI
sections.text: Charm Person, MassUI: Charm person (1st level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) = 4th level; as charm person, but Cha penalty is 1d6 +1/level (+15 max.), and affects up to 2d4+ 1/level (+10 max.) HD of humanoids in 40’r. (you choose which ones to be affected until potential filled).

sections.heading: Charming LieBRL
sections.text: Charming LieBRL: Compel (believe lie; 2nd level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Disguise Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 2nd level; those in 20’r. automatically believe one lie you tell as the verbal component (casting is disguised).

sections.heading: Charnel HouseHA
sections.text: Charnel HouseHA: Glamer (0 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Shadow Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 5th level; illusion of blood dripping from ceiling, massacred flesh on floor, etc. sickens and counts as difficult terrain (Intuition for 60% chance to ignore effects).

sections.heading: Charnel TouchHH
sections.text: Charnel TouchHH: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Augment Spell (1d6 to 5d6; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (necromancer or [death] bloodline, domain, etc.; -1 level) = 0 level (divine 1st); damage cap 5d6 negative energy.

sections.heading: Charon’s DispensationBotD3
sections.text: Charon’s DispensationBotD3: Warding (1st level) + Rewach Sperll (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 effect/3 levels; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (River Styx, Lethe, etc.; -2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) = 5th level (listed as 4th); subjects immune to harmful magical effects of rivers of the underworld: loss of memory, soul leaching, etc.

sections.heading: Chasing PerfectionPHII
sections.text: Chasing PerfectionPHII: Attribute boost (0 level) + Augment Spell (+4 total bonus; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) = 5th level; +4 enhancement to all attributes for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: CheatBVD
sections.text: CheatBVD: Skill enhancement (Profession: gambling; 0 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +5; +1 level) = 1st level; immediate action gives you +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to die roll to resolve a game of chance.

sections.heading: Chill/WarmthRR
sections.text: Chill/WarmthRR: Variable Spell (ray of frost or jet of flame; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 0d6; -3 levels) = 0 level. This is different from endure elements insofar as it actually changes the ambient temperature for the subject.

sections.heading: Chill GazeRR2
sections.text: Chill GazeRR2: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (ray of frost; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 6th level; damage cap  15d6 cold plus 1d4 Dex/rd. in 40’r. of you.

sections.heading: Chill Touch
sections.text: Chill Touch: Damage attribute (Str; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (as used; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6 negative energy and 1d4 Str damage, or 1d6 and 1 Str damage per touch for 1 touch/level (up to 5 total). Variants:

sections.heading: Chill WindSLPG
sections.text: Chill WindSLPG: Ray of frost (0 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (staggered; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 cold and staggered 1 rd./level (Fort half/neg.) in 5’r. burst.

sections.heading: Chilling Chamber, Darsson’sShS
sections.text: Chilling Chamber, Darsson’sShS: Ray of frost (0 level) + Conductive Evocation (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Delay Spell (onset 1/min. instead of 1/rd.; ­1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 1d6; -4 levels) = 2nd level; 1d6 cold/min. in one 10-ft. cube/level area (Fort half). Darsson’s fiery furnaceShS is the same, except it uses jet of flame as the base seed and deals fire damage.

sections.heading: Chord of DistractionCSc
sections.text: Chord of DistractionCSc: Inertia (0 level) + Quicken Spell (+4 levels) + Interupting Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 4th level; immediate casting leaves opponent flat-footed for 1 rd.

sections.heading: Chromatic BladeDr181
sections.text: Chromatic BladeDr181: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 feat/3 levels; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (BAB +11 effects; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 10d6; -3 levels) = 5th level (listed as 7th); damage cap 15d6/19-20 force, divided among iterative melee touch attacks (max. 10d6 for one), +3 to attacks and damage, and severs limb on a crit.

sections.heading: Chromatic OrbUA1
sections.text: Chromatic OrbUA1: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses: +1 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 1d6; -2 levels) = 1st level; close ranged touch attack forces Intuition save or deals 1d6 force plus blind 1 rd./level (Fort neg.). Paralysis, petrifaction, etc. orbs are not available from a 1st level spell.

sections.heading: Circle of BindingAUG2
sections.text: Circle of BindingAUG2: Compel (don’t leave circle; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 4th); those entering 5’r. circle are compelled not to leave it by any means for the remainder of the duration.

sections.heading: Circle of ClarityUM
sections.text: Circle of ClarityUM: Skill enhancement (Perception; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (targeted warding against concealment; 2nd level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Arcane Defense vs. illusion; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (0 to medium; +1 level) = 7th level; 20’r. emanation eliminates concealment less than full, +1/2 level to Perception checks to notice creatures or objects in area, and illusions in area are saved against with +2 bonus.

sections.heading: Circle of NauseaBVD
sections.text: Circle of NauseaBVD: Sickening touch (0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Circle of PrivacyTM2
sections.text: Circle of PrivacyTM2: Hand of fate (0 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (random encounters only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Fate or Travel domain; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; for the next 1 hr./level, roll twice for random encounter checks, and encounter occurs only if both checks say so.

sections.heading: Circle of SeeingRR
sections.text: Circle of SeeingRR: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (up to 1 location/level; +3 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (runes of seeing placed by you; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 8th level (listed as 4th); for 1 hr./level, you can see through up to 1 of your runes of seeing/level, shifting back and forth among them at will. Cf. rune of seeingRR.

sections.heading: Circle of SoundsRR
sections.text: Circle of SoundsRR: Tongues (3rd level) + Augment Spell (basic; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (animal sounds only; -2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (those affected only; cannot speak to actual animals; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Animal domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; subjects can communicate with each other (but not with actual animals) using animal sounds (birds, squirrels, etc.).

sections.heading: Circle of SunmotesTM2
sections.text: Circle of SunmotesTM2: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+2 bonus; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Variable Spell (Cascade Spell: jet of flame or spark of life; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Augment Spell (dazzling; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (0 to medium; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Sun domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 5d6; -3 levels) = 9th level; allies in 60’r. lighted area are healed 2d6 hp, gain +2 to atks, damage, saves vs. fear, and gain 3d6 temp. hp; enemies take 5d6 fire (Reflex half) per round and -2 to atks, damage, saves. Your enemies in area are illuminated by normal light, and you and your allies treated as if enemies in dazzling light.

sections.heading: City TransportAUG2
sections.text: City TransportAUG2: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (destination: close to line of sight; +4 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (within same settlement; -2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (standard activation; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 8th); you can teleport anywhere within the same city as a standard action (up to 1 jump/3 levels total).

sections.heading: Clairtangent HandSRD
sections.text: Clairtangent HandSRD: Mage hand (0 level) + Cascade Spell (detection: visual; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to line of sight; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to clairsentience discipline, oracular mystery, etc.; -1 level) = 5th level; you can see and manipulate a mage hand clairvoyantly, at a distance of up to ¼ mile per level.

sections.heading: Clarity of MindAUG2
sections.text: Clarity of MindAUG2: Skill enhancement (Concentration; 0 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +5; +1 level) = 0 level; you gain +1/2 levels (max. +5) enhancement to Concentration for 1 min./level. Variants:

sections.heading: Claws, LittorianAUG
sections.text: Claws, LittorianAUG: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); damage cap 7d6 slashing, divided between two melee claw attacks. Variants:

sections.heading: ClawstrikeRR2
sections.text: ClawstrikeRR2: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Overwhelming Evocation (+2 levels) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 1st level; melee attack deals 1d6 force/level (max. 5d6) + Str modifier, ignores hardness and energy resistance.

sections.heading: Cleansing StrikeLoM
sections.text: Cleansing StrikeLoM: Bestow feat (Insightful Strike; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (bolt of force; +3 levels) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (psionic; -1 level) = 3rd level; one melee attack gains Wis modifier to attack and damage and deals +1d6/level force damage (max. +10d6).

sections.heading: ClearstoneLEF
sections.text: ClearstoneLEF: Transmute (1st level) = 1st level (listed as 3rd); renders 1 cu. ft./level of rock transparent for up to 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Clear PathTM2
sections.text: Clear PathTM2: Residual Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Restricted Spell (druid, ranger, or access to Travel domain; -1 level) = 5th level; difficult terrain within 10 ft. of you is treated as normal, and very difficult terrain as difficult, for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Climbing TreeCM
sections.text: Climbing TreeCM: Skill enhancement (Athletics; 0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to vertical line; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+5 to +10; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 1st level; immobile tree (height equal to spell’s range) provides +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Climb checks.

sections.heading: Cloak of Adeamozs7S
sections.text: Cloak of Adeamozs7S: Warding (1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 effect/level; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Expedient Spell (max. spell level; -1 level) = 3rd level; subject immune to acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic spells of 3rd level or less (and negative energy at CL 6th, force at 7th, attribute damage at 8th-13th, etc.).

sections.heading: Cloak of Chaos
sections.text: Cloak of Chaos: Deflection (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 bonus; +1 level) +

sections.heading: Cloak of DarknessBRL
sections.text: Cloak of DarknessBRL: Gloom (0 level) + Selective Spell (+3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (spread to target; −2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; ambient light around you is reduced by 1 step (min. darkness) for everyone except you.

sections.heading: Cloak of KhyberDr337
sections.text: Cloak of KhyberDr337: Glamer (1st level) + Tenacious Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (2 effects; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 2 hrs./level; +4 levels) + Effect-S[ecofoc Spell (see below; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level; cloaks your alignment and causes any existing glamer on you to appear as your real form to true seeing, etc.

sections.heading: Cloak of RighteousnessRR
sections.text: Cloak of RighteousnessRR: Blessing (0 level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (blindness; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) = 4th level; blesses allies and blinds enemies within 20’r. of you (emanation lasts 1 rd./level).

sections.heading: Cloak of SecretsPC
sections.text: Cloak of SecretsPC: Glamer (1st level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Spellcraft; +1 level) + Extend (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); disguises speech (and lip movements) of those within 5’r. emenation from those outside, and imposes -1/2 levels (-5 max.) penalty to Spellcraft checks to ID spells being cast from within.

sections.heading: Cloak of the PhoenixRRE
sections.text: Cloak of the PhoenixRRE: Raise dead (5th level) + Delay Spell (until killed; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) = 9th level; one creature/level is raised from the dead if slain. Requires diamond dust (5,000 gp worth per creature) and investiture of 450 x CL numen to maintain the latent effect.

sections.heading: Cloak of the SeaCAd
sections.text: Cloak of the SeaCAd: Bestow feat (Favored Terrain: underwater; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Favored Terrain 3 more times; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (underwater only; -2 levels) = 6th level; subject gains Favored Terrain (underwater) +8, but no benefits apply when not actually underwater. Cf. liquid formRRO.

sections.heading: Cloak of WindsAPG
sections.text: Cloak of WindsAPG: Zephyr (0 level) + Shape Spell (line to target; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) = 3rd level; subject surrounded by severe winds for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Clone
sections.text: Clone: Resurrection (7th level) + Cross-Class Spell (arcane; +1 level) + Delay Spell (new body animates when original dies/is destroyed; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (re-animates in new body’s location, rather than in location of death; -1 level) = 8th level. The numen cost for latent spells (400 x CL) applies to each clone you have ready. AKA aksashic formOcA, astral seedSRD.

sections.heading: Close WoundsMH
sections.text: Close WoundsMH: Spark of life (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); immediate casting heals 5d6 hp.

sections.heading: Cloth of FlameRRO
sections.text: Cloth of FlameRRO: Jet of flame (0 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (until garment put on; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 1st level; person donning affected garment takes 1d6 fire/level (max. 5d6) per round until removed, plus 1d6 burn.

sections.heading: Clothier’s ClosetME
sections.text: Clothier’s ClosetME: Creation (1st level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 3 cu./ft.; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (shaping; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Craft; +1 level) + Item-Specific Spell (clothing only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 2nd); you conjure up to 1 outfit per level, lasting up 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Cloud MindSRD
sections.text: Cloud MindSRD: Invisibility (2nd level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (visual and auditory; +1 level) = 2nd level; you are invisible (as the spell, including Stealth bonus) and inaudible to one observer, and things you do are also hidden from that creature (gross effects allow another save, and attacking ends the spell).

sections.heading: Cloud of BewildermentPGF
sections.text: Cloud of BewildermentPGF: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cone; +1 level) + Widen Spell (30 ft. to 15 ft.; -1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; 15-ft. cone nauseates 1 rd./level or unil save.

sections.heading: Cloud of KnivesPHII
sections.text: Cloud of KnivesPHII: Invisible needle (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Improved Critical; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +6 effects; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 1d6; -4 levels) = 2nd level; each round, make 1 swift ranged touch attack for 1d6/19-20 piercing). Variants:

sections.heading: Cloud of PurificationTM2
sections.text: Cloud of PurificationTM2: Damage attribute  (Con; 1st level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Cretaure-Specific Spell (Tiny or smaller animals and vermin; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (create water; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Air or Water domain; -1 level) = 4th level; mobile spread deals up to 10d6 negative energy damage to organic filth, garbage, etc. and Tiny or smaller vermin (which also take 1d4 Con drain, potentially disintegrating them), leaves behind pure water that lasts 1 hr./level before evaporating.

sections.heading: Cloud of the AchaieraiBVD
sections.text: Cloud of the AchaieraiBVD: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cascade Spell (wisp; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of obliviousness; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Restricted Spell (afflicted with soul rot, or access to Lower Planar domain, mystery, etc.; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 6th level; 10’r. cloud around you obstructs vision, deals 10d6 negative energy/rd. (Fort half), and inflicts 1d6 +1/level penalty to Wis (save half, confused at 1).

sections.heading: Cloud the MindAUG2
sections.text: Cloud the MindAUG2: Skill enhancement (Perception; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Bluff; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); target is -1/2 levels (-5 max.) to Bluff and Perception for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Cloudkill
sections.text: Cloudkill: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (wisp; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) = 5th level; 1d4 Con damage/rd. (Fort half) to all within area with 9 HD or less, and obscures vision.

sections.heading: Coat of ArmsCM
sections.text: Coat of ArmsCM: Mage armor (1st level) + Variable Spell (shield bonus; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 to +6; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bolt of force; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) = 5th level;  you gain shield of force (+6 shield bonus to AC), can fire bolts of force as a partial action (damage cap 15d6, Reflex half).

sections.heading: Coat of Many StarsAPG
sections.text: Coat of Many StarsAPG: Mage armor (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (inure: bludgeoning; +1 level) + Energy Admixture (piercing; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Void domain, etc.; −1 level) = 1st level; you gain +4 armor bonus (and DR 5/slashing or adamantine at CL 4th+) for 1 hr./level. Augment to 2nd level to increase armor bonus to +6, and DR to 10/slashing or adamantine at CL 12th+.

sections.heading: Coax forth PowerAUG2
sections.text: Coax forth PowerAUG2: Bestow feat (Empower Spell; 1st level) + Variable Spell (item spells rather than ones you cast; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Sudden Metamagic; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (additional uses; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (direct-damage spells only; -2 levels) = 6th level (listed as 4th); hp damage of spells from item touched are Empowered for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Cobra’s BreathCA
sections.text: Cobra’s BreathCA: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (cone; +1 level) + Widen Spell (30 ft. to 15 ft.; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (water wu jen; -1 level) = 1st level; 1d4 Con damage in 15-ft. cone (Fort half).

sections.heading: CobwebsRR2
sections.text: CobwebsRR2: Web (q.v.; 2nd level) – Augment Spell (­1 level) = 1st level; as web, but entangled rather than grappled.

sections.heading: Cobwebs, ChokingCM
sections.text: Cobwebs, ChokingCM: Sickening touch (0 level) + Cascade Spell (wisp; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Variable Spell (see below; +1 level) = 6th level; area of difficult terrain sickens and obscures vision; overlapping area of two such spells nauseates and deals 1d4 Con damage:

sections.heading: Cognitive BlockOcA
sections.text: Cognitive BlockOcA: Compel (cast slowly; 2nd level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoid; -2 levels) = 2nd level; target casts standard casting time spells as full-round rituals for 1 rd./level. N.B. Removing the humanoid-only target limitation results in a 4th level spell.

sections.heading: Coin ShotPC
sections.text: Coin ShotPC: Energy mace (0 level) + Energy Admixture (piercing; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (lesser versatile weaponAPG; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Delay Spell (standard; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); 3 thrown coins make short ranged touch attacks for up to 7d6 total damage (half bludgeoning, half piercing) and penetrate one metal-specific DR.

sections.heading: Cold of the GraveDr347
sections.text: Cold of the GraveDr347: Ray of frost (0 level) + Energy Admixture (negative energy; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Str; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6 and 1d4 to 1d3; -1 level) = 2nd level; ray deals up to 5d6 damage (half cold, half entropic) plus 1d3 Str.

sections.heading: Combat Trap, BefuddlerCSc
sections.text: Combat Trap, BefuddlerCSc: Ray of idiocy (1st level) + Cascade Spell (ray of obliviousness; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (ray of beguiling; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Delay Spell (square stepped on; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or rogue; -1 level) = 2nd level; intruder takes 1d6 + ½ levels (+10 max., Intuition half) penalty to Int, Wis, and Cha for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Combat Trap, EnfeeblerCSc
sections.text: Combat Trap, EnfeeblerCSc: Touch of fatigue (0 level) + Delay Spell (square stepped on; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger or rogue; -1 level) = 1st level; intruder fatigued. Rangers add Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level), for 0 level.

sections.heading: Combat Trap, EntanglerCSc
sections.text: Combat Trap, EntanglerCSc: Bind (0 level) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Delay Spell (square stepped on; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or rogue; -1 level) = 1st level; intruder entangled and square is difficult terrain for 1 rd./level. Rangers add Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level), for 0 level.

sections.heading: Combat Trap, EqualizerCSc
sections.text: Combat Trap, EqualizerCSc: Topple (0 level) + Delay Spell (square stepped on; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or rogue; ­1 level) = 0 level; intruder knocked prone.

sections.heading: Combat Trap, FlashbangCSc
sections.text: Combat Trap, FlashbangCSc: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Augment Spell (add sense: hearing; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Fell Dazzling (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Delay Spell (square stepped on; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or rogue; -1 level) = 1st level; intruder blinded and deafened (Intuition dazzled/neg.) for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Combat Trap, FootspikerCSc
sections.text: Combat Trap, FootspikerCSc: Invisible needle (0 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Delay Spell (square stepped on; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or rogue; -1 level) = 1st level; intruder takes 1d6/level (max. 5d6) piercing damage and speed is slowed by 10 ft. for 1 min./level (Fort half/neg.). Rangers add Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level), for 0 level (damage 1d6, regardless of level).

sections.heading: Combat Trap, GlitterburstCSc
sections.text: Combat Trap, GlitterburstCSc: Warding (glamers; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Stealth; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Delay Spell (square stepped on; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or rogue; -1 level) = 1st level; negates invisibility and imposes -1/2 levels (-5 max.) penalty to Stealth for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Combat Trap, Great ScorcherCSc
sections.text: Combat Trap, Great ScorcherCSc: Jet of flame (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Delay Spell (square stepped on; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or rogue; -1 level) = 1st level; damage cap 5d6 fire in 10’r. when triggered.

sections.heading: Combat Trap, ScorcherCSc
sections.text: Combat Trap, ScorcherCSc: Jet of flame (0 level) + Delay Spell (square stepped on; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or rogue; -1 level) = 0 level; intruder takes 1d6 fire damage (Reflex half).

sections.heading: Combat Trap, SleeperCSc
sections.text: Combat Trap, SleeperCSc: Whelm (0 level) + Delay Spell (square stepped on; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger or rogue; -1 level) = 1st level; damage cap 5d6 nonlethal.

sections.heading: Combat Trap, SpiderwebCSc
sections.text: Combat Trap, SpiderwebCSc: Bind (0 level) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; −1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (square stepped on; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or rogue; -1 level) = 1st level; 5’r. grapples, is difficult terrain for 1 rd./level. Rangers add Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level), for 0 level.

sections.heading: Combat Trap, StinkburstCSc
sections.text: Combat Trap, StinkburstCSc: Wisp (0 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (square stepped on; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or rogue; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level; intruder nauseated, and vision obscured in square.

sections.heading: Combined TalentCM
sections.text: Combined TalentCM: Skill enhancement (0 level) + Variable Spell (choose skill at time of casting; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Delay Spell (until skill used; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+5 to +10; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 1st level; +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to next check with selected skill.

sections.heading: CombustMF
sections.text: CombustMF: Jet of flame (0 level) + Ray Splitting (anyone touching target; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (1d6; +1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 12d6 (half to initial target; the rest divided among other targets) plus 2d6 burn.

sections.heading: CometstrikeFB
sections.text: CometstrikeFB: Ray of frost (0 level) + Energy Admixture (bludgeoning; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 7th level (listed as 9th); damage cap 27d6, divided among comets. Each round, make 3 long ranged touch attacks for 3d6 bludgeoning + 1d6 cold/3 levels above 2nd (max. 6d6 at 20th) each plus stunning 1 rd.

sections.heading: Comforts of HomeDHD
sections.text: Comforts of HomeDHD: Glamer (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Fast Recovery; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 2 hrs./level; +4 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoid; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Augment Spell (olfactory, tactile, and thermal effects; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (halfling or access to Travel domain; ­1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); for up to 2 hrs./level, cold, hard ground seems like a warm, soft bed to subject, who also gains Fast Recovery.

sections.heading: Command Plants
sections.text: Command Plants: Speak with plants (3rd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (1-way communication only; -2 levels) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Cha; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (plants only; -2 levels) +  Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 4th level; you can speak with plants and 2d4 +1 HD/level (+10 max.) of them take a 4d4 Cha penalty vs. your commands.

sections.heading: Command Undead
sections.text: Command Undead: Damage attribute (Cha; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Threnodic Spell (+0 levels) = 3rd level; 3d4 Cha damage to one undead.

sections.heading: Command, MurderousUM
sections.text: Command, MurderousUM: Compel (attack ally; 2nd level) + Still Spell (+1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st). Variants:

sections.heading: Commanding PresenceRR
sections.text: Commanding PresenceRR: Eagle’s splendor (2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 2nd); +4 enhancement to Charisma for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Commune with CityAUG2
sections.text: Commune with CityAUG2: Augury (2nd level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 question/level; +4 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (pertaining to settlement where you are at time of casting; -2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 5th).

sections.heading: Companion Mind LinkUC
sections.text: Companion Mind LinkUC: Mindlink (1st level) + Cascade Spell (charm animal; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (animal companion; -2 levels) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Companion TranspositionUW
sections.text: Companion TranspositionUW: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to long; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (2 targets; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (you and your animal companion, familiar, etc.; -2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (you switch places; -2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 5th); you and your animal companion, familiar, etc. switch places if within long range.

sections.heading: Compassionate AllyUM
sections.text: Compassionate AllyUM: Compel (aid injured ally; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (fails if no injured ally; -2 levels) = 2nd level; subject compelled to spend next round tending to an injured ally.

sections.heading: CompelOA
sections.text: CompelOA: Glamer (alignment aura; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (compel: behave as aligned per false aura; +3 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; ­1 level) = 8th level; creature detects and acts as if aligned as you specify; invest 400 x CL numen to maintain effect indefinitely. Cf. morality undoneFC1.

sections.heading: Compel HostilityUC
sections.text: Compel HostilityUC: Compel (attack me instead; 2nd level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +4 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (creature attacking one of your allies; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (attacks transferred to you; -1 level) = 4th level; as an immediate action, you can force an opponent to redirect an attack from an ally to you. As long as you spend at least 1 immediate action/rd., the spell remains in effect, limited only by your number of immediate actions and willingness (and ability) to continue concentrating. Cf. tauntUA1.

sections.heading: Compelling Question, LesserAUG
sections.text: Compelling Question, LesserAUG: Compel (answer truthfully; 2nd level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; subject compelled to truthfully provide a brief (up to 6-second) answer to 1 question.

sections.heading: Compelling Question, GreaterAUG
sections.text: Compelling Question, GreaterAUG: Compelling question (q.v., 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 3rd level; allows longer, more complete replies (taking up to 6 seconds/level).

sections.heading: Compelling RantHA
sections.text: Compelling RantHA: Damage attribute (Wis; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (ray of beguiling; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Pattern Spell (auditory; -1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Wis; -1 level) = 5th level; listeners in 120’r. take 1d4 Wis damage (Wis half) and Cha penalty of 1d6 + 1/level (+15 max., Intuition half, Helpful at 1) to you while you continue speaking and for 1 rd./level thereafter; you take 1d4 Wis damage.

sections.heading: CompressionSRD
sections.text: CompressionSRD: Reduce (3rd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; your size is reduced by 1 step.

sections.heading: CompulsionPH5
sections.text: CompulsionPH5: Compel (move in indicated direction; 2nd level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) = 5th level (listed as 4th); designated targets within 20 ft. move in the direction you indicate for 1 rd. while you concentrate or until save.

sections.heading: Compulsive LiarUI
sections.text: Compulsive LiarUI: Compel (lie; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (about factual topics only; -2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 2nd); for 1 hr./level, subject always lies about factual topics (but otherwise can talk normally).

sections.heading: Compulsive OrderTM2
sections.text: Compulsive OrderTM2: Compel (meticulously organize evything you encounter; 2nd level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Law domain; -1 level) = 4th level; subject cannot act except in a comically OCD fashion; all actions must be justified as such or cannot be completed. Invest 400 x CL numen to maintain curse indefinitely.

sections.heading: Comrade’s TrailAUG2
sections.text: Comrade’s TrailAUG2: Figment (0 level) + Shape Spell (cubes to line; -2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to line of sight; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (glowing path marker only; -2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (your actual path; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 1st level (listed as 0); creates illusory glow to mark your path (up to ¼ mi./level) that only those you name during casting can see.

sections.heading: Conceal ItemDHD
sections.text: Conceal ItemDHD: Glamer (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +1 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (item held or worn by you; -2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 3rd); one item you are holding or wearing becomes invisible for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Conceal ThoughtsSRD
sections.text: Conceal ThoughtsSRD: Skill enhancement (Bluff; 0 level) + Use-Specific Spell (conceal motives only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Arcane Defense, divination; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 3rd level; +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to conceal motives, and +2 to saves vs. divinations. A 1st level version lasts only 1 min./level and has a maximum bonus of +5.

sections.heading: Concussion BlastSRD
sections.text: Concussion BlastSRD: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6 (Fort half). Variants:

sections.heading: Condemnation, Apolioth’sAUG2
sections.text: Condemnation, Apolioth’sAUG2: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (­1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 force in 20’r. plus entangled 1 rd./level. (or until save).

sections.heading: CondemnedRR
sections.text: CondemnedRR: Warding (positive energy; 1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) = 4th level; victim touched unaffected by spark of life effects. Invest 200 x CL numen to maintain as a curse.

sections.heading: Conduit of LifeCC
sections.text: Conduit of LifeCC: Spark of life (1st level) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; you heal 1d6 hp/level (max. 5d6) the next time you use a spell or class feature to heal someone else.

sections.heading: Conditional FavorUI
sections.text: Conditional FavorUI: Bestow feat (Delay Spell; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Sudden Metamagic; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (subject of 2nd spell must be willing; -2 levels) = 1st level; swift casting Delays next spell cast on willing subject so that it activates if the subject either breaks some pre-selected promise or encounters some pre-selected condition.

sections.heading: Cone of Cold
sections.text: Cone of Cold: Ray of frost (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) + Widen Spell (30-ft. to 60-ft.; +1 level) + Augment Spell (10d6 to 15d6; +1 level) = 4th level (Winter 5th). Variants:

sections.heading: ConfoundCC
sections.text: ConfoundCC: Blessing (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +3; +1 level) Variable Spell (+1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd./level; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) = 4th  level; target is flat-footed (cannot make AoO) and -3 to attacks and damage; you are +3 to attacks and damage against the subject.

sections.heading: Confounding Battlefield, Talen’sRR2
sections.text: Confounding Battlefield, Talen’sRR2: Glamer (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Variable Spell (random assignment; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (+1 level) = 5th level; up to 1 creature/level is magically disguised as one of the other affected creatures (determine randomly); illusion includes auditory, visual, olfactory, and tactile elements. Cf. bewildering substitutionCC.

sections.heading: Confuse LanguagesPH1
sections.text: Confuse LanguagesPH1: Ray of idiocy (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Linguistics; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+5 to +10; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 1st level; touch reduces effective Int by 1d6 +1/2 levels for purposes of speaking languages, and imposes -1/2 levels (-10 max.) penalty to Lingustics, with resultant loss of languages spoken.

sections.heading: Conjure AnimalsPH5
sections.text: Conjure AnimalsPH5: Summon (1st level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 2; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Animal domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; summons animals: 1 CR 2, 1d3 CR 1, or 1d4+1 CR ½.

sections.heading: Conjure AurumvoraxDHD
sections.text: Conjure AurumvoraxDHD: Summon (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 2 rds./level; +1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 7; +4 levels) + Restricted Spell (gnome; -1 level) = 5th level.

sections.heading: Conjure Black PuddingUM
sections.text: Conjure Black PuddingUM: Summon (1st level) + Tenacious Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 5 black pudding; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-1 level) = 5th level; can be extended by investing numen.

sections.heading: Conjure CarriageUI
sections.text: Conjure CarriageUI: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 1; +1 level) + Augment Spell (1d4+1; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Shadow Spell (-1 level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level; summons carriage with (roll 1d3): 1 = two light horses; 2 = two light horses and a 3rd level Expert coachman; 3 = four light horses and a coachman.

sections.heading: Conjure CavernRRE
sections.text: Conjure CavernRRE: Shaping (2nd level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 5,832 cu. ft./level; +5 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (cave in existing unworked earth or stone; -2 levels) = 5th level.

sections.heading: Conjure Fire ElementalPH1
sections.text: Conjure Fire ElementalPH1: Summon (1st level) + Variable Spell (no control over results; -1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 10; +6 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Fire domain, etc.; -1 level) = 6th level; summons one of the following:

sections.heading: Consecrate
sections.text: Consecrate: Enhancement (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (positive energy DCs; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (warding: animate dead, summon undead; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell ([good] caster;  -1 level) = 3rd level; undead cannot be animated or summoned into area, are -1 to attacks, damage, and saves, and positive energy DCs are increased by +1, +1/4 levels. For the stronger effect, add the Augment Spell feat (+1 level) and the Location-Specific Spell feat (emanates from altar or shrine; -2 levels) = 2nd level; undead are -3 to attacks, damage, and saves.

sections.heading: Consistent AimMW
sections.text: Consistent AimMW: Hand of fate (0 level) + Quicken Spell (+4 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (ranged attack roll; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; reroll one ranged attack as an immediate action.

sections.heading: Constricting ChainsBED
