sections.text: Constricting ChainsBED: Bind (0 level) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 7th); damage cap 10d6/rd. nonlethal and grappled 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Construction Crew, Bigby’sGA
sections.text: Construction Crew, Bigby’sGA: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 1/3; -1 level) + Augment Spell (2d4+1 summoned; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 4th level; summons 2d4+1 1st level hafling Experts with tools, trained in Craft (construction), Profession (mining), etc.

sections.heading: Consume LikenessBVD
sections.text: Consume LikenessBVD: Polymorph (3rd level) + Variable Spell (type; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (assume form of creature eaten; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Concentration (standard; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 5th level; you assume the form of a creature you eat (of the same size as you) as if polymorphed, can switch back & forth between forms as a standard action. Invest 250 x CL numen to retain access to alternate form indefinitely, gaining the [shape-changer] descriptor.

sections.heading: Consume PersonAUG2
sections.text: Consume PersonAUG2: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+5d4; +4 levels) + Crippling Drain (+5 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoid only; -2 levels) = 9th level; close ranged touch deals 6d4 Con drain (Fort half).

sections.heading: Consumption of FireRR
sections.text: Consumption of FireRR: Jet of flame (0 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Dex; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; +1 level)+ Reach Spell (touch to planar; +6 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Cascade Spell (enervation; -4  levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 10d6; -3 levels) = 5th level (listed as 2nd); target takes 10d6 fire plus 1d4 Dex and 1d4 Con damage (no save, no SR), from anywhere on the same plane (caster takes 1d4 temp. negative levels).

sections.heading: Consumptive AuraBotD
sections.text: Consumptive AuraBotD: Touch of fatigue (1st level) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 1d6; -3 levels) + Reduce Spell (daemon cultist, etc.; -1 level) = 3rd level; aura deals 1d6 nonlethal/rd. plus fatigued.

sections.heading: Contact EntityHA
sections.text: Contact EntityHA: Mindlink (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to continental; +5 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (-2 levels) + Variable Spell (choose type or species at time of casting; +1 level) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to inst.; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level; up to 1 creature/level of specified type within 100 miles/level (affected in order of distance) of 7 HD or less receives notice of your location and intent to make contact. A 4th level contact greater entity spell would have no HD limit (and emulates the 7th level contact entity IV spell).

sections.heading: Contagion, Bleeding DiseaseRR
sections.text: Contagion, Bleeding DiseaseRR: Contagion (2nd level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (see below; -2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (see below; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 0 level; inflicts minor disease on a creature that has not prayed to a god of pestilence in over a week (can end effects by doing so).

sections.heading: Contagion, Breath of DeathTM2
sections.text: Contagion, Breath of DeathTM2: Contagion (2nd level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1,000 r.; +5 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Pestilence domain; -1 level) = 7th level; all within 1,000 feet of you must save or be infected with chosen disease.

sections.heading: Contagion, Contagious TouchCD
sections.text: Contagion, Contagious TouchCD: Contagion (2nd level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Pestilence domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; 1 touch/rd. inflicts disease.

sections.heading: Contagion, Crypt Warden’s GraspCM
sections.text: Contagion, Crypt Warden’s GraspCM: Contagion (2nd level) + Augment Spell (mummy rot; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (warding: remove disease; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 5th level; touch inflicts mummy rot, cannot be magically cured until curse lifted. Temporatily invest 250 x CL numen to maintain effect until victim dies or is cured.

sections.heading: Contagion, EpidemicUM
sections.text: Contagion, EpidemicUM: Contagion (2nd level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Delay Spell (by contact, over length of illness; +1 level) + Delay Spell (12-hour incubation period; -1 level) = 7th level; target contacts disease, can transmit it to 1 additional target/level over the duration of its incubation period and affliction. AKA pestilenceBVD.

sections.heading: Contagion, GreaterUM
sections.text: Contagion, GreaterUM: Contagion (2nd level) + Inexorable Spell (+4 levels) + Tenuous Spell (initial save applies; -1 level) = 5th level; if afflicted, saving throws vs. the disease fail thereafter.

sections.heading: Contagion, MassRF
sections.text: Contagion, MassRF: Contagion (2nd level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/3 levels; +2 levels) = 5th level; the 6th level version instead affects up to 1 creature/level.

sections.heading: Contagion, PestilenceSRD
sections.text: Contagion, PestilenceSRD: Contagion (2nd level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1,000’r.; +5 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 9th level (listed as epic); infects those in area with slimy doom.

sections.heading: Contagion, PlaguePHII
sections.text: Contagion, PlaguePHII: Damage attribute (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) = 7th level spell dealing 1d4 attribute damage/rd. for 1 rd./level to up to 1 creature/level.

sections.heading: Contagion, Plague BearerPC
sections.text: Contagion, Plague BearerPC: Contagion (2nd level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (onset: inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 6th); creature touched exudes disease in 5’r. for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Contagion, Plague CarrierRF
sections.text: Contagion, Plague CarrierRF: Contagion (2nd level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (as contact occurs; +1 level) = 6th level (listed as 4th); as contagion, but contact with victim can infect up to one other creature/3 levels above 3rd.

sections.heading: Contagion, Plague CarrierUM
sections.text: Contagion, Plague CarrierUM: Bestow feat (Unclean Strike; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) = 5th level.

sections.heading: Contagion, Plague StormUM
sections.text: Contagion, Plague StormUM: Contagion (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (wisp; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 7th level; mobile fog cloud carries disease.

sections.heading: Contagion, Plague TouchRR2
sections.text: Contagion, Plague TouchRR2: Contagion (2nd level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) = 5th level; you can use contagion at will for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Contagion, ScourgeCD
sections.text: Contagion, ScourgeCD: Greater contagion (q.v., 5th level) + Reach Spell (touch to long; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Pestilence domain; -1 level) = 9th level (listed as 7th); one creature/level within long range is afflicted with a greater contagion.

sections.heading: Containment of MesosRR2
sections.text: Containment of MesosRR2: Dispel (0 level) + Shielding Spell (+2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Irresistible Spell (no check needed; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (specific schools: see below; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell [(bolt of force; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Expedient Spell (damage limited by spell levels absorbed; -1 level) + Augment Spell (15d6 to 25d6; +2 levels) = 7th level; one spell/3 levels targeting you is negated (one each Transmutation, Conjuration, and Enchantment, and one Necromancy at CL 12th, Evocation at CL 15th, and Divination at CL 18th), and you can emit a 20-ft. radius burst of force (damage 1d6 x level of spell absorbed, to a max. of 25 total spell levels for all spells absorbed).

sections.heading: Contraception (new)
sections.text: Contraception (new): Warding (fertility; 1st level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoid; -2 levels) + Pacific Spell (cannot be used against nonwilling subject; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 0 level; willing humanoid becomes infertile for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Control AirSRD
sections.text: Control AirSRD: Zephyr (0 level) + Variable Spell (increase or decrease winds; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (line to spread; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 360’r.; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (6 steps to 1 step; -5 levels) = 2nd level; increase or decrease wind speed by 1 step.

sections.heading: Control BodySRD
sections.text: Control BodySRD: Possession (3rd level) + Cross-Class Spell (psychokinesis; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 rd.; −4 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 4th); you telekinetically control the subject (Fort neg.), but the effect is otherwise similar to possession.

sections.heading: Control ConstructUM
sections.text: Control ConstructUM: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (animate object; +1 level) + Widen Spell (Small to Huge; +4 levels) + Concentration Spell (+1 level) = 7th level; dispels master’s control of a construct of up to Huge size, allowing you to control it by concentration.

sections.heading: Control CurrentsSW
sections.text: Control CurrentsSW: Celerity (water speed; 0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Water domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (50 ft. to 30 ft.; -1 level) = 4th level; you control water speed (±30 ft./rd.) and flow direction in 120’r.

sections.heading: Control LightSRD
sections.text: Control LightSRD: Variable Spell (gloom or light; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (emanation to cubes; +0 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); illuminate one 10-ft. cube/level (up to normal light), or reduce ambient illumination by up to 2 steps.

sections.heading: Control Light, SwiftRR
sections.text: Control Light, SwiftRR: Variable Spell (gloom or light; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) = 5th level (listed as 4th); illuminate 20’r. area up to normal light, or reduce ambient light up to 3 steps, as a swift action each round.

sections.heading: Control ObjectSRD
sections.text: Control ObjectSRD: Animate object (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Control Plants
sections.text: Control Plants: Damage attribute (Cha; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+5d4; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (days to minutes; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (mindlink; +1 level) + Coaxing Spell (+0 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Expedient Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 6th level (listed as 8th); 6d4 Cha damage each to one plant/level (total HD 2d4 + 1/level, +15 max.) and telepathic commands.

sections.heading: Control SoundSRD
sections.text: Control SoundSRD: Glamer (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Augment Spell (dampen existing sound if desired; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (no olfactory, tactile, or visual; -2 levels) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Control TemperaturePH1
sections.text: Control TemperaturePH1: Variable Spell (jet of flame or ray of frost; 1st level) + Merciful Spell (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Weather domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level; you create (or negate) freezing or sweltering conditions within a mobile 10’r. of you (up to 5d6).

sections.heading: Control TemperatureFB,AUG
sections.text: Control TemperatureFB,AUG: Variable Spell (jet of flame or ray of frost; +1 level) + Merciful Spell (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 1d6; -3 levels) = 3rd level; you can adjust temperature in 40’r. emanation, but not increase or lower it enough to cause nonlethal damage.

sections.heading: Control the SoulRR
sections.text: Control the SoulRR: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Augment Spell (also hearing; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (mindlinkSRD; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Cha; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+5d4; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to planar; +6 levels) + Cascade Spell (enervation; -4 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 8th level (listed as 3rd); as dominate monster, but functions at any range on the same plane, and you can see and hear what the subject does (you take 1d4 temp. negative levels). Invest 400 x CL numen to maintain indefinitely (but the neg. levels last that same period of time).

sections.heading: Control Undead
sections.text: Control Undead: Damage attribute (Cha; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+5d4; +4 levels) + Threnodic Spell (+0 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (+3 levels) + Expedient Spell (-1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 7th level; 4d6 Cha damage to one undead/level (total HD 2d4 + 1/level, +15 max.), save each round to halve remaining damage.

sections.heading: Control Water
sections.text: Control Water: Creation (water; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 10 min./level; -1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to long; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (volume to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Water domain, etc.; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 4th); lowers or raises water level in area by up to 2 ft./level. Control sandSSt is essentially similar. Variants:

sections.heading: Control Weather
sections.text: Control Weather: Variable Spell (create water, ray of frost, jet of flame, wisp, zephyr; +1 level) + Shape Spell (emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1 mi.; +6 levels) + Concentration Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (­2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Weather domain, etc.; -1 level) = 7th level; each round, choose wind (up to hurricane speed), rain, and/or freezing or very hot temperatures. If two effects chosen, Reduce all by 1 step (e.g., violent to heavy rain, hurricane to windstorm); for 3 effects, Reduce all by 2 steps (e.g., moderate rain, severe winds). Variants:

sections.heading: ConvertRR
sections.text: ConvertRR: Compel (worship caster’s deity; 2nd level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 9th level; invest 450 x CL numen to maintain effect.

sections.heading: ConvictionSC
sections.text: ConvictionSC: Resistance (0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+5 total bonus; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); subject gains +5 sacred bonus to saves.

sections.heading: Cooling Breeze, Darsson’sShS
sections.text: Cooling Breeze, Darsson’sShS: Zephyr (0 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Reduce Spell (severe to light; -3 levels) = 1st level; creates long-lasting light breeze.

sections.heading: Co-Opt ConcentrationSRD
sections.text: Co-Opt ConcentrationSRD: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (steal effect; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd.; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 5th level; you take over effects of ongoing spell while you concentrate.

sections.heading: CopyCWH
sections.text: CopyCWH: Shaping (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (copy of document touched; -2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (no Craft check needed, but also no variation from original possible; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 1/64 cu. ft./level; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 0 level (listed as 1st); creates an exact copy of an existing document, using ink and paper you provide as material components.

sections.heading: Corpse CandleCA
sections.text: Corpse CandleCA: Light (0 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 min./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (see invisibility; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (personal to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) = 3rd level; mobile light reveals invisible creatures.

sections.heading: Corpse VisageCWH
sections.text: Corpse VisageCWH: Spook (0 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (onset: inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (glamer; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 1st level; for 1 rd./level, your face appears as a rotting corpse’s, and creatures of 5 HD or less within 20 ft. are shaken 1 rd./level or until save.

sections.heading: CorrespondSRD
sections.text: CorrespondSRD: Mindlink (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +7 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (must have had physical or mental contact with subject in the past; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 4th level; as mindlink, but proximity with subject can be prior to casting.

sections.heading: Corruption ResistanceAPG
sections.text: Corruption ResistanceAPG: Inure (alignment-based; 0 level) + Variable Spell (select alignment at time of casting; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin or access to Inquisition domain; -1 level) + Augment Spell (15 to 30; +1 level) = 2nd level; subject gains resistance 5/2 levels (max. 30) to damage that targets specific alignment (e.g., holy smite).

sections.heading: Corrupting TouchSRD
sections.text: Corrupting TouchSRD: Glamer (evil aura; 1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain; -1 level) = 0 level; victim touched is shaken and radiates as [evil] for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Counterbalancing AuraPnA
sections.text: Counterbalancing AuraPnA: Deflection (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 bonus; +1 level) + Cascade Spell [(spell resistance; +5 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (neutral spells/spells cast by neutral creatures only; -2 levels)] + Cascade Spell [(sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Shielding Spell (included above; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (neutral attackers only; -2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (2 attackers/rd.; +1 level)] + Communal Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (non-neutral caster; -1 level) = 8th level; +4 deflection to AC and +4 resistance to saves, plus SR 10 + Concentration bonus vs. neutral spells, and up to 2 neutral creatures hitting per round are nauseated 1 rd. Protection lasts 1 min./level total, divided among recipients.

sections.heading: CountercharmBRL
sections.text: CountercharmBRL: Remove condition (Cha penalty; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: CounterspellPH5
sections.text: CounterspellPH5: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) = 5th level (listed as 3rd); immediate casting allows counterspelling of one spell being cast within Close range. AKA stifle spellPHII. Variants:

sections.heading: Crafter’s CurseAPG
sections.text: Crafter’s CurseAPG: Skill enhancement (Craft; 0 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); target is -1/2 levels (-5 max.) to Craft checks.

sections.heading: Create BonfirePH5
sections.text: Create BonfirePH5: Jet of flame (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (area cannot be re-directed; -2 levels) = 0 level; creates fire in small area (1d6, Reflex half).

sections.heading: Create CampsiteTM2
sections.text: Create CampsiteTM2: Shaping (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Stealth; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target material to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (campsite only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Travel domain; -1 level) = 3rd level (ranger 2nd); makes 40’r. campsite using materials at hand; +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to DC of Perception checks to notice it.

sections.heading: Create EquipmentBRL
sections.text: Create EquipmentBRL: Creation (1st level) + Variable Spell (material and item; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (shaping; +2 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (mundane object of low value only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 rd./level; -3 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Craft; +1 level) = 0 level. Conjures a single simple, mundane (non-masterwork) item of up to 1 lb./level, lasting 1 rd./level before disappearing. The spell grants you a Craft check (DC 15) of +1/2 levels (max. +5) to properly shape the item even if you have no ranks; if this check is failed, the conjured item is unusable. Whether the item is called from some other place or created is immaterial. Cf. call weaponrySRD. Variant:

sections.heading: Create MindscapeOcA
sections.text: Create MindscapeOcA: Dimensional pocket (1st level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 27 lbs./level; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to long; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (environment and ecology; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 10 min./level; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 5th level; creates illusory demiplane (you select terrain, ecology, etc.) for subject to wander through (if can be enticed to enter). You need not have the Power over Shadow feat, as the effect is illusory. Greater create mindscapeOcA affects 1 creature/level (+3 levels), lasts 1 hr./level (+1 level), and is not Augmented (-2 levels) = 7th level.

sections.heading: Create PitAPG
sections.text: Create PitAPG: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Shape Spell (spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level; “fall” for 5d6 bludgeoning plus grappled (in essence; victims can climb out instead of breaking free); initial Reflex save for half/negates. The pit remains for 1 rd./level (treat as difficult terrain, but creatures jump over/skirt the pit instead of ignoring the terrain via Acrobatics, etc.).

sections.heading: Create SoundSRD
sections.text: Create SoundSRD: Ghost sound (0 level) + Cross-Class Spell (metacreativity/conjuration (creation); +1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Reduce Spell (no olfactory, tactile, or visual; -3 levels) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Creeping Eye, Tevikk’sRR
sections.text: Creeping Eye, Tevikk’sRR: Arcane eye (3rd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (line of sight to extreme; -1 level) = 4th level; as arcane eye, but shorter range and lasts longer. Invest 2,000 x CL numen to make permanent (use-activated spell effect).

sections.heading: Creeping IceACG
sections.text: Creeping IceACG: Creation (ice; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 10 min./level; -1 level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 8 cu. ft./level; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Concentration (swift action; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (on horizontal surfaces; -1 level) = 4th level; creates ice 10 ft. x 10 ft. x 1 inch thick per level, spreads each round thereafter as a swift action.

sections.heading: Creeping Shadow, Lorloveim’sTM2
sections.text: Creeping Shadow, Lorloveim’sTM2: Alter senses (1st level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Augment Spell (add sense: hearing; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; you can see, hear, and speak through sensor (appearing as an extension of your shadow) at Long range. ShadowcatTM2 is Extended to 10 min./level (+2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 7th).

sections.heading: Crime of OpportunityUI
sections.text: Crime of OpportunityUI: Compel (2nd level) + Variable Spell (no control over compulsion; -1 level) = 1st level; target rolls 1d4: 1 = refuses to accept Aid Another or beneficial spells, 2 = attempts to pickpocket valuables from nearest creature, 3 = attempts to vandalize nearest structure, 4 = attack nearest creature. If unable to do any of these, attempts to hide.

sections.heading: Crime WaveUI
sections.text: Crime WaveUI: Crime of opportunityUI (q.v.; 1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) = 6th level (listed as 7th).

sections.heading: Crisis of LifeSRD
sections.text: Crisis of LifeSRD: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (telepathy; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+5d4; +4 levels) = 7th level; 6d4 Con damage (Fort half) at Medium range.

sections.heading: Critical StrikeCAd
sections.text: Critical StrikeCAd: Bestow feat (Improved Critical; 1st level) + Augment Spell (BAB +6 effects; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Vital Strike; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (vs. flanked or Dex-denied opponent only; -2 levels) + Still Spell (-1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (+1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 1st level; against flat-footed opponents (or those denied Dex bonus), you deal Vital Strike damage, double crit threat range, and are +4 to confirm crits for 1 round (swift casting).

sections.heading: Crown of BrillianceBED
sections.text: Crown of BrillianceBED: Light (0 level) + Positive Spell (+0 levels) + Augment Spell (blinding; +5 levels) + Fell Dazzling (+1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd./level; -2 levels) + Selective Spell (+2 levels) = 6th level; subject gains aura of light; enemies blinded while within and 1 rd. thereafter (Fort dazzled). Variants:

sections.heading: Crown of GloryCD
sections.text: Crown of GloryCD: Eagle’s splendor (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (Compel: watch; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) + Pacific Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Glory domain; -1 level) = 8th level; you gain +4 Cha, and creatures in 120’r. with up to 12 HD are fascinated.

sections.heading: Crown of VerminSRD
sections.text: Crown of VerminSRD: Invisible needle (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Overwhelming Evocation (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 8th level (listed as epic); damage cap 120/rd. to those within 10 feet of you (overcomes DR, and SR does not apply).

sections.heading: Cruel DisappointmentBVD
sections.text: Cruel DisappointmentBVD: Compel (fail at next effort, but believe you succeeded; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (ailing; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; subject saves or fails at next task, but believes it succeeded for 1 rd. Thereafter, it must save again or be ailing for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Cruel JauntHA
sections.text: Cruel JauntHA: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (adjacent to creature affected by [fear] condition; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (sense fearHA, q.v.; +4 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) = 7th level (listed as 6th); you sense fear within 120 ft. for 10 min./level, and can make standard-action teleports to arrive adjacent to affected creatures.

sections.heading: Crunchy SnowFB
sections.text: Crunchy SnowFB: Skill enhancement (Stealth; 0 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to horizontal wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 20-ft. squares; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (snow-covered area only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Resticted Spell (ranger or access to Winter, domain, etc.; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); -1/2 levels to Stealth in large area of snowy ground.

sections.heading: Crusader’s StrikeToB
sections.text: Crusader’s StrikeToB: Spark of life (0 level) + Augment Spell (+1/level; +1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (credible threat; -2 levels) = 1st level; successful [strike] heals you or ally within close range 1d6 +1/level (+5 max.) hp. Variants:

sections.heading: Crushing Despair
sections.text: Crushing Despair: Spook (0 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level for effects; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (frightened to shaken; -1 level) = 3rd level; those in 30-ft. cone are shaken and sickened for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Crushing Fist of SpiteBVD
sections.text: Crushing Fist of SpiteBVD: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to cylinder; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10’r. to 5’r.; -1 level) + Explosive Spell (+1 level) = 8th level (listed as 9th); damage cap 20d6 force in a 5’r., 25-ft.-tall cylinder, and those affected ejected from area. Direct each round as a swift action.

sections.heading: Crushing SphereLEM
sections.text: Crushing SphereLEM: Otiluke’s resilient sphere (q.v.; 4th level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) + Energy Admixture (bludgeoning; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 6th level; damage cap 20d6/rd. (half crushing, half nonlethal).

sections.heading: Crushing WallsTM2
sections.text: Crushing WallsTM2: Energy mace (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cubes; +3 levels) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Delay Spell (activating condition and 1 rd. time delay; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 6th level; area up to one 10-ft. cube/level crushes intruders for up to 7.5d6+90 damage (Reflex half, no SR) 1 rd. after entered.

sections.heading: Cry of YsgardBED
sections.text: Cry of YsgardBED: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (1-3 summoned; +1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 9 bariaur ranger; +5 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Str; -1 level) + Crippling Drain (-1 level) = 7th level; summons 1d3 bariaur defenders of Ysgard, but caster takes 1d4 Str drain.

sections.heading: Crystal Dirk, Nystul’sGA
sections.text: Crystal Dirk, Nystul’sGA: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Cascade Spell [(inertia; +1 levels) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead and lower planar; -1 level) + Positive Spell (+0 levels)] + Concentration Spell (standard action; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 13d6 slashing, divided among melee touch attacks (1.5x and possible dazing vs. undead and lower-planar, others take half).

sections.heading: Crystal Recording (Roger Zelazny, Knight of Shadows)
sections.text: Crystal Recording (Roger Zelazny, Knight of Shadows): Figment (0 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (no olfactory; ­1 level) = 2nd level; creates audiovisual recording lasting up to 1 hr./level in glass or crystal (repeats continually if shorter recording throughout remaining duration, or permanently, if 6,000 numen invested).

sections.heading: Crystal of ReflectionAUG2
sections.text: Crystal of ReflectionAUG2: Dispel (0 level) + Augment Spell (reverse back onto caster instead of dispelling; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (rays only; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (no check needed; +2 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 6th level (listed as 2nd); ranged touch attacks targeting you are reflected back on attacker (up to Medium range). AKA mirror shieldAUG2.

sections.heading: Crystal Rhythms, Otto’sGA
sections.text: Crystal Rhythms, Otto’sGA: Compel (clap hands; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) = 4th level; target claps obsessively for 1 rd./level (but can perform actions not requiring hands).

sections.heading: Crystal ShardAUG2
sections.text: Crystal ShardAUG2: Invisible needle (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 1st level; ranged attack deals 1d6 piercing/level (max. 5d6, no SR).

sections.heading: Crystalline MemoriesCM
sections.text: Crystalline MemoriesCM: Damage attribute (Int; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (invisible needle; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (detection: memories; +2 levels) – Concentration Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6 piercing plus 1d4 Int, and you gain instantaneous reading of subject’s surface thoughts from the last round.

sections.heading: Cup of DustAPG
sections.text: Cup of DustAPG: Warding (hydration; 1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (normal water; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 3rd level; target immediately begins to die of thirst (invest 600 x CL numen to maintain effect).

sections.heading: Cultural AdaptationUI
sections.text: Cultural AdaptationUI: Skill enhancement (Knowledge: linguistics; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Perform (acting); +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (+5 to +10; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (language/culture/locale specified; -2 levels) = 1st level, you gain +1/2 levels to Perform (acting) and Knowledge (linguistics) checks to pass as a native (including accent) of the location or culture specified during casting.

sections.heading: Curse, Hibyrntic’sDr345
sections.text: Curse, Hibyrntic’sDr345: Ray of frost (0 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (staggered; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 cold/rd. (divine 5d6) plus staggered.

sections.heading: Curse of Arrow AttractionPHII
sections.text: Curse of Arrow AttractionPHII: Deflection (0 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Augment Spell (-5 total penalty; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Improved Critical; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (ranged attacks only; -1 level) = 3rd level (2nd for ranger or access to Archery domain); target -5 AC vs. ranged attacks, and attackers +4 to confirm crits (greater crit effects if attacker’s BAB +6/+11/+16).

sections.heading: Curse of ChaosDLM
sections.text: Curse of ChaosDLM: Polymorph (mutant; 3rd level) + Cascade Spell (ray of beguiling; +2 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (+20 to +0 and fewer special abilities; -4 levels) + Restricted Spell ([chaotic] bloodline, patron, etc.; -1 level) = 3rd level; target takes 1d6 penalty to Charisma and is noticeably deformed (possibly gaining a natural attack). Invest 150 x CL numen to maintain indefinitely.

sections.heading: Curse of DisgustUM
sections.text: Curse of DisgustUM: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (close; +1 level) + Delay Spell (proximity to trigger; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (compel; leave proximity; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) = 5th level; subject sickened within close range of location or class of items and compelled to leave. Invest 1,000 x CL numen investiture to make permanent (5th level x 50 x 4 for duration).

sections.heading: Curse of DistractionDr339
sections.text: Curse of DistractionDr339: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Restricted Spell (hexblade; -1 level) = 4th level; victim must succeed at opposed Concentration checks to cast spells.

sections.heading: Curse of Fell SeasonsHA
sections.text: Curse of Fell SeasonsHA: Control weather (q.v.; 7th level) + Extend Spell (conc. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 9th level; as control weather, but invest 450 x CL numen to maintain extreme weather effect in 1 mi-radius area until curse removed.

sections.heading: Curse of Impending BladesMH
sections.text: Curse of Impending BladesMH: Enhancement (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (AC only; -2 levels) + Hex Spell (+0 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) = 2nd level; target takes -1/4 levels penalty to AC.

sections.heading: Curse of Languishing DeathAUG
sections.text: Curse of Languishing DeathAUG: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 8th); deals 1d4 Con damage (Fort half) at range, and invest 150 x CL numen to repeat damage each day.

sections.heading: Curse of LycanthropyCD
sections.text: Curse of LycanthropyCD: Polymorph (animal; 3rd level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (enlarge person; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of idiocy; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Delay Spell (full moon; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (appropriate domain; -1 level) + Time-Specific Spell (only manifests during full moon; -2 levels) = 7th level; subject becomes a lycanthrope of your choice (animal form Tiny to Large). Invest 350 x CL numen to maintain past 1 night.

sections.heading: Curse of LycanthropySC
sections.text: Curse of LycanthropySC: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cascade Spell (summon; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (CR 2 wererats; +1 level) + Augment Spell (1d4+1 summoned; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Pestilence domain; −1 level) = 6th level; touch deals 1d6 negative energy/level (max. 15d6) and 1d4+1 wererats burst forth from victim, remaining for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Curse of Magic NegationUM
sections.text: Curse of Magic NegationUM: Dispel (0 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Variable Spell (affects both incoming spells and victim’s own; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; ­1 level) = 6th level (listed as 4th); victim gains SR 10 + your Concentration bonus, which cannot be lowered, and must defeat its own SR to cast spells or use SLAs.

sections.heading: Curse of NightHA
sections.text: Curse of NightHA: Warding (light; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (gloom; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1 mi.; +6 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Reduce Spell (5 steps to 2 steps; -3 levels) = 8th level; reduces natural ambient light by 2 steps and negates magical light in large area; invest 400 x CL numen to maintain effect until curse removed and sunburst cast on area.

sections.heading: Curse of Petty FailingMH
sections.text: Curse of Petty FailingMH: Spook (0 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Reduce Spell (panicked to shaken; -2 levels) = 3rd level; target takes -2 morale penalty to attacks, saves, and checks (no save) for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Curse of Spilt WaterDr334
sections.text: Curse of Spilt WaterDr334: Transmute (flesh to water; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 27 lbs./level; +2 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 5th level (listed as 6th); ranged touch turns 1 creature within weight limit to water (Fort neg.). Invest 250 x CL numen to maintain effect.

sections.heading: Curse of TerrorRR
sections.text: Curse of TerrorRR: Spook (0 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Delay Spell (until encounter specified object of phobia; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Extend Spell (trigger; inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (panicked to frightened; -1 level) = 4th level; subject frightened 1 rd./level when encountering specified object of phobia (cannot be ubiquitous or necessary). Invest minimum 300 x CL numen to maintain.

sections.heading: Curse of the Chaotic MindAUG
sections.text: Curse of the Chaotic MindAUG: Ray of idiocy (1st level) + Variable Spell (choose Int, Wis, Cha; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 7th level; imposes long-lasting penalty of 1d6 + 1/level to one mental attribute. Invest 350 x CL numen to mauntain curse, with attribute affected staying constant or changing each day as you decide.

sections.heading: Curse of the FatespurnedRW
sections.text: Curse of the FatespurnedRW: Spook (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Lucky Spell (+1 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (halfling or access to Fate domain, etc.; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (frightened to shaken; -1 level) = 2nd level; target shaken for 1 min., and you gain +3 luck bonus to saves.

sections.heading: Curse of the FireflyRR2
sections.text: Curse of the FireflyRR2: Skill enhancement (Stealth; 0 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = 2nd level; target glows 1 min./level and is -1/2 levels (-5 max.) to Stealth.

sections.heading: Curse of the Putrid HuskBVD
sections.text: Curse of the Putrid HuskBVD: Whelm (0 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 nonlethal plus dazed 1 rd.

sections.heading: Curse of Unexpected DeathPF89
sections.text: Curse of Unexpected DeathPF89: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (1/min., instead of 1/rd.; +1 level) + Resistible Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; touch deals up to 10d6 necrotic/min. (Fort half) for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Curse of VengeanceAUG
sections.text: Curse of VengeanceAUG: Spook (0 level) + Cascade Spell [(hand of fate; +1 level) + Delay Spell (when most inconvenient; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level)] + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; subject -2 morale to attacks, saves, and checks for 1 rd./level, and once must reroll one critical roll and keep the worse result. Invest 400 x CL numen (4th level x 50 x 2) to maintain curse indefinitely (reroll 1/day).

sections.heading: Curse of WoundingAUG2
sections.text: Curse of WoundingAUG2: Hand of fate (0 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (attacks against only; -2 levels) = 5th level; target’s attackers roll twice, choose the better result. Invest 250 x CL numen to maintain effect.

sections.heading: Curse of YondallaDHD
sections.text: Curse of YondallaDHD: Modify memory (q.v.; 4th level) + Cascade Spell (polymorph; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (younger version of self; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (reduce; +3 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Outrider or Time domain; -1 level) = 8th level; target loses two size categories and all memories, becomes infant version of self. Invest 400 x CL numen to make effect permanent (subject can still grow up and make new memories).

sections.heading: Curse Water
sections.text: Curse Water: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Bane Spell (fixed: [good] outsiders; +0 levels) + Delay Spell (throw as standard action; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 1st level; flask (ranged touch) deals 1d6 negative energy/level (max. 5d6; 5d8 vs. celestials). Variants:

sections.heading: Cursed EarthUM
sections.text: Cursed EarthUM: Variable Spell (2nd level +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1 mi.; +6 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 9th level; choose from lesser animate dead (corpses in area become uncontrolled zombies at nightfall), blight (plants do not grow), or contagion (each night, all in area save or contract disease). Invest 7,650 numen to make effect permanent until a specified condition is met (9th level x CL 17th x 50 x 1).

sections.heading: Cursed LocaleAUG
sections.text: Cursed LocaleAUG: Blessing (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (-3 total; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to long; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 6th level; -3 to attacks, saves, checks in area, invest numen to maintain curse.

sections.heading: Cushioning BandsUM
sections.text: Cushioning BandsUM: Inure (bludgeoning; 0 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (30 to 15; -1 level) = 2nd level; subject gains DR 2/5 levels vs. bludgeoning damage (max. DR 15/slashing or piercing).

sections.heading: CynosureDr338
sections.text: CynosureDr338: Bestow feat (Variable Spell; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Sudden Metamagic; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (16 ranks effects; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (dimensional skip spells only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); allows person using plane shift or teleport during the next round to arrive on-target without mishap chance, even if would normally be unable to cast 6th or 7th level spells.

sections.heading: C
sections.text:
Call aquatic animals II (3rd level; listed as 4th) summons 1 orca or giant octopus; 1d3 giant crocodiles, giant moray eels, tiger sharks, or hammerhead sharks; 1d4+1 blue sharks or crocodiles; or 2d4+1 bull sharks, dolphins, ebon eels, octopuses, or squid.
Call Lightning Storm: Call lightning (q.v., 2nd level) + Reach Spell (medium to long; +1 level) – Widen Spell (+1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 in 10’r. cylinder up to 50 ft. tall, 1/rd. while you concentrate.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteCall Lightning, GreaterMW: Call lightning storm (q.v.; 4th level) + Empower Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (10d6 to 15d6; +1 level) = 6th level; damage cap 1.5 x 15d6 per bolt.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Call of the SapphireAUG2: As call of the emeraldAUG2 (q.v.), but compulsion is to go home.
Call of the TopazAUG2: As call of the emeraldAUG2 (q.v.), but compulsion is to stand still (as if paralyzed) for 1 round.
Resistance (0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +3; +1 level) = +3 to next saving throw;Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteSkill enhancement (0 level) = +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to next skill check;Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteAttribute boost (0 level) + Augment Spell (+2 to +4; +1 level) = +2 to next attribute check;Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteBlessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +3; +1 level) = +3 to attack roll and damage.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Abundant AmmunitionUC: Creation (copy of existing mundane ammo; 1st level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Widen Spell (1/8; -1 level) + Delay Spell (activates once per round; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (magic weapon, etc.: retains multiple-projectile spell effects on original, but not single-projectile ones; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) = 1st level; refills ammunition container (max. ⅛ cu. ft./level; assume 1 piece of ammo per level for the sake of simplicity) once per round. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteDevlin’s barbAUG2 conjures a piece of mundane ammunition (no enhancement bonus; -1 level) of only 1/8 lb./level (-1 level), and is not Ritual (+1 level) = 0 level.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteEverfull quiverDHD is as abundant ammunitionUC (see above), but with Cascade Spell (versatile weaponAPG, q.v.; +2 levels), allowing duplicaton of special metals arrowheads = 3rd level. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteBoltSRD produces up to 1 lb./level of +1 ammunition. Casting is a standard action (+1 level), but the ammunition is destroyed when used (Tenuous Spell; -1 level) = 1st level. sections.text: Dancing WebBED: Whelm (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 nonlethal in 20’r. plus entangled 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Dancing Whip, Laeral’s7S
sections.text: Dancing Whip, Laeral’s7S: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 1d6; -2 levels) = 1st level; two close ranged touch attacks/rd. (­2 to attack roll) against target for 1d6 piercing each.

sections.heading: Daredevil AthleteCSc
sections.text: Daredevil AthleteCSc: Skill enhancement (0 level) + Variable Spell (Acrobatics, Athletics, Escape Artist, or Handle Animal; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) = 1st level; immediate action grants you +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to one skill check.

sections.heading: Dark MirrorDr181
sections.text: Dark MirrorDr181: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (redirect; +1 level) + Fell Dispelling (dispelled, rather than redirected, if check fails; +1 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (darkness spells only; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 2nd); darkness spells cast into area are reflected back on caster or negated.

sections.heading: Dark WaySC
sections.text: Dark WaySC: Mage armor (1st level) + Augment Spell (cover, for semi-solid bridge; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to wall; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 rd./level; -3 levels) = 1st level (2nd for divine casters); bridge of force 5 ft. wide and 20 ft./level long lasts 1 rd./level. Variants:

sections.heading: Dark WhispersUI
sections.text: Dark WhispersUI: Figment (0 level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (no olfactory, tactile, or visual elements; -2 levels) = 2nd level; voice seems to whisper to subject from its shadow, and you can hear its replies at Long range.

sections.heading: DarkboltBVD
sections.text: DarkboltBVD: Ray of frost (0 level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6 (half cold, half unholy) plus staggered 1 round.

sections.heading: Darkbolt, GreaterSC
sections.text: Darkbolt, GreaterSC: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Darkness domain, etc.; -1 level) = 5th level; damage cap 20d6 (half negative energy, half unholy), divided among up to 1 bolt/2 levels, plus each target save or dazed 1 rd.

sections.heading: DarkfireDHD
sections.text: DarkfireDHD: Produce flame (q.v.; 1st level) – Reduce Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 10d6.

sections.heading: Darkness, Assassin’sCSc
sections.text: Darkness, Assassin’sCSc: Gloom (0 level) + Shape Spell (spread to emanation; +0 levels) + Selective Spell (you are unaffected; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 step; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (rogue skill trick; -1 level) = 4th level; lowers light by 4 steps (max. supernatural darkness) in mobile 40’r. around you, and you can see normally.

sections.heading: Darkness, CreepingCA
sections.text: Darkness, CreepingCA: Gloom (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (silence; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (wu jen; -1 level) = 5th level; silence 20’r., and ambient light reduced by 3 steps.

sections.heading: Darkness, Nystul’s EnvelopingGA
sections.text: Darkness, Nystul’s EnvelopingGA: Displacement (3rd level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (gloom; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Augment Spell (2 steps to 4 steps; +1 level) = 5th level; reduces ambient light by 4 steps, and you gain displacement vs. creatures who can see in darkness.

sections.heading: Darkness, Pall of TwilightCM
sections.text: Darkness, Pall of TwilightCM: Gloom (0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Perception; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; lowers light by 2 steps, and -1/2 levels (-10 max.) penalty to Perception in area.

sections.heading: Darkness, Shroud ofPC
sections.text: Darkness, Shroud ofPC: Gloom (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (emanation to target; -2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (1 step to 3 steps; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); one creature/3 levels treats light as 3 steps lower than actual for 1 rd./level (Will neg.).

sections.heading: Darkness, UtterdarkBVD
sections.text: Darkness, UtterdarkBVD: Gloom (0 level) + Selective Spell (evil creatures ignore; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1,000’r..; +5 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Reduce Spell (5 steps to 4 steps; -1 level) = 8th level; ambient light lowered by 4 steps in a 1,000-foot radius (evil creatures can see normally).

sections.heading: Darkness, Veil ofAUG
sections.text: Darkness, Veil ofAUG: Gloom (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (2 steps to 4 steps; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); lowers light in 10’r. by 4 steps (max. supernatural darkness) for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: DarksoulRR2
sections.text: DarksoulRR2: Energy mace (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) +

sections.heading: Darkvision, GreaterUM
sections.text: Darkvision, GreaterUM: Darkvision (q.v.; 2nd level) + Widen Spell (60’r. to 120’r.; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 4th). Superior darkvisionUnE is Widened to 1 mile (6th level; listed as 4th).

sections.heading: Darts of LifeCC
sections.text: Darts of LifeCC: Spark of life (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Delay Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 10d6; -2 levels) = 5th level; 15d6 hp healing, divided among close-range rays fired by you as immediate actions.

sections.heading: Daunting StrikeToB
sections.text: Daunting StrikeToB: Spook (0 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Fell Frightening (+1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 5th); [strike] causes target to be unnerved (Will shaken) for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Daybreak ArrowUC
sections.text: Daybreak ArrowUC: Light (0 level) + Positive Spell (+0 levels) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 missile/level; +3 levels) = 4th level; missiles shed light and deal +50% damage to molds, fungi, oozes, and undead, half to others.

sections.heading: Daze AnimalMW
sections.text: Daze AnimalMW: Compel (do nothing; 2nd level) + Cross-Class Spell (druid; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (animal; -2 levels) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) = 0 level; dazes 1 animal of up to 4 HD for 1 rd.

sections.heading: Daze Person, MassUM
sections.text: Daze Person, MassUM: Compel (do nothing; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoids; -2 levels) = 4th level (no HD limit).

sections.heading: Dazing TouchCRB
sections.text: Dazing TouchCRB: Compel (do nothing; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Charm domain; -1 level) = 0 level.

sections.heading: DazzlesphereAUG
sections.text: DazzlesphereAUG: Inertia (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); those in 10’r. with 7 HD or less are dazed 1 rd./level (Fort save each round to end).

sections.heading: Dead EndDr325
sections.text: Dead EndDr325: Skill enhancement (0 level) + Variable Spell (skill appropriate to tracking; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Cascade Spell [(glamer; 1st level) + Augment Spell (hide; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (traces of passage only; -2 levels)] + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); subject cannot perceive signs of your passage unless disbelieves, and even if so, takes -1/2 levels penalty to track you.

sections.heading: Dead Man’s EyesCWH
sections.text: Dead Man’s EyesCWH: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+5d4; +4 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level; each round, you deal 6d4 Con damage (Fort half) with a ranged touch attack.

sections.heading: Deadeye’s LoreUC
sections.text: Deadeye’s LoreUC: Skill enhancement (Survival; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (­1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level (ranger 1st); you gain +1/2 levels sacred bonus to Survival, and +20 ft. speed while tracking or hiding your trail.

sections.heading: Deadly JuggernautUC
sections.text: Deadly JuggernautUC: Blessing (0 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Str; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+5 total; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (inure: slashing; +1 level) + Energy Admixture (bludgeoning and piercing; +0 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Expedient Spell (bonus equal to number of credible threats defeated; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); on dropping a credible threat in combat, you gain +1 to attacks, damage, and Str, and DR 2/adamantine, for 1 min./level (cumulative, up to +5 and DR 10/adamantine).

sections.heading: Deadly Strike, Tenser’sGA
sections.text: Deadly Strike, Tenser’sGA: Bestow feat (Perfect Strike; 1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +11 effects; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; your first weapon attack each round (excluding all spells) deals maximum damage, for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Deadly SunstrokeCM
sections.text: Deadly SunstrokeCM: Jet of flame (0 level) + Bane Spell (undead and plants; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (touch of fatigue; +1 level) + Augment Spell (exhaust; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to long; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) = 9th level; damage cap 25d6 fire (25d8 vs. undead or plant) plus exhaustion (Fort half/neg.) in 1 creature/level.

sections.heading: Deafening ClangMF
sections.text: Deafening ClangMF: Alter senses (0 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Restrict Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 1st level; hit by weapon deafens those in 10’r. for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Death ArmorMF
sections.text: Death ArmorMF: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Shielding Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (+10 to +5; -1 level) = 2nd level; melee attackers take 1d6 + 1/level (max. +5) negative energy. Variants:

sections.heading: Death by ThornsBVD
sections.text: Death by ThornsBVD: Invisible needle (0 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) + Fell Staggering (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute; -1 level) + Crippling Drain (-1 level) = 7th level; damage cap 20d6 piercing/rd. plus stunned for 1 rd./level (Fort half/flat-footed), vs. up to one target/3 levels. Caster takes 1d4 Wis drain.

sections.heading: Death FieldPnA
sections.text: Death FieldPnA: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Shielding Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (swarms; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (+10 to +0; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (warding: Plant domain spells; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Favored Terrain (forest); +1 level) + Cascade Spell (warding: healing; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 1st level; swift casting: for the next round, swarms entering your space take 1d6 negative energy damage, you are immune to Plant domain spells and have the woodland stride ability, and you are immune to magical healing.

sections.heading: Death from BelowARG
sections.text: Death from BelowARG: Bestow feat (Dodge; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (enhancement; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (dodge bonus only; -2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (vs. attacks by larger creatures only; -1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +1/3 levels; +2 levels) = 3rd level (gnome caster 2nd); subject gains dodge bonus of +1, +1/3 levels, vs. attacks by larger creatures.

sections.heading: Death GrimaceBVD
sections.text: Death GrimaceBVD: Shaping (2nd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (corpse of creature slain by you; -1 level) = 1st level; you deform murder victim in some way (distinctive expression, word carved in flesh, etc.; Heal check for fineness of detail).

sections.heading: Death HailFB
sections.text: Death HailFB: Damage attribute (1st; Constitution) + Versatile Spell (split damage between Str and Con; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Winter domain, etc.; -1 level) = 6th level; 1d2 Str and 1d2 Con/rd. within 40’r. area.

sections.heading: Death Knell
sections.text: Death Knell: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (dying creature; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Str; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) = 2nd level; deals 1d6 negative energy/2 levels (max. 5d6) to dying creature within close range (Fort half); if it dies, you gain +2 Str, +1d6 per HD (max. +5d6) temp. hp for 10 min./HD of creature. Variants:

sections.heading: Death PactCD
sections.text: Death PactCD: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to planar; +5 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (transports to designated sanctum only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (raise dead; +5 levels) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 8th level; if killed, target is teleported to your sanctum, raise dead activates, and is healed 1d6 hp/level (max. 20d6). Note the 400 x CL numen investiture cost.

sections.heading: Death Screen, Otiluke’sGA
sections.text: Death Screen, Otiluke’sGA: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 5-ft. squares; -1 level) = 7th level; 15d6 negative energy plus 5d6/rd. and dazed 1 rd./level (save each round to end effect).

sections.heading: Death TouchSRD
sections.text: Death TouchSRD: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Augment Spell (5d6 to 20d6; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Tenuous Spell (no damage if total is less than current hp; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Death domain; -1 level) = 1st level; touch deals 1d6 necrotic/level (max. 20d6), but only if the total exceeds the target’s current hp.

sections.heading: Death WardCRB
sections.text: Death WardCRB: Warding ([death]; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (inure: negative energy; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) = 4th level; subject is immune to [death] effects (Chapter 7) and gains resistance 5/2 levels (max. 30) to negative energy. Variants:

sections.heading: Death’s CallCM
sections.text: Death’s CallCM: Sound lance (1st level) + Bane Spell (swarms; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (touch of fatigue; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level (bard 1st); damage cap 5d6 sonic (5d8 vs. swarms) plus fatigue in 10’r. burst around you.

sections.heading: Death’s KissAPG
sections.text: Death’s KissAPG: Polymorph (undead; 3rd level) + negative energy affinity (ad hoc +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Death domain, etc.; -1 level) = 2nd level; target gains negative energy affinity for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: DeathsightCM
sections.text: DeathsightCM: Bestow feat (Killing Stroke; 1st level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +21 effects; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (rogue skill trick; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); you can perform a coup de grâce as a standard action against a cowering, dazed, flat-footed, grappled, staggered, or stunned target.

sections.heading: Debilitating PortentUC
sections.text: Debilitating PortentUC: Spark of life (1st level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 6th level; each of victim’s attacks and/or damaging spells deals less damage (1d6 hp + ½ levels, max. +15, each; Intuition neg.). You can maintain the curse until the victim confirms a crit, by expenditure of numen (e.g., 6th level x CL 11th x 50 x 1 = 3,300).

sections.heading: DecapitateHA
sections.text: DecapitateHA: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Improved Critical; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +16 effects; +3 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (hit by crit; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 15d6; -1 level) = 6th level; immediate casting auto-confirms crit threat within close range, increases crit multiplier by +1, and deals +1d6 slashing/level (max. +15d6).

sections.heading: DecastaveUnE
sections.text: DecastaveUnE: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Energy Admixture (sonic; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 2nd level; each round, make one melee touch attack for up to 5d6 (1d6 sonic, and the remainder force) plus deafens 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Deceitful VeneerUI
sections.text: Deceitful VeneerUI: Skill enhancement (Bluff; 0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (glamer; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (suppress and resume as a standard action; +1 level) = 5th level; subject always seems to be lying (Bluff check, opposed to subject’s passive Bluff score +1/2 levels, to discern otherwise), unless you suppress the effect. Lie detection spells fooled by glamer unless it is disbelieved. Cf. false lieCM.

sections.heading: DecelerationSRD
sections.text: DecelerationSRD: Celerity (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) = 1st level; target’s land speed reduced by 10 ft. (Fort neg.) for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Deceptive FacadeCM
sections.text: Deceptive FacadeCM: Glamer (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (visual only; -1 level) = 2nd level; disguise self/other/object.

sections.heading: DecerebrateSRD
sections.text: DecerebrateSRD: Damage attribute (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (teleportation; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +2 levels) + Crippling Drain (+2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (Int and Wis; +1 level) = 8th level (listed as 7th); 4d4 Int and Wis drain at medium range.

sections.heading: Declaration of DeathRR
sections.text: Declaration of DeathRR: Phantasmal killer (q.v.; 4th level) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) = 5th level (listed as 6th); as phantasmal killer, but initial damage is up to 15d6 nonlethal, rather than 3d6.

sections.heading: DecollateHA
sections.text: DecollateHA: Polymorph (monstrous humanoid; 3rd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Tenuous Spell (target dies if head destroyed; -1 level) = 5th level; target’s head detaches; he/she gains DR 5/−, blindsense 30 ft., immunity to decapitation.

sections.heading: DecomposeRR2
sections.text: DecomposeRR2: Variable Spell (ray of entropy or spark of life; 1st level + 1 level) + Augment Spell (5d6 to 10d6; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Death or Destruction domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 10d6 disintegration to corpse, or 10d6 positive energy to undead touched.

sections.heading: Decompose CorpseUM
sections.text: Decompose CorpseUM: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) = 1st level; touch deals 1d6/level to dead flesh (only), turning a corpse (or zombie) into a skeleton.

sections.heading: DecompositionCD
sections.text: DecompositionCD: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (injured creatures only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Death or Destruction domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 1d6; -2 levels) = 3rd level; injured creatures within 40’ of you take 1d6 negative energy/round ongoing damage.

sections.heading: Decoy ImageMF
sections.text: Decoy ImageMF: Figment (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Shape Spell (cubes to spread; +0 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) = 4th level; mimics you and allies within 40 ft.; audio, visual, olfactory, and tactile/thermal components.

sections.heading: Decrepit DisguiseOcA
sections.text: Decrepit DisguiseOcA: Glamer (1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (-2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. = 80 cu. ft./level to 10 cu. ft./level; -2 levels) = 1st level; object within volume limit appears as a worthless version of itself. AKA dust and dirtBRL.

sections.heading: DeeppocketsUA1
sections.text: DeeppocketsUA1: Dimensional pocket (1st level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 216 lbs./level; +4 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (extradimensional spaces must be in existing pockets of focus garment; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Defenestrating SphereCA
sections.text: Defenestrating SphereCA: Topple (0 level) + Cascade Spell (energy mace; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 bludgeoning and knock prone with medium ranged touch attack.

sections.heading: Defense against Lycanthropes, Mordenkainen’sGA
sections.text: Defense against Lycanthropes, Mordenkainen’sGA: Warding (curses; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Creature/Effect Specific Spell (lycanthropes and shapeshifters only; -2 levels) = 2nd level; subject gains +2 deflection vs. [shapeshifters] and is immune to lycanthrope for 1 hour/level.

sections.heading: Defense against Reptiles and Amphibians, Mordenkainen’sGA
sections.text: Defense against Reptiles and Amphibians, Mordenkainen’sGA: Resistance (0 level) + Augment Spell (+4 total; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell ([reptilian] or [amphibian] only; -1 level) = 2nd level; for 1 min./level, subject gains +2 deflection and +4 on saves against creatures with one of the appropriate descriptors (include dinosaurs, since Gygax described them as reptiles in AD&D).

sections.heading: Defile Snow and IceFB
sections.text: Defile Snow and IceFB: Warding (fire; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (also positive energy; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (snow-covered or icy ground; ­2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead and [cold] creatures; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Evil or Winter domain, etc.; -1 level) = 3rd level; undead and [cold] creatures in 20’r. are immune to fire and positive energy for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Deflect BlameUI
sections.text: Deflect BlameUI: Glamer (1st level) + Quicken Spell (+4 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); immediate casting makes it seemt to subject that it was attacked by someone other than you, or that someone else just failed your botched Bluff or Diplomacy check, etc.

sections.heading: Defuse TensionPC
sections.text: Defuse TensionPC: Remove condition (fear; 1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (also fatigue; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 2nd level; removed shaken and fatigued conditions.

sections.heading: DehydrateSC
sections.text: DehydrateSC: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+1d4; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Bane Spell (plants & [water]; +0 levels) = 3rd level; 2d4 Con (2d6 vs. plants & water creatures).

sections.heading: Déjà VuSRD
sections.text: Déjà VuSRD: Compel (repeat last action; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoid only; -2 levels) = 1st level. Variants:

sections.heading: Delay DeathRD
sections.text: Delay DeathRD: Warding (death due to hp loss; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Endurance; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 3rd level; subject cannot die from hp loss for 1 rd./level (is still dying at -1, however, but gains +1/2 levels to Endurance checks). Variants:

sections.heading: Delay DiseaseARG
sections.text: Delay DiseaseARG: Warding (afflictions; 1st level) + Irresistible Spell (affects nonmagical afflictions; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (disease only; -2 levels)  + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Resistible Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level; target cannot catch new diseases, and existing ones suspended (Concentration check vs. disease DC needed), for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Delay PainUM
