sections.text: Delay PainUM: Warding (pain; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); suppresses magical pain effects.

sections.heading: Delay Poison
sections.text: Delay Poison: Warding (attribute damage; 1st level) + Irresistible Spell (+3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (poison only; -2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (suppresses, but does not grant immunity to exposure; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: DemoralizeSRD
sections.text: DemoralizeSRD: Spook (0 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to personal; −1 level) + Augment Spell (frightened to shaken; −1 level) = 2nd level; demoralizes those in 20’r. of you (this is a “pulse,” not an aura).

sections.heading: DenounceAPG
sections.text: DenounceAPG: Ray of beguiling (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; subject takes penalty to Cha equal to 1d6 + 1/level (+15 max.).

sections.heading: DepressionDr349
sections.text: DepressionDr349: Ray of beguiling (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (touch of fatigue (0 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) = 3rd level; those within 20 ft. of you are fatigued and take a 1d6+1/2 levels penalty to Charisma.

sections.heading: Desecrate
sections.text: Desecrate: Blessing (0 level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Thanatopic Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 hr./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell ([evil] caster; -1 level) = 2nd level; undead in 20’r. area gain 5d6 temp. hp and +1 profane bonus to attacks, damage, saves vs. positive energy.

sections.heading: Desert TempestToB
sections.text: Desert TempestToB: Bestow feat (Dodge; 1st level) + Augment Spell (BAB +6; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (use as prerequisite only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Skirmish; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (­1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 6th); swift casting allows you to move your speed and still make iterative attacks that round.

sections.heading: DesiccateSSt
sections.text: DesiccateSSt: Touch of fatigue (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Bane Spell (plant or water elemental: fixed; +0 levels) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6 desiccation (10d6 arcane), or 5d8 (10d8 arcane) vs. plant or water elemental), plus fatigued (Fort half/neg.). Variants:

sections.heading: Desperate WeaponUI
sections.text: Desperate WeaponUI: Bestow feat (Power over Shadow; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Planar Sense; +1 level) + Augment Spell (6 ranks effects; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (common object only; -2 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (improvised weapon; -2 levels) = 0 level (listed as 1st); swift casting allows you to find an improvised weapon appropriate to your surroundings within easy reach (DC 20 Planar Sense check at +1/2 levels needed).

sections.heading: Destined BlowRRE
sections.text: Destined BlowRRE: Blessing (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+3 total; +1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 hr./level; +1 level) = 4th level; attacks, damage vs. target are at +3 by a specific weapon or creature, or in a specific place (Shape Spell).

sections.heading: Destiny DissonanceSRD
sections.text: Destiny DissonanceSRD: Sickening touch (0 level) + Cross-Class Spell (clairsentience/divination; +1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Destructive AuraCRB
sections.text: Destructive AuraCRB: Bestow feat (Improved Critical; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +11 effects; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (crit confrm only; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+4 bonus; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (damage only; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Destruction domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; swift casting grants those in 20’r. +4 profane bonus to damage and automatically confirmed crits for 1 round.

sections.heading: Destructive Resonance, Tenser’sS&M
sections.text: Destructive Resonance, Tenser’sS&M: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Variable Spell:

sections.heading: Destructive SmiteCRB
sections.text: Destructive SmiteCRB: Enhancement (2nd level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (damage; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 to +1/2 levels; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Destruction domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; swift casting grants you +1/2 levels profane bonus to damage for 1 rd.

sections.heading: Detect CharmPH1
sections.text: Detect CharmPH1: Detection (Cha penalty or damage; 2nd level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 1st level; 1st round—presence; 2nd—number; 3rd—type of effect (charm, domination, etc.).

sections.heading: Detect CreatureAUG
sections.text: Detect CreatureAUG: Detection (creature; 2nd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (single creature type; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (select creature type at time of casting; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (ends if encounters overwhelming aura, and you are stunned 1 round if HD = 2x yours; -1 level) = 0 level; can detect type only, not specific creatures.

sections.heading: Detect DiseaseAUG, OA
sections.text: Detect DiseaseAUG, OA: Detection (disease; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (concentration to inst.; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (additional information requires Heal check; ad hoc -1 level) = 0 level.

sections.heading: Detect Favored EnemyMW
sections.text: Detect Favored EnemyMW: Detection (creatures; 2nd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (favored enemies or quarry; -2 levels) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to extreme; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger; -2 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); 1st round—presence or absence, 2nd—type(s) and numbers, 3rd—locations and HD.

sections.heading: Detect FireFB
sections.text: Detect FireFB: Detection (creatures, effects, and items with [fire] subtype/descriptor, or on fire; 2nd level) + Tenuous Spell (ends if encounters verwhelming aura, and you are stunned 1 rd. if HD/CL = 2x yours; -1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Detect Hostile IntentSRD
sections.text: Detect Hostile IntentSRD: Detection (aggression; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (cone to emanation; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Extend Spell (conc. to 10 min./level; +3 levels) = 5th level (listed as 2nd); you are instantly aware of aggression/hostile intent in 20’r. of you.

sections.heading: Detect IllusionPH1
sections.text: Detect IllusionPH1: Detection (illusions; 2nd level) + Restricted Spell (illusionist; -1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Detect LifeUA1
sections.text: Detect LifeUA1: Detection (life; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; ­1 level) = 2nd level; 1st round—presence/absence; 2nd round—number; 3rd round—locations and if comatose, incapacitated, dying, etc.

sections.heading: Detect Metal and MineralsRF
sections.text: Detect Metal and MineralsRF: Detection (specified metal/mineral; 2nd level) + Variable Spell (change specified material with concentration; +1 level) = 3rd level; 1st round—presence or absence; 2nd—mass; 3rd—distance and direction.

sections.heading: Detect PhaseS&M
sections.text: Detect PhaseS&M: Detection (incorporeal; 2nd level) + Transdimensional Spell (-1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Detect PsionicsSRD
sections.text: Detect PsionicsSRD: Detection (magical or psionic power manifestation; 2nd level) + Tenuous Spell (ends if encounters overwhelming aura, and you are dazed 1 round; -1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Detect Scrying
sections.text: Detect Scrying: Detection (scrying sensors; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (cone to emanation; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Extend Spell (Concentration to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (very contingent usage; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; ­1 level) = 4th level; no concentration needed to maintain effect. Additional information (if you do concentrate) is visual image, direction, and distance of scryer (requires opposed Concentration check).

sections.heading: Detect Secret Passages and PortalsS&M
sections.text: Detect Secret Passages and PortalsS&M: Detection (secret doors/passages; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (cone to cubes; +1 level) – Concentration Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level (rogue skill trick 1st).

sections.heading: Detect ShipSW
sections.text: Detect ShipSW:  Detection (objects; 2nd level) + Object-Specific Spell (ships only; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to line of sight; +4 levels) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); 1st round—presence/absence; 2nd round—number and locations; 3rd round—type, allegiance, etc.

sections.heading: Detect TeleportationSRD
sections.text: Detect TeleportationSRD: Detection (teleportation; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (cone to emanation; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (nomad; -1 level) = 2nd level; you sense use, can determine direction with concentration.

sections.heading: Detect the FaithfulUI
sections.text: Detect the FaithfulUI: Detection (worshippers; 2nd level) + Restricted Spell (worshippers of your deity only; -1 level) = 1st level. 1st round—presence or absence; 2nd—numbers; 3rd—locations.

sections.heading: DetonateAPG
sections.text: DetonateAPG: Ray of frost (0) + Variable Spell (acid, cold, electricity, or fire, chosen at time of effect; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Empower Spell (+1 level) = 4th level; 1.5 x 1d6/level (max. 15d6 at 10th level) in 40’r. burst centered on you.

sections.heading: DetonatePHII
sections.text: DetonatePHII: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +2 levels) + Crippling Drain (+3 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Cascade Spell [jet of flame (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (-1 level) = +2 levels] = 9th level; 3d4 Con drain to target and up to 20d6 fire damage in a 20’r. centered on the target.

sections.heading: Devastation, MassAUG
sections.text: Devastation, MassAUG: Energy mace (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to bloodline, domain, etc. with appropriate elemental descriptor; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Devilbane RefrainAG
sections.text: Devilbane RefrainAG: Versatile weaponAPG (q.v.; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (bladebaneUnE; +4 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 4th level; weapon penetrates DR/silver and deals up to +10d6 damage vs. [evil], divided among attacks, each with +5 to attack and damage.

sections.heading: Devil’s EgoBVD
sections.text: Devil’s EgoBVD: Warding (creature-specific effects; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Cha; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 Cha; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; you gain +4 enhancement to Cha and immunity to magic targeting non-outsiders (assuming you are some other type).

sections.heading: Devil’s GateAUG2
sections.text: Devil’s GateAUG2: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 7 max. devil; +5 levels) + Variable Spell (no control over type; -1 level) + Extend Spell (onset: inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 7th level, each round for 1 rd./level, a random lesser devil (bearded devil, kyton, or erinyes) is summoned.

sections.heading: Devil’s TailBVD
sections.text: Devil’s TailBVD: Invisible needle (0 level) + Concen-tration Spell (swift action; +4 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to [lawful, evil] domain, mystery, or bloodline; -1 level) = 1st level; you grow a tail that makes melee attacks (1/round as a swift action) for 1d6/level (max. 5d6).

sections.heading: Devil’s TongueBVD
sections.text: Devil’s TongueBVD: Bind (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Wis; -1 level) = 3rd level; your tongue can grapple at Close range as a standard action. AKA tongue tendrilsBVD. Variant:

sections.heading: Dextrous Digits, Bigby’sGA
sections.text: Dextrous Digits, Bigby’sGA: Mage hand (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 8 lbs./level; +1 level) + Variable Spell (manipulate multiple objects; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Dex; capable of fine manipulation; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level; you can manipulate objects (up to weight limit shown) and even use manual skills at Medium range.

sections.heading: DictateS&M
sections.text: DictateS&M: Compel (2nd level) + Variable Spell (choose command at time of casting; +1 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Charm or Law domain; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); as command, but longer-lasting and affects all in area.

sections.heading: DictationS&M
sections.text: DictationS&M: Summon (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (trabscription only; -2 levels) = 1st level; invisible scribe (treat as Expert 2 with max. ranks and Skill Focus in Knowledge (linguistics)) provides transcription of everything said in vicinity for the next 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Dictum
sections.text: Dictum: Alter senses (deafened; 0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: DigPH1
sections.text: DigPH1: Shaping (2nd level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (earth only; -2 levels) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 27 cu. ft./level; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 4th level; moves one 5-ft. cube/level of earth per round while you concentrate. Variants:

sections.heading: DilationTM2
sections.text: DilationTM2: Bestow feat (Widen Spell; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Sudden Metamagic; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) = 2nd level; area-effect spells you cast for the next round are Widened, as if by the Sudden Metamagic (Widen Spell) feat (limits to total spell level, etc. apply).

sections.heading: Dimension HopPHII
sections.text: Dimension HopPHII: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level spell; you transport subject to location within Close range.

sections.heading: Dimension ShufflePHII
sections.text: Dimension ShufflePHII: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (target: touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) = 5th level; you teleport up to 1 creature/level to new locations within Close range (Will neg.). Tactical teleportationCM affects only 1 creature/3 levels (-1 level) = 4th level.

sections.heading: Dimension SlideSRD
sections.text: Dimension SlideSRD: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); you transport yourself anywhere within Close range with line of sight as a partial action. AKA shadow jaunt, shadow strideToB. Variants:

sections.heading: Dimension StepPHII
sections.text: Dimension StepPHII: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (target: touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/3 levels; +2 levels) + Variable Spell (recipients choose destinations; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (willing; -2 levels) = 3rd level; 1 ally/3 levels teleports to location it chooses within Close range. ShuffleShS allows one such teleportation/rd. as a partial action (Concentration spell; +2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 6th).

sections.heading: Dimension SwapSRD
sections.text: Dimension SwapSRD: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (target: touch to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (dimensional skip one additional close target; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (switch places only; -2 levels) = 2nd level; two targets save or swap places. AKA baleful transpositionMH. Benign transpositionMH is also Creature-Specific (willing targets; -1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Dimensional BladeS&M
sections.text: Dimensional BladeS&M: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (magic weapon; +1 level) + Overwhelming Evocation (+1 level) + Transdimensional Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 6th level; damage cap 26d6 slashing, divided among interative touch attacks that ignore hardness and DR, and deal full damage to incorporeal targets, with +1 enhancement/3 levels.

sections.heading: Dimensional BounceACG
sections.text: Dimensional BounceACG: Dimensional skip (1st level) Personal Spell (-1 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (two fixed locations; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (select locations at time of casting; +1 level) + Delay Spell (up to 1 rd./level; +1 level) = 4th level (listed as 7th); you make multiple swift-action jumps to/from specified locations within Close range. Variants:

sections.heading: Dimensional FoldingTM2
sections.text: Dimensional FoldingTM2: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to planar; +6 levels) + Variable Spell (bi-directional; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (5.6’r./level to 1.4’r./level; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd.; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Travel or Void domain; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as 4th); you open a small 2-directional gate to another location on the same plane.

sections.heading: Dire ProphecyUM
sections.text: Dire ProphecyUM: Ray of enfeeblement (1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 attribute/3 levels; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 7th level; subject takes 1d6 + 1/level penalty to all attributes. Invest 350 x CL numen to maintain effect beyond 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Dire WinterSRD
sections.text: Dire WinterSRD: Zephyr (0 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of frost; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1,000’r.; +5 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to [cold] or [weather] bloodline, domain, etc.; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 15d6 and tornado to windstorm; -2 levels) = 8th level (listed as epic); 15d6 cold/rd. and windstorm winds in 1,000’r. emanation around subject, lasting 1 hr./level

sections.heading: Directed CharmAUG
sections.text: Directed CharmAUG: Skill enhancement (Diplomacy; 0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 skill/3 levels; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (vs. creatures of same type as you only; -2 levels) = 1st level; subject +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Diplomacy vs. creaures of your type (also Bluff at CL 6th, one additional Cha-based skill/3 levels thereafter).

sections.heading: DirgeMF
sections.text: DirgeMF: Damage attribute (Str; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Dex; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 levels) + Shape Spell (emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (Intuition neg.; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 6th level; 1d4 Str and 1d4 Dex/rd. to enemies within 40’r. of you (Fort half).

sections.heading: Dirge of WoeRR
sections.text: Dirge of WoeRR: Compel (lament; 2nd level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 3rd level; those in 20’r. take no action while you concentrate, unless attacked.

sections.heading: DisableSRD
sections.text: DisableSRD: Compel (act as if disabled; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (cone; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (30 ft. to 15 ft.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; those with 5 HD or less in 15-ft. cone disbelieve or are disabled 1 rd./level or until save.

sections.heading: Disable ConstructACG
sections.text: Disable ConstructACG: Damage attribute (Str; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (constructs only; -2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; touch deals 3d4 Str damage to construct (save for half; helpless at 0); a new save applies each round to halve remaining damage.

sections.heading: DiscordRR2
sections.text: DiscordRR2: Skill enhancement (Perform; 0 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 0 level; subject takes -1 penalty to Perform checks. Variant:

sections.heading: Discordant BlastAPG
sections.text: Discordant BlastAPG: Sound lance (1st level) + Cascade Spell (pushPH1: q.v.; +1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (+1 level; 30-ft. cone or 10’r. burst; +1 level) = 4th level (bard 3rd); damage cap 10d6 sonic and bull rush away from caster.

sections.heading: Discordant MaledictionCM
sections.text: Discordant MaledictionCM: Sound lance (1st level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 5d6; -3 levels) = 6th level (bard 5th); for the next 1 hr./level, every time the subject casts a spell with a verbal component, it triggers a 10’r. burst for 5d6 sonic (this damage forces a Concentration check for the caster to avoid losing the spell).

sections.heading: Discovery TorchUC
sections.text: Discovery TorchUC: Light (0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Knowledge; +1 level) + Variable Spell (different Knowledge checks; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level; sheds normal light in 20’r. and provides +1/level (max. +10) bonus to Knowledge checks.

sections.heading: Disdain MagicDr328
sections.text: Disdain MagicDr328: Hand of fate (0 level) + Quicken Spell (+4 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (save vs. magic; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; as an immediate action, reroll one save against a spell, spell-like ability, or supernatural ability.

sections.heading: Disdain the DivineBEM2
sections.text: Disdain the DivineBEM2: Resistance (0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +5; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (divine magic only; -2 levels) = 0 level (listed as 1st); subject +5 to saves vs. divine magic (cleric spells, channeled energy, etc.).

sections.heading: Disfiguring TouchUM
sections.text: Disfiguring TouchUM: Variable Spell (attribute boost, blessing, celerity, or resistance; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level. Imposes ­2 penalty to one attribute, -1 to attacks and damage, ­10 ft. to land speed, or -1 to saves; curse manifests as deformation appropriate to penalty, and can be made permanent by investing 200 x CL numen.

sections.heading: Disguise, GhostlyUM
sections.text: Disguise, GhostlyUM: Glamer (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (appear as self, except translucent and oddly-colored; -2 levels) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Disguise OtherUM
sections.text: Disguise OtherUM: Glamer (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (your same type only; -2 levels)  = 2nd level; visual and auditory.

sections.heading: Disguise Self, AdjustableACG
sections.text: Disguise Self, AdjustableACG: Disguise self (1st level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level (inquisitor 3rd, as a Cross-Class Spell).

sections.heading: Disguise ShipSW
sections.text: Disguise ShipSW: Glamer (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 4th level; long-lasting illusion disguises ship type, armaments, condition, flags, etc. Includes auditory, visual, and tactile (feel of wake, etc.) components.

sections.heading: Disguise WeaponACG
sections.text: Disguise WeaponACG: Glamer (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Item-Specific Spell (manufactured weapon, to look like another; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: DisheartenDr337
sections.text: DisheartenDr337: Enhancement (2nd level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (AC; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Augment Spell (unnerved; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 2nd level; target is unnerved and takes a -1/4 levels penalty to AC.

sections.heading: Disintegrate
sections.text: Disintegrate: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Empower Spell (+1 level) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Overwhelming Evocation (+1 level) + Resistible Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (15d6 to 20d6; +1 level) = 6th level; damage cap 10d6+120 (bypasses hardness and energy resistance, but Fort save applies for half), and creature or object struck is destroyed (Chapter 7) if reduced to negative hp total equal to max. hp + Con score or hardness, respectively. Damage comparisons:

sections.heading: DismantleRRO
sections.text: DismantleRRO: Shaping (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (dispel; +1 level) + Silent Spell (-1 level) + Inexorable Spell (destroys, rather than suppressing; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Artifice or Destruction domain; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 7th); touch disassembles item (up to 1 cu. ft./level) into component parts and destroys magical properties.

sections.heading: Dispel IllusionPH1
sections.text: Dispel IllusionPH1: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (no check needed; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (illusions only; -2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 3rd). Variant:

sections.heading: Dispel, ChainPHII
sections.text: Dispel, ChainPHII: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Bouncing Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 spell/3 levels; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level targeted; +3 levels) = 7th level.

sections.heading: Dispel, SlashingPHII
sections.text: Dispel, SlashingPHII: Dispel (0 level) + Cascade Spell (invocation of the knife; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Bouncing Spell (+1 level) + Expedient Spell (damage capped by dispelling; -1 level) = 4th level; dispel magic in 20’r. and deals 1d6 slashing/spell level dispelled.

sections.heading: Dispelling BufferSRD
sections.text: Dispelling BufferSRD: Warding (dispel; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 6th); spells affecting target cannot be dispelled while warding is up (the warding does not protect itself). AKA ghostdweomerRR.

sections.heading: Dispelling Screen, Otiluke’sCA
sections.text: Dispelling Screen, Otiluke’sCA: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to wall; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 4th level.

sections.heading: Dispelling TouchPHII
sections.text: Dispelling TouchPHII: Dispel (0 level) + Bouncing Spell (if one effect not dispelled, try another on same target; +2 levels) = 2nd level spell.

sections.heading: Dispelling, SuperbSRD
sections.text: Dispelling, SuperbSRD: Greater dispel magic (6th level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Concentration; +1 level) + Insightful Spell (+1 level) = 8th level (listed as epic); as greater dispel magic, but with +1/2 levels (+10 max.) insight bonus to check.

sections.heading: Dispelling, TenaciousCM
sections.text: Dispelling, TenaciousCM: Greater dispel magic (6th level) + Creature-Specific Spell (target of dispel, etc. last round; -2 levels) = 4th level; you can cast a follow-up greater dispel magic at a discounted spell level.

sections.heading: Displace SelfS&M
sections.text: Displace SelfS&M: Displacement (3rd level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: DisquietudeMF
sections.text: DisquietudeMF: Compel (avoid physical contact; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoid only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 1st level; target moves to avoid physical contact with any other creatures, including allies (touch spells from them must be touch attacks). If attacked in melee, subject moves away (if possible) or uses full defense (otherwise).

sections.heading: Disrupt SilenceUI
sections.text: Disrupt SilenceUI: Warding (silence; 1st level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 2nd level; negates magical silence.

sections.heading: Disrupting BlowLoM
sections.text: Disrupting BlowLoM: Ray of beguiling (1st level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+10 to +20) = 3rd level; [strike] inflicts 1d6 +1/level penalty to Charisma for 1 rd./level, likely preventing the use of spell-like abilities, sorcerer or incarnate spells, and/or psionic abilities during that time.

sections.heading: Disrupting Hand, Bigby’sPHII
sections.text: Disrupting Hand, Bigby’sPHII: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (hand can be physically destroyed; -1 level) = 3rd level; spend a partial action each round to force opposed Concentration checks to cast.

sections.heading: Disrupting WeaponSRD
sections.text: Disrupting WeaponSRD: Spark of life (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) = 4th level; damage cap +84 hp/rd. vs. undead, divided among iterative attacks (max. +60 for any one attack). Augment to 5th level for damage cap +120/rd. (+90 for any one).

sections.heading: Dissipating TouchSRD
sections.text: Dissipating TouchSRD: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (teleportation; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (5d6 to 1d6; -1 level) = 0 level; damage 1d6.

sections.heading: Dissolving TouchSRD
sections.text: Dissolving TouchSRD: Acid splash (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 1st level (listed as 2nd); deal 1d6 acid/level (max. 5d6, no SR) by melee touch. AKA corrosive touchUM. Variants:

sections.heading: Dissolving WeaponSRD
sections.text: Dissolving WeaponSRD: Acid splash (0 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Delay Spell (until next hit; +1 level) = 2nd level; next successful hit by weapon deals +1d6 acid/level (max. 10d6). Variants:

sections.heading: Dissonant ChordCAd
sections.text: Dissonant ChordCAd: Sound lance (1st level) + Shape Spell (burst; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 sonic in 10’r. burst around you (bard 2nd, 5d6).

sections.heading: Distance DistortionPH1
sections.text: Distance DistortionPH1: Celerity (0 level) + Variable Spell (increase or decrease speed; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to horizontal wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 30-ft. squares; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (60 ft. to 40 ft.; -1 levels) = 5th level; speed to traverse large area of ground is increased or decreased by up to 40 ft./rd.

sections.heading: Distort ShadowRR
sections.text: Distort ShadowRR: Gloom (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd,/level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (around existing shadow; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (darkness to dim light; -1 level) = 0 level; changes size/outline of existing shadow.

sections.heading: Distort SummonsBVD
sections.text: Distort SummonsBVD: Compel (attack summoner; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (summoned monsters only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (evil caster; -1 level) = 4th level; summoning spells summon evil versions that attack caster.

sections.heading: DistractSRD
sections.text: DistractSRD: Skill enhancement (Perception; 0 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) = 1st level; imposes -1/2 levels (-5 max.) penalty to Perception for 1 min./level. AKA daydreamDHD.

sections.heading: DistractDr314
sections.text: DistractDr314: Skill enhancement (Perception; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Concentration; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (+10 to +5; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); multiple targets receive -1/2 levels (-5 max.) penalty to Perception and Concentration for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Distract AssailantCAd
sections.text: Distract AssailantCAd: Inertia (0 level) + Quicken Spell (+4 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (rogue skill trick; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); swift action leaves target flat-footed 1 rd. AKA vital strikeCM, ghost bladeToB

sections.heading: Distracting ShadowsME
sections.text: Distracting ShadowsME: Skill enhancement (Perception; 0 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (+10 to +5; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); -5 to Perception in mobile emanation.

sections.heading: Distracting WilesRRO
sections.text: Distracting WilesRRO: Skill enhancement (Bluff; 0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (also Seight of Hand; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoid; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Charm domain, etc.; -1 level) = 1st level; subject is -1/2 levels to Bluff and Sleight of Hand.

sections.heading: DistractionAUG
sections.text: DistractionAUG: Compel (do nothing; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); target saves vs. Intuition or completes no actions 1 rd./level (or until Will save—check each round) due to phantasmal distraction.

sections.heading: Distressing ToneUM
sections.text: Distressing ToneUM: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) = 2nd level; those hit by rays are sickened for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Divert ChargeAUG2
sections.text: Divert ChargeAUG2: Mage hand (0 level) + Extend Spell (concentration to instantaneous; -1 level) + Shielding Spell (+2 levels) = 1st level; charge against you from within Close range is diverted up to 20 ft. in a different direction of your choosing.

sections.heading: Divination EnhancementTM2
sections.text: Divination EnhancementTM2: Bestow feat (1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 feat/3 levels; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 spell/3 levels; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (divinations only; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; increase the duration of divination spells (per Innate Metamagic [Extend Spell], but affects 1/3 levels x as many spells) for 1 min./level. At CL 12th, also gain Innate Metamagic (Reach Spell), usable likewise.

sections.heading: Divine AgilityCD
sections.text: Divine AgilityCD: Cat’s grace (2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Lightning Reflexes; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (dodge; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Spring Attack; +1 level) = 5th level; subject +4 enhancement to Dex, +2 to Reflex saves, +1 dodge bonus to AC, and Spring Attack (if already has 6+ ranks in Acrobatics).

sections.heading: Divine CleansingCW
sections.text: Divine CleansingCW: Resistance (0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (Fort only; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 to +3; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (able to channel positive energy; -1 level) = 3rd level; allies in 60’r. gain +3 sacred bonus to Fort saves for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Divine EmissaryPGF
sections.text: Divine EmissaryPGF: Mindlink (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (same alignment or servant of same deity; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Diplomacy; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restrricted Spell (you must serve a patron deity; -1 level) = 4th level; you gain telepathy 60 ft. with those of your alignment and servants of your deity, and also +1/2 levels to Diplomacy.

sections.heading: Divine ImpetusToB
sections.text: Divine ImpetusToB: Bestow feat (Combat Reflexes; 1st level) + Augment Spell (special; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Restricted Spell (able to channel energy; -1 level) = 2nd level; swift casting grants you 2 additional immediate actions, usable for 1 rd. (i.e., the swift action for casting is replaced, and an additional one gained).

sections.heading: Divine InsightCAd
sections.text: Divine InsightCAd: Skill enhancement (0 level) + Variable Spell (choose skill when activated; +1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Augment Spell (+5 to +10; +1 level) = 2nd level; swift casting grants +1/2 levels (+10 max.) sacred bonus to 1 skill check. Cf. Master’s touchPHII.

sections.heading: Divine InspirationBED
sections.text: Divine InspirationBED: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+3 total; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd./level; -2 levels) = 0 level (listed as 1st); as blessing, but +3 bonus and shorter duration (bonus applies to all attacks, not just those vs. evil).

sections.heading: Divine InspirationTM2
sections.text: Divine InspirationTM2: Divination (4th level) – Ritual Spell (+2 levels) = 6th level.

sections.heading: Divine InterdictionWotC
sections.text: Divine InterdictionWotC: Warding (channeled energy; 1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Variable Spell (includes variant channeling; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); blocks channeled energy in 10’r. emanation.

sections.heading: Divine InterferenceRRO
sections.text: Divine InterferenceRRO: Dispel (0 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Variable Spell (affects both incoming spells and victim’s own; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (divine spells only; -2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) = 6th level (listed as 7th); victim gains SR 10 + your Concentration bonus vs. divine magic from those of religions other than yours, which cannot be lowered, and must defeat its own SR to cast divine spells or use divine SLAs.

sections.heading: Divine InterferenceUM
sections.text: Divine InterferenceUM: Hand of fate (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (attack roll; -2 levels) = 3rd level; immediate casting forces reroll of attack hitting one ally within Close range.

sections.heading: Divine Power
sections.text: Divine Power: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Augment Spell (+6 to Str; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (haste; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to War domain; -1 level) = 4th level; you are hasted and gain a +6 enhancement to Strength and 1d6/level (max. 10d6) temp. hp.

sections.heading: Divine ProtectionMH
sections.text: Divine ProtectionMH: Deflection (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) = 5th level (listed as 2nd); allies in 20’r. burst gain +2 sacred bonus to AC and +1 to saves for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Divine ProtectionRR2
sections.text: Divine ProtectionRR2: Attribute boost (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+6 total; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 attribute/3 levels; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 7th level; 1 ally/level gains +6 enhancement to Dex, Con, Wis, Cha (and Str at CL 15th, Int at CL 18th).

sections.heading: Divine PursuitUM
sections.text: Divine PursuitUM: Celerity (0 level) + Variable Spell (movement type appropriate to quarry; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement; +1 level) + Variable Spell (Athletics for climbing or swimming, Fly for flying, etc., +1 level) + Cascade Spell (lasting breathTM2: q.v.; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (+30 ft. to +60 ft.; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Inquisition or Hunting domain; -1 level) = 4th level; you gain movement speed appropriate to creature pursued (max. 60 ft.) and +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to applicable skill checks for that movement for 1 rd./level, and can breathe if swimming or burrowing, etc.

sections.heading: Divine SacrificeCD
sections.text: Divine SacrificeCD: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; ­1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 1st level; each round, deal +1d6 force/level (max. 5d6) as a [strike], but you take 1d6 negative energy if successful.

sections.heading: Divine ShieldCW
sections.text: Divine ShieldCW: Enhancement (2nd level) + Consecrate/Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (shield; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +1/3; +3 level) + Restricted Spell (able to channel energy, proficient with shield; -1 level) = 1st level; your shield gains +1/3 levels sacred/profane bonus for 1 rd./level. Variant:

sections.heading: Divine SurgeToB
sections.text: Divine SurgeToB: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 4th level; [strike] deals +1d6/level (max. +10d6, half force, half holy, and SR does not apply). Variants:

sections.heading: Divine TalionDD
sections.text: Divine TalionDD: Acid splash (0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Versatile Evocation (bludgeoning, cold, electricity, fire, force, negative energy, piercing, slashing, or sonic: +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (+15 to +20; +1 level) = 6th level; attackers within Long range take 1d6 +1/level damage of the same type they inflict on you each time they damage you.

sections.heading: Divine WisdomRR
sections.text: Divine WisdomRR: Owl’s wisdom (2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 2nd).

sections.heading: Dolorous MotesBED
sections.text: Dolorous MotesBED: Compel (dazing; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (onset: inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Wis; -1 level) = 6th level (listed as 3rd); those in affected cubes save each round or dazed 1 rd., but caster takes 1d4 Wis damage.

sections.heading: Dominate Animal
sections.text: Dominate Animal: Damage attribute (Cha; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (mindlink; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (animal; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Animal domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; 4d4 Cha damage and mental commands possible.

sections.heading: Dominate ItemAUG2
sections.text: Dominate ItemAUG2: Damage attribute (Cha; 1st level) + Threnodic Spell (modified: intelligent items rather than undead; +0 levels) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (mindlink; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = 5th level; intelligent item takes 3d4 Cha damage with respect to you, and mental commands possible.

sections.heading: Dominate Vermin
sections.text: Dominate Vermin: Damage attribute (Cha; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (mindlink; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Pestilence domain; -1 level) + Coaxing Spell (+0 levels) = 3rd level; 4d4 Cha damage and mental commands possible.

sections.heading: Domination, EnslaveSRD
sections.text: Domination, EnslaveSRD: Damage attribute (Cha; 1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (mindlink; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (compel; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 9th level (listed as epic); 3d4 Cha damage and telepathic commands (even self-destructive ones). Invest 450 x CL numen to maintain the effect indefinitely.

sections.heading: Domination, Monstrous ThrallCD
sections.text: Domination, Monstrous ThrallCD: Damage attribute (Cha; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +3 levels) + Crippling Drain (+3 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (compel; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 9th level; 4d4 Cha drain, and self-destructive commands possible (but no telepathic link).

sections.heading: Domination, TrueCD
sections.text: Domination, TrueCD: Damage attribute (Cha; 1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (mindlink; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (compel; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoids only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Charm or Possession domain; -1 level) = 8th level; 3d4 Cha damage and telepathic commands (even self-destructive ones). AKA utter thrallAUG2; invest 400 x CL numen to maintain the effect indefinitely.

sections.heading: Doom ChargeToB
sections.text: Doom ChargeToB: Inure (slashing; 0 level) + Energy Admixture (bludgeoning and piercing; +0 levels) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Personal Spell (+1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Reduce Spell (-1 level) = 5th level; [strike] grants you DR 10/― for 1 round; you can activate as a swift action to make the [strike] at the end of a charge, etc.

sections.heading: Doom of the SeasSW
sections.text: Doom of the SeasSW: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 15; +9 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 9th level; summons one half-fiend kraken.

sections.heading: DoomhoundDHD
sections.text: DoomhoundDHD: Spook (0 level) + Cascade Spell [(figment; +1 level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level)] + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Fell Frightening (+1 level) = 3rd level; victim stalked by phantom black hound, is frightened 1 rd./level (Will shaken). Invest 150 x CL numen to extend effect until remove curse or remove fear used.

sections.heading: DoomtideCD
sections.text: DoomtideCD: Wisp (0 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (fog: 1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+2 levels) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) = 5th level (listed as 4th); short-lived fog obscures vision and dazes 1 rd. (save each round while within), you and allies immune.

sections.heading: DoomwailRR
sections.text: DoomwailRR: Spook (0 level) + Fell Frightening (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to cone; +1 level) = 6th level (listed as 5th); those in 30-ft. cone dazed 1 rd., panicked and deafened 1 rd./level (shaken 1 rd./level even if save).

sections.heading: Door SightAPG
sections.text: Door SightAPG: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (through door only; -2 levels) = 0 level; you can see through doors, out to Close range.

sections.heading: Door WarningAUG
sections.text: Door WarningAUG: Augury (2nd level) + Cross-Class Spell (arcane; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (door touched during casting; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 0); the next time designated door opens, you learn the name of who or what opened it (e.g., “Bob Smith” or “the wind.”).

sections.heading: Doorway to ElsewhereAUG2
sections.text: Doorway to ElsewhereAUG2: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (dimensional skip; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 2.5-ft. squares; −2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Mishap Possibility (ad hoc -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 9th level; 1-way door allows viewing of, and travel to, destination chosen. Invest 9,000 x CL numen to make the doorway permanent.

sections.heading: Doppelganger TransformationRE
sections.text: Doppelganger TransformationRE: Polymorph (monstrous humanoid; 3rd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (doppelganger; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (non-extended barkskin; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level (listed as 7th); you become a doppelganger, +2 Str, Con, Cha (and Wis if CL 9th+, Dex if 12th, +4 Str at 15th, +4 Cha at 18th) and bonus to natural armor of +2 +1/4 levels, plus darkvision 60 ft., +2 to saves vs. enchantments.

sections.heading: DoublespeakCM
sections.text: DoublespeakCM: Glamer (0 level) + Variable Spell (scripted; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/3 levels; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 2nd level; subjects’ actual conversation is concealed by scripted illusion (auditory and visual components).

sections.heading: DowndraftRR2
sections.text: DowndraftRR2: Zephyr (0 level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses: hearing; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (wisp; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (severe to strong; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (race or bloodline, mystery, domain, etc. with [air] descriptor; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); 20’r. burst of severe wind also creates dust cloud, deafens 1 rd./level, and knocks prone.

sections.heading: DracomorphDr297
sections.text: DracomorphDr297: Form of the dragon III (q.v.; 8th level) – Personal Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (attributes; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoid to bronze dragon only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 9th level; subject becomes a Huge bronze dragon: +10 Str, -4 Dex, +4 Con, +6 natural armor +1/2 levels (max. +16 total at CL 20th), low-light vision, darkvision 120 ft., blindsight 60 ft., fly 120 ft., swim 120 ft., 6 natural attacks (bite 3d6, 2 claws 2d6, 2 wings 1d8, tail slap 2d6), breath weapon, electricity immunity, frightful presence, DR 10/+2, SR. Trade feats for Improved Overrun and Vital Strike to gain trample (crush) ability.

sections.heading: Draconic SuppressionPC
sections.text: Draconic SuppressionPC: Enervation (4th level) + Creature-Specific Spell (dragons only; -2 levels) = 2nd level; ray deals 1d4 temp. negative levels (apply vs. sorcerer levels first) to a dragon, causing loss of spells and/or spell-like abilities, possible reduction of breath weapon damage, etc.

sections.heading: Dragon KnightSRD
sections.text: Dragon KnightSRD: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 14 adult red dragon; +8 levels) = 9th level (listed as epic); summons an adult red dragon for 1 rd./level. River dragonSW is Augmented 2 more steps (CR 17-18 black or bronze wyrm; +2 levels), has a full round casting time (-1 level), and is Restricted (access to Water domain; -1 level) = 9th level (listed as epic).

sections.heading: Dragon Turtle ShellPC
sections.text: Dragon Turtle ShellPC: Reduce (3rd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (damage dice only; -2 levels) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (1 step to 3 steps; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 attack/3 levels; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (overcome by manufactured weapons; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; each round for 1 rd./level, damage dice for up to one natural or unarmed attack/3 levels are reduced by 3 steps.

sections.heading: DragonbaneTM2
sections.text: DragonbaneTM2: Hedge (dragons; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (emanation to cubes; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 6th); dragons cannot physically enter area for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Dragon BreathCD
sections.text: Dragon BreathCD: Dragon’s breathAPG (3rd level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 (breathe each round).

sections.heading: Dragon’s BreathAPG
sections.text: Dragon’s BreathAPG: Acid splash (0 level) + Variable Spell (x2: choose shape and energy type at time of casting; +2 levels) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6.

sections.heading: Dragon’s BreathRR
sections.text: Dragon’s BreathRR: Acid splash (0 level) + Variable Spell (Versatile Evocation: acid, cold, electricity, fire; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Delay Spell (standard action trigger; +1 level) + Variable Spell (Shape Spell: cone, or Reach Spell: medium; +1 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 14d6, divisible among multiple breaths (each released as a standard action).

sections.heading: Drain Away SpeedAUG
sections.text: Drain Away SpeedAUG: Celerity (0 level) + Variable Spell (different speeds; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Augment Spell (+10 ft. to +30 ft.; +1 level) = 2nd level; target’s speed reduced by 30 ft. for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Drain ProwessDR337
sections.text: Drain ProwessDR337: Enervation (4th level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 target/3 levels; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to targets; +0 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (1d4 to 1d2; -2 levels) = 4th level; 1 target/3 levels takes 1d2 temp. negative levels (Fort half).

sections.heading: Drain VitalityToB
sections.text: Drain VitalityToB: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level; melee attack also deals 1d4 Con damage (Fort half).

sections.heading: Draw Upon Holy MightTM2
sections.text: Draw Upon Holy MightTM2: Attribute boost (0 level) + Variable Spell (select attribute at time of casting; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2 to +6; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; you gain +6 enhacement to one attribute for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Dread BlastPGF
sections.text: Dread BlastPGF: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) = 5th level; Close ranged touch deals up to 15d6 negative energy plus dazed 1 rd.

sections.heading: Dread WordBVD
sections.text: Dread WordBVD: Damage attribute (Cha; 1st level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (evil caster; -1 level) = 3rd level; 1d4 Cha drain at Medium range (Will half; if successful, second save neg.).

sections.heading: Dreaded FreezeAUG2
sections.text: Dreaded FreezeAUG2: Spook (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Fell Frightening (+1 level) + Augment Spell (cowering; +1 level) = 4th level (listed as 1st); targets cower, motionless, for 1 rd. (Will shaken instead).

sections.heading: DreadscapeHA
sections.text: DreadscapeHA: Ray of beguiling (1st level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (to panicked to unnerved and +20 to +15; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 4th); unless disbelieve, subjects unnerved and determine reaction to others as if their Cha were 1d6 +1/level (+15 max.) less than actual (hostile if reduced to 1).

sections.heading: Dream SightCD
sections.text: Dream SightCD: Detection (visual; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to line of sight; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (concentration to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (Dreamspun bloodline, etc.; -1 level) = 6th level; your spirit travels up to ¼ mile/min. and observes as it goes.

sections.heading: Dreaming PuppetHH
sections.text: Dreaming PuppetHH: PossessionOcA (3rd level) + Cross-Class Spell (enchantment [compulsion]; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to interplanar; +7 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (sleeping target; -2 levels) = 5th level; you possess a sleeping creature from any distance.

sections.heading: Dress CorpseUI
sections.text: Dress CorpseUI: Shaping (2nd level) + Object-Specific Spell (corpse; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Heal; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 8 cu. ft./level; +1 level) = 2nd level; make state of corpse seem to match cause of death you decide (opposed Heal check to interpret correctly, and you get +1/2 levels bonus).

sections.heading: Drowning GlanceCM
sections.text: Drowning GlanceCM: Touch of fatigue (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (exhausting; +1 level) + Fell Fatigue (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) = 1st level; target is exhausted 1 rd. (Fort fatigued).

sections.heading: Drug ResistanceBVD
sections.text: Drug ResistanceBVD: Warding (addiction; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (drug addiction only; -2 levels) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Druid GroveMW
sections.text: Druid GroveMW: Spell (6th level or below) + Delay Spell (standard; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (grove; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 5th level; you can store up to 1 spell/3 levels (max. 6th level) in the trees of a sacred grove, held latent until you use a standard action to release them.

sections.heading: Drums of Despair, Otto’sGA
sections.text: Drums of Despair, Otto’sGA: Spook (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 20-ft.; +1 level) + Augment Spell (frightened to shaken; -1 level) = 3rd level; those in one 20-ft. cube/level are shaken 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: DungeonsightPC
sections.text: DungeonsightPC: Detection (architectural layout; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (cone to emanation; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) = 5th level; you gain mental image of architectural layout in 60’r. while you concentrate. Note that areas enclosed behind more than 1 ft. of stone, 3 ft. or earth or wood, or 1” of metal are hidden from the divination.

sections.heading: DuplicateCWH
sections.text: DuplicateCWH: Creation (1st level) + Variable Spell (material(s); +1 level) + Cascade Spell (shaping; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (complex objects possible; +1 level) + Item-Specific Spell (object to be duplicated; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (choose object at time of casting; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 5-ft. cubes; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; by touch, you create a duplicate of any mundane, nonliving object that can fit within one 5-ft. cube/level (no craft check needed due to template).

sections.heading: Dust of TwilightAPG
sections.text: Dust of TwilightAPG: Gloom (0 level) + Cascade Spell (touch of fatigue; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) = 3rd level; reduces ambient light by 2 steps and save or fatigued in 10’r. area.

sections.heading: Dust WardMC
sections.text: Dust WardMC: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Overwhelming Evocation (+2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Delay Spell (time delay; +1 level) + Variable Spell (two activating conditions; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level; item takes 1d6 negative energy/level (max. 15d6; no SR, bypasses hardness and energy resistance) after 1 hour of being held/worn by unauthorized creature type, or if studied to learn properties, etc. Requires investment of 300 x CL numen as a latent spell effect.

sections.heading: D

+ Personal Spell (-1 level) = 5th level; for 1 rd./level, you gain +4 enhancement to Str, Dex, and Con (and Cha, Wis, and Int at CL 12th, 15th, 18th), two melee attacks/rd. (damage cap 20d6, divided between them), and DR 10/adamantine. You must also save vs. Intuition or be confused for the duration (attacking objects instead of doing nothing).
Fungal blistersPF119 is Shaped Spell (burst; +2 levels), Widened Spell (5’r.; -2 levels), and Extended (1 min./level; +1 level), and Restricted (access to Pestilence domain, etc.; -1 level) = 2nd level; whenever you are hit in melee, you release a 5’r. cloud of spores dealing 1d6 +1/level (+5 max.) necrotic damage (Fort half). Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteStarmantleBED is Interrupting (+1 level), Overwhelming (+1 level), and Extended (1 min./level; +1 level), and can be cast on others (+1 level) = 6th level; weapons hitting subject take 1d6 +1/level (+15 max.; divine +10) negative energy damage that ignores hardness/energy resistance (possibly destroying them before they can inflict damage; nonmagical steel weapons have only 10 hp). Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Death ClutchHA: Variable Spell (+1 level):
200 hp or less: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Reaping Spell (+2 levels) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 20d6; -1 level) = 8th level; damage cap 120/rd. and staggered until save, and raise dead does not work on victim.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente201+ hp: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Fell Staggering (+1 level) = 8th level; 1d4 Con drain and staggered 1 rd./level (Fort half/flat-footed).    Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Aura of succombingPC is as death knell auraBotD3 (see below), but is also Restricted (able to channel negative energy; -1 level) and Reduced (5d6 to 1d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; deals 1d6/rd. to dying creatures in 20’r. and grants you 1d6 temp. hp. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteDeath knell auraBotD3 has a range of Personal (-1 level) and is Shaped (target to emanation; +2 levels), Personal (-1 level), and Extended (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 4th level; deals 1d6 negative energy/2 levels (max. 5d6) to dying creatures in 20’r. (Fort half); you gain +2 Str, +1d6/HD (max. +10d6 at any one time) temp. hp for 10 min./HD of creature that dies. AKA consumptive fieldLM. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteGutwrenchBVD: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell [(attribute boost: Str; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 bonus; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level)] + Cascade Spell [(spark of life; +1 level) + Thanatopic Spell (+2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level)] + Restricted Spell (undead caster; -1 level) = 7th level; deals 3d4 Con damage plus 10d6 negative energy at close range (Fort half); if victim dies, you gain like temp. hp and +4 Str for 10 min./level.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteReaving AuraCM: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to 0; ­1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (0 or fewer hp only; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 1d6; -2 levels) = 2nd level; swift casting deals 1d6 negative energy to all in 20’r. with 0 or fewer hp.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Death wardSRD uses warding [negative energy] instead of inure (+1 level) = 5th level (listed as 4th); grants full immunity to negative energy.Mark of deathAUG2 is Extended (1 hr./level; +2 levels) and Ritual (full round; -1 level).
