sections.heading: Earth BlastRR2
sections.text: Earth BlastRR2: Invisible needle (0 level) + Energy Admixture (bludgeoning; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 (half piercing, half bludgeoning) and knocked prone (Reflex half/neg.) in 20’r.

sections.heading: Earth BurstAUG
sections.text: Earth BurstAUG: Energy mace (0 level) + Energy Admixture (piercing; +0 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +3 levels) + Delay Spell (standard activation; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; rock bursts on command for 5d6 damage (half bludgeoning, half piercing) in 20’r.

sections.heading: Earth TremorUW
sections.text: Earth TremorUW: Energy mace (0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: EarthboltCA
sections.text: EarthboltCA: Energy mace (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to line; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (earth or stone ground or floor; -1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Residual Spell (+1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 (no SR) and difficult terrain.

sections.heading: Earthen ClawAUG
sections.text: Earthen ClawAUG: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Augment Spell (5d6 to 10d6; +1 level) = 2nd level; close ranged touch deals 1d6 slashing/level (max. 10d6) and knocks prone.

sections.heading: Earthen GraspCA
sections.text: Earthen GraspCA: Bind (0 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (unworked earth;  −2 levels) = 2nd level; makes 1 grapple attempt/round.

sections.heading: Earthquake
sections.text: Earthquake: Energy mace (0 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (pin; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 10d6; -3 levels) = 7th level; 10d6 bludgeoning (divine 5d6) and pinned under rubble (+1d6/round). Variants:

sections.heading: Ease of BreathFB
sections.text: Ease of BreathFB: Bestow feat (Favored Terrain: mountains; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (altitude affinity only; -2 levels) = 3rd level (ranger 1st).

sections.heading: Ease PainBED
sections.text: Ease PainBED: Remove condition (pain; 1st level) + Augment Spell (moderate conditions; +1 level) = 2nd level; removes minor and moderate fatigue, nonlethal damage, sickening, etc. from [pain] effects.

sections.heading: Easy ClimbCAd
sections.text: Easy ClimbCAd: Skill enhancement (Athletics; 0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to line; +1 level) + Widen Spell (5 ft. wide to 10 ft. wide; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (vertical surface; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger; −2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 3rd); +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to climb surface (10’ft. wide area, to a height up to Medium range) for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: EchoUW
sections.text: EchoUW: Figment (0 level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (no visual component; -1 level) = 1st level; as ghost sound, but speech possible, either repeat same sound for 1 rd./level, or change sound (and apparent source location, within area) as a standard action.

sections.heading: EclipseRR
sections.text: EclipseRR: Gloom (0 level) + Cascade Spell (warding: light; +2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5 mi./level; +9 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (shadow bloodline, mystery, etc.; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (5 steps to 2 steps; -3 levels) = 9th level; light reduced by 2 steps across large area lasts 10 min./level, cannot be alleviated with mundane or magical light sources.

sections.heading: EclipseSRD
sections.text: EclipseSRD: Gloom (0 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5 mi.; +7 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (4 steps to 3 steps; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as epic); area of darkness in 5-mile radius emanation around you lasts 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Ecstasy, Gulaben’sRR2
sections.text: Ecstasy, Gulaben’sRR2: Damage attribute (Wis; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (also Cha; +1 level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (panicked to shaken; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 5th); touch deals 1d4 Wis and Cha damage (up to 1d4 total is drain) and unnerves 1 min./level (Will half/neg.).

sections.heading: Ectoplasmic ArmorLM
sections.text: Ectoplasmic ArmorLM: Mage armor (1st level) + Augment Spell (+8 total bonus; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (incorporeal attacks only; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; you gain +8 armor bonus vs. incorporeal attacks.

sections.heading: Ectoplasmic ShamblerSRD
sections.text: Ectoplasmic ShamblerSRD: Wisp (0 level) + Cascade Spell (dispel; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd.; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to long; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 10d6; -2 levels) = 5th level; area deals negative energy damage (10d6/rd., Fort half), obstructs vision, forces opposed Concentration checks to cast spells while you concentrate.

sections.heading: Ectoplasmic SnareOcA
sections.text: Ectoplasmic SnareOcA: Bind (0 level) + Cascade Spell (energy mace; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Fell Entangling (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 bludgeoning and grappled (Reflex half/entangled) while you concentrate.

sections.heading: Efficacious Monster WardTM2
sections.text: Efficacious Monster WardTM2: Hedge (2nd level) + Shape Spell (emanation to cubes; +0 levels) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature type/level; +3 levels) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Protection or Riftwarden domain; -1 level) = 4th level; creatures of 8 HD or less of 1 type/level are hedged out of area for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Effortless ArmorUC
sections.text: Effortless ArmorUC: Bestow feat (Skill Focus: Endurance; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Endurance; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (reduce armor penalty only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; reduces ACP by 1 + 1/6 levels.

sections.heading: Ego WhipSRD
sections.text: Ego WhipSRD: Damage attribute (Cha; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (compel: daze; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoid; -2 levels) = 2nd level; 1d4 Cha damage plus dazed 1 rd. (Will half/neg.).

sections.heading: Ego Whip IOcA
sections.text: Ego Whip IOcA: Ray of beguiling (1st level) + Variable Spell (choose mental attribute at time of casting; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; +1 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (+15 to +5; -2 levels) = 3rd level; target takes 1d6 + ½ levels (+5 max.) penalty to one mental attribute for 1 rd./level and is staggered 1 rd. (Will half/neg.).

sections.heading: Ego Whip IIOcA
sections.text: Ego Whip IIOcA: Ray of beguiling (1st level) + Variable Spell (choose mental attribute at time of casting; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; +1 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (+15 to +10; -1 level) = 4th level; target takes 1d6 + ½ levels penalty to one mental attribute and is staggered 1 rd./level or until save (Will half/neg.).

sections.heading: Ego Whip IIIOcA
sections.text: Ego Whip IIIOcA: Ego whip IIOcA (4th level) – Tenuous Spell (+1 level) = 5th level; target takes 1d6 + 1/level (+15 max.) penalty to one mental attribute and is staggered 1 rd./level (Will half/neg.).

sections.heading: Ego Whip IVOcA
sections.text: Ego Whip IVOcA: Ego whip IIIOcA (5th level) – Reduce Spell (+1 level) = 6th level; target takes 1d6 + 1/level (+20 max.) penalty to one mental attribute and is staggered 1 rd./level (Will half/neg.).

sections.heading: ElationBEM
sections.text: ElationBEM: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Dex; +1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (+60 ft. to +5 ft.; -3 levels) = 3rd level; +2 morale bonus to Str and Dex, and +5 ft. speed, to those in 120’r.

sections.heading: Electric VengeancePHII
sections.text: Electric VengeancePHII: Inure (electricity; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (electric arc; +1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level; you gain resistance 5/2 levels (30 max.) to electricity for 1 min./level, and the next attacker to hit you in melee takes up to 1d6 electricity/level (max. 10d6 arcane or 5d6 for divine caster). AKA vivid dischargeAUG2. Variants:

sections.heading: Electrical Screen, Otiluke’sGA
sections.text: Electrical Screen, Otiluke’sGA: Electric arc (0 level) + Conductive Evocation (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20-ft. squares; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 5th level; 10d6 electrical and entangled 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Elemental AuraAPG
sections.text: Elemental AuraAPG: Ray of frost (0) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Variable Spell (+2 levels; see below) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 1d6; -3 levels) = 3rd level; damage 1d6/rd. plus additional effect in 20’r. emanation around you:

sections.heading: Elemental AuraTM2
sections.text: Elemental AuraTM2: Warding (1st level) + Variable Spell (choose element at time of casting; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Cascade Spell (hedge; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (planar adaptation; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (bloodline, school, etc. with appropriate elemental descriptor; -1 level) = 9th level; choose one element: you gain immunity to appropriate energy type and to attacks from elemementals of that element, and can survive, breathe, move, etc. on the appropriate elemental plane.

sections.heading: Elemental Body ICRB
sections.text: Elemental Body ICRB: Polymorph (elemental; 3rd level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level: Cascade Spell (attribute boost or enhancement: natural AC; +1 level)) = 4th level

sections.heading: Elemental Body IICRB
sections.text: Elemental Body IICRB: Polymorph (elemental; 3rd level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (enhancement: natural AC; +1 level) + Augment Spell (better natural AC) = 5th level.

sections.heading: Elemental Body IIICRB
sections.text: Elemental Body IIICRB: Elemental body II (5th level) + Cascade Spell (enlarge self; +1 level) = 6th level.

sections.heading: Elemental Body IVCRB
sections.text: Elemental Body IVCRB: Polymorph (elemental; 3rd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (specific element; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (enlarge self; +1 level) + Augment Spell (Huge; +1 level) = 7th level; +6 Str, -2 Dex, +2 Con, +2 Wis (and +2 Cha at 15th, +2 Int at 18th), +4 natural AC, elemental traits as shown. AKA elemental bodyMP.

sections.heading: Elemental BurstCA
sections.text: Elemental BurstCA: Variable Spell (invisible needle, jet of flame, or topple; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (5d6 to 1d6; -1 level) = 1st level; deal 1d6 damage or knock prone in 10’r. burst.

sections.heading: Elemental EyeCM
sections.text: Elemental EyeCM: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (not blocked by stone; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (scrying sensor must be placed in advance; -1 level) + Delay Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (wu jen; −1 level) = 3rd level; as clairvoyance, but you place focus in advance (which then becomes the sensor) and it activates some time thereafter (either by standard action concentration or in response to pre-set trigger).

sections.heading: Elemental KissRR2
sections.text: Elemental KissRR2: Polymorph (elemental; 3rd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (neutralize poison; +4 levels) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (-1 level) = 8th level (7th with access to appropriate elemental domain); subject healed 1d6/level (max. 20d6), cured of poisons, and gains elemental type (including DR, senses, immunities, etc.) for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Elemental ProdME
sections.text: Elemental ProdME: PushPH1 (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (bolf of force; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (elementals only; -2 levels) + + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level; pushes elemental 20 ft./rd. with concentration; you can choose to deal 1d6 force/level (max. 10d6) if it resists.

sections.heading: Elemental Swarm
sections.text: Elemental Swarm: Summon (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 10 greater elemental; +5 levels) + Augment Spell (1d3 Huge elementals plus 1d4+1 Large elementals = 1d4+1 greater elementals; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 9th level; summons one greater elemental, 1d3 Huge elementals, and 1d4+1 Large elementals of the same type.

sections.heading: Elemental TouchAPG
sections.text: Elemental TouchAPG: Acid splash (0) + Concentration Spell (standard action; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (-2 levels) + Variable Spell (+2 levels; see below) = 2nd level; touch or attack deals +1d6 energy damage plus sickened, fatigued, entangled, or catch on fire.

sections.heading: Elemental WardCA
sections.text: Elemental WardCA: Compel (leave w/o attacking; 2nd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (specific elemental type; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (wu jen, elementalist, etc.; -1 level) = 4th level; turns elementals.

sections.heading: Embrace the WildCAd
sections.text: Embrace the WildCAd: Polymorph (animal; 3rd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (senses only; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Animal domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; gain animal senses for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Emerald BurstBEM
sections.text: Emerald BurstBEM: Inertia (0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Emerald Energy Shield, Nezram’sLEF
sections.text: Emerald Energy Shield, Nezram’sLEF: Inure (sonic; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (warding; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) = 4th level; subject gains resistance to sonic 5/2 levels (max. 30) and temp. immunity to deafness and compulsions, plus [language-dependent] spells at CL 9th, charms at 12th, etc. for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Emotion ReadTM2
sections.text: Emotion ReadTM2: Detection (emotions; 2nd level) – Concentration Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; provides instantaneous reading of subject’s dominant emotion.

sections.heading: Emotive BlockOcA
sections.text: Emotive BlockOcA: Compel (don’t cast spells; 2nd level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (special; -2 levels) = 2nd level; creature with any [fear] or non-harmless [emotion] condition cannot cast spells or use spell-like abilities for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Empathic FeedbackSRD
sections.text: Empathic FeedbackSRD: Whelm (0 level) + Shielding Spell (+2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (+15 to +5; -2 levels) = 3rd level; melee attackers take 1d6 + 1/level (+5 max.) nonlethal damage per hit.

sections.heading: Empathetic Resonance, Madriel’sRR
sections.text: Empathetic Resonance, Madriel’sRR: Blessing (0 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Augment Spell (-2 penalty; +1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 hr./level; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (only while attempting to harm others; -2 levels) = 1st level; target is -2 to attacks, damage, saves vs. fear while attempting to harm others.

sections.heading: Empathic SurgeRRO
sections.text: Empathic SurgeRRO: MindlinkSRD (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level; to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (fear only transferred if you are under effect; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (panicked to shaken; -2 levels) = 3rd level; you broadcast your emotions to those in 60’r., and they become shaken if you are.

sections.heading: Empathic TransferRRO
sections.text: Empathic TransferRRO: MindlinkSRD (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (lesser confusion; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level; to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (conditions only transferred if subject is under effects; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (panicked to shaken; −2 levels) = 4th level; thoughts of subject within range are broadcast to those in 40’r., and they become confused, shaken, or sickened if the subject is.

sections.heading: Empyreal EcstasyBED
sections.text: Empyreal EcstasyBED: Remove condition (pain; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (warding: compulsions; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (warding: other [mind-affecting]; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level; removes minor, moderate, and serious [pain] effects affecting up to 1 subject/level, and wards 1 min./level against [mind-affecting] spells.

sections.heading: Encourage FailureDr337
sections.text: Encourage FailureDr337: Enhancement (2nd level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 2nd level; target takes a -1/4 levels penalty to all rolls.

sections.heading: End to StrifeBED
sections.text: End to StrifeBED: Energy mace (0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Variable Spell (Merciful Spell if desired; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (makes attack; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 8th level; damage cap 28d6, divided among attacks. Those in 120’r. of you take 1d6/level after each attack made (up to 14d6 each for 2 attacks, 9d6 each for 3, 7d6 each for 4, etc.); damage can be either half bludgeoning, half holy, or nonlethal (you choose at time of casting).

sections.heading: Enduring ScrutinyCM
sections.text: Enduring ScrutinyCM: Mindlink (1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) = 3rd level; you get a mental alert if the subject performs a specific action specified during casting.

sections.heading: Enemy’s HeartARG
sections.text: Enemy’s HeartARG: Spark of life (1st level) + Augment Spell (+1/level; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Str; +1 level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (orc or half-orc; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (adjacent to helpless, living creature; -2 levels) + Channel Spell (+1 level) = 1st level; your coup de grâce blow grants you +2 profane bonus to Str and 1d6 +1/level temp. hp (max. +5) for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Energetic HealingBED
sections.text: Energetic HealingBED: Warding (1st level) + Variable Spell (choose energy type at time of casting; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) = 5th level; subject immune to 1 energy type and heals half damage it would have caused (up to 15d6 total over spell duration) when targeted.

sections.heading: Energize PotionBED
sections.text: Energize PotionBED: Sound lance (1st level) + Variable Spell (Versatile Evocation: choose at time of casting; +1 level) + Splash Evocation (+0 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Expedient Spell (special; -1 level) = 2nd level; thrown potion or alchemical flask explodes for up to 1d6/spell level of potion (max. 5d6).

sections.heading: EnergumenMW
sections.text: EnergumenMW: Resistance (0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Str; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Con; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (same nation, tribe, etc. and religion as you; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (cultist; -1 level) = 3rd level; +2 Str, Dex, and saves to one creature/level.

sections.heading: Energy AdaptationSRD
sections.text: Energy AdaptationSRD: Inure (0 level) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 energy type/level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) = 4th level; you gain resistance 5/2 levels (max. 30) against 1 energy type/level for 10 min./level, and can convert energy damage to light in a 20’r.

sections.heading: Energy AegisPHII
sections.text: Energy AegisPHII: Inure (0 level) + Variable Spell (choose type at time of casting; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (30 to 15; -1 level) = 3rd level; immediate casting grants ally resistance 15 to one energy type for 1 rd.

sections.heading: Energy ConversionSRD
sections.text: Energy ConversionSRD: Inure (0 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 energy type/level; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (sound lance, etc.; +1 level) + Delay Spell (when potential; +1 level) = 6th level (listed as 7th); you gain resistance 5/2 levels (max. 40) against 1 energy type/level for 10 min./level, and can convert energy damage resisted into close ranged attacks (damage cap 20d6). Variant:

sections.heading: Energy EbbLM
sections.text: Energy EbbLM: Enervation (4th level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine and non-necromancer Sor/Wiz; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +3 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 7th level; ray deals 1 negative level/rd. for 1 rd./level. (save each round to end effect). The Necromancer specialist version (also 7th level) lacks the Cross-Class Spell and Tenuous Spell feats.

sections.heading: Energy EmanationFB
sections.text: Energy EmanationFB: Sound lance (1st level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Energy ImmunityCA
sections.text: Energy ImmunityCA: Warding (1st level) + Variable Spell (select energy type at time of casting; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) = 6th level; subject gains long-lasting immunity to one energy type.

sections.heading: Energy LashAUG2
sections.text: Energy LashAUG2: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 1d6; -4 levels) = 2nd level; 1d6 force plus grappled, for up to 3 iterative ranged touch attacks/rd. while you concentrate.

sections.heading: Energy RaySRD
sections.text: Energy RaySRD: Sound lance (1st level) + Variable Spell (Versatile Evocation: choose cold, electricity, or fire instead; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 1st level; as sound lance, but choose energy type at time of casting.

sections.heading: Energy SheathAUG
sections.text: Energy SheathAUG: Deflection (0 level) + Cascade Spell (sound lance; +2 levels) + Variable Spell (Versatile Evocation: acid, cold, electricity, or fire; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Variable Spell (touch or shield; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 6th level; you gain +2 deflection, touch attack for 1d6 energy/level (max. 15d6) and those hitting you in melee take 1d6 +1/level. Variants:

sections.heading: Energy Siege ShotUC
sections.text: Energy Siege ShotUC: Jet of flame (0 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Variable Spell (+2 levels worth of additional effects; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 6th level; siege missiles from designated engine deal additional energy damage (select type and additional effects at time of casting) for 10 min./level:

sections.heading: Energy VulnerabilityPHII
sections.text: Energy VulnerabilityPHII: Metaphysical feat (1st level) + Augment Spell (Empower Spell; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (selected energy type; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 3rd); specified creatures in 10’r. gain vulnerability to specified energy type for 1 rd./level. Variant:

sections.heading: Enervating Shadow StrikeToB
sections.text: Enervating Shadow StrikeToB: Enervation (4th level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; ­1 level) + Cascade Spell (personal, cross-class spark of life; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (rogue or monk; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 8th); melee attack also deals 1d4 temp.  negative levels, and you gain 1d6 temp. hp/level (max. 10d6).

sections.heading: Enervating TouchHH
sections.text: Enervating TouchHH: Enervation (4th level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (necromancer or access to [death] bloodline, domain, etc.; -1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 negative energy plus 1d4 temp. negative levels by touch. Variants:

sections.heading: Enervation, RetributiveCM
sections.text: Enervation, RetributiveCM: Enervation (4th level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 6th level (listed as 7th); those striking you in melee take 1 temp. negative level (max. 1d4+6 total).

sections.heading: Enfeebled MindAUG
sections.text: Enfeebled MindAUG: Ray of idiocy (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 6th level (listed as 5th); inflicts penalty of 1d6 +1/level to Int (Intuition half). Invest 300 x CL numen to maintain effect indefinitely.

sections.heading: Enhance Magical FlowAUG
sections.text: Enhance Magical FlowAUG: Bestow feat (Spell Focus; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Greater Spell Focus; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 6th level (listed as 2nd); you gain +2 to save DCs for your spells from 1 school of magic/3 levels.

sections.heading: Enhanced SensesRR2
sections.text: Enhanced SensesRR2: Darkvision (2nd level) + Exend Spell (19 min./level to 1 rd./level; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (alter senses: smell; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Perception; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; subject gains darkvision, scent, and +1/2 levels to Perception for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Entanglement, BurningPC
sections.text: Entanglement, BurningPC: Lesser entangle (q.v.; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (jet of flame; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (wisp; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); as lesser entangle, but growth is afire (5d6/rd., Reflex half) and smoke obscures vision.

sections.heading: Entanglement, SickeningACG
sections.text: Entanglement, SickeningACG: Lesser entangle (q.v.; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) = 2nd level; 20’r. area entangles and sickens.

sections.heading: Entanglement, ThirstingPC
sections.text: Entanglement, ThirstingPC: Bind (0 level) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (vegetation; -2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (Con damage applies only vs. entangled creatures; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain, etc.; -1 level)  = 4th level; as greater entangle, but those entangled take 1d4 Con/rd. (Fort half).

sections.heading: Entanglement, ThornyACG
sections.text: Entanglement, ThornyACG: Greater entangle (q.v.; 3rd level) + Cascade Spell (invisible needle; +1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6/rd. plus entangled and difficult terrain in 40’r. AKA briartanglePGF.

sections.heading: Entangling BladeToB
sections.text: Entangling BladeToB: Celerity (0 level) + Variable Spell (various movement modes; +1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (-50 ft. to -30 ft.; -1 level) = 4th level; [strike] reduces target’s speeds by 30 ft. for the next round (no save, no SR).

sections.heading: Entangling EctoplasmSRD
sections.text: Entangling EctoplasmSRD: Bind (0 level) + Cross-Class Spell (creation/metacreativity; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to ray; +0 levels) = 1st level; ranged touch entangles 1 rd./level (no save, but SR applies).

sections.heading: Entangling StaffCAd
sections.text: Entangling StaffCAd: Bind (0 level) + Cascade Spell (energy mace; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Item-Specific Spell (channeled through staff only; -2 levels) + Concentration Spell (+1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) = 4th level; hit deals +1d6 bludgeoning/level (max. 10d6) and entangles 1 rd./level for 1d6 bludgeoning/rd. while entangled; make one such attack each round as a standard action.

sections.heading: Enter ImageAPG
sections.text: Enter ImageAPG: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level)  + Augment Spell (also hearing and smell; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (glamer; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (object bearing your image; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); while you concentrate, you can perceive the surroundings of a statue, paitning, etc. of you, and can make it appear to move and speak.

sections.heading: Entice FeyUI
sections.text: Entice FeyUI: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to interplanar; +8 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (fey; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard, druid, or ranger; -1 level) = 4th level. Rather than higher-level spells being needed to call more powerful fey, the mark of the wild rules are used, with the caster’s CR and Handle Animal bonus both being limiting factors.

sections.heading: Entrap SpiritOcA
sections.text: Entrap SpiritOcA: Plane shift (to mirror demi-plane; 6th level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (incorporeal; -2 levels) = 5th level; traps incorporeal being in mirror demiplane.

sections.heading: Entropic BoltCD
sections.text: Entropic BoltCD: Sound lance (1st level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; - 1 level) = 1st level; damage cap 5d6 (half sonic, half unholy).

sections.heading: Entropic Shield
sections.text: Entropic Shield: Blur (q.v.; 2nd level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (concealment vs. ranged attacks only; -2 levels) = 1st level; you gain 20% miss chance vs. ranged attacks for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Entropy ShieldS&M
sections.text: Entropy ShieldS&M: Hedge (lawful; 2nd level) + Widen Spell (10’r. to 5’r.; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (warding; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 type/3 levels; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (displacement; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Chaos domain; -1 level) = 6th level; [lawful] creatures cannot approach within 5 ft. of you, and you gain +2 deflection, 50% miss chance, and temp. immunity to magical acid, electricity, fire, force (and cold at CL 15th and sonic at 18th).

sections.heading: Enveloping CocoonCD
sections.text: Enveloping CocoonCD: Bind (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (pin; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 feat/3 levels; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Pestilence domain; -1 level) = 6th level; target pinned for 1 rd./level, and one spell you cast on it is Delayed (until the pin ends) and Inexorable, as if by the Sudden Metamagic feat (limits to total spell level, etc. apply).

sections.heading: Envious UrgeUM
sections.text: Envious UrgeUM: Compel (mug; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 6th level; affected targets attempt to rob the nearest creature, disarming weapons and stealing items (grappling if necessary), until a successful save is made.

sections.heading: Ephod of MeleeRR
sections.text: Ephod of MeleeRR: Deflection (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+6 bonus; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (ranged attacks and Reflex saves only; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; −2 levels) = 0 level; you gain +6 sacred bonus to Reflex saves and to AC vs. ranged attacks for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: ErasePH1
sections.text: ErasePH1: Shaping (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (dispel; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (writing only; -2 levels) = 1st level; removes mundane writing/drawing from up to 1 cu. ft./level, and possibly destroys one item of magical writing (scroll, symbol, etc).

sections.heading: Erase ImpressionsOcA
sections.text: Erase ImpressionsOcA: Remove condition (psychic impressions; 1st level) + Crippling Drain (permanent impressions; +1 level) + Augment Spell (serious; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level; erases psychic impressions from target object.

sections.heading: Escalating EnfeeblementCM
sections.text: Escalating EnfeeblementCM: Ray of enfeeblement (1st level) + Variable Spell [(Empower Spell; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (fatigued or exhausted; -2 levels) = 2nd level; as ray of enfeeblement, but penalty is 1.5x greater vs. a fatigued or exhausted target.

sections.heading: Escaping WardARG
sections.text: Escaping WardARG: Skill enhancement (Acrobatics; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (feat: Combat Reflexes; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; you gain +1/2 levels (+5 max.) enhancement to Acrobatics and +20 ft. to speed for 1 rd./level, plus additional immediate actions used to take the additional movement.

sections.heading: Essential BladeRR2
sections.text: Essential BladeRR2: Bestow feat (1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 feat/3 levels; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (BAB +11 effects; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (melee weapon; -2 levels) = 5th level; weapon affected gains ghost touch property (Ghost Strike), or single attacks are resolved as touch attacks (Unstoppable Strike), or penetrate any damage reduction or object hardness and ignore 75% of the target’s fortification (if any) (Penetrating Strike). Starting at CL 12th, it can make iterative attacks for either of those options (at a -5 penalty; Rapid Strike). At CL 15th and 18th, it also gains +3 to attacks and damage (Weapon Specialization) and a doubled crit range and auto-confirmed crits (Improved Critical), respectively.

sections.heading: Estate TransferrenceTM2
sections.text: Estate TransferrenceTM2: Create lesser demiplane (7th level) + Transdimensional Spell (elemental plane; +1 level) + Variable Spell (maintain material plane features as were; +1 level) = 9th level; you impinge up to one 20-ft. cube/level of the Material Plane as a demi-planar pocket in an elemnental plane of your choice. Invest 4,500 x CL numen to maintain the estate, or else re-cast the spell once per day.

sections.heading: Eternity of TortureBVD
sections.text: Eternity of TortureBVD: Damage attribute (1st level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 attribute/3 levels; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (Con never drained to 0; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (ailing; +1 level) + Fell Sickening (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (­1 level) = 9th level; 3d6 nonlethal plus 1d4 drain to all attributes and ailing (Intuition negates all effects; Fort halves attribute damage and reduces ailing to sickened, if that fails). Invest 450 x CL numen to maintain effect so that it repeats every day (affliction continuous) until some condition is met.

sections.heading: Ether BlastMP
sections.text: Ether BlastMP: Zephyr (0 level) + Shape Spell (line to emanation; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Transdimensional Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (moderate to tornado; +4 levels) = 5th level (listed as 4th); creates area of hurricane winds on the ethereal plane lasting 1 rd./level. Large or smaller creatures take 2d6 nonlethal damage and are blown 0.4 x CL miles away (assuming 240 mph winds and no resistance once initial movement begins) in a random direction.

sections.heading: Ethereal BarrierS&M
sections.text: Ethereal BarrierS&M: Hedge (incorporeal or on other plane; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (emanation to cubes; +0 levels) + Widen Spell (5-ft. to 10-ft. cubes; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Protection or Void domain; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 2nd); keeps out ethereal, incorporeal, etc. creatures, and prevents teleportation into area (outgoing is not affected).

sections.heading: Ethereal BoltRR
sections.text: Ethereal BoltRR: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to line; +1 level) + Transdimensional Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 vs. incorporeal and ethereal targets.

sections.heading: Ethereal Jaunt
sections.text: Ethereal Jaunt: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (ethereal plane; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 7th level. AKA wraithformUA1. Variants:

sections.heading: Ethereal MountMP
sections.text: Ethereal MountMP: Summon (ethereal horse-like being; 1st level) + Augment Spell (phantom steed template; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Augment Spell (+80’ to +100’; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (ethereal plane; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); ethereal mounts move at a speed of 160 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels through the ethereal plane.

sections.heading: Ethereal PrisonAUG2
sections.text: Ethereal PrisonAUG2: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+4d4; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (mindlink; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (dimensional pocket; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level (listed as 4th); helpless or willing subject sent to demi-plane, held in stasis if 5d4 Dex damage reduces to 0 or less, and caster can mentally communicate with subject. Invest 400 x CL numen to maintain indefinitely.

sections.heading: Etheric ShardsOcA
sections.text: Etheric ShardsOcA: Invisible needle (0 level) + Energy Admixture (slashing; +0 levels) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cubes; +2 levels) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Transdimensional Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) +  Reduce Spell (25d6 to 1d6; -5 levels) = 5th level (listed as 4th); volume of space deals damage and impedes movement on both material and ethereal planes.

sections.heading: Euphoric CloudACG
sections.text: Euphoric CloudACG: Compel (do nothing; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (wisp; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) = 6th level (listed as 2nd); creates 20’r. area of fog: save each round or fascinated.

sections.heading: Euphoric TranquilityAPG
sections.text: Euphoric TranquilityAPG: Bind (0 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Extend Spell ( 1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of beguiling; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) = 7th level (listed as 8th); victim touched is dazed, entangled, and takes a penalty to Cha equal to 1d6 + 1/levels (+15 max.) for 1 rd./level, no save.

sections.heading: Evacuation RuneCSc
sections.text: Evacuation RuneCSc: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to continental; +5 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (to site marked by pre-drawn rune only; -2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (rune can be destroyed, ruining spell; -1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) = 5th level; as a swift action, you teleport to location of mark placed in advance (up to 100 mi./level away).

sections.heading: Evade BurstSRD
sections.text: Evade BurstSRD: Bestow feat (Lightning Reflexes; 1st level) + Augment Spell (6 ranks effects; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Acrobatics; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) = 4th level; you gain +2 to Reflex saves, +1/2 levels to Actobatics, and evasion 1 rd. as an immediate action.

sections.heading: Ever ScentRR
sections.text: Ever ScentRR: Figment (0 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Shape Spell (cubes to emanation; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (no auditory or visual; -1 level) = 2nd level; illusory scent in 20’r. around you lasts 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Ever Scent, GreaterRR
sections.text: Ever Scent, GreaterRR: Variable Spell (see below; +1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level:

sections.heading: EvergreenFB
sections.text: EvergreenFB: Spark of life (1st level) + Cascade Spell (inure: cold; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (plants only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; ­1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; plants in area healed 1d6 hp/level (max. 5d6) and gain resistance 5/2 levels (max. 30) to cold for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Exalted FuryBED
sections.text: Exalted FuryBED: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Bane Spell (evil: fixed; +0 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Inexorable Evocation (+3 levels) + Selective Spell (you take damage as well; -1 level) + Restricted Spell ([good] descriptor; -1 level) = 9th level; damage cap 120 hp (160 vs. evil; half force, half holy) in 40’r. burst around you (no save, and you take full damage). Variant:

sections.heading: Excellent Prisnatic Spray, The (Jack Vance, The Dyring Earth)
sections.text: Excellent Prisnatic Spray, The (Jack Vance, The Dyring Earth): Jet of flame (0 level) + Energy Admixture (piercing; +0 levels) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Irresistible Evocation (+2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Mazimize Spell (+2 levels) + Heighten Spell (+1 level) = 6th level; damage cap 10d6+120 to one target (half piercing, half fire).

sections.heading: Excruciating DeformationUM
sections.text: Excruciating DeformationUM: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (1d4 to 1d2, 15d6 to 5d6, and 50’ to 30’; -2 levels) = 3rd level. Victim takes 5d6 nonlethal plus 1d2 Dex and 1d2 Con per round, and speed is reduced by 30 ft. (to a minimum 10 ft.), for 1 rd./level (save each round to end effect).

sections.heading: Exhalation of ChernRR2
sections.text: Exhalation of ChernRR2: Damage attribute (Int; 1st level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) = 5th level; cone deals 1d4 Int drain +1d4/rd.

sections.heading: Exhalation of the Black DragonSRD
sections.text: Exhalation of the Black DragonSRD: Acid spash (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) = 1st level (listed as 3rd); damage cap 5d6 acid.

sections.heading: Exile from Nature, Denev’sRR
sections.text: Exile from Nature, Denev’sRR: Ray of beguiling (1st level) + Creature-Specific Spell (penalty applies vs. animals, druids, rangers, etc. only; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement; +1 level) + Variable Spell (1 skill/rd.; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (wilderness only; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (druid or access to Animal domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (+10 to +5; -1 level) = 3rd level;  victim suffers Cha penalty (1d6+1/2 levels, +5 max.) vs. animals, druids, rangers, etc., and takes penalty to skill checks (-1/2 levels, -5 max.) when in the wilderness. Invest 150 x CL numen to make effect permanent.

sections.heading: ExorcisePH1
sections.text: ExorcisePH1: Remove condition (possession; 1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +3 levels) + Augment Spell (serious; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 4th level; dispels possession, plus charm and domination at CL 6th, curses at 9th, etc.

sections.heading: ExpansionSRD
sections.text: ExpansionSRD: Enlarge (3rd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; your size is increased by 1 step.

sections.heading: Expeditious Retreat, SwiftCAd
sections.text: Expeditious Retreat, SwiftCAd: Expeditious retreat (q.v.; 1st level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 1st level; swift action grants you +30 ft. speed for 1 rd. AKA burstSRD, wind strideToB.

sections.heading: Explode HeadOcA
sections.text: Explode HeadOcA: Enegy mace (0 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Explosive Rune FieldPHII
sections.text: Explosive Rune FieldPHII: Jet of flame (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Delay Spell (until living creature enters area; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 5d6; -3 levels) = 4th level; 5d6 fire/rd. and difficult terrain in 20’r.

sections.heading: Explosive Runes
sections.text: Explosive Runes: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Shape Spell (burst; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Delay Spell (when read; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (trap on written media only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6.

sections.heading: Extend LifeAUG
sections.text: Extend LifeAUG: Remove condition (attribute loss from aging; 1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 attribute/3 levels; +3 levels) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (+2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 7th); removes 1d4 penalty from aging from 1 attribute/3 levels (Str, Dex, and Con; Wis at CL 12th, Int at 15th, Cha at 18th). Cf. age resistanceUM.

sections.heading: Extended ChargeAUG2
sections.text: Extended ChargeAUG2: Variable Spell (choose spell activated; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (activated from charged item only; -2 levels) + Expedient Spell (max. spell level; ad hoc -1 level) = 3rd level; spend 1 charge at casting, thereafter activate spell effect of 4th level or less from a wand or other charged item every round for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: ExtensionPH1
sections.text: ExtensionPH1: Bestow feat (Extend Spell; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Sudden Metamagic; +2 levels) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) = 4th level; as swift action, next spell cast that round has double the normal duration, as if by the Sudden Metamagic (Extend Spell) feat (limits to total spell level, etc. apply).

sections.heading: Extract DrugBVD
sections.text: Extract DrugBVD: Creation (1st level) + Augment Spell (special substance; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd./level; -2 levels) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Extract GiftFC1
sections.text: Extract GiftFC1: Variable Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (2 targets: one mortal and one demon; +1 level):

sections.heading: Extradimensional PocketTM2
sections.text: Extradimensional PocketTM2: Dimensional pocket (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 27 lbs./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 5th); you store up to 27 lbs./level in a temporary bag of holding.

sections.heading: Extreme FlexibilityACG
sections.text: Extreme FlexibilityACG: Bestow feat (Improved Grapple; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (applies to escaping or avoid grapples only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Escape Artist; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; you gain +2 vs. grapples and +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Escape Artist checks.

sections.heading: Eye of PowerPGF
sections.text: Eye of PowerPGF: Arcane eye (q.v.; 3rd level) + Reach Spell (spell origin: touch to line of sight; +4 levels) + Delay Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Tenuous Spell (using reach ends spell effect; -1 level) = 9th level; as arcane eye, but you can end the spell by casting another non-personal spell through the eye.

sections.heading: Eye of the BeholderBVD
sections.text: Eye of the BeholderBVD: Skill enhancement (Perception; 0 level) + Variable Spell (choose ray each round; +1 level):

sections.heading: Eyebite
sections.text: Eyebite: Sickening touch (0 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) = 6th level; damage cap 15d6 nonlethal plus sickened and panicked; repeat as a swift action each round.

sections.heading: Eyes of DarknessCRB
sections.text: Eyes of DarknessCRB: Light (0 level) + Widen Spell (20 ft. to 30 ft.; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3 levels) + Variable Spell (augmentation does not dazzle or blind you; +1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 min./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Darkness domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; swift casting allows you to see in darkness (even supernatural darkness) for 1 rd.

sections.heading: Eyes of the VoidACG
sections.text: Eyes of the VoidACG: Light (0 level) + Widen Spell (20 ft. to 60 ft.; +3 levels) + Augment Spell (normal to blinding; +4 levels) + Selective Spell (augmentation does not dazzle or blind you; +1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 min./level; -1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (single creature only benefits from “light”; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; you can see normally for 60 ft. in dim light and darkness, or magical darkness is mitigated for you by 5 steps (meaning that you still treat eldritch darkness as being fully dark). Devil’s eyeBVD (3rd level) extends only to 30 ft.
