Cascade Spell (ray of beguiling; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) = +4 levels; 1d6 +1/level (+20 max.).Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteCasscade Spell (whelm; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to ray; +0 levels) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) = +4 levels; 6 x CL nonlethal damage (max. 120).Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteCascade Spell (damage attribute: Dex; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Crippling Drain (+2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = +4 levels; 3d4 Dex drain (as flesh to stone).Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteCascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Fell Frightening (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Augment Spell (frightened to cowering; +1 level) = +4 levels; victim is cowering (Will shaken) 1 rd./level.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteCascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) = +4 levels; victim is staggered 1 rd./level.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteCascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) = +4 levels; 6 x CL negative energy damage (max. 120).Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteCascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = +4 levels; ray deals 4d4 Con damage (Fort half).Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteCascade Spell (mage hand; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 27 lbs./level; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) = +4 levels; telekinesis effect.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
+ Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) = 7th level; +1/2 levels to Perception and activate one ray/round as a partial action (choose each round).

sections.heading: Fabricate, GreaterSRD
sections.text: Fabricate, GreaterSRD: Fabricate (q.v.; 5th level) + Widen Spell (8 cu. ft./level to 216 cu. ft./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (transmuter; -1 level) = 6th level.

sections.heading: Fade into DarknessDU
sections.text: Fade into DarknessDU: Skill enhancement (Stealth; 0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +5; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Darkness domain or able to use darkness as spell-like ability; -1 level) = 0 level; you gain +1/level (+5 max.) to Stealth for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Faerie Fire
sections.text: Faerie Fire: Warding (glamers; 1st level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (concealment only; -2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (dim light; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Sun or Void domain; -1 level) = 1st level; creatures and objects in burst glow softly, lose concealment from darkness or glamer spells (blur, invisibility, etc.) for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Faithful Phantom Defenders, Mordenkainen’sGA
sections.text: Faithful Phantom Defenders, Mordenkainen’sGA: Summon (1st level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Selective Spell (summoned monsters not affected by your spells; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2 levels) = 5th level; summons 1d4+1 Resolute blue sharks, dire bats, or 4th level human warriors, or 1d3 Resolute centaurs.

sections.heading: Faithful Phantom Guardian, Mordenkainen’sGA
sections.text: Faithful Phantom Guardian, Mordenkainen’sGA: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 6; +4 levels) + Delay Spell (appears when attacked; +1 level) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level; summons one human ghost fighter 3/warrior 3 with the Ghost Strike, Improved Initiative, and Permanent Spell (see invisibility) feats, and the Shield Other talent.

sections.heading: Faithful Phantom Shield-Maidens, Morden-kainen’sGA
sections.text: Faithful Phantom Shield-Maidens, Morden-kainen’sGA: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (2 summoned; + 1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 2; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 4th level; summons a pair of 3rd level Resolute human fighters with chainmail, heavy shields, and spears (Exotic use); the Armor Training and Shield Other talents; and the Shared Shield feat.

sections.heading: False BravadoMW
sections.text: False BravadoMW: Compel (act as though raging; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (touch of fatigue; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); subject is convinved it is raging (as barbarian rage), refrains from casting spells and attempts to use Power Attack, etc., for 1 rd./level or until saves, is fatigued thereafter.

sections.heading: False FlavorRR2
sections.text: False FlavorRR2: Glamer (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (food or drink; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (emanaton to cubes; +0 levels) + Augment Spell (olfactory/taste; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20-ft. to 1-ft. cubes; -3 levels) = 0 level; alters taste of 1 cu. ft./level of food or drink.

sections.heading: False FutureUI
sections.text: False FutureUI: Glamer (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) = 5th level; for 1 hr./level, divinations reveal fictitious destiny, events, etc. concerning subject.

sections.heading: False LieCM
sections.text: False LieCM: Skill enhancement (Bluff; 0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (glamer; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 2nd level; Bluff checks to sense subject’s motive or detect his/her lies are at -1/2 levels (-10 max.), and failure indicates observer believes subject to be lying. Likewise, failed lie detection spells indicate a lie, rather than no result. Invest 400 x CL numen (2nd level x 50 x 4) to maintain the effect beyond 1 rd./level. Cf. deceitful veneerUI.

sections.heading: False PriestDr353
sections.text: False PriestDr353: Warding (lie detection; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Cultist domain or demon lord/archdevil/Great Old One parton deity; -1 level) = 3rd level; you are immune to magical attempts to uncover falsehood (discern lies, zone of truth, etc.).

sections.heading: False ResurrectionUI
sections.text: False ResurrectionUI: Summon (1st level) + Ruse Spell (raise dead; +1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 9 Advanced shadow demon; +5 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 2 hrs./level; +4 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (into corpse to be possessed; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 6th level (listed as  7th); apparent raise dead ritual instead summons an Advanced shadow demon (Perform: acting 9/+20) to possess the corpse, and magical aura, etc. are disguised to appear correct.

sections.heading: False Resurrection, GreaterUI
sections.text: False Resurrection, GreaterUI: False resurrection (q.v.; 6th level) + Augment Spell (CR 12 Young belier devil; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 8th level (listed as 9th); apparent resurrection instead causes belier devil to possess the corpse. Invest 400 x CL numen to maintain indefinitelty.

sections.heading: False Sensory InputSRD
sections.text: False Sensory InputSRD: Glamer (1st level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (defeats true seeing, etc.; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level; phantasm with auditory, visual, and/or olfactory components, which you can change from round to round, lasts for as long as you concentrate.

sections.heading: False Vision
sections.text: False Vision: Glamer (1st level) + Variable Spell (change image; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (visible to scrying only; -2 levels) + Widen Spell (10’r. to 30’t.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 5th level; scrying area reveals illusion.

sections.heading: False Vision, GreaterUI
sections.text: False Vision, GreaterUI:  Glamer (1st level) + Variable Spell (change image; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (visible to scrying only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to planar; +5 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level)  = 7th level; scrying on individual reveals illusory actions and surroundings.

sections.heading: Familiar MeldingUM
sections.text: Familiar MeldingUM: Magic jar (5th level) + Creature-Specific Spell (your familiar; -2 levels) = 3rd level; you possess your familiar, leaving your body helpless.

sections.heading: Familiar RefugeCM
sections.text: Familiar RefugeCM: Greater teleport (7th level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (you or your familiar; -2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) = 7th level; swift casting brings your familiar to you (or vice versa). Cf. callbackUW.

sections.heading: FamiliarityRRO
sections.text: FamiliarityRRO: Blessing (0 level) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Insightful Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 total; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (vs. specified target only; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 5th); you gain +4 insight to atks, damage, and AC vs. specified target.

sections.heading: Family CurseAUG
sections.text: Family CurseAUG: Blessing (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +4; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (relatives of priary target only; -1 level) = 6th level (listed as 3rd); up to 1 related creature (members of family)/3 levels takes -4 penalty to attacks, damage, and saves for 1 min./level; invest 600 x CL numen to maintain indefinitely.

sections.heading: Fang TrapSK
sections.text: Fang TrapSK: Invisible needle (0 level) + Energy Admixture (bludgeoning; +0 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grappled; +1 level) + Delay Spell (proximity trigger; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); when triggered, damage cap 10d6 (half bludgeoning, half piercing) plus grappled 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Fantastic MachineFRCS
sections.text: Fantastic MachineFRCS: Summon (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Augmernt Spell (CR 3; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Artifice domain; ­1 level) = 4th level (listed as 6th); conjures one construct:

sections.heading: Far ReachingTM2
sections.text: Far ReachingTM2: Bestow Feat (Reach Spell; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Sudden Metamagic; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) = 2nd level; spells you cast for the next round have their range increased, as if by the Sudden Metamagic (Reach Spell) feat (limits to total spell level, etc. apply). This also subsumes telethaumaturgyTM2.

sections.heading: FarfingerRR2
sections.text: FarfingerRR2: Invisible needle (0 level) + Variable Spell (effect aimed by secondary subjects; +1 level) + Delay Spell (as used; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (skeleton; -2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) = 3rd level; 1 skeleton/level can make 1 ranged touch attack/level (max. 10) for 1d6 piercing each.

sections.heading: Fast EscapeBRL
sections.text: Fast EscapeBRL: Skill enhancement (Escape Artist; 0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +10; +1 level) = 1st level; you gain +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Escape Artist checks.

sections.heading: Fatal FlameCSc
sections.text: Fatal FlameCSc: Jet of flame (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (when subject killed; +1 level) = 1st level; when killed, subject explodes for up to 5d6 fire damage to adjacent creatures.

sections.heading: Fate LinkSRD
sections.text: Fate LinkSRD: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Variable Spell (Versatile Evocation; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (two subjects; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (seer or access to Community domain, etc.; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (+20 to +10; -2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 3rd); any time one subject takes damage, the other takes 1d6+10 of the same type, if within Close range.

sections.heading: Fate’s ProofRW
sections.text: Fate’s ProofRW: Hand of fate (0 level) + Quicken Spell (+4 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (halfling or Destined bloodline, Fate domain, etc.; -1 level) = 3rd level; reroll any one roll as an immediate action, after learning results of first.

sections.heading: Favor of IlmaterPGF
sections.text: Favor of IlmaterPGF: Warding (1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Endurance; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 effect/3 levels; +2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 4th); subject +1/2 levels to Endurance, and is immune to Cha damage, compulsions, and nonlethal damage for 1 min./level (and existing effects suppressed), plus the following at higher caster levels: 12th—inertia, 15th—affictions, 18th—pain effects.

sections.heading: Favorable WindSW
sections.text: Favorable WindSW: Zephyr (0 level) + Shape Spell (line to cone; +1 level) + Widen Spell (30 ft, to 60 ft.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); creates severe wind in a 60-ft. cone (can fill sails of ship).

sections.heading: Fear and Weakness GazeFC2
sections.text: Fear and Weakness GazeFC2: Ray of enfeeblement (1st level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Pattern Spell (visual; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; each round as a swift action, one creature within close range takes a 1d6 +1/2 levels penalty to Str (Fort half) and is frightened (Will neg.).

sections.heading: Fear ContagionTM2
sections.text: Fear ContagionTM2: Spook (0 level) + Fell Frightening (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (cowering to panicked; -1 level) = 8th level; up to 1 creature/level is panicked (Will shaken) for 1 hr./level, and emanates aura of panic in a 20’r.

sections.heading: Fear WardCWH
sections.text: Fear WardCWH: Warding (fear; 1st level) + Irresistible Spell (+3 levels) + Mass Effect Spell [(all schools; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead casters only; ­2 levels)] + Cascade Spell (hedge: undead; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (10’r. emanation to 5’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 7th level (listed as 8th); subject immune to fear and magical abilities of undead, and undead cannot approach within 5 ft.

sections.heading: Fearful TouchAPG
sections.text: Fearful TouchAPG: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+2; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (warding: fear immunity; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min,/level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) = 2nd level; touch removes resistances/immunities to fear, and subject -2 to atks, damage, saves vs. fear for 1 rd.

sections.heading: Fearsome Aspect, Phade’sDr333
sections.text: Fearsome Aspect, Phade’sDr333: Glamer (1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Bluff; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Staredown; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +11 effects; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 6th level (listed as 2nd); subject gains illusory demonic appearance, can demoralize 30’r. as a partial action with +1/2 levels to the check.

sections.heading: Fearsome DuplicateARG
sections.text: Fearsome DuplicateARG: Figment (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (vision and hearing; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Bluff; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (halfling; -1 level) = 3rd level; larger, monstrous image of you at medium range mimics you, serves as scrying sensor, and provides +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Bluff checks.

sections.heading: Fearsome GrappleWotC
sections.text: Fearsome GrappleWotC: Bestow feat (Improved Grapple; 1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +6 effects; +1 level) + Personal Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level; as a partial action, you gain +3 to grapple checks plus grab and maintain grapple.

sections.heading: Feast of AshesAPG
sections.text: Feast of AshesAPG: Warding (nutrition; 1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (normal food; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 3rd level; target immediately begins to starve (invest numen to maintain effect: 3rd x CL 5th x 50 x 6 = 4,500).

sections.heading: Feast of WormsDD
sections.text: Feast of WormsDD: Summon (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 4 lard wormCrC colony; +2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 2nd); summons lard worm colony into opponent’s space.

sections.heading: Feast on FearACG
sections.text: Feast on FearACG: Spook (0 level) + Concentration Spell (swift; +5 levels) + Cascade Spell (lesser false life; +1 level) + Expedient Spell (-1 level) = 5th level; 1 attack/rd. panics (shaken if save) and grants you 5 temp. hp; creatures over 9 HD unaffected.

sections.heading: Feat LeechSRD
sections.text: Feat LeechSRD: Bestow feat (1st level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (feats must be known by creature touched; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); you gain up to 1 feat/3 levels known by creature you touch; target loses same feats for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Feather StepAPG
sections.text: Feather StepAPG: Skill enhancement (Acrobatics; 0 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (difficult terrain only; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 to +10; +1 level) = 1st level; subject +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Acrobatics checks to ignore difficult terrain. Note that the spell does not grant outright immunity to difficult terrain.

sections.heading: FeathersMW
sections.text: FeathersMW: Polymorph (animal; 3rd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (Small mundane bird; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (willing subjects; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Animal domain; -1 level) = 4th level; one willing subject/level is polymorphed into a Small crow, owl, etc. (low-light vision, fly 60 ft.) for up to 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: FeedbackAUG2
sections.text: FeedbackAUG2: Electric arc (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 4th level; for next 1 rd./level, subject takes 1d6 +1/level (+15 max.) electrical damage whenever performing specified action.

sections.heading: FermentationRRE
sections.text: FermentationRRE: Creation (alcohol; 1st level) + Variable Spell (type appropriate to starting liquid; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 1 pint/level; -2 levels) = 0 level; beverage becomes alcoholic (as if brewed/fermented); if already so, becomes more so (as if distilled). Cf. deCamp & Pratt, “The Mathematics of Magic.”

sections.heading: FesterAPG
sections.text: FesterAPG: Warding (healing; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 level) = 2nd level; subject immune to spark of life-based spells for 1 min./level (Fort half). Variants:

sections.heading: Festering StrikePF113
sections.text: Festering StrikePF113: Damage attribute (Str; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Str; +1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Pestilence domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; as a [strike], deal 1d4 Str and Con damage and cause victim to be sickened 1 rd./level (Fort half/neg.).

sections.heading: Fever DreamCM
sections.text: Fever DreamCM: Whelm (0 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (ailing; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Fey Form IUW
sections.text: Fey Form IUW: Polymorph (fey; 3rd level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Magical Talent; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Magical Array; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (90 ft. to 30 ft., etc.; -1 level) = 4th level; you assume fey form, gain low-light vision, +2 Dex, +2 natural armor, iron allergy, suite of fey spell-like abilities (as applicable to type, max. level equal to level of fey form spell, even if Concentration allows higher), plus water breathing and/or fly 30 ft., swim 30 ft., up to 3 natural attacks (as applicable to form).

sections.heading: Fey Form IIUW
sections.text: Fey Form IIUW: Fey form IUW (q.v.; 4th level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (enlarge self or reduce self; +1 level) = 6th level (druid 5th); become Tiny to Large fey, gain applicable 5th level abilities.

sections.heading: Fey Form IIIUW
sections.text: Fey Form IIIUW: Fey form IIUW (q.v.; 6th level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) = 7th level (druid 6th); become Tiny to Large fey with applicable 7th level abilities, or become Diminutive or Huge fey with 5th level abilities.

sections.heading: Fey Form IVUW
sections.text: Fey Form IVUW: Fey form IIIUW (q.v.; 7th level) + Augment Spell (+2 levels) = 9th level (druid 8th); become Tiny to Large fey with applicable 9th level abilities, or Diminutive or Huge with 7th level, or Fine with 6th level.

sections.heading: Fey GateUW
sections.text: Fey GateUW: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (destination: close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (Faerieland; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (random location on that plane, with no control; -1 level) + Shape Spell (target to vertical wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 2.5-ft. squares; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Variable Spell (2-way gate; +1 level) = 7th level (listed as 8th); creates 2-way gate to Faeireland, but each creature entering the portal arrives at a random location on that plane.

sections.heading: Fey StorageAUG2
sections.text: Fey StorageAUG2: Dimensional pocket (1st level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 3 lbs./level; +1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st).

sections.heading: Fey WardAUG2
sections.text: Fey WardAUG2: Hedge (fey; 2nd level) + Widen Spell (10’r. to 20’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 3rd level; fey cannot enter mobile emanation unless it fails to bypass their SR.

sections.heading: Field of GhoulsLM
sections.text: Field of GhoulsLM: Ray of entropy (0 level) + Cascade Spell (lesser animate dead; +3 levels) + Augment Spell (CR 2; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Knowledge (planes); +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Death or Hunger domain; −1 level) = 7th level; damage cap 15d6 negative energy/rd. in 20’r. around you, dead creatures in emanation rise as ghouls (if 2- HD) or ghasts (3+ HD), and your Command Undead capacity (if any) is enhanced while the spell lasts.

sections.heading: Field of LawDLM
sections.text: Field of LawDLM: Dispel (0 level) + Variable Spell (dispel effect or suppress ability; +1 level) + Irresitible Spell (can suppress (Sp) or (Su) ability; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell ([lawful] bloodline, domain, etc.; -1 level) = 2nd level; touch dispels one active spell effect or suppresses one (Sp) or (Su) ability for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Fiendish ClarityBVD
sections.text: Fiendish ClarityBVD: Eyes of the void (q.v.; 4th level) + Cascade Spell (see invisibility, q.v.; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell ([evil] caster; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 7th); you can see normally for in 60 ft. in dim light, darkness, and supernatural darkness for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Fiendish QuickeningBVD
sections.text: Fiendish QuickeningBVD: Bestow feat (Innate Metamagic: Quicken dimensional skip; 1st level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +3 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (can use 1/level, not 3/day or whatever; +3 levels) = 7th level; choose a [teleportation] spell-like ability you possess; it is Quickened for 1 rd./level. Cf. QuickshiftBED.

sections.heading: Fiery Constrictor, Forest’sTM2
sections.text: Fiery Constrictor, Forest’sTM2: Jet of flame (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 6th); damage cap 15d6/rd. plus grab (damage applies each round grappled).

sections.heading: Fiery ShurikenUC
sections.text: Fiery ShurikenUC: Jet of flame (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Delay Spell (use over multiple rounds; +1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 12d6 fire, divided among multiple ranged touch attacks, not all of which need to be made at once.

sections.heading: Fiery VintageRRO
sections.text: Fiery VintageRRO: Jet of flame (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +4 levels) + Bane Spell (special; +0 levels) + Augment Spell (10d6 to 15d6; +1 level) = 5th level (listed as 8th); damage cap 15d6 fire, or 15d8 vs. those who ingested alcohol in the last hour (Fort half).

sections.heading: FilterCWH
sections.text: FilterCWH: Zephyr (0 level) + Shape Spell (line to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 2nd level; mobile 10’r. emanation of strong wind keeps out smoke, gases, fog, etc. Cf. life bubbleAPG. Variants:

sections.heading: FimbulwinterFB
sections.text: FimbulwinterFB: Control weather (7th level) + Widen Spell (1 mile to 1 mi./level; +2 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (concentration to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Winter domain; ­0 levels) + Variable Spell (roll randomly for conditions; ­1 level) + Reduce Spell (tornado to windstorm and 25d6 to 15d6; -2 levels) = 8th level; 1,600 x CL numen to maintain. Roll for each condition each day:

sections.heading: Finale, DeadlyAPG
sections.text: Finale, DeadlyAPG: Sound lance (1st level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Lingering Evocation (+3 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 5th level; damage cap 15d6 sonic plus 3d6 bleed (Fort half/neg.).

sections.heading: Finale, PurgingAPG
sections.text: Finale, PurgingAPG: Remove condition (1st level) + Variable Spell (select condition at time of casting; +1 level) + Augment Spell (serious; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (under effect of your bardic inspiration; -2 levels) = 3rd level; removes one serious condition in an inspired subject.

sections.heading: Finale, RevivingAPG
sections.text: Finale, RevivingAPG: Spark of life (1st level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (under effect of your bardic inspiration; -2 levels) = 3rd level; cures 5d6 hp.

sections.heading: Finale, SavingAPG
sections.text: Finale, SavingAPG: Hand of fate (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (saving throw; -2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (under effect of your bardic inspiration; -2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (casting ends any bardic inspiration you are maintaining; -1 level)  = 1st level; target can immediately re-roll one saving throw w/+1 resistance bonus, but this ends inspiration you are maintaining.

sections.heading: Finale, StunningAPG
sections.text: Finale, StunningAPG: Inertia (0 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +4 levels) + Fell Staggering (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) + Tenuous Spell (casting ends any bardic inspiration you are maintaining; -1 level) = 5th level; stuns up to 1 creature/3 levels for 1 rd. (Fort flat-footed).

sections.heading: Find QuarryUC
sections.text: Find QuarryUC: Divination (specific individual creature known to you; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to line of sight; +4 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Inquisition domain; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; 1st round—learn presence; 2nd—distance and direction; 3rd—mode, speed, and direction of movement. The ranger version of the spell (also 4th level, but more restricted) has a range of Continental rather than Line of Sight.

sections.heading: Finger Darts, Lahm’sBVD
sections.text: Finger Darts, Lahm’sBVD: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+1d4; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Str; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 2nd); one ranged touch/3 levels deals 2d4 Dex, but you take 1d4 Str (Fort ½).

sections.heading: Fins to FeetSW
sections.text: Fins to FeetSW: Polymorph (3rd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (willing subject; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (speed only 30 ft., lose swim speed; -2 levels) = 2nd level; creature touched loses swim speed, gains land speed (base 30 ft. for Medium).

sections.heading: Fire BoltPH5
sections.text: Fire BoltPH5: Jet of flame (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) = 1st level; damage cap 5d6. Variants:

sections.heading: Fire CharmPH1
sections.text: Fire CharmPH1: Compel (fascination; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (suggestion; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (existing fire; -2 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; those within 20’r. of fire are fascinated 1 rd/level and susceptible to a suggestion made during that time.

sections.heading: Fire of VengeanceAPG
sections.text: Fire of VengeanceAPG: Jet of flame (0 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Delay Spell (attacks someone other than you; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 4th); the next time an opponent you hit attacks someone other than you, they take 5d6 fire damage.

sections.heading: Fire Quill7S
sections.text: Fire Quill7S: Glamer (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (fiery letters; -2 levels) = 1st level; for the next 1 min./level, focus pen or feather seems to write in letters of fire that disappear at the end of the duration. Words of fire7S (2nd level) lasts 2 min./level instead.

sections.heading: Fire Seeds
sections.text: Fire Seeds: Jet of flame (0 level) + Cascade Spell (sparkAPG: q.v.; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Delay Spell (swift activation; +4 levels) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (druid; -1 level) = 6th level.

sections.heading: Fire Shield
sections.text: Fire Shield: Inure (0  level) + Variable Spell (fire or cold; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell [(ray of frost or jet of flame; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels)] + Augment Spell (30 to 40; +1 level) = 4th level; you gain fire or cold resistance 5/2 levels (max. 40), and melee attackers take 1d6 +1/level (+15 max.) cold or fire on each hit made against you. Variants:

sections.heading: Fire SnakeAPG
sections.text: Fire SnakeAPG: Jet of flame (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. cubes to 5-ft. cubes; -1 level) + Augment Spell (10d6 to 15d6; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 5th); damage cap 15d6 fire in one 5-ft. cube/level. Variants:

sections.heading: Fire StrideSC
sections.text: Fire StrideSC: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Cascade Spell (detect fire; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 jump/level; +3 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (jump between fires; -2 levels) = 4th level; 1 standard action long-range teleport/level between fires.

sections.heading: Fire Trap
sections.text: Fire Trap: Jet of flame (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Selective Spell (password; +1 level) + Delay Spell (when opened; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6. Note numen investiture for latent spells: e.g., 2nd level x CL 3rd x 50 = 300.

sections.heading: Fire, RecoilUC
sections.text: Fire, RecoilUC: Topple (0 level) + Cascade Spell (dispel; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (wand, loaded firearm, etc.; -2 levels) = 0 level; expends 1 charge or shot to knock wielder prone.

sections.heading: Fire, ThunderUC
sections.text: Fire, ThunderUC: Alter senses (deafness; 0 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (loaded firearm or charged wand or staff as origin point; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (dispel; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = 2nd level; expends 1 charge or shot to deafen those in 10’r. for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Fireball
sections.text: Fireball: Jet of flame (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 fire in 20’r. bust (Reflex half). Variants:

sections.heading: FirelightS&M
sections.text: FirelightS&M: Light (0 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Fire or Sun domain; -1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Fires of PurityCD
sections.text: Fires of PurityCD: Jet of flame (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (inure: fire; +1 level) = 5th level (listed as 6th); subject deals up to +20d6 fire total, divided among melee attacks (max. +15d6 for any one), has resistance 5/2 levels (40 max.) to fire, and melee attackers take 1d6+15 fire damage per hit.

sections.heading: FirestaffDr181
sections.text: FirestaffDr181:: Jet of flame (0 level) + Enegy Admixture (bludgeoning; +0 levels) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) = 1st level (listed as 2nd); 2 melee attacks/rd. for 1d6 bludgeoning + up to 2d6 fire each.

sections.heading: FissionSRD
sections.text: FissionSRD: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 10; +6 levels) = 7th level; you split off an 11th level version of yourself with mundane gear only, lasting 1 rd./level. Variants:

sections.heading: Fist of StoneCA
sections.text: Fist of StoneCA: [Energy mace (0 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +3 levels) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (5d6 to 1d6; -1 level)] + Cascade Spell [(attribute boost: Str; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+6 total bonus; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level)] = 1st level (0 level with access to Earth domain); you gain +6 enhancement to Str and slam attack (base 1d6) for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Five-Shadow Creeping Ice Enervation StrikeToB
sections.text: Five-Shadow Creeping Ice Enervation StrikeToB: Ray of frost (0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Flame Arrow
sections.text: Flame Arrow: Jet of flame (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Item-Specific Spell (ranged weapon or ammunition; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level; +8d6 fire/rd., divided among projectiles fired from target weapon (max. +5d6 for one), for the next 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Flame Strike
sections.text: Flame Strike: Jet of flame (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cylinder; +2 levels) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (10d6 to 15d6; +1 level) = 5th level; damage cap 15d6 (half fire, half holy) in 10’r., 50-ft.-tall cylinder. Variant:

sections.heading: Flame’s BlessingToB
sections.text: Flame’s BlessingToB: Inure (fire; 0 level) + Augment Spell (5 to 50; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 1st level; you gain resistance to fire 5/2 ranks in Acrobatics for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Flaming Sphere
sections.text: Flaming Sphere: Jet of flame (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6. Variants:

sections.heading: Flare
sections.text: Flare: Light (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (dazzling; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (light: 10 min./level to inst.; -3 levels) + Extend Spell (dazzling: 1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Shape Spell (emanation to target; -2 levels) = 0 level; single target is dazzled for 1 rd./level. Variants:

sections.heading: Flaying TendrilsCM
sections.text: Flaying TendrilsCM: Energy mace (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Improved Grapple; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +6 effects; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Killing Stroke; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +11 effects; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 5th); as a standard action each round, make 4 tentacle melee attacks for up to 3d6 (base) each, plus grab and coup de grâce after 2 rounds pinned.

sections.heading: Fleet Feet of HermesRRO
sections.text: Fleet Feet of HermesRRO: Celerity (0 level) + Augment Spell (+10 ft. to +60 ft.; +5 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (land speed only; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); increases target’s land speed by 60 ft.

sections.heading: Flesh PuppetHA
sections.text: Flesh PuppetHA: Lesser animate deadUM (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (shaping; +2 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; animates zombie and disguises it as you see fit (with +1/2 level to your Perform: acting check). Variant:

sections.heading: Flesh to Stone
sections.text: Flesh to Stone: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Crippling Drain (+2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) = 6th level; 3d4 Dex drain (Fort neg.; petrified if Dex drained to 0 or lower). AKA crystallizeSRD (Cross-Class: shaper; +0 levels due to metamagic synergy), vitrificationAUG. Variants:

sections.heading: Flesh WallHA
sections.text: Flesh WallHA: Summon (1st level) + Summon Undead (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 6th level; summons 1 zombie/level, linked to form a wall 5 ft./level long.

sections.heading: FleshhammerDD
sections.text: FleshhammerDD: Damage attribute (1st level) + Augment Spell (+1d4; +1 level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Variable Spell (roll randomlty for attribute drained; -1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (bludgeoning weapon only; -2 levels) Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 6th); bludgeon deals +2d4 drain/rd. (divided among attacks) to randomly-determined attributes.

sections.heading: FleshshiverSC
sections.text: FleshshiverSC: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 15d6; -1 level) = 6th level; damage cap 15d6 bludgeoning plus dazed 1 rd. and nauseated 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Fleshworm InfestationUM
sections.text: Fleshworm InfestationUM: Invisible needle (0 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Dex; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) = 4th level; touch deals 1d6 piercing/level (max. 10d6), plus 1d6 piercing and 1d4 Dex per round and staggered for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Flickering LightsHA
sections.text: Flickering LightsHA: Light (0 level) + Cascade Spell (gloom; +1 level) + Augment Spell (bright light or 2 steps reduction; +1 level) + Variable Spell (no control over effects; -1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (emanation to cubes; +0 levels) = 2nd level; for 1 rd./level, roll at start of each creature’s turn to determine light in area: 1 = bright, 2-3 = normal, 4 = dim, 5 = ambient light reduced by 1 step, 6 = ambient light reduced by 2 steps (minimum darkness).

sections.heading: FlowsightSW
sections.text: FlowsightSW: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Augmernt Spell (additional senses: hearing, darkvision, etc.; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to continental; +4 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (touching same body of water you are; -2 levels) + Resistible Spell (save permitted; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 5th). You gain the ability to listen to and observe one creature (and area around it to Close range), or one specific location, up to 100 mi./level away if in contact with same body of water you are touching; maintain observation or change targets by concentration.

sections.heading: Flurry, Liliandel’sRR
sections.text: Flurry, Liliandel’sRR: Invisible needle (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Delay Spell (when arrow fired; +1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 12d6. When arrow fired, make 2 additional ranged attacks vs. same target for up to 6d6 piercing each (latent cost is 100 x CL numen).

sections.heading: Fly
sections.text: Fly: Mage hand (0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Fly; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Extend Spell (concentration to 1 min./level; +2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); creature touched flies at 60 ft. and gains +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Fly checks for 1 min./level. Variants:

sections.heading: Flying Feat, Drawmij’sGA
sections.text: Flying Feat, Drawmij’sGA: Mage hand (0 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 216 lbs./level; +4 levels) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; carpet, wagon, or whatever (216 lbs./level total weight of object, passengers, gear) flies at a 60-ft. speed while you concentrate. Variants:

sections.heading: Focused ScrutinyACG
sections.text: Focused ScrutinyACG: Skill enhancement (Bluff; 0 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 skill/3 levels; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (checks vs. specified target only; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (choose target at time of casting; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+5 to +10; +1 level) = 2nd level; you gain +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Bluff vs. creature specified (also Diplomacy at CL 6th, Perception at 9th, Survival at 12th, etc.).

sections.heading: Focusing ChantCAd
sections.text: Focusing ChantCAd: Blessing (0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement; +1 level) + Variable Spell (change skills as use; +1 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 1st level; you gain +1 morale to attacks, damage, checks, and saves vs. fear for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Foe of the UnluckyDr339
sections.text: Foe of the UnluckyDr339: Hand of fate (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (see below; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (hexblade; -1 level) = 2nd level; immediate casting forces reroll of one attack within range that scores a critical threat.

sections.heading: FoebaneCAd
sections.text: FoebaneCAd: Enhancement (2nd level) + Item-Specific Spell (manufactured weapon only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bolt of force; +3 levels) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (affects specific type only, chosen when prepared; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger; -2 levels) = 3rd level; damage cap +13d6. Weapon gains enhancement bonus of +1/4 levels against specified type and deals up to +10d6 damage (1 attack/rd.), +6d6 (2/rd.), +4d6 (3/rd.), or +3d6 (4/rd.) force damage for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: FoehammerToB
sections.text: FoehammerToB: Variable Spell (+1 level): magic weapon, metaphysical feat (Versatile Evocation: bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing), or lesser versatile weapon (1st level) + Selective Spell (variable option suited to target; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to inst,; -1 level) = 2nd level; [strike] bypasses metal-based, damage type, or magic DR.

sections.heading: Foil TracerAUG2
sections.text: Foil TracerAUG2: Warding (detection; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (teleport tracers only; -2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/3 levels; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) = 3rd level; 1 creature/3 levels can teleport w/o being traced for the next 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Fool’s ForbiddanceAPG
sections.text: Fool’s ForbiddanceAPG: Lesser compelling confusion (1st level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; +1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Tenuous Spell (staggered only if not confused; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard action; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 6th level; 10’r. aura confuses 1 rd. (staggered if save; check each round while you concentrate).

sections.heading: Fool’s GoldPH1
sections.text: Fool’s GoldPH1: Transmute (1st level) + Augment Spell (precious metal; +1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 hr./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Fool’s LuckBRL
sections.text: Fool’s LuckBRL: Hand of fate (0 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 2nd level; swift casting allows you to roll twice for everything for 1 rd., keeping better of the two rolls. Choose destinyRD is Quickened (+3 levels) rather than Sudden (and therefore lasts 1 rd./level), and is Restricted (access to Fate domain; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 9th)

sections.heading: Fool’s SpeechTM2
sections.text: Fool’s SpeechTM2: Tongues (3rd level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (unique secret language only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard or wild magic; -1 level) = 4th level; recipients can converse in a unique, secret language only they can understand. CodespeakUI is similar, except it affects only 1 creature/3 levels (-1 level) and lasts only 10 min./level (-1 level) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Forbid ActionUM
sections.text: Forbid ActionUM: Compel (refrain from action; 2nd level) + Variable Spell (select action at time of casting; +1 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoid; -2 levels) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Forbid Action, GreaterUM
sections.text: Forbid Action, GreaterUM: Compel (refrain from action; 2nd level) + Variable Spell (select action at time of casting; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) = 5th level.

sections.heading: Forbiddance
sections.text: Forbiddance: Warding (planar travel; 1st level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. cubes to 60-ft. cubes; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bolt of force; +2 levels) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (specified alignment components; -2 levels) = 6th level; damage cap 15d6 (half force, half holy) upon entering area. To make the effect permanent, invest 6,000 x CL numen as for a use-activated spell effect (6th level x 500 x 2 for duration).

sections.heading: Forbiddance, ElementalTM2
sections.text: Forbiddance, ElementalTM2: Hedge (elementals; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (emanation to cubes; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 5th); elementals cannot enter an area of one 5-ft. cube/level.

sections.heading: Forbidden SpeechBVD
sections.text: Forbidden SpeechBVD: Compel (do not communicate specific topic; 2nd level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 5th level; subject cannot communicate anything about one narrow, specific topic (e.g., identity of captors, formula for Classic Coke, etc.); invest 250 x CL numen to make permanent.

sections.heading: Force Hook ChargeUM
sections.text: Force Hook ChargeUM: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cascade Spell [(dimensional skip; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level)] = 3rd level; ranged touch deals up to 10d6 force and transports you adjacent to target.

sections.heading: Force of WillRR2
sections.text: Force of WillRR2: Attribute boost (0 level) + Variable Spell (select attribute at time of casting; +1 level) + Insightful Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+6 total bonus; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; you gain a +6 insight bonus to one attribute of your choice.

sections.heading: Force PunchUM
sections.text: Force PunchUM: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (push; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 10d6 plus bull rush. Cf. forcewaveMF.

sections.heading: Force Sculpture, Bigby’sGA
sections.text: Force Sculpture, Bigby’sGA: Creation (1st level) + Augment Spell (magical force; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (shaping; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 10 min./level; -1 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Force Sculpture, Bigby’s SuperiorGA
sections.text: Force Sculpture, Bigby’s SuperiorGA: Bigby’s force sculpture (3rd level) + Widen Spell (8 cu. ft./level; +1 level) + Augment Spell (moving parts, etc.; +2 levels) = 6th level.

sections.heading: Force Sculpture, Bigby’s Most ExcellentGA
sections.text: Force Sculpture, Bigby’s Most ExcellentGA: Bigby’s superior force sculpture (6th level) + Widen Spell (27 cu. ft./level; +1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 hr./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round to full ritual; -1 level) + Variable Spell (some flexible pieces; +1 level) = 8th level.

sections.heading: Force ShapechangeCD
sections.text: Force ShapechangeCD: Warding (polymorph; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Inquisition domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; returns shapeshifter to true form for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Force ShapechangeRE,CWH
sections.text: Force ShapechangeRE,CWH: Dispel (0 level) + Cascade Spell (acid splash; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (shapechangers only; -2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) = 5th level; 1 shapechanger/level takes 1d6 acid/level (max. 15d6) and resumes true form for 1 rd./level. Variants:

sections.heading: Force WaveSC
sections.text: Force WaveSC: Push (0 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Reach Spell (close to 0; -1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) = 4th level; swift action bull rushes away all within 10 ft. of you.

sections.heading: Force Wave, Dolomar’sRR
sections.text: Force Wave, Dolomar’sRR: Push (0 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) = 2nd level; bull rushes creatures, objects up to 3 lbs./level in 20’r. away from center.

sections.heading: Forcecage
sections.text: Forcecage: Mage armor (1st level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to hemisphere; +1 level) + Widen Spell (4’r./level to 1’r./level; -2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 7th level; no SR, but Reflex neg. Alternatively, substitute Inexorable Evocation for Extend Spell; there is no saving throw, but the cage lasts only 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: ForcewardMF
sections.text: ForcewardMF: Antilife shell (6th level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Resistible Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 4th level.

sections.heading: ForcewardSC
sections.text: ForcewardSC: Warding (force effects; 1st level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (hedge: incorporeal; +2 levels) + Resistible Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; 10’r. sphere keeps out [force] effects and incorporeal creatures.

sections.heading: ForcewaveMF
sections.text: ForcewaveMF: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (push; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 1d6; -3 levels) = 1st level; 1d6 force (Reflex half) plus bull rush vs. 1 target. Cf. force punchUM.

sections.heading: Forest FriendUC
sections.text: Forest FriendUC: Bestow feat (Favored Terrain: forests; 1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/3 levels; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level)  + Restricted Spell (druid or ranger; -1 level) = 3rd level; one ally/3 levels gains favored terrain (forests) +2 (note that the skill bonuses are enhancement bonuses, because they are being granted by a spell).

sections.heading: Forest’s SenseUW
sections.text: Forest’s SenseUW: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (other senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (sound, smell, and touch; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to line of sight; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (scry on target individual specified only; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (choose target at time of casting; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (plants/fungi within 10’r. of target act as scrying sensors; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level; to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 4th level; you can scry on target (sound, smell, touch/tremorsense) through nearby plants.

sections.heading: ForestfoldCAd
sections.text: ForestfoldCAd: Skill enhancement (Stealth; 0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (one type of terrain; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (choose terrain when cast; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +10; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (druid or ranger; -1 level) = 1st level; +1/2 levels (+10 max.) sacred bonus to Stealth in specific terrain.

sections.heading: ForetellingME
sections.text: ForetellingME: Variable Spell (blessing, deflection, or resistance; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Insightful Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level; each round, subject gains +1 insight bonus to attacks and damage, AC, or saves.

sections.heading: Forge of AirRRO
sections.text: Forge of AirRRO: Jet of flame (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. cubes to 1.25-ft. cubes; -1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (metal objects only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Artifice or Fire domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); area of space deals up to 5d6 fire/rd. to metal objects, allowing them to be forged.

sections.heading: Form of the Dragon ICRB
sections.text: Form of the Dragon ICRB: Polymorph (dragon; 3rd level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Str; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Con; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (enhancement: natural armor; +1 level) = 6th level; +4 Str, +2 Con, +2 natural armor +1/3 levels (max. +8 total at CL 16th), low-light vision, darkvision 120 ft., blindsense 60 ft., 5 natural attacks (bite 1d8, 2 claws 1d6, 2 wings 1d4), breath weapon 1d6/level (max. 15d6) in Long-range line or 30-ft. cone (up to 3x), fly 120 ft., DR 5/+1, resist energy 20.

sections.heading: Form of the Dragon IICRB
sections.text: Form of the Dragon IICRB: Form of the dragon I (6th level) + Cascade Spell (enlarge self; +1 level) = 7th level; +6 Str, -2 Dex, +2 Con, +4 natural armor +1/3 levels (max. +10 total at CL 16th), low-light vision, darkvision 120 ft., blindsense 60 ft., 6 natural attacks (bite 2d6, 2 claws 1d8, 2 wings 1d6, tail slap 1d8), breath weapon 1d6/level (max. 20d6) in Extreme-range line or 60-ft. cone (usable 3x), fly 120 ft., DR 10/+1, resist energy 30, SR.

sections.heading: Form of the Dragon IIICRB
sections.text: Form of the Dragon IIICRB: Form of the dragon II (7th level) + Augment Spell (Huge size; +1 level) = 8th level; +8 Str, -4 Dex, +2 Con, +6 natural armor +1/2 levels (max. +16 total at CL 20th), low-light vision, darkvision 120 ft., blindsense 60 ft., 6 natural attacks (bite 3d6, 2 claws 2d6, 2 wings 1d8, tail slap 2d6), trample, breath weapon 1d6/level (max. 20d6) in Extreme-range line or 90-ft. cone (usable 3x), frightful presence, fly 120 ft., DR 10/+2, energy immunity, SR..

sections.heading: FortifyTM2
sections.text: FortifyTM2: Bestow feat (Maximize Spell; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Sudden Metamagic; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell ([healing] spells only; -2 levels) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 1st level (0 with access to Healing domain; listed as 4th); swift action causes [healing] spell you cast that round to be Maximized, within level limts and number allowed per the Sudden Metamagic feat.

sections.heading: Fortify Cold CreaturesFB
sections.text: Fortify Cold CreaturesFB: Blessing (modified; 0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 min./level; -1 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell ([cold] subtype; -2 levels) = 0 level; 1 [cold] creature/level gains +1 to atks, damage, saves vs. fire for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Foster HatredOcA
sections.text: Foster HatredOcA: Ray of beguiling (1st level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (-2 levels) + Variable Spell (select creature type at time of casting; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 6th level (listed as 5th); those in area view one creature type with disfavor (as if they had a Cha penalty of 1d6 + 1/level; modify attitude accordingly) for the next 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Foundation of StoneSC
sections.text: Foundation of StoneSC: Enhancement (2nd level) + Item-Specific Spell (natural armor only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (enhancement; +3 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 to +3; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (CMD only; -2 levels) + Communal Spell (+1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); +1/4 levels (min. +1) to natural armor and +3 (+1/4 levels) to CMD. Divide total duration (1 min./level) among creatures affected.

sections.heading: Fourfold ForgingDD
sections.text: Fourfold ForgingDD: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Versatile Evocation (bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (magical weapon; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) = 7th level (listed as 8th); melee weapon deals up to +20d6 damage of appropriate type, with +1/3 levels enhancement (as if hitting with more than one magical weapon; SR does not apply).

sections.heading: Freedom, EternalSRD
sections.text: Freedom, EternalSRD: Warding (1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +3 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) = 9th level (listed as epic); subject immune to [beguiling], [inertia], and [restraint] conditions, Dex damage/drain, sleep effects, etc. Invest 450 x CL numen to mainatain indefinitely.

sections.heading: Freedom of Movement
sections.text: Freedom of Movement: Skill enhancement (Escape Artist; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Acrobatics; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Variable Spell (celerity when balancing, climbing, etc.; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (warding: Dex damage and other paralysis effects; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (warding: restraints; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (+60’ to +20’; -2 levels) = 4th level; +1/2 levels (+10 max.) enhancement to Escape Artist checks, warding against paralysis, [restraint] effects reduced by 1 step, and +20 ft. to  movement speed while climbing, swimming, in difficult terrain, etc. (if normally reduced).

sections.heading: Freezing GlanceFB
sections.text: Freezing GlanceFB: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4d4; +3 levels) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (days to minutes; -2 levels) = 6th level; 1 swift action/rd. deals 5d4 Dex (Will half) while you concentrate; damage lasts 1 min. per point.

sections.heading: Freezing Sphere, Otiluke’s
sections.text: Freezing Sphere, Otiluke’s: Ray of frost (0 level) + Bane Spell (fixed: [water]; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (transmute: freezes water in area; +1 level) = 6th level; cap 15d6 cold and freezes water in 40’r.

sections.heading: FriendsPH1
sections.text: FriendsPH1: Attribute boost (Cha; 0 level) + Augment Spell (+6 total; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; you gain +6 enhancement to Cha for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Frightful AspectUC
sections.text: Frightful AspectUC: Polymorph (monstrous humanoid; 3rd level) + Cascade Spell (barkskin; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (enlarge self, +1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Str; +1 level) + [Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Shape Spell (emanation; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (cowering to shaken; -3 levels) = +2 levels] = 8th level; your size increases by 1 step and you become hideous, with +6 Str, -2 Dex, +3 +1/3 levels natural armor, DR 10/magic, SR 10 + Concentration bonus, and 20’r. aura of fear (Will or shaken).

sections.heading: Frightful Joining, Bloodstone’sDr348
sections.text: Frightful Joining, Bloodstone’sDr348: PossessionOcA (3rd level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); you possess one corporeal undead, but cannot access its supernatural abilities.

sections.heading: Frightful Joining, Bloodstone’sTM2
sections.text: Frightful Joining, Bloodstone’sTM2: PossessionOcA (3rd level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Cha; +2 levels) + Threnodic Spell (+0 levels) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +2 levels) = 7th level; you possess one corporeal undead, which also takes 4d4 Cha damage (Will half, at 0, the undead is dominated and you can also access its extraordinary and supernatural abilities).

sections.heading: Frigid TouchUM
sections.text: Frigid TouchUM: Ray of frost (0 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Inexorable Evocation (+3 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); touch deals 5d6 cold and staggers 1 rd. (no save).

sections.heading: Frisky ChestTM2
sections.text: Frisky ChestTM2: Animate object (1st level) + Cascade Spell (mage hand; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Delay Spell (when approached; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) = 4th level; small object moves across ground at 50 ft. and/or flies at 20 ft. away from anyone approaching except you, and fights if cornered. Once activated, the object remains animated up to 1 min./level. To make the effect permanent, invest 3,000 x CL numen, as per a use-activated spell effect.

sections.heading: Frog, MassSRD
sections.text: Frog, MassSRD: Baleful polymorph (frogs; 5th level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) = 9th level (listed as epic); transforms creatures in area to Tiny frogs, and they take 1d6 +1/level penalty to Int. Invest 900 x CL numen to maintain effect past 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Frost FallUC
sections.text: Frost FallUC: Ray of frost (0 level) + Cascade Spell (inerta; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); 5d6 cold/rd. and staggered 1 rd. (save half/neg.).

sections.heading: FrostburnFB
sections.text: FrostburnFB: Variable Spell (+1 level: ray of frost or spark of life; 1st level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Violate Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6, half frostburn (as Vile, but moderate or warm conditions instead of hallowed); [cold] creatures are healed instead.

sections.heading: Frostburn, MassFB
sections.text: Frostburn, MassFB: FrostburnFB (3rd level) – Reach Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 15d6; -1 level) = 6th level; damage cap 15d6, half frostburn (Fort half).

sections.heading: FrostfellFB
sections.text: FrostfellFB: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (ray of frost; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (grease; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 20-ft. cubes; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Winter domain, etc.; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 10d6; -2 levels) = 8th level; 10d6 cold and 1d4 Dex/rd. (Fort half) and slippery conditions in one 20-ft. cube/level.

sections.heading: Frozen Moment, Storm’s7S
sections.text: Frozen Moment, Storm’s7S: Celerity (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (20 ft. to 60 ft.; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (mage hand; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (flying; -2 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); creature’s flying speed reduced by 60 ft., and hovers motionless for 1 rd. if reduced to 0.

sections.heading: Frozen NoteAPG
sections.text: Frozen NoteAPG: Compel (do nothing; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; --1 level) + Concentration Spell (+1 level) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 5th level; creatures of 9 HD or less within 40 ft. of you do nothing for as long as you continue to concentrate.

sections.heading: FumblePH1
sections.text: FumblePH1: Compel (drop object; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) = 4th level; target drops object held and/or falls prone (check each round for each). AKA chaos curseDr342.

sections.heading: Fundamental Breakdown, Alamir’sTM2
sections.text: Fundamental Breakdown, Alamir’sTM2: Bestow feat (Skill Focus: Craft (alchemy); 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhahcement: Craft (alchemy); +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Spellcraft; +1 level) = 3rd level; you gain +1/2 levels to Craft (alchemy) and Spellcraft checks, and treat them as class skills.

sections.heading: Fungal InfestationUM
sections.text: Fungal InfestationUM: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Lingering Evocation (+1d6; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Delay Spell (when damaged; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Cha; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Pestilence domain, etc.; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 1d6; -4 levels) = 3rd level; touch deals 1d4 Cha damage immediately, thereafter, victim takes 1d6 bleed/hit (necrotic damage) for up to 4 hits/round. To make the bleed effect last longer than 1 rd./level, invest 600 x CL numen (3rd level x 50 x 4).

sections.heading: Fury of the AbyssAPG
sections.text: Fury of the AbyssAPG: Enhancement (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (melee attacks only; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 to +1/2; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (­1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Abyss domain; -1 level) = 1st level; swift casting grants you an enhancement bonus to melee attacks, damage, and CMB equal to half your caster level.

sections.heading: Fury of the SunARG
sections.text: Fury of the SunARG: Touch of fatigue (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (jet of flame; +1 level) + Merciful Spell (+0 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 1d6; -3 levels) = 2nd level; maintain curse by investing 150 x CL numen. Victim is fatigued and takes 1d6 nonlethal fire damage/10 min. (Fort half).

sections.heading: Fury, Denev’sRR
sections.text: Fury, Denev’sRR: Jet of flame (0 level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to line of sight; +3 levels) + Energy Admixture (bludgeoning; +0 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1 mi.; +6 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (druid; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 15d6; -1 level) = 9th level; 10d6 bludgeoning plus 5d6 fire and knock prone (Reflex half/neg.) in a 1-mile radius.

sections.heading: Fuse FleshSRD
sections.text: Fuse FleshSRD: Topple (0 level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (additional sense; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 6th level; creature touched is knocked prone and stunned, deafened, and blinded for 1 rd./level.

Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteCall of StonePHII: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 4th level; 1d4 Dex/rd. to target (Fort half).Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteCast in stoneMF is close range (-1 level), is not Shaped (+0 levels), and can be repeated each round with concentration (swift action; +3 levels) = 8th level; 1 swift ranged touch attack/rd. deals 3d4 Dex drain (Fort half).
