Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteJudgment of GoldDD: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+4d4; +4 levels) + Cascade Spell (transmute; +1 level) + Augment Spell (precious metal; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Law or Greed domain; -1 level) = 7th level; touch deals 5d4 Con damage; if victim dies, is transmuted to gold (invest 350 x CL numen to maintain as gold statue until broken).Mostra la descrizione di ogni componentePolar rayCRB Cascades ray of frost (+1 level), is not Shaped (+0 level) = 7th level (listed as 8th); damage cap 20d6 cold plus 3d4 Dex drain (turns to ice instead of stone if drained to 0).Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
CloudwalkersCD includes Cross-Class Spell instead of skill enhancement (+0 levels), lasts 1 hr./level (+2 levels), affects 1 creature/level (+3 levels), and is Reduced (+90 ft. to +50 ft.; -2 levels) = 7th level; one creature/level gains a fly speed of 70 ft. (no skill bonus) for up to 1 hr./level.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteMurdoch’s feathery flyerTM2 is Personal (-1 level), lasts only 1 rd./level (-1 level), and does not include celerity (-1 level) = 1st level; you can glide with a 20-ft. speed for 1 rd./level.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteOverland flightSRD Cascades skill enhancement (Endurance; +1 level), lasts 1 hr./level (+1 level), and is Personal (-1 level) = 5th level; you fly at 50 ft./round and gain +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Fly checks and Endurance checks to hustle, for 1 hr./level.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteShield of WingsPC is Personal (-1 level) and Cascades inure (fire) instead of skill enhancement (+0 levels) = 3rd level; you gain fly speed of 50 ft. and resistance to fire 5/2 levels (max. 30) for 1 min./level.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteSwift flyCAd is Personal (-1 level), Sudden (+0 levels), and does not include skill enhancement (-1 level) = 2nd level; you gain fly speed 40 ft. for 1 rd. as a swift action. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
AirboatTM2: Mage hand (0 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (all flying creatures must be adjacent; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 8th level; up to 1 creature/level can fly together at speeds up to 100 ft. This manifests as a cloud ship you steer as a partial action; the ship itself remains for up to 1 hr./level, flying straight at constant speed if not steered. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteChariot of SustarrePH1: Mage hand (0 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (jet of flame; +1 leevl) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Sun domain; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 7th level; up to 1 creature/3 levels can fly together at speeds up to 90 ft. You steer as a swift action; enemies within 10 ft. take 1d6 fire/level (max. 15d6) per round. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteCloud ChariotCA: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to continental; +5 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/3 levels; +2 levels) = 8th level; near-instantaneous travel of up to 100 miles/level on a cloud-like chariot.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteHighwayTM2: Mage hand (0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Fly; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (know direction; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (endure elements; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (zephyr; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10 ft. to 20 ft.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (concentration to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Personal Spell (you must be on flying wall; -1 level) = 9th level; creatures on area 20 ft. wide and  up to 20 ft./level long fly at 110 ft. rate (+1/2 levels to checks) for up to 1 hr./level. Passengers are protected from cold and wind, and the flying plane has a built-in compass (so you can set a direction and then go to sleep, for example). For a divine caster, add Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) and Restricted Spell (access to Travel domain; -1 level).Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Lunar VeilUM: Gloom (0 level) + Cascade Spell (dispel; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to long; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (dispels only polymorph; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (4 steps to 2 steps; -2 levels) = 6th level; reduces illumination 2 steps and forces lycanthropes into true form (Will neg.). Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteTanil’s purgingRR affects a 20’r. emanation instead of a number of creatures (-1 level) and has a damage cap of only 5d6 (-1 level) = 3rd level.True FormAPG: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (polymorph or shapechanging only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) = 4th level; up to 1 creature/3 levels assumes true form, cannot re-transform for 1 rd./level.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Frostfell SlideFB: As tree stride (4th level), but between areas of slush/snow/ice instead of tree types.

sections.heading: Gale AuraAPG
sections.text: Gale AuraAPG: Zephyr (0 level) + Shape Spell (line to emanation; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; ­1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to [air] bloodline, domain, etc.; -1 level) = 2nd level; 20’r. emanation of strong wind around you counts as difficult terrain for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Gallant InspirationAPG
sections.text: Gallant InspirationAPG: Blessing (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +5; +2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to inst.; -3 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 3rd level; subject gains +5 on a failed attack or check (immediate action casting after die rolled).

sections.heading: Gate
sections.text: Gate: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Variable Spell (bi-directional; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (compel: step through; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Shape Spell (target to wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 5-ft. squares; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 9th level; long ritual opens a portal to another plane that can be held open by concentrating, or by investiture of numen (as an active spell effect). You can also compel a named creature to step through (Will neg.), controlling it by means of the Thaumaturgy feat.

sections.heading: Gauntlet7S
sections.text: Gauntlet7S: Mage armor (1st level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cone; +1 level) + Widen Spell (30-ft. to 15-in.; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell [(bolt of force; +2 levels) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 1d6; -2 levels) = 1st level; gauntlet of force can be used as armored glove (base 1d6 force when striking blows) or as a small edge of force.

sections.heading: Gaze of DestructionAUG
sections.text: Gaze of DestructionAUG: Channel Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd.; +1 level) + Delay Spell (+1 level) + Pattern Spell (gaze; -1 level) + Expedient Spell (max. spell level; -1 level) = 4th level; next offensive spell of 4th level or less you cast affects a 40’r. as if a gaze attack.

sections.heading: Gaze of TruthRR
sections.text: Gaze of TruthRR: Detection (mind control; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (detection: illusion; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); you detect presence of illusions and/or mind control in area; learn more information by concentrating.

sections.heading: Gaze ReflectionPH1
sections.text: Gaze ReflectionPH1: Dispel (0 level) + Augment Spell (reverse effect instead of dispelling; +2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd.; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (gaze attacks only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (illusionist; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st).

sections.heading: Geas, Familial
sections.text: Geas, Familial: Geas (q.v.; 6th level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (closest adult relative of last subject; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (+1 level) = 8th level; as geas, but if subject dies before completing quest, the geas passes to its nearest adult relative. You must invest 400 x CL numen to m

sections.heading: Geas, Lesser
sections.text: Geas, Lesser: Compel (2nd level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of enfeeblement if fails; +1 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 attribute/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Language-Specific Spell (­1 level) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (+20 to +5; -3 levels) = 4th level; creature of up to 8 HD must fulfill task or takes 1d6 +1/2 levels (+5 max.) penalty to all attributes. Invest 200 x CL numen to continue the effect past 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Geas/Quest
sections.text: Geas/Quest: Compel (2nd level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch if fails; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Language-Specific Spell (-1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 6th level; subject must fulfill task (no initial save against this compulsion) or take up to 20d6 negative energy damage and be sickened. Invest 300 x CL numen to continue the geas past 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: GembombDHD
sections.text: GembombDHD: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Delay Spell (standard; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (gnome or access to [earth] domain, etc.; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 8d6 force, divided among standard action 10’r. bursts.

sections.heading: GembombFRCS
sections.text: GembombFRCS: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Delay Spell (standard; +1 level) + Resistible Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Gnome domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 7d6 force (Reflex half), divided among Medium ranged touch attacks

sections.heading: GembombSC
sections.text: GembombSC: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Delay Spell (standard; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Gnome domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6 force (Reflex half) in a single 5’r. burst.

sections.heading: Genius LociCM
sections.text: Genius LociCM: Summon (1st level) + Tenacious Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 12 elder elemental; +6 levels) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 8th level; elder elemental appears in casting locale when stated conditions fulfilled. Note numen cost for latent spell effects; the elemental appears for 1 rd./level (or until destroyed) when triggered, but you can immediately re-invest the numen to reset the effect.

sections.heading: Gentle BreezeACG
sections.text: Gentle BreezeACG: Zephyr (0 level) + Shape Spell (line to target; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (severe to light; -3 levels) = 1st level; light breeze provides +2 circumstance bonus vs. heat stress and gases.

sections.heading: Gentle Reminder, Nybor’sMF
sections.text: Gentle Reminder, Nybor’sMF: Daze person (0 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Str; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (frightened to shaken; -1 level) = 1st level; humanoid target of 5 HD or less saves or is dazed 1 round and shaken 1 rd./level, but gains +2 enhancement to Strength for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Gentle Repose
sections.text: Gentle Repose: Warding (aging or decay; 1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (wards against natural aging; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (dead body only; -2 levels) = 2nd level; invest 200 x CL numen to extend duration indefinitely. Variants:

sections.heading: GetawayAPG
sections.text: GetawayAPG: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to planar; +6 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (destination is site of casting; -2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (swift activation trigger; +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 9th level; as a swift action, up to 1 creature/3 levels is transported to the location where the spell was cast.

sections.heading: GeyserAPG
sections.text: GeyserAPG: Jet of flame (0) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5-ft. square; -2 levels) + Energy Admixture (falling damage = bludgeoning; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (Reduced burning hands in a 20’r.; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard action; +1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 in the center (half fire, half falling damage) and 1d6 fire damage/round in a 20’r.

sections.heading: GeyserAUG2
sections.text: GeyserAUG2: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cylinder; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10’r. to 5’t.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 3rd level; 5d6 bludgeoning plus knocked prone in 5’r., 25-ft.-tall cylinder

sections.heading: Ghost BrandUI
sections.text: Ghost BrandUI: Dimensional pocket (1st level) + Variable Spell (remove and return; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 8 lbs./level; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 4th).

sections.heading: Ghost LanternCM
sections.text: Ghost LanternCM: Light (0 level) + Selective Spell (+3 levels) = 3rd level; as light, but only those you select can see (and benefit from) the light. Variants:

sections.heading: Ghost LightCA
sections.text: Ghost LightCA: Light (0 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd.; -3 levels) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (0 to medium; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (frightened to shaken; −1 level) = 1st level; bright light causes shaken condition within area. Cf. heartglowAUG2.

sections.heading: Ghost PipesLEF
sections.text: Ghost PipesLEF: Figment (0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Perform; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 1st level; instrument seems to play itself for up to 1 min./level, using your Perform (music) skill with a +1/2 levels (+5 max.) bonus.

sections.heading: Ghost Touch ArmorLM
sections.text: Ghost Touch ArmorLM: Mage armor (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (actual value of existing armor up to +8; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Ghost Touch WeaponSC
sections.text: Ghost Touch WeaponSC: Bestow feat (Ghost Strike; 1st level) + Augment Spell (BAB +11 effects; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Item-Specific Spell (single weapon touched only; -2 levels) = 3rd level. Variants:

sections.heading: Anger
sections.text: Anger: Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = +1 level; damage cap +15d6 necrotic (divided among iterative attacks), but wielder takes 1d6/rd.

sections.heading: Dedication
sections.text: Dedication: Cascade Spell (returning weaponUC; +1 level) = +1 level.

sections.heading: Despair
sections.text: Despair: Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (suffering from [fear] effect; -2 levels) + Concentration Spell (+1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = +1 level; if target struck is suffering from a [fear] effect, it is also sickened 1 rd./level or until saves.

sections.heading: Fear
sections.text: Fear: Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3 total bonus; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (bonuses apply vs. flanked opponents only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 min./level; -1 level) = +1 level; up to 1 ally/level (including wielder) are +3 to attacks and damage vs. opponents they flank.

sections.heading: Zeal
sections.text: Zeal: Cascade Spell (keen edge; +3 levels) – Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd./level; -2 levels) = +1 level.

sections.heading: Ghost WhipOcA
sections.text: Ghost WhipOcA: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Precise Shot; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +16 effects; +3 levels) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 1d6; -5 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); damage cap 5d6 force, divided among iterative attacks, plus entangle; ignores cover.

sections.heading: Ghost WolfARG
sections.text: Ghost WolfARG: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (Phantom Steed template; +1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 4 terror dire wolf; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell ([orc] or [goblinoid] caster; -1 level) = 4th  level.

sections.heading: Ghostbane DirgeAPG
sections.text: Ghostbane DirgeAPG: Bestow feat (Ghost Strike; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (single target only; -2 levels) = 2nd level; non-magical attacks from within 20 ft. deal half damage vs. incorporeal creature specified.

sections.heading: Ghostharp7S
sections.text: Ghostharp7S: Figment (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 30-ft. cubes; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (music previously heard by caster; -2 levels) = 1st level; music you have previously heard fills up to one 30-ft. cube/level.

sections.heading: Ghoul GauntletLM
sections.text: Ghoul GauntletLM: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+3 levels) + Cascade Spell [(lesser animate dead; +2 levels) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 2; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (slain by this spell; -2 levels) = 5th level (necromancer or cleric 4th; listed as 6th/5th); touch deals 1d6/level negative energy (max. 15d6, cleric 10d6) plus 3d6/round; victim becomes ghoul (if 2 HD or less) or ghast (3 HD+) if dies. Variants:

sections.heading: Ghoul GlyphLM
sections.text: Ghoul GlyphLM: Sickening touch (0 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Dex; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoid only; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 2nd level; magic trap deals 4d4 Dex plus stench to humanoid setting it off.

sections.heading: Ghoul Touch
sections.text: Ghoul Touch: Sickening touch (0 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Dex; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoid only; -2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; touch deals 4d4 Dex damage (save each round to halve remaining) and victim radiates stench (sickens, 10’r.).

sections.heading: Giant Form ICRB
sections.text: Giant Form ICRB: Polymorph (giant; 3rd level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (enlarge self; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bear’s endurance; +2 levels) = 7th level; you become a Large giant (low-light vision, +4 Str, +4 Con, -2 Dex, +4 natural armor, regeneration 5 or resist energy 30 if applicable, etc.).

sections.heading: Giant Form IICRB
sections.text: Giant Form IICRB: Polymorph (giant; 3rd level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (enlarge self; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (Huge; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bear’s endurance; +2 levels) = 8th level you become a Huge giant (low-light vision, +6 Str, +4 Con, -2 Dex, +6 natural armor, energy immunity if applicable, etc.).

sections.heading: Giant SizeCA
sections.text: Giant SizeCA: Enlarge (3rd level) + Augment Spell (Large to Gargantuan; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Str; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Con; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+8 total; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (wu jen; -1 level) = 7th level; you grow to Gargantuan size (+14 Str, -6 Dex, +14 Con, +6 natural armor).

sections.heading: Giant’s CurseAUG
sections.text: Giant’s CurseAUG: Skill enhancement (Perception; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (-1 to -4; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (vs. smaller creatures only; -2 levels) = 3rd level; target -4 to attacks and damage and -1/2 levels to Perception vs. creatures at least one size category smaller than itself. Invest 300 x CL numen to maintain curse beyond 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Giant’s GripAUG
sections.text: Giant’s GripAUG: Bestow feat (Improved Grapple; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Str; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 bonus; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) = 5th level; confers +4 enhancement to Str and Improved Grapple feat.

sections.heading: Gift, Alikaba’sAUG2
sections.text: Gift, Alikaba’sAUG2: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Cascade Spell (compel: accept item; +3 levels) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); item or creature you hold is transferred to target, who must save or drop item(s) held to receive the teleported object.

sections.heading: Girallon’s BlessingSC
sections.text: Girallon’s BlessingSC: Polymorph (humanoid; 3rd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (extra arms; -2 levels) = 3rd level; subject gains an extra pair of arms for 10 min./level (trade up to 5 feats for Improved Grapple, Improved Multiweapon Fighting, Multiweapon Fighting, Two-Weapon Strike, and/or Vital Strike). All 4 hands end in claws (base 1d4 damage).

sections.heading: Gird the WarriorAUG
sections.text: Gird the WarriorAUG: Mage armor (0 level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Augment Spell (armor: +4 to +10; +3 levels) + Augment Spell (blessing: +1 to +4; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 min./level; -1 level) = 5th level; subject gains +10 armor bonus and +4 to attacks and damage.

sections.heading: Glacial WardFB
sections.text: Glacial WardFB: Warding (fire; 1st level) + Irresistible Spell (+3 levels) = 4th level; subject immune to fire for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: GlacierFB
sections.text: GlacierFB: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 12; +7 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (see below; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 8th level.

sections.heading: GlasseePH1
sections.text: GlasseePH1: Transmute (1st level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 27 cu. ft./level; +3 levels) + Selective Spell (+2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 6th); volume of material becomes transparent to you and/or those you specify (generally 3 ft. wide x 2 ft. high x 4.5 ft./level thick).

sections.heading: GlassteelPH1
sections.text: GlassteelPH1: Transmute (1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (special material: glassteel; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 8 lbs./level; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 7th level; invest numen to maintain effects (as continuous spell effect or per cost of glassteel material: see Chapter 6).

sections.heading: Glaze LockFB
sections.text: Glaze LockFB: Transmute (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 10 min./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Disable Device; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+10 max.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (locking mechanism only; -2 levels) = 1st level; lock is +5 to hardness and Disable Device checks to open it are at -1/2 levels (-10 max.).

sections.heading: Glimpse of EternityME
sections.text: Glimpse of EternityME: Whelm (0 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of obliviousness; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (+5 to +15; +1 level) + Augment Spell (10d6 to 15d6; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 5th); damage cap 15d6 nonlethal plus 1d6 +1/level (+15 max.) penalty to Wis for 1 rd./level or until saves (Intuition half, confused at 1).

sections.heading: Glimpse of FearDr333
sections.text: Glimpse of FearDr333: Ray of beguiling (1st level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; Intuition or 3d6 nonlethal plus 1d6 +1/2 levels (+5 max.) penalty to Cha and shaken 1 rd./level (Will half/neg.).

sections.heading: Glimpse of the ProphecyME
sections.text: Glimpse of the ProphecyME: Deflection (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (+8 to resistance; +4 levels) + Tenous Spell (augmenting ends entire spell; -1 level) = 6th level; you gain sacred bonus to saves (+1) and AC (+2) for 1 hr./level; end effect by increasing save bonus to +9 for 1 save.

sections.heading: Glimpse of TruthBVD
sections.text: Glimpse of TruthBVD: Augury (2nd level) + Cross-Class Spell (arcane; +1 level) = 3rd level; single yes/no question, 1d4 Wis damage on Knowledge check failure.

sections.heading: Glimpse of TruthUI
sections.text: Glimpse of TruthUI: True seeing (q.v.; 5th level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 4th level; swift casting grants you true seeing for 1 rd.

sections.heading: Glitterdust
sections.text: Glitterdust: Warding (glamers; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (invisibility only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Stealth; +1 level) + Cascade Spell [(alter senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level)] + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r,; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); negates invisibility, imposes −1/2 levels to Stealth (-10 max.), and blinds 1 rd./level (save each round to end blindness).

sections.heading: Globe of Invulnerability
sections.text: Globe of Invulnerability: Warding (1st level) + Variable Spell (versatile evocation; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Selective Spell (one-way; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Expedient Spell (max. spell level; -1 level) = 4th level; 10’r. emanation around you blocks incoming spells of up to 4th level (direct-damage evocations, attribute damage, energy drain, negative energy, [death], force, wind, +1/level above 7th). Variants:

sections.heading: Gloom, ExtendedRR
sections.text: Gloom, ExtendedRR: Gloom (0 level) + Extended Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (2 steps to 1 step; -1 level) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Glorious TransmutationTM2
sections.text: Glorious TransmutationTM2: Transmute (1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 8 lbs./level; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 4th level; you transmute up to 8 lbs./level of iron into silver, or lead into gold, etc. Invest 200 x CL numen to maintain transformation, and the effect can be cannot be dispelled except by remove curse, etc.

sections.heading: Glowing Orb, Nchaser’sPGF
sections.text: Glowing Orb, Nchaser’sPGF: Light (0 level) + Variable Spell (control light level, from none to normal, and radius; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) = 3rd level; variable light (up to normal) in an area up to 60’r.; invest 11,250 numen (3rd level x CL 5th x 500 x 1.5) to make permanent.

sections.heading: GlueRR
sections.text: GlueRR: Bind (0 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +3 levels) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) = 2nd level; entangles 1 rd./level and difficult terrain.

sections.heading: Glue SealACG
sections.text: Glue SealACG: Bind (0 level) + Variable Spell (target 5-ft. square or object; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: GluttonyRR
sections.text: GluttonyRR: Compel (eat reavenously; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 4th).

sections.heading: GodlockRRO
sections.text: GodlockRRO: Figment (0 level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Delay Spell (object moved/opened; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (object up to 1 lb./level; -2 levels) = 1st level; when warded item disturbed, illusion of god appears and yells dire warnings for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: GodspeedAUG2
sections.text: GodspeedAUG2: Celerity (0 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (Str and Dex; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2 to +4; +1 level) = 3rd level; +4 enhancement to Str and Dex and +30 ft. to land speed for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Golden BardingCD
sections.text: Golden BardingCD: Mage armor (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 to +8; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (mount only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 2 hrs./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 1st level; your mount gains +8 armor bonus for 2 hrs./level.

sections.heading: Golem ImmunityRE
sections.text: Golem ImmunityRE: Warding (1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (all schools of magic; +4 levels) = 5th level (listed as 8th); target is immune to magic that is susceptible to SR.

sections.heading: Good FortuneCRB
sections.text: Good FortuneCRB: Hand of fate (0 level) + Quicken Spell (+4 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Fate domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; immediate casting allows one reroll. Fortune’s follyDD is the same, but works at Medium range (+1 level, = 4th level).

sections.heading: Gong of Isolation, Otto’sGA
sections.text: Gong of Isolation, Otto’sGA: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (other senses; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 sense/level; +3 levels) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) = 4th level; lasts 1 rd./level; suppresses blindsense, blindsight, hearing, taste, sight, smell, touch, others at CL 8th+. Variants:

sections.heading: Goodberry
sections.text: Goodberry: Spark of life (1st level) + Cascade Spell (remove condition: hunger; +2 levels) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Delay Spell (eat up to 1 day/level later; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Good or Plant domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 1d6; -2 levels) = 1st level; berries cure 2d6 hp total (divided among berries) and abate hunger. Variants:

sections.heading: GraceAPG
sections.text: GraceAPG: Skill enhancement (Acrobatics: 0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 to +10; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (vs. AoO only; -2 levels) = 0 level (listed as 2nd); swift action grants +1/2 levels (+10 max.; not immunity) on Acrobatics checks to move without provoking AoO for 1 rd. AKA lightfootMH.

sections.heading: Graft WeaponSRD
sections.text: Graft WeaponSRD: Bestow feat (Improved Weapon Maneuvers; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Weapon Specialization; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (weapon touched; -2 levels) = 3rd level; you graft a light or one-handed weapon to your hand, making it harder to disarm and giving you competence bonuses to hit and damage.

sections.heading: Grant QuarterAUG2
sections.text: Grant QuarterAUG2: Dimensional pocket (1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 27 lbs./level; +2 levels) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 2nd level; willing or helpless creature of 6 HD or less held in pocket dimension for 1 hr./level; invest 100 x CL numen to maintain effect until freeing condition named.

sections.heading: Grant SpeechAUG2
sections.text: Grant SpeechAUG2: Tongues (3rd level) + Augment Spell (different senses; +4 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (intelligent magic item; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 min./level; -1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (langauges you know only; -2 levels) = 2nd level; intelligent magic item can speak verbally (in any language(s) you know) for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Grasp of the StyxBotD
sections.text: Grasp of the StyxBotD: Grasping hand (q.v., 4th level) + Cascade Spell (enervation; +4 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (grappled victim only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (cultist of daemon lord, etc.; -1 level) = 7th level; target grappled 1 rd./level and takes 1d4 temp. negative levels, treats approach to you as difficult terrain and you as having cover even if not grappled.

sections.heading: Grasping CorpseHA
sections.text: Grasping CorpseHA: Variable Spell (+1 level): topple or bind (0 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Grasping WallCSc
sections.text: Grasping WallCSc: Bind (0 level) + Selective Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. cubes to 5-ft.; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 3rd level; enemies entering area are entangled while you concentrate and up to 1 rd./level thereafter.

sections.heading: Grave Mist, Kelgore’sPHII
sections.text: Grave Mist, Kelgore’sPHII: Ray of frost (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 1d6; -3 levels) = 2nd level; 1d6 cold/rd. in 20’r. area (fatigues if lightly wounded).

sections.heading: Gravity BowAPG
sections.text: Gravity BowAPG: Invisible needle (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Item-Specific Spell (mechanical projectile weapon only; -2 levels) + Expedient Spell (additional damage limited by initial base damage; -1 level) = 1st level; projectiles from affected weapon deal 1 die step larger base damage (Chapter 1).

sections.heading: Gravity VariationTM2
sections.text: Gravity VariationTM2: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 30-ft.; +2 levels) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to War domain; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 6th); those in 30-ft. cube/level fight at a disadvantage (-2 to attacks and treat area as difficult terrain) for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Great CircleTM2
sections.text: Great CircleTM2: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (evil creatures; -2 levels) + Cascade Spel (light; +1 level) + Positive Spell (+0 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 360’r.; +4 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Sun domain; -1 level) = 6th level; damage cap 1.5 x 15d6 vs.  undead, and those vulnerable to sunlight destroyed; other [evil] creatures take 0.5d6/level (max. 7.5d6).

sections.heading: Greater TruthBRL
sections.text: Greater TruthBRL: Compel (believe outrageous lie; 2nd level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 10 min./level; +3 levels) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 6th level; up to one creature/level believes a lie, no matter how absurd, for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: GreenfireUnE
sections.text: GreenfireUnE: Acid splash (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 5-ft. cubes; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd.; +1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 5d6 acid.

sections.heading: GreenspyAUG
sections.text: GreenspyAUG: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (additional sense; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (plant only; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (“play back” later by ritual; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain, etc.; -1 level) = 2nd level. Plant “records” sights and sounds within close range for 1 hr./level after casting; you can gain those impressions at a later time (once only) after plant retrieved.

sections.heading: Grim FeastRR
sections.text: Grim FeastRR: Spark of life (1st level) + Augment Spell (1d6 to 20d6; +4 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Expedient Spell (special: see below; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (evil caster; -1 level) = 2nd level; you heal 1d6 hp per Small or larger corpse within Medium range of you (they cannot be re-used for this spell), max. 20d6.

sections.heading: Grim RevengeBVD
sections.text: Grim RevengeBVD: Summon (1st level) + Summon Undead (+1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 3 wight; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels: Improved Weapon Maneuvers, Weapon Specialization, Severing Strike; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (BAB +11 effects; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (undead caster; -1 level) = 8th level (listed as 4th); severs one of victim’s limbs, which attacks as a wight for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Grip of IronSRD
sections.text: Grip of IronSRD: Bestow feat (Improved Grapple; 1st level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) = 1st level; you gain Improved Grapple (including +2 to checks) for 1 rd. as an immediate action.

sections.heading: GroundingTM2
sections.text: GroundingTM2: Warding (electricity; 1st level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +3 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level; one 10-ft. cube/level is warded against magical and non-magical electricity.

sections.heading: Group MindTM2
sections.text: Group MindTM2: Mindlink (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Community or Mind domain; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 6th); as telepathic bond, but up to 1 creature/level.

sections.heading: Grove of SerenityRR
sections.text: Grove of SerenityRR: Glamer (1st level) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +2 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (within prepared grove; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (goodberry; +1 level) + Cacade Spell (heal; +7 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (spend 8 hours in grove; -2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 9th level (listed as 8th); up to 1 creature/level resting 8 hours in grove is healed, fully nourished, and invisible while within.

sections.heading: Grue Conjuration, Nystul’sGA
sections.text: Grue Conjuration, Nystul’sGA: Summon (1st level) + Variable Spell (choose type of grue at time of summoning; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (CR 3-4; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 4th level.

sections.heading: Guarded FormRRO
sections.text: Guarded FormRRO: Warding (transmutation; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) = 4th level; suppresses polymorph and similar transmutations on subject, and prevents new ones from affecting it, for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Guardian HammerDHD
sections.text: Guardian HammerDHD: Bolt of force (2nd level) + + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) + Delay Spell (warded area disturbed; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Protection or Soul Forger domain; -1 level) + Reduced Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 4th); magic trap deals 10d6 force plus knocked prone and stunned 1 rd.

sections.heading: Guardian of FaithACG
sections.text: Guardian of FaithACG: Shield of faith (1st level) + Cascade Spell (protection from evil; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Variable Spell (swap subject each round; +1 level) = 4th level; shield of faith and protection from evil can be traded between allies by touch.

sections.heading: Guardian of FaithPH5
sections.text: Guardian of FaithPH5: Jet of flame (0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Delay Spell (approached within range; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels)  + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Delay Spell (activate by separate creatures; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 4th level; magic trap deals up to 60 hp (half fire, half holy; Reflex half), divided among 3 activating targets.

sections.heading: Guards and Wards
sections.text: Guards and Wards: Wisp (0 level) + Variable Spell (depending on location within area; +1 level):

sections.heading: Guess, Hornung’sTM2
sections.text: Guess, Hornung’sTM2: Detection (numbers; 2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (must be able to see general extent of group) = 0 level; 1st round—order of magnitude estimate of numbers in group of similar objects/creatures; 2nd round—exact number in group; 3rd- round—numbers in visible subsets of group. (This spell is subject to your perception, so if an ogre is leading an army of orcs disguised as ogres, it will count the whole army and not alert you to the ruse.) AKA enumerateSLPG.

sections.heading: Guidance
sections.text: Guidance: Variable Spell (blessing, resistance, or skill enhancement; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (effect ends the first time the bonus is used; -1 level) = 0 level.

sections.heading: Guidance of the AvatarWotC
sections.text: Guidance of the AvatarWotC: Skill enhancement (0 level) + Variable Spell (choose skill at time of use; +1 level) + Delay Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) = 2nd level; subject gains +1/2 levels to one skill check as a swift action.

sections.heading: Guide CraftAUG
sections.text: Guide CraftAUG: Mage hand (0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Guided PathCM
sections.text: Guided PathCM: Skill enhancement (Streetwise; 0 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (+5 to +10; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard or rogue; -1 level) = 1st level; you gain +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Streetwise checks, allowing you to find public places more easily and efficiently for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Guiding BoltPH5
sections.text: Guiding BoltPH5: Jet of flame (0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3 bonus; +1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd.; ­3 levels) = 1st level; damage cap 5d6 (half fire, half holy) and attacks against target +3 to hit and damage for the next round.

sections.heading: Guiding LightMH
sections.text: Guiding LightMH: Blessing (0 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (ranged attacks only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to long; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 min./level; -1 level) = 1st level; 5’r. area of light provides +1 to attacks and damage against illuminated targets.

sections.heading: Guiding StarAPG
sections.text: Guiding StarAPG: Anchored navigationSRD (4th level) + Restricted Spell (ranger; -2 levels) = 2nd level, and lasts only 1 hr./level, not 1 day/level; a 3rd level version (adding Transdimensional Spell) works across planar boundaries.

sections.heading: Guiding StarDr340
sections.text: Guiding StarDr340: Find the path (6th level) - Location-Specific Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) - Ritual Spell (+2 levels) = 8th level (ranger 6th; listed as 1st).

sections.heading: GuiltAUG2
sections.text: GuiltAUG2: Compel (do nothing; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); target is dazed 1 rd./level or until saves.

sections.heading: GullibilityRR2
sections.text: GullibilityRR2: Ray of obliviousness (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (also beguiling; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (+25 to +5; -4 levels) = 5th level; 1 creature/level takes 1d6+5 penalty to Wis and Cha (Intuition half).

sections.heading: Gusting SphereARG
sections.text: Gusting SphereARG: Zephyr (0 level) + Cascade Spell (push; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (line to burst; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) = 3rd level; mobile sphere of severe winds also bull rushes; control as partial action.

sections.heading: Gusting WindAUG
sections.text: Gusting WindAUG: Zephyr (0 level) + Shape Spell (line to burst; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (bloodline, domain, etc. with [air] descriptor; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); 1-rd. burst of severe winds in 120’r. outwards from you

sections.heading: GutrootRR
sections.text: GutrootRR: Invisible needle (0 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Crippling Drain (3d4; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain, etc.; -1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 piercing plus 3d4 Con drain.

sections.heading: G
sections.text:
Gaseous Form: Polymorph (air elemental; 3rd level). Variants:
Cloud shapeARG: Gaseous form (3rd level) + Cascade Spell (glamer; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10 ft. to 30 ft.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level;  +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (race, bloodine, etc. with [air] descriptor; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (no tactile or olfactory; -2 levels) = 4th level; you assume gaseous form and are magically disguised as a 30-ft. radius cloud.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteMiasmatic FormARG: Gaseous form (3rd level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute or Fell sickening touch; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (race or bloodline with [air] descriptor; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as 4th); gaseous form also sickens (not nauseates) 1 rd./level (1 rd. on save) or deals 1d4 Con damage (Fort half) by touch.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteWind WalkSRD: Gaseous form (3rd level) + Cascade Spell (zephyr; +1 level) + Variable Spell (assume/resume gaseous form and wind; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (tornado to windstorm; -2 levels) = 7th level; subjects become gaseous; you can blow them along at up to 60 mph.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteWraithformDr348: Gaseous form (3rd level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Perform; +1 level) = 4th level; for 1 min./level, subject is in gaseous form, gains +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Perform (acting) checks to impersonate a wraith (possibly causing undead to ignore).Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
PreserveUA1: Warding (aging; 1st level) + Expedient Spell (volume limit; -1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (wards against natural aging; +2 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (mundane only; -1 level) = 2nd level; invest 200 x CL numen to protect 1 cu. ft./level of mundane substances/objects from aging. Betray the yearsAUG2 (1st level) has a full-round casting time.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteSlow RotTM2: Warding (time; 1st level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 5–ft.; -1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (edible plant matter; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full tound; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant or Time domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; up to 125 cu. ft./level worth of grain, fruit, vegetables, etc. immune to the effects of time (invest numen to extend effect permanently).Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Dark flamesRR is Widened (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) = 5th level; torch sheds light in a 60’r. that only you and specified allies within the area can see.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteDarklightBVD is Widened (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) and Extended (10 min./level to 1 min./level; -1 level) = 1st level; 10’r. emanation from creature touched has normal light, but only for those within (those outside area see ambient light condition without this effect). Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Blade of bright victoryUM Cascades metaphysical feat (Variable Versatile Evocation; +2 levels) and bestow feat (Improved Weapon Maneuvers; +1 level), and is Item-Specific (your bonded weapon; -1 level) and Restricted (Paladin; -2 levels) = 3rd level; your bonded weapon gains ghost touch property, improved weapon maneuvers, and is treated as dealing bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Blade of dark triumphUM is the same, except for antipaladins.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteGhost touch weaponLM is Extended (10 min./level; +1 level) = 4th level.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteDivine accuracyLM is Selective (+0 levels due to metamagic synergy), Creature-Specific (vs. undead only) rather than Item-Specific, Shaped (emanation; +2 levels), and is Restricted (able to channel positive energy; -1 level) rather than Extended (-1 level) =  1 3rd level; you and allies in 20’r. burst gain ghost touch attacks vs. undead for 1 rd./level.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteSpirit-bound bladeOcA is Variable (+1 level) with an additional +1 level property = 5th level (listed as 4th). Select from:Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Hatred: Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Improved Critical) = +1 level; weapon is +4 to confirm threats.
Jealousy: Cascade Spell (inure; +1 level).
Animus BlastSRD: Ray of frost (0 level) + Cascade Spell (lesser animate dead; +3 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (animates only those killed by spell’s cold damage; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) = 7th level (listed as epic); damage cap 20d6 cold (divine 15d6) in 20’r., and up to 1 creature/level killed is animated as a CR ½ Medium skeleton. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteAnimus BlizzardSRD: Animus blast (q.v.; 7th level) + Augment Spell (CR 4 frost wights; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level to 1/3 levels; -1 level) + Empower Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as epic); as animus blast, but slower casting, 1.5x damage and 1 frost wight/3 levels instead of 1 skeleton/level. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteDagger of UndeathRR2: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cascade Spell [(lesser animate dead; +3 levels) + Augment Spell (up to CR 14; +7 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (slain by spell’s negative energy damage; -2 levels)] + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 20d6; -1 level) = 9th level; ranged touch deals up to 20d6 negative energy, and victim immediately rises as zombie or zombie lord of up to CR 14 if slain. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente

Bastion of GoodBED: Globe of invulnerability (5th level) + Cascade Spell (magic circle against evil; +3 levels) + Augment Spell (+2 to +4; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (caster must fast 24 hours prior to casting; -1 level) = 8th level (listed as 7th); as globe of invulnerability and double-strength (+4) magic circle against evil.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Glyph of Warding: Variable Spell (+1 level):
Acid splash (0 level) + Versatile Evocation (cold, fire, electricity, or sonic; +1 level) + Shape Spell (burst; +2 levels) = +3 levels, damage cap 5d6 (divine caster); orMostra la descrizione di ogni componenteCascade Spell (any spell you know up to 3rd level).
+ Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level; you must also invest numen (latent spell) until discharged.
Glyph of Warding, Greater: As glyph of warding, but increase blast radius to 120 ft., or spell level to 6th (+3 levels = 6th level; damage cap 15d6).
Inner WorldAUG: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Augment Spell (4 additional senses; +3 levels) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; subject is unable to sense anything in the real world; is trapped in imaginary one instead. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteReality BlindBVD: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Tenous Spell (-1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); subject is blinded and dazed as long as you concentrate (minimum 1 rd./level blindness and 1 rd. dazing), or until succeeds at Will save (check each round), but is not prevented from healing naturally (as listed).Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Bread of lifeRR2 is not reduced (2nd level; max. 7d6 hp healed).Estanna’s StewBED: Spark of life (1st level) + Augment Spell (+1/level; +1 level) + Communal Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level; 1 serving/level (max. 5) heals 1d6+1 hp or deals like amount to undead.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteRoyalberryDHD: Goodberry (q.v.; 1st level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (remove condition: afflictions; +1 level) + Augment Spell (2 steps to 3; +1 level) – Reduce Spell (+2 levels) + Restricted Spell (halfling or access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 5th level; berries cure up to 20d6 hp total (divided among berries) and abate hunger, and ameliorate [afflictions] by 3 steps (neutralize poison and/or remove disease).Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Grappling Grasp, Geirdorn’s: Variable Spell (+1 level):
