+ Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); each round, hand of force can be used to grapple, move objects, or ward against Bigby’s hand-type spells.
Arcane lock (2nd level) on doors;Glamer (1st level; disguising doors as plain wall) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level);Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteWeb (2nd level) in stairs only;Compel (go wrong way; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) at intersections; andMostra la descrizione di ogni componenteOne of the following: mass dancing lights (3rd level), magic mouth (2nd level), stinking cloud (3rd level), gust of wind (2nd level), or suggestion (3rd level).
+ Shape Spell (spread to cubes; +0 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 20-ft. cubes; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 6th level.
Concentration Spell (standard to swift action; +3 levels); or Extend Spell (concentration to 1 hr./level; +4 levels)
+ Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 216 lbs./level; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (vehicle only; -2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (steer travel only; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); you can steer target vehicle by swift action command, and/or by setting course and letting it continue.

sections.heading: HaboobSSt
sections.text: HaboobSSt: Wisp (0 level) + Cascade Spell (invocation of the knife; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 5d6; -3 levels) = 4th level; 5d6 slashing and obscures vision. Variants:

sections.heading: Hail of StoneCA
sections.text: Hail of StoneCA: Energy mace (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cylinder; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10’r. to 5’r.; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (evoker or [earth] bloodline, etc.; -1 level) = 1st level; damage cap 5d6 bludgeoning in 5’r. cylinder 25 ft. tall.

sections.heading: Halfling JinxPC
sections.text: Halfling JinxPC:  Resistance (0 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (halfling caster; -1 level) = 0 level; target takes -1 penalty to saves for 1 min./level (Intuition neg.).

sections.heading: Hallow
sections.text: Hallow: Magic circle against evil (3rd level) + Accursed Spell (good version; +1 level) + Variable Spell (cascade with other spells: see below; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10’r. to 40’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 hr./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full ritual; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell ([good] caster; -1 level) = 5th level; site is protected against evil. Invest 375 x CL numen to make effect last longer than 1 min./level. To consecrate and/or add an extra spell effect, cast those spells within the area and invest additional numen (50 x caster level x CL) for those. Unhallow is the same, with the alignments inverted.

sections.heading: Hallucination, AudiovisualUI
sections.text: Hallucination, AudiovisualUI: Figment (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (no olfactory or tactile; -2 levels) = 3rd level; up to 1 subject/level sees and hears phantasms while you concentrate (change each round) and for 1 rd./level thereafter.

sections.heading: Hallucination, AuditoryUI
sections.text: Hallucination, AuditoryUI: Audivisual hallucinationUI (3rd level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (no visual; -1 level) = 1st level; up to 1 subject/level hears phantom sounds (possibly incl. speech) while you concentrate (change each round).

sections.heading: Hallucination, ComplexUI
sections.text: Hallucination, ComplexUI: Audivisual hallucinationUI (3rd level) - Reduce Spell (+2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 4th); as audiovisual hallucinationUI but affects all senses.

sections.heading: Hallucinatory ForestPH1
sections.text: Hallucinatory ForestPH1: Glamer (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (druid; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (forest only; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (emanation to cubes; +0 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. cubes to 30-ft. cubes; +2 levels) + Specific Spell (terrain only; no structures, creatures, etc.; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level) = 3rd level; illusory forest fills up to one 30-ft. cube/level, but does not hide structures or creatures. Invest 2,250 x CL numen (3rd level x 500 x 1.5) to maintain effect.

sections.heading: Halo of SandSSt
sections.text: Halo of SandSSt: Deflection (0 level) + Augment Spell (scaling bonus; +1 level) + Cross-Class Spell (Desert domain; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; +2 deflection, +1/6 levels.

sections.heading: HaltPHII
sections.text: HaltPHII: Bind (0 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) = 5th level (listed as 3rd).

sections.heading: Halt Undead
sections.text: Halt Undead: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (+3d4 Dex; +2 levels) + Threnodic Spell (+0 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (days/level to rds./level; -3 levels) + Expedient Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level spell dealing 4d4 Dex damage to up to 2d4+5 HD worth of undead; the damage is removed after 1 round/level. Bone chillFB is Tenuous (-1 level) = 2nd level; save each round to end effect.

sections.heading: HammerSRD
sections.text: HammerSRD: Energy mace (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 1st level; 1 melee touch/rd. deals 1d6 bludgeoning/level (max. 5d6).

sections.heading: Hammer and AnvilRR2
sections.text: Hammer and AnvilRR2: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (staggered; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) = 5th level (listed as 7th); damage cap 15d6 force plus staggered 1 rd./level or until save (Reflex half/neg.).

sections.heading: Hammer of RighteousnessBED
sections.text: Hammer of RighteousnessBED: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Variable Spell (energy admixture: nonlethal; +1 level) + Bane Spell (evil: fixed; +0 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 (10d8 vs. evil; Fort half), decide proportions of force damage and nonlethal damage at time of casting.

sections.heading: Hand of BattleAUG
sections.text: Hand of BattleAUG: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 1st level (listed as 3rd); damage cap 5d6 force.

sections.heading: Hand of DeathCoC
sections.text: Hand of DeathCoC: Destruction (7th level) + Reach Spell (close to line of sight; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Death or Destruction domain; -1 level) = 9th level; damage cap 20d6 (half fire, half unholy) plus 3d4 Con drain at great distance.

sections.heading: Hand of DeathToB
sections.text: Hand of DeathToB: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+6d4; +6 levels) + Extend Spell (days to rounds; -3 levels) = 4th level; melee attack also deals 7d4 Dex damage. An initial save reduces the damage by half; thereafter, an additional point of attribute damage is removed each round (1+ Con bonus if target has the Fast Recovery feat).

sections.heading: Hand of DivinityMF
sections.text: Hand of DivinityMF: Resistance (0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+3 bonus; +1 level) = 2nd level; grants +3 sacred bonus to saves for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Hand of JusticeRR
sections.text: Hand of JusticeRR: Bestow feat (1st level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 feat/level; +3 levels) + Augment Spell (BAB +6 effects; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); you gain feats as follows (choose one):

sections.heading: Hand of TormMF
sections.text: Hand of TormMF: Inertia (0 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Reach Spell (close to 0; −1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 7th level (listed as 4th); aura stuns enemies within (save each round).

sections.heading: HandfangRF
sections.text: HandfangRF: Invisible needle (0 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6 and 1d4 to 1d3; -1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 piercing (divine 5d6) plus 3d3 Con (Fort half), and grappled 1 rd./level (1d6/rd.).

sections.heading: HandfireMF
sections.text: HandfireMF: Jet of flame (0 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +2 levels) + Positive Spell (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 1st level; touch deals 1d6 fire/level (5d6 max; 1.5x vs. undead, half to others). Variants:

sections.heading: Handy GrapnelUI
sections.text: Handy GrapnelUI: Mage hand (0 level) + Shape Spell (target to line; +1 level) + Manifested Spell (ranged attack roll needed to establish line; -1 level) + Exctend Spell (conc. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 8 lbs./level; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (along fixed line only; -2 levels) = 1st level; can pull creatures (or objects up to weight limit) 20 ft./rd. along Close range line iof effect.

sections.heading: Hangman’s GroveRRE
sections.text: Hangman’s GroveRRE: Hangman’s tree (q.v.; 1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Selective Spell (next 1 creature/level to die within range; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = as hangman’s tree, but affects next 1 intelligent creature/level that dies within range.

sections.heading: Hangman’s TreeRRE
sections.text: Hangman’s TreeRRE: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (target: touch to close; +1 level) + Delay Spell (until dies; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (destination: pre-designated tree or structure; -2 levels) = 1st level; when target dies, is teleported into nearby awaiting noose, gibbet, etc.

sections.heading: Harassing WeaponAUG2
sections.text: Harassing WeaponAUG2: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (provokes AoO only; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); for 1 rd./level, target takes ranged touch attack dealing up to 5d6 force damage whenever it provokes an attack of opportunity.

sections.heading: HardeningSRD
sections.text: HardeningSRD: Enhancement (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (item hardness; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Augment Spell (+1/4 to +1/2; +2 levels) = 5th level; +1/2 levels to item’s hardness (invest numen to maintain effect). Variants:

sections.heading: Harmonic VoidCSc
sections.text: Harmonic VoidCSc: Sound lance (1st level) + Cascade Spell (dispel; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd.; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 10d6; -2 levels) = 6th level (bard 5th); 10d6 sonic/rd. and opposed Concentration checks required to cast spells in 60’r. of you, while you concentrate.

sections.heading: HarmonyPGF
sections.text: HarmonyPGF: Enhancement (2nd level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (inspire courage; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) + Extend Spell 1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (+1/4 to +1; -1 level) = 1st level; your inspire courage is at an additional +1 (for up to 1 subject/level) for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Haste
sections.text: Haste: Celerity (0 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Dex; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3 total bonus; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (attack bonus only; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Manyshot; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = 3rd level; subject gains +30 ft. speed, +2 enhancement to Dex, and an additional attack; all attacks that round gain an overall +1 attack bonus (+3, -2 for Manyshot). To affect 1 creature/level, also apply the Mass Effect Spell feat (+3 levels) = 6th level.

sections.heading: Haunting ChoirUM
sections.text: Haunting ChoirUM: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard action; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Haunting MistsUM
sections.text: Haunting MistsUM: Wisp (0 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Wis; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (frightened to shaken; -1 level) = 3rd level; mists deal 1d4 Wis damage (once) and creatures are shaken while they remain within.

sections.heading: Haunting TuneMF
sections.text: Haunting TuneMF: Spook (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (frightened to shaken; -2 levels) = 3rd level; 1 creature/level is shaken for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: HawkeyeCAd
sections.text: HawkeyeCAd: Bestow feat (Far Shot; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Perception; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +11 effects; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (increment increase only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger; -2 levels) = 1st level; you gain +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Perception for 10 min./level, and your range increments increase by 50%.

sections.heading: Healer’s BlessingCRB
sections.text: Healer’s BlessingCRB: Bestow feat (Empower Spell; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Sudden Metmagic; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (healing only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Healing domain; -1 level) = 0 level; swift casting allows you to cast an Empowered cure spell within the next round.

sections.heading: Healer’s VisionCSc
sections.text: Healer’s VisionCSc: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+2 bonus; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Heal; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 1st level; subject gains +2 to attacks, damage, saves vs. fear and +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Heal checks for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Healing Circle, GreaterRR
sections.text: Healing Circle, GreaterRR: Spark of life (1st level) + Augment Spell (+1 hp/level; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) = 6th level (listed as 7th); heals 1d6 +1/level (15d6+15 max.) in 40-ft. burst.

sections.heading: Healing SpiritPHII
sections.text: Healing SpiritPHII: Spark of life (1st level) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 4th level; shed light and bestow 5d6 positive energy as a ranged touch 1/rd.

sections.heading: Healing TouchBED
sections.text: Healing TouchBED: Spark of life (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (arcane; +1 level) + Variable Spell (decide total dice at time of casting; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy: self; -1 level) = 2nd level; touch heals up to 1d6/level (max. 10d6), and you take like amount of negative energy damage. Variants:

sections.heading: Healing WordPH5
sections.text: Healing WordPH5: Spark of life (1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 1d6; -2 levels) = 1st level; partial action casting heals 1d6 hp at medium range.

sections.heading: Healing Word, MassPH5
sections.text: Healing Word, MassPH5: Healing wordPH5 (q.v.; 1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) = 3rd level; partial action heals 5d6 hp each to one ally/3 levels.

sections.heading: Heart of AirCM
sections.text: Heart of AirCM: Celerity (fly; 0 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (­1 level) + Cascade Spell (catfallSRD; +1 level) + Restricted Spell ([air] domain, etc.; -1 level) = 2nd level; you gain +20 ft. to fly speed and falls are slowed if plummet, but no fortification.

sections.heading: Heart of FireCM
sections.text: Heart of FireCM: Celerity (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resist fire; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Cacade Spell [jet of flame (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Fire domain, etc.; -1 level) = 5th level; you gain +50 ft. to land speed and resistance to fire 3/level for 1 hr./level, and can injure attackers with fire (1d6+15/hit) for 1 rd. as an immediate action once.

sections.heading: Heart of the MammothPC
sections.text: Heart of the MammothPC: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Con; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2 to +8; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell:

sections.heading: Heart of ValorRR
sections.text: Heart of ValorRR: Warding (fear; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Personal Spell (−1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 3rd level; allies immune to fear and gain +1 to attacks and damage; enemies save or frightened.

sections.heading: HeartacheBVD
sections.text: HeartacheBVD: Inertia (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) = 4th level (listed as 1st); target is stunned (not incapacitated) for 1 rd.

sections.heading: HeartclutchBVD
sections.text: HeartclutchBVD: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Empower Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 5th level; damage 15d6/rd. necrotic (Fort half). Variant:

sections.heading: HeartglowAUG2
sections.text: HeartglowAUG2: Spook (0 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (frightened to shaken; -1 level) = 2nd level; you shed light in 10’r. for 1 min./level, and enemies in aura are shaken. Cf. ghost lightCA.

sections.heading: Heart’s EaseBED
sections.text: Heart’s EaseBED: Remove condition (fear; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (also confusion; +1 level) = 3rd level; ameliorates fear by 2 steps, makes confused subject merely dazzled, and/or cures up to 3d4 Wis damage at close range.

sections.heading: Heat ShimmerUM
sections.text: Heat ShimmerUM: Glamer (1st level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Desert domain; -1 level) = 1st level; swift blur and those hitting you that round must save or be dazzled.

sections.heading: Heaven’s TrumpetBED
sections.text: Heaven’s TrumpetBED: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) = 7th level (bard 6th); enemies in 120’r. of you take 3d4 Dex (Fort half; save each round to halve remaining), paralyzed at 0.

sections.heading: Hedging WeaponsHA
sections.text: Hedging WeaponsHA: Deflection (0 level) + Augment Spell (scaling bonus; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (bolt of force; +2 levels) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Delay Spell (use rays as see fit during deflection duration; +1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Tenuous Spell (each ray reduces deflection by 1; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 7d6 force (divided among attacks). You gain +2 deflection to AC, +1/6 levels, for 1 min./level, and can make ranged attacks (max. 5d6 for one attack) that reduce your deflection by -1 each.

sections.heading: Heightened AwarenessACG
sections.text: Heightened AwarenessACG: Skill enhancement (Perception; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Knowledge; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; you gain +1/2 levels (+5 max.) enhancement to Perception and trained Knowledge checks.

sections.heading: Heir of HellBotD
sections.text: Heir of HellBotD: Spook (0 level) + Fell Frightening (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (Damnation domain, archdevil cultist, etc.; -1 level) = 5th level; enemies in 20’r. stunned 1 rd. and panicked 1 rd./level (Will shaken).

sections.heading: HellballSRD
sections.text: HellballSRD: Jet of flame (0 level) + Energy Admixture (acid, electricity, and sonic; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+2 levels) + Empower Spell (+1 level) = 8th level (listed as epic); damage cap 1.5 x 20d6 (1.5 x 5d6 each acid, electricity, fire, and sonic) plus 3d6 burn and 2d6 acid/rd. thereafter.

sections.heading: HellfireBVD
sections.text: HellfireBVD: Jet of flame (0 level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Overwhelming Evocation (fire; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Inexorable Evocation (+3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to [lawful evil] bloodline, domain, etc.; -1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 (half fire and half unholy, no save, and fire resistance does not apply).

sections.heading: Hellfire RayBotD
sections.text: Hellfire RayBotD: Jet of flame (0 level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Empower Spell (+1 level) + Reaping Spell (+2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 6th); damage cap 1.5 x 20d6 (half fire, half unholy), divided among rays, and victims killed warded against resurrection. You must invest 150 x CL numen to maintain anti-resurrection effect (typically the caster has the Soulcrafting feat and uses the victim’s own numen).

sections.heading: Hellfire StormBVD
sections.text: Hellfire StormBVD: Jet of flame (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Overwhelming Evocation (+1 level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Inexorable Evocation (+3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to [lawful evil] bloodline, domain, etc.; -1 level) = 7th level; damage cap 15d6 (half fire, half unholy, no save, and fire resistance does not apply).

sections.heading: Hellish RebukePH5
sections.text: Hellish RebukePH5: Jet of flame (0 level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (attacking you; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell ([lawful evil] bloodline, domain, etc.; ­1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 1st level; immediate casting deals up to 5d6 damage (half fire, half unholy; Reflex half) to attacker within close range.

sections.heading: Hellmouth LashARG
sections.text: Hellmouth LashARG: Acid splash (0 level) + Variable Spell (Versatile Evocation: electricity or fire; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 13d6/round, divided among iterative ranged touch attacks.

sections.heading: Hell’s CorruptionAPG
sections.text: Hell’s CorruptionAPG: Resistance (0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement; +1 level) + Variable Spell (different skills; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3; +1 level)

sections.heading: Hell’s GripPC
sections.text: Hell’s GripPC: Mage hand (0 level) + Extend Spell (conc. to 1 rd.; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) + Delay Spell (proximity; +1 level) + Tenacious Spell (+1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (devil cultist; -1 level) = 1st level; 1d6 bludgeoning plus lifted 20 ft. into the air for 1 rd. when triggered (by non-devil worshipper); re-invest numen (50 x CL) to reset.

sections.heading: Hell’s HammerDLM
sections.text: Hell’s HammerDLM: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+4 total bonus; +3 levels) + Item-Specific Spell (bludgeoning weapon; -2 levels) = 1st level; bludgeoning weapon touched gains +4 profane bonus to attacks and damage for 10 min./level. Variants:

sections.heading: Hell’s PowerBVD
sections.text: Hell’s PowerBVD: Enhancement (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell ([lawful evil]; -1 level) = 2nd level; you gain +2 deflection to AC, and your DR (if any) increases by +1 hp/4 levels.

sections.heading: Helm of WardingAUG2
sections.text: Helm of WardingAUG2: Resistance (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+5 bonus; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (mind-affecting; -2 levels) = 1st level; subject +5 vs. [mind-affecting] for 1 min./level. Variants:

sections.heading: Helpful Hand, Bigby’sPHII
sections.text: Helpful Hand, Bigby’sPHII: Mage hand (0 level) – Concentration Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Craft; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Disable Device; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (mage hand can only hold objects; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; floating hand holds items up to 1 lb./level and provides +1/2 levels (+5 max.) bonus to skills.

sections.heading: Helping Hand
sections.text: Helping Hand: Locate creature (4th level) + Effect-Specific Spell (location only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (figment; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (ghostly beckoning hand only; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to line of sight; +3 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (back to you only; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (visual only; -3 levels) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Herald’s CallCAd
sections.text: Herald’s CallCAd: Inertia (0 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoids; -2 levels) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); swift action staggers humanoids of 7 HD or less in 20’r. for 1 round.

sections.heading: Heroes’ Feast
sections.text: Heroes’ Feast: Create food & drink (1st level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (warding: afflictions; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (those partaking in 1-hour feast; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 7th level; 1 creature/level healed 15d6 hp, immune to afflictions, and +1 to attacks, damage, and saves vs. fear for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Heroic InvocationUC
sections.text: Heroic InvocationUC: Spark of life (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Blessing (+1 level) + Augment Spell (increase bonus to +4; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (warding: fear; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 9th level; subjects gain 1d6 temp hp/level (max. 20d6), +4 morale bonus to attacks and damage, and are immune to fear for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Heroism
sections.text: Heroism: Remove condition (fear; 1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Reduce Spell (3 steps to 1 step; ­2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level; reduces fear by 1 step, or grants +2 morale to atks, saves, checks if not under any. The bard version of this spell is also [language-dependent] (-1 level, for 2nd). Variants:

sections.heading: Hero’s DeathDD
sections.text: Hero’s DeathDD: Inure (0 level) + Energy Admixture (bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+10 total bonus; +8 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd.; -3 levels) + Cascade Spell [(spell resistance; +5 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels)] + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (willing recipient; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell [(damage attribute: Con; -1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; -2 levels) + Crippling Drain (-2 levels) + Delay Spell (duration ends; +1 level)] + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 8th level (listed as 7th); subject +10 to attacks and damage, gains DR 15/adamantine, fast healing 20, and SR 10 + your Concentration bonus for 1 hr./level; at the end of that time, takes 3d4 Con drain.

sections.heading: Hero’s DefianceAPG
sections.text: Hero’s DefianceAPG: Spark of life (1st level) + Augment Spell (+1/level) + Delay Spell (reduced to 0 hp or less; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 1st level; you heal 1d6 hp +1/level upon being reduced to 0 hp or less (if you Heighten the spell to 2nd level, the cap is 5d6+10, rather than 1d6+5).

sections.heading: HesitatePHII
sections.text: HesitatePHII: Inertia (0 level) + Augment Spell (staggering; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoid only; -2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); immediate action staggers 1 rd./level (save each round to end effect).

sections.heading: HesitationTM2
sections.text: HesitationTM2: Bestow feat (Improved Initiative; 1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Time domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; creatures with 7 or fewer HD in area take -4 to initiative for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: HibernateFB
sections.text: HibernateFB: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Stilent Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+4d4; +3 levels) = 5th level; touh deals 5d4 Dex damage (Will half); target in suspended animation while Dex reduced to 0 or below. Variants:

sections.heading: Hidden ObjectUAG
sections.text: Hidden ObjectUAG: Warding (divinations; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (glamer; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (object only; -2 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); object is invisible and immune to magical detection. Invest 150 x CL numen to maintain effect.

sections.heading: Hidden PresenceUI
sections.text: Hidden PresenceUI: Invisibility (2nd level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/3 levels; +2 levels) = 2nd level; you erase your presence from the minds of up to 1 creature/3 levels.

sections.heading: Hidden SpeechAPG
sections.text: Hidden SpeechAPG: Skill enhancement (Bluff; 0 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Communal Spell (+1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; subjects gain +1/2 levels (max. +10) enhancement to Bluff.

sections.heading: Hidden SpringUW
sections.text: Hidden SpringUW: Creation (plain water; 1st level) + Delay Spell (time release; +2 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (incremental release over course of spell, with no control of timing; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 0 level (listed as 1st). Creates spring procuding 1 cu. ft./hr. of water (~1.25 gal./10 min.) for 1 hr./level. Water evaporates after 1 hr./level, so the maximum accumulation of standing water < 7.5 gallons.

sections.heading: Hidden WardME
sections.text: Hidden WardME: Skill enhancement (Spellcraft; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (glamer; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (magic trap only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 1st level; hides aura of magical trap (and its physical glyph or symbol(s), if any), and adds +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Spellcraft DC to find or disarm it. Invest 50 x CL numen to maintain.

sections.heading: Hide CampsiteAPG
sections.text: Hide CampsiteAPG: Glamer (1st level) + Augment Spell (total concealment; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Travel domain; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level; hides auditory, visual, and olfactory traces in 10’r.

sections.heading: Hide from Animals
sections.text: Hide from Animals: Glamer (1st level) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (animals only; -2 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); masks auditory, visual, and olfactory/auras.

sections.heading: Hide from Undead
sections.text: Hide from Undead: Glaner (1st level) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +2 levels)) + Threnodic Spell (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) + Reduce Spell (no tactile; -1 level) = 1st level; masks subject’s auditory, visual, and olfactory/auras from undead. A mass effect version, as in the core rules, would be 4th level.

sections.heading: Hideous Laughter, Tasha’s
sections.text: Hideous Laughter, Tasha’s: Compel (daze; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to rd./level; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoid; -2 levels) = 2nd level; person affected falls prone and is dazed 1 rd./level. A 1st level bard version is also [language-dependent].

sections.heading: Hoard WardAUG2
sections.text: Hoard WardAUG2: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (destination: close to line of sight; +4 levels) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Tenacious Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 8th level; intruders into one 10-ft. cube/level teleported to pre-selected destination within ¼ mi./level, but nonliving gear is left behind. Once activated, you can re-invest the latent spell numen to re-set the trap.

sections.heading: HoarfrostUM
sections.text: HoarfrostUM: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Delay Spell (rds. to min.; -1 level) = 5th level; 1d4 Con/min. (Fort half).

sections.heading: Hold Animal
sections.text: Hold Animal: Damage attribute (Dex, 1st level) + Augment Spell (+4d4; +4 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (animals only; -2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Animal domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; 5d4 Dex damage. An initial save reduces the damage by half; thereafter, a save is allowed each round to halve any remaining Dex damage (round down remainder), until the effects are removed.

sections.heading: Hold PlantPH1
sections.text: Hold PlantPH1: Warding (plant movement or binding; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Dex; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (plants only; -2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (overcomes plant immunity to paralysis; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain, etc.; -1 level) = 4th level; normal and magically animated plants in 20’r. become immobile, and plant creatures take 3d4 Dex damage (Reflex half).

sections.heading: Hold StoneRR2
sections.text: Hold StoneRR2: Warding (earth magic; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (stone within area only; -2 levels) = 4th level; stone within area not affected by transmution spells, resists passwall and earth glide, etc.

sections.heading: Holy Aura
sections.text: Holy Aura: Deflection (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 bonus; +1 level) +

sections.heading: Holy BeaconRR
sections.text: Holy BeaconRR: Light (0 level) + Delay Spell (various conditions; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (emanation to line; -1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to continental; +5 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (paladins only; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (colors of light based on conditions; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); color-coded signal beams 100 miles/level into the air if you are knocked out (red), otherwise rendered unconscious (orange), or dying of exposure, thirst, etc. (yellow), or if you activate it as a standard action (blue). Other paladins can see the signal at a distance equal to its height; it lasts 10 min./level once activated.

sections.heading: Holy Beacon’s AnswerRR
sections.text: Holy Beacon’s AnswerRR: Dimensional skip (1st level) Cross-Class Spell (paladin; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to continental; +4 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (destination: source of holy beacon; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 4th).

sections.heading: Holy ChannelRR
sections.text: Holy ChannelRR: Bestow feat (Reach Spell; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Sudden Metamagic; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Delay Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (healing spells only; -2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; you can cast [healing] spells on subject from increased distance, depending on final effective spell level (per Sudden Metamagic feat, but 1/level times as many spells total). Bath of purityRR2 has a full ritual casting (3rd level). Cf. sacred bondAPG.

sections.heading: Holy Ice JavelinsUM
sections.text: Holy Ice JavelinsUM: Invisible needle (0 level) + Energy Admixture (cold; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 7d6 (equal parts piercing, cold, and holy), divided among javelins.

sections.heading: Holy Ice WeaponACG
sections.text: Holy Ice WeaponACG: Energy mace (0 level) + Energy Admixture (cold; +0 level) + Bane Spell (fixed: evil; +0 levels) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 7d6 (half bludgeoning, half cold), divided among iterative attacks; increase dice to d8s vs. [evil] creatures.

sections.heading: Holy JavelinHA
sections.text: Holy JavelinHA: Invisble needle (0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell ([evil] only; -2 levels) = 3rd level (paladin 2nd); damage cap 10d6 (half piercing, half holy) vs. evil, plus 2d6/rd. and sickened and illuminated for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Holy LanceCRB
sections.text: Holy LanceCRB: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Good domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 3rd level; damage cap 8d6 (half force, half holy), divided among iterative attacks (max. 5d6 for any one). Staff of orderCRB (Law domain) is similar, but the holy damage is axiomatic instead.

sections.heading: Holy ShieldUM
sections.text: Holy ShieldUM: Mage armor (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Variable Spell (shield bonus; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 10 min./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (enhancement; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; subject gains +4 shield bonus with additional +1 enhancement/4 levels; you lose your shield bonus during that time.

sections.heading: Holy Smite
sections.text: Holy Smite: Jet of flame (0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (blinding; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Bane Spell (evil; +0 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell ([good] caster; -1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 (10d8 vs. evil), half fire, half holy in 20’r., and blinds 1 rd./level (Reflex half/neg.).

sections.heading: Holy Sword
sections.text: Holy Sword: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (magic weapon

sections.heading: Holy WarRR2
sections.text: Holy WarRR2: Remove condition (affliction; 1st level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (followers of your deity; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (3 steps to 2 steps; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as 9th); reduces [afflictions] by 2 steps, and/or grants +2/+4 competence bonus to attacks, damage, saves, and checks, to followers of your deity within 120 ft. of you.

sections.heading: Holy Word
sections.text: Holy Word: Alter senses (hearing; 0 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: HoneRRO
sections.text: HoneRRO: Enhancement (2nd level) + Object-Specific Spell (item up to 1 lb./level; -2 levels) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level (1st with access to Artifice domain); item becomes masterwork (+1 enhancement/4 levels) for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Honest WordsRRO
sections.text: Honest WordsRRO: Compel (don’t lie; 2nd level) + Mass Effect Spell (2 targets; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (only to each other; -2 levels) + Exend Spell (1 rd. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Community domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; two subjects cannot lie to each other for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Honeyed TongueAPG
sections.text: Honeyed TongueAPG: Hand of fate (0 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (Diplomacy only; -2 levels) = 2nd level; for the next 10 min./level, roll twice when making Diplomacy checks and select the better result.

sections.heading: Hood of the CobraCM
sections.text: Hood of the CobraCM: Glamer (1st level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; subject sees you as having a cobra’s hood and fangs, takes 3d6 nonlethal, is shaken while you concentrate (Will neg.), and your touch deals 1d4 Con damage (Fort half). An initial Intuition save negates all effects.

sections.heading: Horizon ShotRRO
sections.text: Horizon ShotRRO: Bestow feat (Far Shot; 1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (also Point-Blank Shot; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (BAB +16 effects; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Archery domain; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 7th); swift casting allows you to fire one projectile that ignores range (i.e., you can target anything you can see, regardless of distance, and attack as if it were within your first range increment, with +4 circumstance bonus to attack and damage).

sections.heading: Horn of PursuitUM
sections.text: Horn of PursuitUM: Figment (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level)  + Shape Spell (cubes to burst; +0 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1 mi.; +6 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (hunting horn notes only; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (auditory with no speech; -3 levels) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Horrid SicknessCM
sections.text: Horrid SicknessCM: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Fell Sickening (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 5th level; up to 1 target per 3 levels is nauseated (save each round for sickened thereafter).

sections.heading: Hostile JuxtapositionUC
sections.text: Hostile JuxtapositionUC: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Cascade Spell (dimensional skip on target creature; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (switch places only; -2 levels) = 5th level; immediate casting lets you switch places with one creature within range (this can pre-empt an attack, making the other creature the new target).

sections.heading: Hostile Juxtaposition, GreaterUC
sections.text: Hostile Juxtaposition, GreaterUC: Hostile juxtaposition (5th level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/3 levels; +2 levels) = 7th level. You can switch places with 1 different target/3 levels (once each), after which the spell is discharged.

sections.heading: Hostile LevitationUC
sections.text: Hostile LevitationUC: Bind (0 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of enfeeblement; +2 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); target is entangled 1 rd./level and takes 1d6 +1/2 levels (max. 1d6+5) penalty to Str.

sections.heading: Hound of DoomCW
sections.text: Hound of DoomCW: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 4; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (hexblade; -1 level) = 3rd level; summons one shadowMP dire wolf.

sections.heading: Hounds of the UnderworldRRO
sections.text: Hounds of the UnderworldRRO: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 6; +4 levels) + Augment Spell (1d4+1 summoned; +1 level) = 6th level (5th for underworld cultist); summons 1d4+1 two-headed yeth hounds.

sections.heading: Hovering SkullCWH
sections.text: Hovering SkullCWH: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (invisible needle; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 3rd level; with concentration, visual scrying sensor within close range can also make touch attacks for up to 10d6 piercing damage.

sections.heading: Howling ChainPGF
sections.text: Howling ChainPGF: Bind (0 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (ailing; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (energy mace; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 5d6; -3 levels) = 4th level (listed as 6th); target is entangled and ailing for 1 rd./level, and attacked 2x/rd. for 4d6 bludgeoning each.

sections.heading: Hunger for FleshHA
sections.text: Hunger for FleshHA: Compel (bite those of own kind, or be staggered if can’t; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (invisible needle; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; subject gains bite attack for 1d6/level (max. 10d6) and attempts to commit cannibalism with it.

sections.heading: Hunger of the StyxBotD
sections.text: Hunger of the StyxBotD: Inertia (0 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; +2 levels) + Fell Staggering (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (compel: do nothing; +2 levels) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (cultist of daemon lord, etc.; -1 level) = 5th level; dazes 1 round (Will neg.) and staggers 1 rd./level (Fort flat-footed).

sections.heading: Hunter SerpentAUG2
sections.text: Hunter SerpentAUG2: Damage attribute (Str; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (invisible needle; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to planar; +6 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; −1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 15d6; -1 level) = 6th level (listed as 5th); damage cap 15d6 piercing plus 1d4 Str, anywhere on the same plane.

sections.heading: Hunter’s EyePHII
sections.text: Hunter’s EyePHII: Invisible needle (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (sneak attack conditions; -2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Variable Spell (stacks with existing, and damage type matches weapon; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger; -2 levels) = 2nd level; damage cap +7d6. You gain sneak attack +5d6 for 1 attack, or +3d6 for 2 attacks, +2d6 for 3 attacks, or +1d6 (4-7 attacks) as a swift action.

sections.heading: Hunter’s MoonRR2
sections.text: Hunter’s MoonRR2: Bestow feat (Favored Enemy: [shapechangers]; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Wolfsbane Strike; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (BAB +6 effects; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 2 hrs./level; +4 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (favored enemy restricted to lycanthropes; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger; -2 levels) = 2nd level; you gain lycanthropes as a favored enemy (+1 bonus) and your attacks bypass DR/silver.

sections.heading: Hunting Hawk, Tenser’sGA
sections.text: Hunting Hawk, Tenser’sGA: Summon (hawk; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Versatile Strike; +2 levels) + Item-Specific Spell (arrow; -1 level) = 2nd level; arrow becomes a hawk for 1 rd./level but retains enhancement bonus and other magical properties.

sections.heading: Hydra’s BloodRRO
sections.text: Hydra’s BloodRRO: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 hit or projectile/3 levels; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Scalykind domain; -1 level) = 4th level; poisons melee weapon (good for next 1 hit/3 levels) or like number of projectiles for 1d4 Con/rd. (save each round to end ongoing poison damage).

sections.heading: Hydraulic PushAPG
sections.text: Hydraulic PushAPG: Push (q.v.; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (create water; +1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Hydraulic TorrentAPG
sections.text: Hydraulic TorrentAPG: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (push; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to line; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (create water; +1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6.

sections.heading: HygieneAUG
sections.text: HygieneAUG: Clean (0 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Con; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (saves vs. disease only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 0 level; creature touched becomes clean and well-groomed, and is +1 to saves vs. disease for the next 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Hymn, Faerinaal’sBED
sections.text: Hymn, Faerinaal’sBED: Compulsion (take no immediate actions; 2nd level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (evil only; -2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 2nd); up to 1 evil creature/level unable to take immediate actions (including AoO) while you concentrate.

sections.heading: HypercognitionOcA
sections.text: HypercognitionOcA: Skill enhancement (0 level) + Variable Spell (any Int-based; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (bonus applies to check and reduces penalry for fast skill use; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); you gain +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to one Int check or Int-based skill check, and reduce penalty for fast skill use (Chapter 4) by the same amount.

sections.heading: HypercognitionSRD
sections.text: HypercognitionSRD: Augury (2nd level) – Ritual Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement; +1 level) + Variable Spell (any Knowledge; +1 level) = 8th level; you rapidly deduce detailed solution to complex problem, or gain +1/2 levels to an Int or Knowledge check.
