sections.text: Illusory Script: Glamer (1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (gibberish writing over actual script; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (suggestion; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (those reading text; -2 levels) + Selective Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level; invest 225 x CL numen (3rd level x 50 x 1.5) to maintain effect.

sections.heading: Image, AdvancedUA1
sections.text: Image, AdvancedUA1: Figment (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Variable Spell (scripted; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 5th); as programmed image, but without activating trigger (begins immediately after casting).

sections.heading: Image, Lasting MinorAUG2
sections.text: Image, Lasting MinorAUG2: Figment (0 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Widen Spell (1,000 ft3/level to 2 ft3/level; -3 levels) = 1st level; creates small, long-lasting visual illusion; invest 1,000 numen to make permanent.

sections.heading: ImageryRRO
sections.text: ImageryRRO: Figment (0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Perception; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard or access to Music domain, etc.; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (no thermal or tactile; -1 level) = 3rd level; audio-visual-olfactory illusion in 60’r. also causes -1/2 levels to Perception.

sections.heading: Imago InterrogationTM2
sections.text: Imago InterrogationTM2: Augury (2nd level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) = 9th level; you gain answers to 1 question/level regarding each of up to 1 topic/3 levels, and answers can take as long as 1 rd./level to relay.

sections.heading: Imbue AddictionPC
sections.text: Imbue AddictionPC: Compel (take drug; 2nd level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 3rd level; victim compelled to take specified drug whenever possible. (Invest 150 x CL numen to maintain effect until victim gets through rehab.)

sections.heading: Imbue ShadowRR
sections.text: Imbue ShadowRR: Summon (1st level) + Summon Undead (+1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 4 shadow; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (shadow attacks only creature whose shadow it mimics; -2 levels) = 4th level.

sections.heading: Imbue with Spell Ability
sections.text: Imbue with Spell Ability: Bestow feat (Magical Talent; 1st level) + Variable Spell (choose spell(s) at time of casting; +1 level) + Amplify Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (spells that you have prepared; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; creature touched gains 1 spell level/2 caster levels you possess as spell-like abilities. It must have at least that many HD, and the spells chosen must be among the ones you have prepared, although you do not lose the prepared spells. They are cast at your CL. Variants:

sections.heading: Immediate AssistanceCM
sections.text: Immediate AssistanceCM: Hand of fate (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (skill check only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard or access to Fate domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; immediate casting allows target to reroll one skill check (before results determined).

sections.heading: ImmovabilitySRD
sections.text: ImmovabilitySRD: Warding (movement; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (inure: slashing; +1 level) + Energy Admixture (budgeoning and piercing; +0 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 4th level; while you concentrate, you gain DR 10/− and cannot be moved from your location.

sections.heading: ImmunityAUG
sections.text: ImmunityAUG: Warding (1st level) + Variable Spell (select seed at time of casting; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) = 5th level (listed as 7th); target is warded against one of the following: acid, cold, compulsions, disease, electricity, figments, fire, glamers, negative energy, poison, positive energy, sonics, etc. for 10 min./level. Variants:

sections.heading: Impending PermissionTM2
sections.text: Impending PermissionTM2: Compel (do not perform any action unless given permission by designated person; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 10 min./level; +3 levels) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Law domain; -1 level) = 4th level; victim must ask and receive permission from person you designate before completing any action.

sections.heading: Imperative Ambulation, Otto’sCM
sections.text: Imperative Ambulation, Otto’sCM: Compel (move at least 10 ft.; 2nd level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; target must move at least 10 ft. at the start of each turn, until save made (if cannot move, loses move action instead).

sections.heading: Implosion
sections.text: Implosion: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +2 levels) + Crippling Drain (+3 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 8th level; deals 4d4 Con drain/rd. (Fort half) while you concentrate.

sections.heading: Imprison PossessorBVD
sections.text: Imprison PossessorBVD: Hedge (possessing entity; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (emanation to target; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (0 to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 5th level; possessing entity is trapped in body it currently inhabits. Invest 250 x CL numen to maintain effect indefinitely.

sections.heading: ImprovisationCAd
sections.text: ImprovisationCAd: Variable Spell (blessing, skill enhancement, or attribute boost; 2nd level) + Lucky Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Variable Spell (allocate pool; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard or access to Fate domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; each round, apply +1/2 level (max. +10) as a luck bonus to 1 attack roll, skill check, or attribute check.

sections.heading: IncapacitateRR
sections.text: IncapacitateRR: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cascade Spell [(ray of enfeeblement; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 attribute/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels)] + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 8th level (listed as 9th); damage cap 20d6 necrotic and 1d6 + 1/level (+20 max.) penalty to all attributes; invest 600 x CL numen to maintain penalties past 1 rd./level (8th level x 50 x 1.5).

sections.heading: Incendiary Cloud
sections.text: Incendiary Cloud: Wisp (0 level) + Cascade Spell (jet of flame; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd.; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (+90 ft. to +30 ft. and 25d6 to 10d6; -3 levels) = 6th level; fast (60 ft.), mobile 20’r. fog deals 10d6 fire/rd. in area and obscures vision. Variants:

sections.heading: Incendiary SlimeCM
sections.text: Incendiary SlimeCM: Grease (1st level) + Cascade Spell (jet of flame; +1 level) + Delay Spell (ignited; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (ignition ends grease effect; -1 level) = 2nd level; as grease, but highly flammable (damage cap 5d6), as in 1st ed. AD&D.

sections.heading: InciteMH
sections.text: InciteMH: Compel (act; 2nd level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (holding actions only; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); subject cannot hold actions/delay/ready actions for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Incite, GreaterSC
sections.text: Incite, GreaterSC: InciteMH (3rd level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as 1st).

sections.heading: InciteRR
sections.text: InciteRR: Compel (2nd level) + Variable Spell (name task while casting; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Personal Spell (you must personally lead task; -1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (­2 levels) = 7th level; compels small mob to follow you in completing stated task.

sections.heading: Incorporeal ChainsOcA
sections.text: Incorporeal ChainsOcA: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Transdimensional Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (incorporeal only; -2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 10d6; -2 levels) = 5th level; 1 incorporeal creature/level takes 10d6 force/rd. and is grappled while you concentrate (Reflex half/neg.).

sections.heading: Incorporeal NovaLM
sections.text: Incorporeal NovaLM: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Transdimensional Spell (-1 level) + Empower Spell (+1 level) = 6th level; 1.5d6/level (max. 22.5d6, Reflex half) force damage to incorporeal and gaseous creatures only.

sections.heading: Increase WeightAUG
sections.text: Increase WeightAUG: Enlarge (3rd level) + Selective Spell (weight only, not size or Stength; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 1st); increases target’s weight by a factor of 8, possibly overloading its own carrying capacity (a 150-lb. character would need a 17 Strength to be able to drag his/her own weight; a 200-lb. character would need a 19 Str).

sections.heading: Induce AweME
sections.text: Induce AweME: Skill enhancement (Diplomacy; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Bluff; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Tenuous Spell (activating fear aura ends skill bonuses; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (frightened to shaken; -1 level) = 2nd level; you gain +1/2 levels to Bluff and Diplomacy; can end bonuses to cause enemies in 20’r. to become shaken.

sections.heading: InebriateOJ13
sections.text: InebriateOJ13: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (ailing; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 nonlethal plus ailing 1 min./level (Fort half/neg.).

sections.heading: Inertial ArmorSRD
sections.text: Inertial ArmorSRD: Mage armor (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (ki or psychokinesis; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; as mage armor, but personal only and usable with Canny Defense.

sections.heading: Inescapable SwarmDr333
sections.text: Inescapable SwarmDr333: Sickening touch (0 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (panicked to shaken; -2 levels) = 4th level; Intuition or 3d6 nonlethal plus nauseated and shaken 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Inevitable DefeatPHII
sections.text: Inevitable DefeatPHII: Whelm (0 level) + Lingering Evocation (+2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 1st level spell dealing 1d6 nonlethal/level (max 5d6) plus 2d6/round for up to 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Infestation of MaggotsMF
sections.text: Infestation of MaggotsMF: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +3 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; touch deals 1d4 Con (Fort half) +1d4 Con/rd. until save.

sections.heading: Inflict Light Damage, MassRE
sections.text: Inflict Light Damage, MassRE: Sound lance (1st level) + Irresistible Spell (+3 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (constructs; -2 levels) = 5th level; damage cap 20d6 (Will half, no SR) sonic vs. one construct/level.

sections.heading: Infra-InvisibleDHD
sections.text: Infra-InvisibleDHD: Glamer (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (vs. darkvision only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 2nd level; subject is invisible to darkvision for 1 hr./level or until attacks.

sections.heading: InhibitMH
sections.text: InhibitMH: Metaphysical feat (Delay Spell; 1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (enchantment; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); subject’s actions are delayed by 1 rd. (Will neg.).

sections.heading: Inner BeautyFC1
sections.text: Inner BeautyFC1: Variable Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level):

sections.heading: InnocenceAPG
sections.text: InnocenceAPG: Skill enhancement (Bluff; 0 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (convince others you’re innocent; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+3 levels) = 0 level (listed as 1st); you gain +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Bluff to convince others of your innocence.

sections.heading: InquisitionRR
sections.text: InquisitionRR: Compel (answer truthfully; 2nd level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 question/3 levels within duration; +2 levels) = 4th level. InquisitionBED (5th level) has a standard casting time.

sections.heading: Insatiable ThirstTM2
sections.text: Insatiable ThirstTM2: Compel (drink; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 2nd); victim must drink all potable liquids it can find.

sections.heading: InscribeRRE
sections.text: InscribeRRE: Shaping (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (letters or script only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Craft; +2 levels) = 1st level; inscribes text on affected surface (assume letters 1” deep, so one 3 ft. x 3-ft. square per level can be inscribed).

sections.heading: Insidious RhythmCAd
sections.text: Insidious RhythmCAd: Ray of idiocy (1st level) + Cascade Spell (dispel; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (+15 to +5; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); subject takes 1d6+5 penalty to Int and must concentrate to cast/maintain spells for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Insightful FeintCAd
sections.text: Insightful FeintCAd: Skill enhancement (Bluff; 0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Insightful Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (feint only; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 to +10; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 1st level; +1/2 levels (+10 max.) insight bonus to feint for 1 round.

sections.heading: Insightful FeintSC
sections.text: Insightful FeintSC: Bestow feat (Improved Feint; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Bluff; +1 level) + Insightful Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (feint only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 1st level; +1/2 levels (+5 max.) insight bonus to feint for 1 round, and can feint as a move action.

sections.heading: Insistent BeatRRO
sections.text: Insistent BeatRRO: Ray of idiocy (1st level) + Cascade Spell (ray of obliviousness; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard or access to Music domain, etc.; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (+20 to +10; -2 levels) = 5th level; 1d6+10 penalty to Int and Wis in 60’r. around you while you concentrate.

sections.heading: Inpsire ToughnessCW
sections.text: Inpsire ToughnessCW: Spark of life (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (bard; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Diehard; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = 4th level; ally gains 10d6 temp. hp and the Diehard feat.

sections.heading: Instant ArmorAPG
sections.text: Instant ArmorAPG: Mage armor (1st level) + Augment Spell (+9 total bonus; +3 levels) + Cross-Class Spell (cleric or paladin; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) = 2nd level; short-duration divine mage armor grants you +9 armor bonus.

sections.heading: Instant Exit, Drawmij’sGA
sections.text: Instant Exit, Drawmij’sGA: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/3 levels; +2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Mishap Possibility (ad hoc -1 level) + Variable Spell (random destination within range; -1 level) = 4th level. Variant:

sections.heading: Instant FakeUI
sections.text: Instant FakeUI: Figment (0 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Augment Spell (visual, auditory, olfactory, tactile; +2 levels) = 3rd level; a Sleight of Hand pilfering of an object leaves behind an illusion (even feels real if not disbelieved) that the object is still present (i.e., hasn’t been stolen).

sections.heading: Instant LocksmithCAd
sections.text: Instant LocksmithCAd: Metaphysical feat (1st level) + Augment Spell (+4 level cost; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (Disable Device check; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (rogue skill trick; -1 level) = 1st level; swift casting allows you to make one Disable Device check as a swift action.

sections.heading: Instant RefugeSC
sections.text: Instant RefugeSC: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +7 levels) + Personal Spell (­1 level) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Variable Spell (name up to 6 conditions; +1 level) = 9th level; when one of six conditions occurs, you are instantly transported anywhere within the multiverse you specify.

sections.heading: Instant Summons, Drawmij’s
sections.text: Instant Summons, Drawmij’s: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (pre-selected item; -2 levels) = 6th level; teleports item to your hand (no sapphire component is needed).

sections.heading: Instant SupplicationRW
sections.text: Instant SupplicationRW: Mage hand (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (slows fall only; -2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell ([air] bloodline, domain, etc.; -1 level) = 3rd level; provides feather fall for a single creature at up to long range.

sections.heading: InstillCW
sections.text: InstillCW: Resistance (0 level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+9 resistance; +4 levels) + Augment Spell (+5 blessing; +3 levels) + Insightful Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (all of the above; -9 levels) + Variable Spell (full bonuses/penalties need not be applied; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (monk or kensai; -1 level) = 1st level; you take take a penalty of up to -10 to saves and -5 to attacks and damage; creature touched gains equivalent insight bonuses (if your penalty is removed, so is their bonus).

sections.heading: Instrument of AgonyUC
sections.text: Instrument of AgonyUC: Sickening touch (0 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Fell Sickening (+1 level) + Delay Spell (one attack within the next 1 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Tenuous Spell (save each round to end nausea/sickness; -1 level) = 3rd level; one selected hit causes nausea 1 rd./level (Fort sickened).

sections.heading: Intellect FortressSRD
sections.text: Intellect FortressSRD: Warding (force; 1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 additional damage type/3 levels; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Expedient Spell (halves damage only; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Psychokinesis discipline; -1 level) = 4th level; immediate casting halves all damage from spells in personal-range 20’r. emanation for 1 rd.

sections.heading: Intensify SummoningTM2
sections.text: Intensify SummoningTM2: Bestow feat (Spell Focus: conjuration; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Augment Summons; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 7th).

sections.heading: Interminable EchoCM
sections.text: Interminable EchoCM: Skill enhancement (Perception; 0 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (sound lance; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 sonic plus 2d6/rd. and -1/2 levels (-10 max.) penalty to Perception (Will half/neg.).

sections.heading: Internal FireCA
sections.text: Internal FireCA: Jet of flame (0 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (+4d4; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) = 8th level; damage cap 20d6 fire plus 5d4 Con (Fort half) to up to 2d4 + 1/level (+20 max.) HD worth of creatures.

sections.heading: Interposing Hand, Bigby’s
sections.text: Interposing Hand, Bigby’s: Shield (q.v.; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Shape Spell (emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Residual Spell (+1 level) = 5th level; you gain cover (+4 AC) and those approaching you within 60 ft. treat that area as difficult terrain. Variants:

sections.heading: InterrogationUM
sections.text: InterrogationUM: Skill enhancement (Bluff; 0 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) + Delay Spell (until refuses to answer; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; −1 level) = 1st level; creature touched is -1/2 levels (-5 max.) to Bluff checks and takes 1d6 nonlethal/level (max. 5d6) if refuses to answer a question in the next 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Interstellar VoidUM
sections.text: Interstellar VoidUM: Ray of frost (0 level) + Cacscade Spell (touch of fatigue; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Void domain, etc.; -1 level) = 2nd level (1st with access to Void domain); damage cap 5d6 and fatigued (Fort half/neg.). Variants:

sections.heading: IntoxicateRR
sections.text: IntoxicateRR: Damage attribute (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Variable Spell (spread damage among Dex, Int, and Wis; +1 level) + Extend Spell (days to 10 min./level; -2 levels) = 2nd level; deals 1d4 each to Dex, Int, and Wis for 10 min./level (Fort half).

sections.heading: Intoxicating HazeRRO
sections.text: Intoxicating HazeRRO: Sickening touch (0 level) + Fell Sickening (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of obliviousness; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 6th level (listed as 7th); those in area sickened and take 1d6+1/level penalty to Wis (Intuit half; confused at 1).

sections.heading: Investigative MindACG
sections.text: Investigative MindACG: Hand of fate (0 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (skill checks only; -2 levels) = 2nd level; for the next 10 min./level, you roll twice for all skill checks and use the better of the two results.

sections.heading: Investiture of the Barbed DevilFC2
sections.text: Investiture of the Barbed DevilFC2: Bestow feat (Improved Grapple; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (inure: fire; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (also Vital Strike; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +11 effects; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 6th); subject gains Improved Grapple, constrict (base 4d6), and resistance to fire 5/2 levels (40 max.) for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Investiture of the Bearded DevilFC2
sections.text: Investiture of the Bearded DevilFC2: Inure (fire; 0 level) + Cascade Spell [(ivisible needle; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level)] + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain; -1 level) = 1st level (listed as 3rd); subject gains resistance to fire 5/2 levels (15 max.) and secondary natural attack (beard) for up to 5d6 piecing (base).

sections.heading: Investiture of the Chain DevilFC2
sections.text: Investiture of the Chain DevilFC2: Bestow feat (Combat Reflexes; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (inure: fire; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (also Lunge; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; subject gains Combat Reflexes, Lunge, and resistance to fire 5/2 levels (30 max.) for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Investiture of the ErinyesFC2
sections.text: Investiture of the ErinyesFC2: Compel (approach; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (inure: fire; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain; -1 level) = 4th level; subject gains resistance to fire 5/2 levels (30 max.) and as a partial action each round can force a creature within Close range to approach and then stand still.

sections.heading: Investiture of the Harvester DevilFC2
sections.text: Investiture of the Harvester DevilFC2: Inure (fire; 0 level) + Cascade Spell [(invocation of the knife; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (onset: inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (bleed: 1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level)] + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6 and 40 to 15; ­2 levels) = 4th level; subject gains resistance to fire 15, and its melee attacks deal up to +9d6 piercing (divided among attacks) plus 1d6 bleed for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Investiture of the Hellfire EngineFC2
sections.text: Investiture of the Hellfire EngineFC2: Iron body (8th level) – Personal Spell (+1 level) – Augment Spell (-4 levels) + Cascade Spell (inure: fire; +1 level) + Cascade Spell [(jet of flame; +1 level) + Overwhelming Evocation (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level)] + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain; -1 level) = 8th level (listed as 9th); subject gains iron body, resistance to fire 5/2 levels (50 max.), and as a standard action can breath a 30-ft. cone of fire (damage cap 15d6, Reflex half, energy resistance does not apply).

sections.heading: Investiture of the Horned DevilFC2
sections.text: Investiture of the Horned DevilFC2: Bestow feat Staggering Strike; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (inure: fire; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +16 effects; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 8th); subject gains resistance to fire 5/2 levels (40 max.) and Staggering Strike (staggered 1 rd. plus Fort or stunned 1 rd. and staggered 1d4+1).

sections.heading: Investiture of the Ice DevilFC2
sections.text: Investiture of the Ice DevilFC2: Inure (fire; 0 level) + Energy Admixture (cold; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell [(slow: q.v.; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (ray of frost: +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (onset: inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels)] + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain; -1 level) = 7th level; subject gains restance to fire and cold 20, and melee attacks deal up to +27d6 cold plus slowed 1 rd./level (divide damage and duration among attacks each round).

sections.heading: Investiture of the MalebrancheFC2
sections.text: Investiture of the MalebrancheFC2: Bestow feat (Vital Strike; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (inure: fire; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +16 effects; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 6th); subject gains resistance to fire 5/2 levels (40 max.) and Vital Strike +6d6.

sections.heading: Investiture of the NarzugonFC2
sections.text: Investiture of the NarzugonFC2: Inure (fire: 0 level) + Cascade Spell [(compel: don’t move; +3 levels) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Pattern Spell (visual; -1 level)] + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 5th); subject gains resistance to fire 5/2 levels (30 max.) and swift gaze attack causing 1 creeature to stand still and take no actions for 1 rd.

sections.heading: Investiture of the OrthonFC2
sections.text: Investiture of the OrthonFC2: Inure (fire; 0 level) + Energy Admixture (acid; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell [(sound lance; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels)] + Cascade Spell [(warding: teleportation; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level)] + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (40 to 30 and +15 to +10; -1 level) = 5th level; subject gains resistance to acid and fire 15, radiates 20-ft. aura preventing teleportation, and melee attackers take 1d6 +10 sonic per hit.

sections.heading: Investiture of the Pit FiendFC2
sections.text: Investiture of the Pit FiendFC2: Polymorph (fiend; 3rd level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Investiture of the Spined DevilFC2
sections.text: Investiture of the Spined DevilFC2: Invisible needle (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Delay Spell (need not use spines each round; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (inure: fire; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; subject gains resistance to fire 5/2 levels (max. 30) and can fire 3 spines as a standard action (base damage cap 6d6 piercing, divided among them).

sections.heading: Investiture of the Steel DevilFC2
sections.text: Investiture of the Steel DevilFC2: Deflection (0 level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3 total bonus; +1 level) + Augment Spell [(+3 to +7; +4 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (adjacent to at least 1 other under effects of this spell per +1 increse; -2 levels)] + Cascade Spell (inure: fire; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain; -1 level) = 4th level; subject gains +3 profane bonus to attacks and damage, +3 deflection to AC, and resistance to fire 5/2 levels (max. 30). If adjacent to others also under this spell, the bonuses increase by +1 per such creature (total +7 max.).

sections.heading: InvigorateAPG
sections.text: InvigorateAPG: Warding (debilitation; 1st level) + Still Spell (+1 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (fatigue and exhaustion only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard or illusionist; -1 level) = 1st level; suspends fatigue and exhaustion effects for the duration, then deals 3d6 nonlethal when effect ends.

sections.heading: Invigorate DeadRR
sections.text: Invigorate DeadRR: Warding (death; 1st level) + Irresistible Spell (+3 levels) + Cascade Spell (slow; -3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); recently-dead creature has [dead] condition temporarily suspended, but is slowed.

sections.heading: Invigorate ItemAUG
sections.text: Invigorate ItemAUG: Enhancement (2nd level) + Variable Spell (all SLAs of designated item; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 2nd level; +1 enhancement to SLA save DCs of magic item touched for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Invisibility Sphere
sections.text: Invisibility Sphere: Glamer (1st level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r. emanation; -1 level) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (those entering sphere after casting are not affected; -1 level) = 3rd level; those in 10’r. emanation are invisible to those not affected.

sections.heading: Invisibility, Mass
sections.text: Invisibility, Mass: Glamer (1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Stealth; +1 level) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to long; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Communal Spell (+1 level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 7th level; affects up to 600 creatures for 1 rd./level each, or up to 60 for 1 min./level each, masking from sight, sound, smell, touch, and heat sense.

sections.heading: Invisibility, SelectiveRRE
sections.text: Invisibility, SelectiveRRE: Glamer (1st level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) + Augment Spell (tactile and thermal; +1 level) = 5th level; selected creatures in 60’r. emanation are masked to all senses, except to each other.

sections.heading: Invisibility, SuperiorCA
sections.text: Invisibility, SuperiorCA: Glamer (1st level) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Stealth; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 7th level; creature touched is invisible; smell, sound, tactile, and thermal cues absent; and +1/2 levels to Stealth (max. +10). Effect is not broken by attacking.

sections.heading: Invisibility, SwiftCAd
sections.text: Invisibility, SwiftCAd: Glamer (1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Stealth; +1 level) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 1st level; swift casting makes you invisible (and +1/2 levels, max. +5, to Stealth) for 1 rd. or until you attack. AKA disappearRR.

sections.heading: Invisibility, VanishAPG
sections.text: Invisibility, VanishAPG: Glamer (1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Stealth; +1 level) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +1 level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 1st level; subject invisible to sight and +1/2 levels to Stealth (max. +5) for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Invisibility to ConstructsDD
sections.text: Invisibility to ConstructsDD: Glamer (1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Stealth; +1 level) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +1 level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (constructs; -2 levels) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Invisible MailCWH
sections.text: Invisible MailCWH: Mage armor (0 level) + Cascade Spell [(inure: bludgeoning; +1 level) + Energy Admixture (piercing and slashing; +0 levels) + Tenuous Spell (magic; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels)] + Augment Spell (+4 to +8; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; you gain +8 armor bonus to AC and DR 5/adamantine or magic (DR 10 at CL 12th).

sections.heading: Invoke MagicLoM
sections.text: Invoke MagicLoM: Warding (null magic; 1st level) + Irresistible Spell (+3 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 360’r.; +4 levels) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 9th level; as a swift action, you allow your magic to function for 1 rd. even in an antimagic field, dead magic zone, or null magic plane.

sections.heading: Invoked ApocalypseAUG
sections.text: Invoked ApocalypseAUG: Sound lance (1st level) + Energy Admixture (acid, cold, electricity, and fire; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to line of sight; +4 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to cylinder; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10’r. to ½ mi.; +6 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (whelm; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 10d6; -3 levels) = 9th level; 2d6 each acid, cold, electricity, fire, and sonic (Reflex half) in 1-mile diameter circle to a height of 2.5 miles, up to ¼ mile/level away, each round for 1 rd./level. Caster takes 25d6 nonlethal.

sections.heading: Involuntary ShapeshiftingRE
sections.text: Involuntary ShapeshiftingRE: Compel (change form; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 4th level; subject must change shape each round and takes 5d6 damage when doing so (Will neg./half).

sections.heading: Invulnerability to WeaponsCWH
sections.text: Invulnerability to WeaponsCWH: Warding (1st level) + Mass Effect (1/3 levels; +3 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (1-way; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 5th level; those within 5 ft.of you take no bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage (but can still use physical weapons dealing those types of damage).

sections.heading: Iron ButterfliesRR2
sections.text: Iron ButterfliesRR2: Invcocation of the knife (0 level) + Cascade Spell (lesser versatile weaponAPG; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (ailing; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cone; +1 level) + Widen Spell (30 ft. to 60 ft.; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (fey; -2 levels) = 3rd level (divine 4th); damage cap 10d6 slashing (bypasses DR/cold iron, Reflex half) and ailing 1 rd./level (Fort neg.) vs. fey in 60-ft. cone.

sections.heading: Iron ScarfCA
sections.text: Iron ScarfCA: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) = 1st level; damage cap 5d6 slashing plus entangled 1 rd./level. Note that this spell includes the effects of the entangling scarf spell, and is resolved as a ranged touch attack rather than a ranged attack. Variants:

sections.heading: Iron SilenceCAd
sections.text: Iron SilenceCAd: Glamer (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Item-Specific Spell (armor only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (no olfactory, tactile; -2 levels) = 2nd level; negates armor check penalty to Stealth.

sections.heading: Iron StakeUW
sections.text: Iron StakeUW: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (ailing; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (with DR/cold iron; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (invisible needle; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Cold Iron Strike; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level; ranged touch deals 5d6 piercing (penetrates DR/cold iron and bypasses SR), and creatures with DR/cold iron are left ailing 1 rd./level (Fort neg.).

sections.heading: Iron StormRR
sections.text: Iron StormRR: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Energy Admixture (electricity; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (emanation; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 3rd level; 2d6 slashing and 3d6 electricity/rd. to those in 20’r.

sections.heading: IrongutsMF
sections.text: IrongutsMF: Resistance (0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (Fort saves only; -2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell ([afflictions]; -1 level) = 1st level; subject gains +5 sacred bonus vs. afflictions for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: IronheartRR
sections.text: IronheartRR: Resistance (0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+5 total bonus; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; subject gains +5 to saves for 1 rd. as an immediate action, or can use smaller bonuses multiple times until +5 total is reached (the Interrupting component allows the subject to gauge the margin by which a save would otherwise fail).

sections.heading: IronheartSLPG
sections.text: IronheartSLPG: Resistance (0 level) + Augment Spell (+5 total bonus; +3 levels) = 3rd level; subject gains +5 resistance to saves for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Ironwood
sections.text: Ironwood: Versatile weaponAPG (q.v.; 2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (steel; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (enhancement; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Druid of Earth & Metal; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 2 hrs./level; +4 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 6th); wooden object becomes equivalent of steel, but is still usable by druids, and gains +1/4 levels enhancement bonus. Note that, rather than investing 45,000 numen to maintain a permanent active spell effect, in this case more cost-effective permanent ironwood is available using the special materials rules in Chapter 6.

sections.heading: Irresistible Dance, Otto’s
sections.text: Irresistible Dance, Otto’s: Compel (dance; 2nd level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of clumsiness; +1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) = 7th level (listed as 8th); compels victim to dance for 1 rd./level (no save), provoking attacks of opportunity and taking a 1d6+15 penalty to Dex.

sections.heading: IsolateMC
sections.text: IsolateMC: Glamer (1st level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +1 level) = 3rd level; target is invisible and inaudible to its allies for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Item from BeyondAUG2
sections.text: Item from BeyondAUG2: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Ivory FleshFB
sections.text: Ivory FleshFB: Skill enhancement (Stealth; 0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (snowy and/or icy areas; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Winter domain; -1 level) = 0 level; +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Stealth in wintry terrain.
