sections.text: Jet of SteamCM: Jet of flame (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to line; +1 level) = 1st level; damage cap 5d6 fire in Close range line. Variants:

sections.heading: Jig of the WavesSW
sections.text: Jig of the WavesSW: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (compel: move in random direction; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); up to 2d4+5 HD worth of creatures spend a move action each round to move in a random direction, and are sickened while you concentrate and 1 round thereafter.

sections.heading: Joyful NoiseCAd
sections.text: Joyful NoiseCAd: Warding (glamer; 1st level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (silence only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 1st level; wards against magical silence.

sections.heading: Joyful RaptureUM
sections.text: Joyful RaptureUM: Remove condition (emotion effects; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (remove condition: attribute damage; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) = 6th level; removes up to 6d6 attribute damage and/or serious [emotion] conditions (or renders critical ones merely minor) for those in 20’r. burst.

sections.heading: Judgment UndonePnA
sections.text: Judgment UndonePnA: True resurrection (9th level) + Irresistible Spell (can affect outsider; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (planar petitioner; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (extend lifeAUG; +5 levels) + Cascade Spell (summon monster IX: olethros psychopomp; -5 levels) = 9th level; you restore planar petitioner to mortal life, removing 1d4 age penalty from each attribute (if applicable).

sections.heading: Jump
sections.text: Jump: Skill enhancement (Athletics; 0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (jumping only; -2 levels) + = 1st level; +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Athletics checks to jump, and always treated as if have a running start (if actually running, treat speed as 10 ft. greater).

sections.heading: Jungle’s RaptureSC
sections.text: Jungle’s RaptureSC: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (+2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain, etc.; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 5th); target takes 1d4 Dex drain/day, turning to shrub/tree at Dex 0 (i.e., wood instead of stone). You must invest 1,200 x CL numen (4th level x 50 x 6) to maintain the effect past the 1st day. Variant:

sections.heading: Just AllyPC
sections.text: Just AllyPC: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 8 shield archon; +5 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (servant of lawful good; -1 level) = 6th level.

sections.heading: Just Reversal, Jevicca’sAUG2
sections.text: Just Reversal, Jevicca’sAUG2: Dispel (0 level) + Augment Spell (reverse back onto caster; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (enchantments only; -2 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (no check needed; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 3rd); next enchantment spell targeting you affects caster instead (save applies). Note numen cost for latent spell effects.

sections.heading: Justice, Hedrada’sRR2
sections.text: Justice, Hedrada’sRR2: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+5 total bonus; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 hr./level; +1 level) + Creaure-Specific Spell (only against last creature to injure you; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); you gain +5 sacred bonus to attacks and damage against the last creature to have injured you during the spell’s duration.

sections.heading: Karmic AuraCM
sections.text: Karmic AuraCM: Touch of fatigue (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (fatigue: 1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); after swift casting, those within close range who damage you during the next round are fatigued 1 rd./level (up to 1 attack/3 levels).

sections.heading: Karmic BacklashCM
sections.text: Karmic BacklashCM: Karmic aura (q.v.; 3rd level) + Augment Spell (exhaust; +1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd).

sections.heading: Karmic RetributionCM
sections.text: Karmic RetributionCM: Inertia (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) = 7th level (listed as 6th); as a swift action, those within close range who damage you during the next round must save or be stunned 1 rd. (up to 1 attack/3 levels).

sections.heading: KeepsakeRRO
sections.text: KeepsakeRRO: Enhancement (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (hardness; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (mage hand; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (modified spark of life; +1 level) + Extend Spell (conc. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level; item specified is +1/3 levels to hardness, gains 10d6 temp. hp, and stays within 20 ft. of you at all times. Invest 250 x CL numen to extend beyond 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Ki ArrowUM
sections.text: Ki ArrowUM: Invisible needle (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Versatile Strike; +1 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 1st level; one Medium ranged (thrown weapon) attack deals 1d6 piercing/level (5d6 max.) plus Str modifier and carries improvements that apply to your unarmed attacks.

sections.heading: Ki LeechAPG
sections.text: Ki LeechAPG: Dispel (0 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (transfer spell slot to you; +1 level) = 2nd level; melee attack also steals highest-level spell/slot available (opposed Concentration check needed for success). Cf. power leechSRD.

sections.heading: Kiai, GreatOA1
sections.text: Kiai, GreatOA1: Attribute boost (Str; 0 kevel) + Cascade Spell [(inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level)] + [Augment Spell (+6 to Str; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level)] = 5th level; you gain +6 enhancement to Str for 1 rd./level and those within 10 ft. are stunned 1 rd.

sections.heading: Kin CurseAUG2
sections.text: Kin CurseAUG2: Compel (kill nearest blood relative; 2nd level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) = 5th level; target must go and kill his or her nearest blood relative. Invest 250 x CL numen to maintain compulsion after 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Kin LinkAUG2
sections.text: Kin LinkAUG2: Rary’s telepathic bond (q.v.; 5th level) + Creature-Specific Spell (all targets must be blood relatives; -2 levels) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Kinetic ControlSRD
sections.text: Kinetic ControlSRD: Inure (slashing; 0 level) + Energy Admixture: bludgeoning and piercing; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (energy mace; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Delay Spell (expend incrementally; +1 level) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; −1 level) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 20d6; -1 level) = 9th level (listed as epic); you gain DR 15/adamantine, and can deal up to 54  + 6/level (max. 174) bludgeoning by touch (divided as you choose; max. 120 with one touch).

sections.heading: Kiss of the ToadCA
sections.text: Kiss of the ToadCA: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) Silent Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (wu jen; -1 level) = 2nd level; touch deals 1d4 Con/rd. (Fort half) 1 rd./level or until save.

sections.heading: Kiss of the VampireLM
sections.text: Kiss of the VampireLM: Polymorph (undead; 3rd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Magical Talent; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Magical Array; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 5th); for 1 rd./level, you gain undead type and a suite of racial spell-like abilities: 1st—charm person, 2nd—personal gasous form, 3rd—vampiric touch, 4th—enervation, etc.

sections.heading: KnavescourAUG2
sections.text: KnavescourAUG2: Acid splash (0 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +4 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; −1 level) + Delay Spell (when focus item touched; +1 level) = 4th level; up to 1 object/level deals up to 1d6 acid/level (max. 15d6) when next touched.

sections.heading: Knight’s CallingAPG
sections.text: Knight’s CallingAPG: Compel (move up to me; 2nd level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 0 level.

sections.heading: Knock
sections.text: Knock: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bolt of force; +2 levels) + Overwhelming Evocation (+1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (door or similar lockable item; -2 levels) = 2nd level; dispels an arcane lock or suspends magical treatment to a door’s hardness and break DC, and deals 1d6 force/level (max. 10d6; bypasses hardness) to the door or lock. It does not auto-bypass locks, in keeping with the general rules governing “Spells that Supersede Skills and Class Features.” AKA open doorAUG. Variants:

sections.heading: Know AgeTM2
sections.text: Know AgeTM2: Detection (age of subect; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) – Concentration Spell (-1 level) = 0 level; you instantaneously know the age of one creature or object touched.

sections.heading: Know AlignmentPH1
sections.text: Know AlignmentPH1: Detection (alignment; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (cone to target; -1 level) + Extend Spell (conc. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level; learn alignment of one creature/rd.

sections.heading: Know Direction and LocationSRD
sections.text: Know Direction and LocationSRD: Augury (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (location & direction only; -2 levels) – Ritual Spell (+2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Knowledge (planes); +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level (ranger, seer, etc. 1st);  you have presentiment of your general location in terms of a prominent local landmark, and the direction you’re facing, and gain +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Knowledge (planes) check to figure out where in the Multiverse you are.

sections.heading: Know Greatest EnemyMF
sections.text: Know Greatest EnemyMF: Detection (potential combatants; 2nd level) + Concentration Spell (standard to swift; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 2nd level; detects number, locations, and relative CR of creatures that have CR ratings. (Rather than announcing CR values, the referee can use the rule of thumb that every 2 CR above or below the caster’s represents another doubling or halving of his or relative power.)

sections.heading: Know PeerageUI
sections.text: Know PeerageUI: Skill enhancement (Diplomacy; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Streetwise; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) = 2nd level; subject +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Diplomacy and Streetwise. Variants:

sections.heading: Know ProtectionsMF
sections.text: Know ProtectionsMF: Skill enhancement (0 level) + Variable Spell (Knowledge appropriate to creature type; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 level) = 1st level; swift casting grants you +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Knowledge check to identify DR, SR, resistances/ immunities, etc. for 1 rd. AKA demoncallBVD, know the enemyUM.

sections.heading: Know thy MasterRRO
sections.text: Know thy MasterRRO: Enhancement (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (item function; -2 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (enlarge; +3 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 4th level; object -1/4 levels enhancement and weighs 8x normal when used by unauthorized person. Invest 300 x CL numen to maintain effect indefinitely.

sections.heading: Know ValueCWH
sections.text: Know ValueCWH: Bestow feat (Eye for Larceny; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Knowledge (lore); +1 level) + Augment Spell (16 ramks effects; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level (rogue skill trick 2nd; listed as 5th); you can check at +1/2 levels to learn the types, number, and worth (to within 75%) of all treasure within sight within 30 ft. of you.

sections.heading: Kuo-Toa SkinSW
sections.text: Kuo-Toa SkinSW: Warding (bind; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Escape Artist; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 2nd); subject +1/2 levels to Escape Artist and is immune to magical [restraint].

sections.heading: J - K
sections.text:
FirestreamARG is Lingering (+1 level) and Concentration (standard; +1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 fire plus 1d6 burn (Reflex half/neg.), and you can redirect the line each round.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteMoonraker (new) is Reach (close to planar; +5 levels), Widened (5’ dia. to ¼ mi. dia; +6 levels), Overwhelming (+1 level), Concentration (standard; +1 level), Location-Specific (outdoors at night; -2 levels), Ritual (-2 levels), and Reduced (25d6 to 20d6; -1 level) = 9th level; 20d6 fire (ignores hardness, energy resistance) in a quarter-mile diameter anywhere on the same plane of existence, as long as you can see the target; continue blasting each round as a standard action. With this spell, you can melt craters on the moon or destroy fleets of enemy spacecraft (not appropriate for all settings).Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteMolten blastAUG2 Cascades ray of clumsiness (+2 levels) and is Irresistible (+2 levels) = 5th level; damage cap 15d6 fire plus 1d6+1/level (+15 max.) penalty to Dex (Reflex half, no SR).Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Green CaressHA: Damage attribute (1st level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 attribute/3 levels; +2 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Cross-Class Spell (transmutation [polymorph: plant]; +1 level) = 6th level; touch deals 1d4 drain to Str, Dex, Con (and Int at CL 12th, Cha at 15th, Wis at 18th). Invest 300 x CL numen for drain to recur each day (becomes normal shrub if any score reduced to 0) until curse removed or polymorphed back to normal. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Bigby’s battering gauntletGA is Long range (+1 level) and is repeatable each round with concentration (standard; +1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); damage cap 15d6 force (bypasses hardness).Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteGreat KnockRR: Sound lance (1st level) + Shape Spell (ray to line; +1 level) + Overwhelming Evocation (+1 level) = 3rd level (bard 2nd); damage cap 10d6 sonic (bypasses hardness and energy resistance); when cast on a door or other portal, the line extends beyond if the portal is destroyed.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteMass KnockSLPG: Knock (2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 target/level; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 10d6; -2 levels) = 4th level.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Friendly faceRD also includes the Personal Spell feat (-1 level, for 1st). Know CustomsTM2: Skill enhancement (Streetwise; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Diplomacy; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (tribe or village you are currently in; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Community, Knowledge, or Travel domain; -1 level) + Augment Spell (+2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 3rd); you gain knowledge of local customs, etiquette, and laws, for +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Diplomacy and Streetwise checks there. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente

sections.heading: Labyrinthine WildsUW
sections.text: Labyrinthine WildsUW: Touch of fatigue (0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Survival; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (glamer; +1 level) + Augment Spell (remove memory; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to horizontal wall; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. squares to 1-mile squares; +7 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Cascade Spell (enervation; -4 levels) = 6th level (listed as 5th); Survival checks to navigate 1 sq. mi./level are at -1/2 levels, and Intuition or forget route and details of travel and become fatigued. Caster takes 1d4 temp. negative levels. Invest 300 x CL numen to maintain effect past 1 rd./level (until dispelled).

sections.heading: Lamentable Belabourment, Leomund’sUA1
sections.text: Lamentable Belabourment, Leomund’sUA1: Compel (debate politely; 2nd level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (lesser compelling confusion; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Delay Spell (confusion begins after debate ends; +1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) +  Expedient Spell (Int limit; -1 level) = 5th level; subject (Int 3-14) debates politely, ignoring all else, until you stop concentrating; thereafter, he or she saves again or attacks the nearest creature (or self, if none near), or instead sits and cries at own foolishness (does nothing) if saves, for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Lance of DisruptionS&M
sections.text: Lance of DisruptionS&M: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Shape Spell (ray to line; +1 level) + Overwhelming Evocation (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 3rd level; Close line deals up to 10d6 force (Reflex half; hardness, etc. do not apply).

sections.heading: Land of StabilityTM2
sections.text: Land of StabilityTM2: Warding (natural disasters; 1st level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +3 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Law or Protection domain; -1 level) = 6th level; natural and magical avalanches, earthquakes, floods, windstorms, volcanic eruptions do not enter warded area of one 10-ft. cube/level. Invest 6,000 x CL numen (6th level x 500 x 2) to maintain the effect indefinitely.

sections.heading: Languid VenomUI
sections.text: Languid VenomUI: Delay poison (q.v.; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Craft (toxicology); +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 4th level (listed as 2nd); poison gains 1 hr./level onset time, -1/2 levels to be detected or identified. Invest 200 x CL numen to maintain until activated.

sections.heading: Languid Venom, ContingentUI
sections.text: Languid Venom, ContingentUI: Languid venomUI (q.v.; 4th level) + Delay Spell (end onset time when specified triggering event occurs; +1 level) = 5th level (listed as 4th).

sections.heading: LanguorCD
sections.text: LanguorCD: Slow (3rd level) + Cascade Spell (ray of enfeeblement; +1 level) = 4th level; target staggered, entangled, and takes penalty to Str equal to 1d6 +1/level (+15 max.).

sections.heading: Lash of ForceCM
sections.text: Lash of ForceCM: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to line; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift; +3 levels) = 7th level; damage cap 20d6 plus knocked prone.

sections.heading: Last JudgmentBED
sections.text: Last JudgmentBED: Plane shift (Hell; 6th level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Wis; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 20d6; -1 level) = 8th level; damage cap 20d6 plus 3d4 Wis and sent to Hell (save half/half/neg.).

sections.heading: Last RitesPnA
sections.text: Last RitesPnA: Spark of life (1st level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; -1 level) + Transdimensional Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6 plus staggered 1 rd. vs. undead and haunts.

sections.heading: Launch BoltMF
sections.text: Launch BoltMF: Invisible needle (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Versatile Strike; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 1d6; ­2 levels) = 0 level; you fire an arrow or crossbow bolt as a Medium ranged touch attack dealing 1d6 base damage; it retains its proper weapon’s properties, feats, etc. Variants:

sections.heading: Lava MissileSK
sections.text: Lava MissileSK: Jet of flame (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Lingeriong Evocation (+1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Cascade Spell [(bestow feat: Precise Shot; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +11 effects; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level)] + Resistible Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; 1  ranged touch attack/2 levels (7 max.) deals 1d6 fire each plus 1d6 burn (Reflex half/neg.), ignore cover and concealment less than total.

sections.heading: Lava SplashSK
sections.text: Lava SplashSK: Variable Spell (+1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Lead BladesAPG
sections.text: Lead BladesAPG: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Item-Specific Spell (melee weapons only; -2 levels) + Expedient Spell (additional damage limited by initial base damage; -1 level) = 1st level; affected melee weapon deals 1 die step larger base damage (Chapter 1). AKA bladethirstRR2, enlarge weaponCSc. Variants:

sections.heading: Leaf on the WindUC
sections.text: Leaf on the WindUC: Attribute boost (Dex; 0 level) + Augment Spell (+12 bonus; +6 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 4th level; while you concentrate, you gain +12 Dex and fast healing 1/level (max. 10).

sections.heading: Leaping FlameToB
sections.text: Leaping FlameToB: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (adjacent to enemy that just attacked you; -2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) = 5th level; immediate casting (that cannot be counterspelled) teleports you adjacent to the last opponent that attacked you.

sections.heading: Learn HeritageAUG2
sections.text: Learn HeritageAUG2: Detection (ancestry; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (cone to target; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 0 level; 1st round—type/race; 2nd—ancestry/family; 3rd—bloodline or other admixture. Know bloodlineLEF has a standard casting time (1st level; listed as 3rd).

sections.heading: Learn SecretAUG
sections.text: Learn SecretAUG: Enhancment (2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) = 1st level; you gain +1/4 levels enhancement when using item touched for the next 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Leashed ShacklesUM
sections.text: Leashed ShacklesUM: Bind (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 4th).

sections.heading: Leech FieldSRD
sections.text: Leech FieldSRD: Dispel (0 level) + Augment Spell (use energy to regain own spell slots; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) = 7th level (listed as 5th); you can decide to suppress spells cast within 20’r., regaining a spell slot of that level if successful, for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: LegacyAUG2
sections.text: LegacyAUG2: Figment (0 level) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (image of you only; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (scripted; +1 level) = 1st level (listed as 2nd); visual image of you appears when activating condition met, acts out script for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Legal ThoughtsTM2
sections.text: Legal ThoughtsTM2: Compel (follow law cited; 2nd level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Law domain; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 6th); subject compelled to obey one law you cite to the letter. Invest 200 x CL numen to maintain curse indefinitely.

sections.heading: Legion’s MarchRR
sections.text: Legion’s MarchRR: Attriubute boost (Con; 0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 total bonus; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level (listed as 5th); one subject/level gains long-lasting +4 enhancement to Con.

sections.heading: Lethality DeniedAUG2
sections.text: Lethality DeniedAUG2: Metaphysical feat (Merciful Spell; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Delay Spell (+1 level) = 3rd level; the next attack that would otherwise kill the target through hp loss deals nonlethal damage instead.

sections.heading: Levitation, HostileUC
sections.text: Levitation, HostileUC: Mage hand (0 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 216 lbs./level; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (concentration to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (vertical lift only; -2 levels) = 3rd level; target gently floats above the floor (Will neg.) to height up to Close range for 1 rd./level (you cannot slam it against the ceiling), is easier to drag, push, etc.

sections.heading: Levity, Eriador’sAUG2
sections.text: Levity, Eriador’sAUG2: Resistance (0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +5; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (mind-affecting; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 skill/3 levels; +2 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 3rd level; subject +5 vs. [mind-affecting] and +1/2 levels to Diplomacy, Streetwise, and 1 Perform skill/3 levels above 6th, but cannot initiate combat; invest 600 x CL numen to maintain indefinitely.

sections.heading: Liberating CommandUC
sections.text: Liberating CommandUC: Skill enhancement (Escape Artist; 0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (restrained ally only; −2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) = 1st level; restrained creature gains Escape Artist check at +1/2 levels. Immediate casting on your part means check can interrupt constriction, etc.

sections.heading: Life LureUM
sections.text: Life LureUM: Compel (fascinate; 2nd level) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) + Threnodic Spell (+0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (able to channel positive energy; -1 level) = 3rd level; undead in 20’r. are fascinated 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Life ShieldRR
sections.text: Life ShieldRR: Spark of life (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (arcane; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; you gain up to 5d6 temp. hp lasting up to 10 min./level. Variants:

sections.heading: Light, ContinualPH1
sections.text: Light, ContinualPH1: Light (0 level) + Augment Spell (bright light; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level; invest 11,250 numen (3rd level x CL 5th x 500 x 1.5) to make permanent.

sections.heading: Light, Irian’sRE
sections.text: Light, Irian’sRE: Spark of life (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 8d6 positive energy, divided among Medium-ranged rays.

sections.heading: Light BladeRR2
sections.text: Light BladeRR2: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Bane Spell (fixed: evil; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell [(enhancement; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (invocation; ­2 levels)] + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6 and +1/4 levels to +1; ­1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 7d6 slashing (7d8 vs. evil), divided among iterative melee touch attacks with +1 enhancement bonus, and sheds light.

sections.heading: Lightburst, Nystul’sGA
sections.text: Lightburst, Nystul’sGA: Flare (0 level) + Augment Spell (blinding; +1 level) + Extend Spell (blindness: 1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Inexorable Evocation (+3 levels) + Cascade Spell (disrupt undead; +1 level) + Positive Spell (+0 levels) + Shape Spell (burst; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 5th level; damage cap 10d6 (15d6 to undead, 5d6 to others) and blinds 1 round.

sections.heading: Lighten LoadTM2
sections.text: Lighten LoadTM2: Reduce (3rd level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (anger or access to Travel domain; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 2nd); weight of objects and creatures in 5’r. is reduced to 1/8 for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Lightning Bolt
sections.text: Lightning Bolt: Electric arc (0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Lightning RingPGF
sections.text: Lightning RingPGF: Inure (electricity; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (electric arc; +1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Line in the SandACG
sections.text: Line in the SandACG: Bestow feat (Combat Reflexes; 1st level) + Variable Spell (casting stat instead of Dex; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; you can take additional immediate actions (max. 1 + spell-casting attribute modifier per round).

sections.heading: Line of ProtectionTM2
sections.text: Line of ProtectionTM2: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Bane Spell ([evil]: fixed; +0 levels) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: LinebreakerARG
sections.text: LinebreakerARG: Celerity (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Improved Bull Rush; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Improved Overrun; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell ([orc] caster; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); you gain +20 ft. speed and Improved Forcing Maneuvers.

sections.heading: Lingering ChorusCM
sections.text: Lingering ChorusCM: Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 4th level; swift casting extends 1 rd. inspiration to 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Lingering FlamesCM
sections.text: Lingering FlamesCM: Jet of flame (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 5th level; damage cap 15d6 fire/rd. in 20’r. Variants:

sections.heading: Lingering InfernoToB
sections.text: Lingering InfernoToB: Jet of flame (0 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) = 1st level; single melee attack deals up to +5d6 fire plus 2d6 burn.

sections.heading: Lion’s ChargeSRD
sections.text: Lion’s ChargeSRD: Bestow feat (Skirmish; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: prerequisite; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 2nd level; swift casting provides you with pounce ability for 1 rd.

sections.heading: Liquid FormRRO
sections.text: Liquid FormRRO: Polymorph (elemental; 3rd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (water elemental; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 2 min./level; +1 level) + Augment Spell (3rd level effects; +1 level) = 3rd level; subject becomes water elemental, gains darkvision, swim 30 ft., resist fire 5, water breathing, and can pass through narrow pipes, etc. Cf. cloak of the seaCAd. Variants:

sections.heading: Listening RingwormRR
sections.text: Listening RingwormRR: Alter senses (0 level) + Reach Spell (effects: close to planar; +6 levels) + Reach Spell (target: close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (vicinity of creature touched only; -2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (sensor removed by remove disease, etc.; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Pestilence or Plant domain; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd), you plant sensor on target by touch, can listen to its surroundings 1 hr./level thereafter.

sections.heading: Litany of DefenseUC
sections.text: Litany of DefenseUC: Enhancement (2nd level) + Item-Specific Spell (armor only; -2 levels) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (remove fear; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 2nd level; swift casting grants you +1 sacred bonus/4 levels to AC and immunity to fear for 1 rd.

sections.heading: Litany of EloquenceUC
sections.text: Litany of EloquenceUC: Compel (watch; 2nd level) + Quicken Spell (+4 levels) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin or access to Inquisition domain; -1 level) = 4th level; swift casting fascinates target for 1 round.

sections.heading: Litany of EntanglementUC
sections.text: Litany of EntanglementUC: Bind (0 level) + Quicken Spell (+4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin or access to Inquisition domain; -1 level) = 1st level; swift casting entangles target for 1 round.

sections.heading: Litany of EscapeUC
sections.text: Litany of EscapeUC: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (target; touch to close; +1 level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (grappled subject only; -2 levels) = 4th level; grappled ally is dimension doored out of grapple to location within Close range.

sections.heading: Litany of MadnessUC
sections.text: Litany of MadnessUC: Lesser compelling confusion (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (antipaladin or access to Inquisition or Madness domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; swift casting confuses target 1 rd./level (save each round to end effect).

sections.heading: Litany of RighteousnessUC
sections.text: Litany of RighteousnessUC: Light (0 level) + Augment Spell (dazzling; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (light: 10 min./level to 1 rd.; -3 levels) + Extend Spell (dazzling: 1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Shape Spell (emanation to target; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (sound lance; +1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (vs. [evil] only; -2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Restricted Spell ([good] caster; -1 level) = 3rd level (paladin 2nd); damage cap +12d6 (half sonic, half holy) divided among melee attacks vs. [evil] opponent, plus dazzles 1 rd./level or until save.

sections.heading: Litany of SightUC
sections.text: Litany of SightUC: See invisibility (q.v.; 2nd level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Litany of SlothUC
sections.text: Litany of SlothUC: Bestow Feat (Combat Reflexes; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Concentration; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin or access to Inquisition domain; -1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); target cannot take immediate actions and is -1/2 levels (-10 max.) to Concentration for 1 round.

sections.heading: Litany of ThunderUC
sections.text: Litany of ThunderUC: Ray of obliviousness (1st level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses: deafness; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Extend Spell (deafness; 1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin or access to Inquisition domain; -1 level) = 4th level; swift casting deals 1d6+1/level (+15 max.) penalty to Wis for 1 rd./level (confused at 1), deafens 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Litany of VengeanceUC
sections.text: Litany of VengeanceUC: Blessing (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (+3 levels) + Augment Spell (+2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (specified target only; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (choose target at time of casting; +1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin or access to Inquisition domain; -1 level) = 4th level; swift casting grants 1 creature/level +4 sacred bonus to attacks and damage against target  for 1 round.

sections.heading: Litany of WardingUC
sections.text: Litany of WardingUC: Bestow feat (Combat Reflexes; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Restricted Spell (paladin or access to Inquisition domain; -1 level) = 1st level; you gain Combat Reflexes for 1 round as a swift action.

sections.heading: Litany of WeaknessUC
sections.text: Litany of WeaknessUC: Touch of fatigue (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Extend Spell (8 hrs. to 10 min./level; -1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin or access to Inquisition domain; -1 level) = 1st level; target fatigued.

sections.heading: Live WoodRR
sections.text: Live WoodRR: VigorCD (q.v.; 3rd level) + Shape Spell (emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Item-Specific Spell (wood only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 1st level; wood in area regenerates 2 hp/rd. until 1d6+1 hp/level regained (max. 5d6+5).

sections.heading: Living PrintsMF
sections.text: Living PrintsMF: Enhancement (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (tracking time lapse DC; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Survival; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1/4 to +1/3; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger; -2 levels) = 1st level; you gain +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Survival checks, and the elapsed-time DCs for your tracking are reduced by 1/3 levels.

sections.heading: Living WeaponSLPG
sections.text: Living WeaponSLPG: Invisible needle (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (enhancement; +2 levels) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Loathsome VeilUM
sections.text: Loathsome VeilUM: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. cubes to 20-ft. cubes; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Fell Sickening (+1 level) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) = 6th level (listed as 3rd); 2d4 +1/level (+15 max.) HD nauseated 1 rd./level (Fort sickened). To get down to 3rd level, remove Concentration Spell, Fell Sickening, and Widen Spell.

sections.heading: Locate CityRD
sections.text: Locate CityRD: Detection (cities; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to continental; +5 levels) – Concentration Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 5th level (bard 4th, ranger 3rd with Restricted Spell; listed as 1st).

sections.heading: Locate CorpseRR
sections.text: Locate CorpseRR: Detection (corpses; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Locate GateHA
sections.text: Locate GateHA: Detection (dimensional portals; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (concentration to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 5th level.

sections.heading: Locate OasisRR2
sections.text: Locate OasisRR2: Detection (water; 2nd level) + Location-Specific Spell (in desert; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to extreme; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (conc. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 1st).

sections.heading: Locate WaterSSt
sections.text: Locate WaterSSt: Detection (water; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (bodies of water—pools, brooks, lakes, rivers, etc.; -2 levels) + Resistible Spell (blocked by fire or magma; -1 level) = 1st level; 1st round—presence or absence; 2nd—number and size of largest; 3rd—sizes and locations. DowsingRR also adds Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels); it can penetrate the ground surface (1st level; listed as 0).

sections.heading: Locate WaterRR2
sections.text: Locate WaterRR2: Detection (water; 2nd level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Locate WeaknessUC
sections.text: Locate WeaknessUC: Hand of fate (0 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (damage only; -2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 3rd); for the next 1 min./level, you roll all damage twice and take the better of the two.

sections.heading: Lock GazeUC
sections.text: Lock GazeUC: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (blindness; +1 level) + Selective Spell (subject can see you; +1 level) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; target can look only at you 1 rd./level, is blind to everything else.

sections.heading: LockjawAPG
sections.text: LockjawAPG: Bestow feat (Improved Grapple; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Maneuvering Strike; +1 level) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Long ArmACG
sections.text: Long ArmACG: Enlarge (3rd level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; your reach increases by 5 ft. for 1 min./level (assume the other bonuses/penalties for changing size cancel out).

sections.heading: Long FlameAUG2
sections.text: Long FlameAUG2: Light (0 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (replaces light of finite mundane light source; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 0 level; existing candle, lantern, etc. continues to illuminate 20’r. for 1 hr./level after it would otherwise go out.

sections.heading: Longstrider, GreaterACG
sections.text: Longstrider, GreaterACG: Celerity (0 level) + Variable Spell (additional movement speeds; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; +20 ft. to land speed; +10 ft. to others for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Longstrider, MassPHII
sections.text: Longstrider, MassPHII: Celerity (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Travel domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (+70 ft. to +10 ft.; -3 levels) = 4th level.

sections.heading: Lord of NightmaresSRD
sections.text: Lord of NightmaresSRD: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 18 dream larva; +10 levels) + Cascade Spell (possessionOcA; -3 levels) = 8th level (listed as epic); for 1 rd./level you are possessed by a dream larvaELH (use all of its stats in place of yours; you cannot act, nor control what situation you’ll be in when the duration ends).

sections.heading: Lord of the CityAUG2
sections.text: Lord of the CityAUG2: Detection (residents; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (message; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to line of sight; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (conc. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (-1 level) = 9th level; for 1 hr./level, you know the location, numbers, and status of all residents of settlement you are in, and can communicate with them.

sections.heading: Lore KeeperCRB
sections.text: Lore KeeperCRB: Skill enhancement (Knowledge; 0 level) + Variable Spell (as appropriate for target; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Knowledge domain; -1 level) = 0 level; as a swift action, make an appropriate knowledge or other ID check with a +1/2 levels bonus (+5 max.). Cf. ancient knowledgeME.

sections.heading: Lose the PathPH1
sections.text: Lose the PathPH1: Glamer (1st level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (other sense: navigation; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 6th level; subject cannot discern direction to find its way: obscures visual, auditory, olfactory, tactile clues and eliminates all sense of direction.

sections.heading: Love’s LamentSC
sections.text: Love’s LamentSC: Damage attribute (Wis; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Tenous Spell (save each round to end nausea; -1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (cone; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 4th level; cone deals 1d4 Wis damage (Fort half) and nausea until save made (max. 1 rd./level).

sections.heading: Lovers’ KnotRRO
sections.text: Lovers’ KnotRRO: MindlinkSRD (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (detection; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (cone to target; -1 level) + Variable Spell (bestow effects to other; +1 level) + Extend Spell (conc. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 7th level; two subjects can communicate telepathically, and know one another’s location. Invest 350 x CL numen to maintain effect.

sections.heading: Lower Spell ResistanceTM2
sections.text: Lower Spell ResistanceTM2: Warding (SR; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; removes SR (Fort neg.) for 1 min./level. Variants:

sections.heading: Love’s PainBVD
sections.text: Love’s PainBVD: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Variable Spell (loved one instead of target; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (target’s closest friend/ loved one; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (medium to interplanar; +5 levels) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 2nd); medium ranged touch deals 1d6 negative energy/level (max. 10d6) to target’s closest friend or loved one (even if they are on another plane).

sections.heading: Low-Light VisionCA
sections.text: Low-Light VisionCA: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (vision only; -1 level) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Luck, Enkili’sRR
sections.text: Luck, Enkili’sRR: Compel (fail; 2nd level) + Delay Spell (next major effort; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to inst.; -1 level) = 3rd level; subject is compelled to fail at its next major effort.

sections.heading: Lucky Bead, Blaise’sRR2
sections.text: Lucky Bead, Blaise’sRR2: Hand of fate (0 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 4th); for the next 1 rd./level, you roll twice for d20 rolls and select the better result.

sections.heading: Lucky BladeME
sections.text: Lucky BladeME: Hand of fate (0 level) + Delay Spell (swift activation; +4 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (attack roll only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 2nd); as an immediate action, reroll one attack roll made with affected weapon.

sections.heading: Lucky CapeME
sections.text: Lucky CapeME: Hand of fate (0 level) + Delay Spell (swift activation; +4 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (saving throw; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 3rd); as an immediate action, reroll one saving throw.

sections.heading: Lucky StreakCSc
sections.text: Lucky StreakCSc: Enhancement (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (rerolls; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (any rerolls; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level (bard 1st); for the next 1 min./level, subject gains +1/3 levels enhancement bonus to rerolls (e.g. Hand of fateCRB, hero points, etc.).

sections.heading: Lucky StrikeCSc
sections.text: Lucky StrikeCSc: Blessing (0 level) + Lucky Spell (+2 levels) + Augment Spell (+4 bonus; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 min./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 2nd level; swift casting grants you +4 to attacks and damage for 1 rd.

sections.heading: Lucubration, Mordenkainen’s
sections.text: Lucubration, Mordenkainen’s: Bestow feat (Magical Talent; 1st level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (11 ranks effects; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (spell you cast that day; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 2 hrs./level; +4 levels) = 5th level (listed as 6th); you regain one spell of up to 6th level already cast that day. Variants:

sections.heading: Lullaby
sections.text: Lullaby: Ray of obliviousness (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (Perception and saves vs. sleep only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 0 level; -1d6 penalty to Wis for purposes stated only.

sections.heading: Luminous ArmorBED
sections.text: Luminous ArmorBED: Mage armor (1st level) + Augment Spell (+5 bonus; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Augment Spell (dazzling; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (dazzling only when attacking subject of spell; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 hr./level; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Str; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (caster with [good] descriptor; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); +5 mage armor sheds normal light (dazzling vs. attackers), but caster takes 1d4 Str damage.

sections.heading: Luminous Armor, GreaterBED
sections.text: Luminous Armor, GreaterBED: Lumious armorBED (3rd level) + Augment Spell (+9 total bonus; +2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 4th).

sections.heading: Luminous AssassinPHII
sections.text: Luminous AssassinPHII: Summon (human rogue 1; 1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd). The 3rd level luminous assassin spell adds Augment Spell (CR 2 human rogue 3; +1 level), and the 5th level greater luminous assassin instead adds Augment Spell (CR 6 human rogue 5; +3 levels).

sections.heading: Lunar ArmorRRO
sections.text: Lunar ArmorRRO: Deflection (0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Lucky Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (wood elf, or access to Heavens mystery, etc.; -1 level) = 2nd level; you gain +2 luck bonus to AC (+1/6 levels) for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Lunar RevelationRRO
sections.text: Lunar RevelationRRO: Scrying (q.v.; 4th level) + Location-Specific Spell (location scried must be in moonlight; -2 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 6th).

sections.heading: Lunar SpeedRRO
sections.text: Lunar SpeedRRO: Celerity (0 level) + Variable Spell (all modes of movement; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (−1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (outdoors, in moonlight; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+10’ to +30’; +1 level) = 1st level; while outdoors, in the moonlight, you gain +30 ft. enhancement to all movement speeds.

sections.heading: Lustful Gaze, Rie’sRR2
sections.text: Lustful Gaze, Rie’sRR2: Compel (follow me; 2nd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoid; -2 levels) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) + Pattern Spell (visual; -1 level) = 2nd level; subject does nothing but follow the caster around sheepishly, until attacked.
