sections.heading: Mace of OdoMF
sections.text: Mace of OdoMF: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Bane Spell (undead: fixed; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (dispel; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Law or Protection domain; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); one melee touch/rd. deals up to 10d6 force plus dazed 1 rd., and you can use a held action to attempt to dispel a spell targeting you.

sections.heading: Mad HallucinationUM
sections.text: Mad HallucinationUM: Ray of beguiling (1st level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 3rd level; 1d6 + ½ levels (max. +5) penalty to Cha (indirectly impacting Will saves and Concentration checks).

sections.heading: Mad MonkeysUC
sections.text: Mad MonkeysUC: Summon (1st level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 2 monkey swarm; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level; summoned monkey swarm deafens those damaged. Trade Perception, Stealth, and Survival skills for Sleight of Hand (3/+9) and Lightning Reflexes for Improved Weapon Maneuvers (disarm).

sections.heading: Mad Sultan’s MelodyHA
sections.text: Mad Sultan’s MelodyHA: Compel (fascination; 2nd level) + Coaxing Spell (+0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) = 6th level (bard 5th) (listed as 4th/3rd); oozes and other formless servitors of the Outer Gods are fascinated 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Maddening ScreamSRD
sections.text: Maddening ScreamSRD: Inertia (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (stunning; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of clumsiness; +1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Madness domain or cultist of Tharizdun; −1 level) = 8th level; victim stunned and takes 1d6 +1/level penalty to Dex for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Mage Armor, ImprovedUnE
sections.text: Mage Armor, ImprovedUnE: Mage armor (1st level) + Cascade Spell (enhancement; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (armor bonus; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1/4 to +1/3; +1 level) = 3rd level; armor bonus is +4, +1/3 levels (max. +10 at CL 18th).

sections.heading: Mage Hand, GreaterMF
sections.text: Mage Hand, GreaterMF: Mage hand (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 8 lbs./level; +1 level) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Magic Missile
sections.text: Magic Missile: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Inexorable Evocation (+3 levels) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 5d6; -4 levels) = 4th level (listed as 1st); damage cap 9d6, divided among missiles, with no attack roll needed and no saving throw. Variants:

sections.heading: Magic Missile Reflection7S
sections.text: Magic Missile Reflection7S: Dispel (0 level) + Augment Spell (reflects, rather than dispels; +2 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (bolt of force effects only; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); for 1 rd./level, bolt of force-derived spells targeting the subject are reflected back at the caster.

sections.heading: Magic Mouth
sections.text: Magic Mouth: Figment (0 level) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +2 levels) = 2nd level (auditory with speech and visual). Like other latent spells, numen investiture is needed to maintain the spell for more than 1 day (e.g., 2nd level x CL 3rd x 50 = 300).

sections.heading: Magic SavantCM
sections.text: Magic SavantCM: Skill enhancement (Spellcraft; 0 level) + Quicken Spell (+4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 1st level; swift casting grants you +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Spellcraft.

sections.heading: Magic Stone
sections.text: Magic Stone: Energy mace (0 level) + Variable Spell (can be burled or slung; +1 level) + Manifested Spell (­1 level) + Cascade Spell (magic weapon; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Bane Spell (undead; +0 levels) + Reduce Spell (5d6 to 1d6; -1 level) = 1st level (ranger 0); two +1 stones deal base 1d6 each (1d8 vs. undead).

sections.heading: Magical Beast ShapeUW
sections.text: Magical Beast ShapeUW: Beast shape IIICRB (5th level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 bonus; +1 level) = 7th level; you become a Diminutive to Huge animal, or Small to Medium magical beast, with applicable abilities up to 7th level as shown in the table, with an additional +4 bonus divided among Str, Dex, and/or Con as appropriate.

sections.heading: Magical PerformanceAUG2
sections.text: Magical PerformanceAUG2: Skill enhancement (0 level) + Variable Spell (all Perform skills; +1 level) = 1st level; subject is +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Perform for 1 min./level. Variants:

sections.heading: MagnetismAUG
sections.text: MagnetismAUG: Mage hand (0 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Str; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+10 bonus; +4 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (metal only; -2 levels) = 2nd level; you gain +10 to Str when interacting with metal objets (climbing metal ladder, CMD if disarmed of metallic weapon, etc.) for 1 min./level, and can pull small metallic objects to you from within close range (1 lb./level max.) with concentration.

sections.heading: MagnetismCA
sections.text: MagnetismCA: Mage hand (0 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 216 lbs./level; +4 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (ferrous metal only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (pull: as push but to you; +1 level) = 3rd level; you attract metal object(s) up to indicated weight limit while you concentrate, one at a time at 20 ft./rd.

sections.heading: Magnetism, SuperiorS&M
sections.text: Magnetism, SuperiorS&M: Mage hand (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grappled; +1 level + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 216 lbs./level; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (conc. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (metal only; -2 levels) = 6th level; metal objects within 20 ft. pulled to focus of emanation and grappled there. Variants:

sections.heading: Magical VestmentUA1
sections.text: Magical VestmentUA1: Mage armor (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+6 total bonus; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (enhancement; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level; touch bestows +6 armor with additional +1 enhancement bonus/4 levels.

sections.heading: Magnifying ChimeACG
sections.text: Magnifying ChimeACG: Sound lance (1st level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (when object touched; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 7th level (bard 6th); damage cap 15d6 sonic/rd. Invest 300 x CL numen to maintain the spell before it is discharged.

sections.heading: Mailed Might of the MagelordsLEF
sections.text: Mailed Might of the MagelordsLEF: Mage armor (1st level) + Augment Spell (+8 total bonus; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (inure: bludgeoning; +1 level) + Energy Admixture (piercing and slashing; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (warding: [force]; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) = 5th level; subject gains +8 armor bonus, DR 13/adamantine, and temporary immunity to [force] spells (not including this one).

sections.heading: Make ManifestMP
sections.text: Make ManifestMP: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (target: touch to close; +1 level) + Reach Spell (range: close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (your plane; -2 levels) + Trans-dimensional Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 7th level (listed as 6th); creature on coterminous plane appears on yours for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: MalaiseRR2
sections.text: MalaiseRR2: Damage attribute (Str; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (days to hours; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 3rd); those in 20’r. take 3d4 Str damage (Fort half), regained at 1 point per hour.

sections.heading: MalfunctionUM
sections.text: MalfunctionUM: Lesser compelling confusion (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (enchantment to transmutation; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (construct only; -2 levels) = 3rd level; construct acts as if confused for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Malicious ImageRR2
sections.text: Malicious ImageRR2: Summon (1st level) + Cascade Spell (dispel; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 4; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (1d4+1 summoned; +1 level) + Shadow Spell (-1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (under mirror image spell; -2 levels) = 3rd level; dispels mirror image and replaces 1d4+1 images with hostile shadow duplicates of subject (CR 4, 20% real).

sections.heading: Malicious SpiteUM
sections.text: Malicious SpiteUM: Compel (act spitefully towards specified creature; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Wis if fail to do so; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 4th level; invest 1,200 x CL numen (4th level x 50 x 6) to maintain effect (Wis damage recurs each day, if applicable).

sections.heading: Malign EyeAPG
sections.text: Malign EyeAPG: Resistance (0 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (saves vs. your spells only; -2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (special; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (witch or access to Fate domain; -1 level) = 1st level; target saves at -3 vs. your spells for 1 min./level or until hits you with an attack.

sections.heading: Malison, MinorTM2
sections.text: Malison, MinorTM2: Resistance (0 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 3rd level; those in 2’r. take -1 penalty to saves for 1 rd./level. Greater malisonTM2 is Augmented 1 step (4th level; -3 penalty).

sections.heading: Malleable FormPnA
sections.text: Malleable FormPnA: Reduce (3rd level) + Cascade Spell (enhancement; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (CMD; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level; you gain compression ability and +1/4 levels to CMD for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Mana FluxPHII
sections.text: Mana FluxPHII: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) = 5th level; those in area must make opposed Concentration checks to cast spells (spell lost if check failed).

sections.heading: Mana SinkRR2
sections.text: Mana SinkRR2: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd.; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level (listed as 5th); spells cast within or entering emanation are dispelled/ counterpselled; move area as a swift action.

sections.heading: ManaspearRR
sections.text: ManaspearRR: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (dispel; +1 level) + Bouncing Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 4th level; 1d6 force/level (max. 10d6) and lose 1 prepared spell or spell slot (start with highest level, “bounces” to next if first dispel fails). Variant:

sections.heading: Mantle of BaravarDHD
sections.text: Mantle of BaravarDHD: Spell resistance (5th level) + Effect-Specific Spell (illusions only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Communal Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (gnome or access to Charm domain; -1 level) = 4th level; SR vs. ilusions for 1 hr./level (divided among recipients).

sections.heading: Mantle of Egregious MightAUG2
sections.text: Mantle of Egregious MightAUG2: Deflection (0 level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (resistamce; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 attribute/3 levels; +2 levels) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +4; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 8th level; +4 sacred bonus to AC, attacks, damage, saves, and attributes for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Mantle of MoonlightAPG
sections.text: Mantle of MoonlightAPG: Warding (hostile polymorph effects; 1st level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Void domain, etc.; -1 level) = 0 level; you are immune to lycanthrope, baleful polymorph, etc.

sections.heading: ManyjawsPGF
sections.text: ManyjawsPGF: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 1d6; -4 levels) = 3rd level; 1d6 force/level (Reflex half), divided as you see fit among one or more targets.

sections.heading: Mapping, Dolomar’sRR
sections.text: Mapping, Dolomar’sRR: Summon (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 2nd level; summons Small elemental (air) Expert 1 with max. ranks Craft (cartographer), Craft (construction), and Profession (mining), and Skill Focus (Profession: cartographer).

sections.heading: Marching ChantACG
sections.text: Marching ChantACG: Celerity (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (overland speed only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 1st level; +30 ft. to subjects’ overland walking speed―so a walk covers the distance of a hustle―while you concentrate.

sections.heading: Marid’s MasteryARG
sections.text: Marid’s MasteryARG: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+4 total bonus; +3 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (subject and opponents are touching water; -2 levels) = 1st level; subject gains +4 to attacks and damage against opponents who are also in the water.

sections.heading: Mark AlliesAUG
sections.text: Mark AlliesAUG: Bestow feat (Selective Spell; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Sudden Metamagic; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (+3 levels) + Expedient Spell (max. spell level; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 2nd); for 1 rd./level, one set of allies you designate is immune to your spells of 5th level or less (as per the Selective Spell feat, but level x as many spells can be affected).

sections.heading: Mark of AirAUG2
sections.text: Mark of AirAUG2: Attribute boost (Dex; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+5 total deflection; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (activating deflection negates Dex boost; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level; subject gains +2 Dex for 10 min./level; can end that to gain +5 deflection instead for remaining duration.

sections.heading: Mark of DoomPHII
sections.text: Mark of DoomPHII: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Delay Spell (when attacks; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (single creature not of your alignment; -2 levels) + Inexorable Evocation (+3 levels) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 1d6; -4 levels) = 4th level; target takes 1d6 force damage (no save) each time it attacks or takes some other hostile action (max. 5d6/rd.).

sections.heading: Mark of EarthAUG2
sections.text: Mark of EarthAUG2: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Extend Spell (1 nin./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (energy mace; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Delay Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; subject +2 Str for 10 min./level and can make one Medium ranged attack for 5d6 + Str modifier.

sections.heading: Mark of FireAUG2
sections.text: Mark of FireAUG2: Attribute boost (Dex; 0 level) + Extend Spell (1 nin./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (jet of flame; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Delay Spell (+1 level) + Tenuous Spell (ends Dex bonus; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; subject +2 Dex for 10 min./level or until makes ranged touch attack for 5d6 fire.

sections.heading: Mark of Fire, GreaterAUG2
sections.text: Mark of Fire, GreaterAUG2: Attribute boost (Dex; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (inure: fire; +1 levels) + Extend Spell (1 nin./level to 10 min./level; +1 levels) + Cascade Spell (jet of flame; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (+1 level) + Tenuous Spell (ends other effects; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6 and 40 to 15; -2 levels) = 4th level; subject +2 Dex snd resist fire 15 for 10 min./level or until throws 5d6 fireball. Greater mark of frostAUG2 is similar but cold instead of fire.

sections.heading: Mark of FrostAUG2
sections.text: Mark of FrostAUG2: Enhancement (2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (natural armor; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of frost; +1 level) + Energy Admixture (piercing; +0 levels) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Delay Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level; subject +1/4 levels natural AC for 10 min./level and can make one Close ranged attack for 2d6 piercing + 3d6 cold + Str modifier.

sections.heading: Mark of JudgmentPHII
sections.text: Mark of JudgmentPHII: Spark of life (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Delay Spell (when hit marked creature; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (single creature of alignment different from yours; -2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 1d6; -3 levels) = 3rd level; 1 ally/3 levels heals 1d6 hp whenever damages selected target (up to 4d6/rd. total for each subject).

sections.heading: Mark of Justice
sections.text: Mark of Justice: Bestow curse (3rd level) + Delay Spell (subject performs prohibited act; +1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level (paladin 4th). Invest 250 x CL numen to maintain curse until atoned.

sections.heading: Mark of Justice, LesserDr342
sections.text: Mark of Justice, LesserDr342: Lesser bestow curseDr342 (2nd level) + Delay Spell (as above; +1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) = 3rd level (paladin 2nd). Invest 150 x CL numen to maintain curse until atoned.

sections.heading: Marked ManDr325
sections.text: Marked ManDr325: Skill enhancement (0 level) + Variable Spell (skill approproate to tracking; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 2 hrs./level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (possessor of focus object; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (rogue or ranger; -1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +1/2 levels; +1 level) = 1st level; you are +1/2 levels to track possessor of spell’s focus object.

sections.heading: Mask of DeathTM2
sections.text: Mask of DeathTM2: Glamer (1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Perform (acting); +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; corpse appears as specific creature of same general size and shape; you gain +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to check to match specifics.

sections.heading: MasochismBVD
sections.text: MasochismBVD: Blessing (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +5; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Expedient Spell (scales with damage taken; -1 level) = 2nd level; for 1 min./level, you gain +1 profane bonus to attacks, damage, and saves per 10 hp unhealed damage you have (max. +5).

sections.heading: MassacreHA
sections.text: MassacreHA: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+6d4; +5 levels) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to line; +1 level) = 9th level; those in Close line take 7d4 Con plus 1d6 negative energy/level (max. 20d6, arcane 25d6), Fort half.

sections.heading: MassmorphPH1
sections.text: MassmorphPH1: Glamer (1st level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (willing subjects only; -2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (appear as trees; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (de facto invisibility outdoors; +1 level) = 4th level; creastures in up to one 10-ft. cube/level are disguised as trees (audiovisual, olfactory, and tactile components).

sections.heading: Master EarthMF
sections.text: Master EarthMF: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (druid; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to planar; +5 levels) + Irresistible Spell (not blocked by earth; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 7th level; you teleport through the earth to any destination on the same planet.

sections.heading: Master of Arms, Tenser’sGA
sections.text: Master of Arms, Tenser’sGA: Bestow feat (Weapon Specialization; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +3 levels) = 4th level.

sections.heading: Master of the Rolling RiverOA
sections.text: Master of the Rolling RiverOA: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (push; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 6th); damage cap 10d6 plus bull rush.

sections.heading: Master’s IllusionCRB
sections.text: Master’s IllusionCRB: Glamer (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Trickery domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; allies within 20 ft. of you are cloaked by illusion to appear and sound as you choose for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Master’s TouchCAd
sections.text: Master’s TouchCAd: Bestow feat (weapon or shield proficiency; 1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Item-Specific Spell (weapon or shield held; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 0 level; you gain Exotic proficiency with weapon or shield held for 1 round as a swift action.

sections.heading: Master’s TouchPHII
sections.text: Master’s TouchPHII: Skill enhancement (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to inst.; -3 levels) = 2nd level; subject gains +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to skill check being made (can interrupt an action, so you can reserve use for a seemingly failed attempt). Cf. divine insightCAd.

sections.heading: MaterialUA1
sections.text: MaterialUA1: Creation (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Variable Spell (choose material at time of casting; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); creates 1 cu. ft./level of simple, unworked, mundane material.

sections.heading: Maw of ChaosSC
sections.text: Maw of ChaosSC: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (dispel; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Selective Spell ([chaotic] creatures immune; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 10d6; -3 levels) = 9th level; 10d6 force damage/rd. and save or dazed 1 rd., plus opposed Concentration checks to cast in area.

sections.heading: Maze
sections.text: Maze: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (target: touch to close; +1 level) + Reach Spell (destination: close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (maze demi-plane; -2 levels) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 8th level; target transported to labyrinth demi-plane; save each round after the first to return. Variants:

sections.heading: MeldTM2
sections.text: MeldTM2: PossessionOcA (3rd level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (willing recipient; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 5th); you possess a willing host.

sections.heading: Meld into Stone
sections.text: Meld into Stone: Shaping (2nd level) + Object-Specific Spell (stone only; -2 levels) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 3 cu. ft./level; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (shapes stone around you; -2 levels) = 3rd level; you and your gear merge into a block of stone.

sections.heading: MeltUA1
sections.text: MeltUA1: Jet of flame (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. cubes to 5-ft. cubes; -1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (cold subtype; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 level) = 1st level; damage cap 5d6 fire vs. [cold] creatures, and ice and snow. Variants:

sections.heading: Membrane of LawDLM
sections.text: Membrane of LawDLM: Hedge (chaos; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (emanation to wall; +0 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) = 5th level; door (up to one 5-ft. square/level) allows one-way access only to [chaotic] creatures. Invest 1,000 x CL numen to maintain effect.

sections.heading: Memorize PageACG
sections.text: Memorize PageACG: Figment (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (written page touched; -2 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (visual component; +1 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 0 level (listed as 1st); perfect phantasmal duplicate of page studied lingers in subject’s memory. Invest 25 x CL numen to maintain memory permanently.

sections.heading: Memory ReadTM2
sections.text: Memory ReadTM2: Detection (memories; 2nd level). For mind raidRR, add Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Memory RotMF
sections.text: Memory RotMF: Damage attribute (Int; 1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 5th level; deals 1d4 Int drain/rd. (Fort save each round to end ongoing drain).

sections.heading: Menacing Tentacles, Evard’sPHII
sections.text: Menacing Tentacles, Evard’sPHII: Energy mace (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Point-Blank Shot; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Ranged Threat; +1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 3rd level; 2 attacks/rd. at +1 vs. Close opponents for up to 4d6+1 + ½ Str mod each, and can make attacks of opportunity within 10 ft.

sections.heading: Mental BarrierSRD
sections.text: Mental BarrierSRD: Deflection (0 level) + Augment Spell (+4 total bonus; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); immediate casting grants +4 deflection for 1 rd. AKA aegisSLPG. Variants:

sections.heading: Mental Barrier IOcA
sections.text: Mental Barrier IOcA: Warding (mind thrust; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (shield; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level; immediate casting grants you +4 shield bonus to AC and immunity to mind thrust spells for 1 rd.

sections.heading: Mental Barrier IIOcA
sections.text: Mental Barrier IIOcA: Mental barrier I (q.v.; 2nd level) + Aufment Spell (+6 shield bonus; +1 level) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Mental Barrier IIIOcA
sections.text: Mental Barrier IIIOcA: Mental barrier I (q.v.; 2nd level) + Augment Spell (+8 shield bonus; +2 levels) = 4th level.

sections.heading: Mental Barrier IVOcA
sections.text: Mental Barrier IVOcA: Mental barrier III (q.v.; 4th level) + Cascade Spell (warding: precision damage; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (protects against nonmagical precision damage; +2 levels) + Expedient Spell (5% per level, rather than 100% protection; -1 level) = 6th level; as mental barrier III, plus 5% fortification/level.

sections.heading: Mental BlockOcA
sections.text: Mental BlockOcA: Compel (forget all skills, feats, special abilities; 2nd level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); target forgets all feats, skills, special abilities, and spells for 1 rd./level or until saves.

sections.heading: Mental DisruptionSRD
sections.text: Mental DisruptionSRD: Compel (daze; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +3 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 2nd); dazes those in 10’r. of you.

sections.heading: Mental StrengthOA
sections.text: Mental StrengthOA: Resistance (0 level) + Augment Spell (+9 total bonus; +5 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (Will saves only; -2 levels) = 3rd level; subject gains +9 resistance bonus to Will saves for 1 min./level. Variants:

sections.heading: Mephit MobSSt
sections.text: Mephit MobSSt: Summon (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 3 mephit; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (2d4+1; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 round/level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 6th level; ritual summons 2d4+1 mephits for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Merge with FamiliarUW
sections.text: Merge with FamiliarUW: Dimensional pocket (1st level) + Transdimensional Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (only your familiar can access; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (enter, leave, return to space during duration; +1 level) + Widen Spell (familiar can weigh up to 8 lbs./level; +1 level) = 2nd level; your familiar can hide in a pocket dimension (appears to merge with you), can still share spells, etc.

sections.heading: Message
sections.text: Message: Figment (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Selective Spell (choose up to 1 recipient/level; +1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) = 0 level; up to 1 recipient/level receives mental messages.

sections.heading: Message, DemandingUI
sections.text: Message, DemandingUI: Message (q.v.; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (suggestion; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; as message, but lasts longer and and one recipient receives a suggestion lasting up to 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Message, InterplanarMP
sections.text: Message, InterplanarMP: MindlinkSRD (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Reach Spell (casting: close to touch; -1 level) + Reach Spell (message: planar to interplanar; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (swift; +3 levels) = 3rd level; after touching subject (and investing latent spell numen), you can send it a 6-second message from almost anywhere in the multiverse as a swift action.

sections.heading: MetafacultySRD
sections.text: MetafacultySRD: Augury (2nd level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +4 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Cascade Spell (warding: anti-scrying effects; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (diviner/seer/ oracle; -1 level) = 8th level (listed as 9th); you gain info to 1 one-word question/rd. (or more detailed info by using more rounds), which is not blocked by lead or anti-divination magic. (To also remote view the subject, cast scrying separately.)

sections.heading: Metal Melt, Ghorus Toth’sMF
sections.text: Metal Melt, Ghorus Toth’sMF: Shaping (2nd level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd.; +1 level) = 4th level; metal object (up to 1 cu. ft./level) becomes liquid, re-hardens (as puddle or in shape of container) after 1 rd. Variant:

sections.heading: Meteor Swarm
sections.text: Meteor Swarm: Jet of flame (0 level) + Energy Admixture (bludgeoning; +0 levels) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; fire damage portion only; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (burst radius from 20 ft. to 40 ft.; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+2 levels) + Empower Spell (+1 level) + Residual Spell (+1 level) = 9th level; damage cap 29d6 x 1.5 for Empower Spell = 43.5d6 total, divided among 4 meteors = approx. 11d6 each. Each meteor is a ranged touch attack for 5d6 impact damage, then bursts in a 40-ft. radius for 6d6 fire damage plus 5d6 burn (Reflex half/neg.) and creates difficult terrain within the blast radius. Variants:

sections.heading: Meteoric StrikePHII
sections.text: Meteoric StrikePHII: Jet of flame (0 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6. Your melee attack deals +1d6 fire/level (+5d6 max.) in a 5’r. (no save for creature struck, others save for half, you specify those unaffected). Variant:

sections.heading: Miasma, Mystra’sPGF
sections.text: Miasma, Mystra’sPGF: Wisp (0 level) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (zephyr; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Concentration; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of beguiling; +1 level) + Variable Spell (spellcasting attribute, if other; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (line to spread; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) = 8th level (listed as 9th); as solid fog, plus -1/2 levels to Concentration checks and 1d6 +1/level penalty to Cha (or spellcasting attribute, if different).

sections.heading: Mild Admonishment, Nybor’sPGF
sections.text: Mild Admonishment, Nybor’sPGF: Compel (do nothing; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell [(sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (ailing; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level)] + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = 5th level (listed as 3rd); target ailing 1 rd./level, dazed 1 rd./level until saves.

sections.heading: MimicryCSc
sections.text: MimicryCSc: Figment (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Perform; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard or rogue; -1 level) = 1st level; you can mimic sounds or speech, with +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Perform (acting) checks to imitate a specific person’s voice, etc.

sections.heading: Mind Blank
sections.text: Mind Blank: Warding (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) = 8th level; subject immune to divinations and scrying, plus charms, compulsions, phantasms, and other [mind-affecting], including (Ex), (Sp), and (Su) abilities. Variants:

sections.heading: Mind BondBED
sections.text: Mind BondBED: Bestow feat (Improved Flanking; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +5; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (bonded mount; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 2nd level; your mount gains +5 sacred bonus to atks, damage, saves vs. fear, and is +2 to give and receive flanking bonuses for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Mind SeedSRD
sections.text: Mind SeedSRD: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 6; +4 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (possessionOcA; +3 levels) + Cross-Class Spell (telepathy; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Delay Spell (1 week; -1 level) = 8th level and 400 x CL numen; over the course of a week, victim touched is gradually possessed as if by a 7th level version of you.

sections.heading: Mind StabAUG
sections.text: Mind StabAUG: Whelm (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to ray; +0 levels) = 1st level; damage cap 5d6 nonlethal.

sections.heading: Mind SwitchSRD
sections.text: Mind SwitchSRD: Possession (3rd level) + Cross-Class Spell (telepathy or enchantment; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (2 creatures; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 10 min./level; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 6th); you and one other creature possess each other’s bodies.

sections.heading: Mind Switch, TrueSRD
sections.text: Mind Switch, TrueSRD: Mind switch (5th level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 6th level (listed as 9th); invest 300 x CL numen to make effect permanent.

sections.heading: Mind ThrustSRD
sections.text: Mind ThrustSRD: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (telepath; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 1st level; damage cap 5d6 necrotic (Will half).

sections.heading: Mind Thrust IIIOcA
sections.text: Mind Thrust IIIOcA: Mind thrustSRD (1st level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Empower Spell (+1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 1.5 x 10d6.

sections.heading: Mind Thrust IVOcA
sections.text: Mind Thrust IVOcA: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cascade Spell (touch of fatigue; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Empower Spell (+1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 1.5 x 10d6 plus fatigued.

sections.heading: Mind Thrust VOcA
sections.text: Mind Thrust VOcA: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cascade Spell (touch of fatigue; +1 level) + Augment Spell (exhaust; +1 level) + Fell Fatigue (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) = 5th level; damage cap 15d6 plus exhausted (Will half/fatigued).

sections.heading: Mind Thrust VIOcA
sections.text: Mind Thrust VIOcA: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cascade Spell (touch of fatigue; +1 level) + Augment Spell (exhaust; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) = 6th level; damage cap 20d6 plus stunned and exhausted 1 rd.

sections.heading: Mind TrackerTM2
sections.text: Mind TrackerTM2: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (visual; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (sensor can be dispelled or destroyed, ending all effects; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Mind domain; -1 level) = 6th level; as scrying, but lasts as long as you concentrate, and the subject is panicked while the effect lasts.

sections.heading: Mind TrapSRD
sections.text: Mind TrapSRD: Dispel (0 level) + Shielding Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (telepathy only; -2 levels) = 3rd level; immediate casting dispels telepathy powers used against you for 1 rd.

sections.heading: Mindless RageCAd
sections.text: Mindless RageCAd: Compel (attack caster in melee; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Mindlink, ThievingSRD
sections.text: Mindlink, ThievingSRD: MindlinkSRD (1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Magical Talent; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (11 ranks effects; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (spell/power must be known by subject; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (mindlink ends when power gained; -1 level) = 4th level; as mindlink, and can end link by gaining one of linked subject’s powers known.

sections.heading: MindnetTM2
sections.text: MindnetTM2: Imbue with spell ability (q.v., 4th level) + Cascade Spell (mindlinkSRD; 1st level) + Channel Spell (through link; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Community or Mind domain; -1 level) = 9th level; up to 1 creature/level share telepathic bond at distance, can grant each other spells through link.

sections.heading: Mindscape DoorOcA
sections.text: Mindscape DoorOcA: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (targets: touch to close; +1 level) + Reach Spell (destination: close to interplanar; +7 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (into or out of mindscape only; -2 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (mindscape, not actual demiplanes; -1 level) = 6th level (listed as 4th); target can enter or leave a mindscape (Cf. create mindscape).

sections.heading: Descent into MadnessS&M
sections.text: Descent into MadnessS&M: Compel (2nd level) + Variable Spell (see below; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) = 7th level; invest 350 x CL numen to maintain effects. Possible commands include schizophrenia (“slavishly emulate a role model totally unlike yourself”), dementia praecox (“ignore everything”; 50%, check each round), delusional insanity (“you are a monarch, god, or whatever”), paranoia (“violently mistrust all other creatures”), or hallucinatory inasanity (use Augmented, Phantasmal figment instead of compel; subject constantly hallucinates.)

sections.heading: MindwrackRR2
sections.text: MindwrackRR2: Damage attribute (Int; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+1d4; +1 level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Variable Spell (no control over effect: roll 1d4; -1 level):

sections.heading: Minute FormCA
sections.text: Minute FormCA: Reduce (3rd level) + Variable Spell (choose number of sizes reduced; +1 level) + Augment Spell (3 additional steps; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 5th level.

sections.heading: Minute Meteors, Melf’sUA1
sections.text: Minute Meteors, Melf’sUA1: Jet of flame (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Splash Evocation (+0 levels) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Miraculum, Jalartan’s7S
sections.text: Miraculum, Jalartan’s7S: Bestow feat (1st level) + Variable Spell (Eschew Materials, Silent Spell, or Still Spell; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Innate Metamagic; +1 level) + Delay Spell (until cast; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; modify one prepared spell (or spell known, for spontaneous casters) to be Silent or Stilled (or not to require material components) when cast.

sections.heading: MirageUW
sections.text: MirageUW: Glamer (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 2 hrs./level; +4 levels) + Shape Spell (emanation to cubes; +0 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 30-ft. cubes; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (terrain only; no structures, creatures, etc.; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Reduce Spell (visual only; -2 levels) = 3rd level; as hallucinatory terrain, but visual component only.

sections.heading: Mirror BlastAUG2
sections.text: Mirror BlastAUG2: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Energy Admixture (slashing; +0 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (30 ft. to 60 ft.; +1 level) = 5th level; damage cap 15d6 (half slashing, half force).

sections.heading: Mirror HideawayACG
sections.text: Mirror HideawayACG: Dimensional pocket (1st level) + + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 216 lbs./level; +4 levels) = 5th level (listed as 2nd).

sections.heading: Mirror Image
sections.text: Mirror Image: Figment (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (images of caster only; -2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (+1 image/3 levels; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Inexorable Spell (no save; +3 levels) + Tenuous Spell (images can be destroyed; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (no olfactory; -1 level) = 2nd level. Variants:

sections.heading: Mirror PolishACG
sections.text: Mirror PolishACG: Shaping (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (smooth and polish metal finish; -2 levels) = 0 level.

sections.heading: Mirror PortalAUG2
sections.text: Mirror PortalAUG2: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (destination: close to planar; +6 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (to receiving mirror; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. squares to 2.5-ft. squares; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 7th level; establishes 1-way transport between two mirrors (up to one 2.5-ft. square/level).

sections.heading: Mirror SafeRR
sections.text: Mirror SafeRR: Dimensional pocket (1st level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 27 lbs./level; +3 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 access/3 levels; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 4th level; invest minimum 1,400 numen to maintain (4th level x CL 7th x 50).

sections.heading: Mirror StrikeUC
sections.text: Mirror StrikeUC: Bestow feat (Whirlwind Strike; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 2nd level; you make a single attack; if it hits, gain an AoO vs. adjacent foe within reach. Variants:

sections.heading: Mirror TransportACG
sections.text: Mirror TransportACG: Dimensional pocket (1st level) + + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 27 lbs./level; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (dimensional skip; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) = 8th level (listed as 4th); one creature/level (weighing up to 27 lbs./level) can hide in extradimensional mirror space or dimension door from nearby mirror within close range.

sections.heading: Mirror TruthAUG2
sections.text: Mirror TruthAUG2: Glamer (1st level) + Shape Spell (emanation to cubes; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Selective Spell (see through illusion if view area through mirror; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Reduce Spell (no auditory, olfactory, or tactile components; -3 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 6th); creates long-lasting visual illusion over one 10-ft. cube/level; anyone viewing area through a mirror can automatically see through the illusion. Invest 100 x CL numen to maintain illusion indefinitely.

sections.heading: Miscast MagicTM2
sections.text: Miscast MagicTM2: Compel (cast wrong spell; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Delay Spell (until cast next spell; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (spellcaster or creature with SLAs; -1 level) = 3rd level. AKA Enkili’s prankRR.

sections.heading: Misdirection
sections.text: Misdirection: Glamer (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (misleads divinations only; -2 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (divinations read as if reading other specified creature/object only; -1 level) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Mislead
sections.text: Mislead: [Greater invisibility (4th level) + Personal Spell (-1 level)] + [Cascade Spell (figment; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (image of you only; -2 levels)] + Silent Spell (+1 level) = 6th level; you are cloaked in greater ionvisibility, while an illusion of you moves away.

sections.heading: Missile StormRR2
sections.text: Missile StormRR2: Invisible needle (0 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Versatile Strike; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) + Widen Spell (30 ft. to 60 ft.; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level; fired projectile trails a 60-ft. cone in its wake (damage cap 5d6 piercing, Reflex half, and properties and feats of projectile apply).

sections.heading: MissiveSRD
sections.text: MissiveSRD: Mindlink (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) = 0 level; you send a 1-round telepathic message to one creature in range with which you share a language.

sections.heading: Missive, MassSRD
sections.text: Missive, MassSRD: Mindlink (1st level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Communal Spell (+1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; you send a 1-round message to up to 1 creature/level within long range; or an instantaneous message to up to 6 creatures/level.

sections.heading: Missive TokenAUG2
sections.text: Missive TokenAUG2: Mindlink (1st level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (standard; +1 level) + Expedient Spell (1-way; -1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level; as a standard action subject (holder of focus) can send you a mental message of up to 25 words.

sections.heading: Mistaken MissiveTM2
sections.text: Mistaken MissiveTM2: Glamer (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Chaos or Rune domain; -1 level) = 1st level; written message (up to 1 page/level) appears to say the opposite (in intent) of what was written; invest 200 x CL numen (1st level x 50 x 4) to maintain effect past 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Modify Memory
sections.text: Modify Memory: Glamer (1st level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Variable Spell (subtract, alter, or remove; +1 level) + Augment Spell (memories can be removed outright: analogous to adding invisibility; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 4th level; invest 400 x CL numen to make the modification permanent. Variants:

sections.heading: Mold Shadow RealityADR
sections.text: Mold Shadow RealityADR: Dimensional pocket (1st level) + Transdimensional Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Power over Shadow; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Planar Sense; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) = 9th level; alters magical and physical laws in 60-ft. emanation around you (Planar Sense check at +1/2 levels needed, per Power over Shadow feat) for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Mold TouchPGF
sections.text: Mold TouchPGF: Summon (1st level) + Reach Spell close to touch; -1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 2 brown mold; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 3rd level; touch creates patch of brown mold lasting 1 min./level, or indefinitely until destroyed if 150 x CL numen is invested.

sections.heading: MomentTM2
sections.text: MomentTM2: Variable Spell (blessing or skill enhancement; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 2nd level; each round, you grant 1 ally either +3 to attacks and damage or +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to 1 skill check (choose each round).

sections.heading: Moment of ClarityBED
sections.text: Moment of ClarityBED: Remove condition (mind-affecting; 1st level) + Augment Spell (minor to critical; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 2nd level; touch removes minor, moderate, or serious [mind-affecting] condition, or up to 4d4 Cha damage.

sections.heading: Moment of ClaritySC
sections.text: Moment of ClaritySC: Dispel (0 level) + Selective Spell (mind-affecting; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (no check needed; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 1st level; touch dispels one [mind-affecting] spell or SLA affecting target, with no check needed.

sections.heading: Moment of GreatnessUC
sections.text: Moment of GreatnessUC: Enhancement (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (morale bonus; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (one roll in next 1 min./level; +1 level) = 2nd level; each ally in area gains +1/4 levels enhancement to an existing morale bonus to one roll or check of their choice.

sections.heading: Momento MoriSRD
sections.text: Momento MoriSRD: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) Augment Spell (+4d4; +4 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) = 9th level (listed as epic); 5d4 Con damage at Medium range (Fort half) as a swift action.

sections.heading: Monkey FishACG
sections.text: Monkey FishACG: Celerity (climb; 0 level) + Variable Spell (swim; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Athletics; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; you gain climb and swim speeds of 10 ft. and +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to checks.

sections.heading: Monster Summoning IPH1
sections.text: Monster Summoning IPH1: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (2d4+1; +3 levels) + Variable Spell (no control over creatures summoned; -1 level) = 3rd level; summons 2d4+1 randomly-determined creatures of CR ½ or less. For the higher-level monster summoning spells, augment the CR.

sections.heading: Monstrous ExtremitiesPC
sections.text: Monstrous ExtremitiesPC: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Variable Spell (Versatile Evocation: bludgeoning or piercing; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Delay Spell (non-consecutive rounds; +1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6; target gains secondary natural attack, usable as a swift action, dealing 1d6/level (max. 10d6).

sections.heading: Monstrous Physique IUM
sections.text: Monstrous Physique IUM: Polymorph (monstrous humanoid; 3rd level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 2 min./level; +1 level) = 3rd level; +2 Str and natural armor, darkvision 60 ft., up to 3 natural attacks, etc.

sections.heading: Monstrous Physique IIUM
sections.text: Monstrous Physique IIUM: Polymorph (monstrous humanoid; 3rd level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (enlarge/reduce self; +1 level) = 4th level; Tiny to Large size.

sections.heading: Monstrous Physique IIIUM
sections.text: Monstrous Physique IIIUM: Polymorph (monstrous humanoid; 3rd level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (enlarge/reduce self; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) = 5th level; Diminutive to Huge size.

sections.heading: Monstrous Physique IVUM
sections.text: Monstrous Physique IVUM: Polymorph (monstrous humanoid; 3rd level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (enlarge/reduce self; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) = 6th level; Diminutive to Huge, and access to more abilities.

sections.heading: Monstrous RegenerationMF
sections.text: Monstrous RegenerationMF: Spark of life (1st level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Versatile Evocation (nonlethal; +0 levels) + Irresistible Spell (non-magical attacks also affected; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level)  = 5th level; damage you take (except fire and acid) is nonlethal for 1 rd./level, and healed at 15 hp/rd. during that time.

sections.heading: Moon RuneS&M
sections.text: Moon RuneS&M: Arcane mark (q.v.; 0 level) + Delay Spell (+1 level) = 1st level (listed as 2nd); mark becomes visible when stated condition met.

sections.heading: MoonbeamSC
sections.text: MoonbeamSC: Compel (assume animal form; 2nd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (lycanthropes; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cone; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Moon domain; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); cone of light causes shapeshifted creatures to resume true forms.

sections.heading: MoonbeamUA1
sections.text: MoonbeamUA1: Light (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (emanation to cylinder; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd./level; -2 levels) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 5th); creates magical spotlight (10’r., 50 ft. high) that you direct.

sections.heading: Moonbow, Presper’sPGF
sections.text: Moonbow, Presper’sPGF: Electric arc (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Delay Spell (use some attacks on subsequent rounds as a standard action; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 5th); damage cap 13d6 electricity, divided among ranged touch attacks.

sections.heading: MoonfireBotD
sections.text: MoonfireBotD: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (flare; +1 level) + Bane Spell (lyncanthropes; +0 levels) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 force (10d8 vs. lycanthropes) and dazzled 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: MoonfireSC
sections.text: MoonfireSC: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (polymorph; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of frost; +1 level) + Bane Spell (undead and shapechangers; +0 levels) +

sections.heading: Moonlit StrollRRO
sections.text: Moonlit StrollRRO: Air walk (q.v.; 4th level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (can only air walk on moonlit areas; -2 levels) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: MoonstruckAPG
sections.text: MoonstruckAPG: Lesser compelling confusion (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (rage; +3 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (under moon only; -2 levels) = 4th level; subjecy is raging and confused.

sections.heading: MoonwebPGF
sections.text: MoonwebPGF: Wall of force (q.v.; 5th level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Selective Spell (1-way; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. squares to 5-ft. squares; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Moon domain; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as 5th); creates a long-lasting, one-way wall of force in a wall or ring.

sections.heading: Morality UndoneFC1
sections.text: Morality UndoneFC1: Glamer (alignment aura; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (compel: behave as if evil; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 10 min./level; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (evil caster; -1 level) = 6th level (listed as 5th); creature detects and acts as if evil. Cf. compelOA.

sections.heading: More Luck than SkillCSc
sections.text: More Luck than SkillCSc: Skill enhancement (0 level) + Variable Spell (choose skill when used; +1 level) + Lucky Spell (+1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Restricted Spell (halfling or access to Fate domain, etc.; -1 level) = 1st level; swift casting grants you +1/2 levels (+5 max.) luck bonus to next skill check.

sections.heading: Mortal CloakRRO
sections.text: Mortal CloakRRO: Forced mortal cloakRRO (q.v.; 6th level) + Creature-Specific Spell (model creature must be willing; -2 levels) = 4th level.

sections.heading: Mortal Cloak, ForcedRRO
sections.text: Mortal Cloak, ForcedRRO: Polymorph (3rd level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 attribute/3 levels; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (only attributes that provider has higher scores in; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 skill/level; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (only skills that provider has ranks in, plus Perform (acting); -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 6th level; target is polymorphed into the form of a specific individual (the “model”), gains +2 to attributes for which model has a higher score (start with physical ones), +1/2 levels to skills the model is trained in (and to Perform: acting checks to impersonate that individual). Model gains a Fort save to resist.

sections.heading: Motes of MoonlightDr340
sections.text: Motes of MoonlightDr340: Light (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 hr./level; +1 level) + Shape Spell (emanation to line; -1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Mud BuddyMC
sections.text: Mud BuddyMC: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 1; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (goblinoid caster; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 2nd level; summons a Small mud elemental.

sections.heading: Muddy GroundAUG
sections.text: Muddy GroundAUG: Topple (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to horizontal wall; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Residual Spell (+1 level) = 5th level (listed as 2nd); one 10-ft. square/level is difficult terrain, and save each round or slip and fall prone.

sections.heading: Multiple PersonalitiesAUG
sections.text: Multiple PersonalitiesAUG: Compel (do opposite of intent; 2nd level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Tenuous Spell (save each round to act normally; -1 level) = 7th level; subject saves each round or attempts action opposite of intent (e.g., healing or buffing an opponent instead of harming it). Invest 350 x CL numen to maintain curse.

sections.heading: MummifySSt
sections.text: MummifySSt: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cascade Spell (touch of fatigue; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4d4; +3 levels) = 6th level; touch deals up to 15d6 plus negative energy plus 5d4 Con and fatigue.

sections.heading: Mummy DustSRD
sections.text: Mummy DustSRD: Summon (1st level) + Summon Undead (+1 level) + Augment Spell (1d3 CR 8 greater mummies; +5 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 8th level (listed as epic); summons 1d3 greater mummies. Invest 400 x CL numen to keep them past 1 rd./level, if you have sufficient Command Undead potential. Variant:

sections.heading: Murderous MistCD
sections.text: Murderous MistCD: Jet of flame (0 level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (blinding; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (wisp; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (access Sun domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 5th level; 2d6 fire/rd. and blinds 1 rd./level in 20’r.; invest 9,000 numen to make blindness permanent (5th level x CL 9th x 50 x 4).

sections.heading: MuteRRO
sections.text: MuteRRO: Bestow feat (Throat Punch; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); target cannot speak for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: My LightSRD
sections.text: My LightSRD: Light (0 level) + Shape Spell (emanation to cone; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (personal to close; +1 level) = 1st level; as light, but extends from your eyes in a cone.

sections.heading: Mysterious RedirectionCM
sections.text: Mysterious RedirectionCM: Compel (attack someone else; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) = 9th level (listed as 8th); swift casting causes attacks against you (requiring attack rolls) made within 20 ft. to be redirected to a different potentiual target (Will neg.), or simply miss if no other targets.

sections.heading: Mystic BacklashCM
sections.text: Mystic BacklashCM: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (casts spell that round; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 1st level; touch causes target to take 1d6 force/level (max. 5d6) during each round in which it casts as spell or activates a spell-like ability.

sections.heading: Mystic LashMF
sections.text: Mystic LashMF: Electric arc (0 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard action; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Evil or Suffering domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 8d6. Ranged touch attacks deal up to 5d6 (1 attack/rd.), 4d6 (2/rd.), 2d6 (3-4/rd.) electricity, based on your BAB and caster level, and possibly dazes target 1 round on a hit.

sections.heading: Mystic SurgePHII
sections.text: Mystic SurgePHII: Bestow feat (Ability Focus; 1st level) + Variable Spell (select ability/spell to be applied to; +1 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 3rd level; you gain +2 to next spell DC if cast within 1 round. AKA Rary’s spell enhancerGA.
