sections.heading: Natural RhythmAPG
sections.text: Natural RhythmAPG: Blessing (0 level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (up to +5 bonus; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (target damaged by subject’s last attack against it; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 1st level; recipient +1 to attacks and damage per previous hit against opponent (max. +5; resets to +0 if misses).

sections.heading: Nature’s BalancePGF
sections.text: Nature’s BalancePGF: Attribute boost (0 level) + Variable Spell (choose attribute at time of casting; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 bonus; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); longer-lasting attribute boost (you take no penalty).

sections.heading: Nature’s ExileAPG
sections.text: Nature’s ExileAPG: Skill enhancement (Survival; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (blessing, to animal companion; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 3rd level; -1/2 levels to Survival (-10 max.) and animal companion -1 to attacks, damage, saves vs. fear. Invest 300 x CL numen to make effect permanent.

sections.heading: Nature’s FavorCAd
sections.text: Nature’s FavorCAd: Blessing (1st level) + Augment Spell (+1/3 levels; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (animal; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 min./level; -1 level;) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level; target animal gains +1/3 levels to attacks, damage, saves vs. fear for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: NaturewatchMF
sections.text: NaturewatchMF: Deathwatch (q.v.; 2nd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (animals and plants; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (druid, ranger, or access to Animal or Plant domain; −1 level) = 0 level.

sections.heading: Nauseating DartACG
sections.text: Nauseating DartACG: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (invisible needle; +1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (witch or access to Archery or Pestilence domain; -1 level) = 1st level; close ranged attack deals 1d6 piercing plus nauseated 1 rd.

sections.heading: Nauseating TrailACG
sections.text: Nauseating TrailACG: Sickening touch (0 level)) + Augment Spell (nausea; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. cubes to 5-ft. cubes; -1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (you or designee must move through all affected squares; -2 levels) = 3rd level; nauseating vapors in area moved through persist 1 rd,/level.

sections.heading: Near HorizonCM
sections.text: Near HorizonCM: Bestow feat (Far Shot; 1st level) + Cascade Spell [(enhancement; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (Far Shot effects; -2 levels)] + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger, rogue, or access to Archery domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; swift casting reduces your range increment penalties by 1 each, and total end penalty is then reduced by another -1/4  levels, for the next round.

sections.heading: Necrotic AwarenessLM
sections.text: Necrotic AwarenessLM: Detection (creatures; 2nd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (those with necrotic cysts only; -2 levels) = 0 level.

sections.heading: Necrotic BloatLM
sections.text: Necrotic BloatLM: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Violate Spell (+1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (must have necrotic cyst, q.v.; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (Necromancer or access to Death domain, etc.; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); damage cap 10d6 (divine 5d6) negative energy (half is also Vile damage),  plus 2d6 lingering negative energy/rd.

sections.heading: Necrotic CurseCM
sections.text: Necrotic CurseCM: Metaphysical feat (Versatile Evocation; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 7th); changes positive energy in area to negative energy.

sections.heading: Necrotic CystLM
sections.text: Necrotic CystLM: Bestow feat (Arcane Defense: necromancy; 1st level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; 1st level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (Necromancer or access to Death domain, etc.; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; touch imposes penalty to saves vs. necromancy, and victim takes +1d6 negative energy damage from undead (max. 7 attacks/rd.). Invest 400 x CL numen to maintain effect (2nd level x 50 x 4).

sections.heading: Necrotic EmpowermentLM
sections.text: Necrotic EmpowermentLM: Attribute boost (0 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 attribute/3 levels; +3 levels) + Augment Spell (+8 total bonus; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (barkskin; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as 8th); for 1 rd./level, you gain +8 enhancement to Dex, Int, Wis, Con (and Cha at CL 15th, Str at 18th); +1/2 levels enhancement to natural armor; and 15d6 temp. hp.

sections.heading: Necrotic TumorLM
sections.text: Necrotic TumorLM: Damage attribute (Cha; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (+4d4; +3 levels) + Crippling Drain (+4 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (must have necrotic cyst, q.v.; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (Necromancer or access to Death domain, etc.; -1 level) = 7th level; 5d4 Cha drain to bearer of cyst (save for half).

sections.heading: Negative Energy BurstHH
sections.text: Negative Energy BurstHH: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (5d6 to 10d6; +1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 10d6 (divine 5d6) negative energy to adjacent creatures.

sections.heading: Negative ReactionUC
sections.text: Negative ReactionUC: Ray of beguiling (1st level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (skill checks only; -2 levels) = 1st level; target takes penalty to Cha-based skill checks equal to 1d6 + ½ levels (+5 max.).

sections.heading: Nereid’s GraceARG
sections.text: Nereid’s GraceARG: Deflection (0 level) + Augment Spell (scaling bonus; +1 level) + Augment Spell (base +4; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (not wearing armor; -2 levels) = 1st level; for 1 hr./level, you gain a +4 deflection bonus to AC (+1/6 levels; max. +7 total bonus at CL 18th)

sections.heading: NerveskitterSC
sections.text: NerveskitterSC: Enhancement (2nd level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Delay Spell (next initative check; +1 level) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Insightful Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (initiative; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); subject gains +1/3 levels insight bonus to next initiative check, lasting 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Net of ShadowsMF
sections.text: Net of ShadowsMF: Gloom (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (4 steps total; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) = 1st level; target cannot see or be seen (even with darkvision) except using the see in darkness ability. To affect 1 creature/level, also apply the Mass Effect Spell feat (+3 levels).

sections.heading: NetherbladeRR2
sections.text: NetherbladeRR2: Spark of life (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (arcane; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Transdimensional Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; ­2 levels) = 2nd level; damage cap 7d6 positive energy (divided among iterative melee touch attacks) vs. undead (full damage vs. incorporeal).

sections.heading: NethergazeRR
sections.text: NethergazeRR: Spark of life (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (arcane; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (warding: energy drain; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 warding/3 levels; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Pattern Spell (visual; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 5th level; damage cap 10d6 positive energy/rd. vs. undead, and prevents energy drain within area (also prevents Con and Dex damage/drain (and Cha at CL 12th, .

sections.heading: Night BlindnessPC
sections.text: Night BlindnessPC: Gloom (0 level) + Shape Spell (emanation to target; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); target treats ambient light as 2 steps lower and loses darkvision, low-light vision, and see in darkness.

sections.heading: Night HunterAPG
sections.text: Night HunterAPG: Invisibility (2nd level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Darkness domain, etc.; -1 level) = 0 level.

sections.heading: Nightmare
sections.text: Nightmare: Whelm (0 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (onset: 1/rd. to 1/10 min.; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Delay Spell (until target falls asleep; +1 level) = 5th level; target takes 1d6 nonlethal per 10 min. for next 10 min./level when next tries to sleep (Intuition neg.); prevents regaining of spells, etc. Invest 2,250 x CL numen to maintain on subsequent nights. Variants:

sections.heading: Nightmare LullabyMF
sections.text: Nightmare LullabyMF: Ray of obliviousness (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 2nd level; target takes 1d6+1/2 levels (+10 max.) penalty to Wisdom (Intuition half, confused at 1) as long as you concentrate and 1 round thereafter.

sections.heading: Nightmare TerrainCM
sections.text: Nightmare TerrainCM: Wisp (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; area obscures vision and entangles those within unless they disbelieve.

sections.heading: Night’s CaressLM
sections.text: Night’s CaressLM: Selective Spell (+1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level, +3 levels of options) = 5th level; effects depending on creature type:

sections.heading: Nightstalker’s TransformationCAd
sections.text: Nightstalker’s TransformationCAd: Invisible needle (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (flanked or denied Dex to AC; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Dex; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 total; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement (Perception; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Stealth; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 5th level; for 1 min./level, you gain +2 deflection, +4 Dex, +1/2 levels to Perception and Stealth, and sneak attack (up to 10d6 piercing total, divided among attacks, max. 5d6 for one attack).

sections.heading: No MovePF117
sections.text: No MovePF117: Bind (0 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (goblinoid caster; -1 level) = 1st level; touch causes target to be entangled and -20 ft. to speed for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Node of BlastingOcA
sections.text: Node of BlastingOcA: Whelm (0 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 nonlethal plus staggered 1 rd./level vs. next creature touching trapped object. Note cost for maintaining latent spells (150 x CL numen).

sections.heading: Nonesuch SpellAUG2
sections.text: Nonesuch SpellAUG2: Warding (1st level) + Variable Spell (choose seed at time of casting; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level; as warding, but you choose the seed at the time of casting, and the effect is wider and lasts longer.

sections.heading: Nonsensical Nullifier, Nahal’sTM2
sections.text: Nonsensical Nullifier, Nahal’sTM2: Dispel (0 level) + Cascade Spell (glamer; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (divinations only; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (caster has no control over results; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) = 2nd level; replaces divination results with random illusory ones.

sections.heading: Noose of Flesh (Michael Moorcock, The Sleeping Sorceress)
sections.text: Noose of Flesh (Michael Moorcock, The Sleeping Sorceress): Energy mace (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1 mi.; +6 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 15d6; -3 levels) = 8th level; 15d6 bludgeoning damage (Reflex half, no SR) over a large area, sparing those you indicate.

sections.heading: NudgeCSc
sections.text: NudgeCSc: Compel (2nd level) + Variable Spell (choose compulsion at time of casting; +1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (under your mindlink spell; -2 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 2nd level; compel target to make a specific choice (no save).

Invest 350 x CL numen to maintain effect. Requires a black sapphire worth 1,000 per HD of the victim, you must invest 400 x CL numen to maintain the effect past the first day, and you take 1d4 Str damage per week. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Living: Damage attribute (Str; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+1d4; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) = +3 levels; damage cap 15d6 negative energy plus 2d4 Str damage.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteUndead: Spook (0 level) + Threnodic Spell (+0 levels) + Augment Spell (shaken to panicked; +2 levels) = +2 levels; panicked 1 rd./level.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Nine LivesARG: Variable Spell (+1 level):
Hand of fate (0 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (saving throws; -2 levels) + Selective Spell = +2 levels; immediate action allows you to reroll saves for 1 round, choose better result.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteWarding (precision damage; 1st level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 level) = +3 levels; immune to precision damage for 1 round.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteSpark of life (1st level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (when reduced to 0 hp or less; -2 levels) = +3 levels; instantly heal 5d6 damage when reduced to 0 hp or less.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteRemove condition (1st level) + Variable Spell (choose condition at time of use; +1 level) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) = +3 levels; instantly removes one condition. + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (rounds need not be consecutive; +1 level) = 7th level (listed as 8th); once per level, subject can reroll a savng throw, negative precision damage, heal 5d6 hp when disabled or dying, or remove a condition affecting it. Note latent spell cost (350 x CL numen) until discharged.

sections.heading: Oak BodySRD
sections.text: Oak BodySRD: Polymorph (plant; 3rd level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Str; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (enhancement; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (natural armor; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (warding: attribute damage; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) = 7th level; you gain plant type, low-light vision, +4 Str, +2 +1/3 levels natural armor, 2 slams (base 1d6), DR 10/slashing, resistance to cold 30, immunity to attribute damage.

sections.heading: OakenbladeDD
sections.text: OakenbladeDD: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Bane Spell (undead; +0 levels) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (magic weapon; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; oaken scimitar deals up to 7d6 slashing/rd. (divided among attacks; 7d8 vs. undead), with +1/4 levels enhancement to attacks and damage.

sections.heading: Oath of BindingDr297
sections.text: Oath of BindingDr297: Attribute boost (0 level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 attribute/3 levels; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (+2 to +4; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (inure: slashing; +1 level) + Energy Admixture (bludgeoning and piercing; +0 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (geased to caster’s cause; -2 levels) = 6th level (listed as epic); geased subject gains +4 profane bonus to attributes and DR 10/−. Invest 300 x CL numen to maintain effect as long as the subject obeys the geas.

sections.heading: OathchordAUG2
sections.text: OathchordAUG2: Enervation (4th level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (willing; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Reduce Spell (1d4 to 1; -3 levels) = 4th level; subjects swear oaths, each loses one level (no save) if theirs is broken.

sections.heading: Object PossessionOcA
sections.text: Object PossessionOcA: Animate object (1st level) + Variable Spell (new object each round, if desired; +1 level) + Widen Spell (up to Large; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 4th level; you animate one Large or smaller object within range at a time. Variants:

sections.heading: Object ReadingOcA
sections.text: Object ReadingOcA: Detection (emotional events; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (lingering aura: days to years; ad hoc +4 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (object touched; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to clairsentience discipline; -1 level) = 2nd level; 1st round—presence/absence of significant events involving strong emotions, 2nd round—general type(s), 3rd round+—other information.

sections.heading: Object ReadingSRD
sections.text: Object ReadingSRD: Augury (2nd level) – Personal Spell (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (object touched; -2 levels) = 2nd level; you gain 1-word answer to 1 querstion/rd. about object touched while you concentrate (e.g., last owner’s race, gender, age, alignment; how owner gained or lost object; etc.). Variant:

sections.heading: ObscureRRE
sections.text: ObscureRRE: Glamer (1st level) + Augment Spell (visual; +1 level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 0 level; blurring hides subject’s face, coat of arms until attacks.

sections.heading: Obscure ShadowRR
sections.text: Obscure ShadowRR: Glamer (1st level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (see below; -2 levels) = 1st level; hides shadow(s) of creature or of objects in 20’r.

sections.heading: ObscurementPH1
sections.text: ObscurementPH1: Wisp (0 level) + Shape Spell (spread to cubes; +0 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. cubes to 30-ft. cubes; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Weather domain, etc.; -1 level) = 2nd level; as wisp, but one 30-ft. cube/level.

sections.heading: Obsidian FlowUC
sections.text: Obsidian FlowUC: Jet of flame (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Residual Spell (+1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 fire plus entangle, and creates difficult terrain.

sections.heading: Ogre CurseRRE
sections.text: Ogre CurseRRE: Enlarge person (1st level) + Cascade Spell (polymorph: giant; +4 levels) + Cascade Spell (bear’s endurance; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (ray of idiocy; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of obliviousness; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (+25 to +10, and no additional polymorph abilities; -3 levels) = 6th level; subject becomes an ogre (Large size, +8 Str, +2 natural armor, penalty to Int and Wis of 1d6 +1/2 levels (+10 max.)). Invest 300 x CL numen to maintain beyond 1 rd./level, and spell is broken if kissed by a princess (or other contingency you set).

sections.heading: Ogre, Murlynd’sLBMM
sections.text: Ogre, Murlynd’sLBMM: Summon (1st level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 4; +2 levels) + Shadow Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; shadow ogre (30% real) has a 10’r. aura of fear (save or frightened).

sections.heading: Old Salt’s CurseARG
sections.text: Old Salt’s CurseARG: Sickening touch (0 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (staggering; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (staggered only when >1 mile from shore; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Water domain, etc.; -1 level) = 5th level; subject is staggered and sickened when more than 1 mile from the nearest ocean. Invest 250 x CL numen to maintain curse indefinitely.

sections.heading: Omen of BonesDr340
sections.text: Omen of BonesDr340: Resistance (0 level) + Augment Spell (+2 bonus; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (inure: positive energy; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1 mile/level; +8 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (evil caster; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (50 to 15; -3 levels) = 7th level; undead within 1 mile/level of you gain +2 resistance to saves and resistance 15 to positive energy.

sections.heading: Omen of CrowsDr340
sections.text: Omen of CrowsDr340: Inure (positive energy; 0 level) + Tenacious Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1 mile/level; +8 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (evil caster; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (50 to 15; -3 levels) = 8th level; creatures within 1 mile/level of you gain resistance 15 to positive energy.

sections.heading: Omen of FliesDr340
sections.text: Omen of FliesDr340: Resistance (0 level) + Augment Spell (+2 bonus; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (saves vs. [afflictions] only; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (­1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1 mile/level; +8 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (evil caster; -1 level) = 9th level; those within 1 mile/level of you are -2 to saves vs. [affliction].

sections.heading: Omen of LossDr340
sections.text: Omen of LossDr340: Skill enhancement (0 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Tenacious Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 skill/3 levels; +2 levels) + Effect-Specidic Spell (Knowledge skills only; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (­1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1 mile/level; +8 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (aberration caster; -1 level) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (+10 to +5; -1 level) = 9th level; those with 13 HD or less within 1 mile/level take a -5 penalty to all Knowledge checks.

sections.heading: Omen of PerilCD
sections.text: Omen of PerilCD: Augury (2nd level) + Ritual Spell (full round; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (1-word answer to “am I in danger?”; -2 levels) = 1st level; you immediately learn if you currently are not in danger (for the next hour or so), are in peril (normal adventuring conditions), or are in grave danger (imminent threat to life).

sections.heading: Omen of SnakesDr340
sections.text: Omen of SnakesDr340: Enhancement (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (poison; -2 levels) + Tenacious Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (­1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1 mile/level; +8 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (evil caster; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (+1/2 levels to +1/4 levels; -2 levels) = 9th level; +4 (+5 at CL 20th) to poison DCs within 1 mile/level of you.

sections.heading: Omniscient EyeS&M
sections.text: Omniscient EyeS&M: Bestow feat (Favored Terrain: shipboard; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (terrain sight only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (warding: glamers; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 other warding effect/3 levels: figments, etc.; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); you can see through illusions, fog, rain, etc.

sections.heading: One with the LandMF
sections.text: One with the LandMF: Skill enhancement (Handle Animal; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Stealth; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Survival; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; +1/2 levels enhancement bonus (max. +5) to skills listed.

sections.heading: Oneiric HorrorOcA
sections.text: Oneiric HorrorOcA: Compel (attack imaginary enemy; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell [(figment; +1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level)] + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; target sees creature out of its nightmares, spends 1 rd./level attacking it to exclusion of all else (save each round to end effect).

sections.heading: Ooze Form IUW
sections.text: Ooze Form IUW: Polymorph (ooze; 3rd level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Con; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 bonus; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (6th level abilities; +1 level) = 5th level; you become a Small or Medium ooze, gain +6 to Con, blindsense 30 ft., +3 to saves vs. [mind-affecting] and other things oozes immune to, climb/swim 20 ft. as applicable, slam attack (1d6 plus 1d6 acid and poison if applicable to ooze type), etc.

sections.heading: Ooze Form IIUW
sections.text: Ooze Form IIUW: Polymorph (ooze; 3rd level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Con; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 bonus; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Variable Spell (Cascade Spell: enlarge self or Augment Spell; +2 levels) = 6th level; you become small or medium ooze as above (but with full immunities), or large ooze with additional +2 Con, +2 Str, -2 Dex, and 6th level abilities (+4 to saves, etc.).

sections.heading: Ooze Form IIIUW
sections.text: Ooze Form IIIUW: Ooze form IIUW (q.v.; 6th level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) = 7th level; small or medium with with full abilities, Large with 8th level, or huge (add +2 Str, +2 Con, -2 Dex) with 7th level abilities (+6 to saves, etc.).

sections.heading: OozepuppetFC1
sections.text: OozepuppetFC1: PossessionOcA (3rd level) + Concentration Spell (full round to partial; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (oozes; -2 levels) = 5th level; you take a partial action each round to control one ooze for up to 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Oozy GlobMW
sections.text: Oozy GlobMW: Minor oozy touchMW (q.v.; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6 plus 1d6/rd., or targets in area shed light.

sections.heading: Open LockAUG
sections.text: Open LockAUG: Skill enhancement (Disable Device; 0 level) + Augment Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (dispel; +1 level) = 0 level; +1/2 levels to one open locks attempt, and/or dispels effect enhancing lock DC.

sections.heading: Opportune DodgeCSc
sections.text: Opportune DodgeCSc: Bestow feat (Press the Advantage; 1st level) + Shielding Spell (+2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (triggered by AoOs only; -2 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level; the next AoO against subject triggers an immediate 5-ft. step, possibly interrupting the attack. AKA travel devotionCC; Cf. lesser celerityPHII.

sections.heading: Oppressive BoredomUM
sections.text: Oppressive BoredomUM: Compel (take no action; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 round to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level spell; victim does nothing for 1 rd./level or until saves.

sections.heading: Orb of AcidCA
sections.text: Orb of AcidCA: Acid splash (0 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) = 4th level; damage cap 15d6 plus sickened 1 round/level.

sections.heading: Orb of ColdCA
sections.text: Orb of ColdCA: Ray of frost (0 level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) = 4th level; damage cap 15d6 and blinds 1 round/level.

sections.heading: Orb of Dancing DeathME
sections.text: Orb of Dancing DeathME: Enervation (4th level) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (1d4 to 1d2; -2 levels) = 5th level; redirect enervation effect each round as a partial action (1d2 temp. negative levels).

sections.heading: Orb of Containment, Otiluke’sGA
sections.text: Orb of Containment, Otiluke’sGA: Mage armor (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Variable Spell (cover; +1 level) + Augment Spell (total cover; +4 levels) + Target-Specific Spell (unattended liquids only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level; sphere of force encapsulates dangerous luqids or gases (up to 5’r.) for up to 1 hr./level. AKA bind itemAUG2.

sections.heading: Orb of ElectricityCA
sections.text: Orb of ElectricityCA: Electric arc (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) = 4th level; damage cap 15d6 electricity plus 2d6/rd. and entangled for 1 rd./level (or until freed).

sections.heading: Orb of SoundCA
sections.text: Orb of SoundCA: Sound lance (1st level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses: hearing; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) = 4th level (bard 3rd); damage cap 15d6 sonic (bard 10d6) and deafens 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Order’s Wrath
sections.text: Order’s Wrath: Inertia (0 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (chaotic only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (sound lance; +1 level) + Sanctify Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Bane Spell (chaotic; +0 levels) + Restricted Spell ([lawful] caster; -1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 (10d8 vs. chaotic; half sonic, half axiomatic), and [chaotic] creatures dazed 1 rd. (Reflex half/neg.).

sections.heading: Origin of SpeciesSRD
sections.text: Origin of SpeciesSRD: Summon (1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 5 achaierai; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 8th level (listed as epic); creates one achaierai (requires 400 x CL numen).

sections.heading: OthertimeS&M
sections.text: OthertimeS&M: Dimensional pocket (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 27 lbs./level; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 rd./level; -3 levels) + Delay Spell (ends at pre-set time; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Power over Shadow; +1 level) + Augment Spell (16 ranks effects; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (dimensional skip; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Time domain; -1 level) = 5th level; you enter a pocket dimension, where no one can follow you, for a pre-set period of time (up to 1 rd./level), whereupon you re-appear anywhere within Close range.

sections.heading: Otyugh SwarmCD
sections.text: Otyugh SwarmCD: Summon (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (2d4+1 CR 4 or 1d3 CR 8; +5 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Pestilence domain; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 9th level; summons 2d4+1 otyughs or 1d3 12 HD neo-otyughs.

sections.heading: Overcome ForceAUG2
sections.text: Overcome ForceAUG2: Warding (force; 1st level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) = 5th level; [force] effects do not manifest within 5 ft. of the subject (negating force damage and allowing it to pass through walls of force, ignore mage armor, etc.).

sections.heading: OverstimulatePC
sections.text: OverstimulatePC: Bestow feat (Diehard; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (6 ranks effects; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); subject gains ferocity.

sections.heading: OverwhelmPHII
sections.text: OverwhelmPHII: Whelm (0 level) + Maximize Spell (+3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Empower Spell (+1 level) = 6th level; ½d6+6 nonlethal/level by touch (max. 7.5d6+90), no save.

sections.heading: Overwhelming GriefUM
sections.text: Overwhelming GriefUM: Spook (0 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of clumsiness; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (shaken to cowering; +3 levels) = 4th level; 1d6 + ½ levels (+10 max.) penalty to Dex and cower for 1 rd./level (Will half/neg.), save each round to end effects.

sections.heading: Overwhelming PresenceUM
sections.text: Overwhelming PresenceUM: Damage attribute (Wis; 1st level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (staggering; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) = 9th level; up to 1 target/level takes 1d4 Wis drain and is cowering (Will neg.) 1 rd./level and/or staggered (Fort neg.) for 1 rd.

sections.heading: Overwhelming RevelationsME
sections.text: Overwhelming RevelationsME: Ray of obliviousness (1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Empower Spell (+1 level) = 6th level; those in 20’r. take 1.5 x (1d6 +1/level) penalty to Wis for 1 rd./level (Intuition half, confused at 1).

sections.heading: Owl’s InsightMF
sections.text: Owl’s InsightMF: Attribute boost (Wis; 0 level) + Augment Spell (+8 to bonus; +5 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./levelk; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (druid; -1 level) = 5th level; subject gains +10 enhancement to Wisdom for 10 min./level.

Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Object LoresightAUG: Augury (2nd level) + Variable Spell (fact not already known; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (object touched; -2 levels) = 1st level; you learn 1 piece of information about object touched: age, name or race of last creature to touch it, creator, purpose, composition, location of creation, owner, magic property, in that order (1-word answer).Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Oneiric Horror, GreaterOcA: Oneiric horrorOcA (3rd level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Str; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = 5th level; as above, plus 1d4 Str damage and greater range.  Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente

= 1st level; touch deals up to 5d6 acid or cold damage (plus 1d6/rd. until removed), or causes target to shed light.
