sections.heading: Pain StrikeAPG
sections.text: Pain StrikeAPG: Whelm (0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = 3rd level; deals 1d6 nonlethal/round and sickens for up to 10 rounds, and caster is +1/2 levels (max +10) to Intimidate the target.

sections.heading: Pain Strike, MassAPG
sections.text: Pain Strike, MassAPG: Pain strike (3rd level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 5th level; damage cap 10d6 and sickened 1 rd./level, caster +1/2 levels to Intimidate up to 1 creature/level.

sections.heading: Pain TouchSC
sections.text: Pain TouchSC: Ray of enfeeblement (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (also Dex penalty; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Sufffering domain; -1 level) = 1st level; touch inflicts 1d6 +1/2 levels (+5 max.) penalty to Str and Dex for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Painful EchoesCM
sections.text: Painful EchoesCM: Sickening touch (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (sound lance; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 1d6; -3 levels) = 3rd level (bard 2nd); 1 target/3 levels takes 1d6 sonic each round and is sickened (save rach round for half/neg.).

sections.heading: Painful StrikeSRD
sections.text: Painful StrikeSRD: Whelm (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap +7d6 nonlethal, divided among melee attacks.

sections.heading: PanaceaMH
sections.text: PanaceaMH: Spark of life (1st level) + Cascade Spell (remove condition; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 condition/3 levels; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (2 to 3 steps; +1 level) = 6th level (listed as 4th); heals up to 15d6 hp and removes debilitation, fear, inertia, and sensory conditions of up to Serious severity (also afflictions at CL 15th and febrility at 18th).

sections.heading: Paragon SurgeARG
sections.text: Paragon SurgeARG: Bestow feat (1st level) + Variable Spell (select feat at time of casting; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Dex; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Int; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell ([elf] caster; -1 level) = 3rd level; you gain +2 enhancement to Dex and Int and access to 1 feat.

sections.heading: ParalyzationPH1
sections.text: ParalyzationPH1: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) = 3rd level; save vs. Intuition or 3d6 nonlethal plus 3d4 Dex damage (Intuition half) in up to 2d4+5 total HD. Invest 150 x CL numen to maintain effects indefinitely.

sections.heading: ParanoiaOcA
sections.text: ParanoiaOcA: Compel (treat others as enemies; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) = 4th level (listed as 2nd); target is shaken, treats all other creatures as enemies for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Parasitic LinkBotD
sections.text: Parasitic LinkBotD: Haste (3rd level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell [(inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./ to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level)] + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Cha; +1 level) + Delay Spell (standard; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (Cha damage ends spell; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Pestilence domain; -1 level) = 4th level; touch staggers victim and hastes you; can end effect by inflicting 1d4 Cha damage on victim.

sections.heading: Parasitic SoulBotD3
sections.text: Parasitic SoulBotD3: Magic jar (5th level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +3 levels) + Variable Spell (shuffle souls among bodies; +1 level) = 9th level; as magic jar, but you can swap multiple souls between bodies and receptacles (up to 1 creature/3 levels, including you, and/or souls, including those trapped with soul bind, etc.).

sections.heading: Partition MindLoM
sections.text: Partition MindLoM: Remove condition (mind-affecting; 1st level) + Quicken Spell (+4 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (slow; -3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (psionic; -1 level) = 1st level; when affected by a [mind-affecting] spell or power, you can spend an immediate action to reduce the severity by 3 steps, at the cost of being slowed for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: PassionRRO
sections.text: PassionRRO: Compel (love or hate designated person; 2nd level) + Mass Effect Spell (2 people; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (each other; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) = 6th level; causes two people to passionately love or hate one another (or one loves the other and is hated in return).

sections.heading: Path of GloryACG
sections.text: Path of GloryACG: Spark of life (1st level) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 1d6; -2 levels) = 3rd level; 4 lighted squares heal 1d6/rd. to those standing on them; move squares each round as a swift action.

sections.heading: Path of the ExaltedBED
sections.text: Path of the ExaltedBED: Augury (2nd level) – Ritual Spell (+2 levels) + Extended Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (cannot have cast divination magic in last 24 hours; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 3rd); as standard-action divination, with longer, more detailed analysis of question (up to 1 rd./level to convey).

sections.heading: Path of the WindsARG
sections.text: Path of the WindsARG: Zephyr (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (line to wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (+1 level) + Explosive Spell (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (+1 level) = 5th level; you direct windstorm (line 10 ft. high, 1 ft./3 levels wide, and up to 10 ft./level in length; increase height and/or width by decreasing length proportionally) by concentration; those in area forcibly expelled.

sections.heading: PatronageRRO
sections.text: PatronageRRO: Deflection (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Bluff; +1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +4; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (saves vs. spells; -2 levels) = 3rd level; subject gains +2 sacred bonus to AC, +4 sacred bonus to saves vs. spells, and +1/2 levels sacred bonus to Bluff.

sections.heading: Pattern, Hypnotic
sections.text: Pattern, Hypnotic: Compel (watch; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level; +1 level) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (+10 to +5; -1 level) = 2nd level; 2d4 +1/level (+5 max.) HD worth of creatures are fascinated 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Pattern, Rainbow
sections.text: Pattern, Rainbow: Compel (follow; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; 2d4 +1/level (+10 max.) HD in 20’r. hypnotically follow where you want them to go, while you concentrate + 1 rd.

sections.heading: Pattern, Scintillating
sections.text: Pattern, Scintillating: Ray of obliviousness (1st level) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (compel: daze; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) = 8th level; damage cap 20d6 nonlethal plus dazed 1 round and 1d6+1/level (+20 max.) penalty to Wis (confused at 1) for 1 rd./level. No save (SR applies), but affects only 2d4 +1/level HD worth of creatures.

sections.heading: Peaceful WeaponAUG
sections.text: Peaceful WeaponAUG: Warding (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels)  + Item-Specific Spell (weapon only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 3rd level; target weapon inflicts no slashing or bludgeoning damage (or piercing at CL 9th, or fire at 12th, etc.).

sections.heading: Peer Through MatterAUG
sections.text: Peer Through MatterAUG: Darkvision (3rd level) + Widen Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 rd./level; -3 levels) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (not blocked by earth, iron, or stone; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to inst.; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 5th level; you can see through normal materials up to close range, with darkvision.

sections.heading: Pellet BlastUC
sections.text: Pellet BlastUC: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (lesser versatile weaponAPG; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) + Irresistible Evocation (+2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level; 5d6 bludgeoning damage penetrates SR and one material-based DR.

sections.heading: Pending PotionME
sections.text: Pending PotionME: Bestow feat (Innate Metamagic: Delay Spell; 1st level) + Augment Spell (CL 16th; +4 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (spell in potion only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 1st level; potion of up to 8th level can be delayed, activated as a swift action after drinking.

sections.heading: Perfect RecollectionRR
sections.text: Perfect RecollectionRR: Fox’s cunning (2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) = 4th level.

sections.heading: Perfume, Elina’sRR2
sections.text: Perfume, Elina’sRR2: Attribute boost (Cha; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (glamer; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (+2 to +1, and no visual, auditory, or tactile/thermal components; -4 levels) = 0 level; subject +1 to Cha and smells like whatever you specify during casting.

sections.heading: Personal ReadingTM2
sections.text: Personal ReadingTM2: Augury (2nd level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 fact/level; +4 levels) + Reach Spell (target: planar to close; -6 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 2nd level; you learn one major fact regarding subject’s personal history per level (Will neg.); each fact consists of a blurb up to 1 rd./level long. Subject must be within Close range. Variants:

sections.heading: Persuasive GoadUM
sections.text: Persuasive GoadUM: Whelm (0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Bluff; +1 level) = 1st level; damage cap 5d6 nonlethal and you gain +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Bluff checks against target.

sections.heading: Pesh VigorPC
sections.text: Pesh VigorPC: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (up to +6 total bonus; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (whelm; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 1st level; subject +2 to Str, +1/1d6 nonlethal damage taken (up to 1d6/level; max. 5d6).

sections.heading: PessimismHA
sections.text: PessimismHA: Warding (morale bonuses; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (frightened to shaken; -1 level) = 5th level; target shaken and loses all morale bonuses for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Phantasmal AsphyxiationHA
sections.text: Phantasmal AsphyxiationHA: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; Intuition or 3d6 nonlethal plus 1d4 Con/rd. (Fort half).

sections.heading: Phantasmal AssailantsCA
sections.text: Phantasmal AssailantsCA: Damage attribute (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (Dex and Wis; +1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; target disbelieves or takes 1d4 Dex and Wis damage.

sections.heading: Phantasmal DecoyCD
sections.text: Phantasmal DecoyCD: Figment (0 level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (compel: follow; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger; -2 levels) = 3rd level; target relentlessly chases figment “enemy” you direct as a partial action each round.

sections.heading: Phantasmal PutrefactionHA
sections.text: Phantasmal PutrefactionHA: Damage attribute (Wis; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 6th level; Intuition or 1d4 Wis plus 3d6 nonlethal +1d6/level (max. +15d6) and 2d6/rd. thereafter, vs. 1 creature per level.

sections.heading: Phantasmal RevengeAPG
sections.text: Phantasmal RevengeAPG: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to planar; +6 levels) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Empower Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (killer of dead creature touched; -2 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 7th level; damage cap 10d6+120 to killer of dead creature touched, anywhere on the same plane.

sections.heading: Phantasmal StranglerCM
sections.text: Phantasmal StranglerCM: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 plus 2d6/rd. and grappled 1 rd./level. Intution neg., if fails, 3d6 nonlethal and Reflex half/neg.

sections.heading: Phantasmal ThiefBVD
sections.text: Phantasmal ThiefBVD: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 12; +7 levels) = 8th level; summons a ghost rogue 11 with the Ghost Strike and Improved Disarm feats, max. ranks and Skill Focus in Sleight of Hand and Stealth, etc.

sections.heading: Phantom ArmorUA1
sections.text: Phantom ArmorUA1: Mage armor (1st level) + Augment Spell (+8 total bonus; +3 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Expedient Spell (total hp; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 1st level; subject gains +8 armor bonus (attackers’ Intuition saves results in +0 instead). Lasts 1 hr./level or until 11 danage taken from attacks affected by armor bonus.

sections.heading: Phantom BattlePHII
sections.text: Phantom BattlePHII: Inertia (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Phantasmal Spell  (­1 level) = 4th level; save vs. Intuition or 3d6 nonlethal plus save vs. Fort or flat-footed and unable to make AoO due to motion and din of illusory battle (you specify those immune).

sections.heading: Phantom DriverUC
sections.text: Phantom DriverUC: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 1; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level; summons a 3rd level human expert, attributes: Str 9, Dex 11, Con 10, Int 10, Wis 15, Cha 10; feats: Skill Focus (handle animal), Skill Synergy (all professions); skills: Handle Animal (3/+9), Perception (3/+8), Profession (driver, pilot, sailing) (3/+10).

sections.heading: Phantom FoilAUG2
sections.text: Phantom FoilAUG2: Compel (waste attack; 2nd level) + Shielding Spell (+2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) = 5th level; up to 1 attack/level against you is foiled by frightful illusion if attacker fails save.

sections.heading: Phantom ObjectARG
sections.text: Phantom ObjectARG: Major creation (4th level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 10 min./level; -1 level) + Shadow Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); object is only 20% real.

sections.heading: Phantom Steed
sections.text: Phantom Steed: Summon (horse-like critter; 1st level) + Augment Spell (Phantom Steed template; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round to full ritual; -1 level) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Phantom ThreatCW
sections.text: Phantom ThreatCW: Blessing (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd./level; -2 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 0 level; target is +3 to be hit and damaged for 1 rd./level (Intuition neg., then Will for 3d6 nonlethal instead).

sections.heading: Phantom Trap, Leoumund’s
sections.text: Phantom Trap, Leoumund’s: Figment (0 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (-2 levels) = 2nd level; object or area detects as trapped, although cannot discern actual mechanism or nature. Invest numen to make permanent (2nd x CL 3rd x 50 = 300).

sections.heading: Phantom WindUA1
sections.text: Phantom WindUA1: Zephyr (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Widen Spell (5-ft. wide to 10-ft. wide; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) = 3rd level; produces up to severe winds in 10-ft. wide path out to Medium range for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Phantom’s HowlRR
sections.text: Phantom’s HowlRR: Spook (0 level) + Fell Frightening (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cone; +1 level) = 2nd level; frightens 1 rd./level (shaken if save). Note that there is no chance of stunning or paralysis.

sections.heading: Phase Arrow (new)
sections.text: Phase Arrow (new): Bestow feat (Precise Shot; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Fell Shot; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (+2 levels) + Ray Splitting (multiple attacks; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Archery domain; -1 level) = 6th level; your ranged attacks target touch AC and ignore intervening barriers.

sections.heading: PhobiaHA
sections.text: PhobiaHA: Spook (0 level) + Fell Frightening (+1 level) + Delay Spell (when confronted with creature, condition, object, etc. of phobia; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 6th level; subject panicked when faced with object of phobia (Will shaken). Invest 300 x CL numen to maintain curse.

sections.heading: Phoenix FireBED
sections.text: Phoenix FireBED: Jet of flame (0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Bane Spell (evil: fixed; +0 levels) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (you take full damage; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) = 7th level; damage 90 hp (120 vs. evil; half fire, half holy; Reflex half, no SR) to all in 20’r. (including you with no save, but you instantaneously heal 15d6 hp of that damage).

sections.heading: Physical MirrorCM
sections.text: Physical MirrorCM: Compel (target self; 2nd level) + Cross-Class Spell (enchantment to conjuration; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to sperad; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) = 8th level (listed as 6th); melee and ranged attacks and spells cast against you from within 60 ft. target the attacker instead.

sections.heading: Pied PipingAPG
sections.text: Pied PipingAPG: Compel (follow; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (-2 levels) + Variable Spell (choose creature type at time of casting; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 6th level.

sections.heading: PierceAUG2
sections.text: PierceAUG2: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (dispel; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (no check needed; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell ([force] only; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 2nd level; Medium ranged touch attack deals 5d6 force dmage and automatically dispels one active [force] effect.

sections.heading: Pierce DisguiseACG
sections.text: Pierce DisguiseACG: Warding (glamers; 1st level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (­1 level) = 3rd level; you see through magical disguises and perceive shapeshifters’ true forms, if within 20 ft.

sections.heading: Piercing ShriekUM
sections.text: Piercing ShriekUM: Inertia (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 2nd level; staggers target.

sections.heading: Pilfering HandUC
sections.text: Pilfering HandUC: Mage hand (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Variable Spell (ranged disarm or Sleight of Hand; +2 levels) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Pillar of LifeAPG
sections.text: Pillar of LifeAPG: Spark of life (1st level) + Augment Spell (+1 hp/level; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Delay Spell (until touched; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (recipient must touch square to be healed; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 5th level; up to 1 creature/level touching glowing square heal 10d6+1/level (max. +10); undead entering square damaged likewise.

sections.heading: Placebo EffectOcA
sections.text: Placebo EffectOcA: Warding (1st level) + Variable Spell (select condition at time of casting; +1 level) +  Irresistible Spell (delay nonmagical effects; +2 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Expedient Spell (no duration loss; ad hoc -1 level) = 2nd level; if subject saves vs. Intuition, one condition affecting it is suspended for 1 min./level (duration does not elapse during this time). 3d6 nonlethal damage instead if fail save.

sections.heading: Plague of RatsCD
sections.text: Plague of RatsCD: Summon (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 2 rat swarm; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level (3rd with access to Pestilence domain); summons one rat swarm per 3 levels.

sections.heading: Plague of UndeadLM
sections.text: Plague of UndeadLM: Lesser animate dead (2nd level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+6 levels) = 9th level; animates up to 15d6 human skeletons or other CR 1/3 undead, 10d6 human zombies or other CR ½, 4d8 CR 1, 3d6 CR 2, 2d4+1 CR 4, 1d4+1 CR 6, 1d3 CR 8, or 1 CR 10 skeleton(s) or zombie(s), or some combination thereof. Requires onyx gems worth 50 gp per HD of undead animated.

sections.heading: Planar AdaptationAPG
sections.text: Planar AdaptationAPG: Bestow feat (favored terrain: planar; 1st level) + Variable Spell (choose plane at time of casting; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: favored terrain x3 more times; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (survival on specified plane only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 5th level (ranger 3rd).

sections.heading: Planar Adaptation, MassAPG
sections.text: Planar Adaptation, MassAPG: Planar adaptation (5th level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger; -2 levels) = 8th level (ranger 6th). AKA attune formMP (listed as 4th level). Avoid planar effectsMP lasts only 1 min./level (-2 levels) = 6th level (ranger 4th; listed as 3rd/2nd).

sections.heading: Planar DampeningMP
sections.text: Planar DampeningMP: Warding (1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (emanates from you; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (11 ranks Planar Sense as a class skill; -1 level) = 6th level; prevents use of plane-breaching magic within 120 ft. of you for 1 rd./level (spells based on dimensional pocket, dimensional skip, and summon, plus augury at CL 12th, [shadow] spells at 15th, and creation at 18th).

sections.heading: Planar NavigationSW
sections.text: Planar NavigationSW: Ritual plane shift (6th level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) = 9th level; as plane shift, but entire ship of up to 10 gross register tons/level plus contents and crew.

sections.heading: Planar QuestTM2
sections.text: Planar QuestTM2: Planar adaptation (q.v., 5th level) + Cascade Spell (dimensional skip; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (destination spell & location; -2 leveks) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/3 levels; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (you must go; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 9th level; 1 creature/level (including you) is shifted to specified location on another plane, treats it as favored terrain.

sections.heading: Plane Truth, Rary’sGA
sections.text: Plane Truth, Rary’sGA: Detection (alignment/planar allegiance; 2nd level) = 2nd level; 1st round—alignment presence/absence, 2nd round—home plane, 3rd round—deity worshipped.

sections.heading: Plant Growth
sections.text: Plant Growth: Creation (plants; 1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +3 levels) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (vegetated area only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Plant domain; -1 level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level; plants grow in 60’r., create difficult terrain where you specify. Invest 150 x CL numen to maintain the effect indefinitely.

sections.heading: Plant Shape ICRB
sections.text: Plant Shape ICRB: Polymorph (plant; 3rd level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Con; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) = 5th level.

sections.heading: Plant Shape IICRB
sections.text: Plant Shape IICRB: Polymorph (plant; 3rd level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Con; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (enlarge self; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Dex; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) = 6th level.

sections.heading: Plant Shape IIICRB
sections.text: Plant Shape IIICRB: Polymorph (3rd level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (enlarge self; +1 level) + Augment Spell (Huge; +1 level) = 7th level; +6 Str, -2 Dex, +2 Con, +2 Wis, +4 natural armor, and other plant traits as shown in Chapter 8.

sections.heading: Play the FoolAUG2
sections.text: Play the FoolAUG2: Glamer (1st level) + Variable Spell (effects differ by attack form; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); subject appears to fail all saving throw for the next 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Plunge Deep to the CoreAUG2
sections.text: Plunge Deep to the CoreAUG2: Enhancement (2nd level) + Augment Spell (penetrates DR up to +4; +4 levels) + Expedient Spell (max. penetration scales; -1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (DR penetration only; -2 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (manufactured weapon; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); target weapon penetrates DR as if it had a permanent enhancement bonus of +1 per 4 caster levels (max. +4).

sections.heading: Poison
sections.text: Poison: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+4d4; +4 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; 5d4 Con damage (1d4/round for 5 rounds until save).

sections.heading: Poison NeedlesCA
sections.text: Poison NeedlesCA: Damage attribute (1st level) + Variable Spell (choose attribute; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (invisible needle; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 piercing plus 1d4 to one attribute.

sections.heading: Poison, AdvanceAUG
sections.text: Poison, AdvanceAUG: Bestow feat (Ability Focus: poison; 1st level) + Channel Spell (through existing poison; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (single dose only; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); as increase virulencePHII (q.v.), but single dose only and longer-lasting).

sections.heading: Poison, Increase VirulencePHII
sections.text: Poison, Increase VirulencePHII: Bestow feat (Ability Focus: poison; 1st level) + Channel Spell (through existing poison; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level; +2 to save DC of poison.

sections.heading: Poison, MindSC
sections.text: Poison, MindSC: Damage attribute (Cha; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +3 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; 4d4 Cha damage (1d4/round for 4 rounds until save).

sections.heading: Poison, PerniciousUM
sections.text: Poison, PerniciousUM: Enhancement (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (poison DCs; -2 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) = 4th level; DCs of up to 1 poison/3 levels increase by +1/4 levels for the creature touched.

sections.heading: Poison, Sethris’ PotencyRR
sections.text: Poison, Sethris’ PotencyRR: Enhancement (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (poison DC only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level; venomous creature +1/3 levels to its poison’s save DC for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Poison, Spit VenomUM
sections.text: Poison, Spit VenomUM: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; 1st level)  + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) = 3rd level; ranged touch blinds 1 round and deals 3d4 Con damage (Fort half).

sections.heading: Poison, Toxic GiftUM
sections.text: Poison, Toxic GiftUM: Poison (4th level) + Restricted Spell (poisoned caster; -1 level) = 3rd level (2nd for antipaladin).

sections.heading: Poison, Toxic WeaponPHII
sections.text: Poison, Toxic WeaponPHII: Poison (4th level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) = 5th level.

sections.heading: Polar MidnightUM
sections.text: Polar MidnightUM: Ray of frost (0 level) + Cascade Spell (gloom; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Dex; +1 level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 15d6 and 5 steps to 3 steps; -2 levels) = 9th level; 15d6 cold and 1d4 Dex drain/rd. (turn to ice at 0) plus grappled in mobile 20’r. spread; light reduced by 3 steps (e.g., normal to supernatural darkness).

sections.heading: Polar Screen, Otiluke’sGA
sections.text: Polar Screen, Otiluke’sGA: Ray of frost (0 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (ailing; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20-ft. squares; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 5d6; -3 levels) = 5th level; 5d6 cold plus 2d6/round and ailing 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Polymorph FamiliarACG
sections.text: Polymorph FamiliarACG: Polymorph (animal; 3rd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (your familiar; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; +1 level) + Variable Spell (Cascade Spell: enlarge/reduce familiar; +1 level) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Polymorph, AdjustableACG
sections.text: Polymorph, AdjustableACG: Alter self (2nd level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Polymorph, Drawmij’s BeneficialGA
sections.text: Polymorph, Drawmij’s BeneficialGA: Polymorph (3rd level) + Variable Spell (multiple forms; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (willing target only; -2 levels) = 6th level.

sections.heading: Polypurpose PanaceaUM
sections.text: Polypurpose PanaceaUM: Variable Spell (select one 0-level spell at time of casting; +1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Pool of HealingCC
sections.text: Pool of HealingCC: Spark of life (1st level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Delay Spell (standard; retain touches for later use; +1 level) = 5th level (4th with access to Healing domain); touch(es) deliver 30 hp + 6/level positive energy (max. 84, or 60 for any one touch).

sections.heading: Positive Energy BurstCD
sections.text: Positive Energy BurstCD: Spark of life (1st level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ability to channel positive energy; -1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 to undead in 120’r.

sections.heading: Positive PulsePnA
sections.text: Positive PulsePnA: Spark of life (1st level) + Augment Spell (+1 hp/level; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead; -2 levels) +

sections.heading: Positive Pulse, GreaterPnA
sections.text: Positive Pulse, GreaterPnA: Positive pulsePnA (q.v.; 1st level) – Widen Spell (+2 levels) + Augment Spell (+3 to +7; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 4th level (paladin 3rd); as positive pulsePnA, but affects a larger area, bestows a +7 save bonus, and the damage cap vs. undead is 5d6+5.

sections.heading: Possess AnimalPGF
sections.text: Possess AnimalPGF: PossessionOcA (3rd level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (animal; -2 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd).

sections.heading: Possession, MarionetteUC
sections.text: Possession, MarionetteUC: PossessionOcA (3rd level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (willing target; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 10 min./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (mindlink; +1 level) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Possession, RidingOcA
sections.text: Possession, RidingOcA: PossessionOcA (3rd level) + Cascade Spell [(glamer; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (masks your presence entirely; +1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level)] + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (cannot control host; -2 levels) = 4th level; you possess (but cannot control) one creature, who is unaware of your presence.

sections.heading: Pouncing FuryUW
sections.text: Pouncing FuryUW: Bestow feat (Dodge; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Skirmish; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; you gain the pounce ability (plus the other effects of the Dodge and Skirmish feats) for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Power CraftAUG2
sections.text: Power CraftAUG2: Animate object (1st level) + Widen Spell (Gargantuan; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (vehicle only; -2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (mobility only; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 3rd level; vehicle of up to Gargantuan size becomes self-propelled.

sections.heading: Power LeechSRD
sections.text: Power LeechSRD: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (steal spell slot instead of dispelling; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); steals target’s highest-level slot available each round while you concentrate. Cf. ki leechAPG.

sections.heading: Power LeechBVD
sections.text: Power LeechBVD: Damage attribute (1st level) + Variable Spell (choose attribute at time of casting; +1 level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+6 total bonus; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Wis; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (Crippling Drain; -1 level) = 5th level; you deal 1d4 attribute drain at range and gain +6 enhancement to that attribute, but you also take 1d4 Wis drain (Will half).

sections.heading: Power Word, Kill
sections.text: Power Word, Kill: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Eschew Materials (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+5d4 Con; +4 levels) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Expedient Spell (individual hp; -1 level) = 9th level; 6d4 Con (no save) to one target currently <100 hp.

sections.heading: Power Word, ThunderRR
sections.text: Power Word, ThunderRR: Alter senses (hearing; 0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Expedient Spell (individual hp; -1 level) = 7th level; those in 60’r. with current hp <78 are deafened 1 rd./level (so save), those with 78-156 hp are deafened 1 rd., those with 157+ hp are unaffected.

sections.heading: Circle of DeathSRD
sections.text: Circle of DeathSRD: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) = 6th level; 4d4 Con (Fort half) to up to 2d4+1/level (+15 max.) HD (max. 10 HD each) in 40’r.

sections.heading: PoxDLM
sections.text: PoxDLM: Ray of infirmity (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Reduce Spell (+15 to +5; -2 levels) = 2nd level; subject takes penalty to Con of 1d6 +1/level (+5 max.) for 1 min./level (Fort half).

sections.heading: Pox PustulesAPG
sections.text: Pox PustulesAPG: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of clumsiness; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (special; -1 level) = 2nd level; victim is sickened and takes a 1d6 +1/2 levels penalty to Dex (Fort neg./half), but can spend a partial action each round scratching to remove the symptoms. Variant:

sections.heading: Prayer
sections.text: Prayer: Blessing (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Lucky Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Variable Spell (Hex Spell: bonus or penalty; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Expedient Spell (individual hp; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (cleric only; -1 level) = 3rd level; allies in 40’r. gain +1 luck bonus to attacks, damage, and saves; enemies with 33 hp or less are -1 to same.

sections.heading: PrecipitationUA1
sections.text: PrecipitationUA1: Creation (plain water; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1/64 volume; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (time release; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (gradual release over course of spell, with no control of timing; -1 level) = 0 level; light rain (0.09 inch per hour) falls over an area 20 ft. in radius for 1 rd./level. Variant:

sections.heading: PrecognitionSRD
sections.text: PrecognitionSRD: Variable Spell (blessing, resistance, or skill enhancement; +1 level) + Insightful Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (seer or access to Fortune or Time domain; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); immediate casting grants you +3 insight to attacks and damage, saves, or checks for 1 rd. Variants:

sections.heading: Predict WeatherPH1
sections.text: Predict WeatherPH1: Augury (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Survival; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (knowledge of weather in area only; -2 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Weather domain; ‑1 level) = 0 level; you gain knowledge of upcoming weather in area. Use Survival instead of Knowledge to augur, with +1 bonus to the check; success = learn weather over next 24 hours, +1 day/5 points by which you beat the DC.

sections.heading: Prediction of FailureUM
sections.text: Prediction of FailureUM: Sickening touch (0 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (dispel; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (cowering to shaken; −3 levels) = 6th level (listed as 8th); target is shaken, sickened, and must make opposed Concentration checks to cast spells; invest personal 300 x CL numen to maintain effect permanently.

sections.heading: Presence, Chardun’sRR2
sections.text: Presence, Chardun’sRR2: Attribute boost (Cha; 0 level) + Augment Spell (+4 total; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell [(spook; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cone; +1 level) + Delay Spell (+1 level) + Tenuous Spell (fear ends Cha bonus; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level)  = 4th level; you gain long-lasting +4 enhancement to Cha and can dismiss the effect by frightening those in a 30-ft. cone.

sections.heading: Pressure SphereSW
sections.text: Pressure SphereSW: Energy mace (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (underwater; -2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 2nd); damage cap 5d6 bludgeoning (Fort half) in 20’r. burst underwater.

sections.heading: Prevarication’s BountyRR
sections.text: Prevarication’s BountyRR: Glamer (1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Delay Spell (when lies; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level; subject rendered mute for 1 rd./level after telling a lie. Retain as active curse by investing 400 x CL numen (2nd level x 50 x 4).

sections.heading: PrevenomSRD
sections.text: PrevenomSRD: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (claw only; -2 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); claw attack deals +1d4 Con damage (Fort half).

sections.heading: Prickling TormentCM
sections.text: Prickling TormentCM: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Creature-Specific Spell (takes standard or move action; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) = 4th level; sickens 1 rd./level and target takes 1d6 negative energy/level (max. 10d6, Fort half) each round if takes a move or standard action.

sections.heading: Primal DevastationDr297
sections.text: Primal DevastationDr297: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to line of sight; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 360’r.; +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (bolt of force; -2 levels) = 9th level; damage cap 20d6 force over large area at very distance range (but caster takes like damage). This is generally cast along with a Delayed summon nature’s ally IX spell, to summon a Giant, Advanced elder elemental into the area after the blast goes off.

sections.heading: Primal FearRE
sections.text: Primal FearRE: Spook (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Fell Frightening (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Restricted Spell (psion or psychic warrior; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (panicked to shaken; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); swift action leaves target shaken 1 rd./level (no SR, no initial save, but save each subsequent round to end effect).

sections.heading: Primal Fury, Tenser’sGA
sections.text: Primal Fury, Tenser’sGA: Spark of life (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (arcane; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (haste: q.v.; +3 levels) + Augment Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (warding: fear; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (fighter only; -2 levels) = 5th level; fighter is hasted, +3 to attacks and damage, gains 15d6 temp. hp, and is immune to magical fear.

sections.heading: Primal RegressionOcA
sections.text: Primal RegressionOcA: Enhancement (2nd level) + Augment Spell (+2 total; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (natural armor; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Str; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+6 total; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of idiocy; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of beguiling; -1 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = 5th level (listed as 6th); target gains +6 enhancement to Str, +2 to natural armor, and 1d6/level (max. 15d6) temp. hp, but also takes penalty to Int and Cha equal to 1d6 +1/level (1d6+15 max.).

sections.heading: Primal ScreamUM
sections.text: Primal ScreamUM: Remove condition (enchantments; 1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (also paralysis; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) + Augment Spell (minor to critical; +3 levels) = 4th level; breaks enchantment and paralysis effects on you.

sections.heading: Prism Cloak, Abrindel’sRR2
sections.text: Prism Cloak, Abrindel’sRR2: Glamer (1st level) + Cascade Spell (compel: watch; +3 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (+3 levels; up to 1 attacker/level can be fascinated) + Expedient Spell (HD limit; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) = 7th level; up to 1 attacker/level (max. 2d4 +1/level total HD) is fascinated 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Prismatic AuraCM
sections.text: Prismatic AuraCM: Prismatic spray (7th level) – Widen Spell (-1 level) + Shape Spell (cone to ray; -1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Tenuous Spell (color disappears once activated; -1 level) = 5th level; anyone hitting you in melee is blinded 1 rd. and subject to one prismatic spray effect (damage cap 90 hp, and each activates only once).

sections.heading: Prismatic BowCM
sections.text: Prismatic BowCM: Prismatic ray (q.v.; 5th level) + Reach Spell (medium to long; +1 level) – Variable Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (invisible needle; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Channeled Spell (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (each color only once; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 20d6; -1 level) = 8th level; damage cap 28d6, divided among iterative attacks, plus one prismatic spray effect per round to one attack (once each color only).

sections.heading: Prismatic DelugeCM
sections.text: Prismatic DelugeCM: Prismatic spray (7th level) + Shape Spell (widened cone to widened cylinder; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 30’r.; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 20d6; -1 level) = 8th level; those in 30’r., 150-ft. tall cylinder bombarded by prismatic spray effect.

sections.heading: Prismatic EyePGF
sections.text: Prismatic EyePGF: Prismatic rayCA (q.v.; 5th level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Tenuous Spell (each color usable only once; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as 6th).

sections.heading: Prismatic MistPHII
sections.text: Prismatic MistPHII: Acid splash (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Variable Spell (Versatile Evocation, but no control over results; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 3rd level; each round, those in area take 5d6 acid, fire, cold, or electricity damage (roll 1d4), Reflex half. No additional effects possible without increasing spell level.

sections.heading: Prismatic RayCA
sections.text: Prismatic RayCA: Prismatic spray (7th level) - Widen Spell (-1 level) – Shape Spell (-1 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Variable Spell (no control over effect; -1 level) = 5th level.

sections.heading: Prismatic Sphere
sections.text: Prismatic Sphere: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (blindness; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (jet of flame; +1 level) + Energy Admixture (acid and electricity; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Dex; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Wis; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (Crippling Drain: Dex and Wis; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (dispel; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 20d6; -1 level) = 9th level; 4d6 fire, 6d6 acid, 10d6 electricity, plus 1d4 Con damage, 1d4 Dex and Wis drain, blindness 1 rd./level, and dispelling, each round, to all within 10’r. of you.

sections.heading: Prismatic Spray
sections.text: Prismatic Spray: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (blindness; +1 level) + Variable Spell (3 levels’ worth of options; +4 levels) + Shape Spell (cone; +1 level) + Widen Spell (30 ft. to 60 ft.; +1 level) = 7th level; all within cone blinded 1 rd./level and effects as follows (roll 1d8):

sections.heading: Prismatic Wall
sections.text: Prismatic Wall: Prismatic sphere (9th level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (emanation to wall; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 15d6; -1 level) = 8th level; 3d6 fire, 5d6 acid, 7d6 electricity, plus 1d4 Con damage, 1d4 Dex and Wis drain, blindness 1 rd./level, and dispelling.

sections.heading: Private ConversationAUG2
sections.text: Private ConversationAUG2: Rary’s telepathic bond (q.v.; 5th level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Tenuous Spell (must remain within close range; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st).

sections.heading: Private Sanctum, Mordenkainen’s
sections.text: Private Sanctum, Mordenkainen’s: Warding (divinations; 1st level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 20-ft. cubes; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (ward also applies against mundane sight/hearing into area; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (pre-selected, fixed location; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level; those outside area cannot see or hear into it, or use divinations into it.

sections.heading: Profane AgonyDU
sections.text: Profane AgonyDU: Whelm (0 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Death or Suffering domain; -1 level) = 1st level; damage cap 5d6 nonlethal plus sickened 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Profane AuraPHII
sections.text: Profane AuraPHII: Deflection (0 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (wisp; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (able to channel negative energy; -1 level) = 1st level; 60’r. aura of mist around you provides concealment, grants undead +2 deflection.

sections.heading: ProficiencyAUG2
sections.text: ProficiencyAUG2: Bestow feat (Exotic Weapon; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (weapon held at time of casting; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); you gain Exotic proficiency with weapon held.

sections.heading: Prohibit KindAUG2
sections.text: Prohibit KindAUG2: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4d4; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (effects: days to rounds; -3 levels) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (onset: inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) = 7th level; those not of selected creature type or race who enter area are held (5d4 Dex, Fort half, recovered at 1 point/rd.).

sections.heading: Project Image
sections.text: Project Image: Figment (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shadow Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (image of you only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (vision and hearing; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Channel Spell (though image); +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Sudden Metamagic;  (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) = 7th level; quasi-real (60%) image of you at medium range mimics you, and serves as scrying sensor and conduit for your spells (limited by Sudden Metamagic rules, but 1/3 levels x as many spells can be affected).

sections.heading: Project VoiceRRE
sections.text: Project VoiceRRE: Glamer (1st level) + Widen Spell (10’r. to 500’r.; +6 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (your normal spoken voice; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (no visual, olfactory, or tactile; -3 levels) = 2nd level; essentially, a magical microphone and speakers.

sections.heading: Protean AuraAPG
sections.text: Protean AuraAPG: Compel (perform other action; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (can perform other action instead; -1 level) + Restricted Spell ([chaotic] bloodline, domain, race, etc.; -1 level) = 4th level; enemies within 20’r. must succeed at saving throws in order to perform intended actions.

sections.heading: Protection DevotionCC
sections.text: Protection DevotionCC: Deflection (0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Communal Spell (+1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Protection domain; -1 level) = 5th level; immediate casting grants you and allies +2 sacred bonus to AC for 1 min./level (divide duration among recipients).

sections.heading: Protection from Avians, Mordenkainen’sGA
sections.text: Protection from Avians, Mordenkainen’sGA: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (avians; -2 levels) = 0 level (listed as 1st); birds and other creatures with the [avian] descriptor are -2 to attacks and damage against the subject.

sections.heading: Protection from Arrows
sections.text: Protection from Arrows: Spark of life (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (arcane; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 hr./level; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (ranged attacks only; -2 levels) = 2nd level; subject gains 1d6+1/level (max. 10d6+10) temp. hp against ranged weapon damage over the next 1 hr./level (or until discharged).

sections.heading: Protection from CantripsUA1
sections.text: Protection from CantripsUA1: Warding (cantrips; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Expedient Spell (spell level limit; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (lower spell level limit: 2nd to 0; -2 levels) = 1st level; target creature or objct is unaffected by cantrips.

sections.heading: Protection from CharmCA
sections.text: Protection from CharmCA: Bestow feat (Arcane Defense: enchantment; 1st level) + Augment Spell (scales with caster level; +1 level) = 2nd level; subject immune to charm person and gains +2 competence bonus to save vs. enchantment (+1/5 levels above 1st, immune at 20th) for 1 rd./level. Variants:

sections.heading: Protection from Hunger and ThirstCWH
sections.text: Protection from Hunger and ThirstCWH: Warding (starvation and thirst; 1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 1st); the subject is immune to starvation and thrist for 1 min./level. Invest 2,800 numen (4th level x CL 7th x 50 x 2 for 1 min./level duration) to maintain the effect.

sections.heading: Protection from Insects and Arachnids, Mordenkainen’sGA
sections.text: Protection from Insects and Arachnids, Mordenkainen’sGA: Hedge (vermin; 2nd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (swarms only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+5 total; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (vermin only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 3rd level; subject +2 deflection and +5 to saves vs. vermin, and vermin swarms cannot approach within 10 ft. for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Protection from ParalysisTM2
sections.text: Protection from ParalysisTM2: Warding (Dex damage and slow; 1st level) = 1st level (listed as 2nd); applies only against magical effects, not Dex damage from poison, Crippling Strike, etc.

sections.heading: Protection from PoisonS&M
sections.text: Protection from PoisonS&M: Hedge (poison-using creatures; 2nd level) + Widen Spell (10’r. to 5’r.; -1 level) = 1st level (listed as 2nd). Protection from verminS&M hedges out vermin instead; protection from amorphsS&M hedges out oozes.

sections.heading: Protection from Slime, Mordenkainen’sGA
sections.text: Protection from Slime, Mordenkainen’sGA: Hedge (oozes; 2nd level) + Widen Spell (10’r. to 5’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (inure: acid; +1 level) = 4th level; oozes, slime, etc. cannot approach within 5 ft., and subject gains resistance to acid 5/2 levels (max. 30) for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Protection from SporesPF113
sections.text: Protection from SporesPF113: Warding (spores, fungal poisons, etc.; 1st level) + Irresistible Spell (protects against nonmagical hazards; +3 levels) = 4th level (listed as 2nd); subject immune to spores, yellow mold, green slime, fungal-derived poisons, infestation from fungal creatures, etc.

sections.heading: Protective AuraAPG
sections.text: Protective AuraAPG: Resistance (0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (hedge: evil; 2nd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (summoned only; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Good domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; allies within 20’r. +2 deflection to AC and resistance to saves, and hedges out summoned evil creatires, for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Protective PenumbraUM
sections.text: Protective PenumbraUM: Gloom (0 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Shape Spell (spread to target; -2 levels) = 2nd level; lowers light by 1 step for subject (minimum dim), alleviating light sensitivities. Variants:

sections.heading: ProwessSRD
sections.text: ProwessSRD: Bestow feat (Combat Reflexes; 1st level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level; you gain Combat Reflexes for 1 rd. as an immediate action.

sections.heading: Prying Eyes, Greater
sections.text: Prying Eyes, Greater: Prying eyes (q.v.; 6th level) + Cascade Spell (true seeing, q.v.; +5 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (diviner; -1 level) = 8th level.

sections.heading: Psychic BeaconME
sections.text: Psychic BeaconME: Detection (2nd level) + Item-Specific Spell (object psychically “marked” during casting; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Psychic BlastAUG
sections.text: Psychic BlastAUG: Damage attribute (Int; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Wis; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) = 5th level (listed as 8th); damage cap 15d6 plus 1d4 Int and 1d4 Wis (Will half).

sections.heading: Psychic ChirurgySRD
sections.text: Psychic ChirurgySRD: Variable Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels):

sections.heading: Psychic CrushSRD
sections.text: Psychic CrushSRD: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Maximize Spell (+3 levels) + Empower Spell (+1 level) + Overwhelming Evocation (+1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 5th level; Intuition or 3d6 nonlethal plus up to 7.5d6 + 90 necrotic (Will half, not subject to energy resistance).

sections.heading: Psychic CrushOcA
sections.text: Psychic CrushOcA: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Fell Sickening (+1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level (listed at 5th); 3d6 nonlethal and sickened 1 rd./level (Intuition 0 damage and 1 rd.), if fails save, also takes 1d6 negative energy/level (max. 15d6, Will half).

sections.heading: Psychic Crush, GreaterOcA
sections.text: Psychic Crush, GreaterOcA: Psychic crushOcA – Phantasmal Spell (+1 level) = 5th level (listed as 8th); damage cap 15d6 negative energy and sickened 1 rd./level (Will half/1 rd.).

sections.heading: Psychic ImageOcA
sections.text: Psychic ImageOcA: Project image (7th level) – Shadow Spell (-1 level) + Reach Spell (medium to line of sight; +3 levels) = 9th level; as project image, but no real component, and image can be projected up to ¼ mile/level away.

sections.heading: Psychic SurgeryOcA
sections.text: Psychic SurgeryOcA: Remove condition (mental attribute damage; 1st level) + Crippling Drain (attribute drain also removed; +3 levels) + Mass Effect (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 5th level (listed at 6th); can remove up to 5d4 attribute mental attribute damage/drain, plus one additional condition of up to serious severity/3 levels above 3rd (choose confusion, enchantments, [fear], memory alteration, etc.).

sections.heading: Psychic VampireSRD
sections.text: Psychic VampireSRD: Variable Spell (+1 level): dispel (0 level) + Mass Effect Spell (2 spell slots; +1 level) = 1st level; or damage attribute (1st level)  + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Variable Spell (touch or [strike]; +1 level) = 4th level; remove 2 spell slots or inflict 1d4 damage to one mental attribute by touch or as a [strike].

sections.heading: PsychofeedbackSRD
sections.text: PsychofeedbackSRD: Attribute boost (0 level) + Variable Spell (select attribute(s) at time of casting; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+20 total bonus; +9 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute; -1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to psychometabolism discipline; -1 level) = 5th level; you gain +20 enhancement to one attribute, at the expense of 3d4 damage to a different one.

sections.heading: Pugnacious Pugilist, Bigby’sGA
sections.text: Pugnacious Pugilist, Bigby’sGA: Energy mace (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; close ranged attack for up to 5d6 bludgeoning each round as a swift action.

sections.heading: Pull of the EarthRRO
sections.text: Pull of the EarthRRO: Enlarge (3rd level) + Selective Spell (weight only, not size or Stength; +1 level) + Item-Specific Spell (object weighing up to 1 lb./level; -2 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 0); increases weight of object by a factor of 8.

sections.heading: Pup ShapeUC
sections.text: Pup ShapeUC: Reduce (3rd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (animal or magical beast; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (sanctuary; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 3rd level; target critter reduced 1 size category, and those within 20 ft. of it are reluctant to attack it.

sections.heading: PuppeteerSC
sections.text: PuppeteerSC: Compel (mimic you; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Purge Akashic MemoryAUG
sections.text: Purge Akashic MemoryAUG: Glamer (1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (memories can be removed outright: analogous to adding invisibility; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1 mile/level; +8 levels) + + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to inst.; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (seer, akashic, etc.; −1 level) = 9th level; inserts, alters, or removes one collective memory from all in area (not entire multiverse). Invest 450 x CL numen to make effect permanent until memory is re-introduced.

sections.heading: Purge SpiritOcA
sections.text: Purge SpiritOcA: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; +1 level) + Thanatopic Spell (+1 level) + Trans-dimensional Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 negative energy and staggered 1 rd. (Will half/neg.); affects incorporeal, ethereal, undead, etc. normally.

sections.heading: Purify Food & Drink
sections.text: Purify Food & Drink: Remove condition (afflictions; 1st level) + Expedient Spell (max. 1 cu. ft./level; -1 level) = 0 level.

PoxBVD: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) = 6th level; 1d4 Con drain (Fort half) to up to 1 creature/level.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente

BilocationOcA is Still (+1 level) = 8th level.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteFamiliar DoubleACG: Project image (7th level) + Location-Specific Spell (image always appears in your familiar’s square; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (image moves with familiar, not you; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (witch; -1 level) = 5th level; 40% real. Area affects targeting the image’s square will affect your familiar as well, and missile fire missing the image might hit the familiar (as if firing into a melee; see Precise Short feat), so this is a very risky way to get early access to project image.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Delusional prideUM Cascades Augmented blessing (-1 level) = 1st level; subject -2 to attacks and damage but gais bonus to saves vs. Enchantment effects.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteEnchantment FoilACG is not Augmented (-1 level), but Cascades skill enhancement (Spellcraft and Bluff; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (enchantments; -2 levels), and is Extended to 1 hr./level (+3 levels) = 4th level; subject gains competence bonus vs. Enchantment effects, is +1/2 levels to Spellcraft checks dealing with them, and is +1/2 levels to Bluff checks to sense or to feign being under the influence.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteRary’s mind shieldGA is Extended (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) and Ritual (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; subject immune to detect thoughts spell and gains +2 to saves vs. Enchantments. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Gaean repastRRO also includes Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (in direct contact with the ground; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level; you are immune to starvation and thirst if remain in contact with the ground (1 hr./level, or invest 100 x CL numen to maintain).Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Protection from Winged FlyersShS: Protection from evil (q.v.; 1st level) vs. winged creatures instead of [evil] ones.
Cloak of dark powerDHD is Augmented (light lowered by 2 steps, minimum darkess; +1 level) and lasts only 1 min./level (-2 levels) = 1st level. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteCloak of ShadeSSt: Gloom (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (emanation to target; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (endure elements; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (2 steps to dim; -2 levels) = 1st level; subject treats ambient light as 1 step lower (minimum dim) and is protected from nonmagical heat and cold. Keshmeeri refugeRR2 (2nd level) is Extended to 2 hrs./level.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteImpede sun’s brillianceSSt is as cloak of shadeSSt, but affects a cylinder (+2 levels), lasts 10 min./level (-1 level), is Silent (+1 level), Reduced 1 more step (3 steps to dim; -1 level), and Restricted (ranger or access to Desert or Sun domain; -1 level) = 1st level. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteShadow shroudDU is Quickened (+3 levels) and lasts only 1 rd./level (-3 levels) = 2nd level.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente

+ Delay Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 2nd); you psychically mark an object (invest 200 numen), and thereafter can find its distance and direction as a swift action (if within medium range) or a standard action (if on the same plane).
Remove condition (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (telepath; +1 level) + Crippling Drain (permanent conditions; +4 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 condition/level; +3 levels) + Augment Spell (serious to critical; +1 level) = 9th level; removes enchantments, energy drain, harmful psionic effects, 9d4 attribute damage/drain each to multiple attributes.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteBestow feat (Magical Talent; 1st level) + Augment Spell (16 ranks; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 8th level; invest 200 x CL numen to provide recipient with psionic power you know of up to 8th level.
