sections.heading: QualmUC
sections.text: QualmUC: Skill enhancement (0 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (all skills; +3 levels) + Tenuous Spell (remove effect by spending 1 round doing nothing; -1 level) = 3rd level; target -1/2 levels (­10 max.) to skill checks for 1 min./level or until spend 1 rd. idle.

sections.heading: Quench
sections.text: Quench: Jet of flame (applied as counter; 0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. cubes to 20-ft.; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Fire domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; dampens fire in area by 5d6 (fires dampened to 0 damage are doused) and deals like damage to [fire] creatures. Variants:

sections.heading: Quick BoostAUG2
sections.text: Quick BoostAUG2: Attribute boost (0 level) + Variable Spell (select attribute at time of casting; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 0 level; touch grants +2 enhancement to one attribute.

sections.heading: Quick LearnRR2
sections.text: Quick LearnRR2: Skill enhancement (0 level) + Variable Spell (choose skill at time of casting; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); subject gains long-lasting +1/2 levels bonus to one skill.

sections.heading: Quick MarchMH
sections.text: Quick MarchMH: Celerity (0 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+20 ft. to +30 ft.; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); allies in 20’r. burst gain +30 ft. to land speed for 1 rd.

sections.heading: Quick SoberRR
sections.text: Quick SoberRR: Remove condition (affliction; 1st level) + Effect-Specific Spell (effects of alcohol or drugs only; -1 level) = 0 level.

sections.heading: Quiet Contemplation, Salamar’sRR
sections.text: Quiet Contemplation, Salamar’sRR: Compel (avoid conflict; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 1st); target refuses to fight (effect broken if attacked).

sections.heading: Quill BlastCD
sections.text: Quill BlastCD: Invisible needle (0 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (ailing; +1 level) + Shape Spell (touch to burst; +2 levels) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Animal domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 60 hp piercing plus ailing 1 rd./level. Variants:

sections.heading: Quintelemental BlastAUG2
sections.text: Quintelemental BlastAUG2: Jet of flame (0 level) + Energy Admixture (acid, cold, electricity, and sonic; +1 level) + Overwhelming Evocation (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (one energy type/3 levels; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) + Widen Spell (30 ft. to 60 ft.; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 5th level; damage cap 10d6 total from listed energy types, and ignores cold, electricity, and fire resistance (and acid resistance at CL 12th, and sonic resistance at CL 15th).

sections.heading: QuintessenceOcA
sections.text: QuintessenceOcA: Glamer (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +3 levels) + Augment Spell (tactile; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (masks injury, flaws, breaks, etc.; -2 levels) = 2nd level; item or creature appears to be in perfect condition (visually and by touch).

sections.heading: Quintessence MasteryPnA
sections.text: Quintessence MasteryPnA: Location-Specific Spell (outer plane; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Radiant Arch, Nystul’sGA
sections.text: Radiant Arch, Nystul’sGA: Jet of flame (0 level) + Variable Spell (see below; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Augment Spell (10d6 to 20d6; +2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 5th); 1 close ranged attack/rd. deals 1d6/level energy damage (1d8/level vs. bane, Reflex half):

sections.heading: Radiant Baton, Nystul’sGA
sections.text: Radiant Baton, Nystul’sGA: Electric Arc (0 level) + Conductive Evocation (+1 level) + Variable Spell (select from Versatile Evocation [acid, cold, fire, electrical], Positive Spell, and/or Creature-Specific Spell; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); 1 touch attack/round (+4 to hit opponents with metallic arms/armor) deals 1d6/level (max. 10d6).

sections.heading: Radiant FogBED
sections.text: Radiant FogBED: Solid fog (4th level) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Augment Spell (dazzling; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (light: 10 min./level to 1 min./level; -1 level) + Extend Spell (dazzling: 1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Resistible Spell (-1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (cannot have cast darkness or necromancy spell in last 24 hours; -2 levels) = 6th level (listed as 4th); solid fog dazzles those within for 1 rd./level (Fort neg.).

sections.heading: Radiant Screen, Otiluke’sGA
sections.text: Radiant Screen, Otiluke’sGA: Ray of frost (0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level; select from Versatile Evocation [acid, fire, electrical], Positive Spell, and/or Creature-Specific Spell) + Shape Spell (ray to wall; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action to change Variable Spell parameters; +3 levels) = 5th level; damage cap 15d6.

sections.heading: Rage, MassDr342
sections.text: Rage, MassDr342: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 attribute/3 levels; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (+2 to +4; +1 level) + Empathic Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (willing subjects; -2 levels) = 6th level; one creature/level gains +4 enhancement to Str, Con, and Cha (and Dex at CL 12th, Wis at 15th).

sections.heading: Raging RubbleARG
sections.text: Raging RubbleARG: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (nausea: 1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (area of gravel or small stones; -2 levels) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); mobile area of rubble deals up to 5d6 bludgeoning/rd. plus nausea 1 rd. while you concentrate.

sections.heading: Raiment, ExaltedBED
sections.text: Raiment, ExaltedBED: Mage armor (1st level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (spell resistance; +5 levels) + Cascade Spell [(inure: slashing; +1 level) + Energy Admixture (bludgeoning and piercing; +0 levels) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (overcome by evil weapons; -1 level)] + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell ([good] descriptor; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 6th); [good] caster gains +4 sacred bonus to AC, DR 10/evil, and SR 10 + Concentration bonus for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Raiment, GloriousBED
sections.text: Raiment, GloriousBED: Mage armor (1st level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (inure: slashing; +1 level) + Energy Admixture (bludgeoning and piercing; +0 levels) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (overcome by evil weapons; -1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (good subject only; -2 levels) = 2nd level; good-aligned subject gains +4 sacred bonus to AC and DR 10/evil for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Rain of Arrows (new)
sections.text: Rain of Arrows (new): Invisible needle (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to extreme; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1,000’r.; +5 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Archery domain; -1 level) = 9th level; damage cap 20d6 at extreme range over a wide area.

sections.heading: Rain of Black TulipsBED
sections.text: Rain of Black TulipsBED: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (evil only; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to flattened cylinder; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Good or Plant domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 15d6; -1 level) = 9th level; damage cap 15d6 (half force, half holy) plus nauseated (evil creatures only) in 60’r. cylinder.

sections.heading: Rain of FrogsUM
sections.text: Rain of FrogsUM: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 4; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level; summons a swarm of frogs (as centipede swarm).

sections.heading: Rain of NeedlesCA
sections.text: Rain of NeedlesCA: Invisible needle (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) = 2nd level, damage cap 12d6, divided among multiple ranged touch targets.

sections.heading: Rain of RosesBED
sections.text: Rain of RosesBED: Damage attribute (Wis; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (evil only; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to long; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Good or Plant domain; -1 level) = 7th level; 1d4 Wis/rd. plus sickened 1 rd./level vs. evil creatures in area.

sections.heading: Rain of SpinesCM
sections.text: Rain of SpinesCM: Invisible needle (0 level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cylinder; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10’r. to 5’r.; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (wu jen or metal incarnate; -1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 in 5’r, cylinder, 25 ft. high, plus knocked prone and grappled 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Dr348
sections.text: Dr348: Figment (0 level) + Shape Spell (cubes to emanation; +0 levels) + Shadow Spell (+1 level) + Variable Spell (roll for effect; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Augment Spell (-1 to -5; +2 levels) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (Will saves only; -2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (saves vs. fear only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Bluff; +1 level) = 6th level (listed as 3rd); quasi-real rain of black water, ash, blood, toads, dead bats, snakes, or spiders (roll randomly) in 120’r. imposes -5 penalty to saves vs. fear, and you gain +1/2 levels to Bluff checks for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Raise FoundationRRE
sections.text: Raise FoundationRRE: Shaping (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (bedrock, to or just above surface; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 5,832 cu. ft./level; +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 7th); bedrock slowly rises to form stone foundation 1 ft./level deep x 5,832 square feet in area (e.g., 43’r. circle or square 76 ft. on each side; shape must be simple unless you possess sufficient Craft skill).

sections.heading: Raise IslandSRD
sections.text: Raise IslandSRD: Shaping (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (seafloor, to island; -2 levels) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 40,000,000 cu. ft./level2; +9 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 7th level (listed as epic); raises hemispherical island from sea floor (radius of base = total height from sea floor = about 80 ft./level). If water is deeper than that, the spell forms a seamount instead (the island does not reach the surface); if less, the radius of the island is equal to its height above water. The open ocean is about 12,000 feet deep on average, so this spell is best used nearer the coast.

sections.heading: Raise LandRRE
sections.text: Raise LandRRE: Raise foundation (3rd level) + Variable Spell (earth and/or rock; +1 level) + Reach Spell (+1 level) + Widen Spell (5,832 cu. ft./level to 8 million cu. ft./level; +2 levels) = 7th level (listed as 9th); increases elevation of land area, within volume restriction (e.g., a 285’r. circle of land of could be increased in elevation by 10 ft./level, possibly forming a small island).

sections.heading: Raise the KeepRR
sections.text: Raise the KeepRR: Mage hand (0 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 8,000,000 lbs./level; +7 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (stone castle only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 8th level; floating castle moves 20 ft./rd. by concentration. Invest 120,000 numen to make permanent.

sections.heading: RallyRRE
sections.text: RallyRRE: Blessing (0 level) + Reach Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd./level; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 level) = 6th level (paladin 4th); allies in 120’r. gain +3 morale to attacks, damage, saves vs. fear.

sections.heading: RampartAPG
sections.text: RampartAPG: Creation (earth; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 216 cu. ft./level; +3 levels) = 6th level; creates earthen rampart 5 ft. thick x 8.5 ft. tall x 5 ft./level in length. Variants:

sections.heading: Ram’s MightSC
sections.text: Ram’s MightSC: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Exotic Weapon Proficiency: unarmed attacks; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Strength domain; ­1 level) = 1st level; you gain +2 Str and unarmed attacks.

sections.heading: RancorMW
sections.text: RancorMW: Invisible needle (0 level) + Variable Spell (versatile evocation and touch vs. ranged touch; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to extreme; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (quarry or favored enemy; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger; -2 levels) = 1st level; damage cap +11d6, divided among interative attacks against quarry/favored enemies.

sections.heading: Random CausalityTM2
sections.text: Random CausalityTM2: Compel (attack yourself or random ally; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (target of attack: touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Chaos domain; -1 level) = 4th level; weapon attacks wielder or one of wielder’s allies within close range (determine randomly) when used.

sections.heading: Random Dispatcher, Hornung’sTM2
sections.text: Random Dispatcher, Hornung’sTM2: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (target: touch to close; +1 level) + Reach Spell (teleport: close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Variable Spell (no control over destination plane; -1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Restricted Spell (wild magic; -1 level) = 9th level; swift casting sends target to another plane.

sections.heading: Rapid JourneyRR
sections.text: Rapid JourneyRR: Teleport (5th level) + Still Spell (+0 levels with metamagic synergy) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 jump/3 levels; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 8th level; as personal teleport, but you return 1 rd./level after arrival, or otherwise make up to 1 jump/3 levels during that duration.

sections.heading: Rapture of the DeepSW
sections.text: Rapture of the DeepSW: Compel (be comatose; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as 6th); target grooves to sublime music and acts as if comatose while spell is maintained (350 x CL numen for duration past 1 hr./level); may drown if in water.

sections.heading: Ray of DizzinessSC
sections.text: Ray of DizzinessSC: Inertia (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to ray; +0 levels) = 3rd level; ranged touch attack staggers target for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Ray of EntropySC
sections.text: Ray of EntropySC: Ray of enfeeblement (1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 attribute/3 levels; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 5th level (listed as 6th); ranged touch imposes 1d6 +1/level (+15 max.) penalty to Str, Con, Dex (and Int at CL 12th, Wis at 15th, Cha at 18th).

sections.heading: Ray of FatigueS&M
sections.text: Ray of FatigueS&M: Touch of fatigue (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Ray of HopeBED
sections.text: Ray of HopeBED: Heorism (3rd level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd./level; -2 levels) = 2nd level (bard 1st).

sections.heading: Ray of the PythonPHII
sections.text: Ray of the PythonPHII: Slow (3rd level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; target entangled and staggered (save each round to end effect).

sections.heading: RazorscalesSK
sections.text: RazorscalesSK: Bestow feat (Improved Grapple; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Vital Strike; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; for 1 rd./level, you can constrict for 1d6 + 1½ Str modifier.

sections.heading: RebukeOA
sections.text: RebukeOA: Inertia (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 5th level (listed as 2nd); target is stunned 1 rd./level or until saves.

sections.heading: Rebuke DeathCRB
sections.text: Rebuke DeathCRB: Stabilize (1st level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Healing domain; -1 level) = 0 level; as stabilize, but healing is 1d6 +1/level (+5 max.), rather than a fixed 1d6.

sections.heading: Recall AgonySRD
sections.text: Recall AgonySRD: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (clairsentience; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; deals 5d6 necrotic damage (Intuition half).

sections.heading: Recall ChampionRR
sections.text: Recall ChampionRR: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 12; +7 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (area hallowed to your deity; -1 level) = 8th level; summons one CR 12 hero (it can leave the hallowed area after being summoned).

sections.heading: Recall DeathSRD
sections.text: Recall DeathSRD: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+4d4; +4 levels) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 level) + Cross-Class Spell (clairsentience; +1 level) = 8th level; deals up to 20d6 necrotic and 5d4 Con damage (Intuit half).

sections.heading: Recall TaleAUG2
sections.text: Recall TaleAUG2: Augury (2nd level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd.; +2 levels) + Variable Spell (gain random infotmation; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level; you gain 6-second story about an event in the history of the target item, creature, or place.

sections.heading: Recent OccupantAUG2
sections.text: Recent OccupantAUG2: Augury (2nd level) + Mass Effect Spell (2 questions; +2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 0); you learn name and race of last creature of Int 3 or higher within 20 ft. of location of casting.

sections.heading: Reciprocal GyreCA
sections.text: Reciprocal GyreCA: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Expedient Spell (special; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) = 5th level; target takes 1d6 force damage per level of active spell effects on it (max. 15d6, Will half) and is dazed 1 rd./level (Fort save each round to end dazing).

sections.heading: Reckless InfatuationUM
sections.text: Reckless InfatuationUM: Compel (be near creature specified; 2nd level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 3rd level; subject attempts to stay within 30 ft. of specified individual. Invest 900 x CL (3rd level x 50 x 6 for 1-rd. duration) numen to maintain as a curse.

sections.heading: Red TideSW
sections.text: Red TideSW: Topple (0 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Fell Sickening (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Str; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant or Pestilence domain; -1 level) = 8th level; 3d4 Str damage plus knocked prone and nauseated 1 rd./level (Fort half/neg./sickened) in 20’r.

sections.heading: ReddopsiSRD
sections.text: ReddopsiSRD: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (reverse back onto caster instead of dispelling; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (no check needed; +2 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Restricted Spell (kineticist; -1 level) = 8th level (listed as 7th); turns 1 spell/power targeting you per round.

sections.heading: Redemption from Evil PowerAUG2
sections.text: Redemption from Evil PowerAUG2: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (no check needed; +2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (death or negative energy spells only; -2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 7th); instantaneously negates the effects of one [death] or negative energy spell cast at target within close range.

sections.heading: Redemptive RedressAUG2
sections.text: Redemptive RedressAUG2: Warding (1st level) + Variable Spell (select spell at time of casting; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); suppresses 1 spell affecting target for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Redirect Spell
sections.text: Redirect Spell: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (redirect onto you instead of dispelling; -2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (no check needed; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 spell/3 levels; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (hostile spells targeting one ally only; -2 levels)  = 4th level (paladin 3rd); each round, up to 1 hostile spell/3 levels targeting the ally you indicate during casting is redirected to you instead.

sections.heading: Reduce WeightAUG
sections.text: Reduce WeightAUG: Reduce (3rd level) + Selective Spell (weight only, not size or Stength; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 0); reduces weight or one creature or object by a factor of 8 (weapon becomes light weapon).

sections.heading: Refine Improvised WeaponACG
sections.text: Refine Improvised WeaponACG: Bestow feat (Catch Off-Guard; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Item-Specific Spell (improvised weapon touched; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); improvised weapon is treated as manufactured one, with no non-proficiency penalty.

sections.heading: Refuge
sections.text: Refuge: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to planar; +6 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (to caster’s abode only; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (standard action trigger; +2 levels) = 7th level; subject activates as a standard action, teleporting to your abode. AKA succorUA1.

sections.heading: Refusal, von Gasik’sTM2
sections.text: Refusal, von Gasik’sTM2: Hedge (arcane casters; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (emanation to cubes; +0 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Widen Spell (5-ft. to 10-ft. cubes; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level; arcane casters barred from one 10-ft. cube/level area for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Regenerate
sections.text: Regenerate: Remove condition (use of limb; 1st level) + Crippling Drain (regrow parts permanently lost; +4 levels) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Augment Spell (moderate to critical; +2 levels) = 7th level; cures 1d6 hp/level (max. 20d6), removes temporary loss of limb or organ function, and even regrows lost body parts.

sections.heading: RegroupPHII
sections.text: RegroupPHII: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (targets; touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (all targets transported adjacent to you; -2 levels) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Reincarnate
sections.text: Reincarnate: Remove condition (death; 1st level) + Crippling Drain (+4 levels) + Cascade Spell (polymorph: humanoid or animal; +3 levels) + Variable Spell (random result for new body; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (−2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Ancestors or Animal domain; -1 level) = 4th level.

sections.heading: Reinforce CampsiteUW
sections.text: Reinforce CampsiteUW: Invisible needle (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Cascade Spell [(figment; +1 level) + Delay Spell (enters area; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (audible, no speech; -1 level)] + Cascade Spell (endure elements; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Cascade Spell (touch of fatigue; -1 level) + Augment Spell (exhausted; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 5d6; -3 levels) = 5th level (listed as 4th); 40’r. area sounds alarm if entered by intruder, deals 5d6 piercing plus entangled 1 rd./level to intruders, and designated campers within gain endure elements, for 1 hr./level (but caster becomes exhausted).

sections.heading: Reinforce ConstructME
sections.text: Reinforce ConstructME: Spark of life (1st) + Cross-Class Spell (arcane; +1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 hr./level; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (construct only; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; construct gains 1d6/level (max. 5d6) temp. hp.

sections.heading: Rejuvenation CocoonCD
sections.text: Rejuvenation CocoonCD: Spark of life (1st level) + Maximize Spell (+3 levels) + Cascade Spell (remove condition: afflictions; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (druid; -1 level) + Augment Spell (10d6 to 15d6; +1 level) + Augment Spell (moderate to serious; +1 level) = 5th level; heals subject 6/level (max. 90) damage and removes poison, disease.

sections.heading: Reloading HandsUC
sections.text: Reloading HandsUC: Creation (1st level) + Variable Spell (as needed for ammo; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (shaping; +2 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (mundane ammunition only; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (1/rd.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 rd./level; -3 levels) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) = 1st level; weapon reloads self once per round with conjured ammunition for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Relocate TownRR
sections.text: Relocate TownRR: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Widen Spell (10 lbs./level to 500 lbs./level; +5 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (buildings, etc. of village only; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (destination: close to line of sight; +3 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (within forest; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 7th level; teleports village (up to one small building/level) up to ¼ mi./level away within the same forest.

sections.heading: Remote View TrapSRD
sections.text: Remote View TrapSRD: Warding (scrying; 1st level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (electric arc; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (scryer only; -2 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 10d6; -2 levels) = 6th level; cloaks you from scrying, and first attempt deals 10d6 electricity damage to scryer (save half). AKA seer’s banePF102. Variants:

sections.heading: Remove AddictionBED
sections.text: Remove AddictionBED: Remove condition (addiction; 1st level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Remove FatigueBED
sections.text: Remove FatigueBED: Remove condition (debilitation; 1st level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 4th); touch reduces debilitation conditions (Chapter 7) by 1 step in up to 1 ally/3 levels. Variants:

sections.heading: Remove NauseaBED
sections.text: Remove NauseaBED: Remove condition (afflictions; 1st level) + Augment Spell (minor to serious; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (no disease or poison; -2 levels) = 1st level; touch removes sickened, ailing, nauseated, or prostrate condition from target.

sections.heading: Remove SicknessUM
sections.text: Remove SicknessUM: Warding (afflictions; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) = 5th level (listed as 1st); suppresses disease, sickness, nausea, poison, and prevents re-affliction. AKA Nezram’s amethyst auraLEF (listed as 3rd).

sections.heading: Rend the Sovereign SoulRR
sections.text: Rend the Sovereign SoulRR: Damage attribute (Wis; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (also Cha; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (saves only; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Augment Spell (+4d4; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (days to minutes; -2 levels) = 2nd level; target takes ­5d4/2 penalty to Intuition and Will saves (Will neg.) for 10 min./level. The penalties are reduced by 1 per 2 min. thereafter until gone. Multiple castings stack.

sections.heading: Renewed FocusRR
sections.text: Renewed FocusRR: Hand of fate (1st level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: (Dex; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (initiative only; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 2nd); swift casting allows you to reroll initiative with a +1 bonus.

sections.heading: Repair DamageSRD
sections.text: Repair DamageSRD: Spark of life (1st) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (construct only; -2 levels) = 2nd level; repairs 1d6 + 1/level (max. 5d6+5) hp to damaged construct.

sections.heading: Repair UndeadACG
sections.text: Repair UndeadACG: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Augment Spell (+1/level; +1 level) + Empower Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead; -2 levels) = 0 level (listed as 1st); touch heals one undead 1d8 + 1/level (+5 max.). Repair deadRR2 also incorporates the Mass Effect Spell feat (1/level; +3 levels) = 3rd level; repairs up to 10d8+10 hp to each damaged undead touched. Mass repair undeadACG (4th level; listed as 5th) is as repair deadRR2 but is usable at up to Medium range.

sections.heading: Repel Metal or Stone
sections.text: Repel Metal or Stone: Mage hand (0 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 27 lbs./level; +3 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (metal or stone objects only; -1 level) + Shape Spell (target to line; +1 level) + Extend Spell (concentration to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) = 7th level; repels all stone and metal within path, subject to weight limit (no save).

sections.heading: Repel Wood
sections.text: Repel Wood: Mage hand (0 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 8 lbs./level; +2 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (wooden objects only; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to line; +1 level) + Extend Spell (concentration to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) = 6th level; repels all wood within path, subject to weight limit (no save).

sections.heading: Replay TracksUW
sections.text: Replay TracksUW: Augury (2nd level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd.; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (events related to tracks you are following using Survival only; -2 levels) = 3rd level; with concentration, you can get a sense of events that occurred in conjunction with tracks/traces you are following.

sections.heading: ReprobationUM
sections.text: ReprobationUM: Warding (religious class features; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (arcane mark; +1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (member of caster’s religion; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (−2 levels) = 5th level; you mark a member of your faith as an apostate and remove his or her magical religious class features (divine spells, channeling, etc.). Invest personal numen to maintain effect (e.g., 5th level x CL 9th x 50 x 1 = 2,250).

sections.heading: Repulsion, EpicSRD
sections.text: Repulsion, EpicSRD: Hedge (2nd level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1,000’r.; +5 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 9th level (listed as epic); specified creature or creature type cannot approach within 1,000 ft. of warded creature, object, or location. Invest 450 x CL numen to maintain effect indefinitely.

sections.heading: Reshape ShadowRR
sections.text: Reshape ShadowRR: Figment (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (shadow only; -2 levels) = 0 level.

sections.heading: Resilient Sphere, Otiluke’s
sections.text: Resilient Sphere, Otiluke’s: Mage armor (0 level) + Variable Spell (cover; +1 level) + Augment Spell (total cover; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (sphere is immobile; ­2 levels) + Cascade Spell [(bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level)] + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Expedient Spell (1 ft./level size limit; -1 level) = 4th level; subject grappled inside sphere of force granting total cover and lasting 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Resinous SkinUC
sections.text: Resinous SkinUC: UnhandAUG2 (q.v.; 0 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; weapons striking you are disarmed from wielders (Reflex neg.), but you gain no DR or CMB/CMD bonuses.

sections.heading: Resinous TarCM
sections.text: Resinous TarCM: Bind (0 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) = 1st level; either object entangled with holder/user, or 10-ft. square entangles those entering it; total stickiness lasts 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Resist ColdPH1
sections.text: Resist ColdPH1: Warding (cold; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Expedient Spell (special; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); subject resists up to 3 hp/level (max. 30 hp) of natural and magical cold per round for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Resist Planar AlignmentPnH
sections.text: Resist Planar AlignmentPnH: Warding (attribute penalties; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (from planar alignment only; -2 levels) = 1st level; subject does not take attribute penalties from planar alignment traits.

sections.heading: Resist TouchAUG2
sections.text: Resist TouchAUG2: Enhancement (2nd level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (touch AC only; -2 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); subject gains +1/4 levels to touch AC.

sections.heading: Resistant TouchCRB
sections.text: Resistant TouchCRB: Resistance (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Protection domain; -1 level) = 0 level; partial-action touch grants +3 resistance to saves for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Resolve, Phieran’sBED
sections.text: Resolve, Phieran’sBED: Resistance (0 level) + Conscrate Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+5 total bonus; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (evil only; -2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell ([good] caster; -1 level) = 3rd level; 1 ally/level gains +5 sacred bonus to saves vs. evil spells or spells/SLAs cast by [evil] creatures for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Resonating AgonyCM
sections.text: Resonating AgonyCM: Sickening touch (0 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +3 levels) + Fell Sickening (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 6th level; touch deals 1d4 Con/rd. plus nausea for 1 rd./level (save for half/sickened).

sections.heading: Resonating BoltCA
sections.text: Resonating BoltCA: Sound lance (1st level) + Shape Spell (ray to line; +1 level) + Overwhelming Evocation (+1 level) = 3rd level (bard 2nd); up to 10d6 sonic damage in a line deals full damage to objects and ignores energy resistance, can potentially shatter barriers and continue.

sections.heading: Resonating ResistanceBVD
sections.text: Resonating ResistanceBVD: Bestow feat (Spell Penetration; 1st level) + Shielding Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; when others attempt to overcome your SR, they roll twice and use the lower result.

sections.heading: Restore Defenses (new)
sections.text: Restore Defenses (new): Bestow feat (Tenacious Spell; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Sudden Metamagic; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (suppression: 1 rd./level to inst.; +2 levels) = 4th level; immediate casting restores one or more personal spells when they are dispelled, subject to limits of Sudden Metamagic feat.

sections.heading: Restore StrengthS&M
sections.text: Restore StrengthS&M: Remove condition (Str damage; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level; removed penalty to Str and/or up to 2d4 Str damage (not drain).

sections.heading: Resurgent TransformationAPG
sections.text: Resurgent TransformationAPG: Haste (q.v.; 3rd level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (Str and Con; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 total; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Int; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Wis; -1 level) + Delay Spell (activates when heavily wounded; +1 level) = 5th level; when reduced to ¼ hp, you heal 15d6 hp, gain +4 Str and Con, are hasted 1 rd./level, and take 1d4 Int and Wis damage,

sections.heading: Resurrection, ContingentSRD
sections.text: Resurrection, ContingentSRD: Resurrection (q.v.; 7th level) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) = 8th level (listed as epic); if subject dies while spell is latent, is resurrected 1 minute later.

sections.heading: Resurrection, TemporaryUM
sections.text: Resurrection, TemporaryUM: Resurrection (q.v.; 7th level) + Cross-Class Spell (arcane; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (dies again after 1 hr./level; -1 level) = 7th level (6th for necromancers).

sections.heading: RetributionAPG
sections.text: RetributionAPG: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (ailing; +1 level) + Fell Sickening (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (victim must have attacked you in the previous round; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Inquisition domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; 1/round, you can spend a swift action to cause one attacker from the previous round to be ailing (Fort sickened).

sections.heading: Retributive ImageCM
sections.text: Retributive ImageCM: Figment (0 level) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (those disbelieving image; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 5th level; as major image, but viewers who successfully disbelieve (Intuition) take up to 15d6 nonlethal damage and are dazed 1 rd. (Will half/neg.).

sections.heading: RetrieveSRD
sections.text: RetrieveSRD: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Cascade Spell (mage hand; +1 level) + Reach Spell (object: touch to medium; +1 level) + Reach Spell (teleport: close to medium; +1 level) = 4th level (listed as 6th); teleports object (up to 10 lbs./level) into your hand (Will save if in another creature’s possession). Cf. apport objectOcA.

sections.heading: RetrocognitionOcA
sections.text: RetrocognitionOcA: Detection (emotional events; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (lingering aura: days to centuries; ad hoc +5 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (your current location only; -2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (ends if fail save vs. traumatic event, as overwhelming aura for detect evil; -1 level) = 3rd level; 1st round—presence/absence of significant events involving strong emotions, 2nd round—general type(s), 3rd round+—other information, stretching further back in time as you concentrate longer. Cf. sensitivity to psychic impressionsSRD.

sections.heading: Return to DormancyUW
sections.text: Return to DormancyUW: Compel (retreat from civilization; 2nd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (Colossal monster; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Tenacious Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 8th); forces Colossal monster saves vs. Will or retreat away from civilization (invest 200 x CL numen to maintain effect until creature attacked).

sections.heading: Returning WeaponUC
sections.text: Returning WeaponUC: Mage hand (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Delay Spell (after weapon thrown; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (multiple throws; +1 level) + Extend Spell (concentration to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (thrown weapon only; -2 levels) = 2nd level (1st level if weapon must be within close range to return).

sections.heading: Reveal True ShapePF19
sections.text: Reveal True ShapePF19: Glamer (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (detection: shapechanged or glamered; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (conc. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (glamer only as true form; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); detects creatures veiled by illusion or shapechanged; one of them is covered in a glamer of its true form (no tactile component) for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: RevelationTM2
sections.text: RevelationTM2: Variable Spell (+1 level: speak with monsters [6th level], true seeing, arcane sight, clairvoyance, discern lies, mindlink) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 9th level; each round, choose one of the above effects.

sections.heading: Reverse ArrowsMF
sections.text: Reverse ArrowsMF: Protection from arrows (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (invisible needle; +1 level) + Shielding Spell (when arrow damage negated; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (+15 to +10; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); negates 1d6+1/level (max. 10d6+10) total projectile damage, and missiles whose damage is negated appear to reverse course and strike the attacker (ranged touch required) for 1d6 +1/level (+10 max.) piercing. AKA arrow redirectionAUG2.

sections.heading: Reverse Gravity
sections.text: Reverse Gravity: Mage hand (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (concentration to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Widen Spell (individual mass: 1 lb./level to 216 lbs./level; +3 levels) = 7th level (divine/druid 8th with Cross-Class Spell).

sections.heading: Reverse IllusionRR
sections.text: Reverse IllusionRR: Glamer (1st level) + Shape Spell (emanation to cubes; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 6th); cloaks real things in glamer that makes them seem illusory (Intuition save with interaction or convinced they’re not real). Invest 2,000 x CL numen to maintain effect.

sections.heading: Revive OutsiderMP
sections.text: Revive OutsiderMP: Raise dead (5th level) + Cascade Spell (remove condition: rotting; +1 level) + Inexorable Spell (creature that cannot normally be raised; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (outsider; -2 levels) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) = 6th level; as raise dead, but affects one outsider of up to 10 HD, and condition of body is not an issue.

sections.heading: Rewire FleshSF
sections.text: Rewire FleshSF: Celerity (0 level) + Cascade Spell (invocation of the knife; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 slashing/rd., plus flat-footed and -40 ft. to speed, for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Ricochet ShotUC
sections.text: Ricochet ShotUC: Invisible needle (0 level) + Versatile Evocation (bludgeoning or slashing, if appropriate; +0 levels) + Channel Spell (originates from target of ammunition; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; each ricochet (up to 1/3 levels) requires a ranged attack roll and deals 1d6/level (max. 10d6; divine 5d6) of the appropriate type.

sections.heading: Ride the WavesUM
sections.text: Ride the WavesUM: Polymorph (3rd level) + Specific Spell (locathah-like aquatic form only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 4th level; subject gains swim speed of 60 ft., +2 Str, +2 natural armor, and water breathing. Variants:

sections.heading: Righteous AuraMH
sections.text: Righteous AuraMH: Light (0 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Cha; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 total; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Righteous BurstPHII
sections.text: Righteous BurstPHII: Spark of life (1st) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) = 6th level; allies healed 1d6/level, enemies take 1d6/level negative energy damage (max. 15d6).

sections.heading: Righteous ChargeRR2
sections.text: Righteous ChargeRR2: Bestow feat (1st level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 feat/3 levels; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (BAB +11 effects; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 5th level (Paladin 4th); you gain the Dodge feat, and can charge with a +40-ft. speed bonus, overrunning intervening opponents as attack actions and making attacks of opportunity against those you knock down or who try to avoid you. You also gain Skirmish at CL 9th (move twice speed during charge), Vital Strike at CL 12th (allowing you to trample those you overrun), Combat Reflexes at CL 15th (providing extra attacks of opportunity), and Spring Attack (change directions and provoke no AoO while charging) at CL 18th.

sections.heading: Righteous FuryMF
sections.text: Righteous FuryMF: Spark of life (1st level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 attribute/3 levels; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (barkskin; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 3rd level; you gain 1d6 temp. hp/level (max. 10d6), +1/4 levels to natural armor, +4 to Str and Con (and Dex at CL 9th, Cha at 12th, Wis at 15th, Int at 18th).

sections.heading: Righteous FuryMH
sections.text: Righteous FuryMH: Bestow feat (Mounted Combat; 1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (also Spirited Charge; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 1st level; for 1 rd./level, subject’s charge attacks deal double damage.

sections.heading: Righteous FuryPC
sections.text: Righteous FuryPC: Invisible needle (0 level) + Bane Spell (fixed: evil; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Insightful Strike; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (BAB +6 effects; +1 level) + Overwhelming Evocation (+1 level) + Restricted Spell ([good] caster; -1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 piercing (10d8 vs. evil) with Insight bonus to attack and damage, and ignores DR and hardness.

sections.heading: Righteous GlareBED
sections.text: Righteous GlareBED: Jet of flame (0 level) + Copnscrtae Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 7th level; damage cap 15d6 (half fire, half holy) plus panicked in 60’r. aura.

sections.heading: Righteous MightCRB
sections.text: Righteous MightCRB: Enlarge person (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (cleric; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (polymorph; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (augmented attribute boost: Con; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to  1 rd./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 5th level; you become Large (+4 Str, +4 Con, -2 Dex, +4 natural armor, and DR 5/evil or 5/good).

sections.heading: Righteous Wrath of the FaithfulCD
sections.text: Righteous Wrath of the FaithfulCD: Spark of life (1st level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (haste: q.v.; +3 levels) + Augment Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (worshipers of your deity; -2 levels) = 7th level; worshippers of your deity in 20’r. of you gain haste (with +3 net attack bonus), +1 sacred bonus to saves, and 15d6 temp. hp for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Ring of BladesCA
sections.text: Ring of BladesCA: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +4 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); damage cap 5d6 slashing/rd. to adjacent squares. Variants:

sections.heading: Ring of FireToB
sections.text: Ring of FireToB: Jet of flame (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 360’r.; +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level; damage cap 15d6 fire in 360’r.

sections.heading: Ring of HandsTM2
sections.text: Ring of HandsTM2: Magic circle agaist evil (3rd level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 1st level; multiple areas can be adjacent/overlap, to simulate cooperative casting.

sections.heading: Rising PhoenixToB
sections.text: Rising PhoenixToB: Mage hand (0 level) + Cascade Spell (jet of flame; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cylinder; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Concentration Spell (swift; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 5d6; -4 levels) = 6th level (listed as 8th); swift casting and allows you to levitate up to 20 ft./rd., with a 5’r. column of fire up to 25’ tall around and under you (5d6 fire, no SR), continue effect each round as a swift action.

sections.heading: Rite of WinterRR
sections.text: Rite of WinterRR: Ray of frost (0 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1 mile/level; +8 levels) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 1d6 and -110 ft. to -10 ft.; -5 levels) = 6th level; -10 ft. speed, difficult terrain, and 1d6 cold/day over large area, lasting until spring (requires investiture of 300 x CL numen).

sections.heading: River of WindAPG
sections.text: River of WindAPG: Whelm (0 level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to line; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Explosive Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 4th level; damage cap 5d6 plus knocks prone and carries outside area.

sections.heading: River WhipACG
sections.text: River WhipACG: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Bane Spell (fixed: fire; +0 levels) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Delay Spell (as used; +1 level) = 2nd level; you can make up to 1 ranged touch attack/level (max. 10) dealing 1d6 slashing each (1d8 vs. creatures with the [fire] subtype or descriptor).

sections.heading: Roar of the WavesSW
sections.text: Roar of the WavesSW: Alter senses (deafness; 1st level) + Fell Condition (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (frightened to shaken; -1 level) = 3rd level; 1 target/level is deafened 1 rd./level (Fort 1 rd.) and shaken for 1 rd./level (Will neg.).

sections.heading: Robe of HealingTM2
sections.text: Robe of HealingTM2: Spark of life (1st level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Selective Spell (+2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 9th level; you emanate healing aura (1 hp/level per rd.) to allies.

sections.heading: RockburstShS
sections.text: RockburstShS: Energy mace (0 level) + Energy Admixture (piercing; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 (divine 5d6), Reflex half.

sections.heading: Rock’s HandAUG
sections.text: Rock’s HandAUG: Summon (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 6 Large earth elemental; +3 levels) = 5th level (listed as 7th); summons Large earth elemental with Improved Overrun traded for Improved Grapple.

sections.heading: Rooftop StriderRD
sections.text: Rooftop StriderRD: Skill enhancement (Acrobatics; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Athletics; +1 level) = 1st level; +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to checks. Variants:

sections.heading: RopeweaveUW
sections.text: RopeweaveUW: Creation (rope; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Craft; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (shaping; +2 levels) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: RosemantlePGF
sections.text: RosemantlePGF: Resistance (0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+9 bonus; +4 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (see below; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1  level) + Restricted Spell (access to Good or Sun domain; -1 level) = 1st level; subject gains +9 sacred bonus to saves vs. afflictions, fear, and pain.

sections.heading: Roses of LifeAUG2
sections.text: Roses of LifeAUG2: Spark of life (1st level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Delay Spell (standard; +1 level) + Variable Spell (transfer to allies; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; −1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 4th level; 1 touch/level carries 5d6+5 positive energy (each can be used by you or donated for use as a standard action). Note numen cost for latent spell effects.

sections.heading: Rotting Curse of UrfestraBVD
sections.text: Rotting Curse of UrfestraBVD: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (rounds to hours; -2 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 3rd level; touch deals 1d4 Con/hr. for 1 hr./level, or indefinitely (until dies) if invest 150 x CL numen.

sections.heading: Rouse Undead SpiritAUG
sections.text: Rouse Undead SpiritAUG: Lesser animate dead (2nd level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (max. CR 10; +5 levels) + Ritual Spell (−2 levels) = 6th level; soul of a creature of up to CR 8 rises as a ghost.

sections.heading: Ruby AxeDHD
sections.text: Ruby AxeDHD: Enhancement (2nd level) + Item-Specific Spell (manufactured weapon; -2 levels) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +1/4; +1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); weapon gains +1/4 levels sacred bonus to attacks and damage.

sections.heading: Rune of DarknessRR
sections.text: Rune of DarknessRR: Gloom (0 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Delay Spell (proximity activating condition; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); when triggered, reduces ambient light by 2 steps for 1 hr./level. Note numen investiture for latent spells.

sections.heading: Rune of FireRR
sections.text: Rune of FireRR: Jet of flame (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +3 levels) + Delay Spell (proximity activating condition; +1 level) + Variable Spell (set lower damage or smaller area if desired; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6.

sections.heading: Rune of JandelayPF77
sections.text: Rune of JandelayPF77: Enervation (4th level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (chaotic; -2 levels) + Resistible Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (resist planar alignment; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (warding: terrain manipulation; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (protection from chaos; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (lawful caster or access to Rune domain; -1 level) = 9th level; emanation around rune acts as widened magic circle against chaos, wards against magical terrain manipulation and chaotic planar alignment, and [chaotic] creatures entering area take 1d4 temp. negative levels.

sections.heading: Rune of PoisonRR
sections.text: Rune of PoisonRR: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +3 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (proximity activating condition; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 4th level.

sections.heading: Rune of SeeingRR
sections.text: Rune of SeeingRR: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (higher senses; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 sense/3 levels; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +7 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (site of casting only; -2 level) + Tenuous Spell (sensor can be dispelled or destroyed; ­1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 7th level (listed as 3rd); you inscribe an invisible symbol, and for 1 hr./level thereafter you can use it as a crying sensor for all your senses.

sections.heading: Running Warrior, Tenser’sGA
sections.text: Running Warrior, Tenser’sGA: Ant haul (1st level) – Ritual Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Skirmish; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (+40 ft. to +20 ft.; -1 level) = 4th level; +20 ft. to tactical movement speed, doubles max. loads, and provides Skirmish feat.

sections.heading: Rushing WatersSC
sections.text: Rushing WatersSC: Push (0 level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to [water] bloodline, domain, etc.; -1 level) = 3rd level; bull rushes and trips in 20’r. area.

sections.heading: Rusted BladeCM
sections.text: Rusted BladeCM: Bestow feat (Unclean Strike; 1st level) + Augment Spell (BAB +6 effects; +2 levels) = 3rd level; for 1 rd./level, hits with affected weapon also inflict filth fever.

You take full damage, which may destroy your body.

Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteWhirlwind of teethBVD affects a 10’r. cylinder (+2 levels) at medium range (+3 levels), is Concentration rather than Extended (swift action; -1 level), and is Corrupt (+1 level) = 7th level; damage cap 15d6 (half slashing, half unholy) in 10’r., 50-ft.-tall cylinder you redirect each round as a swift action. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteWreath of BladesUC: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Cascade Spell (lesser versatile weaponAPG, q,v,; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Versatile Strike; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Concentration; +1 level) + Cascade Spell [(deflection; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1/6 levels; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2 to base bonus; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (vs. attacks of opportunity only; -2 levels)] + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level (listed as 5th); damage cap 10d6 slashing/rd. (bypasses DR/silver, and retains properties of focus weapon) to those within 5 ft. of you, and you gain +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Concentration checks and +4 (+1/6 levels) deflection vs. attacks of opportunity, for 1 rd./level.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Branch to branchCAd also Cascades celerity (brachiating speed; +1 level) and is Extended (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) and Personal (­1 level) = 2nd level; +1/2 levels (max. +5) to Acrobatics and Athletics checks, and +20 ft. to brachiating speed.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteShifter prowessRE is Personal (-1 level), Extended (+1 level), and Sudden (+0 levels) = 1st level; swift casting grants you +1/2 levels (max. +5) to Acrobatics and Athletics for 1 rd. Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (mass to horizontal wall and vertical ladder; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 5-ft. squares; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (glamer; +1 level) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +1 level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = +1 level; creates hidden hammock and ladder.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteShape Spell (mass to vertical wall; +1 level) = +1 level; creates vertical ladder, 10 ft./level tall.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteCascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Shape Spell (mass to horizontal wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 5-ft. squares; -1 level) = +1 level; creates tripline filling one 5-ft. square/level.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente

Dispel (0 level) + Irresistible Spell (no check needed; +2 levels) = +3 levels; dispels one spell effect.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteKnock (q.v.; 2nd level) – Effect-Specific Spell (+1 level) = +3 levels; dispels bind or lock spells, or destroys mundane bindings or locks.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteMage hand (0 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 27 lbs./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Disable Device; +1 level) = +3 levels; sets off mechanical trap targeted (+1/2 levels to discern mechanism, if applicable).Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteRemove condition (transmutation; 1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (arcane; +1 level) + Crippling Drain (permanent condition; +1 level) = +3 levels; removes transmutation effect of any severityMostra la descrizione di ogni componenteRemove condition (inertia; 1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (arcane; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (also [restraints]; +1 level) = +3 levels; removes [inertia] and/or [restraint] conditions of any severity.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteWarding (force; 1st level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) = +3 levels; opens hole up to 5 ft. in radius in a magical [force] effect.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
+ Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2 levels) = 7th level; has one of the effects listed.

sections.heading: Sacred BlazonRRE
sections.text: Sacred BlazonRRE: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (inure; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Augment Spell (+2 to +4; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 4th level; you gain +40 ft. to land speed, +4 enhancement to Str, and resistance 30 to fire and cold (and acid at CL 9th, electricity at 12th, sonic at 15th, negative energy at 18th).

sections.heading: Sacred BondAPG
sections.text: Sacred BondAPG: Bestow feat (Reach Spell; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Reach Spell; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (2 recipients; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (healing spells only; -2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (two recipients only; -2 levels) = 2nd level; you and target can cast healing spells on each other at greater range, subject to limits of Sudden Metamagic feat. Cf. holy channelRR.

sections.heading: Sacred HavenCD
sections.text: Sacred HavenCD: Deflection (0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell [(bestow feat: Alertness; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level)] + Cascade Spell [(greater statusBED, q.v.; +5 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels)] + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 4th level; subject gains Alertness feat and +2 sacred bonus to AC, and you can monitor its condition and heal it remotely.

sections.heading: Sacred JourneyRR
sections.text: Sacred JourneyRR: Enhancement (2nd level) + Variable Spell (smite, grace, or channel; +1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 2 hrs./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1/4 to +1/3; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); you gain a sacred bonus of +1/3 levels to smite attacks and damage, or to grace bonus to saves, or to DC and damage/healing with channeled energy (including lay on hands), for 2 hrs./level.

sections.heading: Sacred WeaponRR
sections.text: Sacred WeaponRR: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 3rd level; 1 ranged attack/round for 5d6 force plus deafens 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: SadismBVD
sections.text: SadismBVD: Blessing (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +5; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Expedient Spell (scales with damage dealt; -1 level) = 2nd level; for 1 min./level, you gain a profane bonus to attacks, damage, and saves equal to +1 per 10 hp damage you inflicted the round before (+5 max.).

sections.heading: Sadistic AngelBotD
sections.text: Sadistic AngelBotD: Bind (0 level) + Fell binding (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (invisible needle; +1 level) + Energy Admixture (fire; +0 levels) + Augment Spell (grappled; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (warding: extradimensional transport; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 10d6; -2 levels) = 6th level; those in area are grappled and take 5d6 piercing and 5d6 fire/rd. (Reflex 1 rd. and half), and cannot escape by teleportation, etc.

sections.heading: SadomasochismPC
sections.text: SadomasochismPC: Spook (0 level) + Shielding Spell (+2 levels) + Cascade Spell (hand of fate; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (damage; ­2 levels) + Cascade Spell (hand of fate; -1 level) = 4th level; you and those attacking you roll twice for damage and take the better result, but those hitting you in melee are shaken 1 rd./level (divide duration by number of hits).

sections.heading: Safe ClearingMF
sections.text: Safe ClearingMF: Compel (don’t attack; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger; -2 levels) = 3rd level; those in 20’r. of campfire or center of camp must save vs. Will or be unable to attack.

sections.heading: Safe SearchAUG2
sections.text: Safe SearchAUG2: Warding (traps; 1st level) + Irresistible Spell (affects nonmagic traps; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Resitricted Spell (rogue skill trick; -1 level) = 1st level; for 1 rd./level, you do not set off traps and are not affected by those that are set off.

sections.heading: SafeguardingTM2
sections.text: SafeguardingTM2: Warding (your own spells; 1st level) + Variable Spell (you choose which spells are affected; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) = 4th level; those within 20 ft. of you (allies and enemies alike) are warded against the effects of your spells.

sections.heading: SafekeepingPC
sections.text: SafekeepingPC: Deflection (0 level) + Insightful Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) = 0 level; touch grants +2 insight bonus to AC for 1 rd.

sections.heading: SafetyMP
sections.text: SafetyMP: Detection (shelter from planar conditions; 2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (planar conditions only, not creatures, traps, other conditions, etc.; -2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard to swift; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to line of sight; +3 levels) = 5th level (ranger 3rd); indicates shortest and most direct route.

sections.heading: Salamander ChargeToB
sections.text: Salamander ChargeToB: Bestow feat (Dodge; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Acrobatics; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (also Spring Attack; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Cascade Spell [(jet of flame; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to cubes; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (along your path of movement; -2 levels)] + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 10d6; -2 levels) = 7th level; swift casting allows you to charge (as with Dodge and Spring Attack feats, and +1/2 levels to Acrobatics to avoid AoOs and bypass difficult terrain), leaving up to one 10-ft. cube/level of fire in your wake (damage 10d6/rd., no SR, and the cubes last 1 rd./level).

sections.heading: SampleAUG2
sections.text: SampleAUG2: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reach Spell (target: touch to close; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Widen Spell (50 lbs. to 6 lbs.; -1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (into pre-prepared container; -2 levels) = 0 level; transports up to 6 lbs. into a pre-prepared lead or glass container.

sections.heading: Sanctify ArmorAPG
sections.text: Sanctify ArmorAPG: Enhancement (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (inure: bludgeoning; +1 level) + Energy Admixture Spell (piercing and slashing; +0 levels) + Item-Specific Spell (suit of armor; -2 levels) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Good or Inquisition domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; suit of armor sacred bonus to AC and grants DR as follows:

sections.heading: Sanctify CorpseUM
sections.text: Sanctify CorpseUM: Warding (animate dead; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (corpse; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 1st level; corpse cannot become undead for 1 hr./level. Variants:

sections.heading: Sanctify WaterSW
sections.text: Sanctify WaterSW: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead or evil outsider; -1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd/level; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (in body of water at least waist-deep; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (able to channel positive energy; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (5d6 to 1d6; -1 level) = 1st level; 20’r. area of water deals 1d6 damage (half force, half holy) per round to undead and evil outsiders.

sections.heading: Sanctuary
sections.text: Sanctuary: Compel (don’t attack; 2nd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (warded target only; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 1st level; for 1 rd./level, those within 10 ft. of target must save vs. Will to attack it. Variants:

sections.heading: SandblastCD
sections.text: SandblastCD: Jet of flame (0 level) + Merciful Spell (+0 levels) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) + Widen Spell (30 ft. to 15 ft.; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Desert domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (5d6 to 1d6; -1 level) = 1st level; 15-ft. cone deals 1d6 nonlethal heat and dazes 1 rd. (Fort half/neg.).

sections.heading: SandstormSSt
sections.text: SandstormSSt: Control winds (6th level) + Cascade Spell (wisp; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Desert domain; -1 level) = 6th level; you control winds (up to windstorm speed) in 40’r.; suspended sand and dust obstructs vision.

sections.heading: Sap StrengthBVD
sections.text: Sap StrengthBVD: Touch of fatigue (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (exhaust; +1 level) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Sap StrengthRR2
sections.text: Sap StrengthRR2: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Con; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2 to +4; +1 level) + Insightful Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Str; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (all effects end if either you or victim reduced to 0 hp or below; -1 level) = 5th level; touch deals 1d4 Str and Con damage, and you gain +4 insight bonus to Str and Con for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Savage MawARG
sections.text: Savage MawARG: Polymorph (animal; 3rd level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Bluff; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell ([orc] caster; -1 level) = 2nd level; you gain a bite attack and +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Bluff for 1 min./level. Swap +2 Str and natural armor from polymorph for Bleeding Strike.

sections.heading: Saving GraceAUG
sections.text: Saving GraceAUG: Resistance (0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 0 level; you gain a +1 sacred bonus to saves for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Saving FinaleAPG
sections.text: Saving FinaleAPG: Hand of fate (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (affected by your bardic inspiration; -2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (saving throw only; -2 levels) = 1st level; immediate casting allows an ally affected by one of your inspirations to reroll one save.

sections.heading: ScamperUW
sections.text: ScamperUW: Skill enhancement (Acrobatics; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (animal companion, etc.; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level; swift casting grants your animal companion, familiar, etc. +1/2 levels to Acrobatics and +20 ft. speed when moving using Acrobatics. Cf. accelerated movementCAd.

sections.heading: ScarifyPC
sections.text: ScarifyPC: Spark of life (1st level) + Augment Spell (+1/level; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (whelm; -1 level) = 1st level; subject heals 1d6+1 hp but takes 1d6 nonlethal damage.

sections.heading: Scattering TrapPHII
sections.text: Scattering TrapPHII: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 5-ft.; -1 level) + Delay Spell (square stepped on; +1 level) + Variable Spell (random destinations not under caster’s control; -1 level) = 3rd level; when triggered, teleports those in area to random destinations within close range. Numen cost for latent spells applies.

sections.heading: ScentCD
sections.text: ScentCD: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (smell; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 3rd level; subject gains scent ability. Variants:

sections.heading: Scent Mask, Drawmij’sGA
sections.text: Scent Mask, Drawmij’sGA: Glamer (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (olfactory only; -1 level) = 2nd level; masks scent. Variants:

sections.heading: Scent TrailAPG
sections.text: Scent TrailAPG: Skill enhancement (Survival; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (message; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Animal or Travel domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; those you specify are +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to track you, and you can leave simple messages.

sections.heading: SchismSRD
sections.text: SchismSRD: Bestow feat (Quicken Spell; 1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (telepathy; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Sudden Metamagic; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) = 4th level; during the next 1 rd./level, you can cast up to one spell/3 levels that is automatically Quickened, as by the Sudden Metamagic feat (limits to total spell level, etc. apply). Variants:

sections.heading: Scorpion TailRE
sections.text: Scorpion TailRE: Invisible needle (0 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (drow caster; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level; you gain secondary sting attack (as a swift action) for 5d6 piercing plus Fort or stunned 1 rd.

sections.heading: Scramble PortalMP
