sections.text: Scramble PortalMP: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (change destination instead of suppressing; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (planar travel; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Variable Spell (no control over destination; -1 level) = 1st level (listed as 4th); those passing through planar portal arrive on random plane, rather than intended one.

sections.heading: ScreamAUG
sections.text: ScreamAUG: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (sound lance; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6 plus 1d4 Con (Fort half/neg.).

sections.heading: Screen
sections.text: Screen: Figment (0 level) + Cascade Spell (glamer; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (emanation to cubes; +0 levels) + Widen Spell (10 ft. to 30 ft. cubes; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 8th level; conceals actual events in area with illusory ones for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Scry BlastAUG2
sections.text: Scry BlastAUG2: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +7 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (through scrying sensor; -2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (ends scrying; -1 level) = 6th level; damage cap 20d6 force (Reflex half) delivered through scrying sensor.

sections.heading: Scry LocationCSc
sections.text: Scry LocationCSc: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision and hearing; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to planar; +5 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (sensor can be dispelled or destroyed; −1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 6th). You gain the ability to see and hear what goes on at one specific location at any distance on the same plane.

sections.heading: Scry ReverseAUG2
sections.text: Scry ReverseAUG2: Scrying (4th level) – Ritual Spell (+2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (scryer; -2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 5th); you can also scry on any creature scrying on you.

sections.heading: ScrytalkAUG2
sections.text: ScrytalkAUG2: MindlinkSRD (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +7 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (through scrying sensor; -2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (with creature scried only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); establish 2-way communication with creature scried.

sections.heading: Sculpt Sound
sections.text: Sculpt Sound: Glamer (1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature or object/level; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (no tactile, olfactory, visual; -3 levels) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Sea of DustUW
sections.text: Sea of DustUW: Jet of flame (0 level) + Cascade Spell (transmute; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1 mi.; +6 levels) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Desert domain; -1 level) = 9th level; heat damage cap 20d6/day (approx. 1d6/hour), dries up water, creates difficult terrain (sand/silt), etc. in 1-mile radius. Invest 450 x CL numen to maintain effect.

sections.heading: Seal PortalMP
sections.text: Seal PortalMP: Warding (planar travel; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Item-Specific Spell (planar portal; -2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 6th); seals off planar portal. Invest 250 x CL numen to maintain indefinitely.

sections.heading: Sealed Door, GreaterAUG
sections.text: Sealed Door, GreaterAUG: Shaping (2nd level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 8 cu. ft./level; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (touch of adamantineBED; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (spell resistance; +5 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (door or portal; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 8th level (listed as 5th); door of up to 8 cu. ft./level seals into surrounding walls, gains hardness and hp of adamantine, and gains SR; can be unsealed for 1 rd. by designated creature(s) by password. Invest 400 x CL numen to maintain (as latent spell).

sections.heading: SeamantleAPG
sections.text: SeamantleAPG: Mage armor (1st level) + Variable Spell (shield bonus; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 to +8; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (celerity: swim speed; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (dispel magic; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (fire spells only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (energy mace; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) = 7th level; you swim at 35 ft., have +8 cover bonus to AC, dispel fire magic, and attack once/round (ranged touch) for 1d6 bludgeoning/level (max. 20d6).

sections.heading: Searing Light
sections.text: Searing Light: Jet of flame (0 level) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Positive Spell (+0 levels) = 3rd level; damage cap 5d6, or 15d6 vs. undead, molds, oozes, etc. (half fire, half holy). Variants:

sections.heading: Sebaceous TwinPF119
sections.text: Sebaceous TwinPF119: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 3rd level; half-formed parasitic twin deals 1d4 Con/rd. for 1 rd./level, and the victim is sickened (Fort half/neg.).

sections.heading: SeclusionTM2
sections.text: SeclusionTM2: Dimensional pocket (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Variable Spell (opening can be mobile with caster, immobile in space, or both; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 27 lbs./level; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 6th); willing or helpless subject can be hidden in extradimensional space.

sections.heading: Second ChanceSRD
sections.text: Second ChanceSRD: Hand of fate (0 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 roll/level; +4 levels) + Delay Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (seer or access to Fate domain; -1 level) = 6th level (listed as 5th); you can reroll up to 1 roll/level, each as an immediate action.

sections.heading: Second WindBED
sections.text: Second WindBED: Skill enhancement (Endurance; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) = 3rd level (paladin 1st); subject +1/2 levels to Endurance checks and +30 ft. to land speed. Variants:

sections.heading: Secret Chest, Leomund’s
sections.text: Secret Chest, Leomund’s: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Widen Spell (10 lbs./level to 270 lbs./level; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (ethereal plane; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (1 hour; -2 levels) = 6th level (listed as 5th). Invest 11,880 numen (6th level x CL 11th x 900 for command-word activation to return chest x 1/5 for single return) while chest is ethereal.

sections.heading: Secret Page
sections.text: Secret Page: Glamer (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Variable Spell (disguise and undisguised page at will; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Allows Spell Switching (ad hoc +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Reduce Spell (visual only; -1 level) = 3rd level, but requires 150 x CL numen investiture if lasts more than 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Secret SignsCA
sections.text: Secret SignsCA: Mindlink (1st level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 round; -2 levels) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Secure CorpseBED
sections.text: Secure CorpseBED: Dimensional pocket (1st level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 27 lbs./level; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (gentle repose; +2 levels) = 6th level; corpse is transferred to extradimensional pocket, where it is in stasis; invest numen (as for a latent spell) to maintain effect beyond 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Secure Shelter, Leomund’s
sections.text: Secure Shelter, Leomund’s: Creation (wood, sod, or stone; 1st level) + Variable Spell (other building materials; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (shaping; +2 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (cottage only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 2 hrs./level; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 216 cu. ft./level.; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (arcane lock; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (alarm; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (unseen servant; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (arcane lock only on door and shutters, alarm only on door, shutter, chimney; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 4th); creates 20-ft. square x 10-ft.-tall cottage with walls 3 inches/2 levels thick, door and shutter arcane locked and warded by alarm. Craft (construction) check needed to shape cottage; spell provides no bonus.

sections.heading: Seed of UndeathCM
sections.text: Seed of UndeathCM: Lesser animate dead (2nd level) + Augment Spell (CR 2; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (until dies; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; subject rises as zombie (max. CR 2) 1 rd. after dying (you must invest 200 x CL numen to maintain the latent effect). Variants:

sections.heading: Seek the SoullessAUG
sections.text: Seek the SoullessAUG: Jet of flame (0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) + Widen Spell (30 ft. to 60 ft.; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 3rd); 5d6 fire and 5d6 holy damage (no SR) vs. selected targets in cone (usu. constructs, fey, outsiders, plants, undead).

sections.heading: Seek ThoughtsAPG
sections.text: Seek ThoughtsAPG: Detection (thought; 2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (thoughts about specific topic only; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (cone to emanation; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard to swift; +1 level) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: SeekerAUG
sections.text: SeekerAUG: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 0 level; swift action grants you +2 to attacks and damage that round.

sections.heading: Seeming of FormAUG2
sections.text: Seeming of FormAUG2: Glamer (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); object appears as different object to all senses, including tactile.

sections.heading: Seething EyebaneBVD
sections.text: Seething EyebaneBVD: Acid splash (0 level) + Splash Evocation (+0 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Blinding Strike; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (BAB +16 effects; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); touch deals up to 10d6 acid plus permanently blinds (Fort half/dazzled 16 rds.), and 1 hp splash damage in 5’r. Caster takes 1d4 Con damage. Variants:

sections.heading: Semblance of LifeME
sections.text: Semblance of LifeME: Spark of life (1st level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Threnodic Spell (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Lingering Evocation (+2 levels) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 5d6; -3 levels) = 6th level; undead in 20’r. take 5d6 positive energy plus 4d6/rd., and are dazed 1 rd.

sections.heading: Sending, MirrorBVD
sections.text: Sending, MirrorBVD: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (figment; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (subject must be looking into a mirror; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 4th level. You gain the ability to observe one creature (and 10’r. around it) through a mirror, and an illusion of you in the mirror can relay a brief message.

sections.heading: Sending, FalseBVD
sections.text: Sending, FalseBVD: Sending (q.v.; 4th level) + Cascade Spell (glamer; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Perform; +1 level) = 6th level; as sending, but you are disguised as and impersonate another creature with +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to your Perform (acting) check.

sections.heading: Sending, ThoughtwaveTM2
sections.text: Sending, ThoughtwaveTM2: Mindlink (1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (+1 to 1/level; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to planar; +5 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Community or Mind domain; -1 level) = 6th level (listed as 5th); as a swift action, you send an instantaneous message (your location and mental state) to up to 1 creature/level on the same plane.

sections.heading: Sense DangerME
sections.text: Sense DangerME: Bestow feat (Alterness; 1st level) + Augment Spell (Perception 16 ranks effects; +4 levels) + Cascade Spell [(bestow feat: Quicken Spell; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Interrupting Spell; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Sudden Metamagic; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (see below; -2 levels)] + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 7th level (listed as 3rd), you gain uncanny dodge, can act during surprise rounds, can automatically Quicken one or more spells during surprise round (or first round of encounter, if no surprise round).

sections.heading: Sense FearHA
sections.text: Sense FearHA: Detection (fear; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (cone to emanation; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Extend Spell (conc. to 10 min./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level (listed as 2nd); presence, number, location and intensity for each affected creature.

sections.heading: Sense LinkSRD
sections.text: Sense LinkSRD: Alter senses (0 level) + Variable Spell (choose sense at time of casting; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (targeted creature; -2 levels) = 1st level; with concentration, you can see, hear, smell, or taste (choose one at time of casting) what target does, at up to Medium range. Variants:

sections.heading: Sernse the UnwantedRR
sections.text: Sernse the UnwantedRR: Scrying (4th level) + Augment Spell (vision and hearing; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (can only scry into a forest; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); you can scry into forest (audio and visual effects) for as long as you concentrate, redirecting area viewed, +1 rd./level (static location) thereafter.

sections.heading: Sense WeaknessME
sections.text: Sense WeaknessME: Bestow feat (Improved Critical; 1st level) + Augment Spell (BAB +11 effects; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (confirmation only; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 2nd); as  swift action, subject can auto-confirm crit threat rolled (and possibly others, for 1 rd).

sections.heading: Sense Weakness, SuddenME
sections.text: Sense Weakness, SuddenME: Bestow feat (Improved Critical; 1st level) + Augment Spell (BAB +11 effects; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (confirmation only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 2nd level; as a swift action, you can auto-confirm crit threat rolled (and possibly others).

sections.heading: Sensitivity to Psychic ImpressionsSRD
sections.text: Sensitivity to Psychic ImpressionsSRD: Detection (lingering thoughts/memories; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (aura lingering time: days to years; ad hoc +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to clairsentience discipline; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); 1st round—presence/absence of significant events involving strong emotions, 2nd round—general type(s), 3rd round—hazy vision of event begins, lasts as long as event did with continued concentration. Variants:

sections.heading: Sepia Snake Sigil
sections.text: Sepia Snake Sigil: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +3 levels) + Delay Spell (until text read; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level; 4d4 Dex damage (Reflex half, paralyzed at 0). Note the numen investiture cost for latent spells.

sections.heading: Sequester
sections.text: Sequester: Warding (divinations; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (glamer; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (time hopSRD; +4 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 6th level; subject cannot act, is undetectable by divinations and sight.

sections.heading: SerenityUM
sections.text: SerenityUM: Whelm (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 crt./level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (attempting harm; -2 levels) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6. Affected creatures take 1d6 nonlethal/level (max. 10d6, Will half) during any round in which they attempt to harm another creature.

sections.heading: Serpent MuseBotD
sections.text: Serpent MuseBotD: Slow (q.v.; 3rd level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Scalykind domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 5th level; one target/level takes 10d6 necrotic damage and is slowed 1 rd./level (Fort half/neg.).

sections.heading: Serpent’s StareRR2
sections.text: Serpent’s StareRR2: Compel (do nothing; 2nd level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Pattern Spell (gaze; -1 level) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) = 2nd level; one creature of up to 6 HD is dazed while you concentrate, as long as it can see you.

sections.heading: Sessile SpiritOcA
sections.text: Sessile SpiritOcA: Hedge (possessing spirits; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (emanation to target; -1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) = 3rd level; neutralizes spirit(s) inihabiting or possessing one creature or object for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Sevant HordeOA
sections.text: Sevant HordeOA: Unseen servant (1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +4 levels) = 5th level.

sections.heading: Seven-EyesS&M
sections.text: Seven-EyesS&M: See invisibility (q.v.; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd./level; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell [(bestow feat: Alertness; 1st level) + Augment Spell (8 ranks effects; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (impr. uncanny dodge; -2 levels)] + Cascade Spell (warding: enchantment; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (warding: death effects; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Cascade Spell [(inure; +1 level) + Variable Spell (1st energy type affected by; +1 level)] + Variable Spell (1 attack/rd.):

sections.heading: SeverRR
sections.text: SeverRR: Ray of obliviousness (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (also Cha; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+15 to +20; +1 level) = 5th level (listed as 7th); 1d6+1/level (+20 max.; Intuition half) penalty to Wis and Cha (may prevent casting of divine spells, channeling, etc.) while you concentrate and 1 rd./level thereafter.

sections.heading: Sever SpiritUW
sections.text: Sever SpiritUW: Dispel (0 level) + Cascade Spell (compel; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (familiar or companion bond; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (extended sickening touch; -2 levels) = 6th level; ritual breaks bond with familiar, animal companion, bonded item, etc., which then hates its former master (if alive). Caster is sickened 1 hr./level, can invest 300 x CL numen to make curse permanent (master can gain another bonded companion, however). Cf. unbondMW.

sections.heading: Shade’s SightRR
sections.text: Shade’s SightRR: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (see out of contiguous shadows only; -2 levels) = 1st level; subject can see out of shadows within Close range as if standing in them. Cf. Lorloveim’s creeping shadowTM2.

sections.heading: Shadow BindingCA
sections.text: Shadow BindingCA: Bind (0 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Shadow Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; 10’r. burst dazes 1 rd. and entangles 1 rd./level. (20% real if disbelieved).

sections.heading: Shadow Blade TechniqueToB
sections.text: Shadow Blade TechniqueToB: Hand of fate (0 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level): Selective Spell (+1 level) or Cascade Spell (channeled ray of frost; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (attack roll; ­2 levels) = 1st level; roll attack roll twice, and either use the higher roll, or use the lower roll and deal +1d6 cold/level (+5d6 max.).

sections.heading: Shadow BoltDr181
sections.text: Shadow BoltDr181: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shadow Spell (evocation; +0 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); damage cap 10d6 budgeoning plus knocked prone; 10% real if disbelieved.

sections.heading: Shadow Bolt, Dar’Tan’sRR
sections.text: Shadow Bolt, Dar’Tan’sRR: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard action; +1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 negative energy (Fort half) to 1 target/rd. while you concentrate.

sections.heading: Shadow CacheMP
sections.text: Shadow CacheMP: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Widen Spell (10 lbs./level to 80 lbs./level; +2 levels) + Item-Specific Spell (nonliving objects only; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (Plane of Shadow; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Tenacious Spell (+1 level) + Tenuous Spell (item goes missing 10%/day; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd). Invest 5,040 numen (4th level x CL 7th x 900 for command-word activation to return item x 1/5 for single return) while item is stashed, or until it is lost; you can immediately re-invest the numen, without the need to cast the spell again, if you choose to resend it.

sections.heading: Shadow CanopyRF
sections.text: Shadow CanopyRF: Gloom (0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Shadow ChainsRR2
sections.text: Shadow ChainsRR2: Bind (0 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 7th level (listed as 4th); up to 1 creature/3 levels are treated as if grappling one another for up to 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Shadow Conjuration
sections.text: Shadow Conjuration: Bestow feat (Magical Talent; 1st level) + Variable Spell (choose spell at time of casting; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Quicken Spell; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow spell: Sudden Metamagic; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Shadow Spell (­1 level) = 4th level; swift casting allows you to immediately cast any [creation] or [summoning] spell of a level you can normally cast (likewise quickened if spell level is within the Sudden Metamagic limits), but created object(s) or summoned creature(s) are only 30% real.

sections.heading: Shadow DoorPH1
sections.text: Shadow DoorPH1: Glamer (1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Stealth; +1 level) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (figment; +1 level) + Variable Spell (scripted; +1 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) = 5th level; you become invisible 1 rd./level, and leave behind illusion of you stepping through a door that suddenly appears (illusion of empty 10 ft. x 10 ft. room beyond).

sections.heading: Shadow EnginesTM2
sections.text: Shadow EnginesTM2: Energy mace (0 level) + Variable Spell (versatile evocation; +1 level) + Splash Evocation (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Shadow Spell (+0 levels) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 7th); up to four quasi-real (40%) siege engines deal 17d6 total/rd. with ranged rouch attacks (divide damage among attacks), plus 5 splash damage to adjacent squares, while you concentrate.

sections.heading: Shadow Evocation
sections.text: Shadow Evocation: Shadow conjuration (q.v.; 4th level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) = 5th level; effects are 40% real.

sections.heading: Shadow FormCAd
sections.text: Shadow FormCAd: Skill enhancement (Escape Artist; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Stealth; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (blur; +2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 5th); subject gains concealment, +1/2 levels to Escape Artist and Stealth checks for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Shadow GarroteToB
sections.text: Shadow GarroteToB: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); ranged touch deals up to 5d6 negative energy plus flat-footed 1 rd. Shadow nooseToB is Augmented (stunning; +3 levels) and Creature-Specific (flat-footed; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 6th); damage cap 10d6 plus stunned 1 rd.

sections.heading: Shadow HandDr181
sections.text: Shadow HandDr181: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift; +3 levels) + Shadow Spell (­1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 15d6 and 70’ to 50’; ­1 level)  = 5th level; damage cap 20d6 force plus -50 ft. to speed (both divided among ranged touch attacks), and effects only 40% real if disbelieved.

sections.heading: Shadow InvasionPnA
sections.text: Shadow InvasionPnA: Enhancement (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (effects of disbelieved Shadow spells; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (gloom; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (summon; +1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 6 kyton; +3 levels) + Kindred Summon (40%; -3 levels) = 4th level; for 1 rd./level, 20’r. area has decreased illumination (2 steps), enhanced effects of Shadow Spells (+5%/4 levels), and a kyton has a 40% chance of stepping through.

sections.heading: Shadow of DenevRR2
sections.text: Shadow of DenevRR2: Metaphysical feat (Ritual Spell; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (arcane spells only; -1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (+2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (druid or access to Time domain; -1 level) = 5th level; increases casting times of arcane spells in mobile 40’r.

sections.heading: Shadow ShieldRR
sections.text: Shadow ShieldRR: Gloom (0 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Cascade Spell [(alter senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (visual; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels)] + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (onset: inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; you are shrouded in darkness (2 steps), and those within 5 ft. panicked and blinded while within and 1 rd./level thereafter (Will/Fort neg.).

sections.heading: Shadow SkeletonDr181
sections.text: Shadow SkeletonDr181: Summon (1st level) + Summon Undead (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (warding: positive energy; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (warding: fire; +1 level) + Augment Spell (1d4+1; +1 level) + Shadow Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; conjures 1d4+1 human skeletons (30% real if disbelieved) that are immune to cold, magical fire, and positive energy.

sections.heading: Shadow SmashRR
sections.text: Shadow SmashRR: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (target: touch to close; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (Plane of Shadow; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (change of lighting; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level; transports object to Plane of Shadow if exposed to full light or darkness.

sections.heading: Shadow SpraySC
sections.text: Shadow SpraySC: Damage attribute (Str; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze;+2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Shadow Spell (-1 level) = 4th level (listed as 2nd); 1d4 Dex damage and dazed 1 round (Fort half/neg.; 30% real if disbelieved) in 5’r. burst.

sections.heading: Shadow StepUM
sections.text: Shadow StepUM: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (between areas of darkness or dim light only; -1 level) = 0 level (listed as 4th).

sections.heading: Shadow StrikeRR
sections.text: Shadow StrikeRR: Bestow feat (Unstoppable Strike; 1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (also Fell Shot; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (vs. single target; -2 levels) = 3rd level; attacks from within 20 ft. of target are against its touch AC for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Shadow VeilCM
sections.text: Shadow VeilCM: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) = 0 level; target within Close range is blinded 1 rd. (Intuition neg.).

sections.heading: Shadow Walk
sections.text: Shadow Walk: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Shadow WeaponUM
sections.text: Shadow WeaponUM: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Variable Spell (Versatile Evocation: piercing or bludgeoning; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Shadow Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 1d6; -2 levels) = 1st level; you can make up to 2 iterative melee touch attacks with semi-real melee weapon (1d6 damage each, and 1 hp damage on a successful Intuition disbelief save). Variants:

sections.heading: Shadow WellMF
sections.text: Shadow WellMF: Spook (0 level) + Augment Spell (shaken to cowering; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (also 1 rd./level frightened; +1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; the subject is not actually pulled into the Plane of Shadow; it’s just an illusion, so it cowers 1 rd./level and is then frightened for an additional 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Shadow, Enkili’sRR2
sections.text: Shadow, Enkili’sRR2: Skill enhancement (Stealth; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +3; +1 level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell ([chaotic]; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); you gain +3 profane bonus to saves and +1/2 levels to Stealth for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: ShadowcatTM2
sections.text: ShadowcatTM2: Lorloveim’s creeping shadowTM (q.v., 3rd level) + Reach Spell (medium to long; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Variable Spell (“toggle” senses back and forth at will; +1 level) = 7th level.

sections.heading: ShadowfadeMP
sections.text: ShadowfadeMP: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Variable Spell (bi-directional; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (Plane of Shadow; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 2.5-ft. squares; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as 5th); you open a temporary gate to the Plane of Shadow.

sections.heading: Shambler
sections.text: Shambler: Summon (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 6; +3 levels) + Augment Spell (1d4+1; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 9th level; summons 1d4+1 shambling mounds. Maintaining the effect past 1 hr./level requires either control of the shamblers through mark of the wild or else investiture of sufficient numen (9th x CL 17th x 500 x 1 = 76,500 if on guard duty, or 153,000 if actively marauding).

sections.heading: Shape ElementAUG
sections.text: Shape ElementAUG: Shaping (2nd level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 5,832 cu. ft./level; +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; ­1 level) = 6th level.

sections.heading: Shape of the Hellspawned StalkerCM
sections.text: Shape of the Hellspawned StalkerCM: Polymorph (3rd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (hellhound only; -2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+4 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; swift casting turns you into a hellhound (+2 Str, +2 natural armor, low-light vision, scent, resist fire 5, limited to 1 use of breath weapon) for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Shapechanger’s GiftUW
sections.text: Shapechanger’s GiftUW: Polymorph (3rd level) + Variable Spell (animal, humanoid, or monstrous humanoid; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost; -1 level) = 5th level; subject becomes Small or Medium animal, humanoid, or monstrous humanoid with no attribute bonus, can change form each round as a standard action (otherwise active 10 min./level).

sections.heading: Shapechanger’s Gift, GreaterUW
sections.text: Shapechanger’s Gift, GreaterUW: Shapechanger’s giftUW (q.v.; 5th level) + Cascade Spell (enlarge/reduce self; +1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 hr./level; +1 level) = 7th level; Tiny to Large animal, elemental, fey, humanoid, monstrous humanoid, and/or vermin.

sections.heading: Shard of ChaosUM
sections.text: Shard of ChaosUM: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Bane Spell (fixed: [lawful]; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (staggering; +1 level) + Restricted Spell ([chaotic] caster; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6 entropic (5d8 vs. lawful) plus staggered 1 rd.

sections.heading: Share MemoryUM
sections.text: Share MemoryUM: MindlinkSRD (1st level) + Augment Spell (memories, not just thoughts; ad hoc +2 levels) Extend Spell (1 min./level to inst.; -2 levels) = 1st level. AKA mindlinkOcA.

sections.heading: Shared HealingME
sections.text: Shared HealingME: Spark of life (1st level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Delay Spell (use in increments as standard actions; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; subject gains “pool” of healing (7d6 max.) that it can then allot to self as standard actions.

sections.heading: Share Pain, ForcedSRD
sections.text: Share Pain, ForcedSRD: Spark of life (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 3rd); for 1 rd./level, each time you are damaged, 1d6 +1/level (+15 max.) hp worth are transferred to the target, if it is within Close range. Variants:

sections.heading: SharpenRRE
sections.text: SharpenRRE: Variable Spell (+1 level): shaping (2nd level) or Extended (1 hr./level) blessing (2nd level) + Object-Specific Spell (edged weapon; -2 levels) = 1st level; either restores edge to weapon touched (Craft check needed) or hones existing edge for +1 enhancement to attacks and damage for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Shatter
sections.text: Shatter: Sound lance (1st level) + Bane Spell (crystalline; +0 levels) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Shatter Mind BlankSRD
sections.text: Shatter Mind BlankSRD: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to interplanar; +8 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (mind blank and similar protections only; -2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (named or specifically-designated target only; -1 level) = 5th level; dispels wardings against divinations and [mind-affecting] effects.

sections.heading: Shatter SoulRR
sections.text: Shatter SoulRR: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+6d4; +6 levels) + Reaping Spell (+2 levels) = 9th level; 7d4 Con damage and cannot be resurrected if slain unless soul fragments gathered. Requires black sapphire worth 1,000 gp per HD of the victim, and you must invest 150 x CL numen.

sections.heading: ShatterfloorMF
sections.text: ShatterfloorMF: Sound lance (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); damage cap 10d6 sonic in 20’r. spread leaves difficult terrain.

sections.heading: Sheltered VitalityLM
sections.text: Sheltered VitalityLM: Warding (damage attribute; 1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (also fatigue; +2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 3rd); subject immune to fatigue/exhaustion and attribute damage/drain for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Shield
sections.text: Shield: Mage armor (1st level) + Variable Spell (shield bonus; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (warding:  bolt of force; +1 level) = 1st level; subject gains +4 shield bonus to AC and is immune to bolt of force and its derivatives. AKA force screenSRD. Variants:

sections.heading: Shield of ColorDD
sections.text: Shield of ColorDD: Light (0 level) + Augment Spell (dazzling; +4 levels) + Cascade Spell (warding: darkness; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Shield of FortificationACG
sections.text: Shield of FortificationACG: Warding (precision damage; 1st level) + Irresistible Spell (protects against non-magic precision damage; +3 levels) + Inexorable Spell (blocks precision-based [strike] feats; +3 levels) + + Restricted Spell (paladin or access to appropriate domain; -1 level) + Expedient Spell (fortification is only 5% per caster level; -1 level) = 5th level (paladin 4th).

sections.heading: Shield of Law
sections.text: Shield of Law: Deflection (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 bonus; +1 level) +

sections.heading: Shield of LightAUG2
sections.text: Shield of LightAUG2: Mage armor (1st level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Cascade Spell [enhancement (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (shield bonus; -2 levels) = +1 level] + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Threnodic Spell (+0 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (+1/3 to +1/4; -1 level) + Augment Spell (panicked to cowering; +1 level) = 5th level; shield provides +4 bonus (+1/4 levels, max. +9 total bonus at 18th), sheds light, and undead hitting you cower 1 rd./level (divided amon those affected).

sections.heading: Shield of the ArchonsBED
sections.text: Shield of the ArchonsBED: Dispel (0 level) + Selective Spell (choose which incoming spell is dispelled; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (no check needed; +2 levels) = 6th level; one magical attack/rd. targeting you is blocked, as if by unbeatable SR.

sections.heading: Shield of the BearRRE
sections.text: Shield of the BearRRE: Bull’s strength (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (active shield user; -2 levels) = 2nd level; subject +4 enhancement to Str and +4 deflection to AC while shield readied (up to 1 min./level).

sections.heading: Shield of the FoxRRE
sections.text: Shield of the FoxRRE: Bestow feat (Combat Expertise; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (active shield user; -2 levels) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Shield of the LeopardRRE
sections.text: Shield of the LeopardRRE: Spark of life (1st level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (active shield user; -2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 4th); subject gains +3 resistance to saves and 1d6 temp. hp/level (max. 5d6) while shield readied (up to 1 min./level).

sections.heading: Shield of the LionRRE
sections.text: Shield of the LionRRE: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+4 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (active shield user; -2 levels) = 2nd level; subject gains +5 morale bonus to attacks, damage, and saves vs. fear while shield readied (up to 1 min./level).

sections.heading: Shield of the MastiffRRE
sections.text: Shield of the MastiffRRE: Resistance (0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (active shield user; -2 levels) = 1st level; subject gains +4 sacred bonus to saves while shield readied (up to 1 min./level).

sections.heading: Shield of the OwlRRE
sections.text: Shield of the OwlRRE: Skill enhancement (Perception; 0 level) + Augment Spell (+2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (active shield user; -2 levels) = 0 level; subject +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Perception while shield readied (up to 1 min./level).

sections.heading: Shield of the Ox
sections.text: Shield of the Ox: Skill enhancement (Endurance; 0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (active shield user; -2 levels) = 0 level; subject +1 to saves and +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Endurance while shield readied (up to 1 min./level).

sections.heading: Shield of the PhoenixRRE
sections.text: Shield of the PhoenixRRE: Resurrection (7th level) + Delay Spell (when slain; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (active shield user; -2 levels) = 6th level; subject is resurrected if slain while shield is readied. Requires 7,500 gp worth of diamond dust.

sections.heading: Shield of the SphinxRRE
sections.text: Shield of the SphinxRRE: Attribute boost (Int; 0 level) + Augment Spell (+2 to +8; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (active shield user; -2 levels) = 0 level; +8 burst of Intelligence when shield readied.

sections.heading: Shield of the TortoiseRRE
sections.text: Shield of the TortoiseRRE: Inure (0 level) + Energy Admixture (bludgeoning and piercing; +0 levels) + Maximize Spell (+3 levels) + Cascade Spell [(enhancement; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (natural armor; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1/4 to +1/2; +2 levels)] + Creature-Specific Spell (active shield user; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 8th); subject +1/2 levels to natural armor and DR 10/adamantine while shield readied (up to 1 min./level).

sections.heading: Shield of the WolfRRE
sections.text: Shield of the WolfRRE: Spark of life (1st level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +4 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (active shield user; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; subject gains fast healing 1/level (max. 5) as long as shield readied (max. 1 min./level).

sections.heading: Shield of the WyrmRRE
sections.text: Shield of the WyrmRRE: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Augment Spell (+8 total; +4 levels) + Cascade Spell (touch of adamantine; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell [(sound lance; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses: deafness; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels)] + Creature-Specific Spell (active shield user; -2 levels) = 8th level; subject +8 to Strength, bypasses DR/adamantine, and attacks deal +13d6 total sonic damage (divided among attacks) and deafen 1 rd./level, while shield readied (up to 1 min./level).

sections.heading: ShieldbreakerAUG2
sections.text: ShieldbreakerAUG2: Bestow feat (Scything Blow; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Improved Weapon Maneuvers; +2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); weapon ignores 5 points shield bonus to AC and can sunder with a +2 bonus (no AoO if fails).

sections.heading: Shillelagh
sections.text: Shillelagh: Energy mace; 0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (magic weapon; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (wooden bludgeon only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (5d6 to 1d6; -1 level) = 1st level; wooden weapon gains +1 enhancement, deals +1d6 bludgeoning damage on a hit (up to 2/rd.). Variants:

sections.heading: Ship SnareRR
sections.text: Ship SnareRR: Celerity (ship speed; 0 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Delay Spell (proximity; +1 level) = 5th level; ship triggering trap stopped (keelboat) or slowed (to 10 ft. for a longship, sailing ship, or warship, or 20 ft. for a galley) 1 hr./level (longer, if invest 250 x CL numen). Variant:

sections.heading: Shock TreatmentDr339
sections.text: Shock TreatmentDr339: Inertia (0 level) + Cascade Spell (electric arc; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stunning; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); close ranged touxh deals 5d6 electricity plus stunned 1 rd./level or until save.

sections.heading: ShockwaveDr344
sections.text: ShockwaveDr344: Inertia (0 level) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stunning; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 3rd); damage cap 10d6 nonlethal plus stunning 1 rd. in a 20’r.

sections.heading: Shooting StarDr340
sections.text: Shooting StarDr340: Jet of flame (0 level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 7d6 fire plus knocked prone, divided among ranged touch attacks.

sections.heading: Shout
sections.text: Shout: Sound lance (1st level) + Bane Spell (crystalline; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (alter senses: deafness; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) = 4th level (bard 3rd); damage cap 10d6 sonic plus deafened 1 rd./level (Fort half/neg.). Variants:

sections.heading: Shrapnel GlobeAUG2
sections.text: Shrapnel GlobeAUG2: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; as fireball, but 5d6 slashing. Variants:

sections.heading: Shriek, Tasso’sDr181
sections.text: Shriek, Tasso’sDr181: Figment (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Reduce Spell (auditory w/o intelligible speech only; -4 levels) = 0 level; swift action creates illusion of shrieking, crying, etc. lasing 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Shrieking WallsTM2
sections.text: Shrieking WallsTM2: Alter senses (deafness; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (onset: inst. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level; intruders in one 10-ft. cube/level are dazed 1 rd. and deafened 1 rd./level; the shrieking lasts 1 rd./level. Note numen cost for latent spells; you can also choose to invest 1,000 x CL additional numen to make the deafness permanent.

sections.heading: ShrivelingBVD
sections.text: ShrivelingBVD: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 10d6 necrotic (Fort half) at medium range. Variants:

sections.heading: Shut Up and ListenPF117
sections.text: Shut Up and ListenPF117: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+2 bonus; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd.; -3 levels) + Restricted Spell (goblinoid caster; -1 level) = 0 level; swift casting grants adjacent ally a +2 profane bonus to attacks, damage, and saves vs. fear.

sections.heading: Siege of TreesUC
sections.text: Siege of TreesUC: Energy mace (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Splash Evocation (indirect fire and adjacent target damage; +0 levels) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard action to change targets; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 6th level; volley of 4 shots/rd. (ranged touch) deal 4d6 bludgeoning each (5d6 at CL 14+).

sections.heading: Siege of Trees, GreaterUC
sections.text: Siege of Trees, GreaterUC: Siege of trees (6th level) + Reach Spell (long to extreme; +1 level) + Empower Spell (+1 level) = 8th level; 9d6 damage/hit and longer range.

sections.heading: Siege Sphere, Otiluke’sGA
sections.text: Siege Sphere, Otiluke’sGA: Energy mace (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to extreme; +3 levels) + Variable Spell (+3 levels) = 6th level; damage cap 15d6.

sections.heading: Siege WallTM2
sections.text: Siege WallTM2: Energy mace (0 level) + Variable Spell (versatile evocation; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Athletics; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Knowledge (warfare); +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 60-ft. squares; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to War domain; -1 level) = 9th level; damage to walls reduced by 20d6, attackers -10 to scale it, and defenders +10 to Warfare checks (up to 3,600 sq. ft./level; requires 9-hour ritual).

sections.heading: Sigil of FireRR2
sections.text: Sigil of FireRR2: Jet of flame (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (inure: fire; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead; -2 levels) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 1d6 and 50 to 5; -4 levels) + Augment Spell (5 to 30; +1 level) = 5th level; up to 9 HD of undead (max. 1/level) gain fire resistance 5/2 levels (max. 30), deal +1d6 fire damage with melee attacks. Sigil of iceRR2 and sigil of oozeRR2 are the same, except cold and acid, respectively.

sections.heading: SignMH
sections.text: SignMH: Detection (initiative count; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to extreme; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (conc. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) = 7th level (listed as 1st); for 1 min./level, you always know the initiative count of everyone within Extreme range, and can sense when delayed actions, etc. will occur.

sections.heading: Signs of the LandUW
sections.text: Signs of the LandUW: Commune with nature (q.v.; 5th level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 4th level (ranger 3rd); as commune with nature, but only 1 feature/level.

sections.heading: Silence, Khelben’s SuspendedMF
sections.text: Silence, Khelben’s SuspendedMF: Silence (2nd level) + Reach Spell (long to touch; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (standard action; +3 levels) = 3rd level; object emits silence at CL 5th when you touch it and state command word; numen investiture = 3rd level x CL 5th x 50 = 750.

sections.heading: Silence, SelectiveRRE
sections.text: Silence, SelectiveRRE: Glamer (1st level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Widen Spell (10’r. to 60’r.; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (no olfactory or tactile; -2 levels) = 4th level; selected creatures are covered with silence, except to each other.

sections.heading: Silencing Hand, Bigby’sGA
sections.text: Silencing Hand, Bigby’sGA: Silence (2nd level) + Shape Spell (10-ft. emanation to target; -1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+4 levels) + Reach Spell (Long to Medium; -1 level) + Tenuous Spell (destroyed by 6 hp damage; -1 level) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Silent TableACG
sections.text: Silent TableACG: Glamer (1st level) + Shape Spell (emanation to wall; +0 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level; 1-way dome of silence (2 ft./level in radius) prevents those outside from listening in.

sections.heading: Silent Winter (new)
sections.text: Silent Winter (new): Ray of frost (0 level) + Cascade Spell (touch of fatigue; +1 level) + Augment Spell (enhausted; +1 level) + Fell Fatigue (+1 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (non-neutral; -1 level) + Expedient Spell (individual hp; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (druid; -1 level) + Reduced Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 6th level; non-neutral creatures in 40’r. are affected based on current hp:

sections.heading: Silvered ClawsBED
sections.text: Silvered ClawsBED: Bestow feat (Wolfsbane Strike; 1st level) + Augment Spell (BAB +6 effects; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (natural attacks only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Animal domain; ­1 level) = 1st level; subject’s natural attacks bypass DR/silver for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Silvered WeaponBED
sections.text: Silvered WeaponBED: Tansmute (1st level) + Augment Spell (rare metal; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 8 lbs./level; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (weapon only; -2 levels) = 1st level; weapon (or multiple projectiles) weighing up to 8 lbs./level penetrate(s) DR/silver for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Simulacrum
sections.text: Simulacrum: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 12; +7 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Shadow Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Craft Construct feat; -1 level) = 7th level. You form a CR 10 construct duplicate of a specific creature, but HD and other abilities are only 60% of normal if disbelieved. The simulacrum melts after 1 hr./level unless you place it under your control (as a crafted construct).

sections.heading: Singing ShoutCW
sections.text: Singing ShoutCW: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 bonus; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 4th level; allies within 60 ft. gain +4 enhancement to Strength.

sections.heading: SinkSW
sections.text: SinkSW: Skill enhancement (Athletics; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity: swim speed; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) = 2nd level; target is -1/2 levels (-10 max.) to Athletics checks and -20 ft. to swim speed for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: SiphonCSc
sections.text: SiphonCSc: Dispel (0 level) + Variable Spell (Cascade Spell: any spell of 4th level or lower; +5 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 charge/level; +3 levels) + Item-Specific Spell (drain charges from wand or staff only; -2 levels) Expedient Spell (special; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level; you drain up to 1 charge/level from a wand or staff to regain 1 spell/5 charges drained (max. 3rd level or highest-level spell in wand or staff, whichever is lower).

sections.heading: Siren’s CallSW
sections.text: Siren’s CallSW: Compel (immerse self; 2nd level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/3 levels; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (ocean; -2 levels) = 4th level; up to 1 victim/3 levels compelled to immerse selves in the sea.

sections.heading: Skeletal GuardMF
sections.text: Skeletal GuardMF: Lesser animate deadUM (2nd level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +4 levels) + Cascade Spell (warding: positive energy; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 8th level; you animate 1 normal skeleton/level, which are immune to positive energy as long as you invest 400 x CL numen.

sections.heading: Skillful MomentDr350
sections.text: Skillful MomentDr350: Metaphysical feat (Maximize Spell; 1st level) + Variable Spell (apply to skill check rather than object; +1 level) + Variable Spell (choose skill at time of casting; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) = 1st level; you Take 20 on one skill check made during the next round.

sections.heading: SkinsendUM
sections.text: SkinsendUM: Polymorph (construct; 3rd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level; you become a construct with appearance of your animated skin.

sections.heading: Skull of SecretsMF
sections.text: Skull of SecretsMF: Magic mouth (2nd level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (jet of flame; +1 level) + Delay Spell (different activating condition; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6.

sections.heading: Skypledged Servant SupplicationRW
sections.text: Skypledged Servant SupplicationRW: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 10; +6 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Air domain, etc.; -1 level) = 8th level; summons a 16 HD Large air elemental for 10 min./level. Variants:

sections.heading: Slapping Hand, Bigby’sMH
sections.text: Slapping Hand, Bigby’sMH: Compel (provoke AoO; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to inst.; -1 level) = 2nd level. Variant:

sections.heading: Slash TongueBVD
sections.text: Slash TongueBVD: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) = 0 level; save or sickened 1 round.

sections.heading: Slashing DarknessMH
sections.text: Slashing DarknessMH: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Empower Spell (+1 level) = 3rd level; ray deals 1.5 x 5d6 negative energy damage.

sections.heading: Slaying ArrowME
sections.text: Slaying ArrowME: Enhancement (2nd level) + Item-Specific Spell (projectile; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+6d4; +5 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (-2 levels) + Variable Spell (choose creature type at time of casting; +1 level) + Channel Spell (into missile; +1 level) + Delay Spell (can be fired later; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level; missile gains +1/3 levels enhancement, deals 7d4 Con damage (Fort half) to specified creature type (is destroyed after use). N.B., If the creature type is set to “undead,” assume that Threnodic Spell (+0 levels) is also a component, and the arrow deals +6d4 Cha damage.

sections.heading: Sleep
sections.text: Sleep: Compel (sleep; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Tenuous Spell (wake if slapped or injured; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; ­1 level) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (+5 to +0 HD; -1 level) = 1st level; a total of 2d4 HD can be affected. Variants:

sections.heading: Sleet Storm
sections.text: Sleet Storm: Topple (0 level) + Cascade Spell (wisp; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to long; +2 levels) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (fog, 1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); obstructs vision 1 rd./level, causes icy conditions (save or slip and fall prone initially, difficult terrain thereafter). Variant:

sections.heading: SlideMH
sections.text: SlideMH: Mage hand (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (concentration to instantaneous; -1 level) = 0 level (listed as 1st); close target pushed up to 20 ft. in any direction (Will neg.). Greater slideMH (1st level; listed as 2nd) works at Medium range.

sections.heading: Slime WaveCD
sections.text: Slime WaveCD: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +3 levels) = 7th level; those in 20’r. take 1d4 Con/rd. (Fort half) for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Slip Between SightAUG2
sections.text: Slip Between SightAUG2: Glamer (1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Stealth; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; you gain partial concealment and +1/2 levels to Stealth (+5 max.) for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: SlipstreamAPG
sections.text: SlipstreamAPG: Celerity (swim speed; 0 level) + Variable Spell (land speed; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) = 2nd level; +20 ft. to swim speed, +10 ft. to land speed.

sections.heading: Slow ConsumptionBVD
sections.text: Slow ConsumptionBVD: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (warding: natural healing; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (helpless target; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Fast Recovery; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (unhallowed ground; -2 levels) = 1st level; victim takes 1d4 Con/day and resists natural healing, while you gain Fast Recovery.

sections.heading: Slowing MudACG
sections.text: Slowing MudACG: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (blindness; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (slow; +3 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Earth domain; -1 level) = 4th level; 1 creature/level is slowed and blinded until saves (i.e., clears mud; max. 1 rd./level).

sections.heading: Slumber Arrows, Melf’sCM
sections.text: Slumber Arrows, Melf’sCM: Whelm (0 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (as fired; +1 level) = 4th level; one arrow/3 levels deals +1d6 nonlethal/level (max. 15d6), potentially causing fatigue, exhaustion, or loss of consciousness.

sections.heading: SmiteRR
sections.text: SmiteRR: Bestow feat (Insightful Strike; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (jet of flame; +1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); one melee attack gains Cha modifier to attack and damage and deals +1d6/level (max. 5d6, half fire, half holy).

sections.heading: Smite HereticBED
sections.text: Smite HereticBED: Enhancement (2nd level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (uses divine spells or SLAs; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1/4 to +1/2; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 3rd level; you gain +1/2 levels sacred bonus to attacks and damage against divine spell/SLA users for 10 min./level (also stacks with smite evil/Channeled Smite effects).

sections.heading: Smoke Cloud (Pyrotechnics)
sections.text: Smoke Cloud (Pyrotechnics): Wisp (0 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to long; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (fog, 1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (existing fire source; −2 levels) = 2nd level; 20’r. cloud around fire obstructs vision and sickens those within. Variants:

sections.heading: Smoke LadderOA
sections.text: Smoke LadderOA: Creation (1st level) + Augment Spell (weightless, self-supporting ladder is equivalent to a rare metal; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (shaping; +2 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (ladder only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to [fire] school, bloodline, etc.; -1 level) = 1st level; conjures weightless, self-supporting ladder 10 ft./level long lasting 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Smoke StairsCSc
sections.text: Smoke StairsCSc: Levitate (2nd level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; you ascent “stairs” of smoke, moving vertically at 20 ft./round.

sections.heading: Smoky ConfinementCM
sections.text: Smoky ConfinementCM: Gaseous form (3rd level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Str; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) = 6th level; touch turns target gaseous and deals 3d4 Str damage (Fort neg./half); you can then attempt to bottle in a suitable receptacle (easy if helpless at 0 Str, but target can still resist and attempt to break free if not). Invest 600 x CL numen (6th level x 50 x 2) to keep gaseous and Str damaged.

sections.heading: SmotherRR
sections.text: SmotherRR: Bind (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Throat Punch; +1 level) = 3rd level; subject is grappled 1 rd./level (speech is hindered and must hold breath). Cf. water’s embraceRR. Variants:

sections.heading: Smug NarcissismUM
sections.text: Smug NarcissismUM: Compel (act vain and fight defensively only; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoid only; -2 levels) = 4th level; subject uses defensive options in combat, takes -2 circumstance penalty to skill checks.

sections.heading: Snake BarrierOA
sections.text: Snake BarrierOA: Hedge (reptiles; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (emanation to wall; -1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = 2nd level; immobile barrier (one 5-ft. square/level or hemisphere with radius 2 ft./level) hedges out [reptilian] creatures.

sections.heading: SnakebiteMF
sections.text: SnakebiteMF: Invisible needle (0 level) + Cascade Spell [(damage attribute; 1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (Dex and Con; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level)] + Resistible Spell (-1 level) + Concentration Spell (partial; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Scalykind domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; 1 partial action melee attack/rd. deals up to 10d6 piercing plus 1d4 Con and 1d4 Dex/rd. for 1 rd./level or until save (Fort half/neg.).

sections.heading: Snapdragon FireworksUM
sections.text: Snapdragon FireworksUM: Jet of flame (0 level) + Cascade Spell (flare; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 1d6; -2 levels) = 1st level; 1d6 fire plus dazzled (save half/neg.) to 1 target/round.

sections.heading: Snapping TeethCWH
sections.text: Snapping TeethCWH: Invisible needle (0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: SneezeRR
sections.text: SneezeRR: Compel (sneeze; 2nd level) + Pacific Spell (­2 levels) = 0 level; subject sneezes loudly (this does not interfere with its other actions that round).

sections.heading: Sniper’s EyeCAd
sections.text: Sniper’s EyeCAd: Skill enhancement (Perception; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (darkvision; +4 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Point-Blank Shot; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +6 effects; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (square cast in; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger or rogue; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 4th); you gain +1/2 levels to Perception (+5 max.), darkvision 60 ft., and can deal precision damage at Medium range for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Sniper’s ShotCAd
sections.text: Sniper’s ShotCAd: Bestow feat (Point-Blank Shot; 1st level) + Augment Spell (BAB +11 effects; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (sneak attack range; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 1st level; swift action allows you to deal precision damage at Long range.

sections.heading: Snow WaveFB
sections.text: Snow WaveFB: Energy mace (0 level) + Energy Admixture (cold; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cone; +1 level) + Inexorable Evocation (+3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Winter domain; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 6th); 4d6 bludgeoning plus 1d6 cold (no save) and knocked prone in 30-ft. cone.

sections.heading: SnowballUW
sections.text: SnowballUW: Ray of frost (0 level) + Augment Spell (1d6 to 5d6; +1 level) = 1st level; damage cap 5d6.

sections.heading: Snowball, Snilloc’sUnE
sections.text: Snowball, Snilloc’sUnE: Ray of frost (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Variable Spell (can also deliver as melee touch; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 1d6; ­2 levels) = 1st level (divine 2nd); each round, make a touch or ranged touch attack for 1d6 cold.

sections.heading: SnowdriftFB
sections.text: SnowdriftFB: Shaping (2nd level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 3 cu. ft./level; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (snow only; -2 levels) = 1st level.

sections.heading: SnowsightFB
sections.text: SnowsightFB: Bestow feat (Favored Terrain: arctic; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (terrain sight only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level)  + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Winter domain; -1 level) = 1st level; subject can see in snow (even whiteout conditions), is immune to snow blindness.

sections.heading: SnowsongFB
sections.text: SnowsongFB: Attribute boost (Cha; 0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3 total; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (dispel; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard or access to Winter domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 1d6; -4 levels) = 7th level (listed as 6th); you and allies +3 morale to atks, damage, AC, Cha, plus fast healing 1; enemies must make opposed Concentration checks to cast spells; in 20’r. emanation lasting 1 min./level.
