sections.text: SpacewarpTM2: Mage hand (0 level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (concentration to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Widen Spell (individual mass: 1 lb./level to 27 lbs./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Chaos, Magic, or Trickery domain; -1 level) = 7th level; gravity pulls towards center of 40’r. sphere (creatures or objects arriving first may be damaged by being struck by later arrivals).

sections.heading: SparkAPG
sections.text: SparkAPG: Jet of flame (0 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (5d6 to 1d6; -1 level) + Merciful Spell (+0 levels) = 0 level; ignites target object without incinerating it outright.

sections.heading: Spark of LifeLM
sections.text: Spark of LifeLM: Metaphysical feat (Thanatopic Spell (1st level) + Augment Spell (+2 levels cost; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 7th); for the next 1 rd./level, undead creature touched is susceptible to attribute damage, etc. as if it were alive (Will neg.).

sections.heading: Spark ShowerDMG1
sections.text: Spark ShowerDMG1: Electric arc (0 level) + Conductive Evocation (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) + Widen Spell (30 ft. to 15 ft.; -1 level) = 1st level (divine 2nd); damage cap 5d6 (metal-armored targets or those with metal weapons save at -4) in 15-ft. cone.

sections.heading: Speak with AnythingMW
sections.text: Speak with AnythingMW: Tongues (3rd level) + Augment Spell (inanimate; +9 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 min./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard or druid; -1 level) = 8th level; for 1 min./level, you can speak with any type of creature, and even with inanimate objects.

sections.heading: Speak with Astral TravelerTM2
sections.text: Speak with Astral TravelerTM2: Mindlink (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +7 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (astral plane; -2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (astral form of material body touched; −2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Speak with Dead
sections.text: Speak with Dead: Tongues (3rd level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (mindless corpse; +5 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (corpse of intelligent being; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 min./level; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level. Variants:

sections.heading: Speak with MonstersPH1
sections.text: Speak with MonstersPH1: Tongues (3rd level) + Cross-Class Spell (cleric; +1 level) + Augment Spell (different senses; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 min./level; -1 level) = 6th level.

sections.heading: Speaking StonesME
sections.text: Speaking StonesME: Figment (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to planar; +6 levels) + Delay Spell (standard; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (to other focus; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (cubes to emanation; +0 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (no visual component; ­1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (send reply message; +1 level) = 2nd level; send 1 verbal message each (up to 1 rd./level) between two focus items.

sections.heading: Spear of PurityUM
sections.text: Spear of PurityUM: Invisible needle (0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Bane Spell (fixed: [evil]; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (blindness; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6 (5d8 vs. evil; half piercing, half holy) and blinds 1 rd.

sections.heading: Spear of ValarianBED
sections.text: Spear of ValarianBED: Invisible needle (0 level) + Channeled Spell (+1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (magical beasts; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (silvered weaponBED; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (greater magic weapon; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (druid or ranger; −1 level) = 4th level; weapon is silver, gains +1/4 levels enhancement bonus, and deals up to +14d6/rd. extra piercing damage (divided among attacks, max. +10d6 for one) vs. magical beasts.

sections.heading: Spectral Archers, Tanil’sRR2
sections.text: Spectral Archers, Tanil’sRR2: Invisible needle (0 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); arrow shot invokes 1d6 piercing/level (max. 10d6, Reflex half) in one contiguous 10’ cube/level starting at impact point.

sections.heading: Spectral SaluqiPC
sections.text: Spectral SaluqiPC: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 4; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level; summons one yeth hound (swap out Improved Initiative feat for Ghost Strike) that communicates with you telepathically.

sections.heading: Spectral StagMF
sections.text: Spectral StagMF: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 1 celestial or fiendish stag; +1 level) + Augment Spell (phantom steed template; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Animal domain; -1 level) = 2nd level. Phantom stagCD is Extended to 1 hr./level (+3 levels) = 5th level.

sections.heading: Spectral Steed, Bloodstone’sTM2
sections.text: Spectral Steed, Bloodstone’sTM2: Summon (1st level) + Summon Undead (+1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 4 Huge zombie giant vulture; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (necromancer, or access to Undead bloodline, etc.; -1 level) = 6th level; summons a Huge vulture zombie (8 HD, fly 120 ft., Str 26, carrying capacity 1125/2450/3675 lbs.) for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: SpeechlinkCAd
sections.text: SpeechlinkCAd: Mindlink (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Spell Inhibitor, Taldock’sRR
sections.text: Spell Inhibitor, Taldock’sRR: Skill enhancement (Concentration; 0 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (­1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) = 6th level; reduces effective caster levels in 60’r. by -1/2 levels (no save).

sections.heading: Spell Reflection, EpicSRD
sections.text: Spell Reflection, EpicSRD: Dispel (0 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (reverse back onto caster instead of dispelling; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to long; +2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (no check needed; +2 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 spell/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 9th level (listed as epic); turns up to 1 spell/level per round targeting subject (no level limit). Invest 1,800 x CL numen to maintain effect indefinitely.

sections.heading: Spell RepetitionDD
sections.text: Spell RepetitionDD: Bestow feat (magical talent; 1st level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (same spell as cast last round; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (16 ranks Concentration; +3 levels) = 3rd level; swift casting enables you to recast any spell of up to 8th level that you expended last round.

sections.heading: Spell Resistance
sections.text: Spell Resistance: Dispel (0 level) + Selective Spell (choose which incoming spells are affected; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) = 5th level; subject gains SR = 10 + your Concentration bonus for 1 min./level. Variants:

sections.heading: Spell StarDr338
sections.text: Spell StarDr338: Dispel (0 level) + Irresistible Spell (no check needed; +3 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 spell/3 levels; +2 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 5th level (listed as 8th); one spell/3 levels targeting you is automatically negated.

sections.heading: Spell WallRR2
sections.text: Spell WallRR2: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 5-ft. squares; -1 level) + Selective Spell (one-way; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) = 8th level (listed as 4th); one side of wall automatically dispels spells and SLAa that contact it; re-orient and/or change location each round as a swift action.

sections.heading: SpellbreakerBRL
sections.text: SpellbreakerBRL: Dispel (0 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Variable Spell (touch or melee attack; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 4th level; for the next 1 rd./level, you can dispel by touch or [strike] using focus object.

sections.heading: SpellcrashACG
sections.text: SpellcrashACG: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (save each round to end effect; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 4th/6th/8th). Target loses 1 spell slot, prepared spell, or daily spell-like ability use per round until saves, starting with highest-level. AKA Gunther’s kaleidoscopic strikeTM2. MindburnME (2nd level) is similar, but the range is only Close. Variant:

sections.heading: SpellmasterAUG
sections.text: SpellmasterAUG: Bestow feat (1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level above 1st; +4 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level (listed as 7th); you can spontaneously apply 1 metamagic feat/2 levels (Delay Spell, Extend Spell, Reach Spell, Selective Spell, possibly others, even if you don’t know them) for the next 1 rd./level, subject to the Sudden Metamagic feat limitations.

sections.heading: Spellstaff
sections.text: Spellstaff: 6th (or lower) level spell + Variable Spell (select spell at time of imbuing staff; +1 level) + Delay Spell (standard action trigger; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (­2 levels) = 6th level; invest 300 x CL numen to maintain spell in staff for use later (as a standard action).

sections.heading: SpelltrapAUG2
sections.text: SpelltrapAUG2: Dispel (0 level) + Cascade Spell (invocation of the knife; +1 level) + Energy Admixture (fire; +0 levels) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Variable Spell (different condition for each component; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; focus gem negates specified spell cast on it, then explodes when next touched (max 10d6 fire/slashing in 20’r.).

sections.heading: Sphere of DeteriorationAUG2
sections.text: Sphere of DeteriorationAUG2: Ray of entropy (1st level) Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 9th); 10d6 entropic/rd. (Fort half) to all within 60 ft. of you. Variants:

sections.heading: Sphere of TerrorDr333
sections.text: Sphere of TerrorDr333: Spook (0 level) + Cascade Spell (gloom; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (invocation of the knife; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (4 steps to 1 step, panicked to shaken, and 20d6 to 1d6; -3 levels) = 4th level; 20’r. area lowers illumination by 1 step, deals 1d6 slashing/rd., and those within become shaken for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Spider Climb
sections.text: Spider Climb: Polymorph (vermin abilities; 3rd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (climbing only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Athletics; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (climb checks only; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) = 2nd level; subject gains climb speed of up to 30 ft. and additional +1/2 levels (+5 max.) bonus to checks. AKA wall walkerSRD.

sections.heading: Spike Growth
sections.text: Spike Growth: Invisible needle (0 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to horizontal wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. squares to 20-ft. squares; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (vegetation or loose earth only; -2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (effects only if move; -2 levels) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6 and 40 ft. to 20 ft.;  −1 level) = 3rd level; one 20-ft. square/level of difficult terrain deals 1d6 damage per 5 ft. of movement, plus save or land speed reduced by 20 ft. (minimum 5 ft.) for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Spine TendrilAUG2
sections.text: Spine TendrilAUG2: Variable Spell (bind or unhandAUG2; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 levels) + Concentration Spell (swift; +3 levels) = 5th level; each round as a swift action, make one Close ranged grapple or disarm attempt.

sections.heading: Spines of DeathAUG
sections.text: Spines of DeathAUG: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Variable Spell (melee or ranged attacks; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (invisible needle; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (3d4 to 2d4 and 20d6 to 15d6; -1 level) = 5th level; damage cap 20d6 piercing plus 2d4 Con, divided among multiple melee or ranged attacks; Str modifier applies.

sections.heading: Spirit ArmorTM2
sections.text: Spirit ArmorTM2: Mage armor (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (necromancy; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 to +6; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +3; +1 level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; you gain +6 armor bonus to AC and +3 profane bonus to saves for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Spirit of PowerTM2
sections.text: Spirit of PowerTM2: Summon (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 20; +11 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 9th level; long ritual summons a minor avatar of your deity (Advanced, half-celestial Incarnate 18) that remains as long as you concentrate.

sections.heading: Spirit of ProwessAUG
sections.text: Spirit of ProwessAUG: Blessing (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 total; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); you gain +4 enhancement (or sacred or morale, if cleric or bard) to attacks and damage for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Spirit of WarAUG
sections.text: Spirit of WarAUG: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Cascade (attribute boost: Dex, Con; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (+2 to +4; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 feat/3 levels; +2 levels) + Variable Spell (select feats at time of casting; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 8th level (listed as 7th); you gain +4 enhancement to Str, Dex, and Con, and 1 feat/3 levels (choose from weapon proficiencies, armor proficiencies, Weapon Specialization, etc.) for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Spiritual ChariotCD
sections.text: Spiritual ChariotCD: Skill enhancement (Handle Animal; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (mage armor; +1 level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Variable Spell (cover bonus; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ant haul; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (cover bonus applies only when riding mount; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 2nd level; mount can carry additional weight, passengers gain cover bonus to AC, and driver gains +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Handle Animal checks. Spell manifests as a chariot of force behind the mount.

sections.heading: Spiritual Soldier, Arathan’sAUG2
sections.text: Spiritual Soldier, Arathan’sAUG2: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (+4d4 Dex; +3 levels) + Threnodic Spell (+0 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (incorporeal undead only; -2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (days/level to hrs./level; -1 level) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (summon; +1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 9; +5 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (stone golem only; -2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (only when at least 25 HD halted; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 8th level; 5d4 Dex damage to up to 1 incorporeal undead/level with up to 12 HD each within Medium range, and animates stone golem servant if 25 HD+ undead affected.

sections.heading: Spiritual WrathTM2
sections.text: Spiritual WrathTM2: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (wisp; +1 level) + Reach Spell (0 to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level; damage cap 15d6 bludgeoning and obscures vision in 120’r. for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Spontaneous SearchSC
sections.text: Spontaneous SearchSC: Detecetion (2nd level) + Shape Spell (cone to burst; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (rogue skill trick; -1 level) = 1st level; learn presence/absence, types, and locations of all objects in 20’r.

sections.heading: Spore CloakRF
sections.text: Spore CloakRF: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Extend Spell (damage onset: inst. to 1 rd./level; +3 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (shielding effect: inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels)  + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 6th level; those entering your square, touching you, grappling with you, etc. take 1d4 Con/rd. for 1 rd./level or until save (initial Fort half).

sections.heading: Spore FieldCSc
sections.text: Spore FieldCSc: Skill enhancement (Acrobatics; 0 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Pestilence domain, etc.; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (+10 to +5; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); area of difficult terrain sickens and imposes -1/2 level (max. -5) penalty to Acrobatics checks within.

sections.heading: Spores of the VrockBVD
sections.text: Spores of the VrockBVD: Invisible needle (0 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Empower Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to 0; -1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 1st level; those in 5’r. of you take 1d8 piercing plus 1d6/rd. ongoing for up to 1 rd./level (or until receive bless, neutralize poison, or remove disease).

sections.heading: Spread of ContentmentBED
sections.text: Spread of ContentmentBED: Remove condition (hostility-inducing; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (ray of beguiling; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 8th level; removes hostility-provoking magic and improves interactions as if additional 1d6 + 1/level difference in Charisma existed.

sections.heading: Spread of SavageryBVD
sections.text: Spread of SavageryBVD: Compel (attack those not affected; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Madness or other appropriate domain; -1 level) = 9th level; after long ritual, those in large area rampage, attacking all not affected, for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Spymaster’s CoinCSc
sections.text: Spymaster’s CoinCSc: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to planar; +5 levels) + Delay Spell (standard action trigger; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (vicinity of focus coin only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); you scry on possessor of coin designated during casting (spell focus object) at some later time.

sections.heading: Squamous BlastCoC
sections.text: Squamous BlastCoC: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (dispel; +1 level) + Irrestistible Spell (+2 levels) + Overwhelming Evocation (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to line of sight; +4 levels) + Restricted Spell (Great Old One or Outer God cultist; -1 level) = 9th level; damage cap 20d6 force (ignores energy resistance and SR, and possibly dispels magical barriers, continuing past them).

sections.heading: Squaring the CircleTM2
sections.text: Squaring the CircleTM2: Bestow feat (Shape Spell; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (Sudden Metamagic; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; you can shape one or more spells during the next 1 rd./level, subject to Sudden Metamagic limits.

sections.heading: Squeaking FloorsTM2
sections.text: Squeaking FloorsTM2: Figment (0 level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Delay Spell (creature steps on floor; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) = 1st level; up to one 10-ft. square/level of floor squeaks loudly when more than 3 lbs. is put on it. By adding Tenacious Spell (+1 level), you can choose to immediately re-invest the numen to maintain the effect as a latent spell after it is discharged.

sections.heading: SqueezeARG
sections.text: SqueezeARG: Reduce (3rd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (for purposes of squeezing only; -2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 2nd).

sections.heading: Stabilize Wild ZoneTM2
sections.text: Stabilize Wild ZoneTM2: Warding (wild magic; 1st level) + Inexorable Spell (spell works even in wild magic zone; +4 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (wild magic; -1 level) = 8th level; 40’r. emanation is free of wild magic trait.

sections.heading: Stalwart PactCD
sections.text: Stalwart PactCD: Resistance (0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +5; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (enhancement; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (until lightly wounded; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level; when lightly wounded, subject gains 1d6 temp. hp/level (max. 15d6), +5 sacred bonus to saves, and DR/magic (1 hp/3 levels) for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Stamina to DefenseAUG
sections.text: Stamina to DefenseAUG: Enhancement (2nd level) + Lucky Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Item-Specific Spell (armor or shield only; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1/4 to +1/3; +1 level) = 4th level; armor or shield gains +1 luck bonus/3 levels for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: StandPHII
sections.text: StandPHII: Skill enhancement (Acrobatics; 0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to inst.; -2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (kip up; -2 levels) = 1st level; prone target gains immediate Acrobatics check at +1/2 levels to regain feet.

sections.heading: Standing WaveCD
sections.text: Standing WaveCD: Celerity (swim; 0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (surface of water; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+10 ft. to +60 ft.; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Water domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; wave propels subject at speed 60 ft. along water’s surface.

sections.heading: Star BlessingRW
sections.text: Star BlessingRW: Blessing (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (outdoors at night; -2 levels) = 1st level; you gain +1 sacred bonus to attacks, damage, and saves when outdoors at night.

sections.heading: Stars of ArvandorBED
sections.text: Stars of ArvandorBED: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: StarshineUA1
sections.text: StarshineUA1: Light (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (emanation to cubes; +0 levels) = 1st level (listed as 3rd); fills one 10-ft. cube/level with normal light.

sections.heading: Static VeilAUG2
sections.text: Static VeilAUG2: Warding (scrying; 1st level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Expedient Spell (special; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); ritual nondetection covers an area.

sections.heading: Status
sections.text: Status: Mindlink (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/3 levels; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (condition and general location only—no actual communication; -2 levels) = 3rd level. Variants:

sections.heading: Steadfast PerceptionSRD
sections.text: Steadfast PerceptionSRD: Warding (figments; 1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (also glamers; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Perception; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; you are immune to figments and glamers, and gain +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Perception, for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Steady Aim, Tenser’sGA
sections.text: Steady Aim, Tenser’sGA: Skill enhancement (Concentration; 0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+5 to +10; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (firing while moving; -2 levels) = 1st level; subject is +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Concentration checks to fire projectiles while moving (Chapter 4).

sections.heading: Steal ControlDD
sections.text: Steal ControlDD: Compel (obey me; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to line of sight; +4 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Threnodic Spell (constructs; +0 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 8th level (listed as 9th); you control one consstuct within ¼ mile/level with concentration.

sections.heading: Steal LifeBVD
sections.text: Steal LifeBVD: Damage attribute (1st level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Cascade Spell [(remove condition: aging; +1 level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level)] + Concentration Spell (+1 level) = 7th level; while you concentrate, you deal 1d4 attribute drain (Fort half, different attribute each round) to the target, and regain like amount of attribute loss from your own aging.

sections.heading: Steal SleepRR
sections.text: Steal SleepRR: Touch of fatigue (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (exhausted; +1 level) + Cascade Spell [(bestow feat: Skill Focus (Endurance); +1 level) + Augment Spell (20 ranks effects; +4 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (restless slumber only; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level)] = 4th level (listed as 0); target at close range is exhausted, and you instantly gain the benefits of 8 hours sleep.

sections.heading: Steal SummoningCM
sections.text: Steal SummoningCM: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (subvert control, rather than ending effect; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd.; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (summoning spells only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Thaumaturgy feat; -1 level) = 5th level; immediate casting interrupts summoning and subverts control of summoned monster to you (you must have sufficient unallocated Thaumaturgy potential remaining, or the summoned creature simply becomes uncontrolled instead). Variant:

sections.heading: Steal VoiceUM
sections.text: Steal VoiceUM: Glamer (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Accused Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (no tactile, olfactory, or visual; -3 levels) = 2nd level; subject cannot be heard above a whisper (20% spell failure, -4 to save DCs of [language-dependent] spells). Invest 100 x CL numen to maintain effect until victim casts shout (2nd level x 50 x 1 for contingent effect).

sections.heading: Sea SteedUW
sections.text: Sea SteedUW: Polymorph (magical beast; 3rd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (your steed; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); your steed gains swim 30 ft., aquatic type, amphibious descriptor, and +2 to natural armor (from scales) and Str. Variants:

sections.heading: SteeldanceMF
sections.text: SteeldanceMF: Enlarge (3rd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (animate object; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (2 objects; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (daggers only; -2 levels) = 3rd level; two daggers grow in size 1 category and attack your enemies for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Stench of PreyACG
sections.text: Stench of PreyACG: Compel (attack designated creature; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (predatory animals or vermin; -2 levels) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Animal or Pestilence domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; up to 2d4 + 1/level (+5 max.) HD worth of animal or vermin predators within 20 ft. of target attack for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Stern Reproof, Nybor’sMF
sections.text: Stern Reproof, Nybor’sMF: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (cowering to frightened; -2 levels) + Fell Frightening (+1 level) = 7th level; target takes 4d4 Con damage (Fort half) plus dazed 1 rd. (Fort neg.) and frightened 1 rd./level (Will shaken).

sections.heading: Stick Servant, Sethtel’sRR
sections.text: Stick Servant, Sethtel’sRR: Animate object (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (Tiny or Small bundle of sticks only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Sticking ScabbardRRE
sections.text: Sticking ScabbardRRE: Bind (0 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (scabbard/sheath only; -2 levels) = 1st level; grapple check to draw weapon (1 min./level).

sections.heading: Sticks and StonesShS
sections.text: Sticks and StonesShS: Summon (1st level) + Summon Undead (+1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); summons one CR ½ wight spawn for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Sticks to SnakesAPG (listed as “snake staff”)
sections.text: Sticks to SnakesAPG (listed as “snake staff”): Summon (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 5th level.

sections.heading: Stimulate HealthAUG
sections.text: Stimulate HealthAUG: Attribute boost (0 level) + Variable Spell (select at time of casting; +1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 6th); subject gains +2 sacred bonus to attribute score of your choice for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Stolen BreathSC
sections.text: Stolen BreathSC: Sickening touch (0 level) + Fell Sickening (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = 2nd level; victim sickened 1 rd./level (Fort. save reduces duration to 1 rd.).

sections.heading: Stone BoltRR2
sections.text: Stone BoltRR2: Topple (0 level) + Cascade Spell (energy mace; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 1st); damage cap 14d6 (divided among bolts) plus knocked prone and dazed 1 round.

sections.heading: Stone DiscusACG
sections.text: Stone DiscusACG: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Variable Spell (Versatile Evocation: bludgeoning; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (lesser versatile weaponAPG; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 12d6 (divine 7d6), divisible among iterative ranged attacks. You choose whether damage is bludgeoning or slashing, and the discs penetrate metals-based DR.

sections.heading: Stone FistAPG
sections.text: Stone FistAPG: Energy mace (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Adamantine Evocation (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; your fists deal 1d6 bludgeoning each (or up to 3d6 for arcane casters), penetrate DR/adamantine, and bypass up to 20 points hardness.

sections.heading: Stone ShieldARG
sections.text: Stone ShieldARG: Mage armor (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 10 min./level; -1 level) + Variable Spell (cover bonus; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) = 1st level (divine 2nd); you gain +4 cover for 1 round as an immediate action.

sections.heading: Stone StormDHD
sections.text: Stone StormDHD: Energy mace (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Stone to Flesh
sections.text: Stone to Flesh: Variable Spell (+1 level, +4 levels’ worth of options) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = 6th level.

sections.heading: Stone TrapShS
sections.text: Stone TrapShS: Energy mace (0 level) + Delay Spell (proximity or standard; +2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Augment Spell (10d6 to 20d6; +2 levels) = 6th level (listed as 7th); damage cap 20d6 bludgeoning (no SR) as a Close ranged touch attack, when activated.

sections.heading: StonefireDHD
sections.text: StonefireDHD: Jet of flame (0 level) + Cascade Spell (touch of fatigue; +1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: StonefireShS
sections.text: StonefireShS: Jet of flame (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cubes; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 5-ft. cubes; -1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Overwhelming Evocation (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 5th); damage cap 10d6 fire in area (hardness and energy resistance do not apply); may burn through stone.

sections.heading: StoneholdMF
sections.text: StoneholdMF: Invisible mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cubes; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (as magic trap; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Earth domain; -1 level) = 6th level; when activated, stone arms make touch attacks for 5d6 plus grab (2d6/round to grappled targets).

sections.heading: Stoneskin
sections.text: Stoneskin: Inure (slashing; 0 level) + Energy Admixture: bludgeoning and piercing; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) = 4th level; subject gains DR 10/adamantine for 10 min./level. Variants:

sections.heading: Stop GolemDD
sections.text: Stop GolemDD: Compel (stand still and do nothing; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Threnodic Spell (constructs; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (Craft Construct or access to Artifice domain; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 2nd); immobilizes 1 construct for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Stop HeartBVD
sections.text: Stop HeartBVD: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +3 levels) = 4th level; touch deals 4d4 Con damage (Fort half).

sections.heading: Storm BurstCRB
sections.text: Storm BurstCRB: Whelm (0 level) + Cascade Spell (flare; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to ray; +0 levels) + Cross-Class Spell (divine evocation; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Weather domain; -1 level) = 1st level; damage cap 5d6 nonlethal and dazzled 1 rd.

sections.heading: Storm of Elemental FuryCD
sections.text: Storm of Elemental FuryCD: Zephyr (0 level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Variable Spell (energy mace or jet of flame; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (wisp; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to long; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Weather domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 15d6 and hurricane to windstorm; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as 8th); damage 15d6/rd. (bludgeoning or fire; choose each round), plus storm winds (DC 18 + 2x spell level Concentration to cast in area), obscured vision, difficult terrain.

sections.heading: Storm of NeedlesCM
sections.text: Storm of NeedlesCM: Invisible needle (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 (Reflex half, no SR) in 30-ft. cone. Variants:

sections.heading: Storm of Vengeance
sections.text: Storm of Vengeance: Alter senses (deafness; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (acid splash; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Variable Spell (Versatile Evocation: bludgeoning or electricity; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (zephyr; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 360’r.; +4 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 10d6 and tornado to windstorm; -2 levels) = 9th level; storm winds (DC 18 + 2x spell level Concentration to cast in area), acid rain (1d6/rd.), and deafening thunder, plus either lightning or hail each round (9d6, Reflex half).

sections.heading: Storm SightAG
sections.text: Storm SightAG: Detection (creatures; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (within storm; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (warding: weather; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level; severe weather does force Concentration checks for you to cast/maintain spells, and sense presence of other creatures caught in the storm: 1st round—presence/absence; 2nd—number and distance to nearest; 3rd—locations.

sections.heading: Storm SlaveDr347
sections.text: Storm SlaveDr347: Electric arc (0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Storm StepPC
sections.text: Storm StepPC: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Cascade Spell (electric arc; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to line; +1 level) = 3rd level; close-range releport deals up to 10d6 electricity to those in path. Variants:

sections.heading: Storm TowerCD
sections.text: Storm TowerCD: Warding (electricity; 1st level) + Irresistible Spell (+3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (zephyr; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (wisp; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to ring-shaped wall; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Air or Weather domain; -1 level) = 6th level; ring of windstorm-strength winds and fog surround an area warded against electricity.

sections.heading: StormrageMF
sections.text: StormrageMF: Mage hand (0 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (zephyr; +1 level) + Shape Spell (line to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels)] + Extend Spell (concentration to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (electric arc; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Conductive Evocation (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Weather domain; -1 level) = 7th level; you fly at 90 ft. speed, are shrouded in hurricane winds, and can fire lightning bolts as a standard action (damage cap 20d6; +4 to attacks vs. those with metal armor/weapons).

sections.heading: Stormrunner’s WardSW
sections.text: Stormrunner’s WardSW: Skill enhancement (Profession: sailing; 0 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level; ship is +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to be sailed for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: StormwalkSW
sections.text: StormwalkSW: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to line of sight; +4 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (you must go along; -1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (from area of storm only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level; use storm to transport self and others up to ¼ mi./level, with 1 rd./level delay in arrival.

sections.heading: Strand of BindingGA
sections.text: Strand of BindingGA: Bind (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Fate or Time domain; -1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Strand of the Tangled KnotPC
sections.text: Strand of the Tangled KnotPC: Deflecton (0 level) + Augment Spell (scaling bonus; +1 level) + Augment Spell (base: +2 to +5; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to inst.; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (until attacked; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; you gain deflection +5, +1/6 levels (max. +8 at CL 18th) against the next attack targeting you.

sections.heading: StreamersShS
sections.text: StreamersShS: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Delay Spell (until target next acts; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (can be dispelled, and disappear if target does not act; -1 level) = 5th level; up to one ranged touch attack/3 levels (damage cap 15d6 force) activates only when the target next takes an action.

sections.heading: Strength DevotionCC
sections.text: Strength DevotionCC: Energy mace (0 level) + Adamantine Evocation (+2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Strength domain; -1 level) = 1st level; make a slam attack for 1d6 bludgeoning/level (max. 5d6) + Str bonus; this penetrates DR/hardness as if adamantine.

sections.heading: Stretch WeaponPHII
sections.text: Stretch WeaponPHII: Enlarge (3rd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (reach only; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (−1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 1st level (listed as 2nd); swift casting increases your reach by 5 ft. for 1 round.

sections.heading: Strike of Perfect ClarityToB
sections.text: Strike of Perfect ClarityToB: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (Weapon Specialization; -1 level) + Augment Spell (10d6 to 20d6; +2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 9th); melee [strike] deals +6 slashing/level (+120 max.).

sections.heading: StrikingXR
sections.text: StrikingXR: Energy mace (0 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (magic weapon; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level; bludgeoning weapon gains +1 enhancement, deals +1d6/level (+8d6 max., divided among iterative attacks, max. 5d6 for any one).

sections.heading: Striking Fist, Bigby’sPHII
sections.text: Striking Fist, Bigby’sPHII: Whelm (0 level) + Cascade Spell (push; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to ray; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) = 2nd level spell; damage cap 10d6 nonlethal and bull rush.

sections.heading: Strip ScalesPC
sections.text: Strip ScalesPC: Enhancement (2nd level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (natural armor; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (1/4 to 1/3; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 5th); reduces target’s natural armor bonus by -1/3 levels for 1 min./level (Fort half).

sections.heading: Stunning BarrierACG
sections.text: Stunning BarrierACG: Resistance (0 level) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Tenuous Spell (ends other effects; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); you gain +2 deflection to AC and +1 resistance to saves for up to 1 rd./level; first to hit you in melee save or stunned 1 rd. (and spell ends).

sections.heading: Stunning ScreechBVD
sections.text: Stunning ScreechBVD: Inertia (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to 0; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard or access to demonic bloodline, domain, etc.; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); those in 20’r. of you save or stunned 1 round.

sections.heading: StuporBVD
sections.text: StuporBVD: Compel (do nothing; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Crteature-Specific Spell (helpless target; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); helpless target is rendered unable to complete actions of its own volition (can still be led around, fed, etc.).

sections.heading: Sturdy Tree FortUW
sections.text: Sturdy Tree FortUW: Creation (wood; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Craft; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (shaping; +2 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (tree and fort only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell [(skill enhancement: Athletics; +1 level) + Selectibe Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (climbing only; -2 levels) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 216 cu. ft./level.; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level (ranger 4th); creates tree (2’r. and 5 ft./level tall) and wooden fort (one 10-ft. cube/level with 6-inch-thick walls); those you designate are +1/2 levels to climb up. You gain +1/2 levels to the Craft check to shape the fort.

sections.heading: Sudden ShiftAPG
sections.text: Sudden ShiftAPG: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine;-+1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (into attacker’s threatened area; -2 levels) = 3rd level (2nd with access to Trickery domain); teleport into attacker’s threatened area as an immediate action.

sections.heading: SuffocationAPG
sections.text: SuffocationAPG: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Fell Staggering (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 5th level; deals 3d4 Con/round to target while you concentrate (Fort staggered 1 rd.). Variants:

sections.heading: Suggestion, InsidiousRE
sections.text: Suggestion, InsidiousRE: Suggestion (3rd level) + Extend Spell (effects: 1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (onset: inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (gnome caster; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as 5th); as suggestion, but can take up to 1 hr./level to fulfull and those succeeding at initial save must still save again each rond for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Summon Ancestral GuardianDG
sections.text: Summon Ancestral GuardianDG: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (divine favor; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 14d6 slashing, divided among two close ranged attacks made together as a single partial action, each with +3 sacred bonus to attacks and damage.

sections.heading: Summon BarghestPC
sections.text: Summon BarghestPC: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 5 barghest; +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level.

sections.heading: Summon ComponentCM
sections.text: Summon ComponentCM: Bestow feat (Eschew Materials; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); as a swift action, you ignore inexpensive material components for 1 rd.

sections.heading: Summon DjinniSRD
sections.text: Summon DjinniSRD: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 8; +5 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 7th level; summons one Advanced djinni for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Summon Elder WormUM
sections.text: Summon Elder WormUM: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 12 Giant purple worm; +7 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 7th level.

sections.heading: Summon Flight of EaglesAG
sections.text: Summon Flight of EaglesAG: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 3 giant eagles; +3 levels) + Augment Spell (1d4+1; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level. Cf. eagle aerieUM.

sections.heading: Summon FroghemothUM
sections.text: Summon FroghemothUM: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 11 froghemoth; +7 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 7th level.

sections.heading: Summon GiantsFB
sections.text: Summon GiantsFB: Summon (1st level) + Variable Spell (select at time of casting; +1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 10; +6 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as 8th); summons fiendish or celestial giant(s): 1 frost or fire, or 1d3 stone, or 1d4+1 hill.

sections.heading: Summon GolemPHII
sections.text: Summon GolemPHII: Summon (1st level) + Variable Spell (select at time of casting; +1 level) + Augment Spell (VII; +6 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 8th level (listed as 9th); summons 1 iron, 1d3 clay or stone, or 1d4+1 flesh golems. Variants:

sections.heading: Summon Instrument
sections.text: Summon Instrument: Major creation (q.v., 4th level) + Object-Specific Spell (musical instrument only; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (choose instrument at time of casting; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Craft; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; −1 level) = 1st level; summons one instrument for 1 hr./level (Craft check at +1/2 level, max. +5 needed at time of casting, or instrument is unusable).

sections.heading: Summon LycanthropeTM2
sections.text: Summon LycanthropeTM2: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to planar; +7 levels) + Crewature-Specific Spell (lycanthrope only; -2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (to your proximity; -2 levels) = 4th level; the nearest lycanthrope (on same plane) is instantly brought to you (can be teleported into a magic circle, hedge, prison, etc. adjacent to you).

sections.heading: Summon NightcrawlerSRD
sections.text: Summon NightcrawlerSRD: Summon (1st level) + Summon Undead (+1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 15 nightcrawler; +8 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 9th level.

sections.heading: Summon ShadowPH1
sections.text: Summon ShadowPH1: Summon (1st level) + Summon Undead (+1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 3 shadow; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (illusionist or access to Darkness domain, Tenebrous bloodline, etc.; -1 level) = 5th level.

sections.heading: Summon Spell DampeningMP
sections.text: Summon Spell DampeningMP: Warding (summon; 1st level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (emanates from you; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (6 ranks Planar Sense as a class skill; -1 level) = 4th level; prevents summoning in a 120’r. around you for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Summon SpiritUM
sections.text: Summon SpiritUM: Summon (1st level) + Summon Undead (+1 level) + Augment Spell (up to CR 12; +6 levels) = 8th level; summons a ghost of up to CR 12, which remains 1 rd./level (indefinitely if controlled using Command Undead feat).

sections.heading: Summon StampedePC
sections.text: Summon StampedePC: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to line; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to extreme; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (5’ to 30’; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level; damage cap 15d6 bludgeoning and knocked prone in 30’ wide path.

sections.heading: Summoner ConduitUC
sections.text: Summoner ConduitUC: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (redirect instead of dispel; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (2 targets; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (conjured creature and its summoner; -2 levels) = 5th level; harmful spells cast against conjured creature are also redirected to its summoner.

sections.heading: Summoning WindCA
sections.text: Summoning WindCA: Whispering wind (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (locate creature; +4 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (wu jen; -1 level) = 6th level; wind locates creatures identified and delivers message.

sections.heading: Sun Father’s FaceDr346
sections.text: Sun Father’s FaceDr346: Bestow feat (1st level) + Variable Spell (ability focus: channel positive energy or skill focus: Handle Animal; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Sun domain; -1 level) = 1st level; swift casting grants you +3 to Handle Animal check or +1 to save DC of channeled positive energy.

sections.heading: Sunbeam
sections.text: Sunbeam: Flare (q.v.; 0 level) + Augment Spell (blinding light; +1 level) + Extend Spell (blindness, 1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (jet of flame; +1 level) + Positive Spell (+0 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to line; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard action; +1 level) = 7th level; 1 beam/round deals up to 10d6 fire (up to 30d6 vs. undead, oozes, fungi, etc.) and blinds 1 hr./level (permanent if numen invested). Variants:

sections.heading: Sunburst
sections.text: Sunburst: Flare (q.v.; 0 level) + Augment Spell (blinding; +1 level) + Extend Spell (blindness, 1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (jet of flame; +1 level) + Positive Spell (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 15d6; -2 levels) = 8th level; burst deals 7.5d6 fire (1.5 x 15d6  vs. undead, oozes, fungi, etc.) and blinds 1 hr./level (or permanently if numen invested). Variants:

sections.heading: Sunder BreakerACG
sections.text: Sunder BreakerACG: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Overwhelming Evocation (+2 levels) + Delay Spell (sundered; +1 level) + Resistible Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); attacker’s weapon (or attacker, if unarmed) takes 1d6 force damage/level (max. 5d6, Fort half, ignores hardness and energy resistance) the first time it uses Sunder against the subject.

sections.heading: Sundered Serpent CoilMC
sections.text: Sundered Serpent CoilMC: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level; ranged touch attacks for 5d6 bludgeoning plus grappled (2d6/rd.). Watery fistS&M is the same, but Restricted to the Water domain (2nd level).

sections.heading: Sundering ShardsACG
sections.text: Sundering ShardsACG: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Energy Admixture (piercing; +0 levels) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (successful sunder; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; +1d6 slashing/piercing to victim (max. 5d6) the first time the target weapon successfully Sunders an item held/worn.

sections.heading: SunmaceDr346
sections.text: SunmaceDr346: Light (0 level) + Augment Spell (dazzling; +4 levels) + Shape Spell (emanation to ray; ­2 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (jet of flame; +1 level) + Positive Spell (+0 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard action; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Sun domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; 1 ranged touch attack/rd. deals up to 0.5 x 5d6 fire (1.5 x 5d6 vs. undead) plus dazled 1 rd. (and undead affected as by bright sunlight).

sections.heading: SunspearRR
sections.text: SunspearRR: Light (0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Suppress GlyphMF
sections.text: Suppress GlyphMF: Warding (magical writings; 1st level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (detection: magical writing; +2 levels) = 6th level; you detect the presence of magical writings (learn locations, type, strength by concentrating), and their effects are suppressed in a 20’r. emanation around you.

sections.heading: Suppress LesserAUG2
sections.text: Suppress LesserAUG2: Compel (don’t use magic; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) = 4th level; target cannot cast spells or use spell-like abilities or spell completion items for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Suppress SchismME
sections.text: Suppress SchismME: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 effect/3 levels; +2 levels) + Bouncing Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell ([mind-affecting], possession, telepathy, etc.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 5th level; dispels or suppresses up to 1 effect/level as listed above, and subject must succeed at opposed Concentration checks to cast/manifest same.

sections.heading: Suppressing Field, Otiluke’sCM
sections.text: Suppressing Field, Otiluke’sCM: Warding (1st level) + Variable Spell (choose school or subtype at time of casting; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; prevents casting of one school or descriptor (e.g., [evil] or [fire]) of magic in area.

sections.heading: Sure StrikePHII
sections.text: Sure StrikePHII: Bestow feat (Insightful Strike; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (BAB +6 effects; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); as a swift action, apply your highest mental attribute modifier as a bonus to your next attack roll and damage.

sections.heading: Sure-Footed Shuffle, Otto’sGA
sections.text: Sure-Footed Shuffle, Otto’sGA: Skill enhancement (Acrobatics; 0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Communal Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; each target +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Acrobatics.

sections.heading: SurelifeSRD
sections.text: SurelifeSRD: Warding (1st level) + Variable Spell (declare at time of casting; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 8th); subject immune to one specific harmful condition or attack form (e.g., swords, or drowning) for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Surge Selector, Hornung’sTM2
sections.text: Surge Selector, Hornung’sTM2: Hand of fate (0 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (wild surges; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (wild magic; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 7th); for the next 1 hr./level, roll twice when triggering a wild surge and select which result to use (you know what dice rolls will result in).

sections.heading: Surmount AfflictionUM
sections.text: Surmount AfflictionUM: Warding (1st level) + Variable Spell (one condition type specified at casting; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 2nd level; suspends effects of 1 condition (not necessarily an [affliction]) for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: SuspensionShS
sections.text: SuspensionShS: Mage hand (0 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 5,832 lbs./level; +5 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 2 hrs./level; +6 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (move unattended object only; -2 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 7th level (listed as 4th); levitates extremely large objects (buildings, bridges, etc.), can move them with concentrations, and they otherwise hover in place for up to 2 hrs./level.

sections.heading: SustenanceSRD
sections.text: SustenanceSRD: Creation (nutritious liquid; 1st level) + Delay Spell (time release; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 1/8 cu. ft./level; -1 level) = 2nd level; you are fully nourished (in terms of food and water) for 1 hr./level. SustainBED also adds Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/ level; +3 levels) and Ritual Spell (full round; ­1 level) = 4th level.

sections.heading: Swarm of CrystalsSRD
sections.text: Swarm of CrystalsSRD: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (30 ft. to 15 ft.; -1 level) + Inexorable Evocation (+3 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level; 5d6 slashing to those in 15-ft. cone (no save). Variants:

sections.heading: Swarm SkinAPG
sections.text: Swarm SkinAPG: Summon (1st level) + Variable Spell (combine types and/or numbers; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard action; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (witch, or access to Pestilence domain; -1 level) = 6th level; you summon up to 3d6 spider swarms, 2d4+1 rat swarms, 1d4+1 crab or wasp swarms, 1d3 centipede or leech swarms, or 1 army ant swarm. You can also “mix-and-match” by selecting fewer numbers (e.g., 1 centipede swarm plus 1d3 wasp swarms). The swarms are active only as long as you consciously direct them, and then disperse.

sections.heading: Swift Mount, Drawmij’sGA
sections.text: Swift Mount, Drawmij’sGA: Celerity (0 level) + Variable Spell (primary movement rate; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (animal or magical beast used as a mount; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+10 ft. to +30 ft.; +1 level) = 2nd level; mount’s primary speed increases by +30 ft.

sections.heading: Swift WaterRR
sections.text: Swift WaterRR: Celerity (0 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Target-Specific Spell (ship only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Augment Spell (+10 ft. to +50 ft.; +2 levels) = 2nd level; increases ship’s speed by 5 mph for 1 hr./level. Billowed sailRRO is Augmented one more step (3rd level; speed increase of 7 mph).

sections.heading: SwimCA
sections.text: SwimCA: Celerity (swim speed; 0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Augment Spell (+10 ft. to +30 ft.; +1 level) = 1st level; target gains swim speed 30 ft. (or +30 ft. to existing) for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Swim, QuickswimSW
sections.text: Swim, QuickswimSW: Celerity (swim speed; 0 level) Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Water domain; -1 level) = 1st level; your swim speed increases by +10 ft.

sections.heading: Swim, SpeedMF
sections.text: Swim, SpeedMF: Celerity (swim; 0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + [Cascade Spell (augmented bull’s strength; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (carrying capacity only; -2 levels)] + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) = 3rd level; grants swim speed of 30 ft. and doubles carrying capacity for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Swim, Touch of the SeaAPG
sections.text: Swim, Touch of the SeaAPG: Celerity (swim speed; 0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+10 ft. to +30 ft.; +1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); grants swim speed of 30 ft. for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Swimmer, ChampionRR2
sections.text: Swimmer, ChampionRR2: Bestow feat (Favored Terrain; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Athletics; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); subject gains favored terrain (underwater) +2 and an additional +1/2 levels (+10 max.) enhancement to Athletic checks for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Swoop, Bendal’s7S
sections.text: Swoop, Bendal’s7S: CatfallSRD (q.v.; 0 level) – Effect-Specific Spell (+2 levels) = 2nd level; immediate casting turns fall into 20-ft. flight.

sections.heading: Sword of ConscienceBED
sections.text: Sword of ConscienceBED: Damage attribute (Wis; 1st level) +Mass Effect Spell (+1 attrubute; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (evil only; -2 levels) = 4th level; one evil creature takes 4d4 Wis and 4d4 Cha damage (Will half).

sections.heading: Swords of the Ash WingsBotD
sections.text: Swords of the Ash WingsBotD: Jet of flame (0 level) + Energy Admixture (slashing; +0 levels) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain, etc.; -1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap +10d6 (half fire, half slashing) to one melee attack or Close ranged attack.

sections.heading: Symbol of HealingUM
sections.text: Symbol of HealingUM: Spark of life (1st level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 5th level; listed as 3rd.

sections.heading: Symbol of HopelessnessPH1
sections.text: Symbol of HopelessnessPH1: Compel (surrender; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 9th level (listed as 7th).

sections.heading: Symbol of Insanity
sections.text: Symbol of Insanity: Damage attribute (Wis; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Crippling Drain (+2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r; +1 level) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 8th level; deals 3d4 Wis drain when triggered.

sections.heading: Symbol of MirroringUM
sections.text: Symbol of MirroringUM: Figment (duplicate image of creature in area; 0 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +4 levels) + Delay Spell (proximity actibating condition; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level; when triggered, creates 1 illusory duplicate each of up to 1 creature/level within 30 ft.

sections.heading: Symbol of Persuasion
sections.text: Symbol of Persuasion: Ray of beguiling (1st level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to 0; -1 level) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 6th level; 1d6 +1/level (+15 max.) Cha penalty vs. caster (Intuition half, charmed at 1) in 40’r. for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Symbol of RevelationUM
sections.text: Symbol of RevelationUM: Warding (glamers; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 6th level (listed as 4th); when invisible, glamered, or shapechanged creature triggers symbol, all such in area are limned in faerie fire for 10 min./level..

sections.heading: Symbol of SealingUM
sections.text: Symbol of SealingUM: Wall of force (5th level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (over door or other portal only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level; when triggered by unauthorized intruder, a wall of force lasting 10 min./level appears over the warded portal.

sections.heading: Symbol of ScryingUM
sections.text: Symbol of ScryingUM: Scrying (4th level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) = 6th level; when triggered, you can scry area for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Symbol of SlowingUM
sections.text: Symbol of SlowingUM: Slow (3rd level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to 0; -1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level.

sections.heading: Symbol of Spell LossMF
sections.text: Symbol of Spell LossMF: SpellcrashACG (q.v.; 5th level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 8th level; when activated, those in area lose 1 prepared spell, spell slot, or daily spell-like ability use per round (starting with the highest-level and working down) until a save is made.

sections.heading: Symbol of Stunning
sections.text: Symbol of Stunning: Compel (do nothing; 2nd level) + Augment Spell (stun; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level.; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (proximity activating condition; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 7th level. Note numen investiture for latent spells (8th x CL 15th x 50 = 6,000).

sections.heading: Symbol of VulnerabilityUM
sections.text: Symbol of VulnerabilityUM: Warding (1st level) +  Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels: resistance, energy resistance, DR, SR; +3 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 9th level; when activated, those in area lose resistance bonuses to saves, energy resistance, spell resistance, damage reduction, and up to 2-3 other forms of protection for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Symbol of Weakness
sections.text: Symbol of Weakness: Damage attribute (Str; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Selective Spell (password bypass; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 7th level; 4d4 Str damage to up to 1 creature per level.

sections.heading: Synaptic PulseOcA
sections.text: Synaptic PulseOcA: Inertia (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (telepath, psychic, etc.; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); stuns those in 20’r. for 1 rd.

sections.heading: Synaptic Pulse, GreaterOcA
sections.text: Synaptic Pulse, GreaterOcA: Synaptic pulse (q.v.; 4th level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Fell Sickening (+1 level) = 5th level; stuns (Will sickens) 1 rd./level or until save.

sections.heading: Synaptic ScrambleOcA
sections.text: Synaptic ScrambleOcA: Ray of obliviousness (1st level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) = 4th level; close target takes 1d6 +1/level (+15 max.) penalty to Wis (Intution half, confused at 1) and is staggered for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: SynestheteSRD
sections.text: SynestheteSRD: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (other senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (2 senses affected; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); you can feel either light or sound, making your eyes or ears (respectively) extraneous. Alternatively, you can see sound or hear light (bypassing the blinded, dazzled, and/or deafened condition).

sections.heading: Synostodweomer, Simbul’sMF
sections.text: Synostodweomer, Simbul’sMF: Bestow feat (Magical Talent: arcane cure light wounds; 1st level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (6 ranks; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Spontaneous Spell; +1 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 7th); for the next 1 rd./level, you can spontaneously convert your spells of up to 3rd level into cure wounds spells.

sections.heading: So
sections.text:
Bind (0 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. cubes to 5-ft. cubes; -1 level) + Residual Spell (+1 level) = +2 levels; area of difficult terrain entangles.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteShaping (2nd level) + Object-Specific Spell (earth & stone only; -2 levels) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 27 cu. ft./level; +2 levels) = +2 levels; collapses into heap.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Variants:
