sections.text: Telekinetic ManeuverSRD: Bind, push, or topple (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) Variable Spell (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple possible; +1 level) = 4th level; each round you concentrate, you can bull rush, grapple, or trip one opponent.

sections.heading: Telekinetic ProjectileOcA
sections.text: Telekinetic ProjectileOcA: Mage hand (0 level) + Cascade Spell (energy mace; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (damage to projectile and target; +1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (5d6 to 1d6; -1 level) = 0 level; close ranged attack deals 1d6 bludgeoning to projectile used (1 lb./level, up to 5 lbs. max.) and target struck.

sections.heading: Telekinetic Sphere, Otiluke’s
sections.text: Telekinetic Sphere, Otiluke’s: Otiluke’s resilient sphere (q.v.; 4th level) + Cascade Spell (mage hand; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 216 lbs./level; +3 levels) = 8th level.

sections.heading: Telekinetic StormOcA
sections.text: Telekinetic StormOcA: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) = 9th level; damage cap 25d6 force plus stuns enemies 1 rd. in a 40’r. burst from you (force can destroy barriers and extend beyond them).

sections.heading: Telekinetic ThrustSRD
sections.text: Telekinetic ThrustSRD: Mage hand (0 level) + Cascade Spell (invisible needle; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 8 lbs./level; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Manifested Spell (­1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 13d6, divided among objects.

sections.heading: Telepathic CensurePC
sections.text: Telepathic CensurePC: Warding (telepathy; 1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); target cannot send or receive telepathic communication.

sections.heading: Telepathic DistractionMC
sections.text: Telepathic DistractionMC: Resistance (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +3; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (vs. [mind-affecting] only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Restricted Spell (telepathy ability or access to Telapthy discipline; -1 level) = 0 level; 1d6 nonlethal plus -3 to saves vs. [mind-affecting] for 1 min./level (Will half/neg.).

sections.heading: Telepathic StrikeDr345
sections.text: Telepathic StrikeDr345: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (auditory also; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Int; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 attribute/3 levels; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to planar; +6 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (special; see below; -2 levels) = 9th level (listed as 3rd); you can see or hear through the eyes and ears of 1 creature on the same plane, and can deal 1d4 damage to each attribute of 1  creature within sight of the alter senses target.

sections.heading: TelepathyOcA
sections.text: TelepathyOcA: MindlinkSRD (1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Tenuous Spell (subjects must remain within emanation for effect to continue; -1 level) = 4th level; you can mentally communicate with all creatures within 120 ft. of you, for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Telepathy BlockBED
sections.text: Telepathy BlockBED: Warding (mindlink and derivatives; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 5th level; blocks telepathic communication in 60’r. emanation.

sections.heading: Telepathy TapBED
sections.text: Telepathy TapBED: Detection (telepathy; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (concentration to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; allows you to detect and eavesdrop on telepathic communication within medium range for 1 rd./level, but only if you understand the communicants’ language(s).

sections.heading: Teleport AttackAUG
sections.text: Teleport AttackAUG: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) = 7th level; touch teleports target into object within close range, where is grappled 1 rd./level and takes 3d4 Con/rd. (Fort half).

sections.heading: Teleport BlockAUG2
sections.text: Teleport BlockAUG2: Warding (teleportation; 1st level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 5th level. Cf. dimensional lock.

sections.heading: Teleport Coordinates TransferAUG2
sections.text: Teleport Coordinates TransferAUG2: Detection (2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to planar; +6 levels) + Shape Spell (cone to target; -1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (teleport coordinates only; -2 levels) - Concentration Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; you gain “very familiar” knowledge of teleport destination.

sections.heading: Teleport Object
sections.text: Teleport Object: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Widen Spell (10 lbs./level to 30 lbs./level; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Variable Spell (destination; +1 level) + Target-Specific Spell (object only; -2 levels) = 7th level; teleports object within weight limit elsewhere on same plane, or into the Deep Ethereal. AKA vanishPH1.

sections.heading: Teleport TracerAUG2
sections.text: Teleport TracerAUG2: Detection (teleport destination; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (time ago of teleport: inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) – Concentration Spell (-1 level) = 7th level (listed as 6th); learn destination of last teleport from within a medium-range quarter-circle. Cf. trace teleportSRD.

sections.heading: Teleport TriggerSRD
sections.text: Teleport TriggerSRD: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to continental; +5 levels) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Mishap Possibility (ad hoc -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 5th level.

sections.heading: Teleport, BalefulSRD
sections.text: Teleport, BalefulSRD: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (necromancy to conjuration [teleportation]; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 5th); deals up to 10d6 negative energy damage (Fort half).

sections.heading: Teleport, DivertSRD
sections.text: Teleport, DivertSRD: Dispel (0 level) + Augment Spell (divert instead of negate; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (teleportation only; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) = 7th level; immediate casting redirects teleports made during the next round from within (or into) 60 ft. of you. Variants:

sections.heading: Teleport, Fiendish
sections.text: Teleport, Fiendish: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to planar; +5 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (outsider; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (self and 50 lbs. only; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (fiendish caster; -1 level) = 3rd level; this is the greater teleport ability used by demons, devils, etc.

sections.heading: Teleport, InterplanetaryUM
sections.text: Teleport, InterplanetaryUM: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to planar; +6 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (you must accompany them; -1 level) = 9th level.

sections.heading: Teleport, Trobriand’s BalefulWCS
sections.text: Teleport, Trobriand’s BalefulWCS: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (target: touch to close; +1 level) + Reach Spell (destination: close to continental; +4 levels) = 6th level; transport close target to destination within 100 miles/level. Thasdrubal’s laganetic transfer (from Jack Vance’s The Eyes of the Overworld) is similar, but the victim must be helpless or restrained (4th level).

sections.heading: Teleportation Circle
sections.text: Teleportation Circle: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to planar; +6 levels) + Irresistible Spell (not blocked by earth or stone; +2 levels) + Inexorable Spell (no save; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (targets to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (until activated, +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (designated target location; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 9th level; invest numen (as a command-activated item) to make it re-usable.

sections.heading: Teleport, TraceSRD
sections.text: Teleport, TraceSRD: Detection (teleport destination; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (time ago of teleport: inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 5th level; with concentration, you learn about teleportation from area within the last 1 rd./level: 1st rd.—presence or absence; 2nd rd.—number and greatest range category; 3rd—destinations. Cf. teleport tracerAUG2.

sections.heading: Temporal AccelerationSRD
sections.text: Temporal AccelerationSRD: Time stop (q.v.; 9th level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Cascade Spell (spook; -1 level) = 8th level (listed as 6th); swift time stop lasts 1 rd.; you are shaken thereafter.

sections.heading: Temporal DivergencePC
sections.text: Temporal DivergencePC: Augury (2nd level) + Cross-Class Spell (arcane; +1 level) – Ritual Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (effects of next spell cast; -2 levels) = 7th level; resolve two spells you could cast that round, then retain the casting desired, after seeing the results (if DC 24 Spellcraft check fails, you take 7d4 Wis damage).

sections.heading: Temporal JoltDr350
sections.text: Temporal JoltDr350: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Variable Spell (other targets are armor and/or items held by primary target; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 4th level; ranged touches deal 10d6 entropic to target and its armor (if any separately), plus up to 1 item held per 3 levels above 6th.

sections.heading: Temporal RegressionPC
sections.text: Temporal RegressionPC: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (remove condition; +1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Delay Spell (swift; +3 levels) + Itnterrupting Spell (+1 level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (location and condition at time of casting; -2 levels) = 8th level; immediate casting transports you to where you were when you cast the spell (if within Close range), heals you up to 20d6 hp taken since then, and removes any one condition accrued since then.

sections.heading: Temporal RepairDr350
sections.text: Temporal RepairDr350: Warding (Time domain; 1st level) + Cascade Spell [(dispel; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (Time spells only; -2 levels)] + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 5th level; dispels Time domain spell effects and prevents those spells from impinging into the area.

sections.heading: Temporal Stasis
sections.text: Temporal Stasis: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+4d4; +3 levels) + Crippling Drain (+4 levels) + Tenuous Spell (susceptible to dispel magic; -1 level) = 8th level; touch deals 5d4 Dex drain, and target in stasis if Dex 0 or lower. Variants:

sections.heading: Temporal VenomAUG2
sections.text: Temporal VenomAUG2: Ray of obliviousness (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 hit or touch/level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level; one touch (or hit with affected weapon) per level inflicts 1d6+½ levels (+10 max.) penalty to Wis (confused at 1, no save) for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Tempus FugitUA1
sections.text: Tempus FugitUA1: Bestow feat (Skill Focus: Endurance; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Endurance; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (restless slumber only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Fast Recovery; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) = 5th level; affected creatures heal at 2x normal rate and regain spells, etc. as if had Endurance as a class skill with 10 ranks more than is actually the case (e.g., those with 0 ranks are fully rested after 4 hours; those with 10 ranks after 1 hour). Note that this construction differs from the one shown in Chapter 8; consider this as a separate version. Variants:

sections.heading: Tentacle WallsTM2
sections.text: Tentacle WallsTM2: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Tenacious Spell (+1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 7th level; six tentacles attack intruders (ranged touch for 3d6 each plus entangled) for up to 1 min./level. After that time, you can immediately re-invest the latent spell numen to reset the trap.

sections.heading: TentaclesCWH
sections.text: TentaclesCWH: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grappled; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (mage hand; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Athletics; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 15d6 and +10 to +5; -1 level) = 6th level; you gain two secondary tentacle attacks (10d6 bludgeoning each plus grappled 1 rd./2 levels), +5 to Athletics checks, and can manipulate objects at Close range.

sections.heading: Teratoid CaressPC
sections.text: Teratoid CaressPC: Damage attribute (1st level) + Variable Spell (Dex or Cha, randomly; -1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (see below; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (demon cultist; -1 level) = 3rd level; touch deals 1d4 Dex or Cha damage. Invest 150 x CL numen for this damage to recur whenever the subject of the curse casts a [good] spell, channels positive energy, or offers a prayer to a good-aligned deity.

sections.heading: Terra Cotta LionOA
sections.text: Terra Cotta LionOA: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 6 animated object; +4 levels) = 5th level; animates statuette into a Huge animated object (8 HD; CP 4: faster, stone, 2 additional attacks).

sections.heading: Terra Cotta WarriorOA
sections.text: Terra Cotta WarriorOA: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 2 animated object; +2 levels) = 3rd level; animates statuette into a Medium animated object (4 HD; CP 2: faster, stone).

sections.heading: Terrain BondUC
sections.text: Terrain BondUC: Bestow feat (Favored Terrain; 1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+6 terrain bonus; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger; -2 levels) = 4th level; you gain one favored terrain with a +6 bonus, or else improve one by +4 (subject to normal maximum).

sections.heading: ThalassemiaSW
sections.text: ThalassemiaSW: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Bane Spell (fixed: [fire]; +0 levels) + Augment Spell (1d6 to 15d6; +3 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 5th); damage cap 15d6 necrotic (15d6 vs. [fire]) by touch.

sections.heading: Theft WardARG
sections.text: Theft WardARG: Skill enhancement (Perception; 0 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (notice theft; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 to +5; +1 levels) = 1st level; you are +1/2 levels (max. +10) to Perception checks to notice theft (pickpocketing, etc.) from you.

sections.heading: There/Not ThereTM2
sections.text: There/Not ThereTM2: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Transdimensional Spell (ethereal plane; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Widen Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Variable Spell (object might be ethereal for some onlookers and not others, but no control over effect; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (wild magic; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; single object up to 400 lbs. is 50% likely to be ethereal with respect to each individual observer.

sections.heading: Thief WardAUG2
sections.text: Thief WardAUG2: Skill enhancement (Stealth; 0 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) = 4th level (listed as 2nd); −1/2 levels to Stealth checks made within 40 ft. of you.

sections.heading: Thief’s LamentTM2
sections.text: Thief’s LamentTM2: Skill enhancement (0 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 skill/3 levels; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 5-ft.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Law or Greed domain; −1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); -10 penalty to Disable Device, Sleight of Hand, and Stealth checks in affected area; also Bluff at CL 12th, Athletics at 15th, Perception at 18th.

sections.heading: Thin AirFB
sections.text: Thin AirFB: Ray of enfeeblement (1st level) + Variable Spell (divide among attributes; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (those with favored terrain or no breath immune; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (+15 to +5; -2 levels) = 2nd level; total attribute penalty of 1d6 + ½ levels (+5 max., divided evenly among stats), Fort half total.

sections.heading: Thirst for WarRR
sections.text: Thirst for WarRR: Deflection (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Endurance; +1 level) + Consecrate/Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 2 hrs./level; +3 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (enervation; -4 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level; one subject/level gains long-lasting +3 sacred/profane bonus to AC, attacks, damage, saves, and Endurance checks; you gain 1d4 temp. negative levels.

sections.heading: Thorn BodyAPG
sections.text: Thorn BodyAPG: Invisible needle (0 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) = 3rd level; non-reach melee attackers take 1d6 piercing +1/level (+10 max.) per hit against you. Variants:

sections.heading: Thorn WhipPH5
sections.text: Thorn WhipPH5: Mage hand (0 level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (invisible needle; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 1st level (listed as 0); damage cap 5d6 percing plus pull up to 20 ft. closer.

sections.heading: Thought BroadcastTM2
sections.text: Thought BroadcastTM2: Detection (thoughts; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (cone to emanation; +1 level) + Extend Spell (concentration to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Mind domain; -1 level) = 4th level; all within 20’r. of target can “hear” its thoughts (Intuition neg.).

sections.heading: Thought EchoOcA
sections.text: Thought EchoOcA: Glamer (1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 1st level; mind reading reveals illusory thoughts rather than target’s actual ones; Intuition disbelief applies.

sections.heading: Thought ShieldSRD
sections.text: Thought ShieldSRD: Spell resistance (q.v.; 5th level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (mind-affecting; -2 levels) = 3rd level; as an immediate action, you gain SR 10 + Concentration bonus vs. [mind-affecting] spells and powers for 1 rd. Variants:

sections.heading: ThoughtsenseOcA
sections.text: ThoughtsenseOcA: Detection (thoughts; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (cone to emanation; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (concentration to 1 min./level; +2 levels) = 7th level (listed as 4th); you automatically sense presence, locations, and sentience (non-, animal, full) within 60 ft. for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Threefold AspectAPG
sections.text: Threefold AspectAPG: Glamer (1st level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Variable Spell (attribute boost: +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 5th level; you seem as you did/will when you were/will be a young adult (+2 Dex, +2 Con, -2 Wis), mature adult (+2 Int, +2 Wis, -2 Dex), or elder (+4 Int, +4 Wis, -4 Str, ­2 Dex), and can switch back and forth as a standard action. Illusion has verbal, auditory, olfactory, and tactile components.

sections.heading: Threestones7S
sections.text: Threestones7S: Energy mace (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) = 2nd level; damage cap 12d6 bludgeoning (Reflex half), divided among targets.

sections.heading: Thunder FieldPHII
sections.text: Thunder FieldPHII: Sound lance (1st level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 15d6; -1 level) = 6th level (bard 5th); damage cap 15d6 sonic/rd. and trips those in a 20’r. spread.

sections.heading: Thunder StaffTM2
sections.text: Thunder StaffTM2: Alter senses (deafness; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to cone; +1 level) + Explosive Spell (+1 level) = 5th level; 30-ft. cone dazes 1 rd. and deafens 1 rd./level (Fort neg.), and Reflex save or ejected from area.

sections.heading: ThunderclapPH5
sections.text: ThunderclapPH5: Sound lance (1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to 0; -1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; ­2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 0); damage cap 5d6 sonic in 5’r. of you (Fort half).

sections.heading: Thunderclap, GreatMF
sections.text: Thunderclap, GreatMF: Topple (0 level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses: hearing; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) = 7th level; knocks prone, dazes 1 rd., and deafens 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Thundering DrumsAPG
sections.text: Thundering DrumsAPG: Sound lance (1st level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) + Widen Spell (30-ft. to 15-ft.; -1 level) = 2nd level (bard 1st); deals 1d6 sonic/level (max. 5d6) and knocks prone.

sections.heading: Thunderstomp, GreaterACG
sections.text: Thunderstomp, GreaterACG: Topple (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to line; +1 level) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Tiger’s ToothMH
sections.text: Tiger’s ToothMH: Greater magic fang (q.v.; 3rd level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 to +1/3 levels; +2 levels) = 2nd level; swift casting grants you +1/3 levels to one natural attack, or (2 + 1/3 levels) divided among multiple natural attacks, for 1 rd.

sections.heading: Time HopSRD
sections.text: Time HopSRD: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (target: touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level. In essence, the subject teleports to its current location, but the transfer takes 1 rd./level (or until saves) instead of occurring instantaneously. Variants:

sections.heading: Time PoolTM2
sections.text: Time PoolTM2: Augury (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Knowledge or Time domain; -1 level) = 5th level; you see up to 1 rd./level of a past event you specify. Variants:

sections.heading: Time ShieldDr350
sections.text: Time ShieldDr350: Metaphysical feat (Extend Spell; 1st level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 30’r.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (spell durations only; -2 levels) = 4th level; spell durations in a 30’r. emanation elapse twice as fast.

sections.heading: Time ShudderACG
sections.text: Time ShudderACG: Haste or slow (3rd level) + Variable Spell (no control over which applies; -1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) = 3rd level; those in 20’r. either hasted (50%) or slowed (50%) for 1 round.

sections.heading: Timeheal, GreaterRR2
sections.text: Timeheal, GreaterRR2: RevivifySRD (q.v., see under breath of lifeCRB; 5th level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Skill Focus (Heal); +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Heal; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; ­1 level) = 6th level (listed as 7th); restores life and/or up to 15d6 hp by bringing duplicate forward in time (caster need not have ranks in Heal as a class skill).

sections.heading: Timeheal, LesserRR2
sections.text: Timeheal, LesserRR2: Remove condition (attribute damage; 1st level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Cross-Class Spell (accane; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Skill Focus (Heal); +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Heal; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6 and 5d4 to 4d4; -1 level) = 4th level; subject heals up to 10d6 hp and 4d4 attribute damage, as if by compressed passage of time.

sections.heading: Timely InspirationAPG
sections.text: Timely InspirationAPG: Variable Spell (skill enhancement or blessing; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Quicken Spell (+1 level) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (+10 to +5; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); retroactively grants +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to a failed attack roll or skill check to ally within close range.

sections.heading: Tin Soldiers, Otto’sGA
sections.text: Tin Soldiers, Otto’sGA: Summon (1st level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; choose 1d3 human warriors (5th level) or 1d4+1 total human warriors (3rd level) and/or light warhorses.

sections.heading: Tiny Hut, Leomund’s
sections.text: Tiny Hut, Leomund’s: Wisp (0 level) + Cascade Spell (endure elements; +1 levels) + Cascade Spell (zephyr; +1 level) + Shape Spell (emanation; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (centered on you; -1 level) + Selective Spell (those inside can see out; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (cannot be moved once created and ends if you leave; -2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (reduce winds only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 3rd level; 20’r. emanation, opaque from outside, provides shelter against extreme temperatures and winds up to severe.

sections.heading: Tomb of LightBED
sections.text: Tomb of LightBED: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (Compel: stand helpless; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard action; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 7th); touch causes helplessness 1 round plus 1d4 Con drain; continues each round you concentrate. AKA tomb of jadeOA.

sections.heading: Tonal Attack, Otto’sGA
sections.text: Tonal Attack, Otto’sGA: Damage attribute (1st level) + Variable Spell (Int, Wis, or Cha; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 4th level spell dealing 4d4 damage to primary spellcasting attribute (save each round to halve remaining damage).

sections.heading: Tones of Forgetfulness, Otto’sGA
sections.text: Tones of Forgetfulness, Otto’sGA: Skill enhancement (0 level) + Variable Spell (1 skill/round; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) = 2nd level; subject is -1/2 levels (-10 max.) on skill checks.

sections.heading: Tongue of AngelsAUG2
sections.text: Tongue of AngelsAUG2: Bestow feat (skill focus: Linguistics; 1st level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 0 level; for 1 rd./level, you treat Linguistics as a class skill and can speak Celestial.

sections.heading: Tongue TieRRE
sections.text: Tongue TieRRE: Glamer (1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (no visual, olfactory, or tactile; -3 levels) = 3rd level; subject unable to speak intelligibly. Invest 150 x CL numen to maintain effect indefinitely.

sections.heading: Torment, Gormoth’sDD
sections.text: Torment, Gormoth’sDD: Enhancement (2nd level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 roll/3 levels; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (civilized humanoids; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5 miles; +7 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (around sacrificial poison victim; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 2 hrs./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (evil caster; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (+1/2 to +1/4; -2 levels) = 8th level; civilized humanoids within large area take -4 penalty to attacks, damage, saves, checks, and AC for 2 hrs./level (or invest 400 x CL numen to maintain effect indefinitely).

sections.heading: Torments, Chardun’sRR
sections.text: Torments, Chardun’sRR: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of beguiling; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 5d6 nonlethal +2d6/rd. plus sickened and penalty to Charisma (1d6 + ½ levels).

sections.heading: Tornado BlastSRD
sections.text: Tornado BlastSRD: Energy mace (0 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Explosive Spell (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) = 8th level (listed as 9th); damage cap 20d6 plus 1d6/rd. thereafer (Reflex half/neg., no SR) and thrown from area.

sections.heading: Torrent of TearsCM
sections.text: Torrent of TearsCM: Sickening touch (0 level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = 3rd level; subject is sickened and blinded for 1 rd./level. Variants:

sections.heading: TortureDr348
sections.text: TortureDr348: Detection (lies; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (cone to target; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (answering truthfully eliminates Con damage; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); victim must answer questions truthfully for 1 rd./level or take 1d4 Con/rd.

sections.heading: Torture StrikeDr342
sections.text: Torture StrikeDr342: Damage attribute (Str; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (nausea; 1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Attack-Specific Spell (nonlethal only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Suffering domain; -1 level) = 1st level; nonlethal melee attack also deals 1d4 Str damage and nauseates 1 rd.

sections.heading: Touch of ChaosCRB
sections.text: Touch of ChaosCRB: Hand of fate (0 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd.; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Chaos domain; -1 level) = 1st level; for the next round, creature touched rolls everything twice, takes the worse of the two.

sections.heading: Touch of DarknessCRB
sections.text: Touch of DarknessCRB: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +2 levels) + Hex Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Darkness domain; -1 level) = 0 level; touch blinds target for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Touch of GloryCRB
sections.text: Touch of GloryCRB: Skill enhancement (0 level) + Variable Spell (any Cha-based; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (until check made; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Glory domain; -1 level) = 0 level; touch grants +1/2 levels to next Cha-based skill check or Cha attribute check made.

sections.heading: Touch of GoodCRB
sections.text: Touch of GoodCRB: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd./level; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell [(skill enhancement; +1 level) + Variable Spell (diferent skills; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level)] + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Good domain; -1 level) = 1st level; touch grants +2 sacred bonus to attacks and damage, +3 to saves, and +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to skills for 1 rd.

sections.heading: Touch of JorascoRE
sections.text: Touch of JorascoRE: Spark of life (1st level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Delay Spell (standard action; +1 levels) + Restricted Spell (halfling caster; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (5d6 to 1d6; -1 level) = 1st level; you can heal up to 2d6 hp, divided among standard action touches as you see fit.

sections.heading: Touch of MadnessCD
sections.text: Touch of MadnessCD: Inertia (0 level) + Augment Spell (dazing; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Madness domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; touch dazes target for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Touch of MadnessRR2
sections.text: Touch of MadnessRR2: Damage attribute (Wis; 1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (necromancy; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Crippling Drain (+2 levels) = 6th level; touch deals 3d4 Wis drain (Will half).

sections.heading: Touch of RenewalRR2
sections.text: Touch of RenewalRR2: Spark of life (1st level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (remove condition [affliction]; +1 level) + Augment Spell (moderate to serious; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 5th level; touch removes minor, moderate, or serious [affliction] condition, and grants fast healing 10 for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Touch of SlimeUM
sections.text: Touch of SlimeUM: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; slime deals 1d4 Con/round until removed (or by successful save).

sections.heading: Touch of TanilRR
sections.text: Touch of TanilRR: Hand of fate (0 level) + Delay Spell (until time chosen; +2 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Fate domain; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); recipient can roll twice, keeping the better result, at any one time of choosing.

sections.heading: Touch of the EelRR
sections.text: Touch of the EelRR: Electric arc (0 level) + Delay Spell (until touch or touched; +2 levels) + Variable Spell (can cast on someone else; +1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6. Variants:

sections.heading: Touch of the GravebornCM
sections.text: Touch of the GravebornCM: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +2 levels) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Touch of the Phoenix (Jack Vance, The Green Pearl)
sections.text: Touch of the Phoenix (Jack Vance, The Green Pearl): Remove condition (refraction; 1st level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 0 level.

sections.heading: Toughen ConstructECS
sections.text: Toughen ConstructECS: Enhancement (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (natural armor; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (construct; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1/4 to +1/3; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Artifice domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; construct gains +1/3 levels enhancement to natural armor for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Towering ThunderheadCM
sections.text: Towering ThunderheadCM: Wisp (0 level) + Cascade Spell (zephyr; +1 level) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell [(bestow feat: Empower Spell; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Sudden Metamagic; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (electricity or sonic only; −2 levels)] + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to long; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to cylinder; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10’r. to 30’r.; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (tornado to windstorm and 9th to 7th; -2 levels) = 9th level; 30’r., 150-ft.-tall cylindrical windstorm obstructs vision and creates difficult terrain (you are immune), and Empowers [electicity] and [sonic] spells (subject to Sudden Metamagic limits).

sections.heading: Toxic TongueCM
sections.text: Toxic TongueCM: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: TracerAUG
sections.text: TracerAUG: Detection (distance and direction; 2nd level) + Object-Specific Spell (focus object only; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to continental; +4 levels) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); you know distance and direction to pre-set object by concentrating, if within 100 miles/level. Invest 1,200 x CL numen (4th level x 50 x 6) to maintain effect.

sections.heading: Transfer SentienceDD
sections.text: Transfer SentienceDD: PossessionOcA (3rd level) + Threnodic Spell (+0 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min,/level; -2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 5th); you possess one construct.

sections.heading: TransfixCA
sections.text: TransfixCA: Compel (do nothing; 2nd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoids; -2 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Tenuous Spell (save each hour to end effect, and effect ends if specific condition chosen by you is met; -1 level) = 6th level; maintain effect by investing 300 x CL numen.

sections.heading: Transform DeadRR2
sections.text: Transform DeadRR2: Remove condition (undeath; 1st level) + Crippling Drain (permanent critical condition; +4 levels) + Cascade Spell (lesser animate deadUM (+2 levels) + Augment Spell (CR 1 ghoul; +1 level) + Creayture-Specific Spell (zombie; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 5th level (non-necromancer 6th); turns one zombie into a ghoul.

sections.heading: Transformation, Tenser’s
sections.text: Transformation, Tenser’s: Polymorph (humanoid; 3rd level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (+2 to +4; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (enhancement: natural armor; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 6th level; you gain +6 Str; +4 Dex, Con (and Wis at CL 12th, Cha at 15th, Int at 18th); +2 natural armor (+1/4 levels), and BAB equal to your character level, but cannot cast spells for 1 rd./level except using the Natural Spell feat. Variants:

sections.heading: Transformation, Yaral’s TotemicRR
sections.text: Transformation, Yaral’s TotemicRR: Polymorph (animal; 3rd level) + Cascade Spell (alter person; retain humanoid abilities; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (no poison, tremorsense, etc.; -1 level) = 4th level.

sections.heading: TransfusionDr339
sections.text: TransfusionDr339: Ray of enfeeblement (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost; +1 level) + Variable Spell (choose attribute at time of casting; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 total bonus; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 2nd level; touch deals 1d6+1/2 levels attribute penalty; you gain +4 bonus to same attribute.

sections.heading: Translator, Terole’sRR
sections.text: Translator, Terole’sRR: Skill enhancement (Knowledge: linguistics; 0 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (+10 to +5; -1 level) = 4th level (bard 3rd); 1 creature/level gains +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Linguistics (learning one or more new languages in the process) for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Translocation TrickMF
sections.text: Translocation TrickMF: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Cascade Spell (dimensional skip on target creature; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (switch places only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (disguise self; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (disguise other; +1 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) = 5th level; you and target switch places and are disguised to appear as each other.

sections.heading: Transmute Blood to AcidUM
sections.text: Transmute Blood to AcidUM: Acid splash (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Fell Sickening (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (staggered; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard action; +1 level) = 6th level (listed as 9th); damage cap 20d6 acid/rd. (Fort half) plus staggered 1 rd. (Fort neg.) and sickened 1 rd./level (Fort 1 rd.); effects apply to one target each round you concentrate.

sections.heading: Transmute Mud to Rock
sections.text: Transmute Mud to Rock: Shaping (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (turns mud to rock only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bind: can trap those in mud; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 216 cu. ft./level; +3 levels) = 5th level; affects one 6-ft. cube/level; those in mud can save vs. Reflex to avoid being trapped, but otherwise the effect is instantaneous (until freed) rather than 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Transmute Rock to LavaCA
sections.text: Transmute Rock to LavaCA: Bind (0 level) + Cascade Spell (jet of flame; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 20d6; -1 level) = 9th level.

sections.heading: Transmute Rock to Mud
sections.text: Transmute Rock to Mud: Bind (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (rock floor or ceiling only; -2 levels) = 5th level; one 10-ft. cube/level becomes entangling difficult terrain.

sections.heading: Transmute Water to DustUA1
sections.text: Transmute Water to DustUA1: Transmute (1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 216 cu. ft./level; +3 levels) = 5th level; turns large volume of water (equivalent to one 6-ft. cube/level) to silty dust (quickly becomes mud if additional water still present). Invest 250 x CL numen to make effect permanent.

sections.heading: Trap the Soul
sections.text: Trap the Soul: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (demiplane represented by gem; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Tree NapDHD
sections.text: Tree NapDHD: Glamer (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Fast Recovery; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 2 hrs./level; +4 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (in contact with tree; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (olfactory and tactile effects; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (gnome or access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); for up to 2 hrs./level, you are disguised as part of a tree (visual, auditory, olfactory, tactile/thermal components) and gain Fast Recovery.

sections.heading: Tree Shape
sections.text: Tree Shape: Polymorph (plant; 3rd level) + Cascade Spell (enlarge person; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (enhancement: natural armor; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; -1 level) + Augment Spell (additional -10’; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of clumsiness; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; you become a Large tree, with +4 natural armor (additional +1/4 levels) but -30 ft. speed and penalty to Dex equal to 1d6 + ½ level (-10 max.).

sections.heading: Tree SteedTM2
sections.text: Tree SteedTM2: Animate object (1st level) + Widen Spell (Large; +3 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (log or other length of wood; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant or Travel domain; -1 level) = 4th level; animates Large log as steed (HD 4, Spd 30 ft., swim 30 ft.; Str 19, carry 350/700/1,050 lbs.)

sections.heading: Tremor StepDr342
sections.text: Tremor StepDr342: Topple (0 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to [earth] bloodline, domain, etc.; -1 level) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: TremorsenseSC
sections.text: TremorsenseSC: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (touch; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (access to next tier effect; +1 level) = 3rd level; you gain tremorsense out to close range for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Tribal FrenzyMH
sections.text: Tribal FrenzyMH: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (recipients must be same type as caster; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (tribal leader; -1 level) = 3rd level (implied 2nd); allies within 20’r. gain +2 enhancement to Strength. For the higher-level versions, apply the Augment Spell feat.

sections.heading: Trick FatePnH
sections.text: Trick FatePnH: Hand of fate (0 level) + Quicken Spell (+4 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Destined bloodline, Fate domain, etc.; -1 level) = 2nd level; as a swift action, reroll any 1 roll just made.

sections.heading: Trigger RuneRR
sections.text: Trigger RuneRR: Delay Spell (ends delay; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to long; +1 level) + Target-Specific Spell (rune you previously placed; -2 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); you can cause any glyph, symbol, or rune magic trap you previously placed to activate, at long range.

sections.heading: TripPH1
sections.text: TripPH1: Topple (0 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (dazes only those tripped; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to horizontal wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 5-ft. squares; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; trips those passing through one 5-ft. square/level (Reflex neg.) and dazes those tripped 1 rd. (Fort neg.).

sections.heading: Trip VineHB
sections.text: Trip VineHB: Topple (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to horizontal wall; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (in vegetated area; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 4th level  (listed as 2nd); one 10-ft. square/level trips those entering.

sections.heading: Tripping Hand, Bigby’sPHII
sections.text: Tripping Hand, Bigby’sPHII: Topple (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) = 1st level.

sections.heading: Trollish FortitudeS&M
sections.text: Trollish FortitudeS&M: Regenerate (q.v.; 7th level) + Cross-Class Spell (arcane; +0 levels due to metamagic synergy) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) – Ritual Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 10d6; ­3 levels) = 6th level; you gain regeneration 10 (fire or acid) for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: TrollshapePHII
sections.text: TrollshapePHII: Polymorph (giant; 3rd level) + Cascade Spell (enlarge self; +2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 6th level; you become a Large troll: +4 AC, +4 Str, -2 Dex, darkvision 60 ft. and scent, 2 claws (1d4) and a bite (1d6), rend special attack, and fast healing 5.

sections.heading: True CastingCM
sections.text: True CastingCM: Bestow feat (Irresistible Spell; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Sudden Metamagic; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); one spell cast before the end of your next turn does not allow SR.

sections.heading: True MetabolismSRD
sections.text: True MetabolismSRD: Spark of life (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (psychometabolism; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (remove condition: severed limbs; +1 level) + Crippling Drain (+3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Augment Spell (serious to critical; +1 level) = 8th level; for 1 min./level, you gain fast healing 1/level (max. 20) and can restore useless/ severed digits/limbs.

sections.heading: True Seeing
sections.text: True Seeing: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Planar Sense; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (warding: glamers; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 other warding effect/3 levels: figments, etc.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 5th level; subject gains darkvision and can see ethereal and through illusions.

sections.heading: True Strike
sections.text: True Strike: Bestow feat (Insightful Strike; 1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +6 effects; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (attacks only; -1 level) + Cascade Spell [(bestow feat: Precise Shot; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +11 effects; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (concealment only; -2 levels)] + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; insight bonus to attacks and damage equal to your highest mental attribute bonus (rather than a flat +20 to attacks). Variants:

sections.heading: TruenameUA1
sections.text: TruenameUA1: Variable Spell (see below; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 7th level.

sections.heading: TruevenomSRD
sections.text: TruevenomSRD: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +2 levels) = 4th level; one melee attack carries poison (4d4 Con, Fort half) as a [strike].

sections.heading: Trust in the GodsRR2
sections.text: Trust in the GodsRR2: Hand of fate (0 level) + Sective Spell (+1 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 reroll/level; +3 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Fate domain; -1 level) = 6th level; as an immediate action, you can reroll any die roll once per level and select the best result.

sections.heading: Truth’s WingsAUG2
sections.text: Truth’s WingsAUG2: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 4 fire-infused giant eagle; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) = 6th level (listed as 4th).

sections.heading: TsunamiAPG
sections.text: TsunamiAPG: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (push; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to line; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (expeditious retreat, to redirect 60 ft. rather than 30 ft.; +1 level) = 9th level; damage cap 25d6 in a line moving 60 ft./round, and possibly pushing and/or knocking prone. Variants:

sections.heading: Tugging StrandsAPG
sections.text: Tugging StrandsAPG: Hand of fate (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Fate domain; -1 level) = 4th level; immediate casting forces target to reroll one roll.

sections.heading: Tunnel SwallowUnd
sections.text: Tunnel SwallowUnd: Energy mace (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cylinder; +2 levels) + Explosive Spell (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) = 6th level; section of tunnel up to 20 ft. in diameter and 50 ft. long crushes for 1d6/level (15d6 max., no SR) and forces creatures out the far end.

sections.heading: TurbiditySW
sections.text: TurbiditySW: Wisp (0 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (ailing; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (underwater; -2 levels) = 2nd level; mud in water obstructs vision, casuses ailing condition in those within 20 ft. of you.

sections.heading: Turn AnathemaCC
sections.text: Turn AnathemaCC: Spook (0 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level)  + Creature-Specific Spell ([evil]; -2 levels) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Restricted Spell (able to channel positive energy; -1 level) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); up to 2d4 + 1/level (+5 max.) HD worth of evil creatures in 60-ft. burst are panicked 1 rd./level (no save). Vary alignment and channeling restriction as needed.

sections.heading: Turn ResistancerRR2
sections.text: Turn ResistancerRR2: Warding (positive energy; 1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (also turning; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead; -2 levels) = 3rd level; undead touched is immune to positive energy and turn undead effects for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Turn UndeadSRD
sections.text: Turn UndeadSRD: Spook (0 level) + Threnodic Spell (+0 levels) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Restricted Spell (able to channel positive energy; -1 level) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) = 5th level; up to 2d4 +1/level (+10 max.) HD worth of undead in 60-ft. burst are panicked 1 rd./level (no save).

sections.heading: Turtle Soup7S
sections.text: Turtle Soup7S: Creation (soup; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (mage armor; +2 levels) + Variable Spell (armor to cover; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (energy mace; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); creates up to 1 cu. ft./level of soup in a “bowl” of force; can be thrown for up to 10d6 bludgeoning damage.

sections.heading: Twilight HazeACG
sections.text: Twilight HazeACG: Gloom (0 level) + Cascade Spell (wisp; +1 level) + Reach Spell (0 to close; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (2 steps to 1 step; -1 level) = 2nd level; ambient light lowered by 1 step, and concealment from fog in 20’r.

sections.heading: Twilight LuckBED
sections.text: Twilight LuckBED: Resistance (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Lucky Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (abstinent caster; -1 level) = 1st level; +1 luck bonus to saves for 1 min./level. Variants:

sections.heading: Twisted SpaceUC
sections.text: Twisted SpaceUC: Compel (attack wrong melee target; 2nd level) + Variable Spell (random target within reach; -1 level) + Cross-Class Spell (enchantment to transmutation; +1 level) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Twisting ThrustSLPG
sections.text: Twisting ThrustSLPG: Bestow feat (Improved Critical; 1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +6 effects; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; you gain doubled threat range, +4 to confirm for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Tyrant’s RebukePnA
sections.text: Tyrant’s RebukePnA: Inertia (0 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Cha; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (archdevil cultist, etc.; -1 level) = 1st level; touch deals 1d4 Cha damage plus staggered 1 rd.

-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger; -2 levels) = 3rd level; you gain additional +3 to attacks and damage vs. your quarry, and you ignore any cover or concealment is has less than total.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteMass true strikeRR2 is not Personal (+1 level), works at medium range (+1 level), and affects 1 creature/ level (+3 levels) = 6th level. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteNamed bulletUC Cascades Channeled energy mace (+2 levels) and wraithstrike (q.v.; +2 levels), and is Delayed (can hold the charge up to 10 min./level; +1 level), Creature-Specific, (-2 levels), and Variable (select type at time of casting; +1 level) = 4th level; vs. specified creature type, piece of ammunition gains insight bonus to attack, ignores less than full concealment, targets touch AC, and deals +1d6/level damage (max. +10d6). DepthsurgeSW: Energy mace (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1,000’r.; +3 levels) + Explosive Spell (+1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (body of water; -2 levels) = 8th level; damage cap 20d6 (may sink ships), plus forces creatures out of area. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteFlashfloodSSt: Sickening touch (0 level) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) + Augment Spell [(nausea; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level)] + Cascade Spell (creation: water; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cone; +1 level) + Widen Spell (30 ft. to 90 ft. cone and 1 cu. ft./level to 27 cu. ft./level; +2 levels) + Explosive Spell (+1 level) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 15d6; -1 level) = 8th level; 90-ft. cone of water deals 15d6 nonlethal plus nauseated 1 rd. and forced out of area (which becomes difficult terrain thereafter). 2,430 cu. ft./level of water is produced (90 squares in cone x 27 cu. ft./level each).Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteMaelstromCD: Energy mace (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cylinder; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10’r. to 180’r.; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Explosive Spell (+1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (within larger body of water; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Water domain, etc.; -1 level) = 8th level; damage cap 20d6 plus 2d6/rd. and dragged to bottom (180’r., max. 900 ft. deep), where expelled. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteTidal SurgeCD: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (push; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (quench; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Water domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 5th level; damage cap 10d6 (fires quenched by like amount) plus bull rush. Tidal surgeUW adds Variable Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (burst to line or cone; -1 level) = 5th level; choose 30-ft. cone or long range line.  Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteTidal WaveShS: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Athletics; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to line; +1 level) + Widen Spell (5 ft. to 90 ft.; +4 levels) + Explosive Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to line of sight; +4 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (must originate in water greater than 100 ft. deep; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 8th level (listed as 9th); wave 90 ft. deep and 90 ft. wide travels ¼ mile/level, deals 20d6 damage, imposes -1/2 levels to Athletics checks in area, and either carries creatures/objects along with it or deposits them at base of wave, 90 ft. underwater.  Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteWaterspoutCD: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cylinder; +2 levels) + Explosive Spell (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 7th level; damage cap 15d6 (divine 10d6) plus ejected from 10’r., 50-ft. deep spout (possibly suspended within spout 1 rd./level first, taking damage each round).Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteWaves of BloodHA: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) + Explosive Spell (+1 level) + Residual Spell (+1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); those in 30-ft. cone are pushed out of the area and sickened 1 rd./level; area is difficult terrain.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
