sections.heading: Ubiquitous VisionSRD
sections.text: Ubiquitous VisionSRD: Bestow feat (Alertness; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Perception; +1 level) + Augment Spell (11 ranks effects; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (+10 to +5; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); you gain Alertness +3 and +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Perception. Variants:

sections.heading: Umbral StrikePC
sections.text: Umbral StrikePC: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Energy Admixture (cold; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Augment Spell (10d6 to 20d6; +2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 7th); ranged touch deals up to 20d6 (half cold, half negative energy) and blinded 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Umbral WeaponPC
sections.text: Umbral WeaponPC: Ray of frost (0 level) + Silent Spell (+0 levels) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (missed by you in melee that round; -2 levels) = 1st level; 1/round as a swift action, make a touch attack against a creature you missed that round (damage cap 5d6 cold).

sections.heading: Unadulterated LoathingUM
sections.text: Unadulterated LoathingUM: Compel (avoid creature specified; 2nd level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 3rd level; subject attempts to stay at least 60 ft. away from specified individual (cannot be itself, its familiar, etc.). Invest 900 x CL numen (3rd level x 50 x 6) to maintain.

sections.heading: UnbindingCD
sections.text: UnbindingCD: Dispel (0 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Irresistible Spell (opposed check not needed; +2 levels) = 8th level; dispels latent spells, lock spells, magical hedges and barriers, spells based on bind and their derivatives, etc.

sections.heading: UnbondMW
sections.text: UnbondMW: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (familiar or companion bond; -2 levels) = 4th level; temporarily severs bond between familiar, animal companion, bonded item, etc. and master. Cf. sever spiritUW.

sections.heading: UnbuckleRR
sections.text: UnbuckleRR: Enhance (2nd level) + Item-Specific Spell (armor; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (mage hand; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) – Concentration Spell (mage hand is instantaneous; -1 level) + Augment Spell (1/4 to 1/2; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (special; -1 level) = 3rd level; undoes buckles, clasps, laces in area, and armor partly falls off (-1 AC/2 levels for 1 min./level or until re-donned; Reflex neg.).

sections.heading: Unceasing Vigilance of the Holy SentinelTM2
sections.text: Unceasing Vigilance of the Holy SentinelTM2: Warding (1st level) + Irresistible Spell (+3 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (true seeing; +5 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (you must stay in 20’r. of casting location; -2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; ­2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Protection domain; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 6th level; while on unmoving vigil, you gain true seeing and are immune to Cha damage/drain, fatigue, fear, nonlethal damage, thirst, and surprise.

sections.heading: Undaunted FixtureAUG2
sections.text: Undaunted FixtureAUG2: Bind (0 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) = 2nd level; two objects are bonded for 1 rd./level (permanently if invest 400 x CL numen).

sections.heading: Undead Anatomy IUM
sections.text: Undead Anatomy IUM: Polymorph (undead; 3rd level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + negative energy affinity (ad hoc +1 level) = 3rd level; this also subsumes the zombie formRR spell.

sections.heading: Undead Anatomy IIUM
sections.text: Undead Anatomy IIUM: Undead anatomy I (3rd level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (enlarge self or reduce self; +1 level) = 5th level; Tiny to Large size.

sections.heading: Undead Anatomy IIIUM
sections.text: Undead Anatomy IIIUM: Undead anatomy II (5th level) + Augment Spell (1 more size step; +1 level) = 6th level; Diminutive to Huge size.

sections.heading: Undead Anatomy IVUM
sections.text: Undead Anatomy IVUM: Undead anatomy III (6th level) + Variable Spell (ethereal jaunt instead of other abilities; +1 level) = 7th level (listed as 8th). AKA ghostformCA, shadow bodyOcA.

sections.heading: Undead Bane WeaponLM
sections.text: Undead Bane WeaponLM: Greater magic weapon (3rd level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min../level; +4 levels) + Ray Splitting (multiple attacks; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 5d6; -3 levels) = 4th level; damage cap 9d6. Weapon gains +1/4 levels enhancement bonus and deals +5d6 (1 attack/rd.,), +4d6 (2/rd.), +3d6 (3/rd.), or +2d6 (4/rd.) positive energy damage to undead on a hit.

sections.heading: Undead LieutenantMF
sections.text: Undead LieutenantMF: Bestow feat (Command Undead; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Knowledge: the planes; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (enhancement; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead; -2 levels) = 3rd level; one of your undead followers gains Command Undead feat, +1/2 levels to Knowledge (the planes) and +1/4 levels bonus to final Command Undead leadership score.

sections.heading: Undead WardTM2
sections.text: Undead WardTM2: Hedge (undead; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (emanation to cubes; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Fell Frightening (+1 level) + Threnodic Spell (+0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 5th level; undead cannot enter one 5-ft. cube/level, and panicked 1 rd./level (Will shaken) if try.

sections.heading: Undeath to Death
sections.text: Undeath to Death: Spark of life (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead; -2 levels) = 6th level; damage cap 90 hp positive energy to undead in 40’r. burst (Will half). Variant:

sections.heading: Undeniable GravityMH
sections.text: Undeniable GravityMH: Mage hand (0 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Extend Spell (conc. to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (prevention of flying; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+10 ft. to +30 ft.; +1 level) = 2nd level; flying creature is constantly pulled downwards at a rate of 50 ft./rd. for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Understand DeviceMF
sections.text: Understand DeviceMF: Skill enhancement (Disable Device: 0 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Skill Focus; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); you treat Disable Device as a class skill, and gain +1/2 levels (+5 max.) enhancement bonus to checks.

sections.heading: Undulant InnardsLoM
sections.text: Undulant InnardsLoM: Warding (precision damage; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (protects against nonmagical precision damage; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 3rd level; subject immune to precision damage for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Unerring WeaponUC
sections.text: Unerring WeaponUC: Bestow feat (Improved Critical; 1st level) = 1st level; weapon (or projectiles) +4 to confirm critical threats for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Unfailing PremonitionS&M
sections.text: Unfailing PremonitionS&M: Augury (2nd level) – Ritual Spell (+2 levels) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Fate or Time domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; you gain sense of relative danger of action contemplated, and also +2 deflection for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: UnhandAUG2
sections.text: UnhandAUG2: Mage hand (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 8 lbs./level; +1 level) + Extend Spell (concentration to inst.; -1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (disarm weapon only; -1 level) = 0 level; ranged disarm of weapon weighing up to 8 lbs./level.

sections.heading: Unholy Aura
sections.text: Unholy Aura: Deflection (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 bonus; +1 level) +

sections.heading: Unholy Blight
sections.text: Unholy Blight: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Bane Spell (good; +0 levels) + Restricted Spell ([evil] caster; -1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 (10d8 vs. good), half negative energy, half unholy, and sickened 1 rd./level (Reflex half/neg.). Other spells dealing negative energy damage and afflictions:

sections.heading: Unholy ChannelRR
sections.text: Unholy ChannelRR: Bestow feat (Reach Spell; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Sudden Metamagic; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (negative energy only; -2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead targets only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); you can cast negative energy spells to repair unded at increased range, subject to limits of Sudden Metamagic feat (but 1/level times as many spells total).

sections.heading: Unholy WardPC
sections.text: Unholy WardPC: Inure (holy damage; 0 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; you gain resistance 30 to holy damage, channeled positive energy, etc.

sections.heading: Unicorn Arrow, Melf’sPHII
sections.text: Unicorn Arrow, Melf’sPHII: Invisible needle (0 level) + Cascade Spell (push; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 15d6 piercing plus bull rush, divided among multiple targets.

sections.heading: Unicorn BloodCM
sections.text: Unicorn BloodCM: Warding (poison; 1st level) + Irresistible Spell (+3 levels) + Cascade Spell (warding: enchantment; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Delay Spell (+1 level) + Tenuous Spell (wardings end when use spark; −1 level) = 6th level (arcane 7th; listed as 5th); you are immune to poison and charm and compulsion effects for 10 min./level; end protection by bestowing 1d6 temp hp/level (max. 15d6).

sections.heading: Unicorn HeartCM
sections.text: Unicorn HeartCM: Skill enhancement (0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 skill/level; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (dimensional skip; +1 level) + Delay Spell (swift action trigger; +3 levels) + Tenuous Spell (skill enhancement ends with teleport; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (+80 ft. to +60 ft. and +10 to +5; -1 level) = 7th level; you gain +5 sacred bonus to one physical skill/level and +60 ft. to speed for 1 hr./level, and can end effect by making a swift dimension door.

sections.heading: Unicorn HornCM
sections.text: Unicorn HornCM: Invisible needle (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Spirited Charge; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (magic weapon; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bless weapon; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 1d6; -3 levels) = 3rd level; you gain gore attack for 1d6 (with +1/4 levels enhancement and overcomes DR/good), plus Spirited Charge, for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: UnityCRB
sections.text: UnityCRB: Resistance (0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +5; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Community domain; -1 level) = 4th level; you and allies in 20’r. gain +5 sacred bonus to saves for 1 rd. as an immediate action.

sections.heading: Unliving RageACG
sections.text: Unliving RageACG: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Cha; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead; -2 levels) = 2nd level; undead gains +2 profane bonus to Str and Cha, and +1 profane bonus to saves. To affect 1/3 levels (as listed), add the Mass Effect Spell feat (+2 levels = 4th level).

sections.heading: Unliving WeaponBVD
sections.text: Unliving WeaponBVD: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Delay Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6. Affected undead explode in 20’r., either when damaged or when set time runs out.

sections.heading: UnluckCA
sections.text: UnluckCA: Hand of fate (0 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = 4th level; for the next 1 rd./level, target rolls everything twice and uses the worse result.

sections.heading: Unnerving GazeBVD
sections.text: Unnerving GazeBVD: Glamer (1st level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) = 1st level; subject sees you as departed loved one (Intuition neg.), is shaken 1 rd./level (Will neg.).

sections.heading: Unseen StrikeCM
sections.text: Unseen StrikeCM: Invisibility (2nd level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 4th); you become invisible the next time you make a successful melee attack. Note numen cost for latent spell effects (e.g., 2nd level x CL 3rd x 50 = 300).

sections.heading: Unwitting AllyAPG
sections.text: Unwitting AllyAPG: Compel (provide flanking; 2nd level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard or rogue; -1 level) = 0 level; target is compelled to use immediate action to aid you in combat (see Aid Another, under “Immediate Actions” in Chapter 7).

sections.heading: Unyielding Form of Inevitable DeathCM
sections.text: Unyielding Form of Inevitable DeathCM: Polymorph (construct; 3rd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (marut only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (enlarge self; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (mage armor; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 to +10; +3 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 8th level; you become a Large marut (+4 Str, -2 Dex, +4 to natural armor, +10 armor; DR 10/adamantine and fast repair 5; acid, electricity, and sonic resistance 10; 2 slams for base 1d6 plus 1d6 electricity, 1d6 sonic, and blindness/ deafness 1 rd.; etc.) for 1 rd./level as a swift action. You do not receive the marut’s other spell-like abilities.

sections.heading: Unyielding RootsCD
sections.text: Unyielding RootsCD: Warding (movement; 1st level) + Irresistible Spell (+3 levels) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (remove condition: afflictions; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (also [death] effects; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (earthen ground; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as 8th); subject cannot be moved, heals 1 hp/level (max. 20) per round, and is cured of afflictions and temporary negative levels each round, for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Urban GraceARG
sections.text: Urban GraceARG: Bestow feat (Favored Terrain: urban; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell ([elf] caster; -1 level) = 1st level; you gain favored terrain (urban) +2 and +10 ft. to land speed for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Urchin’s SpinesSW
sections.text: Urchin’s SpinesSW: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (invisible needle; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Shileding Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (unarmed or grappled only; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (+10 to +0 and 1d4 to 1d2; -2 levels) = 2nd level; unarmed/natural attackers take 1d6 piercing plus 1d2 Dex.

sections.heading: Utter ContemptUM
sections.text: Utter ContemptUM: Ray of beguiling (1st level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (towards target only; -2 levels) = 5th level; target views all within 20 ft. as if their Charisma scores were 1d6+1/level (max +10) points lower; reroll attitude as appropriate (or simply drop 2 steps).

Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteWarning ShoutSC: Bestow feat (Alertness; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Perception; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Alert Bodyguard; +1 level) + Reach Spell (adjacent allies to close range; +1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 3rd level; you gain +1/2 levels (+10 max.) boost to Perception, and you and allies within close range are no longer flat-footed, even if have not acted yet (immediate casting can interrupt other actions).Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteWatchful AncestorsME: Bestow feat (Alertness; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +6 effects; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +5 bonus; +2 levels) + Insightful Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (Reflex saves only; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; you gain Alertness with uncanny dodge and a +5 insight bonus to Reflex saves for 1 min./level. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteWild instinctsRE lasts only 1 min./level (-1 level), is not Augmented (-2 levels), and is Quickened (+3 levels) and Restricted (ranger or access to Animal domain; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 2nd); +10 max. bonus to Percpetion.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
General of UndeathMF is Corrupted (+1 level), Extended to 2 hrs./level (+3 levels), and is Personal rather than Creature-Specific (+1 level) = 8th level; you gain +1/2 levels to Knowlwdge (planes) and +1/2 levels profane bonus to Command Undead leadership score, increasing capacity accordingly (and provides Command Undead feat if not already possessed).Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente

+ Communal Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (evil caster; -1 level) = 8th level; +4 deflection to AC and +4 resistance to saves, plus SR 10 + Concentration bonus vs. [good] spells, and up to 1 [good] creature/level hitting in melee per round takes 1d6 + 1/level penalty to Str. Protection lasts 1 min./level total, divided among recipients.
ChokeCWH: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoid; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6 necrotic/rd. plus sickened 1 rd./level (Fort half/neg.). damage cap 10d6 negative energy (10d8 vs. good; divine 5d6/5d8) plus sickened 1 rd./level.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteFinger of AgonyCM: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Fell Sickening (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 5th); 10d6 necrotic damage plus 2d6/rd., plus sickened and -30 ft. to speed for 1 rd./level (Fort half/neg.).Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente

Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+5 total bonus; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 hr./level; +1 level) = +4 levels;Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteResistance (0 level) + Augment Spell (+3 total bonus; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) = +4 levels;Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteSkill enhancement (0 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (remove condition: fear or emotion; +1 level) + Augment Spell (serious to critical; +1 level) = +4 levels.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
+ Silent Spell (+1 level) = 6th level; for 1 hr./level, each round, subject gains +3 to saves, or +1/2 levels to a skill check, or +4 to attacks and damage; or can end all other effects except the skill boost but also end a [fear] or [emotion] effect on self.

sections.heading: VacancyUA1
sections.text: VacancyUA1: Glamer (1st level) + Shape Spell (emanation to cubes; +0 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. cubes to 30-ft. cubes; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (vacancy; -2 levels) = 4th level; area seems long-abandoned (dust, cobwebs, etc.), with audiovisual, olfactory, and thermal/tactile components.

sections.heading: Valiant FuryCW
sections.text: Valiant FuryCW: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Con; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2 to +4; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +3; +1 level) + Cascade Spell [(resistance; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3 bonus; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (Will saves only; -2 levels)] + Consecrate Spell (+1 level)] + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Manyshot; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin or access to Valor domain; -1 level) = 5th level; subject gains +4 sacred bonus to Str and Dex, +3 to damage, Will saves, net +1 to attacks, and gains 1 extra iterative attack/rd. for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Valiant SteedBED
sections.text: Valiant SteedBED: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 5 unicorn or pegasus; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 6th level; summons unicorn or pegasus steed (use mark of the wild or Thaumaturgy feat to retain service beyond the spell duration).

sections.heading: Vampiric Touch
sections.text: Vampiric Touch: Spark of life (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (arcane; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) = 3rd level; touch deals 1d6 negative energy/2 levels (max. 10d6) to target; caster gains like number of temp. hp. AKA hostile empathic transferSRD. Variants:

sections.heading: Vanishing WeaponBED
sections.text: Vanishing WeaponBED: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (summoning or shadow conjuration only; -2 levels) = 4th level; weapon dispels summoned creatures, shadow conjurations, etc. on a hit (dispel check needed). Projectiles fired from affected weapon have same effect if target within 100 ft. + 10 ft./level.

sections.heading: Vapor of IdiocyRttToH
sections.text: Vapor of IdiocyRttToH: Wisp (0 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Int; +2 levels) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Reach Spell (0 to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) = 9th level; obscures vision and deals 1d4 Int drain/round.

sections.heading: Veil of LustRR2
sections.text: Veil of LustRR2: Ray of beguiling (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Cascade Spell [(skill enhancement: Diplomacy; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+5 to +10; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level)] + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level; target takes Cha penalty of 1d6 +1/2 levels (+10 max.) vs. you, and you gain +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Diplomacy, for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Veil of Positive EnergyAPG
sections.text: Veil of Positive EnergyAPG: Deflection (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+3 bonus; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Cascade Spell [(spark of life; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (+1 level) + Tenuous Spell (ends other effects; -1 level)] + Creature-Specific Spell (vs. undead only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 1st level; you and those adjacent gain +3 sacred bonus to AC and saves vs. undead for up to 10 min./level, end effect by dealing 1d6/level (max. 5d6) positive energy to undead in 5-ft. burst.

sections.heading: Veil of ShadowMH
sections.text: Veil of ShadowMH: Blur (q.v.; 2nd level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Shadow Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level; you gain 20% concealment for 1 min./level, and effect is 10% real vs. see invisibility, etc.

sections.heading: Veil of UndeathLM
sections.text: Veil of UndeathLM: Undead anatomy I (3rd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Heighten Spell (full immunities; +4 levels) = 8th level.

sections.heading: Venomous StareBotD
sections.text: Venomous StareBotD: Compel (fascination; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Scalykind domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6 nonlethal plus fascinated 1 rd. (Will half/neg.).

sections.heading: Vengeance HaloBED
sections.text: Vengeance HaloBED: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Delay Spell (subject slain; +1 level) = 6th level; when subject is slain, his or her slayer takes 1d6/level damage (max. 15d6, half force, half holy; Reflex half, no SR).

sections.heading: Vengeance of MesosRR2
sections.text: Vengeance of MesosRR2: Jet of flame (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (when arcane spells cast in area; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (those casting arcane spells; -2 levels) + Expedient Spell (damage capped by spell level; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 5th); whenever an arcane spell is cast in the area, the caster takes 1d6 fire damage per level of the spell (min. 1d6).

sections.heading: Vengeance of the ScornedDD
sections.text: Vengeance of the ScornedDD: Bestow feat (Favored Enemy; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Survival; +1 level) + Augment Spell (16 ranks equivalent; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (one individual, vs, an entire class of enemies; -2 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level; you gain one individual as a favored enemy, with a +4 bonus to attacks and skill checks, and +8 to damage. Invest 150 x CL numen to maintain effect until chosen enemy is slain.

sections.heading: Vengeful OutrageUM
sections.text: Vengeful OutrageUM: Compel (slay specific enemy; 2nd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (enemy must have harmed target; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (remove fear; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Str; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Con; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+6 total; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (+1 level) + Language-Specific Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) = 6th level; target compelled to seek out and kill enemy, gains +6 Str and Con and immunity to fear vs. that enemy (the caster invests numen, as a latent spell, until the buffs activate; they then last 1 min./level).

sections.heading: Vengeful ShieldAUG2
sections.text: Vengeful ShieldAUG2: Inure (force; 0 level) + Cascade Spell [(bolt of force; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level)] + Reduce Spell (+15 to +5 and 40 to 15; -2 levels) = 3rd level; subject gains resistance to force 15, and non-reach melee attackers take 1d6+5 force damage per hit. Variants:

sections.heading: Venom BoltSK
sections.text: Venom BoltSK: Inertia (0 level) + Cascade Spell (acid splash; +1 level) + Augment Spell (dazed; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Fell Staggering (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to line; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 acid (divine 5d6; Reflex half) plus dazed 1 rd./level or until save (Fort flat-footed).

sections.heading: VenombladeAUG
sections.text: VenombladeAUG: Damage attribute (Str; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (invocation of the knife; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; touch deals up to 10d6 slashing plus 1d4 Str/rd. for 1 rd./level or until save.

sections.heading: VerdigrisSRD
sections.text: VerdigrisSRD: Creation (plant growth; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (energy mace; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 10d6; -3 levels) = 7th level (listed as epic); sudden plant growth over 120’r. area deals 10d6 bludgeoning (Reflex half) and entangles 1 rd./level; vegetation otherwise persists 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Vermin Shape IUM
sections.text: Vermin Shape IUM: Polymorph (vermin; 3rd level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (enhancement; natural armor only; +1 level) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Vermin Shape IIUM
sections.text: Vermin Shape IIUM: Vermin shape I (3rd level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (enlarge self or reduce self, or Augment Spell; +1 level) = 5th level; you become a Tiny to Large vermin.

sections.heading: VerminplagueRR
sections.text: VerminplagueRR: Summon (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 2 rat swarm; +1 level) + Augment Spell (1d4+1 swarms; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; summons 1d4+1 contiguous rat swarms for 1 min./level (swarm 1d6 plus distraction and disease).

sections.heading: Versatile WeaponAPG
sections.text: Versatile WeaponAPG: Transmute (1st level) + Variable Spell (select at time of casting; +1 level) + Augment Spell (rare metal; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (weapon only; -2 levels) = 2nd level; weapon weighing up to 1 lb./level penetrates one metals-based DR (if adamantine, bypasses hardness up to 20). Variants:

sections.heading: VertigoPHII
sections.text: VertigoPHII: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; target must save vs. Intuition or take 3d6 nonlethal damage plus knocked prone (Ref neg.), sickened (Fort neg.), and/or entangled (Ref neg.). Variants:

sections.heading: Vestment of the ChampionUM
sections.text: Vestment of the ChampionUM: Enhancement (2nd level) + Item-Specific Spell (armor or shield; -2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+4 levels) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 2nd level; swift action magic vestment (+1/4 levels) lasting 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Vicious SummonsAUG2
sections.text: Vicious SummonsAUG2: Summon (1st level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 2 fiendish dire weasel; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) = 4th level (listed as 5th); summons a fiendish dire weasel, already grappling if save failed.

sections.heading: Vigilant RestUW
sections.text: Vigilant RestUW: Warding (interrupted rest; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Perception; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) = 6th level (listed as 4th); subject +1/2 levels to Perception and does not lose benefit of rest if sleep is interrupted.

sections.heading: VigorCD
sections.text: VigorCD: Spark of life (1st level) + Augment Spell (+1/level; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level; subject gains fast healing 1 +1/level (+5 max.) for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: VigorSRD
sections.text: VigorSRD: Spark of life (1st level) + Augment Spell (+1/level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; you gain 1d6 +1/level (+5 max.) temp hp.

sections.heading: Village VeilARG
sections.text: Village VeilARG: Glamer (1st level) + Shape Spell (emanation to cubes; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (halfling; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 5th level; area appears to have been the object of some disaster rendering it useless.

sections.heading: Vile LanceBVD
sections.text: Vile LanceBVD: Invisible needle (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Violate Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (enhancement; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 13d6 piercing (half Vile) divided among iterative melee attacks, and with an enhancement bonus to attacks and damage of +1/4 levels.

sections.heading: Vindicator’s ShieldAPG
sections.text: Vindicator’s ShieldAPG: Enhancement (2nd level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (shield; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (until struck in combat; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (able to channel positive energy, proficient with shield; -1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +1/2; +3 levels) = 3rd level; your shield gains +1/2 levels sacred/profane bonus for 1 hr./level or until you are struck in combat (Cf. divine shieldCW).

sections.heading: Vine MineMF
sections.text: Vine MineMF: Animate rope (1st level) + Shape Spell (spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level, +1 level of options) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 5th level; select option each round while you concentrate (standard action):

sections.heading: Vine StrikeUW
sections.text: Vine StrikeUW: Invisible needle (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (unarmed or natural attack only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap +7d6 piercing (divided among attacks) plus target is entangled 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Vines, PoisonCD
sections.text: Vines, PoisonCD: Bind (0 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (vegetated area; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 7th level; vines entangle those within 40’r. and deal 1d4 Con/rd. from poison.

sections.heading: Vile VenomS&M
sections.text: Vile VenomS&M: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (through edged weapon only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) = 6th level (listed as 5th); affected weapon deals +1d4 Con damage per hit (Fort half).

sections.heading: Virility (Larry Niven, “What Good is a Glass Dagger?”)
sections.text: Virility (Larry Niven, “What Good is a Glass Dagger?”): Warding (impotence and refraction; 1st level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (male; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Virulent AllyPC
sections.text: Virulent AllyPC: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 9 piscodaemon; +6 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (daemon cultist; -1 level) = 7th level.

sections.heading: Vision of GloryMF
sections.text: Vision of GloryMF: Resistance (0 level) + Empathic Spell (+1 level) + Delay Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (single save only; -2 levels) = 1st level; subject can spend an immediate action to gain a +1 morale bonus to one saving throw.

sections.heading: Vision of EntropyFC1
sections.text: Vision of EntropyFC1: Spook (0 level) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6 nonlethal (plus 2d6/rd.) and frightened for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Vision of HeavenBED
sections.text: Vision of HeavenBED: Compel (do nothing; 2nd level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell ([evil] descriptor; -2 levels) = 1st level; evil creature is dazed 1 round.

sections.heading: Vision of HellUM
sections.text: Vision of HellUM: Spook (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (panicked to shaken; -2 levels) = 3rd level; those in 40’r. emanation are shaken.

sections.heading: VisitationRRE
sections.text: VisitationRRE: Figment (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to continental; +5 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (illusion of you, saying what you are saying; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Augment Spell (visual and auditory; +1 level) = 2nd level; you appear to subject within 100 miles/level, can speak to recipient for up to 1 rd./level. Variants:

sections.heading: Vitriolic MistUM
sections.text: Vitriolic MistUM: Inure (acid; level) + Cascade Spell (acid splash; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level)] + Augment Spell (30 to 40; +1 level) = 4th level; you gain resistance 5/2 levels (max. 40) to acid, and melee attackers take 1d6 +1/level (+15 max.) acid damage per hit against you. Variants:

sections.heading: Vitriolic SphereCA
sections.text: Vitriolic SphereCA: Acid splash (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+2 levels) = 5th level; damage cap 15d6 plus 4d6/round. Variants:

sections.heading: Vocal AlterationUM
sections.text: Vocal AlterationUM: Glamer (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (no visual or olfactory; -2 levels) = 1st level; changes subject’s voice and/or accent (Linguistics check on caster’s part to simulate the latter).

sections.heading: VocalizeUA1
sections.text: VocalizeUA1: Bestow feat (Silent Spell; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Sudden Metamagic; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) = 2nd level; spells you cast for the next round are Silenced, as if by the Sudden Metamagic feat (limits to total spell level, etc. apply).

sections.heading: Void, Murlynd’sLBMM
sections.text: Void, Murlynd’sLBMM: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +7 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (negative energy plane; -2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (cannot target creatures; gate opening is fixed; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (zephyr; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 7th level. Anyone entering the designated square must save or be sent to the negative energy plane; a storm-force wind blows in that direction.

sections.heading: VolleyUA1
sections.text: VolleyUA1: Dispel (0 level) + Augment Spell (reflect spell; +2 levels) + Bouncing Spell (rebounds back to you if fails to affect caster; -1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) = 6th level (listed as 7th); turns one spell as an immediate action, spell “bounces” back and forth between caster and original target as saves made.

sections.heading: Vomit SwarmAPG
sections.text: Vomit SwarmAPG: Summon (1st level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 2 spider swarm; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 2nd level; summons a spider swarm that you reposition by concentrating.

sections.heading: Vortex, WildTM2
sections.text: Vortex, WildTM2: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Bane Spell (fixed: arcane casters; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cylinder; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10’r. to 5’r.; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (wild magic; -1 level) + Variable Spell (reckless dweomer; +1 level) = 5th level; damage cap 15d6 force (15d8 vs. arcane casters) and explode into wild surge 5%/rd.

sections.heading: Vortex of TeethWotC
sections.text: Vortex of TeethWotC: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 5d6; -3 levels) = 5th level (listed as 4th); area deals 5d6 force/rd. (Reflex half), manifesting as swarming ghostly piranha.

sections.heading: VulnerabilityOA
sections.text: VulnerabilityOA: Warding (DR; 1st level) + Irresistible Spell (+3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 6th); touch temporarily negates target’s damage reduction (if any).

sections.heading: V
sections.text:
AssimilateSRD: Spark of life (1st level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2 to +4; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Empower Spell (+1 level) = 9th level; touch deals 5d6+60 negative energy (no save), and you gain a like number of temp. hp and +4 to 1 attribute/3 levels for 10 min./level.   Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteAura of tyrannyToB is Shaped (target to emanation; +2 levels), Widened (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level), Extended (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels), Personal (­1 level), Sudden (+0 levels), Restricted ([evil] caster; ­1 level), and Reduced (10d6 to 1d6; -2 levels) = 2nd level; as a swift action, deal ½d6 damage to all within 10 feet (Will half) and heal ½d6 for each creature damaged (max. 5d6). Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteBestow woundBVD is Reduced (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; up to 1d6/2 levels (max 5d6). Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteDarkstaffRR Cascades enervation (+4 levels) and is Concentration (standard; +1 level) = 8th level; one touch attack/rd. deals 1d6 negative energy/2 levels and 1d4 temp. negative levels (do not stack); caster heals like amount of damage.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteDoom ScarabsPHII is Shaped (target to cone; +1 level) and Widened (30 ft. to 60 ft.; +1 level) = 5th level; 1d6/2 levels (5d6 max.) to those in area and you heal like amount.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteLeech FieldRR is close range (+1 level) and Shaped (target to spread; +2 levels) = 6th level; 1d6/2 levels (7.5d6 max.) in 20’r. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteMorgannaver’s StingDr181 is Resistible (-1 level) and Cascades sickening touch (+1 level) + Augment Spell (ailing; +1 level) = 4th level (listed as 5th); 1d6/2 levels (max. 5d6, Fort half) and victim ailing 1 rd./level.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteSpectral TouchLM: Enervation (4th level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 6th level; 1 touch/rd. deals 1d4 temp. negative levels and grants you up to 15d6 temp. hp.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteVampiric BladeSRD: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell [(spark of life; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cross-Class Spell (arcane/psionic; +1 level)] + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 3rd level; damage cap 4d6 necrotic (divided among iterative attacks), and you heal like amount. AKA claws of the vampireSRD, vampiric weaponRR2.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Divine retaliationPHII is Personal (-1 level) and Sudden (+1 level) = 3rd level. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteEctoplasmic feedbackLM is Personal (-1 level), Extended (1 min./level; +1 level), Creature-Specific (incorporeal) rather than Reduced = 3rd level; 1d6 +1/level (+10 max.) force damage and max. resistance 30.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteFeedback strikeAUG also affects Close attackers (+1 level), lasts 10 min./level (+2 levels), and is Reduced 1 fewer step (+1 level) = 7th level; 1d6 +1/level (+15 max.) and resistance 30.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteLet go of meSRD cascades dispel instead of inure, and is Irresistible (no dispel check needed; +2 levels),  Inexorable (+1 level), Quickened (+3 levels), Interrupting (+1 level), Creature-Specific (grappler) rather than Reduced, and not Extended (-2 levels) = 7th level (listed as epic); as an immediate action (silent, stilled), deal up to 20d6 force (ignores energy resistance and hardness) to anything grappling you, and/or automatically dispel any magic restraining you. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteSunmantleBED: Daylight (3rd level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd./level; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bolt of force; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (+10 to +5; -1 level) = 4th level; subject sheds bright light in 60’r.; melee attackers take 1d6+5 force damage per hit. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteWarding GlobesAUG2: Deflection (0 level) + Augment Spell (scaling bonus; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bolt of force; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) = 4th level; you gain +2 deflection, +1/6 levels to AC for 1 min./level, and non-reach attackers take 1d6 force/level (max. 15d6; up to 1 attack/3 levels).  Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Greater Versatile WeaponAPG: Magic weapon (1st level) + Cascade Spell (versatile weapon q.v.; +2 levels) = 3rd level; weapon gains +1/4 levels enhancement bonus, penetrates DR/magic and one special metal type. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteHeart of the MetalACG: Transmute (1st level) + Variable Spell (choose at casting; +1 level) + Augment Spell (special metal; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (weapon only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Variable Spell (multiple weapons weighing up to 1 lb./level; +1 level) = 3rd level; temporarily changes weapons (up to 1 lb./level total) to adamantine, cold iron, or silver. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteLesser Versatile WeaponAPG: Versatile weaponAPG (q.v.; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) = 0 level; this is generally used with the Cascade Spell feat to allow spells dealing bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage to penetrate metals-specific DR.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteSparkling SwordDHD: Greater versatile weapon (see above; 3rd level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to War domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; weapon gains +1/4 levels sacred bonus, penetrates DR/magic and one special metal type. Blazing swordDHD (4th level) is Augmented so that the bonus is +1/3 levels.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Impossible AnglesHA: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 5-ft. cubes; -1 level) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 4th level; spatially-warped area sickens those within, counts as difficult terrain for 1 min./level. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteShifting GroundRRE: Topple (0 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (ailing; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) = 6th level (listed as 4th); area knocks prone and causes ailing condition for 1 rd./level.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteVertigo FieldPHII: Glamer (1st level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (no tactile or olfactory; -2 levels) = 6th level (listed as 3rd); nausea and 20% miss chance in 20’r. area of difficult terrain (allies immune to nausea). Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Infernal HealingPC: Spark of life (1st level) + Delay Spell (heals each round until expended; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (evil caster; -1 level) = 1st level; subject gains fast healing 1 for up to 5d6 rounds.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteGreater Infernal HealingPC: Spark of life (1st level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (evil caster; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); subject gains fast healing 5 for 1 rd./level.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componentePersistent VigorACG: Remove condition (afflictions; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; you gain fast healing 10, and [afflictions] are removed or reduced by 2 steps (and/or you gain +2/+4 competence to attacks, damage, saves, and checks) for 1 rd./level. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level): entangles those in area.Residual Spell (+1 level): area is difficult terrain.Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Athletics or Stealth; +1 level): those in area +/2 levels (+10 max. to hide in the vines, or to climb them).
Conditional VisitationRRE: Selective visitationRRE (see below) + Tenacious Spell (+1 level) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) = 7th level; you can re-invest the latent spell numen to cause the visitation to repeat whenever the activating condition is met.  Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteDisguised VisitationRRE: Figment (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to continental; +5 levels) + Ritual Spell (­2 levels) = 3rd level; as visitation, but image can be someone else, saying whatever you want it to.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteDreamSRD: Disguised visitationRRE + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Reach Spell (interplanar; +1 level) + Delay Spell (when recipient falls asleep; +1 level) = 5th level; illusion of messenger in recipient’s dream delivers message lasting up to 1 rd./level. Dream councilOcA uses mindlinkSRD as the seed spell and has a full round casting (+1 level) = 6th level. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteProlonged VisitationRRE: Selective visitation (see below) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full ritual; -1 level) = 7th level, as selective visitation, but message can be longer (or shorter one repeated a number of times).Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteSelective VisitationRRE: Disguised visitation (see above) + Selective Spell (+1 level) – Ritual Spell (full round rather than long ritual; +1 level) = 5th level; only those you designate can see or hear the visitation.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
Babau slimePnH is Overwhelming (+1 level), Extended (1 min./level; +1 levels), Restricted (access to Abyss domain, etc.; -1 level), and Reduced rather than Augmented (-2 levels) = 3rd level; subject gains resistance to acid (max. 15), and weapons hitting take 1d6+5 acid that bypasses hardness and acid resistance (those hitting with natural weapons or unarmed attacks take this damage themselves).Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteEruptive PustulesUM: Acid splash (0 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (+15 to +5; -2 levels) = 3rd level; melee attackers take 1d6 +1/level (+5 max.) acid damage per hit plus save vs. Fort or sickened 1 rd.   Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteMestil’s acid sheathMF is Variable (can also make melee touch attacks) rather than Augmented = 4th level; damage cap 15d6 by melee touch or 1d6 + 1/level (+15 max.) whenever hit with non-reach melee weapon, and resistance is 30 max.
Burst of nettlesUM is close range (-2 levels) and has reduced lingering damage (-1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6 acid plus 1d6/round. Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteCaustic burstAUG is medium range (-1 level), Overwhelming (+1 level), Variable (+1 level), and Mass Effect (1/3 levels) instead of Lingering, and affects a 20’r. (+1 level) = 7th level; up to 20d6 acid in 20’r. burst (Reflex half, bypasses acid resistance) and 1 object/3 levels (metallic first, start with largest) worn/held by each affected creature also takes full damage creature does, bypassing hardness.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteCaustic eruptionUM is Still (+1 level), has a range of 0 (-2 levels), and is Widened (40’r.; +2 levels) and Irresistible (+2 levels) = 7th level; damage cap 20d6 (Reflex half, no SR) +5d6/rd. in 40’r. burst around you.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteFountain of bloodRR2 is medium range (-1 level) and is Selective instead of Lingering (-1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 acid (divine 5d6) to those specified in 10’r. burst.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente

sections.heading: Wages of SinBED
sections.text: Wages of SinBED: Compel (kill nearest evil creature; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (no intoxicant or stimulant use by caster during past week; -1 level) = 6th level; subjects use most effective attacks against nearby evil creatures for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Wake TrailingSW
sections.text: Wake TrailingSW: Bestow feat (Favored Terrain: shipboard; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Survival; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (track ships; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Water domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; you can track ships across water with +1/2 levels to Survival.

sections.heading: Waking DreamsME
sections.text: Waking DreamsME: Variable Spell (blessing, resistance, or spook; +1 level) + Lucky Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level; target gains +1 luck bonus to attacks and damage or saves, or is shaken 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Wall of BlindnessACG
sections.text: Wall of BlindnessACG: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) Shape Spell (target to wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. squares to 20-ft. squares; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (+1 level) = 4th level; blinds 1 rd./level (make permanent by investment of personal numen).

sections.heading: Wall of BonesCA
sections.text: Wall of BonesCA: Invisible needle (0 level + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Cascade Spell [(creation: bones; +1 level) + Widen Spell (27 cu. ft./level; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 10 min./level; -1 level)] + Shape Spell (target to wall; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 1d6; -4 levels) = 4th level; wall (one 10-ft. square/level, 3 in. thick) provides cover, deals 1d6 piercing/rd., and grapples those trying to pass through.

sections.heading: Wall of ChainsBVD
sections.text: Wall of ChainsBVD: Wall of ice (q.v., 4th level) + Versatile Evocation (ice to metal, and cold to piercing; +0 levels) + Shape Spell (damage: touch to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20 ft. to 5 ft.; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 3rd level; damage 5d6 piercing to all within 5 ft. of wall.

sections.heading: Wall of EctoplasmOcA
sections.text: Wall of EctoplasmOcA: Creation (ectoplasm; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Transdimensional Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to wall; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 5th level; 10 sq. ft./level barrier panics those touching it.

sections.heading: Wall of EyesBVD
sections.text: Wall of EyesBVD: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to wall; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (scrying; +4 levels) = 9th level; wall deals Dex drain, allows you to scry through it.

sections.heading: Wall of Fire
sections.text: Wall of Fire: Jet of flame (0 level) + Cascade Spell (wisp; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. squares to 20-ft. squares; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 5d6; -3 levels) = 4th level; damage cap 5d6 and flames obstruct vision. Variants:

sections.heading: Wall of FogPH1
sections.text: Wall of FogPH1: Wisp (0 level) + Reach Spell (0 to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (spread to cubes; +0 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 20-ft.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 1st level; fog bank fills one 20-ft. cube/level.

sections.heading: Wall of GloomCA
sections.text: Wall of GloomCA: Wisp (0 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to wall; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (+1 level) = 4th level (listed as 2nd); wall obstructs vision, and those trying to pass through are frightened away from it.

sections.heading: Wall of GoodMF
sections.text: Wall of GoodMF: Protection from evil (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to wall; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) = 4th level.

sections.heading: Wall of HornetsRR
sections.text: Wall of HornetsRR: Invisible needle (0 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell [(damage attribute: Dex; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level)] + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to wall; +1 level) + Extend Spell (onset: inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Pestilence domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 3rd); those passing through wall take 5d6 piercing plus 1d4 Dex/rd. until save.

sections.heading: Wall of Ice
sections.text: Wall of Ice: Creation (ice; 1st level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 27 cu. ft./level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels] + Cascade Spell (ray of frost; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to wall; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 5d6; -3 levels) = 4th level; one 10-ft. square/level of ice is approx. 3 in. thick (increase thicknes by decreasing area); 5d6 cold damage even if break through.

sections.heading: Wall of IncarnumMI
sections.text: Wall of IncarnumMI: Mage armor (1st level) + Variable Spell (cover; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) + [Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Wis; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels)] + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 levels) + Shape Spell (target to wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20-ft. squares to 5-ft. squares; -1 level) = 5th level; wall of force deals 1d4 Wisdom damage on contact.

sections.heading: Wall of OozeBVD
sections.text: Wall of OozeBVD: Wall of ice (q.v.; 4th level) + Versatile Evocation (ice to slime, and cold to acid; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Dex; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 5th level; damage cap 5d6 plus 1d4 Dex.

sections.heading: Wall of NauseaUM
sections.text: Wall of NauseaUM: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (nauseated 1 round/level to 1 round; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to wall; +1 level) + Extend Spell (wall lasts 1 rd./level; +1 level) = 5th level; nauseates 1 round and knocks prone.

sections.heading: Wall of PainShS
sections.text: Wall of PainShS: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to wall; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 4th level; contact with wall deals up to 10d6 nonlethal plus sickened 1 rd./level or until save.

sections.heading: Wall of SandSSt
sections.text: Wall of SandSSt: Spark of life (1st level) + Cascade Spell (wisp; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (blindness; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to wall; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 5d6; -3 levels) = 6th level (listed as 4th); wall obstructs vision, reduces damage by 5d6, and blinds those passing through it. Arcane casters add Cross-Class Spell (+1 level), but reduce damage cap from 25d6 (-1 level) = also 6th level.

sections.heading: Wall of SoundUM
sections.text: Wall of SoundUM: Sound lance (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. squares to 20-ft. squares; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 10d6; -2 levels) = 5th level (bard 4th).

sections.heading: Wall of TentaclesDr359
sections.text: Wall of TentaclesDr359: Wall of stone (q.v.; 5th level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 rd./level; -3 levels) + Cascade Spell [(energy mace; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grappled; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels)] + Selective Spell (+2 levels) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 5d6; -4 levels) = 7th level (listed as 6th); short-duration wall of stone also deals 5d6 bludgeoning plus grappled 1 rd./level for 5d6/rd., and you and allies can pass through it with no effects.

sections.heading: Wall of Thorns
sections.text: Wall of Thorns: Invisible needle (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 5th level; damage cap 10d6/rd. and entangled; wall itself counts as difficult terrain.

sections.heading: Wall of VerminCSc
sections.text: Wall of VerminCSc: Invisible needle (0 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (wisp; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. squares to 5-ft. squares; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Pestilence domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 plus nauseated 1 rd., and wall obscures vision.

sections.heading: Wall of WaterS&M
sections.text: Wall of WaterS&M: Blessing (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +3; +1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd./level; -2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to wall; +1 level) + Residual Spell (+1 level) = 3rd level; wall counts as difficult terrain for creatures to pass through, and attacks through wall are at -3 to attacks and damage.

sections.heading: Wand ModulationCSc
sections.text: Wand ModulationCSc: Bestow feat (Magical Talent; 1st level) + Channel Spell (into wand; +1 level) + Augment Spell (6 ranks effects; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (spell you know/have prepared; -2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (replaces spell in wand; −2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 3rd); swift action “swaps out” 4th or lower level spell in wand for one of lower level that you know (sorcerer) or have preparted (wizard). AKA convert wandBED.

sections.heading: Wandering Star MotesAPG
sections.text: Wandering Star MotesAPG: Warding (glamers; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (concealment only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Bouncing Spell (+1 level) = 4th level; target illuminated and dazed 1 rd.; if saves, effect “bounces” to a secondary target.

sections.heading: War CryCAd
sections.text: War CryCAd: Skill enhancement (Bluff; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +4; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Dauntuing Strike; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +11 effects; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; you gain +4 morale to attacks and damage and +1/2 levels to Bluff, and those you hit save vs. Will (or opposed Bluff check) or panicked 1 min.

sections.heading: WarcryBED
sections.text: WarcryBED: Spook (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) + Augment Spell (frightened to cowering; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; those in 30-ft. cone cower 1 rd./level (Will save each round to end effect).

sections.heading: Ward MatrixTM2
sections.text: Ward MatrixTM2: Metaphysical feat (Reach Spell; 1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Augment Spell (close to planar; +5 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (abjurations only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Protection or Rune domain; -1 level) = 8th level; wards on up to six locations on the same plane are shared between them.

sections.heading: Ward of the SeasonARG
sections.text: Ward of the SeasonARG: Variable Spell (2 levels’ worth of options; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (change option as standard action; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (elf or half-elf; -1 level) = 3rd level.

sections.heading: Ward the FaithfulAPG
sections.text: Ward the FaithfulAPG: Deflection (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Augment Spell (scaling bonuses; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (followers of same deity; -2 levels) = 3rd level; followers of your deity in 10’r. of you gain +1 deflection, +1 resistance (+1/6 levels to each; max. +4 at 18th level) for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Ward, MinorAUG2
sections.text: Ward, MinorAUG2: Glyph of warding (q.v.; 3rd level) + Reduce Spell (maximum spell level 0 or damage cap 1d6; -3 levels) = 0 level.

sections.heading: Warding GemsBED
sections.text: Warding GemsBED: Spark of life (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 5d6; -3 levels) = 5th level; subject heals 5d6 hp as an immediate action, up to 1 time/3 levels.

sections.heading: Warding Hand, Bigby’sPHII
sections.text: Warding Hand, Bigby’sPHII: Bind (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (entanglement: 1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Warding RuneAPG
sections.text: Warding RuneAPG: Compel (don’t attack; 2nd level) + Creatire-Specific Spell (self; -2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+4 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (target must have been damaged by one of your magical traps that round; -2 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Rune domain; -1 level) = 0 level.

sections.heading: Warding Tones, Otto’sGA
sections.text: Warding Tones, Otto’sGA: Warding (sonic effects; 1st level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) = 4th level.

sections.heading: Wardrobe, Elina’sRR2
sections.text: Wardrobe, Elina’sRR2: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (target: touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (dimensional skip; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (clothing only; -2 levels) = 2nd level; selectively exchanges two outfits of clothing (even if currently worn; Will neg.).

sections.heading: Warning ShoutMF
sections.text: Warning ShoutMF: Figment (0 level) + Shape Spell (cubes to emanation; +0 levels) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1 mi; +6 levels) + Reach Spell (close to 0; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd../level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (no olfactory or visual; -2 levels) = 1st level; 6-word utterance can be heard for up to a mile, wakes up those sleeping naturally. Variants:

sections.heading: Warp FateRD
sections.text: Warp FateRD: Hand of fate (0 level) + Cascade Spell (enhancement; +2 levels) + Insightful Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (save or AC; -1 level) + Augment Spell (+1/3 to +1/2; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Fate domain; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 6th); immediate casting allows you to reroll save with +1/2 levels insight bonus, or reroll one attack against you with +1/2 levels insight bonus to your AC.

sections.heading: Wartrain MountUM
sections.text: Wartrain MountUM: Bestow feat (Mounted Combat; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Intractable; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Creature-specific Spell (animal; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (paladin, access to Animal domain, or mark of the wild; -1 level) = 1st level; mount gains combat training and loses animal skittishness for 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Water Breathing
sections.text: Water Breathing: Creation (breathable air; 1st level) + Communal Spell (+1 level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 27 cu. ft./level; +1 level) + Delay Spell (time-release; +1 level) + Extend Spell (air created: 1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) = 3rd level. A person breathes about 0.25 cubic ft./min. of air, so 27 cubic ft./level lasts 1 creature up to 100 min./level, or 1 creature/level up to 100 minutes (reduce accordingly for larger or smaller creatures, strenuous activity, etc.). Air breathingMC is similar. Variants:

sections.heading: Water RoilAUG
sections.text: Water RoilAUG: Skill enhancement (Athletics; 0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (energy mace; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (in water; -2 levels) = 2nd level; those in water in 60’r. take up to 5d6 bludgeoning (Reflex half) and must succeed at swim checks at -1/2 levels (−10 max.) or go under.

sections.heading: Water to AcidSW
sections.text: Water to AcidSW: Transmute (1st level) + Augment Spell (alchemical liquid; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = 3rd level; up to 1 cu. ft./level of water becomes acid for 10 min./level.

sections.heading: Water to PoisonCA
sections.text: Water to PoisonCA: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+1d4; +1 level) + Delay Spell (until drunk; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 dose/level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (water wu jen; -1 level) = 4th level. Variant:

sections.heading: Water Walk
sections.text: Water Walk: Air walk (4th level; see under mage hand) + Location-Specific Spell (walk on liquids only; −2 levels) = 2nd level (single target). Variants:

sections.heading: Water’s EmbraceRR
sections.text: Water’s EmbraceRR: Bind (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (pinned; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Throat Punch; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (within reach of a quanitity of water at least the size of the victim; -2 levels) = 3rd level; target is pinned 1 rd./level and immediately begins to suffocate. Variants:

sections.heading: Watery DoubleTM2
sections.text: Watery DoubleTM2: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+2 levels) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) = 3rd level; a creature’s image reflected in designated body of liquid triggers a melee touch attack for 1d6/level (max. 10d6) plus 2d6/rd.

sections.heading: Watery PrisonAUG2
sections.text: Watery PrisonAUG2: Polymorph (elemental; 3rd level) + Cascade Spell (hedge; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (target only; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 6th level (listed as 7th); target is polymorphed into a water elemental and confinded to body of water until it is drained or curse removed. Invest 300 x CL numen to maintain effect.

sections.heading: Waxen ImageAPG
sections.text: Waxen ImageAPG: Compel (2nd level) + Variable Spell (move, attack self, lie prone, drop item; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 4th level.

sections.heading: Wave of DeathAUG
sections.text: Wave of DeathAUG: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (30 ft. to 60 ft.; +1 level) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) = 6th level (listed as 8th); damage cap 90 negative energy in 60-ft. cone (Fort half).

sections.heading: Wave of LifeAUG
sections.text: Wave of LifeAUG: Spark of life (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) + Widen Spell (30 ft. to 60 ft.; +1 level) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) = 6th level; up to 90 hp in 60-ft. cone (Will half for undead damaged).

sections.heading: Wave of PainBVD
sections.text: Wave of PainBVD: Inertia (0 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cone; +1 level) = 6th level; stuns 1 rd./level in a 30-ft. cone.

sections.heading: Waves of ColdFB
sections.text: Waves of ColdFB: Bestow feat (Overwhelming Evocation; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (Sudden Metamagic; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to cone; +1 level) + Widen Spell (30 ft. to 60 ft.; +1 level) = 7th level (listed as 6th); up to 2 spells/3 levels in area bypass resistance/immunity to cold, and those in area are shaken 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Waves of EcstasyUM
sections.text: Waves of EcstasyUM: Compel (do nothing; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Fell Staggering (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cone; +1 level) = 7th level; those in cone dazed 1 round (Will neg.) and staggered 1 rd./level; (Fort reduces staggering to 1 round).

sections.heading: Weaken PowderUC
sections.text: Weaken PowderUC: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+2 bonus; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity: range increment; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+20 ft.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Item-Specific Spell (firearm, wand, etc. only; -2 levels) = 1st level; firearm or wand -2 to atks and damage and -30 ft. to range increments for up to 1 rd./level or until cleared by user as a standard action (Disable Device or Spellcraft check at spell save DC).

sections.heading: Weapon BlessOA
sections.text: Weapon BlessOA: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+5 bonus; +4 levels) + Delay Spell (until used against specified creature; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (bonuses only against individual creature specified during casting; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 1st level; weapon is +5 to attacks and damage when next used against specified individual.

sections.heading: Weapon MasterCRB
sections.text: Weapon MasterCRB: Bestow feat (1st level) + Variable Spell (any combat feat; select at time of casting; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to War domain; -1 level) = 1st level; immediate casting grants you use of one [Combat] feat for 1 round.

sections.heading: Weapon of AweAPG
sections.text: Weapon of AweAPG: Enhancement (2nd level) + Item-Specific Spell (manufactured weapon only; -2 levels) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell [(spook; +1 level) + Extend Spell (cause fear: inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (fear: 1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (hit by crit; -2 levels)] = 2nd level; weapon gains +1 sacred bonus/4 levels and opponent shaken 1 rd. on a crit.

sections.heading: Weapon of EnergySC,SRD
sections.text: Weapon of EnergySC,SRD: Ray of frost (0 level) + Versatile Evocation (acid, cold, electricity, or fire; +0 levels) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 7d6 (+5d6 for 1 attack/rd., +3d6 each for 2 attacks/rd., +2d6 for 3 attacks/rd., or +1d6 each for up to 4+ attacks/rd.).
