AKA flame/frost weaponRR, flames of the faithfulAPG. Variants:

sections.heading: Weapon of the DeityCD
sections.text: Weapon of the DeityCD: Magic weapon (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Exotic Weapon Proficiency; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (weapon of energy: q.v.; +2 levels) = 4th level; deity’s favored weapon can be wielded with Exotic proficiency, gains +1 enhancement/4 levels, and deals up to +13d6/rd. additional energy damage for 1 rd./level (substitute other +2 spell level weapon properties as appropriate for your deity).

sections.heading: Wearying DanceCSc
sections.text: Wearying DanceCSc: Touch of fatigue (0 level) + Disguise Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard, by dancing; +1 level) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (3+ ranks in Perform: dance; -1 level) = 2nd level; onlookers in 20’r. are fatigued.

sections.heading: Web BoltARG
sections.text: Web BoltARG: Bind (0 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to vermin bloodline, domain, etc.; -1 level) = 2nd level.

sections.heading: Web ShelterUM
sections.text: Web ShelterUM: Creation (webbing; 1st level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 25 cu. ft./level.; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (volume to hemisphere; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level; creates igloo of web-like material lasting 1 hr./level.

sections.heading: Web StrandAUG2
sections.text: Web StrandAUG2: Creation (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 rd./level; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; creates sticky strand with Close range.

sections.heading: Web, BriarCD
sections.text: Web, BriarCD: Bind (0 level) + Cascade Spell (invisible needle; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (no damage if keep still; -1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (spread; +2 levels) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (vegetation; -2 levels) + Rerstricted Spell (ranger or access to Plant domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 1d6; -2 levels) = 2nd level; 20’r. spread of vegetation entangles, deals 1d6 piercing/rd., and counts as difficult terrain.

sections.heading: Web, IceFB
sections.text: Web, IceFB: Bind (0 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of frost; +1 level) + Violate Spell (+1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (ended by melting; -1 level) + Restricted Spell ([cold] bloodline, etc.; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 cold plus entangled and 2d6/rd. (half damage is frostburn; q.q.v. frostburnFB).

sections.heading: Web, PhantasmalAPG
sections.text: Web, PhantasmalAPG: Gloom (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 5th level; reduces light by 3 steps for target (min. supernatural darkness) and grapples and nauseates if not disbelieved.

sections.heading: Webs, EnduringRR2
sections.text: Webs, EnduringRR2: Web (2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) - Tenuous Spell (can’t break/burn strands; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); make permanent by investing 6,000 numen (2nd level x CL 3rd x 1,000 for continuous spell effect).

sections.heading: Weighty ChestTM2
sections.text: Weighty ChestTM2: Enlarge (3rd level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Augment Spell (Gargantuan; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (chest or similar container only; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Greed or Protection domain; -1 level) = 1st level; affected container (and contents) weigh 512 times as much as actual to anyone except you. Invest 2,000 x CL numen to maintain effect indefinitely (i.e., the chest becomes a comtinuous-effect magic item, per Chapter 6).

sections.heading: WelterAUG2
sections.text: WelterAUG2: Spook (0 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) = 2nd level; one target/level saves or falls prone and shaken 1 rd.

sections.heading: Whelm, MassPHII
sections.text: Whelm, MassPHII: Whelm (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 target/level; +3 levels) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6.

sections.heading: Whelm, MentalPHII
sections.text: Whelm, MentalPHII: Whelm (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 1st level; damage cap 5d6.

sections.heading: Whelming BlastPHII
sections.text: Whelming BlastPHII: Whelm (0 level) + Shape Spell (target to cone; +2 levels) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6.

sections.heading: WhipUA1
sections.text: WhipUA1: UnhandAUG2 (q.v.; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard action; +1 level) = 2nd level; one close ranged touch attack/rd. disarms and/or frightens 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Whip, ForceCA
sections.text: Whip, ForceCA: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (spook affects animals only; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 10d6 plus demoralizes animals.

sections.heading: Whip, Tamer’s LashUW
sections.text: Whip, Tamer’s LashUW: Compel (move away and don’t attack me; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (animals; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (sound lance; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 1d6; -2 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); iterative close ranged touch attacks deal 1d6 sonic, and animals hit cannot attack you, must back away for 1 rd./level or until save.

sections.heading: Whip of AntsACG
sections.text: Whip of AntsACG: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (invocation of the knife; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 10d6; -2 levels) = 5th level; damage cap 20d6 slashing divided among iterative ranged touch attacks (max. 10d6 for 1 attack) plus 2d6 bleed and nauseated 1 round. Variants:

sections.heading: Whirling BladeCA
sections.text: Whirling BladeCA: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to line; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Insightful Strike; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Versatile Strike; +1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6 + Int or Cha mod, and retains properties of focus weapon, in line out to Close range.

sections.heading: Whirlwind, GreaterCD
sections.text: Whirlwind, GreaterCD: Zephyr (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (energy mace; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (line to cylinder; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10’r. to 20’r.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd.; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Augment Spell (hurricane to tornado; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Air domain; -1 level) = 8th level (listed as 9th); damage cap 20d6 plus grappled and tornado winds in 20’r., 100-ft. tall funnel.

sections.heading: Whisper of MadnessAUG
sections.text: Whisper of MadnessAUG: Damage attribute (Wis; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (sound lance; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) = 3rd level (bard 2nd); damage cap 10d6 sonic plus 1d4 Wis (Will half/neg.) to single close target.

sections.heading: Whispering LoreARG
sections.text: Whispering LoreARG: Skill enhancement (0 level) + Variable Spell (appropriate skill to environment; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; you gain +1/2 levels (+5 max.) enhancement to Survival checks in the wilderness, Profession (mining) checks under-ground, Streetwise checks in urban environments, and Knowledge (the planes) checks when on other planes.

sections.heading: Whispering Wind
sections.text: Whispering Wind: Figment (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to continental; +5 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (no visual or olfactory; -2 levels) = 2nd level; illusiory message delivered up to 100 mi./level away.

sections.heading: WhisperleafDHD
sections.text: WhisperleafDHD: Invisible needle (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (magic weapon; +1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (gnome or access to Plant domain; −1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 7d6 piercing (divided among iterative melee attacks; max. 5d6 with any one), with +1/4 levels enhancement.

sections.heading: Widen AurasACG
sections.text: Widen AurasACG: Bestow feat (Innate Metanagic: Widen Spell; 1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 aura/3 levels; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (−1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 2nd level; the radius of your paladin auras is doubled,

sections.heading: Wilderness SoldiersUC
sections.text: Wilderness SoldiersUC: Energy mace (0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level, +2 levels’ worth of options) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (trees, hedges, or undergrowth; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Plant domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; one ranged touch attack/rd. deals 5d6 bludgeoning damage and either bull rushes, drags, or grapples.

sections.heading: WildshieldTM2
sections.text: WildshieldTM2: Dispel (0 level) + Irresistible Spell (no check needed; +3 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 spell/3 levels; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Expedient Spell (total spell levels; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (personal displacement; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (wild magic; -1 level) = 6th level; blocks up to 1 spell/3 levels (1d4+5 total spell levels max.) targeting you and imposes 50% miss chance on other attacks while active.

sections.heading: WildwindTM2
sections.text: WildwindTM2: Dimensional pocket (1st level) + Transdimensional Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to line; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Augment Spell (wild magic property; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (wild magic; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as 9th); damage cap 15d6 (Reflex half) and casting triggers wild surges, in mobile line out to Medium range.

sections.heading: WildzoneTM2
sections.text: WildzoneTM2: Dimensional pocket (1st level) + Transdimensional Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 30-ft.; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Power over Shadow; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Augment Spell (wild magic property; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (wild magic; -1 level) = 9th level; one 30-ft. cube/level is transformed into a wild magic zone, due to to the influence of the coterminous demiplane created.

sections.heading: Wind at BackMF
sections.text: Wind at BackMF: Celerity (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (overland speed only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Air or Travel domain; -1 level) = 4th level; increases overland speed of group by 4 mph.

sections.heading: Wind BladesARG
sections.text: Wind BladesARG: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Variable Spell (damage scales with victim’s movement and/or wind speed rather than caster level; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 4th level; 1d6 slashing damage per 5 ft. of movement and/or category of wind above moderate (15d6/rd. max., Reflex half) for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Wind BreathCWH
sections.text: Wind BreathCWH: Zephyr (0 level) + Shape Spell (line to cone; +1 level) + Widen Spell (30-ft. to 60-ft. cone; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to inst.; -1 level) + Augment Spell (moderate to hurrciane; +3 levels) = 4th level; creates instantaneous blast of hurricane winds in a 60-ft. cone.

sections.heading: Wind ChurnAUG
sections.text: Wind ChurnAUG: Zephyr (0 level) + Shape Spell (line to spread; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Fly; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (flying only; -2 levels) = 2nd level; flying creatures in 60’r. buffeted by storm winds for 1 rd., Fly checks at –(8 +1/2 levels) to stay airborne.

sections.heading: Wind ColumnS&M
sections.text: Wind ColumnS&M: CatfallSRD (q.v.; 0 level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Air domain; -1 level) = 0 level (listed as 1st).

sections.heading: Wind-Guided ArrowsCM
sections.text: Wind-Guided ArrowsCM: Blessing (0 level) + Variable Spell (Hex Spell: bonus or penalty; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Air or Archery domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; as an immediate action, apply +3 bonus or -3 penalty to the attack roll (and damage, if applicable) of one missile in flight.

sections.heading: Window to ElsewhereAUG2
sections.text: Window to ElsewhereAUG2: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Shape Spell (target to wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 5-ft. squares; -1 level) + Tenuous Spell (sensor can be dispelled or destroyed; ­1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 7th level; creates scrying window (one 5-ft. square/level) looking on a fixed location.

sections.heading: Wind’s FavorUM
sections.text: Wind’s FavorUM: Zephyr (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Widen Spell (5 ft. to 10 ft. wide; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Variable Spell (change direction by concentrating; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Air domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (windstorm to strong wind; -2 levels) = 3rd level; creates long area of strong winds.

sections.heading: Winds, FickleUM
sections.text: Winds, FickleUM: Zephyr (0 level) + Shape Spell (line to target; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 round/level to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (+3 levels) = 5th level; subjects protected by storm winds.

sections.heading: Winds of VengeanceAPG
sections.text: Winds of VengeanceAPG: Zephyr (0 level) + Cascade Spell (fly; +4 levels) + Cascade Spell (water breathing; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell [energy mace (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (topple, +1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level)] + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (+25 to +10; -3 levels = 9th level; you can fly, breathe freely, and are protected by tornado winds; those somehow hitting you take 1d6+10 bludgeoning and are knocked prone.

sections.heading: Winged MountCD
sections.text: Winged MountCD: Fly (4th level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 4th level; your mount gains wings and can fly at 60 ft. for 10 min./level (+1/2 levels, max. +10 on checks). Sky steedUW (3rd level) lasts only 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Winged WatcherCSc
sections.text: Winged WatcherCSc: Polymorph (animal; 3rd level) + Cascade Spell (reduce self; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (owl or raven only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Animal domain; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of idiocy; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); swift casting turns you into a Tiny owl or raven for 1 rd./level, but you take a penalty to Int of 1d6 + ½ levels during that time.

sections.heading: Wings7S
sections.text: Wings7S: Polymorph (winged humanoid; 3rd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 2nd level; subject gains wings (fly 30 ft.). Variants:

sections.heading: Witch’s HutUM
sections.text: Witch’s HutUM: Animate object (1st level) + Widen Spell (Small to Huge; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 2 hrs./level; +4 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (hut only; -2 levels) = 7th level; animates hut of up to Huge size as an animated object for 2 hrs./level.

sections.heading: With the WindUW
sections.text: With the WindUW: Zephyr (0 level) + Shape Spell (line to target; +0 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Augment Spell (3 steps to 6 steps; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (checked/blown away only; -2 levels) = 2nd level; subject is not checked or blown away by wind unless it wushes to be.

sections.heading: Withdraw AfflictionOcA
sections.text: Withdraw AfflictionOcA: Remove curse (3rd level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (contagion, poison, or bestow curse; +4 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (affliction bestowed must match that removed; -2 levels) = 6th level; you remove a curse, disease, or poison and can inflict it by touch (Hold the Charge applies).

sections.heading: WitherPH1
sections.text: WitherPH1: Bestow feat (1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels: Improved Weapon Maneuvers, Weapon Specialization, Severing Strike, Versatile Strike; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (BAB +11 effects; +2 levels) = 6th level (listed as 7th); touch destroys one of victim’s limbs (Fort useless for 1 rd. instead). Variants:

sections.heading: Withering PalmCA
sections.text: Withering PalmCA: Damage attribute (1st level) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +3 levels) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (Str and Con; +1 level) = 7th level; touch deals 16 Str and Con damage (Fort half).

sections.heading: Wolf’s CryRR
sections.text: Wolf’s CryRR: Spook (0 level) + Shape Spell (spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) + Fell Frightening (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Animal domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; creatures of 6 HD or less save or frightened 1 rd./level (shaken if succeed at Will save), creatures with 7+ HD shaken (Will neg.), in 40’r. spread.

sections.heading: Wood WoseCD
sections.text: Wood WoseCD: Unseen servant (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (druid; +1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st).

sections.heading: Wooden FistCRB
sections.text: Wooden FistCRB: Bestow feat (Exotic Weapon Proficiency: unarmed; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (enhancement; +2 levels) + Item-Specific Spell (unarmed attacks; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 0 level; for 1 rd./level, you gain a +1 fist for 1d4/19-20, lasting 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Word of Chaos
sections.text: Word of Chaos: Alter senses (0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

sections.heading: Word of FriendshipRW
sections.text: Word of FriendshipRW: Attribute boost (Cha; 0 level) + Augment Spell (+14 total bonus; +7 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (change attitude; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (vs. elves only; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (true friend of the Elven people; -1 level) = 1st level; treat your Cha as being 14 higher than actual when determining the attitude of elves towards you.

sections.heading: Word of ResolveUM
sections.text: Word of ResolveUM: Blessing (0 level) + Cascade Spell (hand of fate; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +4; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to inst.; -3 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 2nd level; immediate casting allows ally to reroll one attack, or saving throw vs. fear, with a +4 sacred bonus (bonus applies to damage, if used for an attack roll).

sections.heading: Words of the KamiOA
sections.text: Words of the KamiOA: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (days to 1 min./level; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (blinded; +1 level) + Fell Condition (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (bolt of force; +2 levels) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (evil; -2 levels) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) = 7th level; damage cap 20d6 (half force, half holy) plus 4d4 Dex damage and blindness (save for deafened) vs. evil creatures in 20’r. (Those with 11+ HD are merely deafened.)

sections.heading: Wounding WhispersMF
sections.text: Wounding WhispersMF: Sound lance (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +3 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) = 4th level (bard 3rd); non-reach melee attackers take 1d6 sonic +1/level (+10 max.) per attack. Variant:

sections.heading: Wracking TouchCAd
sections.text: Wracking TouchCAd: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Channeled Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Interrupting Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); touch deals 5d6 negative energy damage and possibly catches opponent flat-footed so as to deliver sneak attack damage as well.

sections.heading: WraithstrikeCAd
sections.text: WraithstrikeCAd: Bestow feat (Unstoppable Strike; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Rapid Strike; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 2nd level; swift casting allows attacks vs. touch AC for 1 rd. (at -5 to hit if more than 1 attack).

sections.heading: WrathAPG
sections.text: WrathAPG: Blessing (0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Concentratrion; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3 blessing; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Improved Critical; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Destruction, Inquisition, or War domain; -1 level) = 1st level; you gain +3 to atks, damage, saves vs. fear, +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Concentration, and Improved Critical with one weapon for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Wrathful Castigation, Nybor’sMF
sections.text: Wrathful Castigation, Nybor’sMF: Sickening touch (0 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; +1 level)  + Augment Spell (ailing; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3d4 Con; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = 8th level; target takes 4d4 Con damage (Fort half), if survives, is dazed 1 round and ailing 1 rd./level (Fort neg.).

sections.heading: Wrathful MantleAPG
sections.text: Wrathful MantleAPG: Resistance (0 level) + Augment Spell (scaling bonus; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (ends if delayed Cascade activated; -1 level) + Cascade Spell [{bolt of force; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (swift action trigger; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels)] = 4th level; subject +1 resistance/4 levels to saves for 1 min./level or until activates 5’r. burst of 5d6 force.

sections.heading: Wyvern WatchUA1
sections.text: Wyvern WatchUA1: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (proximity activating condition; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level; magic trap makes touch attack for 3d4 Dex (save half; save each round thereafter to halve remaining damage)

sections.heading: W
sections.text:
Body BlazeSSt: Jet of flame (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to wall; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (path of your ground movement; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6. The trail of fire you leave is 20-ft. high and is formed as you move, up to 1 round/level (5 ft. per level maximum length).Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteCampfire WallAPG: Jet of flame (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to ringed wall; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (around campfire; -2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (extinguishing campfire ends spell; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 1d6; -2 levels) = 3rd level; anyone passing through wall takes 1d6 fire and is lit up by light.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteCircle of flame7S has a range of touch (-2 levels), affects only 10-ft. squares (-1 level), and is Reduced only 1 step (10d6 to 5d6; +2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); damage cap 5d6 fire.  Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteWall of coldfireFB adds Energy Admixture (cold; +0 levels) and deals half fire, half cold damage.Wall of lavaAPG is Lingering (+2 levels), occupies 5-ft. squares instead of 20-ft. ones (-2 levels), and includes Cascade Spell [(jet of flame; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +1 level)]; it is Reduced only 2 steps (25d6 to 15d6; +1 level) = 7th level; damage cap 15d6 fire plus 5d6 burn, and fires a 15d6 ray of fire 1/rd. as a partial action.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
ModulateDr338 is similar but has a full round casting time (-4 levels), and is Augmented to 16 ranks effects (+2 levels) = 1st level; the swapped spell is usable at will during duration if 0-2nd level, or 3 times if 3rd-4th, and can be up to 8th level max.

DawnMW: Remove condition (unconsciousness; 2nd level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Augment Spell (moderate to serious; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Sun domain; -1 level) + Cascade Spell [(inertia; -1 level) + Augment Spell (staggered; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 min./level; -2 levels)] = 0 level; wakes up sleeping creatures in area; those unconscious from nonlethal damage become conscious but are staggered 1 min./level.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteSlumberwardDr181: Warding (sleep; 1st level); protects against magically-indiced drowsiness or sleep.Warning shoutDHD is instead restricted to those with access to the Protection domain (+1 level) and allows only a 1-word shout (-1 level) = 1st level.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente
BreathlessCPs: Polymorph (non-breathing form; 3rd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (breathing only; -1 level) = 3rd level; you do not need to breathe for 10 min./level.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componenteLasting breathTM2 is Reach (close) instead of Communal and affects only 0.125 cu. ft./level (-2 levels) = 1st level; time-released air for up to 5 rds./level (adjust for larger or smaller creature, and/or exertion). Life bubbleAPG Cacades zephyr (+1 level) + Shape Spell (line to target; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; ­1 level) = 5th level; provides breathable air and blocks inhaled poisons, vapors, etc. Cf. filterCWH.Mostra la descrizione di ogni componente

sections.heading: Xorn MovementMP
sections.text: Xorn MovementMP: Bestow feat (Favored Terrain: Plane of Earth; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Favored Terrain, 3 more times; +4 levels) = 5th level; subject can earth glide, etc. for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Yari of AirOA
sections.text: Yari of AirOA: Invisible needle (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (magic weapon; +1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to [air] domain, mystery, etc.; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 7d6 piercing (arcane 12d6), divided among melee attacks with +1 enhancement/4 levels. Bo of waterOA and testubo of earthOA are essentially similar, except they deal bludgeoning damage and have different elemental caster restrictions.

sections.heading: YokeAUG2
sections.text: YokeAUG2: Mage hand (0 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Extend Spell (concentration to 10 min./level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (helpless or dominated; -2 levels) = 2nd level; subject is dragged along with you as you move, at up to 40 ft. per round.

sections.heading: Yoke of MercyBED
sections.text: Yoke of MercyBED: Compel (use nonlethal attacks; 2nd level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (caster cannot have inflicted damage during last 8 hours; -1 level) = 2nd level; target of up to 6 HD cannot attack to kill for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Youthful AppearanceUM
sections.text: Youthful AppearanceUM: Glamer (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (older or younger version of target; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 1st level; target appears as he or she did (or might) as far in the past or future as you choose, as long as it’s within its lifespan and does not result in a size change.

sections.heading: ZealCD
sections.text: ZealCD: Bestow feat (Dodge; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Acrobatics; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Mobility; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 deflection; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 2nd level; you gain +4 deflection, Dodge, Mobility, and +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Acrobatics for 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Zealot PactCD
sections.text: Zealot PactCD: Jet of flame (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (magic weapon; +1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bless weapon; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (specified alignment; ­2 levels) + Delay Spell (until hit; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 6th); damage cap +20d6/rd., divided among attacks (max. +15d6 to one). When recipient strikes a creature of the specified alignment, for the next 1 rd./level, he or she gains +1/3 levels sacred bonus to attacks and damage, up to +20d6 damage/rd. (half fire, half holy, divided among attacks, max. +15d6 for one), penetrates DR/aligned, and auto-confirms crits vs. creatures of specified alignment.

sections.heading: Zephyr DanceToB
sections.text: Zephyr DanceToB: Bestow feat (Dodge; 1st level) + Augment Spell (BAB +12 effects; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to inst.; -1 level) = 4th lecel (listed as 3rd); immediate casting grants you +4 dodge bonus to AC vs. one attack.

sections.heading: Zombie DoubleCWH
sections.text: Zombie DoubleCWH: Summon (1st level) + Summon Undead (+1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 6; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (mindlink; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 7th level; you summon a 6th level juju zombie duplicate of you that shares your thoughts and memories.

sections.heading: Zone of RespiteMP
sections.text: Zone of RespiteMP: Warding (dimensional travel; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 30-ft. cubes; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as 4th); wards area against magical dimensional transport. Cf. dimensional lock.

sections.heading: Zone of RevelationMP
sections.text: Zone of RevelationMP: Invisibility purge (q.v.; 3rd level) + Transdimensional Spell (+1 level) = 4th level; invisible creatures, and creatures on coterminous planes, within 60’r. emanation become visible.

sections.heading: Zone of SpeedAUG2
sections.text: Zone of SpeedAUG2: Celerity (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+20 ft.; +1 level) = 5th level; all speeds in area (including falling speed and range increments of projectiles) are reduced by up to 70 ft. (amount chosen by you) for 1 min./level (Fort neg. for those in area), to a minimum speed of 1 ft. per round.

sections.heading: Zone of Truth
sections.text: Zone of Truth: Compel (tell the truth; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (lies only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 2nd); those in 20’r. emanation compelled to tell no lies for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Luck FeatsCSc
sections.text:
The line of [Luck] feats can be similated using the Magical Talent feat (Chapter 5) in conjunction with the hand of fate spell seed, as follows:
Hand of fate (0 level) + Quicken Spell (+4 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (−2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; immediate casting forces reroll of one specific type of roll (refer to the table below).
Feat Name | Reroll
Advantageous Avoidance | Attach roll against you
Fortuitious Strike | Damage
Healer’s Luck | Necromancy [Healing] dice
Lucky Break | Strength check
Lucky Start | Initiative check
Magical Fortune | Concentration check
Make Your Own Fortune | Skill check
Miser’s Fortune | Hostile sunder check
Survivor’s Luck* | Saving throw
Victor’s Luck** | Attack roll (or crit confirm)
* 	This also emulates the iron herat focus counterToB.
** This emulates the lightning recovery counterToB.

sections.heading: AgonizeUM
sections.text: AgonizeUM: Compel (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Augment Spell (-9 total penalty; +4 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (saving throws vs. your spells and abilities only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 10 min./level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (outsider; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 4th level; uncontrolled outsider takes a -9 penalty to saving throws against your spells and abilities, and is compelled to demand 50% less payment for services. (Creatures subjected to this spell resent it and will generally seek revenge.)

sections.heading: Ardor’s OnslaughtPnA
sections.text: Ardor’s OnslaughtPnA: Invisible needle (0 level) + Bane Spell (outsiders: fixed; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell [(sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (outsiders; -2 levels)] + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 piercing (10d8 plus nauseated 1 rd./level vs. outsiders) in a 20’r. burst.

sections.heading: Awaken the DevouredBotD
sections.text: Awaken the DevouredBotD: Whelm (0 level) + Cascade Spell (lesser compelling confusion; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Empower Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (evil outsiders only; -2 levels) = 3rd level; 1.5d6/level (max. 15d6) vs. evil outsider, plus confusion 1 rd./level.

sections.heading: Cleanse AberrationLoM
sections.text: Cleanse AberrationLoM: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+5d4; +4 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (aberration; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) = 7th level; aberration takes 6d4 Con damage (Fort neg., no SR) and you are healed 1d6 hp/level (max. 20d6).

sections.heading: CondemnationPHII
sections.text: CondemnationPHII: Warding (spell resistance; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (outsiders only; -2 levels) = 4th level; target outsider is stunned and stripped of SR for 1 round (Fort neg.).

sections.heading: Crystals of Nature’s WrathLoM
sections.text: Crystals of Nature’s WrathLoM: Sickening touch (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Item-Specific Spell (through natural weapons only; -2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (aberrations only; -2 levels) + Natural Spell (+0 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Riftwarden domain; -1 level) = 0 level; swift casting causes your natural attacks to sicken any aberration hit.

sections.heading: DemonbaneRR2
sections.text: DemonbaneRR2: Magic weapon (1st level) + Cascade Spell (protection from evil; +1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 total bonuses; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell ([good] caster; -1 level) = 4th level; +4 sacred bonus to AC, attacks, damage, and saves vs. evil outsiders, and penetrate DR/good, for 1 min./level.

sections.heading: Dismissal
sections.text: Dismissal: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (target: touch to close; +1 level) + Reach Spell (teleport: close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell ([extraplanar] only; -2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (home plane; -2 levels) = 4th level. Variants:

sections.heading: Disrupting ArcPGE
sections.text: Disrupting ArcPGE: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cross-Class Spell (druid; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to line; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd.; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (aberrations; -2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) = 5th level; swift casting forces aberrations in a close range line to make opposed Concentration checks to cast spells, manifest psionic powers, or use spell-like abilities for 1 rd.

sections.heading: DolorUA1
sections.text: DolorUA1: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (ailing; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Creature-Specific (outsider; -2 levels) = 5th level; target outsider is ailing 1 rd./level (no save, no SR).

sections.heading: Fires of Nature’s RageLoM
sections.text: Fires of Nature’s RageLoM: Jet of flame (0 level) + Variable Spell (attack or shield; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Item-Specific Spell (channel only though natural attacks; -2 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd.; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (damages only aberrations; -2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Augment Spell (+5 to +10; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Riftwarden domain; -1 level) + Natural Spell (+0 levels) = 3rd level; swift casting causes your natural attacks to deal up to +13d6 fire damage (divided among them) to aberrations, and aberrations hitting you in melee take 1d6 +1/level (+10 max.) fire damage per hit.

sections.heading: Invest Byeshk WeaponPGE
sections.text: Invest Byeshk WeaponPGE: Inertia (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (aberrations; -2 levels) + Adamantine Evocation [(+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (aberration DR only; -2 levels)] + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Riftwarden domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; swift casting causes your weapon to bypass aberrations’ DR (up to 20) and daze aberrations 1 rd. on successful hits.

sections.heading: Invoke the Cerulean SignLoM
sections.text: Invoke the Cerulean SignLoM: Inertia (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (aberrations; -2 levels) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) = 3rd level; aberrations within 20 ft. of you are stunned 1 rd./level or until save. When used by a Gatekeeper druid or Keeper of the Cerulean Sign wizard, those affected may also be sickened or nauseated by the caster’s purifying arc.

sections.heading: Khyber TrapME
sections.text: Khyber TrapME: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (target: touch to close; +1 level) + Reach Spell + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (outsider only; -2 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); target outsider is teleported out of action for the duration (Will neg.).

sections.heading: Mental BacklashLoM
sections.text: Mental BacklashLoM: Whelm (0 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to long; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (condition; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (aberration or aberration cultist; -2 levels) = 4th level; when an aberration or aberration cultist targets you with a [mind-affecting] power or spell, it takes 1d6 nonlethal/level (max. 10d6) and is nauseated for 1 rd./level (Fort half/neg.).

sections.heading: Nature’s PurityLoM
sections.text: Nature’s PurityLoM: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Bane Spell (aberrations; +0 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 3rd level; damage cap 8d6 force (8d8 vs. aberrations), divided among ranged touch attacks.

sections.heading: Nether TrailBVD
sections.text: Nether TrailBVD: Compel (follow trail; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (target to line; +1 level) + Variable Spell (line need not be straight; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (evil outsiders only; -2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 1st); lower planar creatures encountering trail are compelled to follow it.

sections.heading: Perfect SummonsBED

The seed spell and metamagic rules are intended to provide the tools to construct nearly any spell. However, in some cases it can be far more time-effective to directly model new spells on existing ones, making cosmetic changes as needed. This is not always recommended, but can be used in a pinch when converting or designing new spells on the fly.
For example, assume that interposing hand and so on were not in the core rulebook or anywhere else, but we wanted to invent something similar, and didn’t want to spend a lot of time and effort doing it. Ch 8 - Spells

CHAPTER 8: SPELLS

Standardized Spellcasting Rules

To avoid needless repetition of standard rules in the class write-ups, standardized casting rules are provided here. In the class descriptions for classes with spellcasting ability, relevant details are listed as needed only. In addition, some terms are clarified here.

Bonus Spells: Most casting classes provide bonus spells, such as the cleric’s domain spells, the sorcerer’s bloodline spells, etc. Some classes (e.g., the ranger) do not receive them at all. Multiclassed casters receive higher-level bonus spells if the contributing classes do (see Spell Theurgy, below).

In some instances, more than one bonus spell is listed for a particular spell level. Upon gaining a high enough spell capacity to gain a bonus spell of that level, you must choose which of the listed options is to be your bonus spell for that spell level; once selected, this cannot be changed.

Cantrips and Orisons: You learn or can prepare a number of 0-level spells (“cantrips” for arcane casters, “orisons” for divine casters), as shown in the tables. These spells are cast like any other spell, but they do not consume any slots and may be used at will.

Caster Level: This is the level at which your spells operate, used to determine duration, range, damage, and other level-dependent effects of your spells. Unless otherwise noted, your caster level for all spells and spell-like abilities is equal to your number of ranks in Concentration (not including bonuses from Skill Focus, etc., if any). It can never exceed your total number of Hit Dice, regardless of bonuses or other improvements. Your caster level is not necessarily the same as your Spell Capacity (see below).

Prepared Casting:

Then I spoke the spell, slowly and clearly, leaving out the four key words I had chosen to omit. The woods grew absolutely still about me as the words rang out. The spell hung before me like a crippled butterfly of sound and color, trapped within the synesthetic web of my personal vision of the Logrus, to come again when I summoned it, to be released when I uttered the four omitted words.

―Roger Zelazny, Blood of Amber (1986)

Clerics, archivists, and wizards must choose and prepare spells in advance. You can prepare and cast only a certain number of spells of each spell level per day. The number of spells per spell level you can have prepared at a time is shown in Spellcasting Table 1: Spells Prepared. In addition, you can prepare additional spells if you have a high spellcasting attribute score (the cleric and archivist have additional limitations on those spells). Each prepared spell can be used only once (unless a spell is prepared multiple times in different slots), until you rest and re-prepare.

You can spend 15 minutes to prepare 1 spell, or 1 hour to prepare any number of spells up to your total number of daily slots. When preparing spells, you can choose to leave one or more spell slots open. Later during that day, you can fill each open slot by taking 15 minutes to prepare a spell in it. In order to re-prepare spells in used slots, you must receive at least 8 hours’ rest and then spend the preparation time again.

Saving Throw DCs: For spells that allow saving throws, the DCs are equal to 10 + the level of the spell + your Charisma modifier. Characters with the Serenity feat may apply their Wisdom modifier instead of their Charisma modifier when calculating save DCs; wizards with the Diligent Preparation arcane bond can apply their Intelligence modifier instead of their Charisma modifier.

Spell Capacity: This is your row on the standardized spellcasting tables, which corresponds to an equivalent level of a full spellcaster in the core rules. Your spell capacity determines your spells known and spells per day, and the highest level of spells to which you have access.

Spellcasting Attribute: Each class has a single attribute that governs spellcasting, as listed in the class description. You are unable to learn, prepare, or cast spells from that class list if your attribute is less than 10 + the level of the spell. You gain additional spells prepared (if a prepared caster) or spells per day (if spontaneous) for a high spellcasting attribute (+1 per level of spells you are able to cast, to a maximum level equal to your spellcasting attribute modifier; unlike in the CRB, you do not gain multiple bonus spells of any level no matter how high your spellcasting attribute is).

Spontaneous Casting: Bards, incarnates, and sorcerers can cast any spell they know without preparing it ahead of time. You know a certain number of spells (Spellcasting Table 1: Spells Known). You can cast only a certain number of spells of each spell level per day. Your base daily spell allotment is given on Table 2: Spontaneous Spells per Day. In addition, you receive additional spells per day if you have a high spellcasting attribute score.

Theurgy

Multiclassing as a spell caster often works differently than in the core rules. Rather than tracking two separate spellcasting progressions, it is normally possible to some extent to combine progression from different spellcasting classes. For example, there are a number of talents and other class features (Chapter 3) allowing a caster to give up the normal spellcasting progression in one class in order to improve casting progression in another class.

This type of spellcasting improvement will be termed “theurgy” in these rules, after the Mystic Theurge prestige class in the core rules, and because of the linguistic similarity with the word “synergy”—spell theurgy works according to the general rules for class synergy features (Chapter 1).

Applying Theurgy: When spellcasting theurgy is used, the improvements shown in the class synergy table are applied directly to your Spell Capacity (q.v.) on Tables 1 and 2 (and not necessarily to the level in the class being advanced). For example, a bard 6 normally has a Spell Capacity of 5th (Bard Table 1). Upon gaining 6 levels in ranger and selecting the Harper Scout ranger lore (allowing your ranger levels to provide Weak synergy towards your bard casting), your new Spell Capacity would be 8th, allowing you to cast 4th level bard spells. This referral back to a standard table avoids unduly penalizing bards and other part-casters who gain improvements in those casting progressions from another such class.

Class Level: As noted in Chapter 1, when another class provides spellcasting theurgy, always use your actual number of levels in that class, not an “effective class level” obtained through feats, talents, etc.

Spell List Access: Theurgy generally grants access to both class spell lists, subject to any limitations specified for the class feature granting it. For example, the Arcane Hierophant druid (Chapter 3) can cast arcane spells only if the spell level is less than or equal to his or her arcane class level.

Stacking Theurgy: If you have more than one class providing theurgy towards a third class’ spellcasting progression, add all levels providing weak theurgy together and compare the total advancement in the appropriate column on Table 3; add all levels providing strong theurgy and check the total against the advancement on Table 3; and apply the total advancement to your Spell Capacity on Tables 1 (and 2, if applicable).

Theurgy and Bonus Spells: Classes that normally receive bonus spells, such as bloodline spells or domain spells, also allow acquisition of higher-level bonus spells when used for theurgy. Theurgy from classes without bonus spells (e.g., ranger) does not count towards acquiring new bonus spells. This is a specific change from the core rules, in which bonus spells are available to single-classed characters only.

Racial Spell-Like Abilities

Rather than have monsters acquire spell-like abilities haphazardly, a standardized mechanic is provided here. Creatures with access to suites of spell-like abilities gain them according to ranks in Concentration, so that their racial spell capacity is equal to their caster level. Spell-like abilities do not require material components, but otherwise conform to the spellcasting rules presented here.

Progression: One spell-like ability is gained at each odd-numbered rank in Concentration, to a maximum of 17 ranks. The spell level of each new spell-like ability gained is equal to half your number of ranks in Concentration (round up)—e.g., a character with 5 ranks in Concentration will have one 1st, one 2nd, and one 3rd level spell-like ability.

For creatures with skill ranks greater than their CR, the acquisition of higher-level spell-like abilities is normally limited by CR+1, rather than by ranks in Concentration. Specific exceptions are made for creatures with tightly-themed spell-like abilities, as shown in the Bestiary monster conversions.

Listing: A race receiving racial spell-like abilities will list them by spell level, much as bloodline or domain spells are listed. For example, the list of spell-like abilities for the half-celestial template might read: 1st—protection from evil, 2nd—aid, 3rd—cure serious wounds, 4th—holy smite, 5th—dispel evil, 6th—exalted raimentBED, 7th—holy word, 8th—holy aura, 9th—summon monster IX (celestials only).

Spellcasting Attribute: The default is Charisma; creatures whose spell-like abilities include mostly Divine spells might use Wisdom instead.

Uses Per Day: When the first spell-like ability of a given spell level is gained, it is usable once per day. A spell-like ability is usable 3 times per day if your number of ranks in Concentration is greater than or equal to 4 x the spell level of the spell-like ability. Vancian Magic

These rules were originally designed for a group of players who were adamant about retaining the traditional D&D structure of nine discrete spell levels, with a specific number of each usable per day—despite the fact that the 3.5 edition psionics model has proven to be better balanced and arguably more logical.

If being able to cast x number of spells per level per day “makes no sense,” think of spell levels as the various shells of electrons around the nucleus of an atom in a Bohr model; thus, “spell level” represents a quantum state, and no fractional spell levels are possible. As a spell is cast, the energy released is no longer available until the system is recharged.

As spell capacity improves, the caster is able to fill each ring (accounting for more spells per day of that level) and also gain access to higher quantum state shells (i.e., higher-level spells). In this rationalization, prepared casters earmark their slots to specific spells in advance; spontaneous casters do so on the fly. This Bohr model analogy is not exact, but will hopefully serve to provide some sort of workable rationale for the legacy D&D spellcasting system. (As an aside, positing this rationalization, I initially argued that “spell valence” was a better game term than “spell level,” but was unanimously overruled.)

Casting Spells

Casting Spells in Combat

Casting spells in combat is far more difficult in these rules than in the core rules, as described under the Concentration skill in Chapter 4. This is ameliorated by the greater power and flexibility of spells (see especially Metamagic and Seed Spells, below), and by the fact that other characters can generally guard an allied caster by holding enough movement and attacks to intercept attacks―or if adjacent, simply by declaring that they are doing so (Chapter 7).

Spells with a listed casting time of “1 standard action” in the core rules generally require a move action to perform somatic gestures, a partial action to retrieve components or present a focus, and a partial action to speak the verbal components and direct the spell (Chapter 7).

For a long time, long after Moonglum had gone to rest, he studied the rune, learning not only how to verbalise it but also the twists of logic which he would have to understand, and the state of mind into which he must put himself if it were to be effective.

―Michael Moorcock, Stormbringer (1964)

For spells requiring an attack roll, the verbal component is spoken while aiming and firing (for rays) or attempting to deliver the touch (for touch spells). If you don't discharge a touch spell in the round when you cast the spell, you can “Hold the Charge” indefinitely, under the conditions described below. This means you can continue to attempt touch attacks round after round in an attempt to discharge the spell. If you touch anything or anyone while holding the charge, even unintentionally, the spell discharges. If you cast another spell, the touch spell dissipates. You can make one touch attempt as a partial action, or touch up to six willing allies as a full-round action.

In order to discharge a touch spell through a weapon or unarmed or natural attack, the spell must have the Channel Spell metamagic feat applied to it (see below) or else you must use the Spellstrike feat (Chapter 5).

Casting Spells on Other Planes

The rules listed above apply to Aviona and the rest of the homebrew world. In other places, magic might work differently: casting might be easier, harder, or even impossible. On Golarion, for example, spellcasting is much easier—casting a standard spell takes only one standard action, and the Concentration DC for casting defensively is a static 15 regardless of threatening opponents, as described in the CRB.

Certain planes have wildly differing rules of magic; some types of spells might work at improved efficiency, or not at all. In general, arcane casters attempting to cast unmodified spells on planes with different magical laws fail automatically. Spontaneous casters can attempt a Planar Sense check (Chapter 4) as a move action prior to casting the spell to cast normally (DC 15 + twice the level of the spell). Arcane casters who prepare spells can make Knowledge (the planes) checks while preparing their spells in order to prepare spells that function on the new plane of existence.

Clerical spells, incarnate spells, and monks’ ki powers work normally on all planes, except those with specific special magic traits that would indicate otherwise. However, most deities’ power and awareness does not extend to all planes. Clerics and archivists out of touch with their deities cannot regain spells above 2nd level. Druids’ connection to the natural world requires special adjudication; unless specific guidelines have been developed for a given plane, treat druids as clerics.

Special Magic Zones

In some places, localized warping of reality—either though massive magical trauma in the past or the impingement of another plane onto the Prime Material—can create conditions in which nonstandard spellcasting rules are used. In the simplest case, use the rules for casting spells on other planes (q.v.). For example, a temple of Graz’zt might count as being part of the Abyss, for purposes of spellcasting inside. Other common examples follow.

Dead Magic Areas: The ambient “mana” of the area has been totally depleted. Spells, spell-like abilities, and supernatural abilities do not work in a dead magic area. Creatures and objects inside the area cannot be detected using divination magic cast from outside the area, and creatures cannot teleport, plane shift, or otherwise magically travel into or out of the dead magic area, with the exception of using permanent planar portals to enter dead-magic planes.

Wild Magic Areas: Attempting to cast a spell or use a spell-like ability in a wild magic area results in a wild surgeTM2 (if that book is not available, use the table in the 3.5 edition System Reference Document or some similar table instead). Supernatural abilities are not so affected.

Other Variations

Active Spell Effects

Active spells that last more than 1 hour/level (such as create demiplane) are essentially magic items, and count against your maximum personal numen (Chapter 6) as if they were magic items you crafted. Use the continuous spell-effect pricing: spell level x caster level x 1,000 x duration multiplier (x1 for 1 hr./level, x1.5 for 10 min./level, x2 for 1 min,/level, x4 for 1 rd./level, x6 for 1 round, x8 for instantaneous).

If the effect remains active, but does not actually benefit you most of the time (e.g., an everburning torch), use the use-activated costing instead (spell level x caster level x 500 x duration multiplier).

You can choose to apply a caster level lower than your number of ranks in Concentration (minimum equal to the minimum caster level for that spell level), but this makes the effect correspondingly easier to dispel.

For permanent effects, another possibility is to spend a feat on the Permanent Spell feat (q.v.) instead.

Area-Effect Spells

Default area-of-effect descriptions are provided here. In some cases, these have slightly different rules than those described in the Pathfinder Core Rulebook.

Burst: A burst effect is 20 ft. in radius as a default (in a sphere, or hemisphere if you are standing on a flat surface). Bursts do not turn corners; interposing objects cast a “shadow” from the effect behind them. However, a burst that deals damage, if it destroys a barrier, can continue to expand to its full radius.

Cone: A cone appears as a triangle in plan view, with one corner at its point of origin. It extends a default of 30 ft., with a 30-ft.-long base. Cones are otherwise treated as bursts.

Cubes: The spell affects a default of one contiguous 10-foot cube/level. The result is generally a smaller volume than a burst, emanation, or spread (q.v.) (except by a caster of at least 17th level), but the fact that the area is shapeable makes up for the smaller volume.

Cylinder: A cylinder is similar to a spread, but is half the radius, and extends to 2.5 times that height (base 10’r., 50 ft. tall). It ignores obstructions within the area. A flattened cylinder has the same original radius (default 20 ft.), but a height of only 2/3 the radius (default 13 ft.).

Emanation: An emanation spell functions like a burst, except that the effect continues to radiate from the point of origin for the duration of the spell. The point of origin can be either:

  • A creature or object, in which case the emanation moves with that creature or object. A saving throw is applicable for an unwilling target to avoid becoming the point of origin; if successful, the spell is lost with no effect. You can apply the Personal Spell feat (Metamagic, below) to an emanation, in which case you become the point of origin.
  • A point in space, in which case the emanation is stationary.

Line: A line extends from you out to the full range in a 5-ft. wide path. All creatures within that straight-line path are potentially affected. A line is blocked by a barrier, unless it deals hit point damage and deals enough damage to destroy the barrier, in which case it continues beyond to its full length.

Ray: You aim a ray as if using a ranged weapon, though typically you make a ranged touch attack rather than a normal ranged attack. As with a ranged weapon, you can fire into the dark or at an invisible creature and hope you hit something. You don't have to see the creature you're trying to hit, as you do with a targeted spell. Intervening creatures and obstacles, however, can block your line of sight or provide cover for the creature at which you're aiming.

Ray spells with a duration other than Instantaneous (e.g., ray of enfeeblement) generally have effects lasting that long; the ray itself is instantaneous unless otherwise noted.

Spread: Some effects, notably clouds and fogs, spread out from a point of origin. The effect can extend around corners and into areas that you can't see. Figure distance by actual distance traveled, taking into account turns the spell effect takes. When determining distance for spread effects, count around walls, not through them. You must designate the point of origin for such an effect, but you need not have line of effect (see below) to all portions of the effect.

Target: Damaging rays changed to area-effect spells allow a Reflex save for half damage, even if the original ray spell did not (for spells that originally allowed a save for partial effects, a successful save negates all effects for the Shaped version). However, no attack roll is needed; the caster simply indicates the target (line of effect applies). If you change a damaging ray to a target or area-effect spell, a saving throw for half damage is applicable, even if the ray did not allow one.

Wall: A wall is an unbroken plane or other flat shape with a default area of 100 sq. ft. (generally one 10-ft. x 10-ft. square) per level and a thickness of ½ inch per level. It can be straight (upright or flat), ring-shaped (A = 2πrh), or form a hemispherical dome (A = 2πr2):

Latent Spells

Latent spells that are not immediately discharged (such as explosive runes, glyph of warding, fire trap, symbol of death, etc.; see the Delay Spell metamagic feat, below) also count against your maximum personal numen (Chapter 6). The cost is as per a magic trap, potion, or other single-use magic item: spell level x caster level x 50. Some examples:

  • 3rd level explosive runes or secret page x CL 5th x 50 = 750 numen.
  • 8th level symbol of death x CL 15th x 50 = 6,000 numen.

Cantrips and Orisons

For 0-level spells that have non-instantaneous results and that are not maintained as continuous active spell effects using numen (see above), only one such effect or result from each 0-level spell can be in existence from one caster at one time. For example, in the core rules, if you cast another light spell while a previously-evoked light is still in effect, the first light winks out. This principle is extended to other applicable 0-level spells: e.g., create water, ghost sound, resistance, etc.

Castles and Dungeons

Spells (and abilities duplicating the effects of spells) with the [teleportation] descriptor cannot penetrate to an area that is entirely enclosed by more than 1 ft. of solid stone, 3 ft. of wood or earth, one inch of metal, and/or a thin coating of lead. The same restriction applies to scrying effects and most detection spells. This guideline, adapted from the Dungeonomicon (Frank and “K,” The Gaming Den), not only curtails “scry-and-fry” tactics, but also provides a rationale for the prevalence of both castles and dungeons in a game world in which dragons exist.

Kings therefore live in stone castles, not for defensibility from armies, but for secrecy; if a need to teleport or use scrying magic comes up, they can go to an outside room and open a leaded-glass window, but while inside an inner room with stone walls and a lead-lined door, their councils are protected from eavesdropping and teleporting assassins. Many wizards likewise live in stone towers with designated divining and transportation rooms open to the outside. Tombs and cultist headquarters are typically found in dungeons underground for similar reasons.

Dimension door effects within a dungeon or building itself are normally not affected, as the doorways, rooms, and corridors provide “open” pathways of effect within the complex itself. However, rooms with stone walls and thick stone or metal doors (such as all of the Tomb of Horrors beyond the Chapel of Evil and Stone Gate) would fall under these guidelines.

Specific exceptions to this guideline include discern location and teleportation circle (see below), both of which use the Irresistible Spell metamagic feat to circumvent the protection normally granted by solid materials.

Counterspelling

Counterspelling uses the preemptive action mechanics (Chapter 7); you hold an action to counterspell when an enemy caster begins to cast.

If the target of your counterspell tries to cast a spell, make a Spellcraft check (DC 15 + the spell's level) as a free action. If the check succeeds, you correctly identify the opponent's spell and can attempt to counter it. If the check fails, you can't do either of these things.

To complete the action, you must then cast an appropriate spell. You may use any spell to counterspell, but success is automatic only if you use the same spell as the one being cast, or one of equal level or greater with effects that are exactly opposite (e.g., haste vs. slow). Use of any other spell requires a Concentration check on your part with a special bonus equal to the level of the spell you are using as a counterspell. The counterspelling DC is equal to 10 + the enemy spellcaster’s Concentration bonus + the level of the spell you are attempting to counterspell.

Use of a spell from a school different from the one being cast results in a –4 penalty to your counterspelling attempt.

The Improved Counterspell feat provides a +4 bonus on all counterspelling attempts and allows counterspelling more quickly, scaling with the caster level of the counterspeller.

Dismissing Spell Effects

You can end one of your own spells that has an ongoing duration by making a Concentration check to do so, as described in Chapter 4. There is no separate “(D)” notation needed for spell duration listings.

Player Note: Spellcasting Etiquette

Playing a caster is hard work, because you generally have access to a lot of spells, and are expected to know what they do without flipping through rulebooks or opening web browsers or PDF documents during the game.

If a player is asked for specifics of a spell his or her PC is casting, and is unable to provide them accurately and instantly, the spell fails. Obviously, keeping a set of index cards or sheet of notes (or an easily-opened page of notes on a handheld device) handy is therefore highly recommended.

Summoned Monster Stats: Any time you cast a summon monster or similar spell, it is your responsibility to have the correct stats on hand, without needing to flip through rulebooks or page through e-documents to look them up. If for some reason you fail in this task, the summoning spell fails as well, and has no effect.

Resurrection Survival

“I hope you didn’t go to all this trouble just to take cheap shots at me,” Ragowski said, surveying the paraphernalia that littered the floor around him. “Regardless, I’m impressed. Necromantic workings demand an obsessive’s eye for detail.”

The N’guise Working, which was the one the magicians had used to raise Ragowski, called for the eggs of pure white doves that had been injected with the blood of a girl’s first menstruation, to be cracked into eleven alabaster bowls surrounding the corpse, each of which contained other obscure ingredients.
