Conjures a single mundane weapon lasting 1 min./level before disappearing; it gains a +1 enhancement bonus (and overcomes DR/magic). The spell grants you a Craft check of +1/2 levels (max. +5) even if you have no ranks; if this check is failed, the conjured weapon is broken or unusable. Variants:

  • Abundant AmmunitionUC: Creation (copy of existing mundane ammo; 1st level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Widen Spell (1/8; -1 level) + Delay Spell (activates once per round; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (magic weapon, etc.: retains multiple-projectile spell effects on original, but not single-projectile ones; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) = 1st level; refills ammunition container (max. ⅛ cu. ft./level; assume 1 piece of ammo per level for the sake of simplicity) once per round.
  • Devlin’s barbAUG2 conjures a piece of mundane ammunition (no enhancement bonus; -1 level) of only 1/8 lb./level (-1 level), and is not Ritual (+1 level) = 0 level.
  • Everfull quiverDHD is as abundant ammunitionUC (see above), but with Cascade Spell (versatile weaponAPG, q.v.; +2 levels), allowing duplicaton of special metals arrowheads = 3rd level.
  • BoltSRD produces up to 1 lb./level of +1 ammunition. Casting is a standard action (+1 level), but the ammunition is destroyed when used (Tenuous Spell; -1 level) = 1st level.
  • Ghost blade7S lasts only 1 rd./level (-1 level), includes no enhancement bonus (-1 level), has a standard casting time (+1 level), and the max. Craft bonus is Augmented to +10 (+1 level) = 1st level (listed as 2nd).
  • Summon weaponCM has no enhancement bonus (-1 level), is cast as a swift action (+4 levels), and is restricted to bards and rogues (-1 level) = 2nd level.

Call Woodland BeingsPH1: Summon (1st level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+5 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Resistible Spell (summoned beings can save vs. being called; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (druid; -1 level) = 5th level; summons one treant, 1d3 uncorns or satyrs, 1d4+1 centaurs or dryads, 2d4+1 brownies, or 4d8 sprites.

CallbackUW: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to long; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (your familiar, etc.; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (when has taken amount of damage specified at time of casting; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (arrives in your space; -2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 2nd); your animal companion, familiar, etc., if within Long range, is instantly transported adjacent to you when the amount of damage it has taken reaches the threshold you set.

Callback, GreaterUW: Callback (q.v.; 1st level) + Reach Spell (long to continental; +3 levels) = 4th level (listed as 5th). Cf. familiar refugeCM.

Calm Animals: Compel (fascinate; 2nd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (animals only; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (affected animals must be of the same type; -2 levels) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Animal domain; ­1 level) + Augment Spell (+0 to +10; +2 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 1st level; up to 2d4 +1/level (+10 max.) HD of animals of the same type are fascinated 1 min./level; effect broken if they are threatened.

Calm ChaosTM2: Compel (cease violent or emotional actions; 2nd level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Law domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; up to 1 creature/level within Close range who see you refrains from violence, merrymaking, passion, etc. while you concentrate.

Calm Emotions: Warding (emotion and morale effects; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; −2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (nonmagic emotions also suppressed; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd). Variants:

CaltropsTM2: Invisible needle (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to horizontal wall; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to War domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 1d6; -2 levels) = 3rd level; 1d6 piercing/rd. in area plus gain entangled condition for the remaining duration (Reflex half/neg.).

Chaos ShieldTM2: Warding (wild surges; 1st level); subject is protected from the effects of wild surges for 1 min./level.

Chaos WardS&M: Glamer (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Chaos domain; -1 level) = 1st level (listed as 2nd); subject gains +2 deflection to AC and 20% miss chance for 1 rd./level.

Chaotic CombatTM2: Deflection (1st level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +3; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Chaos domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; grants +3 profane bonus to attacks and damage and +2 profane bonus to AC for 1 rd./level.

Chaotic CommandsTM2: Warding (compulsions; 1st level) + Variable Spell (active effects turned on caster instead of negated; ad hoc +2 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Chaos domain; -1 level) = 4th level; enchantment [compusion] effects targeting subject rebound on caster.

Charge ObjectOcA: Nystul’s magic aura (1st level) + Variable Spell (choose which aura information to impart; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full riutual; -1 level) = 1st level; you psychically “charge” item so that it detects as psychic, and object reading, etc. reveal information you impart (cannot impart false auras). Invest 25 x CL numen to maintain indefinitely.

Charm Animal: Ray of beguiling (1st level) + Crfoss-Class Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (animal; -2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (attitude towards caster only; -2 levels) = 1st level; target’s Cha is treated as 1d6 +1/2 levels (+5 max.) lower than actual when determining its attitude towards you (Intuition half, automatically Helpful if reduced to 1).

Charm ItemAUG: Ray of beguiling (1st level) + Threnodic Spell (modified; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Item-Specific Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); intelligent item takes penalty to Cha of 1d6 + ½ levels vs. you.

Charm Person, MassRD: Charm person (1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) = 4th level; Cha penalty is 1d6 +1/level (+15 max.).

Charm Person, MassUI: Charm person (1st level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) = 4th level; as charm person, but Cha penalty is 1d6 +1/level (+15 max.), and affects up to 2d4+ 1/level (+10 max.) HD of humanoids in 40’r. (you choose which ones to be affected until potential filled).

Charming LieBRL: Compel (believe lie; 2nd level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Disguise Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 2nd level; those in 20’r. automatically believe one lie you tell as the verbal component (casting is disguised).

Charnel HouseHA: Glamer (0 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Shadow Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 5th level; illusion of blood dripping from ceiling, massacred flesh on floor, etc. sickens and counts as difficult terrain (Intuition for 60% chance to ignore effects).

Charnel TouchHH: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Augment Spell (1d6 to 5d6; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (necromancer or [death] bloodline, domain, etc.; -1 level) = 0 level (divine 1st); damage cap 5d6 negative energy.

Charon’s DispensationBotD3: Warding (1st level) + Rewach Sperll (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 effect/3 levels; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (River Styx, Lethe, etc.; -2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) = 5th level (listed as 4th); subjects immune to harmful magical effects of rivers of the underworld: loss of memory, soul leaching, etc.

Chasing PerfectionPHII: Attribute boost (0 level) + Augment Spell (+4 total bonus; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) = 5th level; +4 enhancement to all attributes for 1 min./level.

CheatBVD: Skill enhancement (Profession: gambling; 0 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +5; +1 level) = 1st level; immediate action gives you +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to die roll to resolve a game of chance.

Chill/WarmthRR: Variable Spell (ray of frost or jet of flame; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 0d6; -3 levels) = 0 level. This is different from endure elements insofar as it actually changes the ambient temperature for the subject.

  • Continual HeatRR2: Jet of flame (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to 0; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 0d6; -4 levels) = 1st level; 5’r. emanation is kept warm, but not hot enough to deal damage. Invest 1,000 numen to make the emanation permanent around a rock (as a continuous magic item).

Chill GazeRR2: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (ray of frost; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 6th level; damage cap 15d6 cold plus 1d4 Dex/rd. in 40’r. of you.

Chill Touch: Damage attribute (Str; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (as used; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6 negative energy and 1d4 Str damage, or 1d6 and 1 Str damage per touch for 1 touch/level (up to 5 total). Variants:

  • Chill WeaponRR2: Damage attribute (Str; 1st level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 1st); for 1 rd./level, weapon deals 1 Str damage on each hit.
  • Cold BlastAUG: Damage attribute (Str; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (ray of frost; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Resistible Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (5d6 to 1d6; -1 level) = 1st level; ranged touch deals 1d6 cold plus 1d4 Str (Fort half/neg.).
  • Parching TouchSSt: Damage attribute (Str; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +2 levels) + Bane Spell (plants and water elementals; +0 levels) + Delay Spell (standard; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; ­2 levels) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6 desiccation plus 1d4 Str damage, or 1d6 and 1 Str damage per touch for 1 touch/level (up to 5 total).
  • QuillfireMF: Damage attribute (Str; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (invisible needle; +1 level) + Variable Spell (ranged or melee; +1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Animal domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level; each round, make one attack (melee or ranged) for 5d6 piercing plus 3d4 Str.
  • Red FesterBVD: Damage attribute (Str; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Cha; +2 levels) = 3rd level; touch deals 1d4 Str and Cha damage.
  • Shadow TouchRR: Damage attribute (Str; 1st level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); one standard action touch/rd. deals 3d4 Str damage (Fort half).
  • Shivering TouchFB: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +2 levels) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Extend Spell (days to rounds; -3 levels) = 3rd level; touch deals 3d4 Dex damage (no save, but recovers at 1 pt./rd., or faster with Fast Recovery feat).
  • Strength of My EnemySRD: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Variable Spell (augmentation depends on Str damage inflicted; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Str; +1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (psychic warrior; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); 1 weapon attack/rd. deals 1d4 Str damage; you gain a like bonus to Str.

Chill WindSLPG: Ray of frost (0 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (staggered; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 cold and staggered 1 rd./level (Fort half/neg.) in 5’r. burst.

Chilling Chamber, Darsson’sShS: Ray of frost (0 level) + Conductive Evocation (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Delay Spell (onset 1/min. instead of 1/rd.; ­1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 1d6; -4 levels) = 2nd level; 1d6 cold/min. in one 10-ft. cube/level area (Fort half). Darsson’s fiery furnaceShS is the same, except it uses jet of flame as the base seed and deals fire damage.

Chord of DistractionCSc: Inertia (0 level) + Quicken Spell (+4 levels) + Interupting Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 4th level; immediate casting leaves opponent flat-footed for 1 rd.

Chromatic BladeDr181: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 feat/3 levels; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (BAB +11 effects; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 10d6; -3 levels) = 5th level (listed as 7th); damage cap 15d6/19-20 force, divided among iterative melee touch attacks (max. 10d6 for one), +3 to attacks and damage, and severs limb on a crit.

Chromatic OrbUA1: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses: +1 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 1d6; -2 levels) = 1st level; close ranged touch attack forces Intuition save or deals 1d6 force plus blind 1 rd./level (Fort neg.). Paralysis, petrifaction, etc. orbs are not available from a 1st level spell.

Circle of BindingAUG2: Compel (don’t leave circle; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 4th); those entering 5’r. circle are compelled not to leave it by any means for the remainder of the duration.

Circle of ClarityUM: Skill enhancement (Perception; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (targeted warding against concealment; 2nd level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Arcane Defense vs. illusion; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (0 to medium; +1 level) = 7th level; 20’r. emanation eliminates concealment less than full, +1/2 level to Perception checks to notice creatures or objects in area, and illusions in area are saved against with +2 bonus.

Circle of NauseaBVD: Sickening touch (0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

  • Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels);
  • Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels).

+ Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (pre-prepared circle; -2 levels) = 2nd level; those entering 20’r. of you sickened, those entering 5’r. of you nauseated instead (save each round; total spell lasts 1 min./level).

Circle of PrivacyTM2: Hand of fate (0 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (random encounters only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Fate or Travel domain; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; for the next 1 hr./level, roll twice for random encounter checks, and encounter occurs only if both checks say so.

Circle of SeeingRR: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (up to 1 location/level; +3 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (runes of seeing placed by you; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 8th level (listed as 4th); for 1 hr./level, you can see through up to 1 of your runes of seeing/level, shifting back and forth among them at will. Cf. rune of seeingRR.

Circle of SoundsRR: Tongues (3rd level) + Augment Spell (basic; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (animal sounds only; -2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (those affected only; cannot speak to actual animals; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Animal domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; subjects can communicate with each other (but not with actual animals) using animal sounds (birds, squirrels, etc.).

Circle of SunmotesTM2: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+2 bonus; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Variable Spell (Cascade Spell: jet of flame or spark of life; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Augment Spell (dazzling; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (0 to medium; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Sun domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 5d6; -3 levels) = 9th level; allies in 60’r. lighted area are healed 2d6 hp, gain +2 to atks, damage, saves vs. fear, and gain 3d6 temp. hp; enemies take 5d6 fire (Reflex half) per round and -2 to atks, damage, saves. Your enemies in area are illuminated by normal light, and you and your allies treated as if enemies in dazzling light.

City TransportAUG2: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (destination: close to line of sight; +4 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (within same settlement; -2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (standard activation; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 8th); you can teleport anywhere within the same city as a standard action (up to 1 jump/3 levels total).

Clairtangent HandSRD: Mage hand (0 level) + Cascade Spell (detection: visual; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to line of sight; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to clairsentience discipline, oracular mystery, etc.; -1 level) = 5th level; you can see and manipulate a mage hand clairvoyantly, at a distance of up to ¼ mile per level.

Clarity of MindAUG2: Skill enhancement (Concentration; 0 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +5; +1 level) = 0 level; you gain +1/2 levels (max. +5) enhancement to Concentration for 1 min./level. Variants:

  • Mind Over MatterRR: Skill enhancement (Concentration; 0 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +4 levels) = 4th level; +1/2 levels (+10 max.) on Concentration checks.
  • Warding WeaponUC: Skill enhancement (Concentration; 0 level) + Maximize Spell (+3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Augment Spell (+5 to +10; +1 level) = 2nd level. Note that this spell provides only a +10 bonus to Concentration checks (+5 for a 1st level version), rather than auto-success.

Claws, LittorianAUG: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); damage cap 7d6 slashing, divided between two melee claw attacks. Variants:

  • AcuminateAUG2 Cascades magic weapon (+1 level), and is Concentration (10 min./level to standard; -2 levels) and Delayed (allows breaks in use; +1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 12d6 slashing/rd. (divine 7d6), divided among iterative melee attacks, each with +1/4 levels enhancement.
  • Arms of PlentyLoM Cascades bestow feat (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (2 feats; +1 level) is Concentration (swift action; +3 levels) rather than Extended (-4 levels), and is Reduced 1 more step (10d6 to 1d6; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); subject gains two secondary claw attacks (base 1d6 each) usable as a swift action, and can rend with them (Two-Weapon Strike and Vital Strike).
  • Beast clawsCD Cascades [keen edge (q.v.; +4 levels) – Extend Spell (-2 levels)], lasts only 1 rd./level (-2 levels), and is Personal (-1 level) and Restricted (ranger or access to Animal domain; ­1 level), and is Augmented 1 step rather than Reduced (+2 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); damage cap 6d6/19-20 slashing, divided between 2 claw attacks.
  • Beast clawsSC Cascades [keen edge (q.v.; +4 levels) – Extend Spell (-2 levels)], lasts 1 hr./level (+1 level), and is Personal (-1 level) and Restricted (ranger or access to Animal domain; ­1 level) = 1st level (listed as 3rd); claws deal 1d3/19-20 slashing.
  • Claws of the beastMF is Personal (-1 level), Extended to only 1 min./level (-1 level), and Sudden (+0 levels) = 0 level; you grow claws (base 1d3 damage each) as a swift action that last 1 round.
  • Claws of the beastSRD is Extended to 1 hr./level (+1 level), Quickened (+3 levels), Personal (-1 level), and Restricted (psychic warrior; -1 level); it is also Reduced 2 more steps (10d6 to 1d6; -2 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); damage cap 3d6. You grow long-lasting claws (1d6 damage each) as a swift action.
  • Claws of the bebilithCD Cascades bestow feat (+1 level) with Mass Effect Spell (1 feat/3 levels: Two-Weapon Strike, Improved Grapple, Improved Weapon Maneuvers; +2 levels), and is Augmented (BAB +6 effects; +1 level) = 5th level; you grow claws dealing up to 7d6 slashing each, plus sunder if both hit, or grab (and sunder if successful) if only one hits. Add the following feat effects to claws with increased caster level: 12th—Vital Strike (+2d6), 15th—Weapon Specialization (+2/+2), 18th—Improved Critical (19-20).
  • Claws of the savageBVD lasts only 1 min./level (-1 level) and Cascades magic weapon (+1 level) with Mass Effect Spell (two claws; +1 level)] = 3rd level; subject grows a pair of magic (+1/4 levels) claws dealing 4d6 slashing damage each.
  • Claws of the umber hulkTM2 lasts only 1 min./level (-1 level) and Cascades burrowUM (q.v.; +3 levels) and celerity (+1 level); it has a full round casting time (­1 level) = 4th level; subject grows claws (up to 7d6 each) and can burrow at 40 ft. rate for 1 min./level.
  • Laeral’s cutting handMF Cascades magic weapon (+1 level) and is Concentration (10 min./level to standard; -2 levels) = 1st level; damage cap 6d6. Your hand becomes a +1 slashing weapon dealing up to 5d6 base damage (1 attack/rd.), 3d6 (2/round), 2d6 (3/rd.), or 1d6 (4+/rd.), depending on your caster level and BAB.
  • Lash of the AstradaemonBotD3: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Cascade Spell (enervation; +5 levels) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 5th level; damage cap 20d6. You grow claws dealing up to 10d6 slashing plus 1 temp. negative level each.

ClawstrikeRR2: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Overwhelming Evocation (+2 levels) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 1st level; melee attack deals 1d6 force/level (max. 5d6) + Str modifier, ignores hardness and energy resistance.

Cleansing StrikeLoM: Bestow feat (Insightful Strike; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (bolt of force; +3 levels) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (psionic; -1 level) = 3rd level; one melee attack gains Wis modifier to attack and damage and deals +1d6/level force damage (max. +10d6).

ClearstoneLEF: Transmute (1st level) = 1st level (listed as 3rd); renders 1 cu. ft./level of rock transparent for up to 1 hr./level.

Clear PathTM2: Residual Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Restricted Spell (druid, ranger, or access to Travel domain; -1 level) = 5th level; difficult terrain within 10 ft. of you is treated as normal, and very difficult terrain as difficult, for 1 hr./level.

Climbing TreeCM: Skill enhancement (Athletics; 0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to vertical line; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+5 to +10; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 1st level; immobile tree (height equal to spell’s range) provides +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Climb checks.

Cloak of Adeamozs7S: Warding (1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 effect/level; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Expedient Spell (max. spell level; -1 level) = 3rd level; subject immune to acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic spells of 3rd level or less (and negative energy at CL 6th, force at 7th, attribute damage at 8th-13th, etc.).

Cloak of Chaos: Deflection (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 bonus; +1 level) +

  • Cascade Spell (spell resistance; +5 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (lawful spells/spells cast by lawful creatures only; -2 levels); and
  • Cascade Spell (lesser compelling confusion; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Shielding Spell (included in spell resistance; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (lawful attackers only; -2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 attacker/level; +3 levels)

+ Communal Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (chaotic caster; -1 level) = 8th level; +4 deflection to AC and +4 resistance to saves, plus SR 10 + Concentration bonus vs. [lawful] spells, and up to 1 [lawful] creature/level hitting in melee per round is confused 1 rd. Protection lasts 1 min./level total, divided among recipients.

Cloak of DarknessBRL: Gloom (0 level) + Selective Spell (+3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (spread to target; −2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; ambient light around you is reduced by 1 step (min. darkness) for everyone except you.

Cloak of KhyberDr337: Glamer (1st level) + Tenacious Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (2 effects; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 2 hrs./level; +4 levels) + Effect-S[ecofoc Spell (see below; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level; cloaks your alignment and causes any existing glamer on you to appear as your real form to true seeing, etc.

Cloak of RighteousnessRR: Blessing (0 level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (blindness; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) = 4th level; blesses allies and blinds enemies within 20’r. of you (emanation lasts 1 rd./level).

Cloak of SecretsPC: Glamer (1st level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Spellcraft; +1 level) + Extend (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); disguises speech (and lip movements) of those within 5’r. emenation from those outside, and imposes -1/2 levels (-5 max.) penalty to Spellcraft checks to ID spells being cast from within.

Cloak of the PhoenixRRE: Raise dead (5th level) + Delay Spell (until killed; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) = 9th level; one creature/level is raised from the dead if slain. Requires diamond dust (5,000 gp worth per creature) and investiture of 450 x CL numen to maintain the latent effect.

Cloak of the SeaCAd: Bestow feat (Favored Terrain: underwater; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Favored Terrain 3 more times; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (underwater only; -2 levels) = 6th level; subject gains Favored Terrain (underwater) +8, but no benefits apply when not actually underwater. Cf. liquid formRRO.

Cloak of WindsAPG: Zephyr (0 level) + Shape Spell (line to target; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) = 3rd level; subject surrounded by severe winds for 1 min./level.

Clone: Resurrection (7th level) + Cross-Class Spell (arcane; +1 level) + Delay Spell (new body animates when original dies/is destroyed; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (re-animates in new body’s location, rather than in location of death; -1 level) = 8th level. Control the SoulRR: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Augment Spell (also hearing; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (mindlinkSRD; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Cha; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+5d4; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to planar; +6 levels) + Cascade Spell (enervation; -4 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 8th level (listed as 3rd); as dominate monster, but functions at any range on the same plane, and you can see and hear what the subject does (you take 1d4 temp. negative levels). Invest 400 x CL numen to maintain indefinitely (but the neg. levels last that same period of time).

Control Undead: Damage attribute (Cha; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+5d4; +4 levels) + Threnodic Spell (+0 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (+3 levels) + Expedient Spell (-1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 7th level; 4d6 Cha damage to one undead/level (total HD 2d4 + 1/level, +15 max.), save each round to halve remaining damage.

Control Water: Creation (water; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 10 min./level; -1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to long; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (volume to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Water domain, etc.; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 4th); lowers or raises water level in area by up to 2 ft./level. Control sandSSt is essentially similar. Variants:

  • Airy WaterPH1,SW: Creation (1st level) + Variable Spell (air/water; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 10 min./level; -1 level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 5,832 cu. ft./level; +4 levels) + Shape Spell (volume to emanation; +0 levels) = 5th level; sphere around you underwater contains air instead (20’r. at 6th, 25’r. at 11th, 30’r. at 19th) for 10 min./level. Air bubbleUC affects only 0.125 cu. ft./level (-5 levels) and is Communal (+1 level) = 1st level; divide duration among those affected.
  • Part the WatersSW: Creation (air; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 10 min./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (shaping; +3 levels) + Concentration (chage shape as standard action; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 8 million cu. ft./level; +6 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 8th level (listed as epic); displaces up to 8 million cu. ft./level of water in a mobile cylinder for 1 hr./level total.
  • WaveformTM2: Animate object (1st level) + Cascade Spell (energy mace; +1 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Bane Spell (fixed: water elementals; +0 levels) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (water only; -2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 5th); damage cap 10d6 (10d8 vs. water elementals). You control up to one 10-ft. cube of water/level with concentration.

Control Weather: Variable Spell (create water, ray of frost, jet of flame, wisp, zephyr; +1 level) + Shape Spell (emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1 mi.; +6 levels) + Concentration Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (­2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Weather domain, etc.; -1 level) = 7th level; each round, choose wind (up to hurricane speed), rain, and/or freezing or very hot temperatures. If two effects chosen, Reduce all by 1 step (e.g., violent to heavy rain, hurricane to windstorm); for 3 effects, Reduce all by 2 steps (e.g., moderate rain, severe winds). Variants:

  • Calm weatherRRE is Effect-Specific (ameliorate extreme conditions only; -2 levels), Extended (conc. to 10 min./level; +3 levels), and Widened (1 mi. to 40 ft.; -5 levels), and has a casting time of only 1 full round (+1 level) = 4th level; maintains an emanation of calmer, milder weather.
  • Weather stasisTM2 is Effect-Specific Spell (maintain current weather conditions; -2 levels) = 5th level.

ConvertRR: Compel (worship caster’s deity; 2nd level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 9th level; invest 450 x CL numen to maintain effect.

ConvictionSC: Resistance (0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+5 total bonus; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); subject gains +5 sacred bonus to saves.

Cooling Breeze, Darsson’sShS: Zephyr (0 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Reduce Spell (severe to light; -3 levels) = 1st level; creates long-lasting light breeze.

Co-Opt ConcentrationSRD: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (steal effect; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd.; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 5th level; you take over effects of ongoing spell while you concentrate.

CopyCWH: Shaping (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (copy of document touched; -2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (no Craft check needed, but also no variation from original possible; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 1/64 cu. ft./level; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 0 level (listed as 1st); creates an exact copy of an existing document, using ink and paper you provide as material components.

Corpse CandleCA: Light (0 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 min./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (see invisibility; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (personal to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) = 3rd level; mobile light reveals invisible creatures.

Corpse VisageCWH: Spook (0 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (onset: inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (glamer; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 1st level; for 1 rd./level, your face appears as a rotting corpse’s, and creatures of 5 HD or less within 20 ft. are shaken 1 rd./level or until save.

CorrespondSRD: Mindlink (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +7 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (must have had physical or mental contact with subject in the past; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 4th level; as mindlink, but proximity with subject can be prior to casting.

Corruption ResistanceAPG: Inure (alignment-based; 0 level) + Variable Spell (select alignment at time of casting; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin or access to Inquisition domain; -1 level) + Augment Spell (15 to 30; +1 level) = 2nd level; subject gains resistance 5/2 levels (max. 30) to damage that targets specific alignment (e.g., holy smite).

Corrupting TouchSRD: Glamer (evil aura; 1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain; -1 level) = 0 level; victim touched is shaken and radiates as [evil] for 1 rd./level.

Counterbalancing AuraPnA: Deflection (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 bonus; +1 level) + Cascade Spell [(spell resistance; +5 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (neutral spells/spells cast by neutral creatures only; -2 levels)] + Cascade Spell [(sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Shielding Spell (included above; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (neutral attackers only; -2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (2 attackers/rd.; +1 level)] + Communal Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (non-neutral caster; -1 level) = 8th level; +4 deflection to AC and +4 resistance to saves, plus SR 10 + Concentration bonus vs. neutral spells, and up to 2 neutral creatures hitting per round are nauseated 1 rd. Protection lasts 1 min./level total, divided among recipients.

CountercharmBRL: Remove condition (Cha penalty; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 1st level.

CountermoonMW: Variable Spell (+1 level):

  • In true form: Warding (polymorph; 1st level)
  • In shapechanged form: Warding (dispel of polymorph; 1st level)

+ Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell ([shape-changer]; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (druid or access to Void domain; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); prevents one [shapechanger] from changing from its current form for 1 hr./level.

CounterspellPH5: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) = 5th level (listed as 3rd); immediate casting allows counterspelling of one spell being cast within Close range. AKA stifle spellPHII. Variants:

  • DuelwardCA: Bestow feat (Improved Counterspell; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Spellcraft; +1 level) + Augment Spell (16 ranks effects; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level (listed as 5th); for 1 rd./level, you can counterspell as an immediate action and gain +1/2 levels bonus to Spellcraft.
  • Elminster’s effulgent epurationPGF: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 spell/level; +3 levels) + Selective Spell (choose which spells to counter; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (no checks needed; +2 levels) = 9th level; during the next 1 rd./level, up to 1 spell/level you specify within range is automatically counterspelled.
  • Epic counterspellSRD has Medium range (+1 level) and is Irresistible (no check needed; +2 levels) = 8th level (listed as epic); immediate casting automatically counterspells one spell being cast within Medium range.
  • Spellcaster’s baneCM is similar to duelwardCA (see above), but is Quickened instead of Augmented (+0 levels) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); as a swift action, you gain Improved Counterspell and +1/2 levels to Spellcraft for 1 rd/level.
  • Spell SnareME: Dispel (0 level) + Shielding Spell (+2 levels) + Irrestistible Spell (no check needed; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (ful round; -1 level) = 3rd level; the next spell or SLA targeting the subject is automatically counterspelled.

Crafter’s CurseAPG: Skill enhancement (Craft; 0 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); target is -1/2 levels (-5 max.) to Craft checks.

Create BonfirePH5: Jet of flame (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (area cannot be re-directed; -2 levels) = 0 level; creates fire in small area (1d6, Reflex half).

Create CampsiteTM2: Shaping (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Stealth; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target material to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (campsite only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Travel domain; -1 level) = 3rd level (ranger 2nd); makes 40’r. campsite using materials at hand; +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to DC of Perception checks to notice it.

Create EquipmentBRL: Creation (1st level) + Variable Spell (material and item; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (shaping; +2 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (mundane object of low value only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 rd./level; -3 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Craft; +1 level) = 0 level. Conjures a single simple, mundane (non-masterwork) item of up to 1 lb./level, lasting 1 rd./level before disappearing. The spell grants you a Craft check (DC 15) of +1/2 levels (max. +5) to properly shape the item even if you have no ranks; if this check is failed, the conjured item is unusable. Whether the item is called from some other place or created is immaterial. Cf. call weaponrySRD. Variant:

  • Drawmij’s tool boxGA conjures one tool/level (+3 levels) lasting 10 min./level (+2 levels), and has a full-round casting time (-1 level) = 4th level.

Create MindscapeOcA: Dimensional pocket (1st level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 27 lbs./level; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to long; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (environment and ecology; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 10 min./level; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 5th level; creates illusory demiplane (you select terrain, ecology, etc.) for subject to wander through (if can be enticed to enter). You need not have the Power over Shadow feat, as the effect is illusory. Greater create mindscapeOcA affects 1 creature/level (+3 levels), lasts 1 hr./level (+1 level), and is not Augmented (-2 levels) = 7th level.

Create PitAPG: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Shape Spell (spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level; “fall” for 5d6 bludgeoning plus grappled (in essence; victims can climb out instead of breaking free); initial Reflex save for half/negates. The pit remains for 1 rd./level (treat as difficult terrain, but creatures jump over/skirt the pit instead of ignoring the terrain via Acrobatics, etc.).

  • Bottomless PitRR: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (target: touch to close; +1 level) + Reach Spell (destination: close to interplanar; +6 levels) +Location-Specific Spell (plane of endless falling; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to horizontal wall; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. squares to 2.5-ft. squares; -2 levels) = 7th level (listed as 4th); opens extradimensonal pit (infinitely deep) in floor.
  • Create acid pitAPG adds Energy Admixture (acid; +0 levels) and Lingering Evocation (+1 level) = 4th level; fall deals 1d6/level (max. 10d6), of which 2d6 is acid, plus 2d6 acid/round thereafter.
  • Create hungry pitAPG adds Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level) = 5th level; fall deals 1d6/level (max. 10d6) plus grappled; damage recurs each round.

Create SoundSRD: Ghost sound (0 level) + Cross-Class Spell (metacreativity/conjuration (creation); +1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Reduce Spell (no olfactory, tactile, or visual; -3 levels) = 1st level.

Creation, TrueSRD: Major creation (4th level); invest 200 x CL numen (as a latent spell effect with duration multiplier added) to change the duration to Instantaneous.

Creeping Eye, Tevikk’sRR: Arcane eye (3rd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (line of sight to extreme; -1 level) = 4th level; as arcane eye, but shorter range and lasts longer. Invest 2,000 x CL numen to make permanent (use-activated spell effect).

Creeping IceACG: Creation (ice; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 10 min./level; -1 level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 8 cu. ft./level; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Concentration (swift action; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (on horizontal surfaces; -1 level) = 4th level; creates ice 10 ft. x 10 ft. x 1 inch thick per level, spreads each round thereafter as a swift action.

Creeping Shadow, Lorloveim’sTM2: Alter senses (1st level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Augment Spell (add sense: hearing; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; you can see, hear, and speak through sensor (appearing as an extension of your shadow) at Long range. ShadowcatTM2 is Extended to 10 min./level (+2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 7th).

Crime of OpportunityUI: Compel (2nd level) + Variable Spell (no control over compulsion; -1 level) = 1st level; target rolls 1d4: 1 = refuses to accept Aid Another or beneficial spells, 2 = attempts to pickpocket valuables from nearest creature, 3 = attempts to vandalize nearest structure, 4 = attack nearest creature. If unable to do any of these, attempts to hide.

Crime WaveUI: Crime of opportunityUI (q.v.; 1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) = 6th level (listed as 7th).

Crisis of LifeSRD: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (telepathy; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+5d4; +4 levels) = 7th level; 6d4 Con damage (Fort half) at Medium range.

Critical StrikeCAd: Bestow feat (Improved Critical; 1st level) + Augment Spell (BAB +6 effects; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Vital Strike; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (vs. flanked or Dex-denied opponent only; -2 levels) + Still Spell (-1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (+1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 1st level; against flat-footed opponents (or those denied Dex bonus), you deal Vital Strike damage, double crit threat range, and are +4 to confirm crits for 1 round (swift casting).

Crown of BrillianceBED: Light (0 level) + Positive Spell (+0 levels) + Augment Spell (blinding; +5 levels) + Fell Dazzling (+1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd./level; -2 levels) + Selective Spell (+2 levels) = 6th level; subject gains aura of light; enemies blinded while within and 1 rd. thereafter (Fort dazzled). Variants:

  • Brilliant EmanationBED: Light (0 level) + Augment Spell (blinding; +5 levels) + Fell Dazzling (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (only [evil] creatures blinded; −2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 360’r.; +4 levels) + Personal Spell (emanation centered on you; -1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd./level; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell ([good] caster; -1 level) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; evil creatures in 360’r. of you are blinded (Fort dazzled) by your aura of light.
  • Nimbus of LightCD: Light (0 level) + Augment Spell (bright light; +1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 min./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (jet of flame; +1 level) + Delay Spell (standard action trigger; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (jet of flame ends light effect; -1 level) = 1st level; you shed bright light, can end effect with jet of flame attack (damage cap 5d6).
  • RadiancePHII: Light (0 level) + Augment Spell (dazzling; +4 levels) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead; -2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd./level; -2 levels) = 5th level; light in 60’r. aura around you dazzles undead (no save).
  • Unbearable BrightnessACG: Light (0 level) + Augment Spell (dazzling; +4 levels) + Inexorable Evocation (+3 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 round/level; ­2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; you emit dazzling light (no save) in a 20’r. for 1 rd./level.

Crown of GloryCD: Eagle’s splendor (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (Compel: watch; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) + Pacific Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Glory domain; -1 level) = 8th level; you gain +4 Cha, and creatures in 120’r. with up to 12 HD are fascinated.

Crown of VerminSRD: Invisible needle (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Overwhelming Evocation (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 8th level (listed as epic); damage cap 120/rd. to those within 10 feet of you (overcomes DR, and SR does not apply).

Cruel DisappointmentBVD: Compel (fail at next effort, but believe you succeeded; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (ailing; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; subject saves or fails at next task, but believes it succeeded for 1 rd. Thereafter, it must save again or be ailing for 1 rd./level.

Cruel JauntHA: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (adjacent to creature affected by [fear] condition; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (sense fearHA, q.v.; +4 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) = 7th level (listed as 6th); you sense fear within 120 ft. for 10 min./level, and can make standard-action teleports to arrive adjacent to affected creatures.

Crunchy SnowFB: Skill enhancement (Stealth; 0 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to horizontal wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 20-ft. squares; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (snow-covered area only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Resticted Spell (ranger or access to Winter, domain, etc.; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); -1/2 levels to Stealth in large area of snowy ground.

Crusader’s StrikeToB: Spark of life (0 level) + Augment Spell (+1/level; +1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (credible threat; -2 levels) = 1st level; successful [strike] heals you or ally within close range 1d6 +1/level (+5 max.) hp. Variants:

  • Rallying strikeToB is Shaped (burst; +2 levels) and Selective (+1 level) = 4th level (listed as 6th); allies within 20 ft. heal 5d6 + 1/level (+10 max) hp.
  • Revitalizing strikeToB is Reach (close; +1 level) = 2nd level; you or one ally within Close range heals 1d6+1/level (max. 5d6+5) hp.
  • Another option is to simply use bestow feat (Rallying Strike; 1st level), then Augment as needed.
  • Strike of righteous vitalityToB: Heal (q.v., 6th level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) = 8th level (listed as 9th); max. 120 hp healed.

Crushing Despair: Spook (0 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level for effects; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (frightened to shaken; -1 level) = 3rd level; those in 30-ft. cone are shaken and sickened for 1 min./level.

Crushing Fist of SpiteBVD: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to cylinder; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10’r. to 5’r.; -1 level) + Explosive Spell (+1 level) = 8th level (listed as 9th); damage cap 20d6 force in a 5’r., 25-ft.-tall cylinder, and those affected ejected from area. Direct each round as a swift action.

Crushing SphereLEM: Otiluke’s resilient sphere (q.v.; 4th level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) + Energy Admixture (bludgeoning; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 6th level; damage cap 20d6/rd. (half crushing, half nonlethal).

Crushing WallsTM2: Energy mace (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cubes; +3 levels) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Delay Spell (activating condition and 1 rd. time delay; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 6th level; area up to one 10-ft. cube/level crushes intruders for up to 7.5d6+90 damage (Reflex half, no SR) 1 rd. after entered.

Cry of YsgardBED: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (1-3 summoned; +1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 9 bariaur ranger; +5 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Str; -1 level) + Crippling Drain (-1 level) = 7th level; summons 1d3 bariaur defenders of Ysgard, but caster takes 1d4 Str drain.

Crystal Dirk, Nystul’sGA: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Cascade Spell [(inertia; +1 levels) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead and lower planar; -1 level) + Positive Spell (+0 levels)] + Concentration Spell (standard action; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 13d6 slashing, divided among melee touch attacks (1.5x and possible dazing vs. undead and lower-planar, others take half).

Crystal Recording (Roger Zelazny, Knight of Shadows): Figment (0 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (no olfactory; ­1 level) = 2nd level; creates audiovisual recording lasting up to 1 hr./level in glass or crystal (repeats continually if shorter recording throughout remaining duration, or permanently, if 6,000 numen invested).

Crystal of ReflectionAUG2: Dispel (0 level) + Augment Spell (reverse back onto caster instead of dispelling; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (rays only; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (no check needed; +2 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 6th level (listed as 2nd); ranged touch attacks targeting you are reflected back on attacker (up to Medium range).
