Deceitful VeneerUI: Skill enhancement (Bluff; 0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (glamer; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (suppress and resume as a standard action; +1 level) = 5th level; subject always seems to be lying (Bluff check, opposed to subject’s passive Bluff score +1/2 levels, to discern otherwise), unless you suppress the effect. Lie detection spells fooled by glamer unless it is disbelieved. Cf. false lieCM.

DecelerationSRD: Celerity (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) = 1st level; target’s land speed reduced by 10 ft. (Fort neg.) for 1 min./level.

Deceptive FacadeCM: Glamer (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (visual only; -1 level) = 2nd level; disguise self/other/object.

DecerebrateSRD: Damage attribute (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (teleportation; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +2 levels) + Crippling Drain (+2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (Int and Wis; +1 level) = 8th level (listed as 7th); 4d4 Int and Wis drain at medium range.

Declaration of DeathRR: Phantasmal killer (q.v.; 4th level) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) = 5th level (listed as 6th); as phantasmal killer, but initial damage is up to 15d6 nonlethal, rather than 3d6.

DecollateHA: Polymorph (monstrous humanoid; 3rd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Tenuous Spell (target dies if head destroyed; -1 level) = 5th level; target’s head detaches; he/she gains DR 5/−, blindsense 30 ft., immunity to decapitation.

DecomposeRR2: Variable Spell (ray of entropy or spark of life; 1st level + 1 level) + Augment Spell (5d6 to 10d6; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Death or Destruction domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 10d6 disintegration to corpse, or 10d6 positive energy to undead touched.

Decompose CorpseUM: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) = 1st level; touch deals 1d6/level to dead flesh (only), turning a corpse (or zombie) into a skeleton.

DecompositionCD: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (injured creatures only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Death or Destruction domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 1d6; -2 levels) = 3rd level; injured creatures within 40’ of you take 1d6 negative energy/round ongoing damage.

Decoy ImageMF: Figment (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Shape Spell (cubes to spread; +0 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) = 4th level; mimics you and allies within 40 ft.; audio, visual, olfactory, and tactile/thermal components.

Decrepit DisguiseOcA: Glamer (1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (-2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. = 80 cu. ft./level to 10 cu. ft./level; -2 levels) = 1st level; object within volume limit appears as a worthless version of itself. AKA dust and dirtBRL.

DeeppocketsUA1: Dimensional pocket (1st level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 216 lbs./level; +4 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (extradimensional spaces must be in existing pockets of focus garment; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 2nd level.

Defenestrating SphereCA: Topple (0 level) + Cascade Spell (energy mace; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 bludgeoning and knock prone with medium ranged touch attack.

Defense against Lycanthropes, Mordenkainen’sGA: Warding (curses; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Creature/Effect Specific Spell (lycanthropes and shapeshifters only; -2 levels) = 2nd level; subject gains +2 deflection vs. [shapeshifters] and is immune to lycanthrope for 1 hour/level.

Defense against Reptiles and Amphibians, Mordenkainen’sGA: Resistance (0 level) + Augment Spell (+4 total; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell ([reptilian] or [amphibian] only; -1 level) = 2nd level; for 1 min./level, subject gains +2 deflection and +4 on saves against creatures with one of the appropriate descriptors (include dinosaurs, since Gygax described them as reptiles in AD&D).

Defile Snow and IceFB: Warding (fire; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (also positive energy; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (snow-covered or icy ground; ­2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead and [cold] creatures; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Evil or Winter domain, etc.; -1 level) = 3rd level; undead and [cold] creatures in 20’r. are immune to fire and positive energy for 1 min./level.

Deflect BlameUI: Glamer (1st level) + Quicken Spell (+4 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); immediate casting makes it seemt to subject that it was attacked by someone other than you, or that someone else just failed your botched Bluff or Diplomacy check, etc.

Defuse TensionPC: Remove condition (fear; 1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (also fatigue; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 2nd level; removed shaken and fatigued conditions.

DehydrateSC: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+1d4; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Bane Spell (plants & [water]; +0 levels) = 3rd level; 2d4 Con (2d6 vs. plants & water creatures).

Déjà VuSRD: Compel (repeat last action; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoid only; -2 levels) = 1st level. Variants:

  • Aura of RepetitionAPG: Compel (repeat last round’s action; 2nd level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Law domain; -1 level) = 3rd level.
  • Rigid thinkingTM2 affects all creatre types (+2 levels), lasts 1 rd./level (+1 level), and is Restricted (access to Law domain; -1 level) = 3rd level.

Delay DeathRD: Warding (death due to hp loss; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Endurance; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 3rd level; subject cannot die from hp loss for 1 rd./level (is still dying at -1, however, but gains +1/2 levels to Endurance checks). Variants:

  • Delay deathCWH lasts 1 min./level (+1 level) but requires a full-round casting time (-1 level).
  • Immortal fortitudeToB is Concentration (swift action; +3 levels) and Cascades bestow feat (Diehard; +1 level) = 7th level (listed as 8th).
  • Prorogate deathAUG2 lasts 10 min./level (+2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 6th).

Delay DiseaseARG: Warding (afflictions; 1st level) + Irresistible Spell (affects nonmagical afflictions; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (disease only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Resistible Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level; target cannot catch new diseases, and existing ones suspended (Concentration check vs. disease DC needed), for 1 hr./level.

Delay PainUM: Warding (pain; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); suppresses magical pain effects.

Delay Poison: Warding (attribute damage; 1st level) + Irresistible Spell (+3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (poison only; -2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (suppresses, but does not grant immunity to exposure; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) = 2nd level.

DemoralizeSRD: Spook (0 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to personal; −1 level) + Augment Spell (frightened to shaken; −1 level) = 2nd level; demoralizes those in 20’r. of you (this is a “pulse,” not an aura).

DenounceAPG: Ray of beguiling (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; subject takes penalty to Cha equal to 1d6 + 1/level (+15 max.).

DepressionDr349: Ray of beguiling (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (touch of fatigue (0 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) = 3rd level; those within 20 ft. of you are fatigued and take a 1d6+1/2 levels penalty to Charisma.

Desecrate: Blessing (0 level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Thanatopic Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 hr./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell ([evil] caster; -1 level) = 2nd level; undead in 20’r. area gain 5d6 temp. hp and +1 profane bonus to attacks, damage, saves vs. positive energy.

  • Ectoplasmic enhancementBVD is Augmented (+5 total bonus; +3 levels) and is Mass Effect rather than an emanation (1 creature/level; +1 level) = 6th level; undead affected gain up to 15d6 temp. hp and +5 profane bonus to attacks, damage, saves vs. positive energy.
  • Incorporeal enhancementLM Cascades deflection (+1 level), is Augmented (scaling bonus; +1 level), and affects one undead/3 levels (+2 levels) = 6th level (listed as 3rd); undead affected gain up to 15d6 temp. hp and +1/4 levels to attacks, damage, deflection, and channel resistance.

Desert TempestToB: Bestow feat (Dodge; 1st level) + Augment Spell (BAB +6; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (use as prerequisite only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Skirmish; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (­1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 6th); swift casting allows you to move your speed and still make iterative attacks that round.

DesiccateSSt: Touch of fatigue (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Bane Spell (plant or water elemental: fixed; +0 levels) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6 desiccation (10d6 arcane), or 5d8 (10d8 arcane) vs. plant or water elemental), plus fatigued (Fort half/neg.). Variants:

  • Ashen UnionSSt: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; +1 level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (touch of fatigue; +1 level) + Augment Spell (exhaustion; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) = 6th level; damage cap 15d6 desiccation plus 1d4 Con drain after damage accrued (which might destroy victim if the additional hp loss kills), exhausted if survive (Fort half/neg./neg.).
  • Release the Water WithinSSt: Touch of fatigue (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (summon; +1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 3 water mephit; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Desert domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 desiccation plus fatigued, and water mephit summoned.

Desperate WeaponUI: Bestow feat (Power over Shadow; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Planar Sense; +1 level) + Augment Spell (6 ranks effects; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (common object only; -2 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (improvised weapon; -2 levels) = 0 level (listed as 1st); swift casting allows you to find an improvised weapon appropriate to your surroundings within easy reach (DC 20 Planar Sense check at +1/2 levels needed).

Destined BlowRRE: Blessing (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+3 total; +1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 hr./level; +1 level) = 4th level; attacks, damage vs. target are at +3 by a specific weapon or creature, or in a specific place (Shape Spell).

Destiny DissonanceSRD: Sickening touch (0 level) + Cross-Class Spell (clairsentience/divination; +1 level) = 1st level.

Destructive AuraCRB: Bestow feat (Improved Critical; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +11 effects; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (crit confrm only; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+4 bonus; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (damage only; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Destruction domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; swift casting grants those in 20’r. +4 profane bonus to damage and automatically confirmed crits for 1 round.

Destructive Resonance, Tenser’sS&M: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Variable Spell:

  • + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Overwhelming Evocation (+1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (unattended object; -2 levels) = +1 level;
  • + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = +1 level.

=5th level; ray deals up to 90 hp force against object struck (hardness and energy resistance do not apply) and up to 10d6 force in a 20’r. blast centered on impact point.

Destructive SmiteCRB: Enhancement (2nd level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (damage; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 to +1/2 levels; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Destruction domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; swift casting grants you +1/2 levels profane bonus to damage for 1 rd.

Detect CharmPH1: Detection (Cha penalty or damage; 2nd level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 1st level; 1st round—presence; 2nd—number; 3rd—type of effect (charm, domination, etc.).

Detect CreatureAUG: Detection (creature; 2nd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (single creature type; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (select creature type at time of casting; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (ends if encounters overwhelming aura, and you are stunned 1 round if HD = 2x yours; -1 level) = 0 level; can detect type only, not specific creatures.

Detect DiseaseAUG, OA: Detection (disease; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (concentration to inst.; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (additional information requires Heal check; ad hoc -1 level) = 0 level.

Detect Favored EnemyMW: Detection (creatures; 2nd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (favored enemies or quarry; -2 levels) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to extreme; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger; -2 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); 1st round—presence or absence, 2nd—type(s) and numbers, 3rd—locations and HD.

Detect FireFB: Detection (creatures, effects, and items with [fire] subtype/descriptor, or on fire; 2nd level) + Tenuous Spell (ends if encounters verwhelming aura, and you are stunned 1 rd. if HD/CL = 2x yours; -1 level) = 1st level.

Detect Hostile IntentSRD: Detection (aggression; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (cone to emanation; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Extend Spell (conc. to 10 min./level; +3 levels) = 5th level (listed as 2nd); you are instantly aware of aggression/hostile intent in 20’r. of you.

Detect IllusionPH1: Detection (illusions; 2nd level) + Restricted Spell (illusionist; -1 level) = 1st level.

Detect LifeUA1: Detection (life; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; ­1 level) = 2nd level; 1st round—presence/absence; 2nd round—number; 3rd round—locations and if comatose, incapacitated, dying, etc.

Detect Metal and MineralsRF: Detection (specified metal/mineral; 2nd level) + Variable Spell (change specified material with concentration; +1 level) = 3rd level; 1st round—presence or absence; 2nd—mass; 3rd—distance and direction.

Detect PhaseS&M: Detection (incorporeal; 2nd level) + Transdimensional Spell (-1 level) = 1st level.

Detect PsionicsSRD: Detection (magical or psionic power manifestation; 2nd level) + Tenuous Spell (ends if encounters overwhelming aura, and you are dazed 1 round; -1 level) = 1st level.

Detect Scrying: Detection (scrying sensors; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (cone to emanation; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Extend Spell (Concentration to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (very contingent usage; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; ­1 level) = 4th level; no concentration needed to maintain effect. Additional information (if you do concentrate) is visual image, direction, and distance of scryer (requires opposed Concentration check).

Detect Secret Passages and PortalsS&M: Detection (secret doors/passages; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (cone to cubes; +1 level) – Concentration Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level (rogue skill trick 1st).

Detect ShapechangersRR2: Detection (shapechangers and polymorphed creatures; 2nd level); 1st round—presence/absence, 2nd—number and power of strongest, 3rd—locations and power of each. Cf. discern shapechangersCA.

  • Discern shapechangerCA is Extended (concentration to 1 rd./level; +3 levels), Personal (-1 level), and Ritual (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level.

Detect ShipSW: Detection (objects; 2nd level) + Object-Specific Spell (ships only; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to line of sight; +4 levels) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); 1st round—presence/absence; 2nd round—number and locations; 3rd round—type, allegiance, etc.

Detect TeleportationSRD: Detection (teleportation; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (cone to emanation; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (nomad; -1 level) = 2nd level; you sense use, can determine direction with concentration.

Detect the FaithfulUI: Detection (worshippers; 2nd level) + Restricted Spell (worshippers of your deity only; -1 level) = 1st level. 1st round—presence or absence; 2nd—numbers; 3rd—locations.

Detect Thoughts: Detection (thoughts of conscious creatures of Int 1+; 2nd level). “Strength” info is Int score; locations not revealed unless you can see the creatures. 3rd round of concentration allows reading of surface thoughts (Intuition negates). Variants:

  • Brain spiderCD is Shaped (cone to target; -1 level), Cascades suggestion (+4 levels), and is Reach (long range; +1 level), Mass Effect (1 creature/level; +3 levels), and Ritual (full round; -1 level) = 8th level; with concentration you can read thoughts of, and implant suggestions in, up to 1 creature/level within Long range.
  • Detect AnxietiesUI: 1st round—presence or absence of fear; 2nd—relative Wis score of one creature and intensity of any [fear] condition affecting it; 3rd—specific anxieties/fears for that creature.
  • Detect DesiresUI: 1st round—presence or absence of desires; 2nd—relative Cha score of one creature; 3rd—most pressing current desire for that creature.
  • Detect DreamsRR2: 1st round—presence or absence of dreams; 2nd round—locations and emotional intensity; 3rd round—you can “see” one dream you continue to concentrate on.
  • Discern kinACG is Effect-Specific Spell (identities and feelings for subject’s relatives only; -2 levels) and Variable (multiple relatives, one after the other; +1 level) = 1st level.
  • Dream scanOcA is Reach (interplanar; +7 levels), Shaped (cone to target; -1 level), and Creature-Specific (subject must be asleep; -2 levels) = 6th level; you read sleeping creature’s thoughts for as long as you concentrate, from any distance.
  • EmpathySRD: Detection (needs/drives/emotions; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (cone to emanation; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st).
  • Flickering fateBRL is Shaped (spread; +1 level), Reach (touch; -1 level), Effect-Specific (intended actions that round; -2 levels), Quickened (+3 levels), and Cascades bestow feat [(Canny Defense and Insightful Strike; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (BAB +16 effects; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (those whose thoughts were read; -2 levels)] = 5th level (listed as 4th); swift casting reveals actions of others in 20’r. for next round (they must announce them if saves failed) and grants you insight bonuses to attacks, damage, and AC against them for that round.
  • Inner viewRRO is non-personal (+1 level), Shaped (cone to target; -1 level), and Restricted (access to Communuty or Inquisition domain; -1 level) = 1st level; with concentration, subject can read the surface thoughts of one designated target creature.
  • Mind probeOcA,SRD is Shaped (cone to target; -1 level), Extended (conc. to 1 rd./level; +1 level), Expedient (opposed Bluff check persimissible to give false or no replies; -1 level), and Ritual (-2 levels), and Cascades mindlink and compel (+2 levels) = 3rd level; you mentally ask 1 question/rd. and gain telepathic response (subject compelled to answer). Probe thoughtsCD has a full-round casting time (+1 level) = 4th level; sleeping subject saves each round to wake up and end effect, if awake can also move out of range.
  • Ray’s mind scanGA is Augmented (gain access to dreams, suppressed memories, etc. after 5 rounds; ad hoc +2 levels) = 4th level.

DetonateAPG: Ray of frost (0) + Variable Spell (acid, cold, electricity, or fire, chosen at time of effect; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Empower Spell (+1 level) = 4th level; 1.5 x 1d6/level (max. 15d6 at 10th level) in 40’r. burst centered on you.

DetonatePHII: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +2 levels) + Crippling Drain (+3 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Cascade Spell [jet of flame (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (-1 level) = +2 levels] = 9th level; 3d4 Con drain to target and up to 20d6 fire damage in a 20’r. centered on the target.

Devastation, MassAUG: Energy mace (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to bloodline, domain, etc. with appropriate elemental descriptor; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

  • Air: Cascade Spell (zephyr; +1 level) + Augment Spell (windstorm to tornado; +1 level) = 8th level; damage cap 20d6 bludgeoning, plus gust of tornado wind.
  • Earth: Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (pin; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 10d6; -2 levels) = 8th level; 10d6 bludgeoning plus pinned 1 rd./level.
  • Fire: Versatile Evocation (fire; +0 levels) + Lingering Evocation (+2 levels) = 8th level; damage cap 20d6 fire plus 5d6 burn.
  • Water: Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Explosive Spell (+1 level) = 8th level; damage cap 20d6 bludgeoning plus knocked prone and swept out of area.

Devilbane RefrainAG: Versatile weaponAPG (q.v.; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (bladebaneUnE; +4 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 4th level; weapon penetrates DR/silver and deals up to +10d6 damage vs. [evil], divided among attacks, each with +5 to attack and damage.

Devil’s EgoBVD: Warding (creature-specific effects; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Cha; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 Cha; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; you gain +4 enhancement to Cha and immunity to magic targeting non-outsiders (assuming you are some other type).

Devil’s GateAUG2: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 7 max. devil; +5 levels) + Variable Spell (no control over type; -1 level) + Extend Spell (onset: inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 7th level, each round for 1 rd./level, a random lesser devil (bearded devil, kyton, or erinyes) is summoned.

Devil’s TailBVD: Invisible needle (0 level) + Concen-tration Spell (swift action; +4 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to [lawful, evil] domain, mystery, or bloodline; -1 level) = 1st level; you grow a tail that makes melee attacks (1/round as a swift action) for 1d6/level (max. 5d6).

Devil’s TongueBVD: Bind (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Wis; -1 level) = 3rd level; your tongue can grapple at Close range as a standard action. AKA tongue tendrilsBVD. Variant:

  • Frog TongueRR: Bind (0 level) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +3 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/3 levels; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; −1 level) + Restricted Spell (druid; −1 level) = 3rd level; 1 ally/3 levels gains tongue (entangles at close range as a partial action).

Dextrous Digits, Bigby’sGA: Mage hand (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 8 lbs./level; +1 level) + Variable Spell (manipulate multiple objects; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Dex; capable of fine manipulation; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level; you can manipulate objects (up to weight limit shown) and even use manual skills at Medium range.

Diagnose DiseaseUM: Detection (disease; 2nd level); 1st round—presence, 2nd round—type and location, 3rd—effects, and best means to treat. For purposes of this spell, molds, slimes, and similar hazards, plus effects causing sickness and/or nausea, count as “diseases.”

DictateS&M: Compel (2nd level) + Variable Spell (choose command at time of casting; +1 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Charm or Law domain; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); as command, but longer-lasting and affects all in area.

DictationS&M: Summon (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (trabscription only; -2 levels) = 1st level; invisible scribe (treat as Expert 2 with max. ranks and Skill Focus in Knowledge (linguistics)) provides transcription of everything said in vicinity for the next 1 min./level.

Dictum: Alter senses (deafened; 0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

  • Cascade Spell (dismissal: q.v.; +4 levels); or

DigPH1: Shaping (2nd level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (earth only; -2 levels) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 27 cu. ft./level; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 4th level; moves one 5-ft. cube/level of earth per round while you concentrate. Dragon’s BreathRR: Acid splash (0 level) + Variable Spell (Versatile Evocation: acid, cold, electricity, fire; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Delay Spell (standard action trigger; +1 level) + Variable Spell (Shape Spell: cone, or Reach Spell: medium; +1 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 14d6, divisible among multiple breaths (each released as a standard action).

Drain Away SpeedAUG: Celerity (0 level) + Variable Spell (different speeds; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Augment Spell (+10 ft. to +30 ft.; +1 level) = 2nd level; target’s speed reduced by 30 ft. for 1 min./level.

Drain ProwessDR337: Enervation (4th level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 target/3 levels; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to targets; +0 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (1d4 to 1d2; -2 levels) = 4th level; 1 target/3 levels takes 1d2 temp. negative levels (Fort half).

Drain VitalityToB: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level; melee attack also deals 1d4 Con damage (Fort half).

Draw Upon Holy MightTM2: Attribute boost (0 level) + Variable Spell (select attribute at time of casting; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2 to +6; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; you gain +6 enhacement to one attribute for 1 rd./level.

Dread BlastPGF: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) = 5th level; Close ranged touch deals up to 15d6 negative energy plus dazed 1 rd.

Dread WordBVD: Damage attribute (Cha; 1st level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (evil caster; -1 level) = 3rd level; 1d4 Cha drain at Medium range (Will half; if successful, second save neg.).

Dreaded FreezeAUG2: Spook (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Fell Frightening (+1 level) + Augment Spell (cowering; +1 level) = 4th level (listed as 1st); targets cower, motionless, for 1 rd. (Will shaken instead).

DreadscapeHA: Ray of beguiling (1st level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (to panicked to unnerved and +20 to +15; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 4th); unless disbelieve, subjects unnerved and determine reaction to others as if their Cha were 1d6 +1/level (+15 max.) less than actual (hostile if reduced to 1).

Dream SightCD: Detection (visual; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to line of sight; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (concentration to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (Dreamspun bloodline, etc.; -1 level) = 6th level; your spirit travels up to ¼ mile/min. and observes as it goes.

Dreaming PuppetHH: PossessionOcA (3rd level) + Cross-Class Spell (enchantment [compulsion]; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to interplanar; +7 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (sleeping target; -2 levels) = 5th level; you possess a sleeping creature from any distance.

Dress CorpseUI: Shaping (2nd level) + Object-Specific Spell (corpse; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Heal; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 8 cu. ft./level; +1 level) = 2nd level; make state of corpse seem to match cause of death you decide (opposed Heal check to interpret correctly, and you get +1/2 levels bonus).

Drowning GlanceCM: Touch of fatigue (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (exhausting; +1 level) + Fell Fatigue (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) = 1st level; target is exhausted 1 rd. (Fort fatigued).

Drug ResistanceBVD: Warding (addiction; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (drug addiction only; -2 levels) = 2nd level.

Druid GroveMW: Spell (6th level or below) + Delay Spell (standard; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (grove; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 5th level; you can store up to 1 spell/3 levels (max. 6th level) in the trees of a sacred grove, held latent until you use a standard action to release them.

Drums of Despair, Otto’sGA: Spook (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 20-ft.; +1 level) + Augment Spell (frightened to shaken; -1 level) = 3rd level; those in one 20-ft. cube/level are shaken 1 rd./level.

DungeonsightPC: Detection (architectural layout; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (cone to emanation; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) = 5th level; you gain mental image of architectural layout in 60’r. while you concentrate. Note that areas enclosed behind more than 1 ft. of stone, 3 ft. or earth or wood, or 1” of metal are hidden from the divination.

DuplicateCWH: Creation (1st level) + Variable Spell (material(s); +1 level) + Cascade Spell (shaping; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (complex objects possible; +1 level) + Item-Specific Spell (object to be duplicated; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (choose object at time of casting; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 5-ft. cubes; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; by touch, you create a duplicate of any mundane, nonliving object that can fit within one 5-ft. cube/level (no craft check needed due to template).

Dust of TwilightAPG: Gloom (0 level) + Cascade Spell (touch of fatigue; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) = 3rd level; reduces ambient light by 2 steps and save or fatigued in 10’r. area.

Dust WardMC: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Overwhelming Evocation (+2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Delay Spell (time delay; +1 level) + Variable Spell (two activating conditions; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level; item takes 1d6 negative energy/level (max. 15d6; no SR, bypasses hardness and energy resistance) after 1 hour of being held/worn by unauthorized creature type, or if studied to learn properties, etc. Requires investment of 300 x CL numen as a latent spell effect.

Eagle AerieUM: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 3 giant eagles; +3 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (summoner or access to Animal domain; -1 level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 6th level; summons 1 giant eagle/3 levels which, if ordered to fight, are entitled to a save each round of combat to end the spell. Cf. summon flight of eaglesAG.

Earth BlastRR2: Invisible needle (0 level) + Energy Admixture (bludgeoning; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 (half piercing, half bludgeoning) and knocked prone (Reflex half/neg.) in 20’r.

Earth BurstAUG: Energy mace (0 level) + Energy Admixture (piercing; +0 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +3 levels) + Delay Spell (standard activation; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; rock bursts on command for 5d6 damage (half bludgeoning, half piercing) in 20’r.

Earth TremorUW: Energy mace (0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

  • Shape Spell (ray to line or ray to cone; +1 level);
  • Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) = +1 level.

+ Residual Spell (+1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 (divine 5d6) bludgeoning, plus leaves area of difficult terrain.

EarthboltCA: Energy mace (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to line; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (earth or stone ground or floor; -1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Residual Spell (+1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 (no SR) and difficult terrain.

Earthen ClawAUG: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Augment Spell (5d6 to 10d6; +1 level) = 2nd level; close ranged touch deals 1d6 slashing/level (max. 10d6) and knocks prone.

Earthen GraspCA: Bind (0 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (unworked earth; −2 levels) = 2nd level; makes 1 grapple attempt/round.

Earthquake: Energy mace (0 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (pin; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 10d6; -3 levels) = 7th level; 10d6 bludgeoning (divine 5d6) and pinned under rubble (+1d6/round). Variants:

  • Cave FangsUW: Energy mace (0 level) + Energy Admixture (piercing; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. cubes to 5-ft. cubes; -1 level) + Variable Spell (cubes need not be adjacent; +1 level) + Delay Spell (area entered; +1 level) = 5th level; damage 10d6 (half piercing, half bludgeoning) plus knocked prone and entangled in rubble (Reflex half/neg.), and leaves difficult terrain 1 rd./level.
  • Great Worm of the EarthCM: Energy mace (0 level) + Enegy Admixture (acid; +0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (pin; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Earth domain, etc.; -1 level) = 5th level; damage cap 15d6 (half bludgeoning, half acid) per round plus pin.
  • IcebergFB: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) +Augment Spell (pin; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell ([cold] bloodline, etc.; -1 level) = 8th level (listed as 9th); damage cap 20d6 bludgeoning plus pinned in 60’r. (Reflex half/neg.).
  • Stone AssaultRR2: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (pin; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cubes; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Earth domain; -1 level) = 6th level (listed as 7th); damage cap 15d6 plus pinned 1 rd./level in one 10-ft. cube/level.
  • VortexAPG: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (pin; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to vertical cone; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (in water only; -2 levels) = 6th level; damage cap 15d6 bludgeoning plus pinned (and subject to damage each round until freed).

Ease of BreathFB: Bestow feat (Favored Terrain: mountains; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (altitude affinity only; -2 levels) = 3rd level (ranger 1st).

Ease PainBED: Remove condition (pain; 1st level) + Augment Spell (moderate conditions; +1 level) = 2nd level; removes minor and moderate fatigue, nonlethal damage, sickening, etc. from [pain] effects.

Easy ClimbCAd: Skill enhancement (Athletics; 0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to line; +1 level) + Widen Spell (5 ft. wide to 10 ft. wide; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (vertical surface; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger; −2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 3rd); +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to climb surface (10’ft. wide area, to a height up to Medium range) for 10 min./level.

EchoUW: Figment (0 level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (no visual component; -1 level) = 1st level; as ghost sound, but speech possible, either repeat same sound for 1 rd./level, or change sound (and apparent source location, within area) as a standard action.

EclipseRR: Gloom (0 level) + Cascade Spell (warding: light; +2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5 mi./level; +9 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (shadow bloodline, mystery, etc.; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (5 steps to 2 steps; -3 levels) = 9th level; light reduced by 2 steps across large area lasts 10 min./level, cannot be alleviated with mundane or magical light sources.

EclipseSRD: Gloom (0 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5 mi.; +7 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (4 steps to 3 steps; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as epic); area of darkness in 5-mile radius emanation around you lasts 1 hr./level.

Ecstasy, Gulaben’sRR2: Damage attribute (Wis; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (also Cha; +1 level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (panicked to shaken; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 5th); touch deals 1d4 Wis and Cha damage (up to 1d4 total is drain) and unnerves 1 min./level (Will half/neg.).

Ectoplasmic ArmorLM: Mage armor (1st level) + Augment Spell (+8 total bonus; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (incorporeal attacks only; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; you gain +8 armor bonus vs. incorporeal attacks.

Ectoplasmic ShamblerSRD: Wisp (0 level) + Cascade Spell (dispel; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd.; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to long; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 10d6; -2 levels) = 5th level; area deals negative energy damage (10d6/rd., Fort half), obstructs vision, forces opposed Concentration checks to cast spells while you concentrate.

Ectoplasmic SnareOcA: Bind (0 level) + Cascade Spell (energy mace; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Fell Entangling (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 bludgeoning and grappled (Reflex half/entangled) while you concentrate.

Efficacious Monster WardTM2: Hedge (2nd level) + Shape Spell (emanation to cubes; +0 levels) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature type/level; +3 levels) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Protection or Riftwarden domain; -1 level) = 4th level; creatures of 8 HD or less of 1 type/level are hedged out of area for 1 rd./level.

Effortless ArmorUC: Bestow feat (Skill Focus: Endurance; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Endurance; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (reduce armor penalty only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; reduces ACP by 1 + 1/6 levels.

Ego WhipSRD: Damage attribute (Cha; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (compel: daze; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoid; -2 levels) = 2nd level; 1d4 Cha damage plus dazed 1 rd. (Will half/neg.).

Ego Whip IOcA: Ray of beguiling (1st level) + Variable Spell (choose mental attribute at time of casting; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; +1 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (+15 to +5; -2 levels) = 3rd level; target takes 1d6 + ½ levels (+5 max.) penalty to one mental attribute for 1 rd./level and is staggered 1 rd. (Will half/neg.).

Ego Whip IIOcA: Ray of beguiling (1st level) + Variable Spell (choose mental attribute at time of casting; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; +1 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (+15 to +10; -1 level) = 4th level; target takes 1d6 + ½ levels penalty to one mental attribute and is staggered 1 rd./level or until save (Will half/neg.).

Ego Whip IIIOcA: Ego whip IIOcA (4th level) – Tenuous Spell (+1 level) = 5th level; target takes 1d6 + 1/level (+15 max.) penalty to one mental attribute and is staggered 1 rd./level (Will half/neg.).

Ego Whip IVOcA: Ego whip IIIOcA (5th level) – Reduce Spell (+1 level) = 6th level; target takes 1d6 + 1/level (+20 max.) penalty to one mental attribute and is staggered 1 rd./level (Will half/neg.).

ElationBEM: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Dex; +1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (+60 ft. to +5 ft.; -3 levels) = 3rd level; +2 morale bonus to Str and Dex, and +5 ft. speed, to those in 120’r.

Electric VengeancePHII: Inure (electricity; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (electric arc; +1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level; you gain resistance 5/2 levels (30 max.) to electricity for 1 min./level, and the next attacker to hit you in melee takes up to 1d6 electricity/level (max. 10d6 arcane or 5d6 for divine caster). AKA vivid dischargeAUG2. Variants:

  • Defensive ShockUM: Electric arc (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Delay Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 12d6 electricity (half on first discharge, then half of remainder, etc.).
  • Greater electric vengeancePHII also Cascades inertia (+1 level) + Augment Spell (dazing; +2 levels) = 5th level; damage cap 15d6 plus dazed 1 rd.
  • Lethene’s inner stormRR2 is Bane (metal-armored; +0 levels), Personal (-1 level), Extended (1 rd./level; +2 levels), Mass Effect (1 attack/level; +3 levels), and Reduced (-1 level) = 5th level; one melee attack/level per round hitting you deals up to 10d6 electricity to the attacker (arcane 15d6; 10d8/15d8 if metal-armored).
  • Radiant shieldBED is Extended to 1 rd./level (+2 levels) = 4th level; attackers take 1d6 +1/level (+15 max.) electricity per hit.

Electrical Screen, Otiluke’sGA: Electric arc (0 level) + Conductive Evocation (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20-ft. squares; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 5th level; 10d6 electrical and entangled 1 rd./level.

Elemental AuraAPG: Ray of frost (0) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Variable Spell (+2 levels; see below) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 1d6; -3 levels) = 3rd level; damage 1d6/rd. plus additional effect in 20’r. emanation around you:

  • Versatile evocation (acid; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level);
  • Versatile evocation (cold; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (touch of fatigue; +1 level);
  • Versatile evocation (electricity; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level);
  • Versatile evocation (fire; +0 levels) + Lingering Evocation (2d6, +1 level).

Elemental AuraTM2: Warding (1st level) + Variable Spell (choose element at time of casting; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Cascade Spell (hedge; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (planar adaptation; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (bloodline, school, etc. with appropriate elemental descriptor; -1 level) = 9th level; choose one element: you gain immunity to appropriate energy type and to attacks from elemementals of that element, and can survive, breathe, move, etc. on the appropriate elemental plane.

Elemental Body ICRB: Polymorph (elemental; 3rd level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level: Cascade Spell (attribute boost or enhancement: natural AC; +1 level)) = 4th level

Elemental Body IICRB: Polymorph (elemental; 3rd level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (enhancement: natural AC; +1 level) + Augment Spell (better natural AC) = 5th level.

Elemental Body IIICRB: Elemental body II (5th level) + Cascade Spell (enlarge self; +1 level) = 6th level.

Elemental Body IVCRB: Polymorph (elemental; 3rd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (specific element; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (enlarge self; +1 level) + Augment Spell (Huge; +1 level) = 7th level; +6 Str, -2 Dex, +2 Con, +2 Wis (and +2 Cha at 15th, +2 Int at 18th), +4 natural AC, elemental traits as shown. AKA elemental bodyMP.

Elemental BurstCA: Variable Spell (invisible needle, jet of flame, or topple; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (5d6 to 1d6; -1 level) = 1st level; deal 1d6 damage or knock prone in 10’r. burst.

Elemental EyeCM: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (not blocked by stone; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (scrying sensor must be placed in advance; -1 level) + Delay Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (wu jen; −1 level) = 3rd level; as clairvoyance, but you place focus in advance (which then becomes the sensor) and it activates some time thereafter (either by standard action concentration or in response to pre-set trigger).

Elemental KissRR2: Polymorph (elemental; 3rd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (neutralize poison; +4 levels) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (-1 level) = 8th level (7th with access to appropriate elemental domain); subject healed 1d6/level (max. 20d6), cured of poisons, and gains elemental type (including DR, senses, immunities, etc.) for 1 rd./level.

Elemental ProdME: PushPH1 (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (bolf of force; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (elementals only; -2 levels) + + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level; pushes elemental 20 ft./rd. with concentration; you can choose to deal 1d6 force/level (max. 10d6) if it resists.

Elemental Swarm: Summon (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 10 greater elemental; +5 levels) + Augment Spell (1d3 Huge elementals plus 1d4+1 Large elementals = 1d4+1 greater elementals; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 9th level; summons one greater elemental, 1d3 Huge elementals, and 1d4+1 Large elementals of the same type.

Elemental TouchAPG: Acid splash (0) + Concentration Spell (standard action; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (-2 levels) + Variable Spell (+2 levels; see below) = 2nd level; touch or attack deals +1d6 energy damage plus sickened, fatigued, entangled, or catch on fire.

  • Versatile evocation (acid; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level)
  • Versatile evocation (cold; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (touch of fatigue; +1 level)
  • Versatile evocation (electricity; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level)
  • Versatile Evocation (fire; +0 levels) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level).

Elemental WardCA: Compel (leave w/o attacking; 2nd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (specific elemental type; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (wu jen, elementalist, etc.; -1 level) = 4th level; turns elementals.

Embrace the WildCAd: Polymorph (animal; 3rd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (senses only; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Animal domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; gain animal senses for 10 min./level.

Emerald BurstBEM: Inertia (0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

  • Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (evil only; -2 levels) = +2 levels; or

Envious UrgeUM: Compel (mug; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 6th level; affected targets attempt to rob the nearest creature, disarming weapons and stealing items (grappling if necessary), until a successful save is made.

Ephod of MeleeRR: Deflection (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+6 bonus; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (ranged attacks and Reflex saves only; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; −2 levels) = 0 level; you gain +6 sacred bonus to Reflex saves and to AC vs. ranged attacks for 1 min./level.

Escalating EnfeeblementCM: Ray of enfeeblement (1st level) + Variable Spell [(Empower Spell; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (fatigued or exhausted; -2 levels) = 2nd level; as ray of enfeeblement, but penalty is 1.5x greater vs. a fatigued or exhausted target.

Estate TransferrenceTM2: Create lesser demiplane (7th level) + Transdimensional Spell (elemental plane; +1 level) + Variable Spell (maintain material plane features as were; +1 level) = 9th level; you impinge up to one 20-ft. cube/level of the Material Plane as a demi-planar pocket in an elemnental plane of your choice. Ethereal Jaunt: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (ethereal plane; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 7th level. AKA wraithformUA1. Variants:

Ethereal PrisonAUG2: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+4d4; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (mindlink; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (dimensional pocket; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level (listed as 4th); helpless or willing subject sent to demi-plane, held in stasis if 5d4 Dex damage reduces to 0 or less, and caster can mentally communicate with subject. Exhalation of ChernRR2: Damage attribute (Int; 1st level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) = 5th level; cone deals 1d4 Int drain +1d4/rd.

Exhalation of the Black DragonSRD: Acid spash (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) = 1st level (listed as 3rd); damage cap 5d6 acid.

= 3rd level (listed as 6th); damage cap 20d6 bludgeoning to primary target, plus 5d6 slashing in a 10’r. (Reflex half).

Extend LifeAUG: Remove condition (attribute loss from aging; 1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 attribute/3 levels; +3 levels) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (+2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 7th); removes 1d4 penalty from aging from 1 attribute/3 levels (Str, Dex, and Con; Wis at CL 12th, Int at 15th, Cha at 18th).   • Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Dex; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Crippling Drain (+2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = +4 levels; 3d4 Dex drain (as flesh to stone).

Fabricate, GreaterSRD: Fabricate (q.v.; 5th level) + Widen Spell (8 cu. ft./level to 216 cu. ft./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (transmuter; -1 level) = 6th level.

Fade into DarknessDU: Skill enhancement (Stealth; 0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +5; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Darkness domain or able to use darkness as spell-like ability; -1 level) = 0 level; you gain +1/level (+5 max.) to Stealth for 10 min./level.

Faerie Fire: Warding (glamers; 1st level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (concealment only; -2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (dim light; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Sun or Void domain; -1 level) = 1st level; creatures and objects in burst glow softly, lose concealment from darkness or glamer spells (blur, invisibility, etc.) for 1 min./level.

Faithful Phantom Defenders, Mordenkainen’sGA: Summon (1st level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Selective Spell (summoned monsters not affected by your spells; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2 levels) = 5th level; summons 1d4+1 Resolute blue sharks, dire bats, or 4th level human warriors, or 1d3 Resolute centaurs.

Faithful Phantom Guardian, Mordenkainen’sGA: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 6; +4 levels) + Delay Spell (appears when attacked; +1 level) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level; summons one human ghost fighter 3/warrior 3 with the Ghost Strike, Improved Initiative, and Permanent Spell (see invisibility) feats, and the Shield Other talent.

Faithful Phantom Shield-Maidens, Morden-kainen’sGA: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (2 summoned; + 1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 2; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 4th level; summons a pair of 3rd level Resolute human fighters with chainmail, heavy shields, and spears (Exotic use); the Armor Training and Shield Other talents; and the Shared Shield feat.

False BravadoMW: Compel (act as though raging; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (touch of fatigue; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); subject is convinved it is raging (as barbarian rage), refrains from casting spells and attempts to use Power Attack, etc., for 1 rd./level or until saves, is fatigued thereafter.

False FlavorRR2: Glamer (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (food or drink; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (emanaton to cubes; +0 levels) + Augment Spell (olfactory/taste; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20-ft. to 1-ft. cubes; -3 levels) = 0 level; alters taste of 1 cu. ft./level of food or drink.

False FutureUI: Glamer (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) = 5th level; for 1 hr./level, divinations reveal fictitious destiny, events, etc. concerning subject.

False LieCM: Skill enhancement (Bluff; 0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (glamer; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 2nd level; Bluff checks to sense subject’s motive or detect his/her lies are at -1/2 levels (-10 max.), and failure indicates observer believes subject to be lying. Likewise, failed lie detection spells indicate a lie, rather than no result. Invest 400 x CL numen (2nd level x 50 x 4) to maintain the effect beyond 1 rd./level. Cf. deceitful veneerUI.

False PriestDr353: Warding (lie detection; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Cultist domain or demon lord/archdevil/Great Old One parton deity; -1 level) = 3rd level; you are immune to magical attempts to uncover falsehood (discern lies, zone of truth, etc.).

False ResurrectionUI: Summon (1st level) + Ruse Spell (raise dead; +1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 9 Advanced shadow demon; +5 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 2 hrs./level; +4 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (into corpse to be possessed; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 6th level (listed as 7th); apparent raise dead ritual instead summons an Advanced shadow demon (Perform: acting 9/+20) to possess the corpse, and magical aura, etc. are disguised to appear correct.

False Resurrection, GreaterUI: False resurrection (q.v.; 6th level) + Augment Spell (CR 12 Young belier devil; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 8th level (listed as 9th); apparent resurrection instead causes belier devil to possess the corpse. Invest 400 x CL numen to maintain indefinitelty.

False Sensory InputSRD: Glamer (1st level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (defeats true seeing, etc.; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level; phantasm with auditory, visual, and/or olfactory components, which you can change from round to round, lasts for as long as you concentrate.

False Vision: Glamer (1st level) + Variable Spell (change image; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (visible to scrying only; -2 levels) + Widen Spell (10’r. to 30’t.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 5th level; scrying area reveals illusion.

False Vision, GreaterUI: Glamer (1st level) + Variable Spell (change image; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (visible to scrying only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to planar; +5 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 7th level; scrying on individual reveals illusory actions and surroundings.

Familiar MeldingUM: Magic jar (5th level) + Creature-Specific Spell (your familiar; -2 levels) = 3rd level; you possess your familiar, leaving your body helpless.

Familiar RefugeCM: Greater teleport (7th level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (you or your familiar; -2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) = 7th level; swift casting brings your familiar to you (or vice versa). Cf. callbackUW.

FamiliarityRRO: Blessing (0 level) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Insightful Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 total; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (vs. specified target only; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 5th); you gain +4 insight to atks, damage, and AC vs. specified target.

Family CurseAUG: Blessing (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +4; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (relatives of priary target only; -1 level) = 6th level (listed as 3rd); up to 1 related creature (members of family)/3 levels takes -4 penalty to attacks, damage, and saves for 1 min./level; invest 600 x CL numen to maintain indefinitely.

Fang TrapSK: Invisible needle (0 level) + Energy Admixture (bludgeoning; +0 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grappled; +1 level) + Delay Spell (proximity trigger; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); when triggered, damage cap 10d6 (half bludgeoning, half piercing) plus grappled 1 rd./level.

Fantastic MachineFRCS: Summon (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Augmernt Spell (CR 3; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Artifice domain; ­1 level) = 4th level (listed as 6th); conjures one construct:
