Far ReachingTM2: Bestow Feat (Reach Spell; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Sudden Metamagic; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) = 2nd level; spells you cast for the next round have their range increased, as if by the Sudden Metamagic (Reach Spell) feat (limits to total spell level, etc. apply). This also subsumes telethaumaturgyTM2.

FarfingerRR2: Invisible needle (0 level) + Variable Spell (effect aimed by secondary subjects; +1 level) + Delay Spell (as used; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (skeleton; -2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) = 3rd level; 1 skeleton/level can make 1 ranged touch attack/level (max. 10) for 1d6 piercing each.

Fast EscapeBRL: Skill enhancement (Escape Artist; 0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +10; +1 level) = 1st level; you gain +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Escape Artist checks.

Fatal FlameCSc: Jet of flame (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (when subject killed; +1 level) = 1st level; when killed, subject explodes for up to 5d6 fire damage to adjacent creatures.

Fate LinkSRD: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Variable Spell (Versatile Evocation; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (two subjects; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (seer or access to Community domain, etc.; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (+20 to +10; -2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 3rd); any time one subject takes damage, the other takes 1d6+10 of the same type, if within Close range.

Fate’s ProofRW: Hand of fate (0 level) + Quicken Spell (+4 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (halfling or Destined bloodline, Fate domain, etc.; -1 level) = 3rd level; reroll any one roll as an immediate action, after learning results of first.

Favor of IlmaterPGF: Warding (1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Endurance; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 effect/3 levels; +2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 4th); subject +1/2 levels to Endurance, and is immune to Cha damage, compulsions, and nonlethal damage for 1 min./level (and existing effects suppressed), plus the following at higher caster levels: 12th—inertia, 15th—affictions, 18th—pain effects.

Favorable WindSW: Zephyr (0 level) + Shape Spell (line to cone; +1 level) + Widen Spell (30 ft, to 60 ft.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); creates severe wind in a 60-ft. cone (can fill sails of ship).

Fear and Weakness GazeFC2: Ray of enfeeblement (1st level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Pattern Spell (visual; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; each round as a swift action, one creature within close range takes a 1d6 +1/2 levels penalty to Str (Fort half) and is frightened (Will neg.).

Fear ContagionTM2: Spook (0 level) + Fell Frightening (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (cowering to panicked; -1 level) = 8th level; up to 1 creature/level is panicked (Will shaken) for 1 hr./level, and emanates aura of panic in a 20’r.

Fear WardCWH: Warding (fear; 1st level) + Irresistible Spell (+3 levels) + Mass Effect Spell [(all schools; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead casters only; ­2 levels)] + Cascade Spell (hedge: undead; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (10’r. emanation to 5’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 7th level (listed as 8th); subject immune to fear and magical abilities of undead, and undead cannot approach within 5 ft.

Fearful TouchAPG: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+2; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (warding: fear immunity; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min,/level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) = 2nd level; touch removes resistances/immunities to fear, and subject -2 to atks, damage, saves vs. fear for 1 rd.

Fearsome Aspect, Phade’sDr333: Glamer (1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Bluff; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Staredown; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +11 effects; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 6th level (listed as 2nd); subject gains illusory demonic appearance, can demoralize 30’r. as a partial action with +1/2 levels to the check.

Fearsome DuplicateARG: Figment (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (vision and hearing; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Bluff; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (halfling; -1 level) = 3rd level; larger, monstrous image of you at medium range mimics you, serves as scrying sensor, and provides +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Bluff checks.

Fearsome GrappleWotC: Bestow feat (Improved Grapple; 1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +6 effects; +1 level) + Personal Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level; as a partial action, you gain +3 to grapple checks plus grab and maintain grapple.

Feast of AshesAPG: Warding (nutrition; 1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (normal food; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 3rd level; target immediately begins to starve (invest numen to maintain effect: 3rd x CL 5th x 50 x 6 = 4,500).

Feast of WormsDD: Summon (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 4 lard wormCrC colony; +2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 2nd); summons lard worm colony into opponent’s space.

Feast on FearACG: Spook (0 level) + Concentration Spell (swift; +5 levels) + Cascade Spell (lesser false life; +1 level) + Expedient Spell (-1 level) = 5th level; 1 attack/rd. panics (shaken if save) and grants you 5 temp. hp; creatures over 9 HD unaffected.

Feat LeechSRD: Bestow feat (1st level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (feats must be known by creature touched; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); you gain up to 1 feat/3 levels known by creature you touch; target loses same feats for 1 min./level.

Feather StepAPG: Skill enhancement (Acrobatics; 0 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (difficult terrain only; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 to +10; +1 level) = 1st level; subject +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Acrobatics checks to ignore difficult terrain. Note that the spell does not grant outright immunity to difficult terrain.

FeathersMW: Polymorph (animal; 3rd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (Small mundane bird; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (willing subjects; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Animal domain; -1 level) = 4th level; one willing subject/level is polymorphed into a Small crow, owl, etc. (low-light vision, fly 60 ft.) for up to 1 hr./level.

FeedbackAUG2: Electric arc (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 4th level; for next 1 rd./level, subject takes 1d6 +1/level (+15 max.) electrical damage whenever performing specified action.

  • Jolting portentUC is similar, but also incorporates Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 5th level; target saves vs. Intuition or takes up to 15d6 electrical damage the first time each round it damages an opponent within Medium range.

FermentationRRE: Creation (alcohol; 1st level) + Variable Spell (type appropriate to starting liquid; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 1 pint/level; -2 levels) = 0 level; beverage becomes alcoholic (as if brewed/fermented); if already so, becomes more so (as if distilled). Cf. deCamp & Pratt, “The Mathematics of Magic.”

  • Water to WineOJ13: Transmute (water to alcoholic beverage; 1st level) + Augment Spell (valuable liquid; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 1 gallon/level; -1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 2 hrs./level; +2 levels) = 3rd level.

FesterAPG: Warding (healing; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 level) = 2nd level; subject immune to spark of life-based spells for 1 min./level (Fort half). Variants:

  • BlackmantleCWH is Cross-Class Spell (necromancy; +1 level), Shaped (target to emanation; +2 levels), Irresistible (+2 levels), and Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level; those in 20’r. area cannot heal damage through magical or natural means (emanation lasts 1 min./level).
  • Cursed bladeCW is Accursed instead of Reach, is Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) and Restricted (assassin or blackguard; -1 level), and includes Ray Splitting (+1 level) and Channel Spell (+1 level) = 5th level (listed as 4th); damage dealt by affected weapon cannot be healed for 1 min./level (invest 200 x CL numen to maintain effect until remove curse is used on the damaged creature).
  • Ebon ray of doomLEF is Irresistible (+2 levels) = 4th level; target immune to magical and nonmagical healing for 1 rd./level (Fort neg.).
  • Entropic FieldCD: Warding (healing; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Lingering Evocation (1d6; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (hand of fate; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Chaos domain; -1 level) = 4th level; magical healing fails in 20’r., those damaged take 1d6 bleed thereafter, and you can force 1 reroll/rd. within field.
  • Healing InterdictionRR2: Warding (healing; 1st level) Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (attribute damage as well as hp; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) = 8th level; subject cannot heal hp or attribute damage by any means, for 1 hr./level. Invest 400 x CL numen to maintain curse.
  • LiferotDr347 is Irrestistible (+2 levels) = 4th level; subject resists natural and magical healing for 1 min./level.

Festering StrikePF113: Damage attribute (Str; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Str; +1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Pestilence domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; as a [strike], deal 1d4 Str and Con damage and cause victim to be sickened 1 rd./level (Fort half/neg.).

Fever DreamCM: Whelm (0 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (ailing; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

  • Cascade Spell (ray of obliviousness; +1 level), when ends; or
  • Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (see below; -2 levels).

= 4th level (listed as 5th); up to 10d6 nonlethal plus ailing 1 rd./level, and take 1d6 +1/level (+10 max.) penalty to Wis for 1 rd./level when spell ends (Intuition negates all effects; if fail, 3d6 nonlethal plus Will for half damage, Fort to negate ailing, and Intuition for half Wis penalty). A creature under the effects of a luminous swarmCM or prickling tormentCM spell gets no save, but also takes no Wis penalty when the exhaustion/fatigue ends.

Fey Form IUW: Polymorph (fey; 3rd level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Magical Talent; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Magical Array; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (90 ft. to 30 ft., etc.; -1 level) = 4th level; you assume fey form, gain low-light vision, +2 Dex, +2 natural armor, iron allergy, suite of fey spell-like abilities (as applicable to type, max. level equal to level of fey form spell, even if Concentration allows higher), plus water breathing and/or fly 30 ft., swim 30 ft., up to 3 natural attacks (as applicable to form).

Fey Form IIUW: Fey form IUW (q.v.; 4th level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (enlarge self or reduce self; +1 level) = 6th level (druid 5th); become Tiny to Large fey, gain applicable 5th level abilities.

Fey Form IIIUW: Fey form IIUW (q.v.; 6th level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) = 7th level (druid 6th); become Tiny to Large fey with applicable 7th level abilities, or become Diminutive or Huge fey with 5th level abilities.

Fey Form IVUW: Fey form IIIUW (q.v.; 7th level) + Augment Spell (+2 levels) = 9th level (druid 8th); become Tiny to Large fey with applicable 9th level abilities, or Diminutive or Huge with 7th level, or Fine with 6th level.

Fey GateUW: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (destination: close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (Faerieland; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (random location on that plane, with no control; -1 level) + Shape Spell (target to vertical wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 2.5-ft. squares; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Variable Spell (2-way gate; +1 level) = 7th level (listed as 8th); creates 2-way gate to Faeireland, but each creature entering the portal arrives at a random location on that plane.

Fey StorageAUG2: Dimensional pocket (1st level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 3 lbs./level; +1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st).

Fey WardAUG2: Hedge (fey; 2nd level) + Widen Spell (10’r. to 20’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 3rd level; fey cannot enter mobile emanation unless it fails to bypass their SR.

Field of GhoulsLM: Ray of entropy (0 level) + Cascade Spell (lesser animate dead; +3 levels) + Augment Spell (CR 2; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Knowledge (planes); +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Death or Hunger domain; −1 level) = 7th level; damage cap 15d6 negative energy/rd. in 20’r. around you, dead creatures in emanation rise as ghouls (if 2- HD) or ghasts (3+ HD), and your Command Undead capacity (if any) is enhanced while the spell lasts.

Field of LawDLM: Dispel (0 level) + Variable Spell (dispel effect or suppress ability; +1 level) + Irresitible Spell (can suppress (Sp) or (Su) ability; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell ([lawful] bloodline, domain, etc.; -1 level) = 2nd level; touch dispels one active spell effect or suppresses one (Sp) or (Su) ability for 1 rd./level.

Fiendish ClarityBVD: Eyes of the void (q.v.; 4th level) + Cascade Spell (see invisibility, q.v.; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell ([evil] caster; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 7th); you can see normally for in 60 ft. in dim light, darkness, and supernatural darkness for 10 min./level.

Fiendish QuickeningBVD: Bestow feat (Innate Metamagic: Quicken dimensional skip; 1st level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +3 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (can use 1/level, not 3/day or whatever; +3 levels) = 7th level; choose a [teleportation] spell-like ability you possess; it is Quickened for 1 rd./level. Cf. QuickshiftBED.

Fiery Constrictor, Forest’sTM2: Jet of flame (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 6th); damage cap 15d6/rd. plus grab (damage applies each round grappled).

Fiery ShurikenUC: Jet of flame (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Delay Spell (use over multiple rounds; +1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 12d6 fire, divided among multiple ranged touch attacks, not all of which need to be made at once.

Fiery VintageRRO: Jet of flame (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +4 levels) + Bane Spell (special; +0 levels) + Augment Spell (10d6 to 15d6; +1 level) = 5th level (listed as 8th); damage cap 15d6 fire, or 15d8 vs. those who ingested alcohol in the last hour (Fort half).

FilterCWH: Zephyr (0 level) + Shape Spell (line to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 2nd level; mobile 10’r. emanation of strong wind keeps out smoke, gases, fog, etc. Cf. life bubbleAPG. Variants:

  • Dance of the unicornCD is Widened to a 60’r. (+3 levels) = 5th level.

  • Lunar VeilUM: Gloom (0 level) + Cascade Spell (dispel; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to long; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (dispels only polymorph; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (4 steps to 2 steps; -2 levels) = 6th level; reduces illumination 2 steps and forces lycanthropes into true form (Will neg.).
  • Tanil’s purgingRR affects a 20’r. emanation instead of a number of creatures (-1 level) and has a damage cap of only 5d6 (-1 level) = 3rd level.
  • True FormAPG: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (polymorph or shapechanging only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) = 4th level; up to 1 creature/3 levels assumes true form, cannot re-transform for 1 rd./level.

Force WaveSC: Push (0 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Reach Spell (close to 0; -1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) = 4th level; swift action bull rushes away all within 10 ft. of you.

Force Wave, Dolomar’sRR: Push (0 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) = 2nd level; bull rushes creatures, objects up to 3 lbs./level in 20’r. away from center.

Forcecage: Mage armor (1st level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to hemisphere; +1 level) + Widen Spell (4’r./level to 1’r./level; -2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 7th level; no SR, but Reflex neg. Alternatively, substitute Inexorable Evocation for Extend Spell; there is no saving throw, but the cage lasts only 1 rd./level.

ForcewardMF: Antilife shell (6th level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Resistible Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 4th level.

ForcewardSC: Warding (force effects; 1st level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (hedge: incorporeal; +2 levels) + Resistible Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; 10’r. sphere keeps out [force] effects and incorporeal creatures.

ForcewaveMF: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (push; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 1d6; -3 levels) = 1st level; 1d6 force (Reflex half) plus bull rush vs. 1 target. Cf. force punchUM.

Forest FriendUC: Bestow feat (Favored Terrain: forests; 1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/3 levels; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (druid or ranger; -1 level) = 3rd level; one ally/3 levels gains favored terrain (forests) +2 (note that the skill bonuses are enhancement bonuses, because they are being granted by a spell).

Forest’s SenseUW: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (other senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (sound, smell, and touch; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to line of sight; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (scry on target individual specified only; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (choose target at time of casting; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (plants/fungi within 10’r. of target act as scrying sensors; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level; to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 4th level; you can scry on target (sound, smell, touch/tremorsense) through nearby plants.

ForestfoldCAd: Skill enhancement (Stealth; 0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (one type of terrain; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (choose terrain when cast; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +10; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (druid or ranger; -1 level) = 1st level; +1/2 levels (+10 max.) sacred bonus to Stealth in specific terrain.

ForetellingME: Variable Spell (blessing, deflection, or resistance; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Insightful Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level; each round, subject gains +1 insight bonus to attacks and damage, AC, or saves.

Forge of AirRRO: Jet of flame (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. cubes to 1.25-ft. cubes; -1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (metal objects only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Artifice or Fire domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); area of space deals up to 5d6 fire/rd. to metal objects, allowing them to be forged.

Form of the Dragon ICRB: Polymorph (dragon; 3rd level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Str; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Con; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (enhancement: natural armor; +1 level) = 6th level; +4 Str, +2 Con, +2 natural armor +1/3 levels (max. +8 total at CL 16th), low-light vision, darkvision 120 ft., blindsense 60 ft., 5 natural attacks (bite 1d8, 2 claws 1d6, 2 wings 1d4), breath weapon 1d6/level (max. 15d6) in Long-range line or 30-ft. cone (up to 3x), fly 120 ft., DR 5/+1, resist energy 20.

Form of the Dragon IICRB: Form of the dragon I (6th level) + Cascade Spell (enlarge self; +1 level) = 7th level; +6 Str, -2 Dex, +2 Con, +4 natural armor +1/3 levels (max. +10 total at CL 16th), low-light vision, darkvision 120 ft., blindsense 60 ft., 6 natural attacks (bite 2d6, 2 claws 1d8, 2 wings 1d6, tail slap 1d8), breath weapon 1d6/level (max. 20d6) in Extreme-range line or 60-ft. cone (usable 3x), fly 120 ft., DR 10/+1, resist energy 30, SR.

Form of the Dragon IIICRB: Form of the dragon II (7th level) + Augment Spell (Huge size; +1 level) = 8th level; +8 Str, -4 Dex, +2 Con, +6 natural armor +1/2 levels (max. +16 total at CL 20th), low-light vision, darkvision 120 ft., blindsense 60 ft., 6 natural attacks (bite 3d6, 2 claws 2d6, 2 wings 1d8, tail slap 2d6), trample, breath weapon 1d6/level (max. 20d6) in Extreme-range line or 90-ft. cone (usable 3x), frightful presence, fly 120 ft., DR 10/+2, energy immunity, SR..

FortifyTM2: Bestow feat (Maximize Spell; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Sudden Metamagic; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell ([healing] spells only; -2 levels) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 1st level (0 with access to Healing domain; listed as 4th); swift action causes [healing] spell you cast that round to be Maximized, within level limts and number allowed per the Sudden Metamagic feat.

Fortify Cold CreaturesFB: Blessing (modified; 0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 min./level; -1 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell ([cold] subtype; -2 levels) = 0 level; 1 [cold] creature/level gains +1 to atks, damage, saves vs. fire for 1 min./level.

Foster HatredOcA: Ray of beguiling (1st level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (-2 levels) + Variable Spell (select creature type at time of casting; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 6th level (listed as 5th); those in area view one creature type with disfavor (as if they had a Cha penalty of 1d6 + 1/level; modify attitude accordingly) for the next 1 hr./level.

Foundation of StoneSC: Enhancement (2nd level) + Item-Specific Spell (natural armor only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (enhancement; +3 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 to +3; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (CMD only; -2 levels) + Communal Spell (+1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); +1/4 levels (min. +1) to natural armor and +3 (+1/4 levels) to CMD. Divide total duration (1 min./level) among creatures affected.

Fourfold ForgingDD: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Versatile Evocation (bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (magical weapon; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) = 7th level (listed as 8th); melee weapon deals up to +20d6 damage of appropriate type, with +1/3 levels enhancement (as if hitting with more than one magical weapon; SR does not apply).

Freedom, EternalSRD: Warding (1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +3 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) = 9th level (listed as epic); subject immune to [beguiling], [inertia], and [restraint] conditions, Dex damage/drain, sleep effects, etc. Invest 450 x CL numen to mainatain indefinitely.

Freedom of Movement: Skill enhancement (Escape Artist; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Acrobatics; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Variable Spell (celerity when balancing, climbing, etc.; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (warding: Dex damage and other paralysis effects; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (warding: restraints; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (+60’ to +20’; -2 levels) = 4th level; +1/2 levels (+10 max.) enhancement to Escape Artist checks, warding against paralysis, [restraint] effects reduced by 1 step, and +20 ft. to movement speed while climbing, swimming, in difficult terrain, etc. (if normally reduced).

Freezing GlanceFB: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4d4; +3 levels) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (days to minutes; -2 levels) = 6th level; 1 swift action/rd. deals 5d4 Dex (Will half) while you concentrate; damage lasts 1 min. per point.

Freezing Sphere, Otiluke’s: Ray of frost (0 level) + Bane Spell (fixed: [water]; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (transmute: freezes water in area; +1 level) = 6th level; cap 15d6 cold and freezes water in 40’r.

FriendsPH1: Attribute boost (Cha; 0 level) + Augment Spell (+6 total; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; you gain +6 enhancement to Cha for 1 rd./level.

Frightful AspectUC: Polymorph (monstrous humanoid; 3rd level) + Cascade Spell (barkskin; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (enlarge self, +1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Str; +1 level) + [Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Shape Spell (emanation; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (cowering to shaken; -3 levels) = +2 levels] = 8th level; your size increases by 1 step and you become hideous, with +6 Str, -2 Dex, +3 +1/3 levels natural armor, DR 10/magic, SR 10 + Concentration bonus, and 20’r. aura of fear (Will or shaken).

Frightful Joining, Bloodstone’sDr348: PossessionOcA (3rd level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); you possess one corporeal undead, but cannot access its supernatural abilities.

Frightful Joining, Bloodstone’sTM2: PossessionOcA (3rd level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Cha; +2 levels) + Threnodic Spell (+0 levels) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +2 levels) = 7th level; you possess one corporeal undead, which also takes 4d4 Cha damage (Will half, at 0, the undead is dominated and you can also access its extraordinary and supernatural abilities).

Frigid TouchUM: Ray of frost (0 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Inexorable Evocation (+3 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); touch deals 5d6 cold and staggers 1 rd. (no save).

Frisky ChestTM2: Animate object (1st level) + Cascade Spell (mage hand; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Delay Spell (when approached; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) = 4th level; small object moves across ground at 50 ft. and/or flies at 20 ft. away from anyone approaching except you, and fights if cornered. Once activated, the object remains animated up to 1 min./level. To make the effect permanent, invest 3,000 x CL numen, as per a use-activated spell effect.

Frog, MassSRD: Baleful polymorph (frogs; 5th level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) = 9th level (listed as epic); transforms creatures in area to Tiny frogs, and they take 1d6 +1/level penalty to Int. Invest 900 x CL numen to maintain effect past 1 min./level.

Frost FallUC: Ray of frost (0 level) + Cascade Spell (inerta; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); 5d6 cold/rd. and staggered 1 rd. (save half/neg.).

FrostburnFB: Variable Spell (+1 level: ray of frost or spark of life; 1st level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Violate Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6, half frostburn (as Vile, but moderate or warm conditions instead of hallowed); [cold] creatures are healed instead.

Frostburn, MassFB: FrostburnFB (3rd level) – Reach Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 15d6; -1 level) = 6th level; damage cap 15d6, half frostburn (Fort half).

FrostfellFB: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (ray of frost; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (grease; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 20-ft. cubes; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Winter domain, etc.; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 10d6; -2 levels) = 8th level; 10d6 cold and 1d4 Dex/rd. (Fort half) and slippery conditions in one 20-ft. cube/level.

Frostfell SlideFB: As tree stride (4th level), but between areas of slush/snow/ice instead of tree types.

Frozen Moment, Storm’s7S: Celerity (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (20 ft. to 60 ft.; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (mage hand; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (flying; -2 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); creature’s flying speed reduced by 60 ft., and hovers motionless for 1 rd. if reduced to 0.

Frozen NoteAPG: Compel (do nothing; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; --1 level) + Concentration Spell (+1 level) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 5th level; creatures of 9 HD or less within 40 ft. of you do nothing for as long as you continue to concentrate.

FumblePH1: Compel (drop object; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) = 4th level; target drops object held and/or falls prone (check each round for each). AKA chaos curseDr342.

Fundamental Breakdown, Alamir’sTM2: Bestow feat (Skill Focus: Craft (alchemy); 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhahcement: Craft (alchemy); +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Spellcraft; +1 level) = 3rd level; you gain +1/2 levels to Craft (alchemy) and Spellcraft checks, and treat them as class skills.

Fungal InfestationUM: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Lingering Evocation (+1d6; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Delay Spell (when damaged; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Cha; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Pestilence domain, etc.; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 1d6; -4 levels) = 3rd level; touch deals 1d4 Cha damage immediately, thereafter, victim takes 1d6 bleed/hit (necrotic damage) for up to 4 hits/round. To make the bleed effect last longer than 1 rd./level, invest 600 x CL numen (3rd level x 50 x 4).

Fury of the AbyssAPG: Enhancement (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (melee attacks only; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 to +1/2; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (­1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Abyss domain; -1 level) = 1st level; swift casting grants you an enhancement bonus to melee attacks, damage, and CMB equal to half your caster level.

Fury of the SunARG: Touch of fatigue (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (jet of flame; +1 level) + Merciful Spell (+0 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 1d6; -3 levels) = 2nd level; maintain curse by investing 150 x CL numen. Victim is fatigued and takes 1d6 nonlethal fire damage/10 min. (Fort half).

Fury, Denev’sRR: Jet of flame (0 level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to line of sight; +3 levels) + Energy Admixture (bludgeoning; +0 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1 mi.; +6 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (druid; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 15d6; -1 level) = 9th level; 10d6 bludgeoning plus 5d6 fire and knock prone (Reflex half/neg.) in a 1-mile radius.

Fuse FleshSRD: Topple (0 level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (additional sense; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 6th level; creature touched is knocked prone and stunned, deafened, and blinded for 1 rd./level.

Gale AuraAPG: Zephyr (0 level) + Shape Spell (line to emanation; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; ­1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to [air] bloodline, domain, etc.; -1 level) = 2nd level; 20’r. emanation of strong wind around you counts as difficult terrain for 1 rd./level.

Gallant InspirationAPG: Blessing (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +5; +2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to inst.; -3 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 3rd level; subject gains +5 on a failed attack or check (immediate action casting after die rolled).

Gaseous Form: Polymorph (air elemental; 3rd level). Variants:

  • Cloud shapeARG: Gaseous form (3rd level) + Cascade Spell (glamer; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10 ft. to 30 ft.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (race, bloodine, etc. with [air] descriptor; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (no tactile or olfactory; -2 levels) = 4th level; you assume gaseous form and are magically disguised as a 30-ft. radius cloud.
  • Miasmatic FormARG: Gaseous form (3rd level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute or Fell sickening touch; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (race or bloodline with [air] descriptor; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as 4th); gaseous form also sickens (not nauseates) 1 rd./level (1 rd. on save) or deals 1d4 Con damage (Fort half) by touch.
  • Wind WalkSRD: Gaseous form (3rd level) + Cascade Spell (zephyr; +1 level) + Variable Spell (assume/resume gaseous form and wind; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (tornado to windstorm; -2 levels) = 7th level; subjects become gaseous; you can blow them along at up to 60 mph.
  • WraithformDr348: Gaseous form (3rd level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Perform; +1 level) = 4th level; for 1 min./level, subject is in gaseous form, gains +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Perform (acting) checks to impersonate a wraith (possibly causing undead to ignore).

Gate: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Variable Spell (bi-directional; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (compel: step through; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Shape Spell (target to wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 5-ft. squares; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 9th level; long ritual opens a portal to another plane that can be held open by concentrating, or by investiture of numen (as an active spell effect). You can also compel a named creature to step through (Will neg.), controlling it by means of the Thaumaturgy feat.

Gauntlet7S: Mage armor (1st level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cone; +1 level) + Widen Spell (30-ft. to 15-in.; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell [(bolt of force; +2 levels) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 1d6; -2 levels) = 1st level; gauntlet of force can be used as armored glove (base 1d6 force when striking blows) or as a small edge of force.

Gaze of DestructionAUG: Channel Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd.; +1 level) + Delay Spell (+1 level) + Pattern Spell (gaze; -1 level) + Expedient Spell (max. spell level; -1 level) = 4th level; next offensive spell of 4th level or less you cast affects a 40’r. as if a gaze attack.

Gaze of TruthRR: Detection (mind control; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (detection: illusion; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); you detect presence of illusions and/or mind control in area; learn more information by concentrating.

Gaze ReflectionPH1: Dispel (0 level) + Augment Spell (reverse effect instead of dispelling; +2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd.; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (gaze attacks only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (illusionist; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st).

Geas, Familial: Geas (q.v.; 6th level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (closest adult relative of last subject; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (+1 level) = 8th level; as geas, but if subject dies before completing quest, the geas passes to its nearest adult relative. You must invest 400 x CL numen to m

Geas, Lesser: Compel (2nd level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of enfeeblement if fails; +1 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 attribute/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Language-Specific Spell (­1 level) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (+20 to +5; -3 levels) = 4th level; creature of up to 8 HD must fulfill task or takes 1d6 +1/2 levels (+5 max.) penalty to all attributes. Invest 200 x CL numen to continue the effect past 10 min./level.

Geas/Quest: Compel (2nd level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch if fails; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Language-Specific Spell (-1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 6th level; subject must fulfill task (no initial save against this compulsion) or take up to 20d6 negative energy damage and be sickened. Invest 300 x CL numen to continue the geas past 1 rd./level.

GreenspyAUG: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (additional sense; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (plant only; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (“play back” later by ritual; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain, etc.; -1 level) = 2nd level. Hand of DivinityMF: Resistance (0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+3 bonus; +1 level) = 2nd level; grants +3 sacred bonus to saves for 1 min./level.

Hand of JusticeRR: Bestow feat (1st level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 feat/level; +3 levels) + Augment Spell (BAB +6 effects; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); you gain feats as follows (choose one):

  • Left Hand of Justice: Combat Expertise, Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Exotic Weapon Proficiency, Open-Handed Parry. 1/round, you can parry an attack as an immediate action and make an immediate counterattack (in addition to the benefits from the other feats listed).
  • Right Hand of Justice: Exotic Weapon Proficiency, Staggering Strike, Improved Critical, Knockout Blow, Versatile Strike. Each round, make only one attack, but it deals 2x damage, has doubled crit threat range, and victim must save vs. Fort save or be staggered 1 rd.

Hand of TormMF: Inertia (0 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Reach Spell (close to 0; −1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 7th level (listed as 4th); aura stuns enemies within (save each round).

HandfangRF: Invisible needle (0 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6 and 1d4 to 1d3; -1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 piercing (divine 5d6) plus 3d3 Con (Fort half), and grappled 1 rd./level (1d6/rd.).

HandfireMF: Jet of flame (0 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +2 levels) + Positive Spell (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 1st level; touch deals 1d6 fire/level (5d6 max; 1.5x vs. undead, half to others). Variants:

  • Burning BrandAUG2: Jet of flame (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Positive Spell (+0 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 1st level; damage cap 7d6 (arcane) or 2d6 (divine) fire (1.5x vs. undead, 0.5x vs. others), divided among iterative touch attacks.
  • Emerald Flame FistCA: Jet of flame (0 level) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+2 levels) + Empower Spell (+1 level) = 5th level; damage cap 15d6 fire plus (1.5 x 3d6) burn. You can make another touch attack each round as a standard action. AKA Malec-Keth’s flame fistTM2.
  • Scalding TouchME: Jet of flame (0 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Augment Spell (15d6 to 20d6; +1 level) = 5th level (listed as 7th); damage cap 25d6 fire (divided among iterative touch attacks), plus dazed 1 rd.; continue to attack each round you concentrate.
  • Touch of CombustionARG: Jet of flame (0 level) + Splash Evocation (+0 levels) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 0 level; touch deals 1d6 fire plus 1d6/rd., and 1 hp to adjacent.

Handy GrapnelUI: Mage hand (0 level) + Shape Spell (target to line; +1 level) + Manifested Spell (ranged attack roll needed to establish line; -1 level) + Exctend Spell (conc. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 8 lbs./level; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (along fixed line only; -2 levels) = 1st level; can pull creatures (or objects up to weight limit) 20 ft./rd. along Close range line iof effect.

Hangman’s GroveRRE: Hangman’s tree (q.v.; 1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Selective Spell (next 1 creature/level to die within range; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = as hangman’s tree, but affects next 1 intelligent creature/level that dies within range.

Hangman’s TreeRRE: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (target: touch to close; +1 level) + Delay Spell (until dies; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (destination: pre-designated tree or structure; -2 levels) = 1st level; when target dies, is teleported into nearby awaiting noose, gibbet, etc.

Harassing WeaponAUG2: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (provokes AoO only; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); for 1 rd./level, target takes ranged touch attack dealing up to 5d6 force damage whenever it provokes an attack of opportunity.

HardeningSRD: Enhancement (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (item hardness; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Augment Spell (+1/4 to +1/2; +2 levels) = 5th level; +1/2 levels to item’s hardness (invest numen to maintain effect). Variants:

  • HardenAUG: Enhancement (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (item hardness; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); +1/4 levels to item’s hardness.
  • EarthfastMF: Transmute (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (adamantine; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (rock formation or stone structure only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 27 cu. ft./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Earth domain; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level; stone is as hard as adamantine (+10 to harness and hp).
  • Matter ManipulationSRD: Enhancement (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (item hardness; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Variable Spell (increase or decrease; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (hardness and hp; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Reduce Spell (-1 level) = 8th level; +/- up to 1/3 levels to item’s hardness and hp (no save, invest numen to maintain effect).
  • ReinforcementRRE: Transmute (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) = 2nd level; object up to 1 cu. ft./level temporarily gains hardness, hp of steel.
  • Unbreakable ConstructUM: Transmute (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (adamantine; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 216 cu. ft./level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (construct; -2 levels) = 4th level; construct of up to Gargantuan size gains DR 20/adamantine for 1 rd./level (a 5th level version is needed for Colossal constructs).

Harmonic VoidCSc: Sound lance (1st level) + Cascade Spell (dispel; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd.; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 10d6; -2 levels) = 6th level (bard 5th); 10d6 sonic/rd. and opposed Concentration checks required to cast spells in 60’r. of you, while you concentrate.

HarmonyPGF: Enhancement (2nd level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (inspire courage; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) + Extend Spell 1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (+1/4 to +1; -1 level) = 1st level; your inspire courage is at an additional +1 (for up to 1 subject/level) for 1 rd./level.

Haste: Celerity (0 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Dex; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3 total bonus; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (attack bonus only; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Manyshot; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = 3rd level; subject gains +30 ft. speed, +2 enhancement to Dex, and an additional attack; all attacks that round gain an overall +1 attack bonus (+3, -2 for Manyshot). To affect 1 creature/level, also apply the Mass Effect Spell feat (+3 levels) = 6th level.

  • Flashing SunToB: Bestow feat (Manyshot; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 2nd level; swift action grants you an additional attack at -2.
  • HustleSRD: Celerity (0 level) + Augment Spell (+10 ft. to +30 ft.; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Variable Spell (other movement; +1 level) = 2nd level; swift casting grants you an extra move action. AKA quicksilver motionToB.
  • Lesser CelerityPHII: Haste (q.v.; 3rd level) – Cascade Spell (blessing; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level; immediate casting grants you one partial action (+20 ft. to speed if used for movement). Cf. opportune dodgeCSc.
  • Snake’s SwiftnessMH: Bestow feat (Manyshot; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) = 2nd level; subject immediately gains 1 attack at -2.
  • Swift hasteCAd: Haste (3rd level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 2nd level; swift casting hastes you 1 rd.
  • Swift hasteSC: Haste (3rd level) + Personal Spell (−1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); swift casting hastes you 1 rd./level (rather than “1d4 rounds”).

Haunting ChoirUM: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard action; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 3rd level.

Haunting MistsUM: Wisp (0 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Wis; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (frightened to shaken; -1 level) = 3rd level; mists deal 1d4 Wis damage (once) and creatures are shaken while they remain within.

Haunting TuneMF: Spook (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (frightened to shaken; -2 levels) = 3rd level; 1 creature/level is shaken for 10 min./level.

HawkeyeCAd: Bestow feat (Far Shot; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Perception; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +11 effects; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (increment increase only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger; -2 levels) = 1st level; you gain +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Perception for 10 min./level, and your range increments increase by 50%.

  • Tenser’s Eye of the EagleGA: Skill enhancement (Perception; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Far Shot; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level; subject gains Far Shot feat and +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Perception.

Healer’s BlessingCRB: Bestow feat (Empower Spell; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Sudden Metmagic; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (healing only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Healing domain; -1 level) = 0 level; swift casting allows you to cast an Empowered cure spell within the next round.

Healer’s VisionCSc: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+2 bonus; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Heal; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 1st level; subject gains +2 to attacks, damage, saves vs. fear and +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Heal checks for 1 rd./level.

Healing Circle, GreaterRR: Spark of life (1st level) + Augment Spell (+1 hp/level; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) = 6th level (listed as 7th); heals 1d6 +1/level (15d6+15 max.) in 40-ft. burst.

Healing SpiritPHII: Spark of life (1st level) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 4th level; shed light and bestow 5d6 positive energy as a ranged touch 1/rd.

Healing TouchBED: Spark of life (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (arcane; +1 level) + Variable Spell (decide total dice at time of casting; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy: self; -1 level) = 2nd level; touch heals up to 1d6/level (max. 10d6), and you take like amount of negative energy damage. Variants:

  • Blood of the martyrBED works at Medium range (+1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); damage cap 10d6.
  • Brothers in ArmsRR: Spark of life (1st level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2 to +4; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of enfeeblement; -1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/3 levels; +2 levels) + Variable Spell (+1 level + Selective Spell (shuffle effects among subjects as agreed); +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level; each round, subjects can “donate” up to 15d6 hp each (by taking like negative energy damage) and Strength bonuses (up to +4, by taking penalty of 1d6 + ½ level) among one another.
  • Empathic transferSRD is also Cross-Class Spell (psion; +1 level) and Variable (transfer disease or poison instead; +1 level) = 2nd level; subject healed 1d6 level (max. 5d6); you are damaged the same amount, or transfer 1 disease or poison to yourself instead.
  • Life force transferRR is Maximized (+2 levels) = 4th level; max. 60 hp.
  • Pact of martyrdomPGF adds Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (10d6 to 20d6; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); damage cap 20d6, at Medium range.
  • Sacrificial BondAPG: Spark of life (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; -1 level) + Inexorable Evocation (you gain no resistance or immunity to the damage inflicted; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Community, Nobility, or Protection domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; as an immediate action, damage against close ally is reduced by 5d6, and you take a like amount.
  • Shield otherSRD: Resistance (0 level) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; -1 level) + Overwhelming Evocation (energy resistance does not apply to the damage you take; -1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Personal Spell (you are always the damage recipient; −1 level) + Reduce Spell (+15 to +5; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); subject gains +2 deflection to AC and +1 to saves, and each time hit, 1d6 +1 hp/level (+5 max.) of the damage is transferred to you instead. AKA share painSRD. Glory of the martyrMF protects up to 1 subject/level (+3 levels) and is Restricted (paladin; -2 levels) = 4th level.

Healing WordPH5: Spark of life (1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 1d6; -2 levels) = 1st level; partial action casting heals 1d6 hp at medium range.

Healing Word, MassPH5: Healing wordPH5 (q.v.; 1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) = 3rd level; partial action heals 5d6 hp each to one ally/3 levels.

Heart of AirCM: Celerity (fly; 0 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (­1 level) + Cascade Spell (catfallSRD; +1 level) + Restricted Spell ([air] domain, etc.; -1 level) = 2nd level; you gain +20 ft. to fly speed and falls are slowed if plummet, but no fortification.

Heart of FireCM: Celerity (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resist fire; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Cacade Spell [jet of flame (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Fire domain, etc.; -1 level) = 5th level; you gain +50 ft. to land speed and resistance to fire 3/level for 1 hr./level, and can injure attackers with fire (1d6+15/hit) for 1 rd. as an immediate action once.

Heart of the MammothPC: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Con; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2 to +8; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell:

  • Warding (fear; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = +2 levels.
  • Bestow feat (Improved Critical; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +11 effects; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (vs. dragons only; -2 levels) = +1 level.

= 6th level; subject gains +8 enhancement to Str and Con, immunity to fear, and doubled critical threat range and auto-confirmed threats against dragons.

Heart of ValorRR: Warding (fear; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Personal Spell (−1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 3rd level; allies immune to fear and gain +1 to attacks and damage; enemies save or frightened.

HeartacheBVD: Inertia (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) = 4th level (listed as 1st); target is stunned (not incapacitated) for 1 rd.

HeartclutchBVD: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Empower Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 5th level; damage 15d6/rd. necrotic (Fort half). Variant:

  • Stricken HeartACG: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cascade Spell [(inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; ­1 level)] = 2nd level; damage cap 10d6 necrotic (5d6 for divine) plus staggered 1 rd./level (Fort half/neg., and save each round to end effect).

HeartglowAUG2: Spook (0 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (frightened to shaken; -1 level) = 2nd level; you shed light in 10’r. for 1 min./level, and enemies in aura are shaken. Cf. ghost lightCA.

Heart’s EaseBED: Remove condition (fear; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (also confusion; +1 level) = 3rd level; ameliorates fear by 2 steps, makes confused subject merely dazzled, and/or cures up to 3d4 Wis damage at close range.

Heat ShimmerUM: Glamer (1st level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Desert domain; -1 level) = 1st level; swift blur and those hitting you that round must save or be dazzled.

Heaven’s TrumpetBED: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) = 7th level (bard 6th); enemies in 120’r. of you take 3d4 Dex (Fort half; save each round to halve remaining), paralyzed at 0.

Hedging WeaponsHA: Deflection (0 level) + Augment Spell (scaling bonus; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (bolt of force; +2 levels) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Delay Spell (use rays as see fit during deflection duration; +1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Tenuous Spell (each ray reduces deflection by 1; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 7d6 force (divided among attacks). You gain +2 deflection to AC, +1/6 levels, for 1 min./level, and can make ranged attacks (max. 5d6 for one attack) that reduce your deflection by -1 each.

Heightened AwarenessACG: Skill enhancement (Perception; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Knowledge; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; you gain +1/2 levels (+5 max.) enhancement to Perception and trained Knowledge checks.

Heir of HellBotD: Spook (0 level) + Fell Frightening (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (Damnation domain, archdevil cultist, etc.; -1 level) = 5th level; enemies in 20’r. stunned 1 rd. and panicked 1 rd./level (Will shaken).

HellballSRD: Jet of flame (0 level) + Energy Admixture (acid, electricity, and sonic; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+2 levels) + Empower Spell (+1 level) = 8th level (listed as epic); damage cap 1.5 x 20d6 (1.5 x 5d6 each acid, electricity, fire, and sonic) plus 3d6 burn and 2d6 acid/rd. thereafter.

HellfireBVD: Jet of flame (0 level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Overwhelming Evocation (fire; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Inexorable Evocation (+3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to [lawful evil] bloodline, domain, etc.; -1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 (half fire and half unholy, no save, and fire resistance does not apply).

Hellfire RayBotD: Jet of flame (0 level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Empower Spell (+1 level) + Reaping Spell (+2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 6th); damage cap 1.5 x 20d6 (half fire, half unholy), divided among rays, and victims killed warded against resurrection. You must invest 150 x CL numen to maintain anti-resurrection effect (typically the caster has the Soulcrafting feat and uses the victim’s own numen).

Hellfire StormBVD: Jet of flame (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Overwhelming Evocation (+1 level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Inexorable Evocation (+3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to [lawful evil] bloodline, domain, etc.; -1 level) = 7th level; damage cap 15d6 (half fire, half unholy, no save, and fire resistance does not apply).

Hellish RebukePH5: Jet of flame (0 level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (attacking you; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell ([lawful evil] bloodline, domain, etc.; ­1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 1st level; immediate casting deals up to 5d6 damage (half fire, half unholy; Reflex half) to attacker within close range.

Hellmouth LashARG: Acid splash (0 level) + Variable Spell (Versatile Evocation: electricity or fire; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 13d6/round, divided among iterative ranged touch attacks.

Hell’s CorruptionAPG: Resistance (0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement; +1 level) + Variable Spell (different skills; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3; +1 level)

+ Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Restricted Spell ([lawful evil] bloodline, domain, deity, etc.; -1 level) = 2nd level; touch inflicts -3 penalty to saves and skill checks for 1 min./level.

Hell’s GripPC: Mage hand (0 level) + Extend Spell (conc. to 1 rd.; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) + Delay Spell (proximity; +1 level) + Tenacious Spell (+1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (devil cultist; -1 level) = 1st level; 1d6 bludgeoning plus lifted 20 ft. into the air for 1 rd. when triggered (by non-devil worshipper); re-invest numen (50 x CL) to reset.

Hell’s HammerDLM: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+4 total bonus; +3 levels) + Item-Specific Spell (bludgeoning weapon; -2 levels) = 1st level; bludgeoning weapon touched gains +4 profane bonus to attacks and damage for 10 min./level. Variants:

  • Hell’s razorDLM (slashing weapons), hells sharp flameDLM (piercing weapons), hell’s talonDLM (natural attack).
  • GodhammerCBEM: is Extended (1 min./level; -1 level), Item-Specific (deity’s favored weapon; -2 levels), Cascaded (non-variable align weapon; +1 level), Personal (-1 level), and Sudden (+0 levels) = 0 level; swift casting grants you +4 sacred/profane bonus to attacks and damage with deity’s favored weapon, and it penetrates alignment-based DR.

Hell’s PowerBVD: Enhancement (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell ([lawful evil]; -1 level) = 2nd level; you gain +2 deflection to AC, and your DR (if any) increases by +1 hp/4 levels.

Helpful Hand, Bigby’sPHII: Mage hand (0 level) – Concentration Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Craft; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Disable Device; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (mage hand can only hold objects; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; floating hand holds items up to 1 lb./level and provides +1/2 levels (+5 max.) bonus to skills.

Heroes’ Feast: Create food & drink (1st level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (warding: afflictions; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (those partaking in 1-hour feast; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 7th level; 1 creature/level healed 15d6 hp, immune to afflictions, and +1 to attacks, damage, and saves vs. fear for 1 hr./level.

Hero’s DeathDD: Inure (0 level) + Energy Admixture (bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+10 total bonus; +8 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd.; -3 levels) + Cascade Spell [(spell resistance; +5 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels)] + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (willing recipient; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell [(damage attribute: Con; -1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; -2 levels) + Crippling Drain (-2 levels) + Delay Spell (duration ends; +1 level)] + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 8th level (listed as 7th); subject +10 to attacks and damage, gains DR 15/adamantine, fast healing 20, and SR 10 + your Concentration bonus for 1 hr./level; at the end of that time, takes 3d4 Con drain.

+ Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 7th level.
