Illusion of TreacheryUI: Glamer (1st level) + Variable Spell (appears to attack, cast spells, etc. as appropriate; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) = 4th level; for 1 rd./level, attacks and hostile spells from you also appear to be coming from affected subject (Intuition disbelief), if within 60 ft. of you.

Illusion of Treachery, GreaterUI: Illusion of treachery (q.v.; 4th level) + Cascade Spell (glamer; +1 level) + Augments Spell (invisibility; +1 level) = 6th level; as above, and you appear not to be attacking (your projectiles/spell effects invisible within 60 ft.),

Illusion PurgeRE: Warding (illusions; 1st level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (emanation centered on you; -1 level) = 6th level (listed as 8th); suppresses illusions in wide area around you.

Illusory ArtilleryTM2: Figment (0 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 30-ft. cubes; +2 levels) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to War domain; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (no tactile, and panicked to frightened; ­1 level) = 4th level (listed as 5th); illusory long-range artillery fire into one 30-ft. cube/level causes fear.

Illusory FortificationTM2: Figment (0 level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10 ft. to 30 ft.; +2 levels) + Shadow Spell (+1 level) + Selective Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to War domain; -1 level) = 7th level; creates quasi-real (40%) fortifications and illusory patrolling sentries in one 30-ft. cube/level, ignored by those you designate.

Illusory HoardPC: Glamer (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (emanation to cubes; +0 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (maintain previous appearance; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (tactile; +1 level) = 4th level; treasure hoard in up to one 10-ft. cube/level appears to be intact and undisturbed (Intuition disbelief if try to use a particular missing item, etc.).

Illusory PitCA: Compel (fall prone and do nothing; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 6th level.

Illusory Script: Glamer (1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (gibberish writing over actual script; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (suggestion; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (those reading text; -2 levels) + Selective Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level; invest 225 x CL numen (3rd level x 50 x 1.5) to maintain effect.

Image, AdvancedUA1: Figment (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Variable Spell (scripted; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 5th); as programmed image, but without activating trigger (begins immediately after casting).

Image, Lasting MinorAUG2: Figment (0 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Widen Spell (1,000 ft3/level to 2 ft3/level; -3 levels) = 1st level; creates small, long-lasting visual illusion; invest 1,000 numen to make permanent.

ImageryRRO: Figment (0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Perception; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard or access to Music domain, etc.; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (no thermal or tactile; -1 level) = 3rd level; audio-visual-olfactory illusion in 60’r. also causes -1/2 levels to Perception.

Imago InterrogationTM2: Augury (2nd level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) = 9th level; you gain answers to 1 question/level regarding each of up to 1 topic/3 levels, and answers can take as long as 1 rd./level to relay.

Imbue AddictionPC: Compel (take drug; 2nd level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 3rd level; victim compelled to take specified drug whenever possible. (Invest 150 x CL numen to maintain effect until victim gets through rehab.)

Imbue ShadowRR: Summon (1st level) + Summon Undead (+1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 4 shadow; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (shadow attacks only creature whose shadow it mimics; -2 levels) = 4th level.

Imbue with Spell Ability: Bestow feat (Magical Talent; 1st level) + Variable Spell (choose spell(s) at time of casting; +1 level) + Amplify Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (spells that you have prepared; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; creature touched gains 1 spell level/2 caster levels you possess as spell-like abilities. It must have at least that many HD, and the spells chosen must be among the ones you have prepared, although you do not lose the prepared spells. They are cast at your CL. Variants:

  • Ability RipSK: Bestow feat (Magical Talent; 1st level) + Casdcade Spell (dispel; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (can also affect a supernatural ability; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (you choose which; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (talent is the same as ability lost; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level (listed as 7th); one creature loses a daily use of a spell-like or supernatural ability you choose, and another recipient gains it as a magical talent for up to 1 hr./level.
  • Blood TranscriptionUC: Bestow feat (Magical Talent; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Spellcraft; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (spell gained must be among those known to dead caster touched; -2 levels) = 2nd level; you temporarily gain the ability to cast one spell known by a deceased caster whose blood you sample, and gain +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to analyze it for entry into your spellbooks, etc. (normal numen cost applies).
  • Legacy of Eldritch MightAUG2: Bestow feat (1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (Magical Talent and Magical Array; +1 level) + Augment Spell (16 ranks effects; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 9th level; target gains suite of spell-like abilities (max. capacity 16th at 16 HD). Invest 450 x CL numen to maintain effect.
  • MetaconcertSRD: Enhancement (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (dispel; +1 level) + Augment Spell (re-assign spell slots; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (enhance DCs and saves; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Magical Talent; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Magical Array; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 contributor/3 levels; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (multiple spell slots each; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (magical array must be powers known by donor; -2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (willing condributors only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 7th level (listed as 5th); up to 1 willing participant/3 levels can contribute knowledge of a magical array of known spells/powers, and the spell slots to cast/manifest them. In addition, recipient’s spell save DCs are enhanced by +1/3 levels, and recipient gains like resistance bonus to saves, lasting 1 min./level.
  • Plundered PowerHA: Bestow feat (Magical Talent; 1st level) + Variable Spell (usuable by possessor of bloodstone focus; +1 level) + Augment Spell (up to CL 20th effect; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (SLA possessed by sacrificial victim; -2 levels) = 7th level; traps one SLA of sacrificed creature in command-activated bloodstone.

Immediate AssistanceCM: Hand of fate (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (skill check only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard or access to Fate domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; immediate casting allows target to reroll one skill check (before results determined).

ImmovabilitySRD: Warding (movement; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (inure: slashing; +1 level) + Energy Admixture (budgeoning and piercing; +0 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 4th level; while you concentrate, you gain DR 10/− and cannot be moved from your location.

ImmunityAUG: Warding (1st level) + Variable Spell (select seed at time of casting; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) = 5th level (listed as 7th); target is warded against one of the following: acid, cold, compulsions, disease, electricity, figments, fire, glamers, negative energy, poison, positive energy, sonics, etc. for 10 min./level. Variants:

  • Greater ImmunityAUG: ImmunityAUG (q.v.; 5th level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 hr./level; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/3 levels; +2 levels) = 8th level (listed as 9th).
  • Heart of StoneS&M: Inure (bludgeoning; 0 level) + Energy Admixture (piercing and slashing; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (warding; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 6th level (listed as 8th); you gain DR 30/— (35/— at CL 14th, 40/— at 16th) and immunity to bleed, attribute damage/drain/penalties, [death] effects, fatigue, [inertia] effects, plus one additional condition or attack form/CL above 11th. To extend beyond 1 hr./level, expend 6,000 x CL numen or select the Permanent Spell feat (14+ ranks Concentration needed)
  • Safe TimeSRD: Timeless body (see below; 9th level) – Personal Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (hold monster; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (until would be hit for 50+ damage; +1 level) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 9th level (listed as epic); the next time subject would be hit for 50+ damage, he/she becomes invulnerable for 1 rd. instead, but cannot act that round.
  • Timeless BodySRD: Warding (1st level) + Irresistible Spell (+3 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) = 9th level; for 1 round, you are immune to attribute damage/drain, acid, cold, bludgeoning, electricity, force, negative energy, nonlethal damage, piercing, slashing, afflictions, fear, energy drain, inertia, polymorph, restraint, sensory, teleportation, and 17+ more attack forms (in essence, you are invulnerable).
  • Transcend MortalityCM: Spell resistance (5th level) + Cascade Spell [(warding; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 effect/level; +3 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels)] + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (disintegrate; -6 levels) + Delay Spell (time lapse; +1 level) = 8th level; as an immediate action, you gain SR 11 + Concentration bonus, immunity to magical and nonmagical damage (acid, bludgeoning, cold, electricity, fire, force, negative energy, nonlethal, piercing, slashing, sonic), plus afflictions, compulsions, [death] effects, starvation, thirst, and breath-dependent effects. After 1 rd./level, the immunities end and you take 1.5d6+6 disintegration damage/level.

Impending PermissionTM2: Compel (do not perform any action unless given permission by designated person; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 10 min./level; +3 levels) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Law domain; -1 level) = 4th level; victim must ask and receive permission from person you designate before completing any action.

Imperative Ambulation, Otto’sCM: Compel (move at least 10 ft.; 2nd level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; target must move at least 10 ft. at the start of each turn, until save made (if cannot move, loses move action instead).

Implosion: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +2 levels) + Crippling Drain (+3 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 8th level; deals 4d4 Con drain/rd. (Fort half) while you concentrate.

Imprison PossessorBVD: Hedge (possessing entity; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (emanation to target; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (0 to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 5th level; possessing entity is trapped in body it currently inhabits. Invest 250 x CL numen to maintain effect indefinitely.

ImprovisationCAd: Variable Spell (blessing, skill enhancement, or attribute boost; 2nd level) + Lucky Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Variable Spell (allocate pool; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard or access to Fate domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; each round, apply +1/2 level (max. +10) as a luck bonus to 1 attack roll, skill check, or attribute check.

IncapacitateRR: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cascade Spell [(ray of enfeeblement; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 attribute/level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels)] + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 8th level (listed as 9th); damage cap 20d6 necrotic and 1d6 + 1/level (+20 max.) penalty to all attributes; invest 600 x CL numen to maintain penalties past 1 rd./level (8th level x 50 x 1.5).

Incendiary Cloud: Wisp (0 level) + Cascade Spell (jet of flame; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd.; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (+90 ft. to +30 ft. and 25d6 to 10d6; -3 levels) = 6th level; fast (60 ft.), mobile 20’r. fog deals 10d6 fire/rd. in area and obscures vision. Variants:

  • FlashfireUW: Wisp (0 level) + Cascade Spell (jet of flame; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium;+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 5-ft. cubes; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (extinguished by heavy precipitation or storm wind; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 3rd level; 5d6 fire plus obscured vision in one 5-ft. cube/level (reconfigure with concentration, and lasts 1 rd./level thereafter).
  • Gas CloudRR: Jet of flame (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (until flame brought into area; +1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); explodes for 1d6/level fire (max. 10d6, Reflex half) in 20’r.
  • Otiluke’s Steaming SphereGA: Jet of flame (0 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (nausea 1 rd./level to 1 round; -1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (wisp; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 5d6; -3 levels) = 4th level; 5d6 fire plus 2d6/round and nausea 1 round, and obstructs vision in area.

Incendiary SlimeCM: Grease (1st level) + Cascade Spell (jet of flame; +1 level) + Delay Spell (ignited; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (ignition ends grease effect; -1 level) = 2nd level; as grease, but highly flammable (damage cap 5d6), as in 1st ed. AD&D.

InciteMH: Compel (act; 2nd level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (holding actions only; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); subject cannot hold actions/delay/ready actions for 1 min./level.

Incite, GreaterSC: InciteMH (3rd level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as 1st).

InciteRR: Compel (2nd level) + Variable Spell (name task while casting; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Personal Spell (you must personally lead task; -1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (­2 levels) = 7th level; compels small mob to follow you in completing stated task.

Incorporeal ChainsOcA: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Transdimensional Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (incorporeal only; -2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 10d6; -2 levels) = 5th level; 1 incorporeal creature/level takes 10d6 force/rd. and is grappled while you concentrate (Reflex half/neg.).

Incorporeal NovaLM: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Transdimensional Spell (-1 level) + Empower Spell (+1 level) = 6th level; 1.5d6/level (max. 22.5d6, Reflex half) force damage to incorporeal and gaseous creatures only.

Increase WeightAUG: Enlarge (3rd level) + Selective Spell (weight only, not size or Stength; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 1st); increases target’s weight by a factor of 8, possibly overloading its own carrying capacity (a 150-lb. character would need a 17 Strength to be able to drag his/her own weight; a 200-lb. character would need a 19 Str).

Induce AweME: Skill enhancement (Diplomacy; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Bluff; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Tenuous Spell (activating fear aura ends skill bonuses; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (frightened to shaken; -1 level) = 2nd level; you gain +1/2 levels to Bluff and Diplomacy; can end bonuses to cause enemies in 20’r. to become shaken.

InebriateOJ13: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (ailing; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 nonlethal plus ailing 1 min./level (Fort half/neg.).

Inertial ArmorSRD: Mage armor (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (ki or psychokinesis; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; as mage armor, but personal only and usable with Canny Defense.

Inescapable SwarmDr333: Sickening touch (0 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (panicked to shaken; -2 levels) = 4th level; Intuition or 3d6 nonlethal plus nauseated and shaken 1 rd./level.

Inevitable DefeatPHII: Whelm (0 level) + Lingering Evocation (+2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 1st level spell dealing 1d6 nonlethal/level (max 5d6) plus 2d6/round for up to 1 rd./level.

Infestation of MaggotsMF: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +3 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; touch deals 1d4 Con (Fort half) +1d4 Con/rd. until save.

Inflict Light Damage, MassRE: Sound lance (1st level) + Irresistible Spell (+3 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (constructs; -2 levels) = 5th level; damage cap 20d6 (Will half, no SR) sonic vs. one construct/level.

Infra-InvisibleDHD: Glamer (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (vs. darkvision only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 2nd level; subject is invisible to darkvision for 1 hr./level or until attacks.

InhibitMH: Metaphysical feat (Delay Spell; 1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (enchantment; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); subject’s actions are delayed by 1 rd. (Will neg.).

Inner BeautyFC1: Variable Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level):

  • Evil Target: Ray of clumsiness (1st level) + Cascade Spell (ray of beguiling; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell ([evil]; -2 levels) + [Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level)] = 6th level; 1d6 +1/level (+20 max.) penalty to Dex and Cha for 10 min./level, and those in 20’r. at time of casting nauseated 1 rd./level or until save.
  • Good Target: Attribute boost (Dex; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Cha; +1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell ([good]; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell [(sickening touch; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level)] = 6th level; +4 sacred bonus to Dex and Cha for 10 min./level, and those in 20’r. at time of casting sickened 1 rd./level or until save.

InnocenceAPG: Skill enhancement (Bluff; 0 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (convince others you’re innocent; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+3 levels) = 0 level (listed as 1st); you gain +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Bluff to convince others of your innocence.

InquisitionRR: Compel (answer truthfully; 2nd level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 question/3 levels within duration; +2 levels) = 4th level. InquisitionBED (5th level) has a standard casting time.

Insatiable ThirstTM2: Compel (drink; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 2nd); victim must drink all potable liquids it can find.

InscribeRRE: Shaping (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (letters or script only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Craft; +2 levels) = 1st level; inscribes text on affected surface (assume letters 1” deep, so one 3 ft. x 3-ft. square per level can be inscribed).

Insidious RhythmCAd: Ray of idiocy (1st level) + Cascade Spell (dispel; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (+15 to +5; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); subject takes 1d6+5 penalty to Int and must concentrate to cast/maintain spells for 1 min./level.

Insightful FeintCAd: Skill enhancement (Bluff; 0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Insightful Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (feint only; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 to +10; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 1st level; +1/2 levels (+10 max.) insight bonus to feint for 1 round.

Insightful FeintSC: Bestow feat (Improved Feint; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Bluff; +1 level) + Insightful Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (feint only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 1st level; +1/2 levels (+5 max.) insight bonus to feint for 1 round, and can feint as a move action.

Insistent BeatRRO: Ray of idiocy (1st level) + Cascade Spell (ray of obliviousness; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard or access to Music domain, etc.; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (+20 to +10; -2 levels) = 5th level; 1d6+10 penalty to Int and Wis in 60’r. around you while you concentrate.

Inpsire ToughnessCW: Spark of life (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (bard; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Diehard; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = 4th level; ally gains 10d6 temp. hp and the Diehard feat.

Instant ArmorAPG: Mage armor (1st level) + Augment Spell (+9 total bonus; +3 levels) + Cross-Class Spell (cleric or paladin; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) = 2nd level; short-duration divine mage armor grants you +9 armor bonus.

Instant Exit, Drawmij’sGA: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/3 levels; +2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Mishap Possibility (ad hoc -1 level) + Variable Spell (random destination within range; -1 level) = 4th level. Instant FakeUI: Figment (0 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Augment Spell (visual, auditory, olfactory, tactile; +2 levels) = 3rd level; a Sleight of Hand pilfering of an object leaves behind an illusion (even feels real if not disbelieved) that the object is still present (i.e., hasn’t been stolen).

Instant LocksmithCAd: Metaphysical feat (1st level) + Augment Spell (+4 level cost; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (Disable Device check; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (rogue skill trick; -1 level) = 1st level; swift casting allows you to make one Disable Device check as a swift action.

Instant RefugeSC: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +7 levels) + Personal Spell (­1 level) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Variable Spell (name up to 6 conditions; +1 level) = 9th level; when one of six conditions occurs, you are instantly transported anywhere within the multiverse you specify.

Instant Summons, Drawmij’s: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (pre-selected item; -2 levels) = 6th level; teleports item to your hand (no sapphire component is needed).

  • Indisputable possessionME is similar, but smaller-scale: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (pre-selected item; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (partial action; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 1st level; partial action teleports item to your hand from within medium range.

InstillCW: Resistance (0 level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+9 resistance; +4 levels) + Augment Spell (+5 blessing; +3 levels) + Insightful Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (all of the above; -9 levels) + Variable Spell (full bonuses/penalties need not be applied; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (monk or kensai; -1 level) = 1st level; you take take a penalty of up to -10 to saves and -5 to attacks and damage; creature touched gains equivalent insight bonuses (if your penalty is removed, so is their bonus).

Instrument of AgonyUC: Sickening touch (0 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Fell Sickening (+1 level) + Delay Spell (one attack within the next 1 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Tenuous Spell (save each round to end nausea/sickness; -1 level) = 3rd level; one selected hit causes nausea 1 rd./level (Fort sickened).

Intellect FortressSRD: Warding (force; 1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 additional damage type/3 levels; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Expedient Spell (halves damage only; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Psychokinesis discipline; -1 level) = 4th level; immediate casting halves all damage from spells in personal-range 20’r. emanation for 1 rd.

Interminable EchoCM: Skill enhancement (Perception; 0 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (sound lance; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 sonic plus 2d6/rd. and -1/2 levels (-10 max.) penalty to Perception (Will half/neg.).

Internal FireCA: Jet of flame (0 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (+4d4; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) = 8th level; damage cap 20d6 fire plus 5d4 Con (Fort half) to up to 2d4 + 1/level (+20 max.) HD worth of creatures.

Interposing Hand, Bigby’s: Shield (q.v.; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Shape Spell (emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Residual Spell (+1 level) = 5th level; you gain cover (+4 AC) and those approaching you within 60 ft. treat that area as difficult terrain. InterrogationUM: Skill enhancement (Bluff; 0 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) + Delay Spell (until refuses to answer; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; −1 level) = 1st level; creature touched is -1/2 levels (-5 max.) to Bluff checks and takes 1d6 nonlethal/level (max. 5d6) if refuses to answer a question in the next 1 min./level.

(half cold, half negative energy) plus exhausted (Fort half/neg.).

Investiture of the Barbed DevilFC2: Bestow feat (Improved Grapple; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (inure: fire; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (also Vital Strike; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +11 effects; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 6th); subject gains Improved Grapple, constrict (base 4d6), and resistance to fire 5/2 levels (40 max.) for 1 min./level.

Investiture of the ErinyesFC2: Compel (approach; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (inure: fire; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain; -1 level) = 4th level; subject gains resistance to fire 5/2 levels (30 max.) and as a partial action each round can force a creature within Close range to approach and then stand still.

Investiture of the Hellfire EngineFC2: Iron body (8th level) – Personal Spell (+1 level) – Augment Spell (-4 levels) + Cascade Spell (inure: fire; +1 level) + Cascade Spell [(jet of flame; +1 level) + Overwhelming Evocation (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level)] + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain; -1 level) = 8th level (listed as 9th); subject gains iron body, resistance to fire 5/2 levels (50 max.), and as a standard action can breath a 30-ft. cone of fire (damage cap 15d6, Reflex half, energy resistance does not apply).

Investiture of the Horned DevilFC2: Bestow feat Staggering Strike; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (inure: fire; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +16 effects; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 8th); subject gains resistance to fire 5/2 levels (40 max.) and Staggering Strike (staggered 1 rd. plus Fort or stunned 1 rd. and staggered 1d4+1).

Investiture of the Ice DevilFC2: Inure (fire; 0 level) + Energy Admixture (cold; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell [(slow: q.v.; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (ray of frost: +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (onset: inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels)] + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain; -1 level) = 7th level; subject gains restance to fire and cold 20, and melee attacks deal up to +27d6 cold plus slowed 1 rd./level (divide damage and duration among attacks each round).

Investiture of the MalebrancheFC2: Bestow feat (Vital Strike; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (inure: fire; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +16 effects; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 6th); subject gains resistance to fire 5/2 levels (40 max.) and Vital Strike +6d6.

Investiture of the OrthonFC2: Inure (fire; 0 level) + Energy Admixture (acid; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell [(sound lance; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels)] + Cascade Spell [(warding: teleportation; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level)] + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (40 to 30 and +15 to +10; -1 level) = 5th level; subject gains resistance to acid and fire 15, radiates 20-ft. aura preventing teleportation, and melee attackers take 1d6 +10 sonic per hit.

  • Spook (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) = +1 level; 10-ft. aura panics 1 rd./level.

+ Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as 9th); subject becomes pit fiend: +2 Str, +2 AC, darkvision 60 ft., fly 120 ft., DR 10/good, regeneration 5, natural attacks (bite, 2 claws, 2 wings, 1 tail), resist fire 20; plus aura as above (choose effect each round).

Investiture of the Spined DevilFC2: Invisible needle (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Delay Spell (need not use spines each round; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (inure: fire; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; subject gains resistance to fire 5/2 levels (max. 30) and can fire 3 spines as a standard action (base damage cap 6d6 piercing, divided among them).

InvigorateAPG: Warding (debilitation; 1st level) + Still Spell (+1 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (fatigue and exhaustion only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard or illusionist; -1 level) = 1st level; suspends fatigue and exhaustion effects for the duration, then deals 3d6 nonlethal when effect ends.

Invigorate DeadRR: Warding (death; 1st level) + Irresistible Spell (+3 levels) + Cascade Spell (slow; -3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); recently-dead creature has [dead] condition temporarily suspended, but is slowed.

Invigorate ItemAUG: Enhancement (2nd level) + Variable Spell (all SLAs of designated item; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 2nd level; +1 enhancement to SLA save DCs of magic item touched for 1 rd./level.

Invisibility Sphere: Glamer (1st level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r. emanation; -1 level) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (those entering sphere after casting are not affected; -1 level) = 3rd level; those in 10’r. emanation are invisible to those not affected.

Invisibility, Mass: Glamer (1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Stealth; +1 level) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to long; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Communal Spell (+1 level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 7th level; affects up to 600 creatures for 1 rd./level each, or up to 60 for 1 min./level each, masking from sight, sound, smell, touch, and heat sense.

Invisibility, SelectiveRRE: Glamer (1st level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) + Augment Spell (tactile and thermal; +1 level) = 5th level; selected creatures in 60’r. emanation are masked to all senses, except to each other.

Invisibility, SuperiorCA: Glamer (1st level) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Stealth; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 7th level; creature touched is invisible; smell, sound, tactile, and thermal cues absent; and +1/2 levels to Stealth (max. +10). Effect is not broken by attacking.

Invisibility, SwiftCAd: Glamer (1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Stealth; +1 level) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 1st level; swift casting makes you invisible (and +1/2 levels, max. +5, to Stealth) for 1 rd. or until you attack. Invisibility to ConstructsDD: Glamer (1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Stealth; +1 level) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +1 level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (constructs; -2 levels) = 1st level.

Invisible MailCWH: Mage armor (0 level) + Cascade Spell [(inure: bludgeoning; +1 level) + Energy Admixture (piercing and slashing; +0 levels) + Tenuous Spell (magic; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels)] + Augment Spell (+4 to +8; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; you gain +8 armor bonus to AC and DR 5/adamantine or magic (DR 10 at CL 12th).

Invoke DeityPnA: Variable Spell (choose one domain at the time of casting; +1 level):

  • Air: Fly (4th level); you gain fly 60 ft., with +1/2 levels bonus to checks.
  • Animal: Polymorph (animal; 3rd level) + Cascade Spell (enhancement; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (natural armor; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (speak with animals; +1 level) = +4 levels; you gain +2 Str, +2 natural armor (+1/4 levels), low-light vision, bite attack (1d6), and can speak with animals.
  • Artifice: Polymorph (construct; 3rd level) + Cascade Spell [(resistance; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3 bonus; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (Fort and Will saves; -1 level)] = +4 levels; you become construct, gain +3 bonus to Fort and Will saves.
  • Chaos: Warding (precision damage; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (protects against nonmagical precision damage; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell [(align weapon: chaos; +2 levels) – Variable Spell (fixed alignment; -1 level)] = +4 levels; you are immune to precision damage and penetrate DR/chaotic.

  • Darkness: Eyes of the voidACG (q.v.; 4th level); you can see in darkness (even magical darkness).
  • Death: Warding (negative energy; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (only when exposed to negative energy; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (as exposed; +1 level) + Expedient Spell (max. healing = total amount of negative energy; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (warding: [death] effects; +1 level) = +4 levels; you are immune to negative energy and [death] effects, and up to one time/level you are exposed to negative energy, you heal a like amount (max. 10d6).
  • Destruction: Transmute (1st level) + Widen Spell (1 lb. to 3 lbs.; +1 level) + Augment Spell (rare metal; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (weapon only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Spell Focus (evocation); 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) = +4 levels; you gain +1 to attacks and damage, +1 to the DCs of your evocation spells, and your weapon attacks bypass object hardness and DR/adamantine.
  • Earth: Warding (Dex drain; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (inure: slashing; +1 level) + Energy Admixture (bludgeoning and piercing; +0 levels) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) = +4 levels; you gain DR 10/adamantine and are immune to petrifaction and other Dex drain effects.

Lingering InfernoToB: Jet of flame (0 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) = 1st level; single melee attack deals up to +5d6 fire plus 2d6 burn.

Lion’s ChargeSRD: Bestow feat (Skirmish; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: prerequisite; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 2nd level; swift casting provides you with pounce ability for 1 rd.

Liquid FormRRO: Polymorph (elemental; 3rd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (water elemental; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 2 min./level; +1 level) + Augment Spell (3rd level effects; +1 level) = 3rd level; subject becomes water elemental, gains darkvision, swim 30 ft., resist fire 5, water breathing, and can pass through narrow pipes, etc. Cf. cloak of the seaCAd. Variants:

  • Dolomar’s Limited LiquifactionRR: Liquid form (q.v.; 3rd level) + Cascade Spell (warding: restraints; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Natural Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (2 min./level to 1 rd./level; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (­1 level) = 4th level (listed as 5th); you assume semi-liquid form, gain darkvision, swim 60 ft., DR 5/+1, immunity to [restraint] conditions; can trade up to 5 feats for Favored Terrain (underwater).
  • Fluid formAPG is Personal (-1 level), Cascades enlarge self (+1 level), and is Augmented 5 steps total (+3 levels) = 6th level; you gain liquid form, darkvision, +4 Str, reach, DR 10/slashing, swim 120 ft., water breathing; trade feats for Favored Terrain to gain [water] subtype, etc.
  • Heart of waterCM is Personal (-1 level), lasts 1 hr./level (+2 levels), and is Restricted (access to Water domain, etc.; -1 level) = 3rd level; you gain darkvision, 60-ft. swim speed, trade 4 feats for favored terrain (underwater) +8 for 1 hr./level.

Listening RingwormRR: Alter senses (0 level) + Reach Spell (effects: close to planar; +6 levels) + Reach Spell (target: close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (vicinity of creature touched only; -2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (sensor removed by remove disease, etc.; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Pestilence or Plant domain; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd), you plant sensor on target by touch, can listen to its surroundings 1 hr./level thereafter.

Litany of DefenseUC: Enhancement (2nd level) + Item-Specific Spell (armor only; -2 levels) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (remove fear; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 2nd level; swift casting grants you +1 sacred bonus/4 levels to AC and immunity to fear for 1 rd.

Litany of EloquenceUC: Compel (watch; 2nd level) + Quicken Spell (+4 levels) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin or access to Inquisition domain; -1 level) = 4th level; swift casting fascinates target for 1 round.

Litany of EntanglementUC: Bind (0 level) + Quicken Spell (+4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin or access to Inquisition domain; -1 level) = 1st level; swift casting entangles target for 1 round.

Litany of EscapeUC: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (target; touch to close; +1 level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (grappled subject only; -2 levels) = 4th level; grappled ally is dimension doored out of grapple to location within Close range.

Litany of MadnessUC: Lesser compelling confusion (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (antipaladin or access to Inquisition or Madness domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; swift casting confuses target 1 rd./level (save each round to end effect).

Litany of RighteousnessUC: Light (0 level) + Augment Spell (dazzling; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (light: 10 min./level to 1 rd.; -3 levels) + Extend Spell (dazzling: 1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Shape Spell (emanation to target; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (sound lance; +1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (vs. [evil] only; -2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Restricted Spell ([good] caster; -1 level) = 3rd level (paladin 2nd); damage cap +12d6 (half sonic, half holy) divided among melee attacks vs. [evil] opponent, plus dazzles 1 rd./level or until save.

Litany of SightUC: See invisibility (q.v.; 2nd level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 2nd level.

Litany of SlothUC: Bestow Feat (Combat Reflexes; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Concentration; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin or access to Inquisition domain; -1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); target cannot take immediate actions and is -1/2 levels (-10 max.) to Concentration for 1 round.

Litany of ThunderUC: Ray of obliviousness (1st level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses: deafness; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Extend Spell (deafness; 1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin or access to Inquisition domain; -1 level) = 4th level; swift casting deals 1d6+1/level (+15 max.) penalty to Wis for 1 rd./level (confused at 1), deafens 1 min./level.

Litany of VengeanceUC: Blessing (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (+3 levels) + Augment Spell (+2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (specified target only; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (choose target at time of casting; +1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin or access to Inquisition domain; -1 level) = 4th level; swift casting grants 1 creature/level +4 sacred bonus to attacks and damage against target for 1 round.

Litany of WardingUC: Bestow feat (Combat Reflexes; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Restricted Spell (paladin or access to Inquisition domain; -1 level) = 1st level; you gain Combat Reflexes for 1 round as a swift action.

Litany of WeaknessUC: Touch of fatigue (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Extend Spell (8 hrs. to 10 min./level; -1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin or access to Inquisition domain; -1 level) = 1st level; target fatigued.

Live WoodRR: VigorCD (q.v.; 3rd level) + Shape Spell (emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Item-Specific Spell (wood only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 1st level; wood in area regenerates 2 hp/rd. until 1d6+1 hp/level regained (max. 5d6+5).

Living PrintsMF: Enhancement (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (tracking time lapse DC; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Survival; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1/4 to +1/3; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger; -2 levels) = 1st level; you gain +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Survival checks, and the elapsed-time DCs for your tracking are reduced by 1/3 levels.

Living WeaponSLPG: Invisible needle (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (enhancement; +2 levels) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

  • Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Improved Critical; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +6 effects; +1 level) + Reach Spell (-1 level) = +1 level; melee weapon with 19-20 threat range.
  • Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level)

+ Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (in forest; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1/4 to +1/3; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (elf or favored terrain: forests; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 1st level; damage cap 6d6 piercing, divided among iterative attacks (melee attacks with 19-20/x2 crit or Long ranged attacks), with +1 enhancement bonus/3 levels.

Loathsome VeilUM: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. cubes to 20-ft. cubes; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Fell Sickening (+1 level) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) = 6th level (listed as 3rd); 2d4 +1/level (+15 max.) HD nauseated 1 rd./level (Fort sickened). To get down to 3rd level, remove Concentration Spell, Fell Sickening, and Widen Spell.

Locate CityRD: Detection (cities; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to continental; +5 levels) – Concentration Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 5th level (bard 4th, ranger 3rd with Restricted Spell; listed as 1st).

Locate CorpseRR: Detection (corpses; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level.

Locate GateHA: Detection (dimensional portals; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (concentration to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 5th level.

Locate OasisRR2: Detection (water; 2nd level) + Location-Specific Spell (in desert; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to extreme; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (conc. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 1st).

Locate WaterSSt: Detection (water; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (bodies of water—pools, brooks, lakes, rivers, etc.; -2 levels) + Resistible Spell (blocked by fire or magma; -1 level) = 1st level; 1st round—presence or absence; 2nd—number and size of largest; 3rd—sizes and locations. DowsingRR also adds Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels); it can penetrate the ground surface (1st level; listed as 0).

Locate WaterRR2: Detection (water; 2nd level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

  • Reach Spell (close to extreme; +2 levels); or
  • Irresistible Spell (penetrates ground surface; +2 levels)

+ Extend Spell (conc. to 10 min./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as 1st).

Locate WeaknessUC: Hand of fate (0 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (damage only; -2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 3rd); for the next 1 min./level, you roll all damage twice and take the better of the two.

Lock GazeUC: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (blindness; +1 level) + Selective Spell (subject can see you; +1 level) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; target can look only at you 1 rd./level, is blind to everything else.

LockjawAPG: Bestow feat (Improved Grapple; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Maneuvering Strike; +1 level) = 2nd level.

Log of EverburningTM2: Creation (wood; 1st level); existing log(s) or torches of up to 1 cu. ft./level burn for up to 1 hr./level.

Long ArmACG: Enlarge (3rd level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 1st level; your reach increases by 5 ft. for 1 min./level (assume the other bonuses/penalties for changing size cancel out).

Long FlameAUG2: Light (0 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (replaces light of finite mundane light source; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 0 level; existing candle, lantern, etc. continues to illuminate 20’r. for 1 hr./level after it would otherwise go out.

Longstrider, GreaterACG: Celerity (0 level) + Variable Spell (additional movement speeds; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; +20 ft. to land speed; +10 ft. to others for 1 hr./level.

Longstrider, MassPHII: Celerity (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Travel domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (+70 ft. to +10 ft.; -3 levels) = 4th level.

Lord of NightmaresSRD: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 18 dream larva; +10 levels) + Cascade Spell (possessionOcA; -3 levels) = 8th level (listed as epic); for 1 rd./level you are possessed by a dream larvaELH (use all of its stats in place of yours; you cannot act, nor control what situation you’ll be in when the duration ends).

Lord of the CityAUG2: Detection (residents; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (message; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to line of sight; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (conc. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (-1 level) = 9th level; for 1 hr./level, you know the location, numbers, and status of all residents of settlement you are in, and can communicate with them.

Lore KeeperCRB: Skill enhancement (Knowledge; 0 level) + Variable Spell (as appropriate for target; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Knowledge domain; -1 level) = 0 level; as a swift action, make an appropriate knowledge or other ID check with a +1/2 levels bonus (+5 max.). Cf. ancient knowledgeME.

Lose the PathPH1: Glamer (1st level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (other sense: navigation; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 6th level; subject cannot discern direction to find its way: obscures visual, auditory, olfactory, tactile clues and eliminates all sense of direction.

  • Reverse fieldRRE lasts only 1 rd./level (-3 levels) and is not accursed (-1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st).

Love’s LamentSC: Damage attribute (Wis; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Tenous Spell (save each round to end nausea; -1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (cone; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 4th level; cone deals 1d4 Wis damage (Fort half) and nausea until save made (max. 1 rd./level).

Lovers’ KnotRRO: MindlinkSRD (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (detection; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (cone to target; -1 level) + Variable Spell (bestow effects to other; +1 level) + Extend Spell (conc. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 7th level; two subjects can communicate telepathically, and know one another’s location. Invest 350 x CL numen to maintain effect.

Lower Spell ResistanceTM2: Warding (SR; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; removes SR (Fort neg.) for 1 min./level. Variants:

  • Assay ResistanceCA: Bestow feat (Spell Penetration; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Concentration; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (vs. target creature only; -2 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 4th); swift casting allows you to roll twice when attempting to penetrate target’s SR, with +1/2 level (max. +5) to checks, for 1 rd./level.
  • Remove resistanceRR includes Mass Effect Spell (also suppresses magical resistance bonuses to saves; +1 level) and lasts only 1 rd./level (-1 level) = 4th level.
  • Spell magnetAUG cascades resistance (+0 levels due to metamagic synergy) + Augment Spell (+9 total; +4 levels) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (saves vs. spells and SLAs only; -2 levels) = 6th level (listed as 8th); subject loses SR and is -9 to saves vs. spells and spell-like abilities.
  • Spell VulnerabilitySC: Enhancement (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (SR only; -2 levels) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (1/4 to ½; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); target takes -1/2 levels penalty to SR for 1 min./level.

Love’s PainBVD: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Variable Spell (loved one instead of target; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (target’s closest friend/ loved one; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (medium to interplanar; +5 levels) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 2nd); medium ranged touch deals 1d6 negative energy/level (max. 10d6) to target’s closest friend or loved one (even if they are on another plane).

Low-Light VisionCA: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (vision only; -1 level) = 2nd level.

  • Keen sensesAPG Cascades skill enhancement (Perception; +1 level), lasts only 1 min./level (-2 levels), lacks a ritual component (+1 level), and is Restricted (druid or access to Animal domain; -1 level) rather than Reduced (+0 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); subject gains low-light vision and +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Perception.
  • ElfsightSRD also Cascades skill enhancement (+1 level) and is Personal (-1 level) and Reduced by 1 more step (-1 level), and has no ritual component (+1 level) = 2nd level; you gain low-light vision and +1 to Perception.
  • Predator’s GraceAPG Cascades celerity (+1 level), is extended to only 1 min./level (-2 levels), and is Personal (-1 level) and Sudden (+0 levels); it is Restricted (access of Animal domain, etc.) rather than Reduced (+0 levels) = 0 level; swift casting grants you gain low-light vision and +10 ft. to land speed for 1 rd.
  • Tenser’s Eye of the TigerGA: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Blind-Fight; +1 level) = 2nd level; subject gains low-light vision and Blind-Fight feat for 1 rd./level.

Luck, Enkili’sRR: Compel (fail; 2nd level) + Delay Spell (next major effort; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to inst.; -1 level) = 3rd level; subject is compelled to fail at its next major effort.

Lucky Bead, Blaise’sRR2: Hand of fate (0 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 4th); for the next 1 rd./level, you roll twice for d20 rolls and select the better result.

Lucky BladeME: Hand of fate (0 level) + Delay Spell (swift activation; +4 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (attack roll only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 2nd); as an immediate action, reroll one attack roll made with affected weapon.

Lucky CapeME: Hand of fate (0 level) + Delay Spell (swift activation; +4 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (saving throw; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 3rd); as an immediate action, reroll one saving throw.

Lucky StreakCSc: Enhancement (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (rerolls; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (any rerolls; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level (bard 1st); for the next 1 min./level, subject gains +1/3 levels enhancement bonus to rerolls (e.g. Hand of fateCRB, hero points, etc.).

Lucky StrikeCSc: Blessing (0 level) + Lucky Spell (+2 levels) + Augment Spell (+4 bonus; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 min./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 2nd level; swift casting grants you +4 to attacks and damage for 1 rd.

Lucubration, Mordenkainen’s: Bestow feat (Magical Talent; 1st level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (11 ranks effects; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (spell you cast that day; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 2 hrs./level; +4 levels) = 5th level (listed as 6th); you regain one spell of up to 6th level already cast that day. Variants:

  • MultiplicityRR is Augmented to 16 ranks (+1 level) and lasts only 1 rd./level (-4 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 5th); for 1 rd./level, you can use one of your prepared spells as a spell-like ability a max. number of times depending on the spell level: 0-2nd—at will, 3rd-4th—3x, 5th+--1x.
  • Rary’s mnemonic enhancerSRD is Augmented only to 6 ranks (-1 level) and is Ritual rather than Effect-Specific (+0 levels) = 4th level (listed as 4th); you gain up to 3 levels’ worth of spell-like abilities (essentially, you prepare additional spells or regain used ones).

Lullaby: Ray of obliviousness (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Concentration Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (Perception and saves vs. sleep only; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 0 level; -1d6 penalty to Wis for purposes stated only.

Luminous ArmorBED: Mage armor (1st level) + Augment Spell (+5 bonus; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Augment Spell (dazzling; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (dazzling only when attacking subject of spell; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 hr./level; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Str; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (caster with [good] descriptor; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); +5 mage armor sheds normal light (dazzling vs. attackers), but caster takes 1d4 Str damage.

Luminous Armor, GreaterBED: Lumious armorBED (3rd level) + Augment Spell (+9 total bonus; +2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 4th).

Luminous AssassinPHII: Summon (human rogue 1; 1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd). The 3rd level luminous assassin spell adds Augment Spell (CR 2 human rogue 3; +1 level), and the 5th level greater luminous assassin instead adds Augment Spell (CR 6 human rogue 5; +3 levels).

Lunar ArmorRRO: Deflection (0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Lucky Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (wood elf, or access to Heavens mystery, etc.; -1 level) = 2nd level; you gain +2 luck bonus to AC (+1/6 levels) for 1 hr./level.

Lunar RevelationRRO: Scrying (q.v.; 4th level) + Location-Specific Spell (location scried must be in moonlight; -2 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 6th).

Lunar SpeedRRO: Celerity (0 level) + Variable Spell (all modes of movement; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (−1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (outdoors, in moonlight; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+10’ to +30’; +1 level) = 1st level; while outdoors, in the moonlight, you gain +30 ft. enhancement to all movement speeds.

Lustful Gaze, Rie’sRR2: Compel (follow me; 2nd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoid; -2 levels) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) + Pattern Spell (visual; -1 level) = 2nd level; subject does nothing but follow the caster around sheepishly, until attacked.

Mace of OdoMF: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Bane Spell (undead: fixed; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (dispel; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Law or Protection domain; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); one melee touch/rd. deals up to 10d6 force plus dazed 1 rd., and you can use a held action to attempt to dispel a spell targeting you.

Mad HallucinationUM: Ray of beguiling (1st level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 3rd level; 1d6 + ½ levels (max. +5) penalty to Cha (indirectly impacting Will saves and Concentration checks).

Mad MonkeysUC: Summon (1st level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 2 monkey swarm; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level; summoned monkey swarm deafens those damaged. Trade Perception, Stealth, and Survival skills for Sleight of Hand (3/+9) and Lightning Reflexes for Improved Weapon Maneuvers (disarm).

Mad Sultan’s MelodyHA: Compel (fascination; 2nd level) + Coaxing Spell (+0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) = 6th level (bard 5th) (listed as 4th/3rd); oozes and other formless servitors of the Outer Gods are fascinated 1 rd./level.

Maddening ScreamSRD: Inertia (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (stunning; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of clumsiness; +1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Madness domain or cultist of Tharizdun; −1 level) = 8th level; victim stunned and takes 1d6 +1/level penalty to Dex for 1 rd./level.

Mage Armor, ImprovedUnE: Mage armor (1st level) + Cascade Spell (enhancement; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (armor bonus; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1/4 to +1/3; +1 level) = 3rd level; armor bonus is +4, +1/3 levels (max. +10 at CL 18th).

Mage Hand, GreaterMF: Mage hand (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 8 lbs./level; +1 level) = 2nd level.

Magic Missile: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Inexorable Evocation (+3 levels) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 5d6; -4 levels) = 4th level (listed as 1st); damage cap 9d6, divided among missiles, with no attack roll needed and no saving throw.   • Mordenkainen’s Force MissilesWotC: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Splash Evocation (+0 levels) = 4th level; damage cap 19d6 force (divided among missiles; max. 15d6 for one) plus 4 hp to those in 5’r. AKA force orbUnE.

Magic Stone: Energy mace (0 level) + Variable Spell (can be burled or slung; +1 level) + Manifested Spell (­1 level) + Cascade Spell (magic weapon; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Bane Spell (undead; +0 levels) + Reduce Spell (5d6 to 1d6; -1 level) = 1st level (ranger 0); two +1 stones deal base 1d6 each (1d8 vs. undead).

  • Giant’s WrathSC: Energy mace (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Insightful Strike; +1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 13d6 (divided among Medium ranged touch attacks), with possible insight bonus to damage and/or attacks.

  • Turn Pebble to BoulderTM2: Energy mace (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Empower Spell (+1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 1.5 x 14d6 bludgeoning, divided among Medium ranged (as thrown weapon) attacks (max. 1.5 x 10d6 for 1 attack).

  • Play InstrumentUM: Skill enhancement (Perform: music; 0 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 1st level; +1/2 levels (+5 max. to Perform (music) and proficiency extends to 1+ new instruments.
  • Shadow CrownRF: Skill enhancement (Perform; 0 level) + Variable Spell (all Perform checks; +1 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (+5 to +10; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 1st level (listed as 3rd); you are +1/2 levels to Perform checks.

MagnetismAUG: Mage hand (0 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Str; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+10 bonus; +4 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (metal only; -2 levels) = 2nd level; you gain +10 to Str when interacting with metal objets (climbing metal ladder, CMD if disarmed of metallic weapon, etc.) for 1 min./level, and can pull small metallic objects to you from within close range (1 lb./level max.) with concentration.

MagnetismCA: Mage hand (0 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 216 lbs./level; +4 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (ferrous metal only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (pull: as push but to you; +1 level) = 3rd level; you attract metal object(s) up to indicated weight limit while you concentrate, one at a time at 20 ft./rd.

Magnetism, SuperiorS&M: Mage hand (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grappled; +1 level + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 216 lbs./level; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (conc. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (metal only; -2 levels) = 6th level; metal objects within 20 ft. pulled to focus of emanation and grappled there. Magical VestmentUA1: Mage armor (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+6 total bonus; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (enhancement; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level; touch bestows +6 armor with additional +1 enhancement bonus/4 levels.

Magnifying ChimeACG: Sound lance (1st level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (when object touched; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 7th level (bard 6th); damage cap 15d6 sonic/rd. Make ManifestMP: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (target: touch to close; +1 level) + Reach Spell (range: close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (your plane; -2 levels) + Trans-dimensional Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 7th level (listed as 6th); creature on coterminous plane appears on yours for 1 rd./level.

MalaiseRR2: Damage attribute (Str; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (days to hours; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 3rd); those in 20’r. take 3d4 Str damage (Fort half), regained at 1 point per hour.

MalfunctionUM: Lesser compelling confusion (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (enchantment to transmutation; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (construct only; -2 levels) = 3rd level; construct acts as if confused for 1 rd./level.

Cf. manaspearRR.

Mantle of BaravarDHD: Spell resistance (5th level) + Effect-Specific Spell (illusions only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Communal Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (gnome or access to Charm domain; -1 level) = 4th level; SR vs. ilusions for 1 hr./level (divided among recipients).

Mapping, Dolomar’sRR: Summon (1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 2nd level; summons Small elemental (air) Expert 1 with max. ranks Craft (cartographer), Craft (construction), and Profession (mining), and Skill Focus (Profession: cartographer).

Marching ChantACG: Celerity (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (overland speed only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 1st level; +30 ft. to subjects’ overland walking speed―so a walk covers the distance of a hustle―while you concentrate.

Marid’s MasteryARG: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+4 total bonus; +3 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (subject and opponents are touching water; -2 levels) = 1st level; subject gains +4 to attacks and damage against opponents who are also in the water.

  • Comrade’s immunityAUG2 affects only 1 spell/3 levels (-1 level), is Extended (10 min./level; +2 levels), Creature-Specific (single target specified; -2 levels), and not Expedient (+1 level) = 5th level (listed as 3rd); for each spell you cast within the next 10 min./level, you choose whether it affects the subject of the comrade’s immunity, subject to Sudden Metamagic limits (with 2x as many spells at CL 6th, 3x at 9th, etc.).

Mark of DoomPHII: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Delay Spell (when attacks; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (single creature not of your alignment; -2 levels) + Inexorable Evocation (+3 levels) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 1d6; -4 levels) = 4th level; target takes 1d6 force damage (no save) each time it attacks or takes some other hostile action (max. 5d6/rd.).

Mark of FireAUG2: Attribute boost (Dex; 0 level) + Extend Spell (1 nin./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (jet of flame; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Delay Spell (+1 level) + Tenuous Spell (ends Dex bonus; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; subject +2 Dex for 10 min./level or until makes ranged touch attack for 5d6 fire.

Mark of Fire, GreaterAUG2: Attribute boost (Dex; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (inure: fire; +1 levels) + Extend Spell (1 nin./level to 10 min./level; +1 levels) + Cascade Spell (jet of flame; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (+1 level) + Tenuous Spell (ends other effects; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6 and 40 to 15; -2 levels) = 4th level; subject +2 Dex snd resist fire 15 for 10 min./level or until throws 5d6 fireball. Mark of Justice: Bestow curse (3rd level) + Delay Spell (subject performs prohibited act; +1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level (paladin 4th). Invest 250 x CL numen to maintain curse until atoned.

Mark of Justice, LesserDr342: Lesser bestow curseDr342 (2nd level) + Delay Spell (as above; +1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) = 3rd level (paladin 2nd). Invest 150 x CL numen to maintain curse until atoned.

Mark of WaterAUG2: As mark of fireAUG2 (q.v.; 2nd level), but Con boost and bludgeoning damage.

Marked ManDr325: Skill enhancement (0 level) + Variable Spell (skill approproate to tracking; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 2 hrs./level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (possessor of focus object; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (rogue or ranger; -1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +1/2 levels; +1 level) = 1st level; you are +1/2 levels to track possessor of spell’s focus object.

MasochismBVD: Blessing (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +5; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Expedient Spell (scales with damage taken; -1 level) = 2nd level; for 1 min./level, you gain +1 profane bonus to attacks, damage, and saves per 10 hp unhealed damage you have (max. +5).

MassacreHA: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+6d4; +5 levels) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to line; +1 level) = 9th level; those in Close line take 7d4 Con plus 1d6 negative energy/level (max. 20d6, arcane 25d6), Fort half.

MassmorphPH1: Glamer (1st level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (willing subjects only; -2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (appear as trees; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (de facto invisibility outdoors; +1 level) = 4th level; creastures in up to one 10-ft. cube/level are disguised as trees (audiovisual, olfactory, and tactile components).

Master EarthMF: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (druid; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to planar; +5 levels) + Irresistible Spell (not blocked by earth; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 7th level; you teleport through the earth to any destination on the same planet.

“How do you know we’re in the center of the earth?” asked Betsy, her voice trembling a little through nervousness.

“Why, we can’t be anywhere else,” replied Polychrome. “I have often heard of this passage, which was once built by a Magician who was a great traveler. He thought it would save him the bother of going around the earth’s surface...”

Master’s IllusionCRB: Glamer (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Trickery domain; -1 level) = 3rd level; allies within 20 ft. of you are cloaked by illusion to appear and sound as you choose for 1 rd./level.

Master’s TouchCAd: Bestow feat (weapon or shield proficiency; 1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Item-Specific Spell (weapon or shield held; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 0 level; you gain Exotic proficiency with weapon or shield held for 1 round as a swift action.

MeldTM2: PossessionOcA (3rd level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (willing recipient; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 5th); you possess a willing host.

MeltUA1: Jet of flame (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. cubes to 5-ft. cubes; -1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (cold subtype; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 level) = 1st level; damage cap 5d6 fire vs. [cold] creatures, and ice and snow.
