  • Jhanifer’s DeliquescenceDr181: Jet of flame (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cubes; +3 levels) + Overwhelming Evocation (+1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (ice or stone; ­2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Augment Spell (5d6 to 20d6; +3 levels) = 4th level (listed as 5th); touch deals up to 20d6 fire to one 10-ft. cube/level of ice or rock (bypasses hardness, energy resistance).

Membrane of LawDLM: Hedge (chaos; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (emanation to wall; +0 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) = 5th level; door (up to one 5-ft. square/level) allows one-way access only to [chaotic] creatures. Invest 1,000 x CL numen to maintain effect.

Memorize PageACG: Figment (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (written page touched; -2 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (visual component; +1 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 0 level (listed as 1st); perfect phantasmal duplicate of page studied lingers in subject’s memory. Invest 25 x CL numen to maintain memory permanently.

Memory ReadTM2: Detection (memories; 2nd level). For mind raidRR, add Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 1st level.

Memory RotMF: Damage attribute (Int; 1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 5th level; deals 1d4 Int drain/rd. Menacing Tentacles, Evard’sPHII: Energy mace (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Point-Blank Shot; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Ranged Threat; +1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 3rd level; 2 attacks/rd. at +1 vs. Close opponents for up to 4d6+1 + ½ Str mod each, and can make attacks of opportunity within 10 ft.

Mental BarrierSRD: Deflection (0 level) + Augment Spell (+4 total bonus; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); immediate casting grants +4 deflection for 1 rd. AKA aegisSLPG. Variants:

Mental Barrier IOcA: Warding (mind thrust; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (shield; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) = 2nd level; immediate casting grants you +4 shield bonus to AC and immunity to mind thrust spells for 1 rd.

Mental Barrier IIOcA: Mental barrier I (q.v.; 2nd level) + Aufment Spell (+6 shield bonus; +1 level) = 3rd level.

Mental StrengthOA: Resistance (0 level) + Augment Spell (+9 total bonus; +5 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (Will saves only; -2 levels) = 3rd level; subject gains +9 resistance bonus to Will saves for 1 min./level. Variants:

Message: Figment (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Selective Spell (choose up to 1 recipient/level; +1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) = 0 level; up to 1 recipient/level receives mental messages.

MetafacultySRD: Augury (2nd level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +4 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Cascade Spell (warding: anti-scrying effects; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (diviner/seer/ oracle; -1 level) = 8th level (listed as 9th); you gain info to 1 one-word question/rd. (or more detailed info by using more rounds), which is not blocked by lead or anti-divination magic. (To also remote view the subject, cast scrying separately.)

Metamorphose LiquidsTM2: Transmute (1st level).

  • Shooting StarsTM2: Jet of flame (0 level) + Energy Admixture (electricity; +0 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell [(energy mace; +1 level) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Ray Splitting (+1 level)] + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Void domain, etc.; -1 level) = 9th level; 7d6 each fire and electricity in 120’r., plus 4 ranged touch attacks for 50 bludgeoning each.

  • Death MarkToB: Jet of flame (0 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) = 3rd level; melee [strike] deals up to 10d6 fire damage (divine 5d6) in a 40’r.

Miasma, Mystra’sPGF: Wisp (0 level) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (zephyr; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Concentration; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of beguiling; +1 level) + Variable Spell (spellcasting attribute, if other; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (line to spread; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) = 8th level (listed as 9th); as solid fog, plus -1/2 levels to Concentration checks and 1d6 +1/level penalty to Cha (or spellcasting attribute, if different).

MimicryCSc: Figment (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Perform; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard or rogue; -1 level) = 1st level; you can mimic sounds or speech, with +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Perform (acting) checks to imitate a specific person’s voice, etc.

Mind Blank: Warding (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) = 8th level; subject immune to divinations and scrying, plus charms, compulsions, phantasms, and other [mind-affecting], including (Ex), (Sp), and (Su) abilities.   • Iron mindCWH lasts only 10 min./level (-1 level) and is not Irresistible (-2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 3rd); subject immune to charm spells, damage attribute (Dex), and figments for 10 min./level (also glamers at CL 12th, compulsions at 15th, phantasms at 18th).
  • Mental protectionAUG is not Irresistible (-2 levels) = 6th level (listed as 7th).
  • One step beyondAUG2 affects 1 creature/level (+3 levels), and is Expedient (special; -1 level) and Ritual (full round; -1 level) = 9th level; as mass mind blank, but warding can be penetrated by an opposed Concentration check.

  • Psychic protectionS&M wards against 1 effect/level (+1 level), lasts only 1 min./level (-2 levels), and is Personal (-1 level) and not Irresistible (-2 levels) = 4th level; you are protected against charms, compulsions, confusion, domination, feeblemind, insanity, possession, etc. for 1 min./level.

Mind BondBED: Bestow feat (Improved Flanking; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +5; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (bonded mount; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 2nd level; your mount gains +5 sacred bonus to atks, damage, saves vs. fear, and is +2 to give and receive flanking bonuses for 1 rd./level.

Mind SeedSRD: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 6; +4 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (possessionOcA; +3 levels) + Cross-Class Spell (telepathy; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Delay Spell (1 week; -1 level) = 8th level and 400 x CL numen; over the course of a week, victim touched is gradually possessed as if by a 7th level version of you.

Mind StabAUG: Whelm (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to ray; +0 levels) = 1st level; damage cap 5d6 nonlethal.

Mind SwitchSRD: Possession (3rd level) + Cross-Class Spell (telepathy or enchantment; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (2 creatures; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 10 min./level; -1 level) = 5th level (listed as 6th); you and one other creature possess each other’s bodies.

Mind Switch, TrueSRD: Mind switch (5th level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 6th level (listed as 9th); invest 300 x CL numen to make effect permanent.

Mind ThrustSRD: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (telepath; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 1st level; damage cap 5d6 necrotic (Will half).

Mind Thrust IIIOcA: Mind thrustSRD (1st level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Empower Spell (+1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 1.5 x 10d6.

Mind Thrust IVOcA: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cascade Spell (touch of fatigue; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Empower Spell (+1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 1.5 x 10d6 plus fatigued.

Mind Thrust VOcA: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cascade Spell (touch of fatigue; +1 level) + Augment Spell (exhaust; +1 level) + Fell Fatigue (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) = 5th level; damage cap 15d6 plus exhausted (Will half/fatigued).

Mind Thrust VIOcA: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cascade Spell (touch of fatigue; +1 level) + Augment Spell (exhaust; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd.; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) = 6th level; damage cap 20d6 plus stunned and exhausted 1 rd.

Mind TrackerTM2: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (visual; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (sensor can be dispelled or destroyed, ending all effects; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Mind domain; -1 level) = 6th level; as scrying, but lasts as long as you concentrate, and the subject is panicked while the effect lasts.

Mind TrapSRD: Dispel (0 level) + Shielding Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (telepathy only; -2 levels) = 3rd level; immediate casting dispels telepathy powers used against you for 1 rd.

Mindless RageCAd: Compel (attack caster in melee; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 3rd level.

Mindlink, ThievingSRD: MindlinkSRD (1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Magical Talent; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (11 ranks effects; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (spell/power must be known by subject; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (mindlink ends when power gained; -1 level) = 4th level; as mindlink, and can end link by gaining one of linked subject’s powers known.

MindnetTM2: Imbue with spell ability (q.v., 4th level) + Cascade Spell (mindlinkSRD; 1st level) + Channel Spell (through link; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Community or Mind domain; -1 level) = 9th level; up to 1 creature/level share telepathic bond at distance, can grant each other spells through link.

Mindscape DoorOcA: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (targets: touch to close; +1 level) + Reach Spell (destination: close to interplanar; +7 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (into or out of mindscape only; -2 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (mindscape, not actual demiplanes; -1 level) = 6th level (listed as 4th); target can enter or leave a mindscape (Cf. create mindscape).

Pellet BlastUC: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (lesser versatile weaponAPG; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) + Irresistible Evocation (+2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level; 5d6 bludgeoning damage penetrates SR and one material-based DR.

Pending PotionME: Bestow feat (Innate Metamagic: Delay Spell; 1st level) + Augment Spell (CL 16th; +4 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (spell in potion only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 1st level; potion of up to 8th level can be delayed, activated as a swift action after drinking.

Perfect RecollectionRR: Fox’s cunning (2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) = 4th level.

Perfume, Elina’sRR2: Attribute boost (Cha; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (glamer; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (+2 to +1, and no visual, auditory, or tactile/thermal components; -4 levels) = 0 level; subject +1 to Cha and smells like whatever you specify during casting.

PeripetySRD: Variable Spell (+1 level):

  • Mage hand (0 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 8 lbs./level; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) = +2 levels;
  • Dispel (0 level) + Augment Spell (reflect on caster; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = +2 levels.

+ Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (use over multiple rounds; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 9th level (listed as epic); up to 1 ranged attack/3 levels is reflected back at the attacker (projectiles from within Long range, or magical attacks from within Medium range) as an immediate action.

Personal ReadingTM2: Augury (2nd level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 fact/level; +4 levels) + Reach Spell (target: planar to close; -6 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 2nd level; you learn one major fact regarding subject’s personal history per level (Will neg.); each fact consists of a blurb up to 1 rd./level long. Subject must be within Close range. Variants:

  • Creature LoresightAUG: Augury (2nd level) + Variable Spell (fact not already known; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (creature touched; -2 levels) = 1st level; you learn 1 piece of information about creature (living or dead) touched: race or type, name, class, how died, most recent goal, attitude towards you, creature most recently interacted with, most valued possession, home, current thoughts, etc., in that order (1-word answer only). Blood biographyAPG (3rd level) instead allows 1 question/3 levels.
  • Divine Personal HistoryRRE: Augury (2nd level) + Cross-Class Spell (arcane; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 fact/level; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (target: planar to close; -6 levels) – Ritual Spell (+2 levels) = 2nd level; you learn one major fact regarding subject’s personal history per level (Will neg.); subject must be within Close range at the time of casting.
  • Psychic ReadingOcA: Detection (personal information; 2nd level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (cone to target; -1 level) + Expedient Spell (opposed Bluff check needed; -1 level) = 1st level; learn one item of personal information/rd. with successful check (e.g., age, class, gender, native language, place of origin, race or ethnicity, religion, secual orientation, secondary skills, etc.).

Persuasive GoadUM: Whelm (0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Bluff; +1 level) = 1st level; damage cap 5d6 nonlethal and you gain +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Bluff checks against target.

Pesh VigorPC: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (up to +6 total bonus; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (whelm; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 1st level; subject +2 to Str, +1/1d6 nonlethal damage taken (up to 1d6/level; max. 5d6).

PessimismHA: Warding (morale bonuses; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Reduce Spell (frightened to shaken; -1 level) = 5th level; target shaken and loses all morale bonuses for 1 hr./level.

Phantasmal AsphyxiationHA: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; Intuition or 3d6 nonlethal plus 1d4 Con/rd. (Fort half).

Phantasmal AssailantsCA: Damage attribute (1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (Dex and Wis; +1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; target disbelieves or takes 1d4 Dex and Wis damage.

Phantasmal DecoyCD: Figment (0 level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (compel: follow; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger; -2 levels) = 3rd level; target relentlessly chases figment “enemy” you direct as a partial action each round.

Phantasmal PutrefactionHA: Damage attribute (Wis; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 6th level; Intuition or 1d4 Wis plus 3d6 nonlethal +1d6/level (max. +15d6) and 2d6/rd. thereafter, vs. 1 creature per level.

Phantasmal RevengeAPG: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to planar; +6 levels) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Empower Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (killer of dead creature touched; -2 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 7th level; damage cap 10d6+120 to killer of dead creature touched, anywhere on the same plane.

Phantasmal StranglerCM: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 plus 2d6/rd. and grappled 1 rd./level. Intution neg., if fails, 3d6 nonlethal and Reflex half/neg.

Phantasmal ThiefBVD: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 12; +7 levels) = 8th level; summons a ghost rogue 11 with the Ghost Strike and Improved Disarm feats, max. ranks and Skill Focus in Sleight of Hand and Stealth, etc.

Phantom ArmorUA1: Mage armor (1st level) + Augment Spell (+8 total bonus; +3 levels) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level) + Expedient Spell (total hp; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 1st level; subject gains +8 armor bonus (attackers’ Intuition saves results in +0 instead). Lasts 1 hr./level or until 11 danage taken from attacks affected by armor bonus.

Phantom’s HowlRR: Spook (0 level) + Fell Frightening (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cone; +1 level) = 2nd level; frightens 1 rd./level (shaken if save). Note that there is no chance of stunning or paralysis.

PhobiaHA: Spook (0 level) + Fell Frightening (+1 level) + Delay Spell (when confronted with creature, condition, object, etc. of phobia; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 6th level; subject panicked when faced with object of phobia (Will shaken). (including you with no save, but you instantaneously heal 15d6 hp of that damage).

(turn to ice at 0) plus grappled in mobile 20’r. spread; light reduced by 3 steps (e.g., normal to supernatural darkness).

Polymorph, Drawmij’s BeneficialGA: Polymorph (3rd level) + Variable Spell (multiple forms; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (willing target only; -2 levels) = 6th level.

Polypurpose PanaceaUM: Variable Spell (select one 0-level spell at time of casting; +1 level) = 1st level.

Pool of HealingCC: Spark of life (1st level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Delay Spell (standard; retain touches for later use; +1 level) = 5th level (4th with access to Healing domain); touch(es) deliver 30 hp + 6/level positive energy (max. 84, or 60 for any one touch).

+ Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) = 1st level; 1d6 +1/level positive energy damage to undead (+5 max.), and living creatures +3 sacred to saves vs. [death] effects for 1 rd./level.

Possession, MarionetteUC: PossessionOcA (3rd level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (willing target; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 10 min./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (mindlink; +1 level) = 3rd level.

Possession, RidingOcA: PossessionOcA (3rd level) + Cascade Spell [(glamer; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (masks your presence entirely; +1 level) + Phantasmal Spell (-1 level)] + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (cannot control host; -2 levels) = 4th level; you possess (but cannot control) one creature, who is unaware of your presence.

Pouncing FuryUW: Bestow feat (Dodge; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Skirmish; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; you gain the pounce ability (plus the other effects of the Dodge and Skirmish feats) for 1 rd./level.

Power CraftAUG2: Animate object (1st level) + Widen Spell (Gargantuan; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (vehicle only; -2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (mobility only; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 3rd level; vehicle of up to Gargantuan size becomes self-propelled.

Power LeechSRD: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (steal spell slot instead of dispelling; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); steals target’s highest-level slot available each round while you concentrate. Cf. ki leechAPG.

Power LeechBVD: Damage attribute (1st level) + Variable Spell (choose attribute at time of casting; +1 level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+6 total bonus; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Wis; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (Crippling Drain; -1 level) = 5th level; you deal 1d4 attribute drain at range and gain +6 enhancement to that attribute, but you also take 1d4 Wis drain (Will half).

Power Word, Kill: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Eschew Materials (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+5d4 Con; +4 levels) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Expedient Spell (individual hp; -1 level) = 9th level; 6d4 Con (no save) to one target currently <100 hp.

Power Word, ThunderRR: Alter senses (hearing; 0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Expedient Spell (individual hp; -1 level) = 7th level; those in 60’r. with current hp <78 are deafened 1 rd./level (so save), those with 78-156 hp are deafened 1 rd., those with 157+ hp are unaffected.

Circle of DeathSRD: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) = 6th level; 4d4 Con (Fort half) to up to 2d4+1/level (+15 max.) HD (max. 10 HD each) in 40’r.

  • PoxBVD: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) = 6th level; 1d4 Con drain (Fort half) to up to 1 creature/level.

PoxDLM: Ray of infirmity (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Reduce Spell (+15 to +5; -2 levels) = 2nd level; subject takes penalty to Con of 1d6 +1/level (+5 max.) for 1 min./level (Fort half).

Pox PustulesAPG: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of clumsiness; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (special; -1 level) = 2nd level; victim is sickened and takes a 1d6 +1/2 levels penalty to Dex (Fort neg./half), but can spend a partial action each round scratching to remove the symptoms. Variant:

  • Itching CursePC: Sickening touch (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; ­1 level) + Tenuous Spell (eliminate penalty each round with move-action scratching; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (reduced penalties; -1 level) = 1st level; itching causes ­1 to attacks, saves, and checks unless scratched.

Prayer: Blessing (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Lucky Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Variable Spell (Hex Spell: bonus or penalty; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Expedient Spell (individual hp; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (cleric only; -1 level) = 3rd level; allies in 40’r. gain +1 luck bonus to attacks, damage, and saves; enemies with 33 hp or less are -1 to same.

  • ChantPH1 affects a 20’r. personal emanation (-1 level) = 2nd level; allies within 20 ft. of you gain a +1 sacred bonus to attacks, damage and saves, enemies with 22 hp or less are -1 to same.
  • RecitationCD is Augmented (±3; +1 level) and Widened (20’r. to 60’r.; +1 level) = 5th level (listed as 4th); affects enemies with up to 55 hp.

PrecipitationUA1: Creation (plain water; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1/64 volume; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (time release; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (gradual release over course of spell, with no control of timing; -1 level) = 0 level; light rain (0.09 inch per hour) falls over an area 20 ft. in radius for 1 rd./level. Variant:

  • CloudburstCD is Long range (+1 level) and is Widened (216 cu. ft./level; +6 levels), Extended (water lasts 1 hr./level to 10 min./level; -1 level), Location-Specific (outdoors only; -2 levels), Ritual (full round; -1 level), and Restricted (access to Water or Weather domain; -1 level) = 2nd level. Heavy rain (0.5 inch per hour) falls over a 100-ft. radius for 10 min./level; fallen rain evaporates after 10 min./level, so the maximum accumulation of standing water is less than an inch.

PrecognitionSRD: Variable Spell (blessing, resistance, or skill enhancement; +1 level) + Insightful Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (seer or access to Fortune or Time domain; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); immediate casting grants you +3 insight to attacks and damage, saves, or checks for 1 rd. Variants:

  • Athena’s Battle GuidanceRRO: Enhancement (2nd level) + Item-Specific Spell (weapon attacks; -2 levels) + Insightful Spell (+2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (melee only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (Blind-Fight; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +1/2; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin or access to Valor domain; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); for 1 rd./level, you gain +1/2 levels insight to melee attacks and roll miss chances twice when attacking targets with concealment.
  • Defensive PrecognitionSRD: Deflection (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Insightful Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); you gain +2 insight to AC, +1 to saves for 1 min./level.
  • Grace of AthenaRRO: Mage armor (0 level) + Cross-Class Spell (divine; +1 level) + Insightful Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Canny Defense; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); subject gains insight bonus to AC equal to 4 + Wisdom modifier. Mark of AthenaRRO is Delayed (perform specified act; +1 level) and has a full Ritual casting (-2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 5th).
  • Greater precognitionSRD is Augmented to a +5 bonus (+1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 6th); as precognition.
  • Moment of prescienceSRD is Augmented to provide a scaling bonus (+1/level; +5 levels) = 7th level.
  • Offensive PrecognitionSRD: Blessing (0 level) + Cross-Class Spell (divination/seer; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 min./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 0 level; swift casting gives you +3 to attacks, damage for 1 rd.
  • Offensive PrescienceSRD: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Insightful Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 0 level (listed as 1st); you gain +2 insight to attacks, damage for 10 min./level.
  • Precognitive FlashesAUG2: Blessing (0 level) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Insightful Spell (+1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 4th); you gain +1 insight to attacks, damage, and saves, and +2 to AC for 1 min./level.
  • Prophetic WarningAUG2: Variable Spell (deflection or resistance; +1 level) + Insightful Spell (+1 level) + Delay Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to inst.; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+2 levels) = 6th level; as an immediate action, subject gains +5 insight to AC or to one save.

Predict WeatherPH1: Augury (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Survival; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (knowledge of weather in area only; -2 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Weather domain; ‑1 level) = 0 level; you gain knowledge of upcoming weather in area. Use Survival instead of Knowledge to augur, with +1 bonus to the check; success = learn weather over next 24 hours, +1 day/5 points by which you beat the DC.

Prediction of FailureUM: Sickening touch (0 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (dispel; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (cowering to shaken; −3 levels) = 6th level (listed as 8th); target is shaken, sickened, and must make opposed Concentration checks to cast spells; invest personal 300 x CL numen to maintain effect permanently.

Presence, Chardun’sRR2: Attribute boost (Cha; 0 level) + Augment Spell (+4 total; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell [(spook; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to cone; +1 level) + Delay Spell (+1 level) + Tenuous Spell (fear ends Cha bonus; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; you gain long-lasting +4 enhancement to Cha and can dismiss the effect by frightening those in a 30-ft. cone.

Pressure SphereSW: Energy mace (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (underwater; -2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 2nd); damage cap 5d6 bludgeoning (Fort half) in 20’r. burst underwater.

  • Pressure sphereRR also Cascades skill enhancement (Athletics and Endurance; +2 levels) and Hex Spell (+0 levels) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 and -1/2 levels to Athletics and Endurance.

Prevarication’s BountyRR: Glamer (1st level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Delay Spell (when lies; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level; subject rendered mute for 1 rd./level after telling a lie. Retain as active curse by investing 400 x CL numen (2nd level x 50 x 4).

PrevenomSRD: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (claw only; -2 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); claw attack deals +1d4 Con damage (Fort half).

Prickling TormentCM: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Creature-Specific Spell (takes standard or move action; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) = 4th level; sickens 1 rd./level and target takes 1d6 negative energy/level (max. 10d6, Fort half) each round if takes a move or standard action.

Primal DevastationDr297: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to line of sight; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 360’r.; +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (bolt of force; -2 levels) = 9th level; damage cap 20d6 force over large area at very distance range (but caster takes like damage). This is generally cast along with a Delayed summon nature’s ally IX spell, to summon a Giant, Advanced elder elemental into the area after the blast goes off.

Primal FearRE: Spook (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Fell Frightening (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Restricted Spell (psion or psychic warrior; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (panicked to shaken; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); swift action leaves target shaken 1 rd./level (no SR, no initial save, but save each subsequent round to end effect).

Primal Fury, Tenser’sGA: Spark of life (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (arcane; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (haste: q.v.; +3 levels) + Augment Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (warding: fear; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (fighter only; -2 levels) = 5th level; fighter is hasted, +3 to attacks and damage, gains 15d6 temp. hp, and is immune to magical fear.

Primal RegressionOcA: Enhancement (2nd level) + Augment Spell (+2 total; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (natural armor; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Str; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+6 total; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of idiocy; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of beguiling; -1 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = 5th level (listed as 6th); target gains +6 enhancement to Str, +2 to natural armor, and 1d6/level (max. 15d6) temp. hp, but also takes penalty to Int and Cha equal to 1d6 +1/level (1d6+15 max.).

Primal ScreamUM: Remove condition (enchantments; 1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (also paralysis; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) + Augment Spell (minor to critical; +3 levels) = 4th level; breaks enchantment and paralysis effects on you.

Prism Cloak, Abrindel’sRR2: Glamer (1st level) + Cascade Spell (compel: watch; +3 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (+3 levels; up to 1 attacker/level can be fascinated) + Expedient Spell (HD limit; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) = 7th level; up to 1 attacker/level (max. 2d4 +1/level total HD) is fascinated 1 min./level.

Prismatic AuraCM: Prismatic spray (7th level) – Widen Spell (-1 level) + Shape Spell (cone to ray; -1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Tenuous Spell (color disappears once activated; -1 level) = 5th level; anyone hitting you in melee is blinded 1 rd. and subject to one prismatic spray effect (damage cap 90 hp, and each activates only once).

Prismatic BowCM: Prismatic ray (q.v.; 5th level) + Reach Spell (medium to long; +1 level) – Variable Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (invisible needle; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Channeled Spell (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (each color only once; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 20d6; -1 level) = 8th level; damage cap 28d6, divided among iterative attacks, plus one prismatic spray effect per round to one attack (once each color only).

Prismatic DelugeCM: Prismatic spray (7th level) + Shape Spell (widened cone to widened cylinder; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 30’r.; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 20d6; -1 level) = 8th level; those in 30’r., 150-ft. tall cylinder bombarded by prismatic spray effect.

Prismatic EyePGF: Prismatic rayCA (q.v.; 5th level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Tenuous Spell (each color usable only once; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as 6th).

Prismatic MistPHII: Acid splash (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Variable Spell (Versatile Evocation, but no control over results; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 3rd level; each round, those in area take 5d6 acid, fire, cold, or electricity damage (roll 1d4), Reflex half. No additional effects possible without increasing spell level.

Prismatic RayCA: Prismatic spray (7th level) - Widen Spell (-1 level) – Shape Spell (-1 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Variable Spell (no control over effect; -1 level) = 5th level.

Prismatic Sphere: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (blindness; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (jet of flame; +1 level) + Energy Admixture (acid and electricity; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Dex; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Wis; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (Crippling Drain: Dex and Wis; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (dispel; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 20d6; -1 level) = 9th level; 4d6 fire, 6d6 acid, 10d6 electricity, plus 1d4 Con damage, 1d4 Dex and Wis drain, blindness 1 rd./level, and dispelling, each round, to all within 10’r. of you.

Prismatic Spray: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (blindness; +1 level) + Variable Spell (3 levels’ worth of options; +4 levels) + Shape Spell (cone; +1 level) + Widen Spell (30 ft. to 60 ft.; +1 level) = 7th level; all within cone blinded 1 rd./level and effects as follows (roll 1d8):

  1. Red: Cascade Spell (jet of flame; +1 level) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels); damage cap 120 hp.
  2. Orange: Cascade Spell (acid splash; +1 level) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels); damage cap 120 hp.
  3. Yellow: Cascade Spell (electric arc; +1 level) + Maximize Spell (+2 levels); damage cap 120 hp.
  4. Green: Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; +1 level) + Reach Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level); 3d4 Con damage (Fort half).
  5. Blue: Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Dex; +1 level) + Reach Spell (+1 level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level); 1d4 Dex drain (Fort half).
  6. Indigo: Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Wis; +1 level) + Reach Spell (+1 level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level); 1d4 Wis drain (Fort half).
  7. Violet: Cascade Spell (dimensional skip; +1 level) + Reach Spell (target: touch to close; +1 level) + Reach Spell (destination: close to long; +1 level); teleports target 1,000 ft. away in random direction.
  8. Struck by two rays.

Prismatic Wall: Prismatic sphere (9th level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (emanation to wall; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 15d6; -1 level) = 8th level; 3d6 fire, 5d6 acid, 7d6 electricity, plus 1d4 Con damage, 1d4 Dex and Wis drain, blindness 1 rd./level, and dispelling.

The energy field that formed like a wall in front of them was of all the primary colors and perhaps a hundred shades.

She had never seen anything like it, nor did she have any chance to appreciate it, but she could feel its awesome power.

“Joe!” she called, relaying Dacaro’s orders. “We’re going to let that thing come out/. When it does, it will run headlong into the damnest spell you ever saw....”

―Jack Chalker, The River of Dancing Gods (1984)

Private ConversationAUG2: Rary’s telepathic bond (q.v.; 5th level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Tenuous Spell (must remain within close range; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st).

Private Sanctum, Mordenkainen’s: Warding (divinations; 1st level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 20-ft. cubes; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (ward also applies against mundane sight/hearing into area; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (pre-selected, fixed location; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level; those outside area cannot see or hear into it, or use divinations into it.

Profane AgonyDU: Whelm (0 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Death or Suffering domain; -1 level) = 1st level; damage cap 5d6 nonlethal plus sickened 1 rd./level.

Profane AuraPHII: Deflection (0 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (wisp; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (able to channel negative energy; -1 level) = 1st level; 60’r. aura of mist around you provides concealment, grants undead +2 deflection.

ProficiencyAUG2: Bestow feat (Exotic Weapon; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (weapon held at time of casting; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); you gain Exotic proficiency with weapon held.

Prohibit KindAUG2: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4d4; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (effects: days to rounds; -3 levels) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (onset: inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) = 7th level; those not of selected creature type or race who enter area are held (5d4 Dex, Fort half, recovered at 1 point/rd.).

Project Image: Figment (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shadow Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (image of you only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (alter senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (vision and hearing; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Channel Spell (though image); +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Sudden Metamagic; (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) = 7th level; quasi-real (60%) image of you at medium range mimics you, and serves as scrying sensor and conduit for your spells (limited by Sudden Metamagic rules, but 1/3 levels x as many spells can be affected).

  • BilocationOcA is Still (+1 level) = 8th level.
  • Familiar DoubleACG: Project image (7th level) + Location-Specific Spell (image always appears in your familiar’s square; -2 levels) + Variable Spell (image moves with familiar, not you; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (witch; -1 level) = 5th level; 40% real. Area affects targeting the image’s square will affect your familiar as well, and missile fire missing the image might hit the familiar (as if firing into a melee; see Precise Short feat), so this is a very risky way to get early access to project image.

Project VoiceRRE: Glamer (1st level) + Widen Spell (10’r. to 500’r.; +6 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (your normal spoken voice; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (no visual, olfactory, or tactile; -3 levels) = 2nd level; essentially, a magical microphone and speakers.

Protean AuraAPG: Compel (perform other action; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (can perform other action instead; -1 level) + Restricted Spell ([chaotic] bloodline, domain, race, etc.; -1 level) = 4th level; enemies within 20’r. must succeed at saving throws in order to perform intended actions.

Protection DevotionCC: Deflection (0 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Communal Spell (+1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Protection domain; -1 level) = 5th level; immediate casting grants you and allies +2 sacred bonus to AC for 1 min./level (divide duration among recipients).

Protection from Avians, Mordenkainen’sGA: Blessing (0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (avians; -2 levels) = 0 level (listed as 1st); birds and other creatures with the [avian] descriptor are -2 to attacks and damage against the subject.

Protection from Arrows: Spark of life (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (arcane; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 hr./level; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (ranged attacks only; -2 levels) = 2nd level; subject gains 1d6+1/level (max. 10d6+10) temp. hp against ranged weapon damage over the next 1 hr./level (or until discharged).

Protection from CantripsUA1: Warding (cantrips; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Expedient Spell (spell level limit; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (lower spell level limit: 2nd to 0; -2 levels) = 1st level; target creature or objct is unaffected by cantrips.

Protection from CharmCA: Bestow feat (Arcane Defense: enchantment; 1st level) + Augment Spell (scales with caster level; +1 level) = 2nd level; subject immune to charm person and gains +2 competence bonus to save vs. enchantment (+1/5 levels above 1st, immune at 20th) for 1 rd./level. Variants:

Raise FoundationRRE: Shaping (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (bedrock, to or just above surface; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 5,832 cu. ft./level; +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 7th); bedrock slowly rises to form stone foundation 1 ft./level deep x 5,832 square feet in area (e.g., 43’r. circle or square 76 ft. on each side; shape must be simple unless you possess sufficient Craft skill).

Raise IslandSRD: Shaping (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (seafloor, to island; -2 levels) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 40,000,000 cu. ft./level2; +9 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 7th level (listed as epic); raises hemispherical island from sea floor (radius of base = total height from sea floor = about 80 ft./level). If water is deeper than that, the spell forms a seamount instead (the island does not reach the surface); if less, the radius of the island is equal to its height above water. The open ocean is about 12,000 feet deep on average, so this spell is best used nearer the coast.

Raise LandRRE: Raise foundation (3rd level) + Variable Spell (earth and/or rock; +1 level) + Reach Spell (+1 level) + Widen Spell (5,832 cu. ft./level to 8 million cu. ft./level; +2 levels) = 7th level (listed as 9th); increases elevation of land area, within volume restriction (e.g., a 285’r. circle of land of could be increased in elevation by 10 ft./level, possibly forming a small island).

Raise the KeepRR: Mage hand (0 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 8,000,000 lbs./level; +7 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (stone castle only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 8th level; floating castle moves 20 ft./rd. by concentration. Invest 120,000 numen to make permanent.

RallyRRE: Blessing (0 level) + Reach Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd./level; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 level) = 6th level (paladin 4th); allies in 120’r. gain +3 morale to attacks, damage, saves vs. fear.

RampartAPG: Creation (earth; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 216 cu. ft./level; +3 levels) = 6th level; creates earthen rampart 5 ft. thick x 8.5 ft. tall x 5 ft./level in length. Variants:

  • Earthen screenRR2 is Close range (-1 level), occupies only 8 cu. ft./level (-2 levels), and lasts only 10 min./level (-1 level) = 2nd level; creates one section of earthen rampart (5 ft./level long x 2 ft. high x 10 in. thick; provides partial cover) lasting 10 min./level.
  • FortifyS&M uses shaping instead of creation (+1 level), so the effect is instantaneous, is Close range (-1 level), requires a full round casting (-1 level), and is Restricted Spell (War domain; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); throws up rampart providing cover, with an equivalent-volume ditch on the outward face. EntrenchS&M also includes Residual Spell, making it even mire difficult to get past (5th level; listed as 4th).
  • Stony RampartPnA: Creation (stone; 1st level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 3 cu. ft./level; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) = 0 level; creates one section of stone rampart (5 ft./level long x 3.5 ft. high x 2 in. thick; provides partial cover) lasting 1 min./level.

Ram’s MightSC: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Exotic Weapon Proficiency: unarmed attacks; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Strength domain; ­1 level) = 1st level; you gain +2 Str and unarmed attacks.

RancorMW: Invisible needle (0 level) + Variable Spell (versatile evocation and touch vs. ranged touch; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to extreme; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (quarry or favored enemy; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (ranger; -2 levels) = 1st level; damage cap +11d6, divided among interative attacks against quarry/favored enemies.

Random CausalityTM2: Compel (attack yourself or random ally; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (target of attack: touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Chaos domain; -1 level) = 4th level; weapon attacks wielder or one of wielder’s allies within close range (determine randomly) when used.

Random Dispatcher, Hornung’sTM2: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (target: touch to close; +1 level) + Reach Spell (teleport: close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Variable Spell (no control over destination plane; -1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Restricted Spell (wild magic; -1 level) = 9th level; swift casting sends target to another plane.

Rapid JourneyRR: Teleport (5th level) + Still Spell (+0 levels with metamagic synergy) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 jump/3 levels; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 8th level; as personal teleport, but you return 1 rd./level after arrival, or otherwise make up to 1 jump/3 levels during that duration.

Rapture of the DeepSW: Compel (be comatose; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as 6th); target grooves to sublime music and acts as if comatose while spell is maintained (350 x CL numen for duration past 1 hr./level); may drown if in water.

Ray of DizzinessSC: Inertia (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to ray; +0 levels) = 3rd level; ranged touch attack staggers target for 1 rd./level.

Ray of EntropySC: Ray of enfeeblement (1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 attribute/3 levels; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 5th level (listed as 6th); ranged touch imposes 1d6 +1/level (+15 max.) penalty to Str, Con, Dex (and Int at CL 12th, Wis at 15th, Cha at 18th).

Ray of FatigueS&M: Touch of fatigue (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) = 1st level.

Ray of HopeBED: Heorism (3rd level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd./level; -2 levels) = 2nd level (bard 1st).

Ray of the PythonPHII: Slow (3rd level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; target entangled and staggered (save each round to end effect).

RazorscalesSK: Bestow feat (Improved Grapple; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Vital Strike; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; for 1 rd./level, you can constrict for 1d6 + 1½ Str modifier.

Reality MaelstromMP: Variable Spell (+1 level):

  • Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (target: touich to medium; +1 level) + Reach Spell (destination: close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Variable Spell (random destination; -1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = +9 levels.
  • Mage hand (0 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 27 lbs./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (conc. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) = +9 levels.

+ Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 9th level (listed as 7th); opens small, one-way rift to random plane (Will save each round to avoid passing through), and those within 120 ft. of it (creatures, and unattended objects up to 27 lbs./level) must save vs. Will or be pulled into the area of the rift.

RebukeOA: Inertia (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 5th level (listed as 2nd); target is stunned 1 rd./level or until saves.

Rebuke DeathCRB: Stabilize (1st level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Healing domain; -1 level) = 0 level; as stabilize, but healing is 1d6 +1/level (+5 max.), rather than a fixed 1d6.

Recall AgonySRD: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (clairsentience; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; deals 5d6 necrotic damage (Intuition half).

Recall ChampionRR: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 12; +7 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (area hallowed to your deity; -1 level) = 8th level; summons one CR 12 hero (it can leave the hallowed area after being summoned).

Recall DeathSRD: Damage attribute (Con; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+4d4; +4 levels) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 level) + Cross-Class Spell (clairsentience; +1 level) = 8th level; deals up to 20d6 necrotic and 5d4 Con damage (Intuit half).

Recall TaleAUG2: Augury (2nd level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd.; +2 levels) + Variable Spell (gain random infotmation; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level; you gain 6-second story about an event in the history of the target item, creature, or place.

Recent OccupantAUG2: Augury (2nd level) + Mass Effect Spell (2 questions; +2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 0); you learn name and race of last creature of Int 3 or higher within 20 ft. of location of casting.

Reciprocal GyreCA: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Expedient Spell (special; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) = 5th level; target takes 1d6 force damage per level of active spell effects on it (max. 15d6, Will half) and is dazed 1 rd./level (Fort save each round to end dazing).

Reckless InfatuationUM: Compel (be near creature specified; 2nd level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) = 3rd level; subject attempts to stay within 30 ft. of specified individual. Invest 900 x CL (3rd level x 50 x 6 for 1-rd. duration) numen to maintain as a curse.

Red TideSW: Topple (0 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Augment Spell (nausea; +2 levels) + Fell Sickening (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Str; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant or Pestilence domain; -1 level) = 8th level; 3d4 Str damage plus knocked prone and nauseated 1 rd./level (Fort half/neg./sickened) in 20’r.

ReddopsiSRD: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (reverse back onto caster instead of dispelling; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (no check needed; +2 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Restricted Spell (kineticist; -1 level) = 8th level (listed as 7th); turns 1 spell/power targeting you per round.

Redemption from Evil PowerAUG2: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (no check needed; +2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (death or negative energy spells only; -2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 7th); instantaneously negates the effects of one [death] or negative energy spell cast at target within close range.

Redemptive RedressAUG2: Warding (1st level) + Variable Spell (select spell at time of casting; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); suppresses 1 spell affecting target for 1 rd./level.

Redirect Spell: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (redirect onto you instead of dispelling; -2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (no check needed; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 spell/3 levels; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (hostile spells targeting one ally only; -2 levels) = 4th level (paladin 3rd); each round, up to 1 hostile spell/3 levels targeting the ally you indicate during casting is redirected to you instead.

Reduce WeightAUG: Reduce (3rd level) + Selective Spell (weight only, not size or Stength; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 0); reduces weight or one creature or object by a factor of 8 (weapon becomes light weapon).

Refine Improvised WeaponACG: Bestow feat (Catch Off-Guard; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +4 levels) + Item-Specific Spell (improvised weapon touched; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); improvised weapon is treated as manufactured one, with no non-proficiency penalty.

Refuge: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to planar; +6 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (to caster’s abode only; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (standard action trigger; +2 levels) = 7th level; subject activates as a standard action, teleporting to your abode. AKA succorUA1.

Refusal, von Gasik’sTM2: Hedge (arcane casters; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (emanation to cubes; +0 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Widen Spell (5-ft. to 10-ft. cubes; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level; arcane casters barred from one 10-ft. cube/level area for 1 hr./level.

Regenerate: Remove condition (use of limb; 1st level) + Crippling Drain (regrow parts permanently lost; +4 levels) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Augment Spell (moderate to critical; +2 levels) = 7th level; cures 1d6 hp/level (max. 20d6), removes temporary loss of limb or organ function, and even regrows lost body parts.

RegroupPHII: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (targets; touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (all targets transported adjacent to you; -2 levels) = 3rd level.

Reincarnate: Remove condition (death; 1st level) + Crippling Drain (+4 levels) + Cascade Spell (polymorph: humanoid or animal; +3 levels) + Variable Spell (random result for new body; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (−2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Ancestors or Animal domain; -1 level) = 4th level.

Reinforce CampsiteUW: Invisible needle (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Cascade Spell [(figment; +1 level) + Delay Spell (enters area; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (audible, no speech; -1 level)] + Cascade Spell (endure elements; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Cascade Spell (touch of fatigue; -1 level) + Augment Spell (exhausted; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 5d6; -3 levels) = 5th level (listed as 4th); 40’r. area sounds alarm if entered by intruder, deals 5d6 piercing plus entangled 1 rd./level to intruders, and designated campers within gain endure elements, for 1 hr./level (but caster becomes exhausted).

Reinforce ConstructME: Spark of life (1st) + Cross-Class Spell (arcane; +1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 hr./level; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (construct only; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; construct gains 1d6/level (max. 5d6) temp. hp.

Rejuvenation CocoonCD: Spark of life (1st level) + Maximize Spell (+3 levels) + Cascade Spell (remove condition: afflictions; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (druid; -1 level) + Augment Spell (10d6 to 15d6; +1 level) + Augment Spell (moderate to serious; +1 level) = 5th level; heals subject 6/level (max. 90) damage and removes poison, disease.

Reloading HandsUC: Creation (1st level) + Variable Spell (as needed for ammo; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (shaping; +2 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (mundane ammunition only; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (1/rd.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 rd./level; -3 levels) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) = 1st level; weapon reloads self once per round with conjured ammunition for 1 rd./level.

Relocate TownRR: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Widen Spell (10 lbs./level to 500 lbs./level; +5 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (buildings, etc. of village only; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (destination: close to line of sight; +3 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (within forest; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 7th level; teleports village (up to one small building/level) up to ¼ mi./level away within the same forest.

Remote View TrapSRD: Warding (scrying; 1st level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (electric arc; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (scryer only; -2 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 10d6; -2 levels) = 6th level; cloaks you from scrying, and first attempt deals 10d6 electricity damage to scryer (save half). AKA seer’s banePF102. Variants:

  • Scry RetaliationAUG2: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +7 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (through scrying sensor; -2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (scryer; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); deals up to 10d6 force damage to a creature scrying on you (Reflex half).
  • Scry TrapME: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (blind; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (electric arc; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (dispel; +1 level) + Delay Spell (proximity to sensor; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (through scrying sensor; -2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (scryer; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 15d6; -1 level) = 5th level; when you approach within 10 ft. of a scrying sensor, the scryer takes 1d6 electricity/level (max. 15d6) and is blinded 1 rd./level (Fort half/neg.), and the scrying is dispelled.

Remove AddictionBED: Remove condition (addiction; 1st level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) = 2nd level.

Remove FatigueBED: Remove condition (debilitation; 1st level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 4th); touch reduces debilitation conditions (Chapter 7) by 1 step in up to 1 ally/3 levels. Variants:

  • Dispel ExhaustionPH1: Remove condition (fatigue; 1st level) + Augment Spell (moderate; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (arcane; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (humanoids only; −2 levels) + Shadow Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; touch heals up to 10d6 damage and removes fatigue/exhaustion, but only 20% real if Intuition save failed.
  • Limbs of EnduranceRR: Remove condition (debilitation; 2nd level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Endurance; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance: +1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (monk or paladin; -2 levels) = 4th level; reduces fatigue by 2 steps, and you gain +1 sacred bonus to saves and +1/2 levels (+10 max.) to Endurance for 1 hr./level.
  • Ray of ResurgenceLEF: Remove condition (fatigue; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (also Str damage/penalty; +1 level) = 3rd level (arcane 4th; listed as 1st/2nd); ranged touch removes exhaustion, fatigue, Str penalties, and/or up to 3d4 Str damage.
  • Refreshing RainPC: Remove condition (debilitation; 1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (also afflictions; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Weather domain; -1 level) = 4th level; lessens [afflictons] and [debilitation] conditions by 2 steps in 20’r. burst.
  • RefreshmentBED: Remove condition (debilitation; 1st level) + Augment Spell (minor to moderate; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (cures only nonlethal damage; -2 levels) = 3rd level; heals 1d6 hp/level (max. 10d6) of nonlethal damage and reduces [debilitation] conditions in 20’r. burst by 2 steps.
  • Renewed VigorPHII: Remove condition (debilitation; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: Con; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) = 4th level; reduces [debilitation] effects by 2 steps, and those affected gain +2 enhancement to Con for 1 min./level.
  • Second WindDr342: Remove condition (fatigue; 1st level) + Restricted Spell (access to Travel domain; -1 level) = 0 level; touch removes fatigue (or reduces exhaustion to fatigue). Dispel fatigueS&M (1st level) is Restricted to the Healing domain, and is Augmented to remove exhaustion as well.

Remove NauseaBED: Remove condition (afflictions; 1st level) + Augment Spell (minor to serious; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (no disease or poison; -2 levels) = 1st level; touch removes sickened, ailing, nauseated, or prostrate condition from target.

Remove SicknessUM: Warding (afflictions; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) = 5th level (listed as 1st); suppresses disease, sickness, nausea, poison, and prevents re-affliction. AKA Nezram’s amethyst auraLEF (listed as 3rd).

Rend the Sovereign SoulRR: Damage attribute (Wis; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (also Cha; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (saves only; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Augment Spell (+4d4; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (days to minutes; -2 levels) = 2nd level; target takes ­5d4/2 penalty to Intuition and Will saves (Will neg.) for 10 min./level. The penalties are reduced by 1 per 2 min. thereafter until gone. Multiple castings stack.

Renewed FocusRR: Hand of fate (1st level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost: (Dex; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (initiative only; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 2nd); swift casting allows you to reroll initiative with a +1 bonus.

Repair DamageSRD: Spark of life (1st) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (construct only; -2 levels) = 2nd level; repairs 1d6 + 1/level (max. 5d6+5) hp to damaged construct.

  • Heal constructDD is Maximized (+2 levels) and Augmented (10d6 to 20d6; +2 levels) = 6th level; construct is repaired by 6 hp/level (max. 120).
  • ReconstructDD: Resurrection (7th level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (destroyed construct; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (Craft Construct feat; -1 level) = 6th level (listed as 7th); repairs destroyed construct (up to 15d6 hp) and, if mindless, reprograms.

Repair UndeadACG: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Augment Spell (+1/level; +1 level) + Empower Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (undead; -2 levels) = 0 level (listed as 1st); touch heals one undead 1d8 + 1/level (+5 max.). Repair deadRR2 also incorporates the Mass Effect Spell feat (1/level; +3 levels) = 3rd level; repairs up to 10d8+10 hp to each damaged undead touched. Mass repair undeadACG (4th level; listed as 5th) is as repair deadRR2 but is usable at up to Medium range.

Repel Metal or Stone: Mage hand (0 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 27 lbs./level; +3 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (metal or stone objects only; -1 level) + Shape Spell (target to line; +1 level) + Extend Spell (concentration to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) = 7th level; repels all stone and metal within path, subject to weight limit (no save).

Repel Wood: Mage hand (0 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 8 lbs./level; +2 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (wooden objects only; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to line; +1 level) + Extend Spell (concentration to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) = 6th level; repels all wood within path, subject to weight limit (no save).

Replay TracksUW: Augury (2nd level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd.; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (events related to tracks you are following using Survival only; -2 levels) = 3rd level; with concentration, you can get a sense of events that occurred in conjunction with tracks/traces you are following.

ReprobationUM: Warding (religious class features; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (arcane mark; +1 level) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (member of caster’s religion; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (−2 levels) = 5th level; you mark a member of your faith as an apostate and remove his or her magical religious class features (divine spells, channeling, etc.). Repulsion, EpicSRD: Hedge (2nd level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1,000’r.; +5 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 9th level (listed as epic); specified creature or creature type cannot approach within 1,000 ft. of warded creature, object, or location. Invest 450 x CL numen to maintain effect indefinitely.

Reshape ShadowRR: Figment (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (shadow only; -2 levels) = 0 level.

Resilient Sphere, Otiluke’s: Mage armor (0 level) + Variable Spell (cover; +1 level) + Augment Spell (total cover; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (sphere is immobile; ­2 levels) + Cascade Spell [(bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level)] + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Expedient Spell (1 ft./level size limit; -1 level) = 4th level; subject grappled inside sphere of force granting total cover and lasting 1 min./level.

Resinous SkinUC: UnhandAUG2 (q.v.; 0 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; weapons striking you are disarmed from wielders (Reflex neg.), but you gain no DR or CMB/CMD bonuses.

Resinous TarCM: Bind (0 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) = 1st level; either object entangled with holder/user, or 10-ft. square entangles those entering it; total stickiness lasts 1 rd./level.

Resist ColdPH1: Warding (cold; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Expedient Spell (special; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); subject resists up to 3 hp/level (max. 30 hp) of natural and magical cold per round for 10 min./level.

Resist Planar AlignmentPnH: Warding (attribute penalties; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (from planar alignment only; -2 levels) = 1st level; subject does not take attribute penalties from planar alignment traits.

Retributive ImageCM: Figment (0 level) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (those disbelieving image; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Pattern Spell (-1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) = 5th level; as major image, but viewers who successfully disbelieve (Intuition) take up to 15d6 nonlethal damage and are dazed 1 rd. Return to DormancyUW: Compel (retreat from civilization; 2nd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (Colossal monster; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Tenacious Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 8th); forces Colossal monster saves vs. Will or retreat away from civilization (invest 200 x CL numen to maintain effect until creature attacked).

Righteous BurstPHII: Spark of life (1st) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) = 6th level; allies healed 1d6/level, enemies take 1d6/level negative energy damage (max. 15d6).

Righteous ChargeRR2: Bestow feat (1st level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 feat/3 levels; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (BAB +11 effects; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 5th level (Paladin 4th); you gain the Dodge feat, and can charge with a +40-ft. speed bonus, overrunning intervening opponents as attack actions and making attacks of opportunity against those you knock down or who try to avoid you. Righteous Wrath of the FaithfulCD: Spark of life (1st level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (haste: q.v.; +3 levels) + Augment Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Consecrate Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (worshipers of your deity; -2 levels) = 7th level; worshippers of your deity in 20’r. of you gain haste (with +3 net attack bonus), +1 sacred bonus to saves, and 15d6 temp. hp for 1 rd./level.

(+1 level) at Close range (+2 levels), lasts 1 rd./level (-1 level), and is Creature-Specific (provokes; -2 levels), Inexorable (+3 levels), Shadow (-1 level), and Reduced (-1 level) = 3rd level; 5d6 slashing (no save) vs. those in area who move about or otherwise provoke (effect is 20% real if disbelieved).

  • Whirlwind of teethBVD affects a 10’r. cylinder (+2 levels) at medium range (+3 levels), is Concentration rather than Extended (swift action; -1 level), and is Corrupt (+1 level) = 7th level; damage cap 15d6 (half slashing, half unholy) in 10’r., 50-ft.-tall cylinder you redirect each round as a swift action.

Rite of WinterRR: Ray of frost (0 level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 1 mile/level; +8 levels) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Reduce Spell (25d6 to 1d6 and -110 ft. to -10 ft.; -5 levels) = 6th level; -10 ft. speed, difficult terrain, and 1d6 cold/day over large area, lasting until spring (requires investiture of 300 x CL numen).

RockburstShS: Energy mace (0 level) + Energy Admixture (piercing; +0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 (divine 5d6), Reflex half.

Sensitivity to Psychic ImpressionsSRD: Detection (lingering thoughts/memories; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (aura lingering time: days to years; ad hoc +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to clairsentience discipline; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); 1st round—presence/absence of significant events involving strong emotions, 2nd round—general type(s), 3rd round—hazy vision of event begins, lasts as long as event did with continued concentration.   • For thought captureTM2, change the restriction to Akashic or Oracular mystery or Mind domain.

Sepia Snake Sigil: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +3 levels) + Delay Spell (until text read; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level; 4d4 Dex damage (Reflex half, paralyzed at 0). Note the numen investiture cost for latent spells.

Sequester: Warding (divinations; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (glamer; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (time hopSRD; +4 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 6th level; subject cannot act, is undetectable by divinations and sight.

SerenityUM: Whelm (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 crt./level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (attempting harm; -2 levels) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6. Serpent MuseBotD: Slow (q.v.; 3rd level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Scalykind domain; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 5th level; one target/level takes 10d6 necrotic damage and is slowed 1 rd./level (Fort half/neg.).

Serpent’s StareRR2: Compel (do nothing; 2nd level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Pattern Spell (gaze; -1 level) + Expedient Spell (individual HD; -1 level) = 2nd level; one creature of up to 6 HD is dazed while you concentrate, as long as it can see you.

Sessile SpiritOcA: Hedge (possessing spirits; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (emanation to target; -1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) = 3rd level; neutralizes spirit(s) inihabiting or possessing one creature or object for 1 rd./level.

Sevant HordeOA: Unseen servant (1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +4 levels) = 5th level.

Seven-EyesS&M: See invisibility (q.v.; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 rd./level; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell [(bestow feat: Alertness; 1st level) + Augment Spell (8 ranks effects; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (impr. uncanny dodge; -2 levels)] + Cascade Spell (warding: enchantment; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (warding: death effects; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Cascade Spell [(inure; +1 level) + Variable Spell (1st energy type affected by; +1 level)] + Variable Spell (1 attack/rd.):
