  • Eye of the Mage: Shaped (line) electric arc (+1 level); damage cap 20d6 electricity.
  • Eye of Venom: Damage attribute (Con; +1 level) + Reach Spell (+1 level) + Resistible Spell (save neg.; ­1 level) = +1 level; 1d4 Con damage (Fort neg.).
  • Eye of the Spirit: Enervation (4th level) + Reduce Spell (1d4 to 1; -3 levels) = +1 level; bestows 1 temp. negatve level.

+ Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (each attack can be used only once; -1 level) = 7th level; effects as shown.

SeverRR: Ray of obliviousness (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (also Cha; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+15 to +20; +1 level) = 5th level (listed as 7th); 1d6+1/level (+20 max.; Intuition half) penalty to Wis and Cha (may prevent casting of divine spells, channeling, etc.) while you concentrate and 1 rd./level thereafter.

Sever SpiritUW: Dispel (0 level) + Cascade Spell (compel; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (familiar or companion bond; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (extended sickening touch; -2 levels) = 6th level; ritual breaks bond with familiar, animal companion, bonded item, etc., which then hates its former master (if alive). Shade’s SightRR: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (see out of contiguous shadows only; -2 levels) = 1st level; subject can see out of shadows within Close range as if standing in them. Cf. Lorloveim’s creeping shadowTM2.

Shadow BindingCA: Bind (0 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) + Shadow Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; 10’r. burst dazes 1 rd. and entangles 1 rd./level. (20% real if disbelieved).

Shadow Blade TechniqueToB: Hand of fate (0 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level): Selective Spell (+1 level) or Cascade Spell (channeled ray of frost; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (attack roll; ­2 levels) = 1st level; roll attack roll twice, and either use the higher roll, or use the lower roll and deal +1d6 cold/level (+5d6 max.).

Shadow BoltDr181: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shadow Spell (evocation; +0 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); damage cap 10d6 budgeoning plus knocked prone; 10% real if disbelieved.

Shadow Bolt, Dar’Tan’sRR: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard action; +1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 10d6 negative energy (Fort half) to 1 target/rd. while you concentrate.

Shadow CacheMP: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Widen Spell (10 lbs./level to 80 lbs./level; +2 levels) + Item-Specific Spell (nonliving objects only; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (Plane of Shadow; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Tenacious Spell (+1 level) + Tenuous Spell (item goes missing 10%/day; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd). Invest 5,040 numen (4th level x CL 7th x 900 for command-word activation to return item x 1/5 for single return) while item is stashed, or until it is lost; you can immediately re-invest the numen, without the need to cast the spell again, if you choose to resend it.

Shadow CanopyRF: Gloom (0 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

  • Shape Spell (emanation to wall; +0 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. squares to 30-ft. squares; +2 levels)
  • Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (3 steps to 1 step; -2 levels)

+ Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level; 60’r., 30-ft. high ring of supernatural darkness (3 steps) encircles area of gloom (1 step light reduction).

Shadow ChainsRR2: Bind (0 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 7th level (listed as 4th); up to 1 creature/3 levels are treated as if grappling one another for up to 1 hr./level.

Shadow Conjuration: Bestow feat (Magical Talent; 1st level) + Variable Spell (choose spell at time of casting; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Quicken Spell; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow spell: Sudden Metamagic; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Shadow Spell (­1 level) = 4th level; swift casting allows you to immediately cast any [creation] or [summoning] spell of a level you can normally cast (likewise quickened if spell level is within the Sudden Metamagic limits), but created object(s) or summoned creature(s) are only 30% real.

  • Greater shadow conjuration is Augmented: 30% to 60% real (+3 levels) = 6th level. Shades (9th level) is augmented 3 more steps, to 90%.
  • Minor shadow conjurationRR (2nd level) is instead Reduced from 30% to 10% (-2 levels).
  • Shades (9th level) mimics spell of 8th level or less, and effects are 80% real.

Shadow DoorPH1: Glamer (1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Stealth; +1 level) + Augment Spell (invisibility; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Cascade Spell (figment; +1 level) + Variable Spell (scripted; +1 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) = 5th level; you become invisible 1 rd./level, and leave behind illusion of you stepping through a door that suddenly appears (illusion of empty 10 ft. x 10 ft. room beyond).

Shadow EnginesTM2: Energy mace (0 level) + Variable Spell (versatile evocation; +1 level) + Splash Evocation (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Shadow Spell (+0 levels) + Concentration Spell (partial action; +2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 7th); up to four quasi-real (40%) siege engines deal 17d6 total/rd. with ranged rouch attacks (divide damage among attacks), plus 5 splash damage to adjacent squares, while you concentrate.

Shadow Evocation: Shadow conjuration (q.v.; 4th level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) = 5th level; effects are 40% real.

  • Greater shadow evocation is Augmented from 40% to 60% (7th level). AKA shade evocationRR.
  • Minor shadow evocationRR is Reduced to 20% real (3rd level).

Shadow FormCAd: Skill enhancement (Escape Artist; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Stealth; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (blur; +2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 5th); subject gains concealment, +1/2 levels to Escape Artist and Stealth checks for 1 min./level.

Shadow GarroteToB: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 3rd); ranged touch deals up to 5d6 negative energy plus flat-footed 1 rd. Shadow nooseToB is Augmented (stunning; +3 levels) and Creature-Specific (flat-footed; -2 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 6th); damage cap 10d6 plus stunned 1 rd.

Shadow GauntletDR181: Variable Spell (+1 level):

  • Celerity (0 level) + Cascade Spell (sickening touch; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (ailing; +1 level) = +3 levels; -60 ft. to speed and ailing 1 rd./level.
  • Energy mace (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) = +3 levels; damage cap 21d6 bludgeoning, divided among attacks.
  • Deflection (0 level) + Cascade Spell (inure; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 damage type/3 levels; +2 levels) = +3 levels; +2 deflection to AC and DR 25/adamantine (30 at CL 12th, 35 at 14th, and 40 at 16th), plus like resistance to force (CL 12th), sonic (CR 15th) and negative energy (18th).

+ Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Shadow Spell (-1 level) = 6th level; choose function each round as a swift action (effects are only 50% real if disbelieved).

Shadow HandDr181: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (celerity; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift; +3 levels) + Shadow Spell (­1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 15d6 and 70’ to 50’; ­1 level) = 5th level; damage cap 20d6 force plus -50 ft. to speed (both divided among ranged touch attacks), and effects only 40% real if disbelieved.

Shadow InvasionPnA: Enhancement (2nd level) + Effect-Specific Spell (effects of disbelieved Shadow spells; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (gloom; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (summon; +1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 6 kyton; +3 levels) + Kindred Summon (40%; -3 levels) = 4th level; for 1 rd./level, 20’r. area has decreased illumination (2 steps), enhanced effects of Shadow Spells (+5%/4 levels), and a kyton has a 40% chance of stepping through.

Shadow of DenevRR2: Metaphysical feat (Ritual Spell; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (arcane spells only; -1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (+2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (druid or access to Time domain; -1 level) = 5th level; increases casting times of arcane spells in mobile 40’r.

Shadow ShieldRR: Gloom (0 level) + Cascade Spell (spook; +1 level) + Cascade Spell [(alter senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (visual; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels)] + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (onset: inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; you are shrouded in darkness (2 steps), and those within 5 ft. panicked and blinded while within and 1 rd./level thereafter (Will/Fort neg.).

Shadow SkeletonDr181: Summon (1st level) + Summon Undead (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (warding: positive energy; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (warding: fire; +1 level) + Augment Spell (1d4+1; +1 level) + Shadow Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; conjures 1d4+1 human skeletons (30% real if disbelieved) that are immune to cold, magical fire, and positive energy.

Shadow SmashRR: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (target: touch to close; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (Plane of Shadow; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (change of lighting; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level; transports object to Plane of Shadow if exposed to full light or darkness.

Shadow SpraySC: Damage attribute (Str; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze;+2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Shadow Spell (-1 level) = 4th level (listed as 2nd); 1d4 Dex damage and dazed 1 round (Fort half/neg.; 30% real if disbelieved) in 5’r. burst.

Shadow StepUM: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (between areas of darkness or dim light only; -1 level) = 0 level (listed as 4th).

Shadow StrikeRR: Bestow feat (Unstoppable Strike; 1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (also Fell Shot; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (vs. single target; -2 levels) = 3rd level; attacks from within 20 ft. of target are against its touch AC for 1 rd./level.

Shadow VeilCM: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 rd.; -1 level) = 0 level; target within Close range is blinded 1 rd. (Intuition neg.).

Shadow Walk: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

  • Reach Spell (close to continental; +4 levels) + Variable Spell (uncertain end point; -1 level) + Expedient Spell (travel takes 1 hour per 50 miles; ad hoc -1 level) = +2 levels.

+ Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level. AKA dream travelSRD.

Shadow WeaponUM: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Variable Spell (Versatile Evocation: piercing or bludgeoning; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Shadow Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 1d6; -2 levels) = 1st level; you can make up to 2 iterative melee touch attacks with semi-real melee weapon (1d6 damage each, and 1 hp damage on a successful Intuition disbelief save).   • Spectral weaponCAd is Quickened (+3 levels) and lasts only 1 rd./level (-1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 4d6, divided among iterative attacks, 20% if disbelieved.

Shadow, Enkili’sRR2: Skill enhancement (Stealth; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +3; +1 level) + Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell ([chaotic]; -1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); you gain +3 profane bonus to saves and +1/2 levels to Stealth for 1 hr./level.

ShadowcatTM2: Lorloveim’s creeping shadowTM (q.v., 3rd level) + Reach Spell (medium to long; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Variable Spell (“toggle” senses back and forth at will; +1 level) = 7th level.

ShadowfadeMP: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Variable Spell (bi-directional; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (Plane of Shadow; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to wall; +1 level) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 2.5-ft. squares; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 7th level (listed as 5th); you open a temporary gate to the Plane of Shadow.

Shambler: Summon (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (CR 6; +3 levels) + Augment Spell (1d4+1; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 9th level; summons 1d4+1 shambling mounds. Maintaining the effect past 1 hr./level requires either control of the shamblers through mark of the wild or else investiture of sufficient numen (9th x CL 17th x 500 x 1 = 76,500 if on guard duty, or 153,000 if actively marauding).

Shape ElementAUG: Shaping (2nd level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 5,832 cu. ft./level; +4 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; ­1 level) = 6th level.

Shape of the Hellspawned StalkerCM: Polymorph (3rd level) + Creature-Specific Spell (hellhound only; -2 levels) + Quicken Spell (+4 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; swift casting turns you into a hellhound (+2 Str, +2 natural armor, low-light vision, scent, resist fire 5, limited to 1 use of breath weapon) for 1 rd./level.

Shapechanger’s GiftUW: Polymorph (3rd level) + Variable Spell (animal, humanoid, or monstrous humanoid; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (attribute boost; -1 level) = 5th level; subject becomes Small or Medium animal, humanoid, or monstrous humanoid with no attribute bonus, can change form each round as a standard action (otherwise active 10 min./level).

Shapechanger’s Gift, GreaterUW: Shapechanger’s giftUW (q.v.; 5th level) + Cascade Spell (enlarge/reduce self; +1 level) + Extend Spell (10 min./level to 1 hr./level; +1 level) = 7th level; Tiny to Large animal, elemental, fey, humanoid, monstrous humanoid, and/or vermin.

Shard of ChaosUM: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Bane Spell (fixed: [lawful]; +0 levels) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (staggering; +1 level) + Restricted Spell ([chaotic] caster; -1 level) = 2nd level; damage cap 5d6 entropic (5d8 vs. lawful) plus staggered 1 rd.

Share MemoryUM: MindlinkSRD (1st level) + Augment Spell (memories, not just thoughts; ad hoc +2 levels) Extend Spell (1 min./level to inst.; -2 levels) = 1st level. AKA mindlinkOcA.

Shared HealingME: Spark of life (1st level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Delay Spell (use in increments as standard actions; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 2nd level; subject gains “pool” of healing (7d6 max.) that it can then allot to self as standard actions.

Share Pain, ForcedSRD: Spark of life (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 5th level (listed as 3rd); for 1 rd./level, each time you are damaged, 1d6 +1/level (+15 max.) hp worth are transferred to the target, if it is within Close range. Variants:

  • Devoted shieldRRO is Extended to 1 hr./level (+3 levels) and Restricted (access to Charm domain; -1 level) = 7th level (+20 max.). Devoted massesRRO affects 1 creature/level (+3 levels) and lasts only 1 min./level (-2 levels) = 8th level.
  • Unwilling ShieldAPG: Resistance (0 level) + Cascade Spell (deflection; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +1 level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 6th level; you gain +1 to saves, +2 to AC; when hit, your damage is reduced by up to 1d6 + 1/level hp (+20 max.) and designated target takes that amount in negative energy damage (save half).
  • Vampiric Shadow ShieldACG: Vampiric touch (q.v.; 3rd level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 5th level; melee attackers take 1d6 + 1/2 levels negative energy, you heal like amount.

SharpenRRE: Variable Spell (+1 level): shaping (2nd level) or Extended (1 hr./level) blessing (2nd level) + Object-Specific Spell (edged weapon; -2 levels) = 1st level; either restores edge to weapon touched (Craft check needed) or hones existing edge for +1 enhancement to attacks and damage for 1 hr./level.

Shatter: Sound lance (1st level) + Bane Spell (crystalline; +0 levels) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

  • Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) or
  • Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels)

= 2nd level; damage cap 10d6 (single target) or 5d6 (multiple fragile targets in a 5’r.). Variants:

  • Burst BondsAPG: Sound lance (1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Overwhelming Evocation (+1 level) + Object-Specific Spell (object or creature restraining you; -2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Augment Spell (0 to 5d6; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Inquisition or Liberation domain; -1 level) = 1st level; verbal-only, damage cap 5d6 sonic (ignores hardness and energy resistance).
  • Sympathetic Vibration: Sound lance (1st level) + Overwhelming Evocation (+2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cubes; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. cubes to 60-ft. cubes; +3 levels) + Object-Specific Spell (structures only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 6th level (bard 5th); 15d6 sonic/rd. (bypasses hardness and/or sonic resistance) to structure(s) in up to one 60-ft. cube/level.

Suppress SchismME: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 effect/3 levels; +2 levels) + Bouncing Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell ([mind-affecting], possession, telepathy, etc.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 5th level; dispels or suppresses up to 1 effect/level as listed above, and subject must succeed at opposed Concentration checks to cast/manifest same.

Suppressing Field, Otiluke’sCM: Warding (1st level) + Variable Spell (choose school or subtype at time of casting; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; prevents casting of one school or descriptor (e.g., [evil] or [fire]) of magic in area.

Sure StrikePHII: Bestow feat (Insightful Strike; 1st level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (BAB +6 effects; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); as a swift action, apply your highest mental attribute modifier as a bonus to your next attack roll and damage.

Sure-Footed Shuffle, Otto’sGA: Skill enhancement (Acrobatics; 0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Communal Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; each target +1/2 levels (+5 max.) to Acrobatics.

SurelifeSRD: Warding (1st level) + Variable Spell (declare at time of casting; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 8th); subject immune to one specific harmful condition or attack form (e.g., swords, or drowning) for 1 min./level.

Surge Selector, Hornung’sTM2: Hand of fate (0 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (wild surges; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (wild magic; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 7th); for the next 1 hr./level, roll twice when triggering a wild surge and select which result to use (you know what dice rolls will result in).

Surmount AfflictionUM: Warding (1st level) + Variable Spell (one condition type specified at casting; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 2nd level; suspends effects of 1 condition (not necessarily an [affliction]) for 1 rd./level.

SuspensionShS: Mage hand (0 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 5,832 lbs./level; +5 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 2 hrs./level; +6 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (move unattended object only; -2 levels) + Pacific Spell (-2 levels) = 7th level (listed as 4th); levitates extremely large objects (buildings, bridges, etc.), can move them with concentrations, and they otherwise hover in place for up to 2 hrs./level.

SustenanceSRD: Creation (nutritious liquid; 1st level) + Delay Spell (time release; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (1 cu. ft./level to 1/8 cu. ft./level; -1 level) = 2nd level; you are fully nourished (in terms of food and water) for 1 hr./level. SustainBED also adds Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/ level; +3 levels) and Ritual Spell (full round; ­1 level) = 4th level.

Swarm of CrystalsSRD: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (30 ft. to 15 ft.; -1 level) + Inexorable Evocation (+3 levels) + Reduce Spell (10d6 to 5d6; -1 level) = 3rd level; 5d6 slashing to those in 15-ft. cone (no save). Variants:

  • Blast of SandSst: Invocation of the knife (0 level) + Silent Spell (+1 level) + Adamantine Evocation (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) = 3rd level (divine 4th); damage cap 10d6 slashing and full damage to objects in 30-ft. cone; bypasses DR/adamantine.
  • Diamond SprayBED: Light (0 level) + Augment Spell (dazzling; +4 levels) + Extend Spell (light: 10 min./level to inst.; -3 levels) + Extend Spell (dazzling: 1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (invocation of the knife; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) + Widen Spell (30-ft. to 60-ft.; +1 level) + Restricted Spell ([good] descriptor; -1 level) = 4th level; damage cap 10d6 slashing plus dazzles 1 rd./level in 60-ft. cone.

Swarm SkinAPG: Summon (1st level) + Variable Spell (combine types and/or numbers; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+4 levels) + Concentration Spell (standard action; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (witch, or access to Pestilence domain; -1 level) = 6th level; you summon up to 3d6 spider swarms, 2d4+1 rat swarms, 1d4+1 crab or wasp swarms, 1d3 centipede or leech swarms, or 1 army ant swarm. You can also “mix-and-match” by selecting fewer numbers (e.g., 1 centipede swarm plus 1d3 wasp swarms). The swarms are active only as long as you consciously direct them, and then disperse.

Swift Mount, Drawmij’sGA: Celerity (0 level) + Variable Spell (primary movement rate; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (animal or magical beast used as a mount; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+10 ft. to +30 ft.; +1 level) = 2nd level; mount’s primary speed increases by +30 ft.

  • Holy spursMH is not extended (-2 levels), and is Sudden (+0 levels), Augmented (+10 ft. to +40 ft.; +3 levels), and Restricted (paladin; -2 levels) = 1st level; swift casting increases your mount’s speed by 40 ft. for 1 rd.

Swift WaterRR: Celerity (0 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Target-Specific Spell (ship only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Augment Spell (+10 ft. to +50 ft.; +2 levels) = 2nd level; increases ship’s speed by 5 mph for 1 hr./level. Billowed sailRRO is Augmented one more step (3rd level; speed increase of 7 mph).

SwimCA: Celerity (swim speed; 0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Augment Spell (+10 ft. to +30 ft.; +1 level) = 1st level; target gains swim speed 30 ft. (or +30 ft. to existing) for 10 min./level.

Swim, QuickswimSW: Celerity (swim speed; 0 level) Still Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger or access to Water domain; -1 level) = 1st level; your swim speed increases by +10 ft.

Swim, SpeedMF: Celerity (swim; 0 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + [Cascade Spell (augmented bull’s strength; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (carrying capacity only; -2 levels)] + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) = 3rd level; grants swim speed of 30 ft. and doubles carrying capacity for 1 min./level.

Swim, Touch of the SeaAPG: Celerity (swim speed; 0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+10 ft. to +30 ft.; +1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); grants swim speed of 30 ft. for 1 min./level.

Swimmer, ChampionRR2: Bestow feat (Favored Terrain; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Athletics; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); subject gains favored terrain (underwater) +2 and an additional +1/2 levels (+10 max.) enhancement to Athletic checks for 1 min./level.

Swoop, Bendal’s7S: CatfallSRD (q.v.; 0 level) – Effect-Specific Spell (+2 levels) = 2nd level; immediate casting turns fall into 20-ft. flight.

Sword of ConscienceBED: Damage attribute (Wis; 1st level) +Mass Effect Spell (+1 attrubute; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (evil only; -2 levels) = 4th level; one evil creature takes 4d4 Wis and 4d4 Cha damage (Will half).

Swords of the Ash WingsBotD: Jet of flame (0 level) + Energy Admixture (slashing; +0 levels) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Damnation domain, etc.; -1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap +10d6 (half fire, half slashing) to one melee attack or Close ranged attack.

Symbol of HealingUM: Spark of life (1st level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 5th level; listed as 3rd.

Symbol of HopelessnessPH1: Compel (surrender; 2nd level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 9th level (listed as 7th).

Symbol of Insanity: Damage attribute (Wis; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Crippling Drain (+2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r; +1 level) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 8th level; deals 3d4 Wis drain when triggered.

Symbol of MirroringUM: Figment (duplicate image of creature in area; 0 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +4 levels) + Delay Spell (proximity actibating condition; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 3rd level; when triggered, creates 1 illusory duplicate each of up to 1 creature/level within 30 ft.

Symbol of Persuasion: Ray of beguiling (1st level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to 0; -1 level) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 6th level; 1d6 +1/level (+15 max.) Cha penalty vs. caster (Intuition half, charmed at 1) in 40’r. for 1 hr./level.

Symbol of RevelationUM: Warding (glamers; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (light; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 6th level (listed as 4th); when invisible, glamered, or shapechanged creature triggers symbol, all such in area are limned in faerie fire for 10 min./level..

Symbol of SealingUM: Wall of force (5th level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (over door or other portal only; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level; when triggered by unauthorized intruder, a wall of force lasting 10 min./level appears over the warded portal.

Symbol of ScryingUM: Scrying (4th level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) = 6th level; when triggered, you can scry area for 10 min./level.

Symbol of SlowingUM: Slow (3rd level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to 0; -1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level.

Symbol of Spell LossMF: SpellcrashACG (q.v.; 5th level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 8th level; when activated, those in area lose 1 prepared spell, spell slot, or daily spell-like ability use per round (starting with the highest-level and working down) until a save is made.

Symbol of Stunning: Compel (do nothing; 2nd level) + Augment Spell (stun; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level.; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (proximity activating condition; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 7th level. Note numen investiture for latent spells (8th x CL 15th x 50 = 6,000).

Symbol of VulnerabilityUM: Warding (1st level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels: resistance, energy resistance, DR, SR; +3 levels) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 9th level; when activated, those in area lose resistance bonuses to saves, energy resistance, spell resistance, damage reduction, and up to 2-3 other forms of protection for 1 min./level.

Symbol of Weakness: Damage attribute (Str; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +2 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Selective Spell (password bypass; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 7th level; 4d4 Str damage to up to 1 creature per level.

Synaptic PulseOcA: Inertia (0 level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (telepath, psychic, etc.; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); stuns those in 20’r. for 1 rd.

Synaptic Pulse, GreaterOcA: Synaptic pulse (q.v.; 4th level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Fell Sickening (+1 level) = 5th level; stuns (Will sickens) 1 rd./level or until save.

Synaptic ScrambleOcA: Ray of obliviousness (1st level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stagger; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd. to 1 rd./level; +1 level) = 4th level; close target takes 1d6 +1/level (+15 max.) penalty to Wis (Intution half, confused at 1) and is staggered for 1 rd./level.

SynestheteSRD: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (other senses; +1 level) + Augment Spell (2 senses affected; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 1st); you can feel either light or sound, making your eyes or ears (respectively) extraneous. Alternatively, you can see sound or hear light (bypassing the blinded, dazzled, and/or deafened condition).

Synostodweomer, Simbul’sMF: Bestow feat (Magical Talent: arcane cure light wounds; 1st level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Augment Spell (6 ranks; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Spontaneous Spell; +1 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 7th); for the next 1 rd./level, you can spontaneously convert your spells of up to 3rd level into cure wounds spells.

Tactical AcumenUC: Deflection (0 level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Augment Spell (scaling bonus; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (those gaining combat Aid Another bonuses only; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 2nd level; you and allies within 20 ft. receiving Aid Another from allies in combat gain an additional +2 deflection to AC (+1/6 levels) and +1 (+1/6 levels) to attacks and damage.

Tactical FormationDG: Deflection (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/level; +3 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (recipients must remain adjacent to one another; -2 levels) = 3rd level; +2 deflection to AC of adjacent allies.

Tactical PrecisionCAd: Bestow feat (Improved Flanking; 1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +11 effects; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (bard; -1 level) = 3rd level.

Tail StrikePC: Energy mace (0 level) + Variable Spell (ranged or melee; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Whirlwind Strike; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (also Ranged Threat; +1 level) + Augment Spell (BAB +6 effects; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift; +3 levels) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 1d6; -3 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 4th); you gain a secondary tail attack (base 1d6 damage) that can extend to Close range (and threatens that area), or can make a primary sweep attack as a full-round action..

TailwindUW: Celerity (0 level) + Variable Spell (land or fly speed; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Selective Spell (+1 level) +Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (affected creatures must remain within 120 ft. of one another; -2 levels) + Reduce Spell (+60 ft. to +20 ft.; -2 levels) = 4th level; affected creatures gain long-lasting +20 ft. to speed, as long as they stay together. Tail CurrentUW is Location-Specific (underwater; -2 levels) and Reduced one less step (40 ft. to 20 ft.; +1 level) = 3rd level.

Take on the MantleAU: Attribute boost (Str; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (inure: bludgeoning; +1 level) + Energy Admixture (piercing and slashing; +0 levels) + Tenuous Spell (overcome by magic; -1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 attribute/3 levels; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (+4 total attribute bonus; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (spell resistance; +5 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (paladin; -2 levels) = 4th level; you gain +4 enhancement to Str and Con (and Cha at CL 9th, Wis at 12th, Dex at 15th, Int at 18th), SR 10 + your Concentration bonus, and DR 5/magic or adamantine (10 at CL 12th). Starting at 12th level in Prestige Paladin, you can cast this spell as a swift action with your swift abjuration ability.

TanglefootTM2: Bind (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 10 min./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to War domain; -1 level) = 4th level; one 10-ft. square/level area entangles those within.

Tar BallUM: Jet of flame (0 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Cascade Spell (ray of clumsiness; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (-1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) = 2nd level; ranged attack deals up to 5d6 fire plus 1d6 burn and 1d6 + ½ levels penalty to Dex.

Tar PoolUC: Jet of flame (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Lingering Evocation (+1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to burst; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Residual Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 6th level; damage cap 10d6 fire/rd. and entangles those in area of difficult terrain, plus 2d6/rd. burn thereafter.

TathlumDDG1: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Delay Spell (until used; +1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level):

  • vs. allies of head: Empower Spell (+1 level) + Creature-Specific Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; sling stone deals up to +15d6 negative energy damage.
  • vs. relatives of head: Maximize Spell (+2 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (-2 levels) = 4th level; damage cap +60 hp negative energy.
  • vs. others: 4th level; damage cap +10d6.

The spell’s material component is a severed head, dipped in lime and allowed to harden into a sling stone.

Tattoo ItemRR: Shrink item (3rd level) + Ritual Spell (­2 levels) = 1st level. Invest 50 x CL personal numen to make permanent (as latent spell effect) but the effects of beneficial magic items in tattoo form are suppressed; to maintain their effects in that state, see meld objectRR (q.v.).

TauntUA1: Compel (attack me; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (target to spread; +3 levels) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) + Expedient Spell (total HD; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); taunting causes up to 2d4 +1/level (+5 max.) HD worth of creatures to attack you. Cf. compel hostilityUC.

Tears of PainAUG: Resistance (0 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = 2nd level (listed as 1st); subject -1 to saves. Invest 400 x CL numen to maintain curse.

Telekinetic AssemblyUC: Fabricate (5th level) + Widen Spell (8 cu. ft./level to 216 cu. ft./level; +2 level) + Object-Specific Spell (siege engine only; -2 levels) – Cascade Spell (caster needs Craft skill; -1 level) = 3rd level; ritual with successful Craft check assembles one Large siege engine from raw materials (at 19th level, you can assemble 2 Large or one Huge engine instead).

Telekinetic ChargeUC: Mage hand (0 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 27 lbs./level; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (concentration to inst.; -1 level) = 2nd level; ally violently thrust through the air up to Close range, counts as charge without costing them movement.

Telekinetic FistCRB: Energy mace (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) = 1st level; ranged touch deals up to 5d6 bludgeoning. AKA stone blastAUG.

Telekinetic ForceSRD: Mage hand (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 27 lbs./level; +2 levels) = 3rd level.

Telekinetic ManeuverSRD: Bind, push, or topple (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) Variable Spell (+1 level) + Concentration Spell (standard; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple possible; +1 level) = 4th level; each round you concentrate, you can bull rush, grapple, or trip one opponent.

Telekinetic ProjectileOcA: Mage hand (0 level) + Cascade Spell (energy mace; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (damage to projectile and target; +1 level) + Manifested Spell (-1 level) + Reduce Spell (5d6 to 1d6; -1 level) = 0 level; close ranged attack deals 1d6 bludgeoning to projectile used (1 lb./level, up to 5 lbs. max.) and target struck.

Telekinetic Sphere, Otiluke’s: Otiluke’s resilient sphere (q.v.; 4th level) + Cascade Spell (mage hand; +1 level) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 216 lbs./level; +3 levels) = 8th level.

Telekinetic StormOcA: Bolt of force (2nd level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (stun; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) = 9th level; damage cap 25d6 force plus stuns enemies 1 rd. in a 40’r. burst from you (force can destroy barriers and extend beyond them).

Telekinetic ThrustSRD: Mage hand (0 level) + Cascade Spell (invisible needle; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (1 lb./level to 8 lbs./level; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Manifested Spell (­1 level) = 3rd level; damage cap 13d6, divided among objects.

Telepathic CensurePC: Warding (telepathy; 1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd); target cannot send or receive telepathic communication.

Telepathic DistractionMC: Resistance (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 to +3; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (vs. [mind-affecting] only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (whelm; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) + Restricted Spell (telepathy ability or access to Telapthy discipline; -1 level) = 0 level; 1d6 nonlethal plus -3 to saves vs. [mind-affecting] for 1 min./level (Will half/neg.).

Telepathic StrikeDr345: Alter senses (0 level) + Augment Spell (vision; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (auditory also; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Int; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 attribute/3 levels; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to planar; +6 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (special; see below; -2 levels) = 9th level (listed as 3rd); you can see or hear through the eyes and ears of 1 creature on the same plane, and can deal 1d4 damage to each attribute of 1 creature within sight of the alter senses target.

TelepathyOcA: MindlinkSRD (1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to personal; -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 120’r.; +3 levels) + Tenuous Spell (subjects must remain within emanation for effect to continue; -1 level) = 4th level; you can mentally communicate with all creatures within 120 ft. of you, for 1 min./level.

Telepathy BlockBED: Warding (mindlink and derivatives; 1st level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) = 5th level; blocks telepathic communication in 60’r. emanation.

Telepathy TapBED: Detection (telepathy; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (concentration to 1 rd./level; +1 level) + Language-Dependent Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level; allows you to detect and eavesdrop on telepathic communication within medium range for 1 rd./level, but only if you understand the communicants’ language(s).

Teleport AttackAUG: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Con; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+2d4; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grapple; +1 level) = 7th level; touch teleports target into object within close range, where is grappled 1 rd./level and takes 3d4 Con/rd. (Fort half).

Teleport BlockAUG2: Warding (teleportation; 1st level) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +3 levels) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 5th level. Cf. dimensional lock.

Teleport Coordinates TransferAUG2: Detection (2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to planar; +6 levels) + Shape Spell (cone to target; -1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (teleport coordinates only; -2 levels) - Concentration Spell (-1 level) = 4th level; you gain “very familiar” knowledge of teleport destination.

Teleport Object: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Widen Spell (10 lbs./level to 30 lbs./level; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to interplanar; +6 levels) + Variable Spell (destination; +1 level) + Target-Specific Spell (object only; -2 levels) = 7th level; teleports object within weight limit elsewhere on same plane, or into the Deep Ethereal. AKA vanishPH1.

Teleport TracerAUG2: Detection (teleport destination; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (time ago of teleport: inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) – Concentration Spell (-1 level) = 7th level (listed as 6th); learn destination of last teleport from within a medium-range quarter-circle. Cf. trace teleportSRD.

Teleport TriggerSRD: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to continental; +5 levels) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Mishap Possibility (ad hoc -1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 5th level.

Teleport, BalefulSRD: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (necromancy to conjuration [teleportation]; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) = 2nd level (listed as 5th); deals up to 10d6 negative energy damage (Fort half).

Teleport, DivertSRD: Dispel (0 level) + Augment Spell (divert instead of negate; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (teleportation only; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) = 7th level; immediate casting redirects teleports made during the next round from within (or into) 60 ft. of you. Variants:

  • Conjuration FoilUI: Dispel (0 level) + Augment Spell (redirect, rather than dispel; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (extradimensional transportation only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (ray of entropy; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Quicken Spell (+3 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6; -2 levels) = 4th level; immediate casting causes one creature teleporting to/from area or being summoned into it to arrive at a random destination and take 5d6 negative energy damage (Will neg./half).
  • Desert DiversionSSt: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +2 levels) + Augment Spell (divert instead of negate; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (no check needed; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (teleportation only; -2 levels) + Location-Specific Spell (waste; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) = 4th level; teleportation by subject leads to a waste spot within range, rather than intended destination.
  • Teleport RedirectAUG2: Dispel (0 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Augment Spell (divert instead of negate; +1 level) + Irresistible Spell (no check needed; +2 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (teleportation only; -2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) = 9th level (listed as 5th); redirects teleportation made from within (or into) area.

Teleport, Fiendish: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to planar; +5 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (outsider; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (self and 50 lbs. only; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (fiendish caster; -1 level) = 3rd level; this is the greater teleport ability used by demons, devils, etc.

Teleport, InterplanetaryUM: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to planar; +6 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (you must accompany them; -1 level) = 9th level.

Teleport, Trobriand’s BalefulWCS: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (target: touch to close; +1 level) + Reach Spell (destination: close to continental; +4 levels) = 6th level; transport close target to destination within 100 miles/level. Thasdrubal’s laganetic transfer (from Jack Vance’s The Eyes of the Overworld) is similar, but the victim must be helpless or restrained (4th level).

Teleportation Circle: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to planar; +6 levels) + Irresistible Spell (not blocked by earth or stone; +2 levels) + Inexorable Spell (no save; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (targets to spread; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; -2 levels) + Delay Spell (until activated, +1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (designated target location; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 9th level; invest numen (as a command-activated item) to make it re-usable.

Teleport, TraceSRD: Detection (teleport destination; 2nd level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Extend Spell (time ago of teleport: inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) = 5th level; with concentration, you learn about teleportation from area within the last 1 rd./level: 1st rd.—presence or absence; 2nd rd.—number and greatest range category; 3rd—destinations. Cf. teleport tracerAUG2.

Temporal AccelerationSRD: Time stop (q.v.; 9th level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Cascade Spell (spook; -1 level) = 8th level (listed as 6th); swift time stop lasts 1 rd.; you are shaken thereafter.

Temporal DivergencePC: Augury (2nd level) + Cross-Class Spell (arcane; +1 level) – Ritual Spell (+2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Selective Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (effects of next spell cast; -2 levels) = 7th level; resolve two spells you could cast that round, then retain the casting desired, after seeing the results (if DC 24 Spellcraft check fails, you take 7d4 Wis damage).

Temporal JoltDr350: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1/3 levels; +2 levels) + Variable Spell (other targets are armor and/or items held by primary target; +1 level) + Reduce Spell (15d6 to 10d6; -1 level) = 4th level; ranged touches deal 10d6 entropic to target and its armor (if any separately), plus up to 1 item held per 3 levels above 6th.

Temporal RegressionPC: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Cascade Spell (spark of life; +2 levels) + Cascade Spell (remove condition; +1 level) + Variable Spell (+1 level) + Delay Spell (swift; +3 levels) + Itnterrupting Spell (+1 level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (location and condition at time of casting; -2 levels) = 8th level; immediate casting transports you to where you were when you cast the spell (if within Close range), heals you up to 20d6 hp taken since then, and removes any one condition accrued since then.

Temporal RepairDr350: Warding (Time domain; 1st level) + Cascade Spell [(dispel; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (Time spells only; -2 levels)] + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) = 5th level; dispels Time domain spell effects and prevents those spells from impinging into the area.

Temporal Stasis: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+4d4; +3 levels) + Crippling Drain (+4 levels) + Tenuous Spell (susceptible to dispel magic; -1 level) = 8th level; touch deals 5d4 Dex drain, and target in stasis if Dex 0 or lower. Variants:

  • Amber PrisonDHD: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Augment Spell (+1d4; +1 level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) + Variable Spell (Con damage when Dex 0; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 4th level; touch deals 2d4 Dex drain/rd. or until save (Fort half/neg.), then 1d4 Con damage/rd. after Dex reaches 0.
  • ImprisonmentSRD: Temporal stasis (q.v.; 8th level) - Tenuous Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (dimensional skip, into the ground; +1 level) + Reach Spell (destination: close to line of sight; +3 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (name and background must be cited; -2 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 9th level; subject entombed in suspended animation in a cyst ¼ mile/level beneath the surface of the earth. Variant:
  • Absolute BindingRR: Imprisonment (q.v.; 9th level) + Cascade Spell (warding: divinations; +1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Crippling Drain (+1 level) + Irresistible Spell (+2 levels) + Inexorable Spell (+3 levels) + Cascade Spell (energy drain; -9 levels) = 9th level; as imprisonment, but Dex drain is 6d4, no save or SR applies, divination spells cannot locate imprisoned creature, and effect cannopt be dispelled. Upon completion of casting, caster takes 1d4 permanent negative levels/rd. (Fort neg., save each round to end effect).
  • SinkUA1: Damage attribute (Dex; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (shaping; +3 levels) + Effect-Specific Spell (into ground; -1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to medium; +1 level) + Augment Spell (+3d4; +2 levels) + Crippling Drain (+3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 8th level; target takes 4d4 Dex drain (suspended animation at 0) and sinks into the ground (save half/neg.).
  • TimelessnessTM2 is Augmented only to 4d4 (-2 levels) and is Delayed instead of Tenuous (effect ends after specified time limit passes; +2 levels) = 8th level; touch deals 4d4 Dex drain, target in stasis if Dex 0 or lower. All drain immediately removed at end of specified time period.

Temporal VenomAUG2: Ray of obliviousness (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Channel Spell (+1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 hit or touch/level; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 3rd level; one touch (or hit with affected weapon) per level inflicts 1d6+½ levels (+10 max.) penalty to Wis (confused at 1, no save) for 1 rd./level.

Tempus FugitUA1: Bestow feat (Skill Focus: Endurance; 1st level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Endurance; +1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (restless slumber only; -2 levels) + Cascade Spell (bestow feat: Fast Recovery; +1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) = 5th level; affected creatures heal at 2x normal rate and regain spells, etc. as if had Endurance as a class skill with 10 ranks more than is actually the case (e.g., those with 0 ranks are fully rested after 4 hours; those with 10 ranks after 1 hour). Note that this construction differs from the one shown in Chapter 8; consider this as a separate version. Variants:

  • Accelerate healingTM2 requires a full ritual casting (-2 levels) and is Restricted (bard or access to Time domain; -1 level) = 2nd level; subject gains Fast Recovery feat and +1/2 levels Endurance for 1 hr./level, or longer if you invest 2,000 x CL numen.
  • Bring down the moonAUG incorporates blessing instead of Fast Recovery, affects a 60’r. (+3 levels), and is Location-Specific (outdoors, when moon visible in sky; -2 levels) = 6th level (listed as 8th); those in area receive bless spell and heal, regain spells, etc. as if had Endurance as a class skill with 10 ranks more than is actually the case.
  • Nap stackAPG affects a 20’r. (+1 level) but requires a full ritual casting (-2 levels) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); affected creatures heal at 2x normal rate and have reduced need for sleep (as if Endurance a class skill with +1/2 levels additional ranks).
  • Restful sleepAPG is similar to nap stackAPG, but affects 1 creature/3 levels instead of an area (+1 level), and is Effect-Specific (regain hp only; -2 levels) and Restricted (bard; -1 level) = 2nd level; 1 ally/3 levels heal wounds at twice the normal rate.

Tentacle WallsTM2: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Tenacious Spell (+1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 10 min./level; +4 levels) + Delay Spell (activating condition; +1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 7th level; six tentacles attack intruders (ranged touch for 3d6 each plus entangled) for up to 1 min./level. After that time, you can immediately re-invest the latent spell numen to reset the trap.

TentaclesCWH: Energy mace (0 level) + Cascade Spell (bind; +1 level) + Augment Spell (grappled; +1 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (mage hand; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Athletics; +1 level) + Concentration Spell (swift action; +3 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 15d6 and +10 to +5; -1 level) = 6th level; you gain two secondary tentacle attacks (10d6 bludgeoning each plus grappled 1 rd./2 levels), +5 to Athletics checks, and can manipulate objects at Close range.

Teratoid CaressPC: Damage attribute (1st level) + Variable Spell (Dex or Cha, randomly; -1 level) + Accursed Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Creature-Specific Spell (see below; -2 levels) + Restricted Spell (demon cultist; -1 level) = 3rd level; touch deals 1d4 Dex or Cha damage. Invest 150 x CL numen for this damage to recur whenever the subject of the curse casts a [good] spell, channels positive energy, or offers a prayer to a good-aligned deity.

Terra Cotta LionOA: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 6 animated object; +4 levels) = 5th level; animates statuette into a Huge animated object (8 HD; CP 4: faster, stone, 2 additional attacks).

Terra Cotta WarriorOA: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 2 animated object; +2 levels) = 3rd level; animates statuette into a Medium animated object (4 HD; CP 2: faster, stone).

Terrain BondUC: Bestow feat (Favored Terrain; 1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+6 terrain bonus; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (ranger; -2 levels) = 4th level; you gain one favored terrain with a +6 bonus, or else improve one by +4 (subject to normal maximum).

ThalassemiaSW: Ray of entropy (1st level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Bane Spell (fixed: [fire]; +0 levels) + Augment Spell (1d6 to 15d6; +3 levels) = 3rd level (listed as 5th); damage cap 15d6 necrotic (15d6 vs. [fire]) by touch.

Theft WardARG: Skill enhancement (Perception; 0 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (notice theft; -2 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 to +5; +1 levels) = 1st level; you are +1/2 levels (max. +10) to Perception checks to notice theft (pickpocketing, etc.) from you.

There/Not ThereTM2: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Transdimensional Spell (ethereal plane; +1 level) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Widen Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 min./level; +3 levels) + Variable Spell (object might be ethereal for some onlookers and not others, but no control over effect; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (wild magic; -1 level) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 4th level; single object up to 400 lbs. is 50% likely to be ethereal with respect to each individual observer.

Thief WardAUG2: Skill enhancement (Stealth; 0 level) + Shape Spell (target to emanation; +3 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 40’r.; +1 level) = 4th level (listed as 2nd); −1/2 levels to Stealth checks made within 40 ft. of you.

Thief’s LamentTM2: Skill enhancement (0 level) + Hex Spell (+0 levels) + Reach Spell (touch to close; +1 level) + Mass Effect Spell (1 skill/3 levels; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to cubes; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (10-ft. to 5-ft.; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 1 hr./level; +2 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Law or Greed domain; −1 level) = 4th level (listed as 3rd); -10 penalty to Disable Device, Sleight of Hand, and Stealth checks in affected area; also Bluff at CL 12th, Athletics at 15th, Perception at 18th.

Thin AirFB: Ray of enfeeblement (1st level) + Variable Spell (divide among attributes; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to emanation; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) + Tenuous Spell (those with favored terrain or no breath immune; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (+15 to +5; -2 levels) = 2nd level; total attribute penalty of 1d6 + ½ levels (+5 max., divided evenly among stats), Fort half total.

Thirst for WarRR: Deflection (0 level) + Cascade Spell (resistance; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (blessing; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (skill enhancement: Endurance; +1 level) + Consecrate/Corrupt Spell (+1 level) + Augment Spell (+1 level) + Extend Spell (1 min./level to 2 hrs./level; +3 levels) + Mass Effect Spell (1 creature/level; +3 levels) + Cascade Spell (enervation; -4 levels) + Ritual Spell (-2 levels) = 5th level; one subject/level gains long-lasting +3 sacred/profane bonus to AC, attacks, damage, saves, and Endurance checks; you gain 1d4 temp. negative levels.

Thorn BodyAPG: Invisible needle (0 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +3 levels) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) = 3rd level; non-reach melee attackers take 1d6 piercing +1/level (+10 max.) per hit against you. Variants:

  • Blackthorns7S Cascades [mage armor (+1 level) + Variable Spell (cover bonus; +1 level) + Extend Spell (-1 level)], and is Personal (-1 level) and Reduced (+10 to +0; -2 levels) = 1st level; you gain +4 cover bonus to AC, and damage is only 1d6 per hit.
  • BonebladesRR2 is Extended (1 hr./level; +3 levels), Effect-Specific (grapple only; -2 levels), Variable Spell (grappling or grappled; +1 level), and Reduced (+15 to +10; -1 level) = 5th level; target deals 1d6 +1/level (+10 max.) piercing/rd. to those grappled.
  • Cape of WaspsUM: Invisible needle (0 level) + Cascade Spell (damage attribute: Dex; +2 levels) + Shielding Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (blur; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Restricted Spell (witch or access to vermin-related bloodline, domain, etc.; -1 level) + Reduce Spell (+15 to +10; -1 level) = 4th level; wasp swarm provides you with partial concealment, and melee attackers take 1d6 +1/level (+10 max.) piercing plus 1d4 Dex (Fort half).
  • Carnivorous plant defenseAUG adds Energy Admixture (slashing and bludgeoning; +0 levels), and is Extended (1 min./level; +1 level) and Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 3rd level.
  • IronbeardARG Cascades deflection (+0 levels due to metamagic synergy), and is Extended (1 min./level; +1 level), Effect-Specific (grappling only; -2 levels), and Reduced (+5 to +0 and +2 to +1; -1 level) = 1st level; for 1 min./level, subject gains +1 deflection and deals 1d6 piercing damage to grappling opponents.
  • Poison thornsCD Cascades [damage attribute (Str; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level)], and is Personal (-1 level) and Restricted (access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 5th level; melee attackers take 1d6 +1/level (+15 max.) plus poison (1d4 Str/rd., initial save half, save each round after first to end ongoing damage).
  • ThornskinCA is also Variable (+0 levels due to metamagic synergy) and adds Ray Splitting (+1 level), Channel Spell (+1 level), and Reduce Spell (15d6 to 5d6 and +15 to +5; -2 levels) = 3rd level; you deal +8d6 piercing damage (divided among melee attacks), and melee attackers hitting you take 1d6+5 piercing per hit.

Thorn WhipPH5: Mage hand (0 level) + Cross-Class Spell (+1 level) + Cascade Spell (invisible needle; +1 level) + Restricted Spell (access to Plant domain; -1 level) = 1st level (listed as 0); damage cap 5d6 percing plus pull up to 20 ft. closer.

Thought BroadcastTM2: Detection (thoughts; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (cone to emanation; +1 level) + Extend Spell (concentration to 1 min./level; +2 levels) + Restricted Spell (access to Mind domain; -1 level) = 4th level; all within 20’r. of target can “hear” its thoughts (Intuition neg.).

Thought EchoOcA: Glamer (1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to touch; -1 level) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 min./level; +1 level) = 1st level; mind reading reveals illusory thoughts rather than target’s actual ones; Intuition disbelief applies.

Thought ShieldSRD: Spell resistance (q.v.; 5th level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Effect-Specific Spell (mind-affecting; -2 levels) = 3rd level; as an immediate action, you gain SR 10 + Concentration bonus vs. [mind-affecting] spells and powers for 1 rd. Variants:

  • Enshroud ThoughtsOcA is Extended (1 min./level to 10 min./level; +1 level) rather than Sudden and Interrupting (-1 level) = 3rd level (listed as 2nd).
  • Insane FocusAPG is Extended (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) rather than Sudden and Interrupting (-1 level), Cascades lesser compelling confusion (-1 level), and is Restricted (access to Madness domain; -1 level) = 0 level; if resistance overcome, subject must save or be confused 1 rd. (SR from this spell does not apply).
  • Tower of Iron WillSRD is Shaped (target to emanation; +2 levels) and Widened (20’r. to 10’r.; -1 level) = 4th level (listed as 5th).
  • Tower of Iron Will, GreaterOcA also affects a 10’r. emanation, but is Quickened (+3 levels) and Extended (1 min./level to 1 rd./level; -1 level) rather than Sudden = 5th level; as above, but lasts longer.

ThoughtsenseOcA: Detection (thoughts; 2nd level) + Shape Spell (cone to emanation; +1 level) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 60’r.; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (concentration to 1 min./level; +2 levels) = 7th level (listed as 4th); you automatically sense presence, locations, and sentience (non-, animal, full) within 60 ft. for 1 min./level.

Threefold AspectAPG: Glamer (1st level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Variable Spell (attribute boost: +2 levels) + Extend Spell (1 rd./level to 1 hr./level; +3 levels) = 5th level; you seem as you did/will when you were/will be a young adult (+2 Dex, +2 Con, -2 Wis), mature adult (+2 Int, +2 Wis, -2 Dex), or elder (+4 Int, +4 Wis, -4 Str, ­2 Dex), and can switch back and forth as a standard action. Illusion has verbal, auditory, olfactory, and tactile components.

Threestones7S: Energy mace (0 level) + Ray Splitting (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to target; +0 levels) = 2nd level; damage cap 12d6 bludgeoning (Reflex half), divided among targets.

Thunder FieldPHII: Sound lance (1st level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to spread; +2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Reduce Spell (20d6 to 15d6; -1 level) = 6th level (bard 5th); damage cap 15d6 sonic/rd. and trips those in a 20’r. spread.

Thunder StaffTM2: Alter senses (deafness; 0 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Shape Spell (target to cone; +1 level) + Explosive Spell (+1 level) = 5th level; 30-ft. cone dazes 1 rd. and deafens 1 rd./level (Fort neg.), and Reflex save or ejected from area.

ThunderclapPH5: Sound lance (1st level) + Still Spell (+1 level) + Reach Spell (close to 0; -1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) + Widen Spell (20’r. to 5’r.; ­2 levels) = 1st level (listed as 0); damage cap 5d6 sonic in 5’r. of you (Fort half).

Thunderclap, GreatMF: Topple (0 level) + Cascade Spell (alter senses: hearing; +1 level) + Cascade Spell (inertia; +1 level) + Augment Spell (daze; +2 levels) + Reach Spell (close to long; +1 level) + Shape Spell (target to burst; +2 levels) = 7th level; knocks prone, dazes 1 rd., and deafens 1 rd./level.

Thundering DrumsAPG: Sound lance (1st level) + Cascade Spell (topple; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to cone; +1 level) + Widen Spell (30-ft. to 15-ft.; -1 level) = 2nd level (bard 1st); deals 1d6 sonic/level (max. 5d6) and knocks prone.

ThunderstompACG: Topple (0 level).

Thunderstomp, GreaterACG: Topple (0 level) + Reach Spell (close to medium; +1 level) + Shape Spell (ray to line; +1 level) = 2nd level.

Tiger’s ToothMH: Greater magic fang (q.v.; 3rd level) + Extend Spell (1 hr./level to 1 min./level; -2 levels) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Sudden Spell (+0 levels) + Augment Spell (+1 to +1/3 levels; +2 levels) = 2nd level; swift casting grants you +1/3 levels to one natural attack, or (2 + 1/3 levels) divided among multiple natural attacks, for 1 rd.

Time HopSRD: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Reach Spell (target: touch to close; +1 level) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 rd./level; +2 levels) + Tenuous Spell (-1 level) = 3rd level. In essence, the subject teleports to its current location, but the transfer takes 1 rd./level (or until saves) instead of occurring instantaneously. Variants:

  • Fiery discorporationSRD: Dimensional skip (1st level) + Cross-Class Spell (psychokinesis; +1 level) + Personal Spell (-1 level) + Delay Spell (+1 level) + Interrupting Spell (+1 level) + Location-Specific Spell (see below; -2 levels) + Extend Spell (inst. to 1 hr./level; +5 levels) + Ritual Spell (full round; -1 level) = 5th level; an instant before you would otherwise be killed, you are teleported 1 hr./level into the future if within 30 ft. of an open flame.
  • Mass time hopSRD is Extended (1 hr./level; +3 levels), Mass Effect (1 target/level; +3 levels), and Creature-Specific (willing creatures only; -2 levels) rather than Tenuous (+1 level) = 8th level.

Unusual Spells

The seed spell and metamagic rules are intended to provide the tools to construct nearly any spell. However, in some cases it can be far more time-effective to directly model new spells on existing ones, making cosmetic changes as needed. This is not always recommended, but can be used in a pinch when converting or designing new spells on the fly.

For example, assume that interposing hand and so on were not in the core rulebook or anywhere else, but we wanted to invent something similar, and didn’t want to spend a lot of time and effort doing it. Making an air elemental appear as a floating hand would allow the following “spells by analogy:”

Bigby’s Interposing Hand: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 6 Large air elemental; +4 levels) = 5th level. Three of the elemental’s feats should be exchanged for Combat Expertise, Shared Shield, and Defensive Rebuke; one of its skills should be exchanged for Planar Sense.

Bigby’s Forceful Hand: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 8 Huge air elemental; +5 levels) = 6th level; Improved Bull Rush feat.

Bigby’s Clenched Fist: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 12 elder air elemental; +7 levels) = 8th level; Staggering Strike, Combat Expertise, Shared Shield, Defensive Rebuke.

Bigby’s Grasping Hand: Summon (1st level) + Augment Spell (CR 10 greater air elemental; +6 levels) = 7th level spell providing cover and protection; the elemental uses its attacks to grapple and restrain, and its movement to remain interposed between you and attackers. Trade five of its feats for Combat Expertise, Shared Shield, Defensive Rebuke, Improved Bull Rush, and Improved Grapple.

Bigby’s Crushing Hand: Bigby’s clenched fist (q.v., 8th level) + Augment Spell (1d4+1; +1 level) = 9th level; 1d4+1 elder air elementals with Improved Grapple, Vital Strike.
